ashby:1password:b141ee0c-30aa-42f8-8ff7-.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Principal Solutions Engineer, Acceleration, you’ll help define how 1Password brings emerging technologies to market. Working across Product Management, Product Marketing, Enablement, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and strategic customers, you’ll validate new capabilities, shape product direction through field feedback, and turn what works into repeatable customer-facing motions.



Your work will help customers adopt innovations that strengthen secure access for people, machines, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents while advancing 1Password’s mission to make secure access simpler. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Solutions Engineering, this remote role is open to candidates in the United States or Canada and may involve up to 30% travel.



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 - 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles within enterprise Business-to-Business Software as a Service (B2B SaaS), including leading initiatives beyond an individual sales territory.

 - A track record of translating emerging technologies into customer value, repeatable field motions, and clear recommendations that shape product or go-to-market direction.

 - Experience partnering effectively with Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to validate capabilities and incorporate customer feedback.

 - Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence audiences ranging from technical practitioners to senior executives, analysts, and strategic partners.

 - Deep knowledge of modern identity architectures and developer or AI-powered workflows, including Open Authorization (OAuth), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure automation, AI agents, and modern cloud platforms.

 - Experience with Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, and Competition (MEDDPICC), or a similar enterprise sales methodology, along with the ability to work autonomously and influence without direct authority.





Bonus points for:

 - Experience with private previews, beta programs, or early-stage products; technical enablement and customer-facing content; or domains such as Artificial Intelligence Security (AI Security), Developer Security, Privileged Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, or Unified Access Management is preferred. 

 - A track record of public speaking, technical writing, podcasts, analyst engagements, or other forms of technical thought leadership is also valued.







What you can expect:

 - Lead technical validation for emerging products, strategic initiatives, and incubating technologies from early development through general availability.

 - Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, and Engineering to shape product direction and turn field feedback into actionable recommendations.

 -  Build repeatable discovery frameworks, demonstrations, technical messaging, reference architectures, and implementation guidance for the global Solutions Engineering organization.

 - Design and deliver technical enablement, including workshops, labs, certifications, and playbooks that help Solutions Engineers confidently support new capabilities.

 - Lead strategic customer engagements, private previews, beta programs, and early-adopter initiatives, providing executive-level technical guidance and influencing customer outcomes.

 - Identify emerging market opportunities and represent 1Password through executive briefings, conferences, webinars, podcasts, customer events, and industry content.

 - Mentor Solutions Engineers and lead cross-functional initiatives that accelerate adoption, strengthen technical excellence, and scale what works across the organization.
   
   



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $171,000 USD and $248,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $170,000 CAD and $247,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.



1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.

 - 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing, with direct experience in password management, enterprise vaulting, credentials security, or identity security.

 - Working knowledge of broad cybersecurity concepts.

 - You've repositioned a mature enterprise product. You know the difference between a messaging refresh and actually shifting how the market thinks about something.

 - You can market to enterprise IT and security buyers: the admin managing rollout, the CISO approving the spend, and the security engineer evaluating the technical depth.

 - A track record of winning in competitive markets by displacing incumbents, not just differentiating in an open field.

Technical Depth

 - You understand how credentials work beyond passwords: API keys, certificates, machine secrets, passkeys, and what it takes to issue credentials to AI agents.

 - Working knowledge of enterprise IT: MDM, SSO, directory services, and where password management fits in the IAM stack.

AI-Forward, Not AI-Dependent

 - You use AI to go faster, not to think less. You know what to hand off and what to own, and you can tell good output from output that still needs work.

 - You want AI to free up time for the work only a good product marketer can do: strategy, judgment, and narrative.

 - You own the ideas you bring. Walk into a room with a recommendation and you can defend it. Candidates who produce content but can’t explain the thinking behind it won’t fit here.

Strategic Storytelling and Senior-Level Communication

 - You write for multiple audiences without diluting the message. An IT admin and a CISO aren't reading the same document for the same reason. You know how to serve both.

 - Strong narrative instincts: open with the problem, build to the solution, and land in a way that makes the reader feel the product was built for their situation.

 - You’ve shaped category narratives, not just contributed to them.



Bonus points for:

 - Security certifications (CISSP, Security+, or similar).

 - Experience developing thought leadership in a fast-moving category. 1Password has a team that produces content. This role provides the point of view.

 - You've repositioned an established product category. There's a real difference between entering a space and redefining it.



What you can expect:

Own EPM Product Marketing

 - Own messaging, positioning, and launch strategy for the Enterprise Password Manager.

 - Define how 1Password talks about credentials security for employees, service accounts, and AI agents.

 - Tell the story clearly to analysts, IT buyers, security leaders, and sellers. The narrative has to work for practitioners and executives.

 - Connect EPM’s story to the Unified Access platform narrative.

Build Competitive Intelligence and Category Positioning

 - Own positioning and market leadership claims for EPM.

 - Partner with Solutions Marketing on competitive differentiation. Know the competitive set cold: where they’re strong, where they’re not, and how to win against each.

 - Track where the credentials security market is moving and keep 1Password’s messaging ahead of it.

Enable the Field with Tools That Actually Get Used

 - Produce discovery decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and technical briefs that sellers and SEs reach for because they work.

 - Take complex concepts like passkeys, machine credential lifecycle, AI agent authentication, and zero-knowledge architecture and make them usable in a customer conversation.

 - Surface win/loss signals from the field and turn them into repeatable GTM motions, not one-off documents.

Influence EPM Product Strategy

 - Bring the market's perspective to Product: customer evidence, analyst intelligence, competitive signals, field feedback.

 - Make the market case early, before decisions are locked.
   
   

Why join us:

 - The credentials security market is being reshaped by machine identities and AI agents. You'll own how 1Password tells that story.

 - You'll work across product strategy, competitive positioning, and field execution. The work is visible at the executive level.

 - 1Password is remote-first and has been since day one. We hire for judgment, not proximity.

 - The company is growing and there's room to shape how PMM works here, not just execute what's already been defined.

You’ll partner with Engineering, Design, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn complex security challenges into products that are clear, useful, and measurable. Reporting to the Director, Product Management – Device Security, this is a remote role open to candidates in the United States or Canada.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

Required qualifications

• 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of security, Identity and Access Management (IAM), endpoint, or access-control products.

• Experience contributing to product vision and strategy across multiple engineering teams or product areas.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience creating PRDs, PR/FAQs, and other artifacts that align teams and support decision-making.

• Experience defining Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), success metrics, and measurement frameworks connected to business outcomes.

• The ability to communicate complex security and product concepts clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders.

• A customer-centered approach to prioritization that combines qualitative insight with quantitative data.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with endpoint security, device management, zero-trust, least-privilege architectures, or related security technologies.

• Familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.

• Experience working with enterprise administration consoles and IT buyer or administrator personas.

• Experience taking AI or machine-learning products from concept to initial launch.

• Experience prototyping with AI-enabled developer tools and curiosity about how AI agents operate.

• Familiarity with device compliance frameworks, endpoint telemetry platforms, or related security systems.



What you can expect:

Own and evolve the Device Security product roadmap, partnering with engineering leadership to define priorities and deliver key capabilities.

• Shape the role of Device Security within 1Password Unified Access and contribute to cross-company product strategy.

• Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly prioritization, balancing near-term delivery with an 18–24 month product vision.

• Represent the customer perspective through discovery, feedback loops, recorded and live demos, and structured product artifacts such as Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and Product Requirements/FAQs (PR/FAQs).

• Collaborate with Product Managers (PMs) across adjacent product areas, as well as Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing.

• Establish success metrics that connect customer outcomes and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) contribution to product progress.

• Engage directly with enterprise customers, including Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), Vice Presidents of Security, and Information Technology (IT) leaders.

• Prototype proof-of-value solutions using AI-enabled developer tools to explore and communicate product ideas.

Security isn't a feature at 1Password. It is the product. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape security strategy across the company, working with Security Engineering, who hold one of the highest technical bars in the industry, and with the product teams building everything our customers touch.


You'll be the bridge. You'll understand cryptographic and architectural detail well enough to earn the trust of our security engineers, and you'll translate what matters into clear priorities for feature teams. Just as importantly, you'll bring a deep respect for the customer: a security control nobody can stand to use makes everyone less safe. You'll help us find the design that's both rigorous and usable, and have the credibility to say so in a room full of experts



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product teams on security early. Work with PMs and feature teams to understand their upcoming roadmaps, identify security requirements and threat-model implications before designs are locked, and make sure those needs are visible, prioritized, and resourced.

 - Align Security Engineering with product strategy. Translate feature-team needs into prioritized security work, and make Security Engineering's priorities legible to the rest of the company so tradeoffs are made in the open.

 - Own an independent security roadmap. Set direction for platform-level security investments, such as key management and recovery, the cryptographic foundations of our zero-knowledge architecture, authentication, and our long-term readiness for post-quantum cryptography.

 - Lead our strategy for the AI era. Define how 1Password approaches agentic access to credentials, secrets for non-human identities and AI agents, and the trust models emerging around tools and protocols like MCP.

 - Balance risk and usability with evidence. Help security engineers weigh real-world risk against user friction, using adoption, support, and telemetry data alongside threat models. Shipping with accepted, documented residual risk is sometimes the right call, and you'll help us make and defend those decisions.

 - Represent 1Password to the security community. Engage with security researchers and our bug bounty program, speak at conferences, and contribute to the wider conversation about where credential security is heading.

 - Raise the bar for product work. Coach PMs on security thinking, challenge assumptions constructively, and set the standard for how security-critical product work gets done.




OUR PHILOSOPHY ON PRODUCT CONSISTS OF FIVE CORE PILLARS:



 - Focus and execution: Can you ship quickly and measure results?

 - Customer empathy: Are you motivated first and foremost to solve customer problems?

 - Effective communication: Can you bring the entire organization, horizontally and vertically, along on the journey?

 - Go to market: Can you understand and drive business outcomes through product decisions?

 - Technology: Articulating how our technology beats our competitors



Product Managers play a highly visible role at 1Password and are critical to the development and execution of our product strategy. As PMs, we are responsible for setting and championing a high bar for our products. At the Principal level, you also set the standard for how product work gets done. You coach, you challenge assumptions, and you make the whole team better. You must excel at prioritization, collaboration, and communication, while holding yourself and others accountable for measuring quality and business results. You will work with Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM teams to ensure every decision we make as a product is grounded in our commitment to verifiable security.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of product management experience, including significant time on security-critical products or platforms in a SaaS environment. We'll also strongly consider exceptional candidates with equivalent depth, such as security engineers or researchers who moved into product.

 - Deep, demonstrable knowledge of security fundamentals: cryptography, authentication protocols, identity and access management, zero-knowledge and end-to-end encrypted system design, and threat modeling.

 - Fluency in the credential and identity landscape, including passkeys, WebAuthn/FIDO, and the standards shaping how people sign in.

 - A track record of earning credibility with security engineering teams, not just working alongside them.

 - The ability to read and reason through technical specifications, security audits, and cryptographic design documents.

 - Experience making and defending risk-based tradeoffs, and explaining them clearly to engineers, executives, and customers.

 - A history of shipping security features that users actually adopt, and of using friction and adoption data to improve them.

 - Experience setting strategy at the platform or infrastructure level, and influencing roadmaps you don't own without formal authority.

 - Communication that scales from a security research paper to an executive briefing without losing precision in either direction.

 - A strong point of view on how the security landscape is shifting, and the ability to connect it to concrete roadmap decisions.


STRONG PLUS

 - Standing in the security community, through conference talks, publications, research, open-source work, or standards participation.

 - Hands-on experience with AI security: agent identity and authorization, prompt injection, secrets management for automated systems.

 - Experience with compliance and certification regimes such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, or FIPS.

 - Prior work in vulnerability disclosure, incident response, or threat intelligence that gives you a practitioner's intuition.

 - Experience running or working closely with a bug bounty program or researcher community.




WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

 - Working with a passionate, highly motivated Product and Security team that holds an exceptional bar and genuinely cares about getting it right

 - A direct line to decisions that shape the security architecture millions of people depend on every day

 - Empowerment to set long-term security product strategy and drive it through execution

 - A culture where technical depth is respected, tradeoffs are named honestly, and shipping the right thing matters more than shipping fast

 - A collaborative environment where the best argument wins, regardless of title

 - Focus and Execution — can you ship quickly and measure results?

 - Customer Empathy — are you motivated first and foremost to solve customer problems?

 - Effective Communication — can you bring the entire organization — horizontally and vertically — along on the journey?

 - Go To Market — can you understand and drive the business outcomes through product decisions?

 - Technology — articulating how our technology beats our competitors.

Product Managers play a highly visible role in the company and are critical to the development and execution of our product strategy. As PMs, we are responsible for setting and championing the high bar for our products. You must excel at prioritization, collaboration, and communication, while holding yourself and others accountable for measuring quality and business results. You'll work with other PMs to understand customer problems and define requirements so your engineering counterparts can create great solutions, and you'll take a holistic view of customer needs that cross buyers, users, and administrators. You will work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and GTM teams to ensure the quality, security, and usability of the service.

 - 5+ years of product management experience owning a product or a set of features and being responsible for its ultimate success, in B2B or enterprise software

 - A track record of shipping and improving software and driving business impact through the features or products you owned

 - Experience building for administrator or IT personas — workflows, dashboards, APIs, or enterprise governance capabilities

 - Strong experience with API first product design, API development, and API management workflows, with the technical depth to engage directly with system architecture and developer documentation

 - An action-bias that won't wait to create change

 - Obsession with internal and external customer problems, and the ability to represent the voice of the customer to motivate the team

 - Strong presentation and leadership skills

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills that scale from technical to non-technical audiences

 - Ability to inspire and bring together different teams and stakeholders to drive forward, solve problems, and remove roadblocks

 - Ability to prioritize tasks and use data — both qualitative and quantitative — to drive decision-making

 - Strong background and experience in cybersecurity is needed.

 - Experience training internal teams as part of bringing products to market, particularly sales, support, and customer success

 - Working with a passionate, highly motivated Product team that is invested in your success and the success of your initiatives

 - A dynamic, highly collaborative environment

 - Empowerment to contribute to, and help drive, overall product strategy and the relative priority of the features you own on the roadmap

 - Being a part of the team that drives the success of 1Password, our products, and business to the next level

lever:achievers:33b4e5e0-f9ca-4ff6-972a-.description:
Achievers is an employee recognition and engagement platform, and our mission is to Change the Way the World Works. We help companies celebrate great work, build stronger cultures, and make sure people feel valued. Every day, our platform powers millions of recognition moments for global, multi-generational workforces.  We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the product behind our Milestone and Celebration experiences. This is the part of Achievers that recognizes work anniversaries, birthdays, and service milestones, the moments people tend to remember from their time at a company. You’ll work in a product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, setting the roadmap and leading the work together. When the product works, a hard-earned anniversary or a quiet milestone gets noticed instead of slipping past. Millions of those moments run through what you would build.  Learn more about the domain here: https://www.achievers.com/platform/celebrate/ Why you`ll love this role::
  • Your work will change how millions of people feel about their jobs. Change the Way the World Works is the mission, and this product is one of the places you can watch it happen.
  • You’ll own product strategy for a core part of the platform, reporting to the Digital Product Director who leads our Member Experience portfolio.
  • You’ll work in a true product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, sharing direction and delivery rather than handing off specs.
  • You`ll join a team that values empathy, ownership, and high standards, and gives you room to make decisions that matter.
  • You`ll thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation is encouraged and your voice truly matters.
    • How you'll shape our Milestone and Celebration experiences::
  • Set the roadmap and lead the work alongside your Product Designer and Lead Engineer, across web, mobile, and the channels we integrate with.
  • Understand the admins and program owners who run recognition and the employees who receive it, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
  • Improve the automation that spots employee milestones and sends timely, personal celebrations without creating extra work for admins.
  • Keep the experience feeling personal and authentic rather than automated and generic.
  • Use data, research, and experimentation to guide decisions and measure impact, including participation, recipient response, on-time delivery, and engagement.
  • Work with enterprise customers and teams across Achievers to understand their programs, cultural norms, and configuration needs in different regions.
  • Make sure celebration experiences work at global scale, with localization, multiple languages, and culturally appropriate recognition across regions.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, raising the standard of the work without managing anyone directly.
    • Experience we feel will set you up for success::
  • 5+ years of hand-on product management experience, shipping digital products end to end in SaaS or B2B2C.
  • Advanced experience in a product triad, or close partnership with Design and Engineering with shared ownership of strategy and delivery.
  • Comfort using data, research, and experimentation to decide what to build and to measure results.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align people without relying on authority.
  • A strong interest in building products that people enjoy using.

    • Advantageous but not required

  • Experience in employee experience, engagement, HR tech, or recognition platforms.
  • Experience with automated or triggered experiences, personalization, or messaging and notifications.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations such as Workday or SuccessFactors.
  • Comfort with SQL or BI tools for exploring engagement and sentiment data.
  • Interest in applying new technology and AI to improve product experiences.

About Us 

 Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

 Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

 Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. equity.quote: As a total compensation company, Amazon's package may include other elements such as sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs).

amazon:amazon:10577301.description:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

- 3+ years of product management experience

Amazon Web Services is seeking a bilingual (English/French) Solutions Architect to join the Agentic WorkSpaces team in Toronto, Canada. The primary mandate is mastery of the Agentic WorkSpaces platform. You will architect, deploy, and optimize Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions using Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Core, as well as Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (formerly AppStream 2.0). The secondary mandate is applied AI consulting. You will guide customers through the agentic AI capabilities integrated into Agentic WorkSpaces—including AI agent configuration, foundation model selection via Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication patterns. You will evaluate LLM performance, design agent evaluation frameworks, and advise on deployment models for production AI workloads. This role requires a "200+" level of technical depth—sufficient to lead customer conversations, conduct hands-on demonstrations, and identify when to engage deeper AI engineering resources.

Canada represents a strategic growth market for Agentic WorkSpaces. Federal, provincial, and regulated-sector clients (financial services, healthcare, public sector) require native-level French engagement for procurement, compliance documentation, and day-to-day technical consulting. This role directly serves Canadian public sector and enterprise clients, leading discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and production readiness assessments in both English and French. Toronto offers geographic proximity to Canada's largest concentration of businesses while providing access to bilingual talent.

Availability to travel up to 25%–50% of the time for on-site customer engagements across Canada.

amazon:amazon:10559423.description:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

-Engage with demand planning to understand and align on topline demand and confidence intervals

These plans are consumed by middle and last mile teams to plan labor and capacity. In collaboration with partner networks, the team builds granular plans covering short (Running 12-Week) and long term (up to 5 Year) time horizon. The team is also responsible for continuous improvements in the tools and process and improving accuracy, flexibility, and resiliency.

Do you like startups? Are you interested in cloud computing? Yes? 

We have a role you might find interesting. Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers, or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that’s capital, engineering resource, or experience. This is where you come in. 

The AWS Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with these early stage startup companies as they build their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so. 

We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with early stage startups to help them as they grow. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories and it’s important that we can help startups take advantages of the right ones. You’ll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the startups you work with. And for the customers you don’t get to work with on a 1:1 basis you’ll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.

Along the way, you’ll work together to solve technical problems, manage costs, or bring a product to market faster. amazon:amazon:10537815.description:
A fulfillment center can appear to be a chaotic place. With millions of items moving in and out of an area twice as large as your average theme park every day, a quick peek under the roof would reveal a manic scene. You would see associates, machinery, vehicles, robots, and packages flying about at break-neck speeds and accessing a breathtaking number of shelves and bins that store products. In reality, however, this activity is all highly organized and orchestrated by software, with each movement carefully planned and optimized. There are times when mistakes occur though, and products disappear, reappear in strange places, are damaged, or worse. When that happens, how does a fulfillment center operating at that size, speed, and scale recover gracefully and with minimal cost? How do we ensure that we meet our commitments to our customers and merchants? How do we find a needle in a haystack when we’re constantly shuffling the haystack around? And how do we do it at extreme scale in an environment of constant growth?

That’s where we come in, the AFT Quality team. Our goal is to prevent entropy in a system in which there are billions of transactions driven by human and robotic input across hundreds of millions of items every year. We must ensure that the virtual and physical state of the world is aligned inside hundreds of Amazon’s fulfillment centers globally. When our job is done well, mistakes are corrected quickly, and products are always ready to sell and ship.

We operate at a nexus of machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and healthy measure of hard-earned expertise in operations to build automated, algorithmic approaches to solving these problems at minimal cost. We create cutting edge software, building automated processes and workflows in the most complex operational problem space in the business world.

Key job responsibilities
-Define the strategy and roadmap for solving the complex, ambiguous problems that emerge throughout fulfillment operations, driving org-wide alignment on the path forward.
-Partner with customers and stakeholders to shape the requirements and specifications that define new product offerings from the ground up.
-Collaborate with scientists to apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technologies, including computer vision, to overcome challenges unique to the scale of the "everything store."
-Own the end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs that advance the organization's long-term goals of improving customer satisfaction and lowering costs.
-Lead high-stakes initiatives that cut across organizational boundaries, uniting disparate teams around a single outcome.
-Communicate initiative status and strategy to senior leadership and stakeholders, keeping them aligned and bought in.
-Engage with executives, principal engineers, managers, scientists, and product owners to drive resolution on contentious technical topics.
-Invent the mechanisms and metrics that turn ambiguous, complex initiatives into measurable, trusted impact.
-Understand system architectures deeply enough to challenge engineering teams, spot risks in technical proposals, and foster simplifications.
-Dive deep into the data or the code to unearth hidden opportunities and crack the toughest problems.
-Mentor TPMs and engineers, participate in promotions for senior employees, and contribute to talent development across the organization.

A day in the life

Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. amazon:amazon:10551580.description:
The AI Center of Excellence builds shared AI building blocks - primitives - that change how Amazon's systems work, not what features they ship. We take on the hardest problems first, prove each primitive with one partner on one real problem, then open it up so any team at Amazon can adopt what we've validated without solving it again.

We are looking for a Product Manager - Technical who can own the vision and lifecycle of these primitives, drive them from concept through adoption, and make sound product and technical trade-offs in a fast-moving AI domain.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product lifecycle for AI primitives end-to-end - from customer discovery and problem framing through vision definition, roadmap prioritization, execution with cross-team dependencies, launch, and post-launch performance optimization

- Define product strategy by understanding problems that cut across multiple teams and personas - translating that into clear principles, requirements, and roadmap priorities that sequence work on evidence

- Drive adoption by partnering with early adopters, generalizing requirements from multiple contexts, and ensuring primitives work for any team without requiring your team to operate them

- Evaluate technical proposals alongside scientists and ML engineers - understanding architecture trade-offs and balancing feature delivery with system health and long-term maintainability

- Make crisp product decisions in ambiguous AI/ML domains where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined - using data, customer insight, and judgment

- Define success criteria that measure the primitive you own, not the partner's business outcome you don't - distinguishing adoption from real impact

- Ensure primitives are findable, adoptable, and valuable - not just built and opened

- Contribute to the team's rhythm of business - planning cycles, business reviews, goal tracking, and operational reporting

A day in the life
Every day brings new challenges. You might work backward from a partner team's pain point to frame a new primitive, review a technical design with scientists to assess whether an architecture can scale, or analyze adoption data to decide what to double down on versus deprecate. Other days, you'll write a vision document for a new capability, find new opportunities across the enterprise, or sit with early adopters to understand how they'd consume a primitive in their pipeline. You'll move between technical discussions with scientists and engineers and alignment conversations with senior managers and directors.

No two weeks look the same. You'll move between customer discovery, technical strategy, and hands-on execution - always building toward primitives that are trusted, consumable, and impactful at scale.

About the team
AICE is a team of scientists and machine learning engineers building the AI primitives that power Amazon's intelligent systems. We develop and harden reusable capabilities for broad consumption by product teams across the enterprise - and partner with those teams to integrate them.

amazon:amazon:10528520.description:
Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
- Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
- Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
- Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
- Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
- Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
- Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
- Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
- Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About the team
The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations. 

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

amazon:amazon:10504150.description:
Are you passionate about using AI to change customers' lives for the better? The Alexa International team is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to drive adoption of Alexa+ across some of our most strategic 3P partners in the Americas, with a focus on Canada, Mexico, and Brazil. 

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation personal AI assistant, rebuilt from the ground up on a modern architecture that orchestrates large language models (LLMs), agentic pipelines, and connected services at scale. Available across Echo devices, mobile, Fire TV, and Alexa.com. Alexa+ is designed to get things done through natural, capable, multi-turn interactions.

As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Americas, you'll serve as the technical face of Amazon for our partners, owning the integration lifecycle from first technical engagement through production launch. You'll work hands-on with partner engineering teams to design, validate, and ship integrations that feel native to Alexa+, while building the playbooks, reference architectures, and documentation that will scale the program beyond 1:1 engagement. As a founding contributor, the patterns and practices you establish will define how we work with partners across categories for years to come.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical execution and strategic influence. You'll translate complex integration requirements into clear business value for partner stakeholders, drive alignment across Amazon's business development teams, product, and engineering organizations, and exercise strong judgment as integration patterns continue to evolve.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with modern integration protocols (including MCP), agentic system design, strong programming skills, and full-stack fluency across backend services, API layers, and front-end rendering. You have a track record of delivering complex multi-party integrations and can move fluidly between a deep technical conversation with a partner's engineering team and a strategic discussion with their leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Partner Integration:

• Design and deliver end-to-end partner integration solutions leveraging modern protocols and agentic patterns (e.g., MCP, tool-calling, REST), ensuring experiences feel native to Alexa+ while respecting partner brand and capabilities.
• Work hands-on with partners to assess technical readiness, architect solutions across the full stack — from backend services and API design to front-end rendering — and troubleshoot complex integration challenges across multiple device surfaces.
• Work with internal engineering teams to test and deploy software packages required to onboard partners to Alexa+.
• Exercise strong judgment in ambiguous technical situations, determining appropriate solution strategies and making clear trade-off recommendations (e.g., partial vs. full E2E integration, link-out vs. native rendering).

Frameworks & Scalable Enablement:

• Create reusable integration patterns, technical documentation, and onboarding playbooks that accelerate future partner launches and reduce hands-on SA effort over time.
• Develop reference architectures that leverage horizontal capabilities (compositional rendering, streaming, smart routing) to address common partner needs across categories.

Partner & Product Influence:

• Own technical relationships with partner engineering and product teams, guiding integrations from commitment through launch.
• Collaborate with product leadership during early capability formation, directly shaping the roadmap based on real partner integration learnings.

A day in the life
We're looking for a highly motivated Sr SA to join the Alexa+ International team as we build out the third-party integration program from the ground up. You'll engage in deep technical design discussions, solve novel challenges spanning agentic architectures and front-end rendering, and coordinate feature implementations across partner categories. You'll represent the partner perspective with internal product and engineering teams, using integration learnings, data-driven analysis, and a working-backwards approach to influence roadmap priorities. This is a founding-team role: you'll shape how we work, what we build, and how we scale.

About the team
Our mission is to enable third-party partners to bring their agentic capabilities and services to Alexa+ through the Americas, creating high-quality experiences across consumer categories that help customers get things done. We are a small, high-impact team of technologists bridging BD, internal product and engineering, and external partners. We're in our foundational year — building the integration model, establishing the playbook, and launching our first wave of strategic partners. If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building from scratch, and want to shape a program that will scale to hundreds of partners, this is the team.

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Must be fluent in English plus one of the following (Spanish, Portuguese, and/or Canadian French).

Our work spans product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

You are responsible for customer experience with considerable complexity where problems, opportunity, and strategy may not be defined. You take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently. You influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities through well-crafted written narratives and data-backed recommendations that earn trust with senior leadership.

You champion exceptional customer experiences by defining requirements for Canadian customers and partnership with global stakeholders on roadmap development. You balance constraints—compliance, localization, and accessibility—with customer experience considerations. You establish direct customer feedback loops and regularly validate assumptions through qualitative and quantitative research. You monitor operational health after launch and work with teams to address issues with appropriate urgency.

You demonstrate curiosity and a desire to dive deep into the technical aspects of your product, particularly in AI/ML systems. You evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses, asking the right questions to identify risks and ensure appropriate trade-offs are surfaced before commitments are made. You understand how AI, including agentic systems and large language models, is reshaping product development and apply this understanding to make better product decisions. You proactively explore new AI capabilities, attend technical deep-dives, and maintain enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to engineering. You use all means possible, including AI, to accelerate development cycles, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation.

You demonstrate high skill at using data to drive decisions. You define success criteria, KPIs, and metrics distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You design experiments and analyze results with statistical rigor. You analyze usage data, performance metrics, customer behavior, and market trends to inform decisions and prioritize roadmap investments—going beyond surface-level reporting to uncover causal relationships and actionable insights. You use AI capabilities to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment.

You collaborate with other product managers, sharing mental models for decision-making, providing feedback on documents and strategies, and helping others grow their technical and strategic capabilities. You raise the bar for the PM community through knowledge sharing and thought leadership.

You communicate with precision and influence—crafting compelling written documents that drive alignment across teams and leadership levels. You tailor your communication to your audience, whether presenting to executives, aligning with engineering partners, or rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

amazon:amazon:10488808.description:
Sr. Product Manager - Technical — AWS Messaging Services

About the Team

AWS Messaging Services power the backbone of modern distributed applications. Our portfolio includes:

Amazon MQ (AMQ) — A managed message broker service for Apache ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ that makes it easy to migrate to the cloud. Amazon MQ provides compatibility with industry-standard messaging APIs and protocols, enabling customers to move from on-premises brokers without rewriting application code.

Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) — A fully managed message queuing service that enables decoupling and scaling of microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications. SQS eliminates the complexity of managing and operating message-oriented middleware, letting developers focus on differentiated work.

Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) — A fully managed pub/sub messaging and mobile notification service that enables high-throughput, push-based, many-to-many communication between distributed systems, microservices, event-driven serverless applications, and mobile devices.

Together, these services process trillions of messages monthly and are foundational to how customers build reliable, scalable, and loosely coupled architectures on AWS. From startups to the world's largest enterprises, customers depend on our messaging services for mission-critical workloads — including financial transactions, order processing, IoT telemetry, real-time analytics, and event-driven computing. When our services are unavailable or degraded, customer applications stop working. The stakes are high and the impact is massive.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager - Technical to define product strategy and drive roadmap execution for AWS Messaging Services. You will own the customer experience end-to-end — deeply understanding how developers, architects, and enterprises use messaging to build distributed systems, and shaping our services to meet their evolving needs. You will work backwards from customer problems to define features that make it easier, faster, and more cost-effective to build reliable applications at any scale

Key job responsibilities

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more AWS Messaging services (SQS, SNS, Amazon MQ)
- Write compelling narratives (PRFAQs, 1-pagers, 6-pagers) to define new product opportunities and gain leadership alignment
- Deeply understand messaging patterns (point-to-point, pub/sub, event-driven architectures, FIFO ordering, fan-out) and how customers apply them to solve real problems
- Partner with engineering, design, science, and business teams to deliver high-quality features on time
- Engage directly with AWS customers — from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises — to understand pain points, gather feedback, and validate product direction
- Define and analyze success metrics (adoption, usage, reliability, latency, cost efficiency) to inform product decisions and measure impact
- Prioritize features and trade-offs based on customer impact, technical feasibility, operational excellence, and business value
- Drive cross-functional alignment across messaging services and adjacent AWS services (Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, Kinesis)

- 5+ years of technical product management with internet business experience
- 3+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

- Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
- 5+ years of enterprise scale infrastructure or development-based cloud programs/projects in a related industry experience
- Experience in launching new products
- Experience with messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or distributed systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, AMQP, MQTT)
- Familiarity with open-source messaging communities and standards

Are you passionate about leveraging machine learning to protect Amazon's marketplace at scale? We're seeking a Senior Program Manager who will drive our brand protection detection systems through systematic problem-solving and technical expertise. In this role, you'll own the end-to-end program lifecycle for ML-powered detection systems, going 2-3 levels deeper than surface analysis to identify root causes and build solutions that eliminate entire classes of false positives. You'll work directly with applied scientists and engineering teams to translate complex abuse patterns into engineering-ready specifications that scale to hundreds of millions of product listings globally.

This position sits at the heart of Amazon's brand protection systems, where your decisions directly determine whether hundreds of millions of product listings are correctly identified as legitimate or infringing. You'll partner with applied scientists on ML model performance, manage golden dataset refresh cycles, optimize image enrollment processes, and conduct root cause analysis on false positive drivers. Your strategic impact will be felt across marketplaces, regions, and languages as you balance precision and recall at unprecedented scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with applied scientists to evaluate machine learning model performance for brand protection detection systems, making high-judgment decisions that directly impact detection accuracy across billions of listings WW.
- Manage high-quality training dataset refresh cycles and text workstream pattern identification across multiple marketplaces and languages to ensure detection models have high-quality training data.
- Conduct comprehensive root cause analysis on false positive drivers, going 2-3 levels deeper than surface analysis to identify systematic improvements for detection systems.
- Translate findings into detailed engineering-ready specifications with clear, measurable success criteria that enable engineering teams to build to specification.
- Present strategic recommendations to Directors and VPs on detection system enhancements, establishing metrics and driving alignment across stakeholders.

A day in the life
Your day begins by reviewing overnight detection metrics across marketplaces to identify any emerging patterns requiring attention. You'll meet with applied scientists to evaluate a new model iteration, making judgment calls on its precision/recall balance before implementation. After, you might spend time analyzing text patterns across multiple languages to identify new detection opportunities or coordinate with engineering on implementing your latest false positive reduction blueprint. You'll wrap up by presenting findings from your latest root cause analysis to leadership, highlighting systematic improvements that could eliminate thousands of false positives while maintaining strong brand protection.

About the team
The brand protection program team serves as Amazon's systemic problem-solving engine, providing vertical product-program support across discovery, detection, and remediation systems. 

Product and engineering teams explicitly prefer working with our team because we deliver detailed blueprints instead of vague problems, enabling engineering to build to specification and validate against clear success criteria.

 The Vice President of Endpoint Security Product Management will define and execute Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint strategy, ensuring product performance, alignment with market needs, and revenue growth.  Strategic Leadership & Ownership 

- Own the complete lifecycle of Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio - from strategy and investment decisions through development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement, including acquisitions and integration.

- Own financial targets for the Endpoint Security product line, ensuring continued growth.

- Oversee competitive landscape analysis, develop business cases for new Endpoint products, and lead strategies to integrate Endpoint capabilities.

- Contribute to key business activities, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), industry forums, and events.

- Represent the Endpoint Security strategy and business performance with executive leadership, customers, industry analysts, partners, and other external stakeholders.

 Team Leadership & Development 

- Lead, coach, and mentor a high-performing team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.

- Cultivate an environment where product managers can thrive and contribute to the company's ambitious growth goals.

 Growth & Innovation 

- Drive innovation within Endpoint strategy, identifying opportunities and exploring new market segments.

- Support M&A activities by contributing to strategic analysis and integration of potential acquisitions.

 Experience & Expertise 

- Significant experience in the cybersecurity space, with extensive knowledge of the Endpoint Security landscape, including a deep understanding of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

- Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, including product strategy, development, launch, scaling, operational challenges, and portfolio evolution.

- Prior experience in high-growth organizations, with a history of success navigating market challenges and executing strategies that drive exceptional growth.

 Technical & Business Acumen 

- Bring sufficient technical depth to guide strategic product decisions involving endpoint agents, prevention and behavioral detection, EDR telemetry, response capabilities, operating-system architecture, performance, reliability, and false-positive management.

- Define how Endpoint Security integrates with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, ensuring endpoint capabilities improve analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience across the portfolio.

- Strong understanding of the competitive landscape in the Endpoint space.

- Establish and own product success metrics spanning protection efficacy, product quality, deployment and adoption, customer health, customer satisfaction, retention, and commercial performance.

- Strong background in business case development for new products and initiatives.
