THE BUSINESS 
 We are Everyday Luxury™. 
 It's what we do and how we do it — together. 
 It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results. 
 It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture. 
 It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong. 
 It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia. 
 It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity. 

 With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.  

 THE TEAM 
 The mission of the Engineering Enablement Department — our platform organization — is to provide the composable building blocks, unified foundations, and operational guardrails that empower teams to assemble world-class engineering, data, and AI solutions at scale.

 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 Aritzia is growing, and our Engineering Enablement team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to design, manage, and scale the community programs, communication frameworks, and operational insights that engineering teams across Aritzia rely on to thrive and adopt technology at scale — from internal documentation hubs and technical roadmaps to developer advocacy networks, hackathons, and sentiment metrics. You will champion our engineers as our valued customers, driving platform adoption through transparent storytelling, data-backed feedback loops, and structured engagement that remove friction from the developer journey, unlocking collaborative capacity across the entire technology organization. With the skills you gain in this role, the opportunities are endless – from a rewarding career in Technology, to continued growth and development with Aritzia. 

 THE ROLE 
 As the Enablement Program Manager, you will:

- Manage project tracking boards and communicate the platform roadmap outward; channel bottom-up requirements from engineering teams to help leadership prioritize what gets built

- Establish clear communication loops and operating cadence for decentralized developer programs, ensuring cross-functional alignment

- Act as the Product Owner for our central documentation hub, making it the single trusted place engineers go to find technical guidance — whether it is authored in the hub or published from the codebase

- Facilitate Communities of Practice, Champions networks, and events (such as Office Hours and Hackathons) that break down silos and drive peer-led knowledge sharing

- Design and manage structured learning pathways, bootcamps, and certifications to drive continuous upskilling across technology teams

- Partner with technology vendors to coordinate training sessions, enablement workshops, and premier support engagements that help engineering teams get full value from our platform tools

- Track platform adoption across engineering teams and gather developer feedback on friction points to measure and refine our enablement frameworks

 THE QUALIFICATIONS 
 The Enablement Program Manager has: 

- Proven skills, education, and/or applicable certifications: 

- Program Management & Execution: Proven ability to manage complex initiatives, prioritize backlogs based on user friction, and coordinate communications across engineering teams 
- Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging, and highly readable documentation

- Information Architecture: Strong expertise in content architecture, creating intuitive documentation hubs and service catalogs that are easy to navigate and discover

- Event & Engagement Design: Innovative ideas for the layout, branding, and execution of internal tech culture events such as Hackathons and Innovation Days

- Internal Platform Marketing: Creative storytelling and marketing instincts, applied to internal campaigns, release notes, and newsletters that generate excitement and drive voluntary platform adoption

- User Research & Insights: Proficient in setting up feedback loops, designing sentiment surveys, and compiling qualitative feedback into structured data insights

- A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles

- The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners

- A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business

 THE COMPENSATION 
 At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.

The range for roles at this level is $100,000 - $300,000 per year. Total compensation may include base, bonus and/or equity depending on the role, which has the potential to be greater than this range.

With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.

- Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.

- Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.

- A-OK Commissary & Cafe — Everyday Luxury dining, exclusive to Aritzia. Our in-house bistro and cafe is a private oasis where employees can enjoy curated, subsidized Everyday Luxury dining. 

- The SET — Our in-office fitness studio and gym with state-of-the-art equipment, custom-created classes and optional personal training. Open 7 days a week, it works out well. 

- Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial. 

- Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration. They’re also dog friendly. Woof.

- Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.

- The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like dry-cleaning, hotel and restaurant discounts, self-care promos and on-site medical care.

 ARITZIA 

 Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.

The Learning Program Manager partners with teams to translate business strategy into structured learning programs and maintain governance frameworks that enable continuous improvement.
What You’ll Do
Translate business priorities into structured, measurable learning programs that drive adoption, retention, and compliance.
Define program goals, blueprints, and governance standards to ensure consistency and scalability.
Manage intake and prioritization of new initiatives, balancing strategic importance, impact, and risk.
Establish program success metrics and partner with Data & Insights teams to track KPIs through dashboards.
Own the Analysis and Evaluation phases of the ADDIE model to scope needs and assess effectiveness.
Collaborate with Learning Consultants and Content Specialists to deliver high-quality, on-time programs.
Align and communicate with cross-functional stakeholders, continuously improving processes and documentation.
Qualifications

Governance & Organization: Skilled at building repeatable processes, managing intake and prioritization, and ensuring programs launch on time and within scope.
Measurement & Reporting: Comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., adoption, retention, completion) and partnering with data teams to track progress through dashboards or reports.
Learning Science Application: Working knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design models (ADDIE, Kirkpatrick), and approaches that support retention and behavior change.
Operational Efficiency: Detail-oriented and organized; able to manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
Collaboration & Communication: Strong communicator and relationship builder, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across Product, CX, and Enablement teams.
Quality Ownership: Takes responsibility for program quality and seeks opportunities to enhance alignment between learning outcomes and business goals.
Tools & Platforms: Experience using LMS platforms and project tracking tools; comfortable learning new technologies like LEAi, Clueso, or PowerBI to enhance efficiency.

Job Description
The Learning Program Manager, Sales Enablement designs, governs, and measures scalable enablement programs that directly support Assent's revenue and go-to-market (GTM) goals. This role serves as a strategic business partner to the Sales organization — translating GTM strategy, sales priorities, and field performance data into structured, evidence-based programs that drive measurable outcomes like faster ramp, higher win rates, quota attainment, and consistent execution of our sales methodology.
Unlike a content or curriculum role, the Sales LPM defines what enablement needs to achieve and why, then partners with Learning Consultants (Instructional Designers) and the Learning Content team to design and build the solutions. The LPM captures needs, shapes desired outcomes, makes informed recommendations, and owns the measurement story — while design and development sit with the Learning Consultant and Content teams.
This role also requires deeper sales fluency than other LPM positions. The Sales LPM is expected to develop working expertise in Assent's sales methodology (potentially through formal methodology training or certification) and to participate actively in sales strategy discussions, bringing an enablement and performance lens to the conversation.
AI is a core part of how this role operates. The Sales LPM is expected to use AI-powered tools to accelerate needs analysis, surface insights from sales data and customer conversations, streamline program operations, and sharpen how program impact is measured and communicated. AI is applied within the role's scope — analysis, measurement, operations, and recommendation — not to create learning content, which remains with the Learning Consultant and Content teams.

Translate GTM and revenue priorities into structured, measurable enablement programs that improve ramp time, pipeline quality, conversion, and quota attainment.
Define program goals, blueprints, and governance standards to ensure consistency and scalability across sales roles (e.g., SDR/BDR, AE, Sales Engineering, and frontline managers).
Manage intake and prioritization of new enablement initiatives, balancing strategic importance, revenue impact, and risk — using AI to triage requests, summarize stakeholder inputs, and keep program documentation current.
Establish program success metrics, convert business needs into evidence-based KPIs, and tell the story with the data through dashboards and executive-ready reporting — leveraging AI and analytics tooling to surface insights and generate reporting narratives, in partnership with Data & Insights teams.
Own the Analysis and Evaluation phases of the ADDIE model: scope needs up front and assess program effectiveness against sales outcomes, using AI-assisted analysis of sales data, conversation intelligence, and learner feedback.
Champion the practical, responsible use of AI across the enablement lifecycle — synthesizing stakeholder inputs and sales-call insights, drafting program briefs and recommendations, and helping the broader enablement team work faster — while instructional design and content development remain with the Learning Consultant and Content teams.
Collaborate with Learning Consultants and the Learning Content team to deliver high-quality, on-time programs — making recommendations and setting direction, while respecting that instructional design and content development live with those teams.
Develop and maintain working fluency in Assent's sales methodology, completing methodology training or certification as needed to credibly partner with the field.
Participate in sales strategy and planning discussions, representing the enablement and performance perspective.
Align and communicate across Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, and Enablement, continuously improving processes and documentation.
Qualifications
Experience: At least 3 years managing learning or enablement programs, or equivalent experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives — paired with meaningful direct sales, sales operations, or revenue-facing experience. SaaS or technology environment strongly preferred; quota-carrying or quota-supporting background is a plus.
Sales Acumen: Genuine understanding of the sales cycle, pipeline dynamics, and how reps and managers actually work day to day. Familiarity with common sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, Sandler, or similar) and a willingness to certify in Assent's chosen approach.
Program Strategy & Execution: Proven ability to translate revenue and GTM goals into structured, outcome-focused enablement programs that align to organizational priorities.
Governance & Organization: Skilled at building repeatable processes, managing intake and prioritization, and ensuring programs launch on time and within scope.
Measurement & Reporting: Comfortable defining sales-relevant success metrics (ramp, win rate, quota attainment, conversion, sales-cycle length, adoption) and partnering with data teams to track progress through dashboards or reports.
AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, insight generation, and program operations. Curious about how AI can improve enablement outcomes and speed, and thoughtful about applying it within the right guardrails — including the boundary that content creation stays with the Consultant and Content teams.
Learning Science Application: Working knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design models (ADDIE, LTEM, evidence-based learning), and approaches that support retention and behavior change.
Operational Efficiency: Detail-oriented and organized; able to manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
Collaboration & Communication: Strong communicator and relationship builder who is credible with sales reps and leaders, and capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, and Enablement.
Quality Ownership: Takes responsibility for program quality and seeks opportunities to strengthen the link between enablement outcomes and revenue goals.
Tools & Platforms: Experience using LMS platforms and project-tracking tools; comfort with CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and interest in learning AI-enabled sales enablement and analytics platforms (e.g., Highspot, Seismic, Gong, PowerBI,Guru) to enhance efficiency.
Mindset: Structured, collaborative, growth-oriented, and AI-forward. Balances execution discipline with genuine sales curiosity, and looks for ways to work smarter with AI, learning from results to improve program quality over time.

Job Requisition ID # 

26WD99517 

 Position Overview 

 Autodesk Research is hiring a Senior Research Program Manager to lead a portfolio of forward-looking construction research programs. You will sit at the intersection of research strategy, construction domain expertise, AI-enabled workflows, and cross-functional program execution — helping teams move from ambiguous opportunity areas to structured plans, measurable progress, and strategic impact.

 Autodesk Research explores advances that may shape products and customer workflows five to ten years out, investigating how intelligent, agentic, and AI-driven systems can transform how ideas move from concept to reality. This is not a traditional Technical Program Manager role. Research Program Managers here are horizontally focused connectors: they organize programs, manage ambiguity, coordinate stakeholders, and link research work to Autodesk outcomes.

 Responsibilities 

 Lead program management for construction research initiative
 Manage a program spanning multiple related projects, experiments, prototypes, and partnerships across complex, extended timelines.

- Build and maintain integrated program plans across workstreams, defining scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, and owners

- Align the portfolio with Research priorities, Autodesk’s long-term construction vision, available capacity, and strategic outcomes

- Help teams prioritize when opportunities compete for attention, staffing, or funding

- Coordinate across researchers, engineers, designers, product teams, external partners, and leadership

 Manage the research lifecycle
 Help teams move through opportunity framing, discovery, experimentation, validation, and transition — keeping work visible and actionable without forcing it into a rigid delivery model.

- Establish lightweight governance for planning, reviews, decisions, and risk tracking

- Ensure research artifacts, learnings, demos, and decision records are findable and reusable

- Support transition planning when research is ready to inform product strategy, incubation, or future investment

- Partner with other Research Program Managers to improve shared practices, tools, and operating rhythms

 Bring construction domain fluency
 You don’t need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you must understand construction well enough to ask informed questions, confidently engage with partners and connect research to real industry needs. Relevant areas:

- Project delivery phases: preconstruction, planning, estimating, scheduling, procurement, field execution, and handover

- BIM/VDC workflows, model coordination, construction documentation, site data, and connected data environments

- Reality capture, digital twins, construction analytics, and AI-enabled decision support

- Autodesk Construction Cloud, Revit, Navisworks, Forma, Tandem, or adjacent AEC platforms

 Coordinate AI and emerging technology research
 Support programs exploring how AI, generative AI, intelligent agents, simulation, and connected workflows can transform construction.

- Help researchers structure AI-enabled workstreams with clear milestones, experiments, and evaluation plans

- Coordinate research integrating BIM, schedules, reality capture, field data, and other construction information sources

- Translate emerging technical work into clear narratives, decision briefs, and next-step recommendations

- Use AI tools in your own practice to improve planning, synthesis, documentation, and follow-through

 Drive accountability and communicate clearly
 Create enough structure to help people do their best work — without slowing research down.

- Maintain dashboards, milestone trackers, decision logs, risk registers, and stakeholder updates

- Identify blockers, ambiguous ownership, unresolved decisions, and priority conflicts

- Facilitate planning sessions, research reviews, workshops, and decision forums

- Prepare crisp executive summaries, narratives, and briefing materials for senior leaders

 Manage resources and external engagements

- Track program budgets, planned expenditures, and resource needs in partnership with leadership and finance

- Support annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and resource prioritization

- Coordinate external collaborations, customer engagements, and academic or industry partnerships

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 8+ years in program management, project management, research operations, construction technology, or a related field

- Experience managing complex, multi-workstream programs with diverse stakeholders, dependencies, and deliverables

- Working knowledge of construction workflows: preconstruction, BIM/VDC, scheduling, field execution, or construction data management

- Demonstrated ability to build structure in ambiguous, newly forming areas.

- Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including executive-ready summaries and dashboards

- Strong facilitation and influencing skills across multidisciplinary teams

- Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Slack, or equivalents

- Ability to work effectively across global teams and time zones

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in construction technology, AEC, digital twins, BIM/VDC, reality capture, or AI-enabled construction workflows

- Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Revit, Navisworks, Forma, Tandem, or related platforms

- Background in applied research, innovation programs, incubation, or early-stage product exploration

- Familiarity with AI/ML, generative AI, intelligent agents, or data-driven product development

- Experience coordinating programs involving data integration, connected workflows, or scalable data pipelines

- Experience managing research collaborations, customer advisory engagements, or academic/industry partnerships

- Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Computer Science, HCI, Business, or related field; equivalent experience welcome

 The Ideal Candidate 

 You create clarity without pretending the future is already known. You thrive managing ambitious, ambiguous work while keeping teams accountable, informed, and aligned.

- Research-minded:  You understand that research is iterative and uncertain, but still requires accountability and decision discipline

- Construction-fluent:  You connect research activity to industry problems, customer needs, and Autodesk opportunity areas

- Structurally rigorous:  You turn broad goals into milestones, workstreams, decision points, owners, and measurable progress

- Cross-functional:  You build trust with researchers, engineers, designers, product teams, executives, customers, and domain experts

- AI-curious:  You actively use AI tools to improve your own program management, synthesis, and communication

- Strategic thinker:  Ability to define and communicate a forward-looking vision, anticipate shifts in the construction and technology landscape, and align research priorities with long-term business objectives

 What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months) 

- A clear, trusted operating rhythm for the construction research program

- An integrated view of priorities, workstreams, milestones, risks, and decisions

- Strong relationships with researchers, engineers, product stakeholders, and Research leadership

- Improved visibility and accountability without reducing research velocity

- Clearer connection between construction research and Autodesk strategic outcomes

- Better documentation and reuse of research artifacts, insights, and decisions

- Active, demonstrable use of AI tools to improve program operations

 Position Overview  
 This is a role for a product leader who wants to fundamentally change how the platform works, and can prove it, not just pitch it.  You will join a small, AI-native disrupt squad within Autodesk’s Platform Services & Emerging Technologies (PSET) organization, accountable for redefining how the platform is experienced, accessed, and built upon. 

 You won’t be handed a roadmap. You will identify high-leverage opportunities, define what should exist, and demonstrate a dramatically better way through working proofs, using AI, real systems, and rapid experimentation. 

 Your role is not to write requirements and hand them off. On this team, product thinking, experience design, and engineering are rethinking how to work as an AI native delivery team. As the product-minded AI Builder, you bring deep product thinking into the what and the why, and you stay close enough to the how that your direction is grounded in something real. In practice, that means building AI-assisted prototypes, shaping demos, and working directly with data yourself. 

 Your focus is not on managing backlogs or operating production systems. You are accountable for turning friction into opportunity and delivering working proofs that make a new approach credible and hard to dismiss. 

 Responsibilities  

- Find the seams, bottlenecks, and handoffs that make the platform harder to use than it should be, and identify the few where a different approach creates outsized value for customers and the business 

- Define what should exist, framing fuzzy, multi-system problems into a clear direction the team can build against 

- Decide what to challenge: actively question whether existing capabilities should be replaced, simplified, or significantly improved, and use experimentation to settle it on evidence rather than opinion 

- Prove it: partner with experience designers and developers, and get hands-on yourself with AI tools, prompts, and data, to build working proofs that show something actually works, not just that it could 

- Package the results as clear “before vs after” proof points that make friction visible and the better approach undeniable, creating pull for change across teams 

- Translate what the proofs reveal into direction: what the platform should become next, and a viable path to get there

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 8+ years driving product direction in complex, technical environments, with deep customer and business understanding and a strong track record of using experimentation to discover, validate, and evolve solutions 

- Acts with agency in ambiguous spaces, setting direction and making progress before anyone hands them a plan 

- Strong product judgment: consistently prioritizes what creates disproportionate value across systems, not just within a single feature or area 

- Hands-on experience building AI-assisted prototypes or demos (prompt design, agentic workflows, tool integrations) to validate direction 

- Proven ability to operate across product, engineering, and experience, shaping solutions end-to-end rather than handing off between functions 

- Turns high-leverage problems and insight into tangible, working outcomes, whether prototypes or proofs, not just requirements, decks, or roadmaps 

- Strong ability to synthesize user needs, business context, and technical constraints into clear, defensible direction 

- Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without relying on formal authority 

- High learning velocity and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Shipped 0→1 products or features, ideally in workflow-heavy enterprise products or greenfield SaaS 

- Ability to structure product intent as an interface for agentic work, validated through hypothesis-driven, metrics-based iteration. 

- Experience comparing multiple solution approaches and deciding based on outcomes, not opinions 

- Familiarity with complex multi-system environments and navigate platform level changes required to achieve business outcomes

26WD100898 

 Position Overview 
 Autodesk is hiring a Product Manager to join the Analytics Data Platform team. The Analytics Data organization builds and runs the data and AI platform Autodesk teams use to capture, produce, and deliver analytics at scale. It powers product health analytics across the portfolio, personalized insights inside AutoCAD, Revit, and Fusion, generative AI features, Autodesk Profile, and the Autodesk Assistant. The Analytics Data Platform team owns the infrastructure the platform runs on. This is where data lives, where compute processes it, and where work moves from one step to the next. It determines whether a team ships in a day or a quarter, and it drives the platform's cost, performance, and reliability. Our direction is self-serve and automated. Teams provision what they need in minutes, we modernize the engines and storage formats underneath, and we are opening the platform to agents that can provision, query, and optimize on a user's behalf. To get there, we are making the infrastructure work like one product, not a set of separate systems each team has to learn. As a Product Manager on the team, you will partner with a distributed engineering team to deliver this work, balancing the needs of platform users, including data engineers, scientists, analysts, and ML and BI teams, with the company's needs for cost, compliance, and reliability. We are looking for a hands-on, technically fluent product manager who leads through influence, enjoys making complex infrastructure simple to use, and knows that Autodesk's analytics and AI depend on getting this infrastructure right.

 Responsibilities 

- Own the vision and roadmap for the platform's storage, compute, and the systems that connect analytics platform workflows

- Define a unified, self-serve experience for getting storage, compute, and access on demand

- Set the reliability bar for the platform and hold it there, so teams can run business-critical analytics and AI workloads with confidence

- Give teams clear visibility into what they use, what it costs, and how to improve performance

- Partner with a distributed engineering team, and talk to users directly to find what slows them down and add the fixes to the roadmap

- Lead technical discussions, write clear product requirements, and run quarterly planning and prioritization

- Manage the full lifecycle, from new capabilities through migrations to retirement, keeping the platform current as engines, formats, and cloud services change

- Build in security and compliance from the start, including least-privilege, project-scoped access, and environment isolation

- Track big data and AI infrastructure trends, and run vendor assessments when buying beats building

- Measure and report the platform's impact, including time to provision, reliability, performance, adoption, and cost

- Be the go-to expert and advocate for the platform, keeping documentation current and supporting the teams that build on it

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 4+ years in product management, including infrastructure or platform products at scale such as data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling

- Proven ability to align cross-functional and globally distributed teams without formal authority

- Skilled at working with stakeholders, communicating early, anticipating needs, and building agreement with peers and senior leadership

- Strong empathy for technical users, turning the daily problems of engineers, scientists, and analysts into product decisions

- Able to connect platform decisions to business outcomes and to clear targets for cost, performance, and reliability

- Able to prioritize across many competing teams and workloads

- Technical depth to discuss storage, compute, query engines, and orchestration credibly with senior engineers, and to weigh the trade-offs of scale, performance, and cost

- A clear communicator who drives adoption across internal teams

- Fluency in product discovery, using research and data to learn what is worth building, whether it will work, and whether teams will use it

- A track record of leading delivery end to end, including migrations where users actually move and the old path is retired

- A data-driven approach, measuring how the platform is used and making decisions from that data

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with big data compute and query engines (such as Spark, Trino, or Athena) and container orchestration (Kubernetes or EKS)

- Experience with lakehouse storage and open table formats (such as Iceberg) and warehouses (such as Snowflake)

- Experience with orchestration and DataOps or MLOps tooling (such as Airflow, Temporal, or Metaflow)

- Experience with access management for big data (project-scoped or role-based models, such as Ranger or Lake Formation)

- Experience with platform observability and cost and performance management

- Experience with the analytics surfaces that sit on top, such as Looker, notebooks, or query workbenches

- Experience leading an infrastructure or platform migration at scale, including multi-region or data-residency requirements

- Experience making build-versus-buy decisions and running vendor assessments

26WD101518 

 L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows. 

 26WD101518, Senior Product Manager 

 Position Overview 
 Revit is the industry-leading BIM platform, used by AEC firms to design, construct, and operate the buildings the world depends on. We're reimagining what Revit is: a connected, cloud-enabled, AI-ready platform that works with open data, APIs, and agents.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a broad set of capabilities. These are the foundations that power nearly every Revit workflow and team. They include APIs and extensibility, MCP and agentic capabilities, cloud engines, interoperability, and data workflows, among other areas. Data is a critical area of focus. 

This role is for a builder. You use AI to prototype, analyze, and ship. You're as comfortable reading an API spec or testing an agent workflow as you are presenting a roadmap to executives. You'll move across a wide range of problems and turn complex technical capabilities into clear value for customers, developers, and partners.

 Location: Toronto, Montreal / Remote

 Responsibilities 

- Own strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a portfolio of Revit Core capabilities, with the freedom to take on new problems as the platform evolves

- Lead product direction for APIs, agentic workflows, and extensibility, defining how Revit capabilities are exposed to Agents, other Autodesk products, developers, customers, and partners

- Drive Revit's shift from file-based import/export to open, granular data, including integration with the AEC Data Model and interoperability with the wider customer ecosystem

- Partner with engineering and architecture leaders on cloud engines, platform modernization, and developer services

- Prototype, test, and validate ideas yourself using AI tools, and bring evidence rather than opinions to decisions

- Work directly with customers and partners, including leading AEC firms and developers, to translate discovery into real workflows and guide priorities

- Translate technical investments into clear customer, developer, and business outcomes, and communicate them to teams and senior leaders

- Align Revit, cloud, AI, platform, and discipline teams so decisions are made quickly and clearly

 Minimum Qualifications 

- Product management experience with APIs, developer platforms, cloud services, AI products, or complex enterprise software

- An AI-native mindset: hands-on experience with LLM-based products, agentic workflows, or developer tooling, and a habit of building with AI in your own work

- Strong technical fluency and credibility with software developers and architects

- Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team initiatives from problem definition through adoption

- Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply

- Comfort managing stakeholders, risk, and uncertainty, and collaborating with a global team

 Preferred Qualifications 

- API experience or prior software development experience

- Experience with AEC, CAD, BIM, or design software. This is helpful but not required, and we welcome strong candidates from AI, platform, and cloud backgrounds

- Familiarity with open standards such as IFC, or with managing large volumes of data

- Experience with agile/scrum methodologies
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26WD101518, Chef de produit senior 

 Aperçu du poste 
 Revit est la plateforme BIM de référence, utilisée par les cabinets d'architecture, d'ingénierie et de construction (AEC) pour concevoir, construire et exploiter les bâtiments dont dépend le monde entier. Nous réinventons Revit : une plateforme connectée, basée sur le cloud et prête pour l'IA, qui fonctionne avec des données ouvertes, des API et des agents. 

 Nous recherchons un chef de produit senior chargé de gérer un large éventail de fonctionnalités. Celles-ci constituent les fondements qui sous-tendent la quasi-totalité des flux de travail et des équipes Revit. Elles englobent notamment les API et l’extensibilité, les capacités MCP et d’agent, les moteurs cloud, l’interopérabilité et les flux de données, entre autres. Les données constituent un domaine d’intérêt crucial. 

Ce poste s’adresse à un créateur. Vous utilisez l’IA pour prototyper, analyser et livrer des solutions. Vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour lire une spécification d’API ou tester un workflow d’agent que pour présenter une feuille de route à la direction. Vous aborderez un large éventail de problématiques et transformerez des capacités techniques complexes en une valeur ajoutée claire pour les clients, les développeurs et les partenaires. 

 Lieu : Toronto, Montréal / Télétravail 

 Responsabilités 

- Maîtriser la stratégie, la feuille de route et les résultats d’un portefeuille de fonctionnalités Revit Core, avec la liberté de vous attaquer à de nouveaux défis à mesure que la plateforme évolue 

- Diriger l’orientation produit pour les API, les flux de travail des agents et l’extensibilité, en définissant la manière dont les fonctionnalités de Revit sont mises à la disposition des agents, des autres produits Autodesk, des développeurs, des clients et des partenaires 

- Conduire la transition de Revit de l’importation/exportation basée sur des fichiers vers des données ouvertes et granulaires, y compris l’intégration avec le modèle de données AEC et l’interopérabilité avec l’écosystème client au sens large 

- Collaborer avec les responsables de l’ingénierie et de l’architecture sur les moteurs cloud, la modernisation de la plateforme et les services aux développeurs 

- Prototyper, tester et valider vous-même des idées à l’aide d’outils d’IA, et fonder les décisions sur des preuves plutôt que sur des opinions 

- Travailler directement avec les clients et les partenaires, notamment les principaux cabinets d’architecture, d’ingénierie et de construction (AEC) et les développeurs, afin de traduire les résultats de la recherche en workflows concrets et d’orienter les priorités 

- Traduire les investissements techniques en résultats clairs pour les clients, les développeurs et l’entreprise, et les communiquer aux équipes et aux dirigeants 

- Coordonner les équipes Revit, cloud, IA, plateforme et spécialisées afin que les décisions soient prises rapidement et clairement 

 Qualifications minimales 

- Expérience en gestion de produit dans le domaine des API, des plateformes de développement, des services cloud, des produits d’IA ou des logiciels d’entreprise complexes 

- Un état d’esprit « natif de l’IA » : expérience pratique des produits basés sur les modèles de langage à grande échelle (LLM), des flux de travail agentiques ou des outils de développement, et l’habitude d’intégrer l’IA dans votre propre travail 

- Solide maîtrise technique et crédibilité auprès des développeurs de logiciels et des architectes 

- Capacité avérée à mener des initiatives inter-équipes ambiguës, de la définition du problème jusqu’à la mise en œuvre 

- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité d’expliquer simplement des concepts techniques complexes 

- Aisance dans la gestion des parties prenantes, des risques et de l’incertitude, ainsi que dans la collaboration avec une équipe internationale 

 Qualifications souhaitées

26WD99140 

 Position Overview

As an ML Platform Product Manager, you will help define and execute the roadmap for the Autodesk Machine Learning Platform (AMP), focused on making it easier and faster for Autodesk’s ML engineers and data scientists to build, test, deploy, and manage AI-powered solutions at scale.

You will partner closely with platform engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists to understand how they work, identify the tools and processes that create friction, and prioritize platform improvements that increase productivity. Your focus will span end-to-end workflows including data exploration, experimentation, model deployment, inference, monitoring, and downstream AI integration.

This role is centered on improving the experience of Autodesk’s internal AI/ML practitioners. You will help simplify complex technical processes, improve interoperability across tools and systems, and establish scalable workflows that allow teams to spend less time navigating infrastructure and more time developing AI capabilities.

We are looking for a technically fluent, execution-oriented Product Manager who is passionate about improving complex AI/ML workflows and building scalable platform capabilities for technical users. You do not need to write machine learning code, but you should understand how modern AI/ML systems are developed and be comfortable discussing technical requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs with engineering teams.
Responsibilities

- Define and execute roadmap priorities for the Autodesk ML Platform with a focus on practitioner productivity, workflow acceleration, interoperability, and platform adoption

- Develop a deep understanding of ML engineers and data scientists as internal users, using practitioner feedback and platform data to identify pain points and prioritize improvements

- Improve end-to-end AI/ML workflows across: 
- Data discovery and exploration

- Experimentation, training, and model iteration

- Model deployment and lifecycle management

- Model serving and inference

- Monitoring and observability

- Downstream AI integration

- Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform engineers to identify workflow bottlenecks, understand root causes, and translate practitioner needs into clear product requirements and priorities

- Help shape scalable platform capabilities related to: 
- Model deployment and serving

- Inference services

- AI/ML observability

- Experiment and model lifecycle management

- Foundation model and generative AI support

- Large language model (LLM) workflows

 26WD100185, Principal Product Manager, PPL Technology 
 Position Overview
 People Insights & Solution Design (PI-SD) owns the technology portfolio for People & Places (PPL), the HR and workplace organization supporting nearly 15,000 Autodesk employees worldwide. PI-SD builds the experience and intelligence layer above Workday and other systems of record, so the logic and insight generated by Autodesk's people and workplace data stay owned by Autodesk, not captured by vendors.Today, too much of that experience is fragmented across disconnected tools. We're moving PPL from that fragmented ecosystem to one seamless experience and intelligence layer, and we need Principal Product Managers to own that shift for an assigned domain, from problem definition through delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization. You will work directly with engineering, experience design teams, PPL Centers of Excellence leaders, and senior leaders to translate ambiguous employee and business problems into product strategy, requirements and measurable outcomes for your domain customers. This role calls for genuine learning agility, not just product experience. The domains, tools, and skills it requires will keep shifting, especially as AI reshapes what a product team can own directly, and we need people who treat that as fuel, not friction. We're looking for product managers who look around corners: who surface risks and opportunities before they become executive escalations, who set direction and make significant calls with minimal oversight, and whose pace is limited by the organization, not by their own judgment or execution.

 Responsibilities

- Own product strategy and roadmap for an assigned PPL domain portfolio, for example Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Compensation & Rewards, Employee Support & Services, Workplace & Travel Experience, or PI-SD's AI-enabled products, applying build versus buy principles and the six-dimension evaluation framework used across the PPL portfolio

- Own visibility across every tool, vendor, and contract in your domain, and drive renewal, divestment, and consolidation decisions backed by business cases through the quarterly PPL leadership technology review

- Translate ambiguous employee and business problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

- Own the experience and intelligence layer for your domain, keeping Workday and other systems of record as infrastructure while PPL owns the logic built on top of them

- Partner with ESE engineering teams daily through build and delivery, acting as the accountable product voice from requirements through launch

- Apply the vendor capture test to every AI capability in your domain: is it trained on data Autodesk owns and controls, or does it represent vendor capture of Autodesk's logic? Use AI directly in your own research, analysis, prioritization, and execution

- Build trust and alignment across technical and business stakeholders, and drive decisions without relying on direct authority

- Drive adoption of what you build, including bringing stakeholders who previously owned their own tech decisions through the transition to a centralized model with trust intact

- Define and own the KPIs for your domain, connecting product-level metrics to the broader PPL talent strategy, and build the dashboards and leading indicators that make performance visible before problems compound

- Identify portfolio risks, redundancies, and opportunities early, and bring recommendations, not open questions, to leadership before they surface as escalations

- Build new domain and technical fluency quickly as the portfolio and tools evolve, rather than waiting for structured training

 Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 Aperçu du Poste 
L'équipe People Insights & Solution Design (PI-SD) gère le portefeuille technologique de People & Places (PPL), la structure chargée des ressources humaines et de l'organisation des espaces de travail qui accompagne près de 15 000 collaborateurs d'Autodesk à travers le monde. PI-SD développe la couche d'expérience et d'intelligence qui s'appuie sur Workday et d'autres systèmes de référence, afin que la logique et les informations générées par les données relatives au personnel et aux espaces de travail d'Autodesk restent la propriété d'Autodesk, sans être capturées par des fournisseurs. Aujourd’hui, une trop grande partie de cette expérience est fragmentée entre des outils disparates. Nous faisons évoluer PPL de cet écosystème fragmenté vers une couche d’expérience et d’intelligence homogène, et nous avons besoin de chefs de produit seniors pour piloter cette transition dans un domaine qui leur sera attribué, depuis la définition du problème jusqu’à la mise en œuvre, l’adoption et l’optimisation continue. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de conception d’expérience utilisateur, les responsables des Centres d’excellence PPL et la direction pour traduire les problèmes ambigus des collaborateurs et de l’entreprise en stratégie produit, en exigences et en résultats mesurables pour les clients de votre domaine. Ce poste exige une véritable agilité d’apprentissage, et pas seulement une expérience en matière de produits. Les domaines, les outils et les compétences requis ne cesseront d’évoluer, d’autant plus que l’IA redéfinit ce dont une équipe produit peut être directement responsable, et nous avons besoin de personnes qui considèrent cela comme un moteur et non comme un frein. Nous recherchons des chefs de produit capables d’anticiper : qui identifient les risques et les opportunités avant qu’ils ne deviennent des problèmes remontés à la direction, qui définissent la direction à suivre et prennent des décisions importantes avec un minimum de supervision, et dont le rythme n’est limité que par l’organisation, et non par leur propre jugement ou leur capacité d’exécution.

 Responsabilités 

- Maîtriser la stratégie produit et la feuille de route d’un portefeuille de domaines PPL attribué, par exemple le recrutement, la gestion des talents, la rémunération et les avantages, le soutien et les services aux employés, l’expérience sur le lieu de travail et les déplacements, ou les produits basés sur l’IA de PI-SD, en appliquant les principes « build versus buy » (développer ou acheter) et le cadre d’évaluation en six dimensions utilisé dans l’ensemble du portefeuille PPL

- Assurer une visibilité complète sur l’ensemble des outils, fournisseurs et contrats de votre domaine, et piloter les décisions de renouvellement, de cession et de consolidation étayées par des analyses de rentabilité dans le cadre de la revue technologique trimestrielle de la direction PPL

- Traduire les problèmes ambigus des employés et de l’entreprise en exigences produit claires, en récits utilisateur et en critères d’acceptation

- Maîtriser la couche d’expérience et d’intelligence de votre domaine, en conservant Workday et les autres systèmes de référence comme infrastructure, tandis que PPL gère la logique construite par-dessus

- Collaborez quotidiennement avec les équipes d’ingénierie ESE tout au long du développement et de la mise en production, en jouant le rôle de porte-parole responsable du produit, depuis la définition des exigences jusqu’au lancement

- Appliquez le test de « captation par le fournisseur » à chaque capacité d’IA de votre domaine : est-elle entraînée sur des données détenues et contrôlées par Autodesk, ou représente-t-elle une captation par le fournisseur de la logique d’Autodesk ? Utilisez l’IA directement dans vos propres activités de recherche, d’analyse, de hiérarchisation des priorités et d’exécution

- Instaurez la confiance et l’alignement entre les parties prenantes techniques et métier, et prenez des décisions sans vous appuyer sur une autorité directe

- Favorisez l’adoption de ce que vous développez, notamment en accompagnant les parties prenantes qui prenaient auparavant leurs propres décisions techniques dans leur transition vers un modèle centralisé, tout en préservant la confiance

- Définissez et assumez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) de votre domaine, en reliant les métriques au niveau du produit à la stratégie globale de gestion des talents PPL, et mettez en place les tableaux de bord et les indicateurs avancés qui rendent les performances visibles avant que les problèmes ne s’aggravent

- Identifiez rapidement les risques, les redondances et les opportunités au sein du portefeuille, et présentez des recommandations, et non des questions ouvertes, à la direction avant qu’elles ne se transforment en escalades

- Acquérir rapidement une maîtrise des nouveaux domaines et des aspects techniques à mesure que le portefeuille et les outils évoluent, plutôt que d’attendre une formation structurée

 Qualifications Minimales

- Au moins 8 ans d’expérience en gestion de produit, ayant pris en charge un produit ou une plateforme de la définition à la livraison et à l’exploitation

 Position Overview  
 As a Senior Program Manager in Go-to-Market Transformation and Programs at Autodesk, you will lead small-to-medium GTM programs end-to-end, or significant workstreams within larger transformation and growth programs. You will translate program objectives into integrated plans, operating rhythms, and clear execution paths that help teams deliver measurable business outcomes. 

 You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders to clarify scope, manage dependencies, surface tradeoffs, and facilitate timely decisions. You will bring structure to ambiguous work, maintain momentum across teams, and ensure risks, decisions, and next steps are visible and actionable. You bring strong program management discipline, sound judgment, and collaborative influence to your work. You are comfortable operating with limited direction on how to execute, while aligning plans and recommendations to GTM priorities and stakeholder objectives. 

 Location: This position is hybrid/remote and reports to the Senior Manager of GTM PMO. 

 Responsibilities  

- Lead small-to-medium GTM transformation and growth programs, or defined workstreams within larger programs, from planning through execution, launch readiness, and stabilization

- Develop and own integrated program plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, owners, and measurable outcomes aligned to GTM priorities

- Design and manage program governance, operating cadence, and stakeholder forums that create visibility, accountability, and forward momentum within the program scope

- Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, and Data stakeholders to align plans, manage dependencies, and resolve blockers within scope

- Facilitate cross-functional alignment by understanding stakeholder goals, constraints, and incentives, and by connecting the right people to move work forward

- Frame decisions clearly with options, tradeoffs, implications, and recommended next steps to enable timely decisions at the appropriate level

- Identify and diagnose risks, dependencies, scope tradeoffs, and root causes; propose practical mitigation options and escalate thoughtfully when needed

- Create clear, executive-ready program updates, dashboards, and summaries that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and decisions needed

- Design change, enablement, readiness, and adoption plans within programs by identifying impacted audiences, sequencing dependencies, and partnering with enablement and change teams 

- Ensure launch-to-run readiness by defining ownership, support needs, hyper care plans, and post-launch stabilization activities

- Apply PMO standards, tools, templates, and best practices consistently while contributing feedback and improvements based on program learnings

- Lead workstreams or small teams through ambiguity, model strong program behaviors, and provide peer guidance, feedback, and coaching when appropriate

 Minimum Qualifications  

- 5+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years managing cross-functional programs, workstreams, or GTM initiatives with measurable business outcomes

- Experience designing and executing integrated program plans, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across multiple stakeholders or functions

- Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, organize complex work, manage scope tradeoffs, and convert objectives into clear plans and next steps 

- Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, or related GTM teams to align program objectives and execution plans 

- Experience facilitating decisions, documenting options and tradeoffs, and preparing clear materials for senior stakeholders

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize inputs from multiple viewpoints into clear recommendations and program narratives

- Experience using PMO tools, program trackers, dashboards, and shared documentation to maintain a trusted source of truth

- Working knowledge of GTM data, systems, and reporting concepts, with the ability to use data to support program decisions and status reporting

- PMP, Change Management, Agile, or related certifications preferred; practical application of program management methods is valued over strict methodology adherence

gem:axonify:am9icG9zdDodJ4MKVZYofffa4vsT.description:
Axonify is the AI-Powered Frontline Enablement Platform that helps organizations close the gap between learning and execution. By unifying learning, execution and insights capabilities, Axonify drives real business impacts for the world’s largest frontline organizations across retail, grocery, healthcare, and financial services.
More than 4 million employees across 160+ countries rely on Axonify today. It’s an exciting time to join as we transform the company and build what’s next.
We’re a team that thinks deeply, moves with intention, and embraces new ideas. We learn quickly, keep a sharp focus on real-world impact, and take meaningful action to drive progress. And we do it as one team, with openness, creativity, and a shared drive to keep pushing what’s possible
The Role
The Senior Product Manager is a strategic role at the heart of Axonify’s product offering. You will define and own the strategy for a key area of our enterprise SaaS platform, balancing the delivery of prioritized initiatives with discovery to shape the longer-term vision and roadmap. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence the direction of our platform while driving customer value, adoption, retention, revenue, and growth.
What You’ll Build
Drive customer and user research (qualitative + quantitative), define buyer personas, use cases, user workflows, and deeply understand the job your customer needs to do and the key unmet needs that unlock value.
Translate research and insights into prioritized product roadmap, requirements, user stories, release plans, and success metrics (KPIs).
Deliver solutions that span multiple interconnected product areas, ensuring they integrate cleanly with shared systems and administrative frameworks while respecting established platform boundaries.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design/UX, QA, marketing, sales, operations, and support teams to deliver high-quality and high-impact features, coordinate product lifecycle changes, and orchestrate go-to-market launches.
AI-powered features and tools across the full lifecycle - from research and ideation to prototypes, development integrations, and customer feedback systems that enhance creativity, speed, and decision quality.
Customer-facing AI experiences with well-designed prompts, human-in-the-loop workflows, quality evaluation, and safeguards for reliability and control.
Ensure internal teams (sales, marketing, enablement) are enabled to sell and support your product.
Monitor product performance post-launch (usage metrics, adoption, retention, feedback), run experiments, iterate on features.
Contribute to product excellence through peer collaboration, shared discovery, and informal mentorship as needed. 
Skillfully manage continuous customer & user input, navigate trade-offs, and ensure transparent alignment across the entire organization.
What You’ll Bring
5–7 years of experience in product management or related roles within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
Proven ability to translate complex business and user problems into clear, actionable product strategies.
Strong technical fluency - able to reason about data, system interactions, and implementation tradeoffs in partnership with engineering, without owning underlying platform architecture.
Experience leveraging product research and analytics to inform decisions, understand customer behavior, and track opportunities.
Practical understanding of modern AI-enabled workflows and how AI can be applied throughout the product lifecycle to enhance creativity, speed, and decision-making.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills — with the ability to influence across teams and levels of the organization. 
Exceptional organizational skills; proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Empathy, emotional intelligence, and a team-first mindset.
Experience building products for frontline employees is strongly preferred, particularly within frontline enablement or adjacent retail technology areas such as point-of-sale, merchandising, planogram, inventory, or warehouse management solutions.
A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies and product management tools is strongly preferred.
Previous experience managing or mentoring junior product managers or product teams is strongly preferred.
It's ok if your experience doesn't check every box! If you check off more than a few - great! We’d welcome a chance to get to know what you can bring, how you can add to our culture, and hear your unique story.
Work Location
We have a strong preference for candidates located in the 
Greater Boston area
 or within commuting distance of our 
Waterloo, Ontario, Canada

ashby:beaconsoftware:71965ed6-44a9-4d11-.title: Product Lead
ashby:beaconsoftware:71965ed6-44a9-4d11-.description:
Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

 

About the role

You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software.

 

At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns!

 

For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring.

 

This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system.


Key Responsibilities

 - Own product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional/founding product leader embedded in each business

 - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals

 - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints

 - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time

 - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions

 - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions

 - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support

 - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers

 - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies

 - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps

 - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your companies

 

As your scope grows you may also:

 - Build and lead a team of PMs, hiring, onboarding, and developing them as your portfolio scales

 - Codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems across an entire vertical

 - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor

 - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical, not just individual companies

 

What We're Looking For

 - BA/BS degree; MBA a plus

 - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS (senior candidates typically bring 7+ years, including 2+ years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder)

 - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks

 - Sharp customer discovery instincts and the ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast

 - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously

 - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority

 - For more senior candidates: a proven track record leading and developing other PMs, not just doing great PM work individually

 - Strong systems thinking — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks

 - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done

 - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity

This Role Is Perfect for You If...

 - You are an ex-founder, or have founding PM / early product hire experience at a high-growth startup

 - You want real ownership over how businesses (and, over time, entire industry verticals) get transformed through software and AI

 - You get satisfaction from shipping great product yourself — and, as you grow, from building capability in others

 - You are commercially-minded and curious about private equity, rollups, and how profitable businesses are built


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

 

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

workday:bb/BlackBerry:20260306.title: QNX Ecosystem Program Manager
workday:bb/BlackBerry:20260306.description:
Worker Sub-Type: 
Regular   
 Job Description:  
 QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

 Are You the Person We're Looking For? 

 At QNX, we're building more than industry-leading embedded software. Through our QNX Everywhere initiative, we're creating a thriving developer ecosystem that connects open-source technologies, startups, universities, consortiums, technology partners, and developers with the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). We're looking for an Ecosystem Program Manager to help scale and operationalize that vision. In this role, you'll be responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of ecosystem initiatives, managing strategic partnerships, and ensuring external engagements translate into measurable outcomes for QNX and our developer community.

 Are you someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and program execution? Do you enjoy bringing people together, building meaningful relationships, and turning strategic ideas into measurable results? We're looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, and passionate about growing technology ecosystems. You enjoy working with startups, developers, universities, open-source communities, industry consortiums, and technology partners. You're comfortable navigating both technical and business conversations and can coordinate activities across multiple teams and organizations simultaneously.

 If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and helping shape the future of the developer ecosystem around QNX, we'd love to hear from you.

 What You'll Do 

- Own the operational execution of the QNX Everywhere ecosystem strategy, ensuring initiatives progress from approval through completion.

- Act as the primary operational point of contact for ecosystem partners, technology vendors, universities, consortiums, incubators, accelerators, and other strategic organizations.

- Lead and manage the QNX Everywhere Enablement Program, helping partners integrate QNX-related offerings, developer resources, and assets into their platforms and user experiences.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with ecosystem partners while identifying opportunities to increase engagement, adoption, and collaboration.

- Develop and maintain program plans, milestones, dependencies, dashboards, KPIs, and executive status reporting.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, marketing, developer relations, product management, sales, legal, and finance teams.

- Manage relationships with incubators and accelerators such as startup hubs, innovation networks, and entrepreneurial programs.

- Create engagement plans, run recurring operational meetings, and ensure commitments, deliverables, and obligations are completed.

- Connect startups, developers, researchers, and ecosystem participants with appropriate QNX resources and subject matter experts.

- Manage operational aspects of industry consortiums, standards bodies, and strategic technology initiatives.

- Participate in consortium working groups, track action items, and ensure organizational commitments are fulfilled.

- Manage sponsorship activities and associated contracts, including NDAs, SLAs, SOWs, sponsorship agreements, and academic framework agreements.

- Coordinate procurement and purchasing activities required to support ecosystem investments and programs.

- Track engagement outcomes, program effectiveness, ecosystem investments, renewal cycles, sponsorship commitments, and budget utilization.

- Maintain a partner inventory database and identify opportunities to strengthen ecosystem coverage.

- Develop scalable, repeatable frameworks for: 
- Partner onboarding

- Sponsorship evaluation

- Ecosystem investment reviews

- Success metric tracking

- Quarterly business reviews

- Renewal and exit decisions

- Coordinate QNX participation in hackathons, workshops, conferences, demo days, job fairs, and other community events.

- Partner with marketing teams to develop and promote ecosystem initiatives and developer-focused programs.

- Use modern AI tools responsibly to help automate, streamline, and scale ecosystem operations and reporting activities.

- Travel as needed to support ecosystem partners, events, workshops, and strategic engagements.

 What You Bring 

- Experience managing programs, partnerships, strategic relationships, or ecosystem initiatives within the technology industry.

- Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with executives, engineers, academics, developers, startups, and industry partners.

- Ability to drive initiatives forward through influence, coordination, and strong follow-through.

- Comfort engaging with technical audiences and understanding developer-focused tools, technologies, and platforms.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Experience working cross-functionally within a technology-driven organization.

- Understanding of software development concepts, particularly within embedded systems, operating systems, developer platforms, or related technical domains.

- Experience managing external vendors, contracts, partnerships, or business relationships.

- Fluency in English.

 It Would Be Nice If You Had Any of the Following 

- Experience in Developer Relations, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Technical Marketing, Partner Management, or Engineering.

- PMP certification or formal project/program management training.

- Experience working with startups, incubators, accelerators, or venture-backed technology companies.

- Familiarity with embedded systems, real-time operating systems, IoT platforms, or edge computing technologies.

- Experience working with open-source communities, foundations, or developer ecosystems.

- Experience organizing technical workshops, hackathons, conferences, training programs, or community events.

- Experience developing dashboards, metrics, KPIs, Salesforce reporting, or ecosystem analytics.

- Knowledge of procurement, sponsorship management, contract administration, or legal coordination processes.

- Experience collaborating with universities, academic institutions, or research organizations.

- Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools and workflow automation solutions.

- Additional language skills such as French, German, Japanese, Korean, Swedish, or Mandarin.

 Why Join Us? 

- Help shape the future of the QNX Everywhere developer ecosystem.

- Build relationships with leading technology companies, startups, research institutions, and developer communities around the world.

- Take ownership of high-impact programs that directly influence ecosystem growth and adoption.

- Work alongside passionate experts in embedded systems, open-source software, developer relations, and product development.

- Join a collaborative, innovative team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning.

- Be exposed to emerging technologies, entrepreneurial communities, and the next generation of developers building intelligent connected systems.

 Scheduled Weekly Hours: 
40   
 Compensation Hiring Base Salary Range: 
$90,000.00 - $126,000.00   
 Please be advised that the compensation hiring range indicated herein is provided solely as a good-faith estimate of expected base compensation for the position. The actual compensation offered will be determined at the time of hire and is contingent upon multiple factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and results of assessments conducted during the hiring process.

 Bonus: 
The BlackBerry Variable Incentive Pay (VIP) program is an organization-wide bonus incentive program which aims to reward full-time eligible employees for their contribution to BlackBerry’s success. VIP payments are made in addition to base salary and factor in company’s performance as a way for employees to share in BlackBerry’s achievements.   
 Benefits: 
The BlackBerry Employee Benefits programs offer a wide range of benefits that support your physical, financial and personal well-being. BlackBerry remains committed to offering affordable benefits including coverage for medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, retirement, employee share purchase program and paid-time-off to those that meet the eligibility requirements.   
 Disclosure of Position Status: 
This is an active opening. We are seeking to fill this position immediately     
 Disclosure of Artificial Intelligence: 
 We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications are reviewed and evaluated by our hiring team.
