Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 The Role 

 Block's Canada Compliance team is building a scalable, technology-enabled compliance function for our regulated Canadian entities - Square Canada and Afterpay Canada. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, Canada, and serving as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements, you will be a “full-stack” compliance leader: driving the annual compliance plan end-to-end, overseeing frameworks across AML/ATF, sanctions, the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), consumer protection, privacy, and payment card industry obligations, and co-building the AI-enabled programs and tools that keep both entities aligned with Canadian regulatory expectations and Block's global standards.

 You Will 

- Serve as the Regulatory Program Lead for Block's Canadian regulated entities, acting as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements

- Lead end-to-end execution of the annual Canada Compliance Plan -  regulatory change management, monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and policy reviews - delivering against key milestones and regulatory commitments

- Run Canada's compliance programs across AML/ATF (Square Canada MSB), RPAA, the PCI Code of Conduct, and consumer protection and privacy obligations (PIPEDA, CASL, FCAC, provincial requirements), including FINTRAC registration and support for regulatory examinations and audits

- Lead governance and tracking of regulatory commitments, audit actions, and findings - driving issue management and remediation through to closure - while maintaining the compliance risk assessment framework, policies, and governance documentation

- Prepare Board and governance committee materials, translating multi-domain regulatory complexity into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership

- Lead cross-functional regulatory programs across Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, and Engineering, driving operational excellence through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled compliance solutions

- Coordinate compliance training and targeted regulatory awareness materials for senior leadership, Boards, and business stakeholders

 You Have 

- 10+ years of progressive experience in compliance, financial crime, or regulatory affairs, which must include payments compliance at a regulated payments entity - an MSB, payment service provider, acquirer, or comparable fintech such as Square Canada and serving in, or directly supporting, a senior compliance leadership role (CCO, Deputy CCO, Head of Compliance, CAMLO / Deputy CAMLO)

- Deep knowledge of Canadian AML/ATF legislation (PCMLTFA, FINTRAC guidance), the RPAA, the Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada, consumer protection frameworks (FCAC, PIPEDA, CASL), and Canadian sanctions regimes (SEMA, UN sanctions)

- Executive presence, with experience preparing and presenting Board-level compliance reporting and engaging directly with regulators through examinations and ongoing supervision

- Direct end-to-end working knowledge of payment systems, money services businesses - including payments-specific financial crime typologies and controls

- Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI tools for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation - with sound judgment about their limits

- A builder mindset with proven leadership, people management, and stakeholder engagement capabilities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment; CAMS, ICA, or equivalent certification

- Bonus points: knowledge of buy-now-pay-later compliance programs, Quebec regulatory regime, hands-on RPAA compliance, OSFI guidelines, the AUSTRAC / Australian AML/CTF regime, or bilingual English/French

 Technologies We Use and Teach 

- Protecht (GRC / issue and risk management)

- AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT / OpenAI Enterprise / GitHub) for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation

- JIRA and Confluence (program and documentation management)

- Looker / Tableau (reporting and dashboards)

About Blue J
Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence.
Backed by a $122M USD Series D funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.
A Note on Location
This is a hybrid role based in Toronto. We’re looking for someone who can join us in-office 2 times per week in our downtown office, while also enjoying flexibility to work remotely the rest of the time. All candidates must be eligible to work in Canada. 
To help you get off to a great start, we bring all new team members together for their first three days of onboarding. If you’re based outside of our local commuting area, Blue J will arrange and cover your travel and accommodation.
The Opportunity
This is a unique opportunity to join Blue J at a stage of rapid growth, taking on dedicated ownership of a key part of our product roadmap. Working day-to-day with a cross-functional team (Product, Design, Engineering) and partnering closely with engineering leadership, you'll bridge the gap between initial discovery and long-term product success. You'll shape how tax professionals experience Blue J day to day, building the strategy and systems that turn core product value into consistent and lasting usage.
What You’ll be Doing
Partner with engineering, design, and other cross-functional teams to help define and execute the product roadmap, from concept through launch.
Understand the competitive landscape and evaluate market trends to inform product strategy and prioritization.
Engage with end users and internal stakeholders to identify pain points, market opportunities, and unmet needs.
Partner with Marketing and Sales to develop go-to-market strategies and ensure successful product launches.
Become an expert on our clients and end users, using a mix of quantitative and qualitative research to shape product requirements and improvements.
Write clear specs and user stories, and work closely with engineering to scope, sequence, and ship features.
Establish, monitor, and measure success metrics after launch, and consistently incorporate usage data and customer feedback into product decisions.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders across the organization.
What You Offer Blue J 
5+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS company, with a solid technical foundation
Comfortable engaging deeply with engineers on architecture, trade-offs, and implementation details, and experience taking products from concept to launch alongside a software engineering team.
Comfortable balancing qualitative and quantitative inputs (user research, data analysis, market trends) to make prioritization calls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into actionable plans.
Excellent communication skills (oral, written, and presentation) to align diverse audiences around a shared direction.
Enjoys working across teams in a collaborative environment, with a high level of diplomacy and tact.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, improve workflows, and stay ahead of industry trends.
What We Offer You 
A rare opportunity  to make a difference and help shape the future of our product.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team that values innovation, respect, and fun.
The excitement of a fast-growing, well-funded company with clear momentum, and the resources to back bold initiatives.
The Core Values that Define Our Culture
We are customer-focused
We put team over self
We are pleasant and playful
We are open to better ideas
We move fast and fix things
What to Expect in the Interview Process
We anticipate a high volume of applicants for this role and are excited to grow our team. A human will review each application and get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with you! 
Interview Process
Chat with Bailey, Talent Acquisition Manager
Meet Adam Haines, VP of Product
Present your Case study to Adam Haines, VP of Product, Matt Malden, Chief Product Officer, and one other stakeholder 
Meet Ben, our CEO
We believe our strength is built on diversity of thought, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value inclusiveness and are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We strive to create an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know in your application. Our team is dedicated to providing the necessary support and making reasonable adjustments to ensure a smooth process for everyone.
How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process
To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Blue J uses AI-enabled tools within our applicant tracking system to help organize applications and highlight profiles that match the key requirements for each role.
AI does not make hiring decisions.
Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans.
We use these tools to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment and we’re committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable 
experience for every candidate.
Compensation
The base pay range for this role i
s $130-150K CAD 
per year.
This is a Level 
3 in
 Blue J’s career level framework. We use levels to define the expected scope, autonomy, impact, decision-making, and experience for each role. Final compensation will be set fairly and thoughtfully based on experience, expertise, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities. While all candidates are expected to bring directly relevant experience, the top of the range is typically reserved for individuals who demonstrate exceptional depth in the role’s core competencies, a strong track record of impact in similar environments, and the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy from day one.

 Product Owner, AI & Analytics 
 What if your next role wasn't about managing a backlog?
 What if it was about taking complex business challenges and transforming them into AI-powered products that change how bankers work, how clients are served, and how decisions are made?
 As a Product Owner within BMO's AI & Analytics team, you will help shape and deliver innovative products that leverage analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven insights to solve meaningful challenges across Commercial Banking.
 You will work directly with business leaders, relationship managers, sales professionals, data scientists, engineers, and product partners to identify opportunities, shape product strategy, and transform ideas into products that drive measurable business value.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys shaping product vision, solving complex business problems, and leading products from concept through adoption and business impact.

 What You'll Do 
 Turn Ideas Into Products
 Take customer needs, business challenges, and strategic opportunities and transform them into products that create measurable business value.
 You will help answer questions such as:

- What problem are we solving?

- Why does it matter?

- Who are we solving it for?

- What experience will create the greatest value?

- What should we prioritize first?

- How do we build something users will adopt and trust?
 Starting with customer needs, business challenges, and strategic opportunities, you will help develop product strategies, priorities, and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Lead Discovery and Shape Product Direction 

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, opportunities, workflows, priorities, and user needs.

- Help stakeholders define, prioritize, and validate opportunities that create value.

- Challenge assumptions and ask thoughtful questions that help teams focus on the problems that matter most.

 Apply Business Acumen to Drive Better Decisions

- Evaluate opportunities through both a product and business lens, balancing customer value, commercial impact, risk, effort, and long-term benefit.

- Build credibility with business leaders by connecting product decisions to measurable outcomes.

- Help stakeholders evaluate trade-offs and investment decisions that maximize value.

 Bridge Business and Technology 
 Act as the link between business stakeholders and delivery teams, translating business goals, user workflows, data requirements, and technology capabilities into clear product requirements.
 Translate business needs into:

- Product roadmaps

- Product requirements

- User stories

- Acceptance criteria

- Prioritized backlogs
 Ensure teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how success will be measured.

 Champion the User Experience

 Continuously evaluate how products can become:

- Easier to use

- More valuable

- More intuitive

- Better aligned to user workflows
 Focus not simply on feature delivery, but on adoption, customer outcomes, and long-term value creation.

 Drive AI Product Delivery 
 Work closely with:

- Data Scientists

- Data Engineers

- Software Developers

- Architects

- Scrum Masters

- Product Managers

- Business Stakeholders
 to bring AI-powered capabilities from discovery through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

- Balance customer value, business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

- Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions align with business objectives and user needs.

 Influence Without Authority 

- Build strong relationships across stakeholder groups.

- Navigate competing priorities and align diverse perspectives to move decisions forward.

- Communicate effectively across business and technical audiences.

- Help teams make informed decisions that maximize business outcomes.
 Success in this role requires strong communication skills, business credibility, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to unite teams around a common product vision.

 Ownership and Initiative 

- You are proactive.

- You do not wait for perfect information.

- You take accountability for outcomes and consistently move work forward.

- You demonstrate resilience, adaptability, and a growth mindset.
 Strong Critical Thinking 

- You enjoy solving difficult problems.

- You can take abstract concepts and transform them into a clear product vision, structured requirements, and executable plans.

- You ask insightful questions and quickly identify what matters most.

- You use data, customer insights, research, and sound judgment to evaluate options and make informed decisions.
 Product Mindset 

- You think beyond requirements.

- You think about customers, adoption, outcomes, workflows, and long-term value creation.

- You connect customer needs, business objectives, data insights, and technology capabilities into cohesive product strategies.
 Business Acumen 

- You understand how organizations create value and how products contribute to business results.

- You can engage credibly with stakeholders and connect product decisions to strategic priorities, customer outcomes, operational improvements, and financial performance.

- Experience in financial services, banking, analytics, payments, lending, treasury, consulting, or related industries is highly valued.
 Product Delivery Experience 

- You have experience translating product strategy into execution through planning, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration.

- You understand product delivery practices, backlog management, release planning, and product development lifecycles.

- You know how to help teams execute effectively while maintaining focus on broader product goals and business outcomes.
 Curiosity and Continuous Learning 

- You enjoy learning new domains, technologies, and business concepts.

- You seek feedback, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve.

- You remain curious about emerging technologies, AI capabilities, customer needs, and business opportunities.

- Typically 5-7 years of relevant experience and post-secondary education in a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Strategy, or related disciplines

- Experience translating business requirements into product requirements and user stories

- Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams

- Experience in financial services, banking, analytics, data products, digital products, or AI-enabled solutions

- Experience supporting Agile delivery teams
 Nice To Have 

- AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics experience

- Jira, Rovo, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tooling experience

- Agile certifications or Product Owner certifications

- Commercial Banking or Treasury & Payments experience
 Why This Role Is Different 
 This is not a role focused solely on requirements gathering or backlog administration.
 This is an opportunity to help define and build the next generation of AI-powered capabilities that will transform how Commercial Banking teams engage clients, generate insights, make decisions, and create value.
 If you enjoy taking ideas from whiteboard discussions to real-world products used by thousands of users, we'd love to hear from you.

 Join a purpose‑driven team at the core of BMO’s risk management ecosystem. As the Senior Manager, Credit Risk Strategy Oversight , you will provide independent, forward‑looking challenge on credit strategies, policies, and portfolio decisions across BMO’s Canadian Retail lending business. In this high‑impact second line role, you will strengthen the bank’s risk discipline through clear, data‑driven oversight, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and enterprise governance. You will influence strategic credit outcomes, elevate decision quality, and help embed sound credit practices across the lifecycle. This role provides meaningful opportunities to strengthen portfolio resilience and support BMO’s commitment to Boldly Grow the Good.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Credit Risk Strategies Oversight & Effective Challenge 

- Provide independent review and challenge of retail unsecured lending credit strategies ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

- Responsibility for forming, documenting and communicating independent conclusions, including findings, limitations, residual risks, approval recommendations and required mitigants.

- End-to-end lifecycle oversight with Effective Challenge across strategy development, approval, implementation, post-implementation review and ongoing monitoring.

- Review and challenge champion-challenger testing frameworks, policy experiments, and strategy optimization initiatives.

- Assess conceptual soundness, core assumptions, data quality, and directional risk impacts across origination, account management, and collections strategies.

- Ensure sufficient controls, monitoring, and success measures are established prior to implementation.

- Evaluate post-implementation results and provide independent assessment of realized risk outcomes.

- Monitor portfolio performance, early‑warning indicators, and emerging risks; escalate material issues with clear, actionable recommendations.

- Identify deviations from expected outcomes and support timely adjustments to strategies, controls, and processes.
 Risk Governance, Policy & Regulatory Compliance

- Oversee adherence to credit‑related policies, standards, and regulatory requirements

- Support internal audits, regulatory examinations and risk governance assessments.

- Ensure appropriate documentation, evidence of challenge, and governance records are maintained for significant risk decisions.
 Cross‑Functional Influence & Collaboration 

- Partner with business teams to review and validate business cases, ensuring assumptions are robust, risk and financial impacts are well quantified, and proposals comply with enterprise standards and governance requirements.

- Take on broader work or enterprise‑wide deliverables as required.

- Demonstrated ability to provide objective, well‑reasoned, analytically grounded challenge.

- Strong understanding of credit lifecycle economics, ROE drivers, and risk‑return optimization principles.

- Advanced skills in Python, SQL, SAS, R, or comparable analytical tools; ability to translate complex analysis for senior audiences.

- Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills; able to operate autonomously in a fast‑paced environment.

 What We Offer

- Access to senior leadership, cross‑functional partners, and complex analytical challenges that support ongoing career development.

 Role Mandate

 The role is accountable for balancing customer outcomes, portfolio growth, profitability, pricing, risk-adjusted performance and operational sustainability . It uses market, customer, financial, operational and risk insights to identify opportunities, recommend priorities, develop business cases and translate strategy into executable initiatives.
 The Group Product Manager operates as a senior Home Financing product subject-matter expert and trusted advisor. The role leads through a complex matrix, mobilizing partners across Technology, Credit Risk, Operations, Collections, Finance, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Analytics and frontline channels. The role also provides direct people leadership, building team capability through clear accountability, coaching, delegation and development.

 Key Accountabilities 
 Product strategy and portfolio leadership 

- Define and maintain the vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for the assigned Home Financing product portfolio, aligned with Canadian P&BB priorities, customer needs, market conditions and BMO’s risk appetite.

- Identify emerging trends, customer needs, competitive developments, regulatory changes and product gaps; translate insights into strategic recommendations and prioritized action plans.

- Recommend business priorities, sequencing and resource requirements to senior leaders and provide clear strategic direction to delivery teams and partners.

- Act as the senior product subject-matter expert for the assigned portfolio, communicating complex product, financial, technology and risk considerations in clear business terms.
 End-to-end product lifecycle management 

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of the assigned products and capabilities, including strategy, design, value proposition, pricing, implementation, servicing, enhancement, sustainment and retirement.

- Ensure product requirements, documentation, templates, customer and employee materials, policies and procedures accurately reflect approved product and system functionality.

- Assess product and process issues, establish root causes and lead sustainable solutions that improve customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and control performance.

- Maintain an integrated view of product, process, technology, data and channel interdependencies and ensure changes are appropriately sequenced and governed.
 Portfolio economics, pricing and performance 

- Establish and monitor financial, customer, growth, utilization, retention, operational and risk indicators for the portfolio.

- Develop a deep understanding of portfolio economics and performance drivers, including balances, originations, revenue, margin, expenses, capital considerations, customer behaviour and channel performance.

- Lead or support pricing and value-proposition strategies, including analysis of customer impact, competitiveness, financial outcomes, operational feasibility and risk implications.

- Partner with Finance, Treasury, Analytics, Risk and channel stakeholders on forecasting, performance reporting and recommended corrective actions.

- Prepare clear executive-level insights, recommendations and decisions required to improve portfolio growth, profitability and risk-adjusted performance.
 Customer, frontline and channel experience 

- Champion the end-to-end customer and frontline experience across acquisition, fulfilment, servicing, renewal, refinance, re-advance and other relevant lifecycle events.

- Use customer research, behavioural data, frontline feedback, complaints, operational insights and journey analysis to identify friction points and prioritize improvements.

- Partner with Marketing, Analytics, Digital, Operations and distribution channels to develop effective value propositions, offers, campaigns, education, training and adoption plans.

- Ensure frontline teams have clear product guidance, job aids, documentation, escalation paths and change-management support.

- Promote simple, transparent and consistent experiences across assisted and digital channels.
 Business cases, investment and roadmap prioritization 

- Identify product and capability opportunities and develop business cases that articulate customer, financial, strategic, operational, technology and risk outcomes.

- Evaluate solution options, delivery dependencies, expected benefits, implementation costs and return on investment.

- Recommend investment priorities and roadmap trade-offs; support project and budget approval processes and maintain visibility of expected outcomes and benefits.

- Govern material roadmap changes through the appropriate approval and escalation forums.

- Ensure initiatives remain aligned to approved scope, intended benefits and product strategy throughout delivery and sustainment.
 Cross-functional execution and change leadership 

- Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from opportunity definition and business requirements through implementation, readiness, adoption, benefits realization and sustainment.

- Establish clear outcomes, decision requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, risks and escalation paths.

- Build alignment among Technology, Credit Risk, Operations, Collections, Finance, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Analytics and frontline-channel partners.

- Monitor delivery progress, resolve obstacles and escalate material scope, funding, risk, customer or timing decisions to the appropriate governance body.

- Lead change-management activities, including stakeholder engagement, readiness, communications, training, implementation and post-launch monitoring.
 Risk, regulatory, audit and control governance 

- Manage product risks in accordance with BMO’s Risk Management Framework, Risk Culture and approved Risk Appetite.

- Maintain an effective understanding of legal, regulatory, compliance, credit, operational, conduct, technology, data and third-party risks affecting the portfolio.

- Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Corporate Audit and operational control partners to identify control gaps, develop sustainable remediation and demonstrate ongoing effectiveness.

- Lead or support product reviews, attestations, regulatory reporting, audit responses, control testing and maintenance of product policies, directives and procedures.

- Ensure product and pricing decisions are risk-informed, appropriately documented and approved through established authorities.

- Surface emerging risks promptly and drive timely escalation and remediation.
 External partners and complex escalations 

- Develop and maintain effective relationships with relevant external partners, vendors and industry contacts.

- Establish expectations, monitor performance and support negotiations or issue resolution while balancing customer outcomes, cost, risk and service quality.

- Provide senior product leadership for complex customer, frontline, product, policy or operational escalations.

- Assess exceptions and escalations within delegated authority and ensure matters outside that authority are advanced to the correct decision maker.
 People Leadership 

- Lead, coach and develop product-management colleagues, establishing clear mandates, priorities, expected outcomes and accountability.

- Build a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team connected to BMO’s purpose, values and Home Financing strategy.

- Attract, retain and develop talent; provide regular feedback, recognize strong contribution and address performance or capability gaps.

- Delegate meaningful accountability and provide appropriate challenge, guidance and decision support.

- Develop product-management capability, subject-matter depth, succession readiness and cross-training to reduce key-person dependency.

- Promote collaboration across functional and operating groups and create an environment in which colleagues can constructively challenge, learn and deliver together.

 Qualifications and Experience 

- Typically 9+ years of relevant experience in banking product management, home financing, secured lending, consumer credit, financial-services strategy or a closely related field.

- Post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Commerce or a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Senior-level experience developing product strategies, multi-year roadmaps and business cases and managing products across their full lifecycle.

- Strong knowledge of Canadian retail banking and home financing, including secured-lending products, pricing, customer and channel considerations, product economics, delivery infrastructure and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Demonstrated experience with portfolio performance, financial analysis, forecasting, market research, competitive analysis and data-driven decision-making.

- Strong experience managing risk associated with new and existing products, including product policies, controls, regulatory or audit requirements and sustainable remediation.

- Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.

- People-management experience, including coaching, delegation, talent development and building team capability.

- Experience managing senior stakeholders and developing effective external-partner or vendor relationships.

- Experience translating complex product, financial, risk, customer and technology considerations into clear executive recommendations.

- Home financing and secured-lending knowledge

- Pricing and value-proposition development

Audit, Risk & Compliance 

 Join a purpose‑driven team at the center of BMO’s risk management ecosystem. As a Manager, Credit Risk Strategy Oversight , you will provide specialized analytics, structured challenge, and risk‑focused insight across Canadian Retail lending business. Operating in the second line, you will apply sound judgment within established frameworks to identify, diagnose, and address complex, non‑routine issues strengthening decision quality, transparency, and alignment to risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and governance standards. While your primary focus is on business/group priorities, you will have opportunities to contribute to broader enterprise initiatives as experience grows.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Independent Risk Oversight & Effective Challenge 

- Provide independent, evidence‑based challenge on credit proposals, strategy changes, segmentation approaches, ML‑enabled decisioning, and underwriting policies to ensure alignment with risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

- Assess conceptual soundness, key assumptions, data integrity, and directional risk impacts across origination, account management, and collections strategies; escalate issues with concise, actionable recommendations.

- Monitor portfolio performance, early‑warning indicators, and emerging risks; contribute to second‑line reporting and leadership briefings with clear, data‑driven insights.

 Portfolio Risk Insight, Stress Testing & Strategic Advisory 

- Conduct advanced analytics, trend and concentration reviews, and early‑warning indicator assessments to identify forward‑looking vulnerabilities and loss pressures.

- Develop well‑supported recommendations that enhance portfolio quality, strengthen risk‑return outcomes, and improve end‑to‑end credit decisioning.

- Present analytical findings to first‑ and second‑line stakeholders in a clear, structured, and decision‑ready manner.

- Execute components of regulatory capital and stress‑testing analysis, with an emphasis on PCL, expected loss dynamics, and sensitivity to macroeconomic scenarios.

 Cross‑Functional Influence & Collaboration 

- Provide analytical and consultative support to partners in Credit, Finance, Product, Legal, Operations, Data & Analytics, and Modeling, embedding risk considerations early in design.

- Translate complex analyses into clear narratives and visuals tailored to executives and governance forums.

- Ensure strategic initiatives align with governance expectations including business casing, risk stewardship, data quality, and model governance considerations.

 Credit Governance, Policy & Framework Stewardship 

- Maintain and enhance credit risk governance artifacts (roles, authorities, controls) in alignment with enterprise risk and model risk management standards.

- Support adherence to credit policies, standards, and Regulatory Compliance Management (RCM) requirements; partner with Compliance on control design, monitoring, and issue remediation.

- Manage documentation lifecycles for credit proposals, policy updates, decision memos, and second‑line oversight deliverables.

 Judgment, Independence & Continuous Improvement 

- Work independently on non‑routine issues applying strong judgment while operating within established frameworks and governance boundaries.

- Mentor analysts and associates to strengthen analytical rigor, credit judgment, and effective‑challenge capabilities.

- Identify and implement improvements to oversight processes, risk reporting, and governance practices as trends and expectations evolve.

- Take on broader responsibilities or contributions to enterprise initiatives based on business needs and developmental trajectory.

 Qualifications 

- Typically 5–7 years in risk analytics, portfolio management, credit strategy, or related analytical roles within a financial institution.

- Postsecondary degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Strong applied experience with analytical tools such as Python, SQL, SAS, or R; ability to translate complex analysis into clear, concise insights for senior audiences.

- Solid understanding of credit risk principles, portfolio analytics, governance expectations, and regulatory concepts gained through hands‑on experience.

 What We Offer 

- A high‑impact second‑line role with visibility across priority businesses and exposure to enterprise initiatives.

- Opportunities to materially enhance credit oversight, strengthen decision quality, and reinforce portfolio resilience.

- A culture that values integrity, inclusion, innovation, and high performance.

- Access to senior leaders, cross‑functional partners, and complex oversight challenges that support ongoing career development.

successfactors:jobs.canadalife.com:14425.description:
Permanent Full Time  

 - 

 The Individual Wealth Technology team within Application Delivery, Canada and Lifeco, is seeking a Solutions Architect. This role is a match for you if you are passionate about Wealth and working to innovate, define, and deliver high quality technology solutions. The Solutions Architect will play a key role in our team by serving as a trusted advisor to our internal clients and partnering with the business to enable and support delivery.

 The Solutions Architect will collaborate with their portfolio & technology teams as well as business partners, sponsors, and stakeholders to contribute to the development of strategies and roadmaps for the business. They will work to define and maintain architecture artifacts for supporting project delivery and application support. They will play an active role in setting the technical vision and direction for solutions, ensuring consistency with overall enterprise and portfolio architecture. During the execution of these activities this may, at times, require hands-on development. The Solutions Architect will also have the opportunity to effect change within the organization by incorporating new patterns and/or technologies into new ways of working that improve business value. 

 At our company, the customer is at the center of what we do. The Individual Wealth Technology team is looking for innovative, collaborative, fun-loving candidates that exemplify this and can demonstrate it in their work. We care about the financial, physical, and mental well-being of our customers and our staff. 

 What you will do: 

- Defines and facilitates a solution architecture that leverages enterprise capabilities and efficient usage of processes, technology, data and people to align these capabilities 

- Consults with business partners and delivery stakeholders 

- Participates in the definition of, and helps to maintain the technical solution architecture(s) 

- Actively participates in the discussions which drive the architectural decisions for the team and develop the technical vision and direction for the solution. 

- Defines and creates candidate architecture solutions 

- Defines and maintains solution architectures for applications 

- Ensures quality designs when involved in solutioning any infrastructure and development issues. 

- Proactively identifies opportunities where solutions can enhance organizational efficiency 

- Actively engaged as the team works to solve complex problems 

- Keeps abreast of latest technological/industry trends 

- Acts as trusted technology advisor/advocate for business units 

- Supports the development of technology roadmaps and proposals to achieve business plans. 

- Works closely with all team members to create solutions that accommodate future architectural changes and designs 

- Identify critical driving forces of process, data, people and technology and identify any changes or improvements that can be made. 

- Ability to look beyond traditional business concepts and drill to the heart of a given concept 

 What you will bring: 

- Bachelor Computer Science / Software Engineering degree or equivalent experience. 

- Minimum 7 years of related experience in technology environments. 

- Minimum of 4 years working as an architect with experience on large scale projects enabling business to achieve the goals and objectives. 

- Experience leading architecture activities in conjunction with the Enterprise Architect or Portfolio Architect. 

- Able to act as a mentor to less experienced architects and developers/engineers. 

- Architectural experience using modelling languages and frameworks (UML, TOGAF, Archimate, 4+1 View Model, LeanIX), architecture practices and principles in Business, Information (data), Application, Technology, and Security architecture disciplines 

- Experience in Wealth Management technology ecosystems. 

- Proven business acumen demonstrated through a broad understanding of an organization, functions, practices, trends and competition. 

- Financial knowledge demonstrated through the ability to calculate the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI). 

- Values simplicity, ability to simplify difficult concepts. 

- Ability to foster collaborative stakeholder relationships across multiple business functions. 

- Ability to effectively communicate high-level concepts and solutions with technology and business teams and stakeholders.  

- Capable of high level of analysis of the big picture while maintaining a level of detail appropriate to the context of a variety of situations. 

- Understands the framework (i.e. structure, people, processes, and technology) that supports an organization’s strategy and can successfully leverage it. 

- Understands policy, practice, and standards to ensure design and delivery of compliant solutions. 

- Able to challenge business and technical constraints in support of continuous improvement. 

- Self-starter with the ability to comfortably operate in ambiguity. 

 - 

 The base salary for this position is between $113,500.00 - $163,500.00 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you. 

 Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Grow with Canada Life   

 We’re united by a shared purpose: to improve the financial, physical and mental well-being of Canadians. Our company is trusted by 1 in 3 Canadians and contributes to the strength of communities across the country.    

 We’re looking for people who live our values everyday: we step up, we do the right thing, and we deliver – for our customers, communities and each other. Are you someone who always strives to do the right thing, who steps up for themselves and others, and who delivers with impact? Then we want to hear from you!   

 What we offer :   

 We’re committed to supporting our employees through every stage of their career. Here’s what you can expect as a full-time or part-time permanent team member:  

- Career Development : Opportunities for career advancement, access to industry-leading learning programs and up to $2,000 annually towards education reimbursement.

 Cloud, Data, Integration & AI

- AI/ML lifecycle architecture (training pipelines, deployment patterns, inference)

- GenAI-enabled use cases with responsible AI guardrails

 Governance, Standards & Delivery Enablement

- Ensure secure-by-design and operationally ready solutions in partnership with security and SRE teams.

 Stakeholder Partnership & Influence 

- Work with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to shape solution options and trade-offs.

- Clearly communicate architectural intent, risks, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Act as a trusted advisor during delivery and planning.

 Required experience 

- 7+ years in technology with 3+ years in solution or technical architecture roles.

- Experience delivering solutions across retail platforms (supply chain, stores, merchandising, and/or digital).

- Strong experience with API-led and event-driven integration architectures.

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or GCP) including networking, identity, and deployment models.

- Strong understanding of security, resiliency, performance, and observability.

 Strongly preferred 

- Experience with retail enterprise platforms such as OMS, POS, WMS/TMS, ERP, PIM, pricing or promotion engines.

- Data platform and analytics architecture experience (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, streaming).

- AI/ML or GenAI architecture exposure, including deployment, monitoring, and responsible AI considerations.

- Store edge computing or offline-first architecture experience.

 Core skills 

- Architecture modeling (C4, UML, sequence/data flows, domain models).

- Strong analytical thinking and decision-making.

- Clear, concise written and verbal communication.

successfactors:careers.celestica.com:144.description:
Req ID: 141532 
Remote Position: Hybrid
Region: Americas 
Country: Canada 
State/Province: Ontario 
City:  Toronto 
 Summary

 The Senior Solutions Architect, Services Operations develops integrated service offerings for major customers within the Services Business Unit (Fulfillment, Supply Chain, After-Market Services, and Product Launch). This role involves leveraging resources to deliver world-class solutions, supporting the entire sales cycle for solution project proposals. They create quantifiable, documented, and technically integrated product lifecycle solutions, identifying and assembling expert teams from various Services core businesses to optimize Product Launch Acceleration, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, After Sales, and Operations. Recognized as a technical expert by clients, the Solutions Architect, Services Operations builds strong relationships with major customers at all organizational levels, directly engaging with key decision-makers. They serve as the technical point of contact, provide expert support to the Sales Organization, participate in Mega Deal Teams, and document standard solutions. 

 Detailed Description

 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following

- Leads solution development for assigned Services Business Unit opportunities.

- Acts as subject matter expert on solutions for integrated solutions being addressed by Services/Celestica.

- Works with other team members to scope the project and create high level work-plans, milestones, decision points, and approval paths.

- Works with customers to understand specific and unstated needs in a consultative manner.

- Identifies pain points, service gaps, dependencies, risks, and requirements not addressed by solution, and communicates to the team.

- Develops complete solutions to customer problems, including service scope, operating model, process flow, capacity, staffing, space, logistics, equipment, technology, quality, and launch approach.

- Pulls in subject matter experts and site resources as needed to develop solutions.

- Works with business process analysts to ensure processes are developed to integrate solutions to customers.

- Works with financial analysts to ensure understanding of financial implications of solutions for Celestica and the customer.

- Works with Account Teams/Engagement Leaders to develop compelling communication solutions.

- Assists with the negotiation team to understand the implications of alternatives.

- Works with salespeople to validate and qualify opportunities.

- Prepares approval-ready recommendations for internal leadership and customer review.

- Leads proposal-to-NPI or proposal-to-implementation handoffs, including scope boundaries, operating assumptions, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and readiness actions.

- Supports launch reviews, early-life stabilization, lessons learned, and post-launch improvement activities.

- Identifies opportunities for standardization, automation, data-quality improvement, and margin expansion.

- Documents reusable solution patterns, templates, models, and standards.

- Develops unsolicited proposals to targeted customers.

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

- Project and Opportunity management experience.

- Strong leadership, professionalism, reliability, creativity, detail oriented and follow-through with a can-do attitude.

- Consultative skills (ability to understand true customer needs).

- Distinctive solution development and systems definition skills.

- Expert spreadsheet and presentation skills, with the ability to make models auditable and explain assumptions clearly.

- Outstanding communication skills.

- Demonstrated team-leadership capabilities, including leadership without direct authority.

- Ability to generate leads within targeted customers.

- Demonstrated success with unsolicited proposals or customer expansion concepts.

- Understand and achieve Financial Plan objectives.

- Demonstrated capability to build relationships and participate effectively on cross-functional teams.

- Ability to translate incomplete or ambiguous requirements into executable operating models.

- Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive opportunities and maintain action ownership through completion.

- Substantial knowledge of business (Fulfillment and Supply Chain, After-Market Services or Product Launch) and demonstrated ability to leverage organization

 Physical Demands

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.

- Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

- Frequent overnight travel may be required.

- Duties may require extended or unusual working hours during critical customer proposals, approvals, implementations, or launches.

 Salary

 The stated range includes Base Salary and target Short-Term Incentive (STI) compensation only. A comprehensive benefits package is offered in addition to this range.

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

 Salary + Short Term Incentive = 125,000 - 199,000 CAD

 Typical Experience

- Eight plus years of applicable experience, including two plus years of directly applicable solutions architect experience.

- Experience in Services Business Unit (Fulfillment and Supply Chain, After-Market Services or Product Launch) solution development.

- Experience in profit & loss responsibility is highly desired.

 Typical Education

- 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 
 Educational requirements may vary by geography.

 Notes

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

 Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them. 

 COMPANY OVERVIEW: 

 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages. 

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments:  Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC): 

 ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions. 

 CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth. 

 Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.

njoyn:cgi:J1026-1264.title: Senior / Principal Forward Deployed Engineering & AI Solutions Architect
njoyn:cgi:J1026-1264.description:
CGI is seeking an accomplished, independent and commercially astute Senior / Principal Forward Deployed Engineering & AI Solutions Architect to help establish, evolve and deliver our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) service offering. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership and business consulting role—not a traditional business analyst, advisory-only architect or staff-augmentation assignment.

The successful candidate combines deep software engineering and enterprise architecture expertise with exceptional business consulting capabilities and demonstrated experience designing, building, integrating and deploying AI-powered solutions. They can engage executive stakeholders, diagnose ambiguous business problems, shape investable opportunities, select appropriate technologies and lead implementation through production readiness, adoption and measurable business outcomes.

A central mandate is to develop, operationalize and continuously refine CGI’s modular FDE delivery framework so it can be adapted to enterprise and mid-market clients, diverse technology stacks, different levels of organizational maturity, and varying security, regulatory and operational requirements. AI must be leveraged both to create valuable client solutions and, wherever appropriate, to accelerate the engineering lifecycle—without compromising security, quality, governance or human accountability.

njoyn:cgi:J1026-0275.title: Product Analyst – Commercial / Logistics & Transportation
njoyn:cgi:J1026-0275.description: CGI is looking for a Product Analyst to act as the key liaison between business users, Business Analysts, product development teams, software vendors, and internal technical teams.This role requires a strong combination of business understanding and technical acumen. The Product Analyst will not be expected to develop or code applications but must have sufficient knowledge of software and application environments to effectively translate business needs into actionable requirements, assess technical feasibility, and facilitate discussions between business and technology stakeholders.The successful candidate will have experience in Logistics, Transportation, and/or Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and will support business users and technology teams across Canada and the United States while collaborating with global teams, including Singapore.

njoyn:cgi:J0626-2163.title: Solution Architect (Wealth/ Asset Management)
njoyn:cgi:J0626-2163.description:
This role is hybrid and requires you to be at our downtown Toronto and/or Client office at a minimum 1 days per week subject to change at any time. 

As a Solution Architect for the Wealth and Asset Management Fund Accounting platform, you will lead end-to-end solution architecture and design, and support delivery for both product development and client implementations. You will act as the technical authority and bridge between product, engineering, and operations, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions aligned with strategic platform goals. 

This role requires strong expertise in fund accounting, institutional investor asset management, and modern architecture patterns, along with the ability to influence stakeholders, guide distributed teams, and drive innovation across the platform lifecycle.

Position Description:
SAP Integration Product Owner
The SAP Integration Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering integration initiatives between SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA) and internal or external applications. The Product Owner acts as the main point of contact between business stakeholders, architects, functional analysts, and the development team, while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives by promoting best practices in Agile, DevSecOps, and integration architecture.
Your future duties and responsibilities:
Responsibilities
. Articulate and communicate a clear vision for SAP integration solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and business strategies.
. Maintain and continuously refine the SAP integration roadmap based on business priorities and evolving needs.
. Gather, analyze, and prioritize requirements from business stakeholders, projects, and IT teams.
. Translate requirements into clear, prioritized user stories, in collaboration with solution and integration architects.
. Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring quality, consistency, and strategic alignment.
. Act as the leader of a team of functional analysts and SAP integration developers, fostering collaboration, accountability, and performance.
. Coach and support the team in delivering robust, secure, and scalable integration solutions.
. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (daily scrums, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
. Contribute to team capacity planning and delivery scheduling.
. Collaborate closely with architects, functional analysts, project teams, and operations to ensure consistent delivery.
. Manage dependencies between SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA) and external systems.
. Ensure the quality, performance, security, and reliability of SAP integrations.
. Contribute to the continuous improvement of integration practices and the adoption of Agile and DevSecOps approaches.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

njoyn:cgi:J1026-0108.description:
This role is centered on supporting products and features tied to the modernization of pharmacy inventory system within a large, enterprise healthcare environment. The organization is making significant investments to transform legacy pharmacy platforms into a more scalable, integrated, and digital first ecosystem and this Product Manager will play a key role in shaping that evolution.

 You would be responsible for driving product strategy, defining and prioritizing features, and partnering closely with engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders to deliver modernized capabilities that improve patient experience, operational efficiency, and overall pharmacy performance. The work is highly visible and impactful, with the opportunity to influence both near-term delivery and long-term platform direction.

 We're looking for someone who can operate strategically while still being hands on in execution, someone comfortable navigating complex enterprise environments, working across multiple stakeholders, and helping translate business and clinical needs into actionable product outcomes.

njoyn:cgi:J0926-1109.title: Solution Architect – Digital Banking Applications
njoyn:cgi:J0926-1109.description:
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to contribute to the design, evolution, and optimization of our Digital Banking Applications.

Working closely with a Senior Solution Architect and architecture leadership, you will collaborate with product, delivery, platform, and technical teams to develop scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

This opportunity is well suited to someone who combines hands-on technical expertise with architectural thinking and is comfortable working across complex, multi-tenant, and regulated technology environments.

Location: Canada, Remote with onsite presence as required

njoyn:cgi:J0926-1737.title: Cloud Network Solutions Architect
njoyn:cgi:J0926-1737.description:
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Network Solutions Architect with deep Microsoft Azure networking expertise to join our Solution Architecture team. This role will provide specialized expertise across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise networking, helping design and support secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available infrastructure solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong networking fundamentals with hands-on Azure experience and will be comfortable working across both architecture and implementation. Responsibilities will include developing solution designs, reviewing network and security configurations, providing technical guidance during implementation and migration activities, and troubleshooting complex connectivity, routing, DNS, firewall, WAF, TLS, load-balancing, and performance issues.

Azure is the primary cloud platform for this role. The position will also support connectivity across on-premises environments, Kubernetes platforms, third-party providers, partner networks, and other cloud environments. Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is an asset, but deep OCI specialization is not required.

This is not a documentation-only architecture role. The Cloud Network Architect will work closely with architects, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, vendor, carrier, and operational teams to translate business and technical requirements into practical network solutions and support their successful implementation.

The role will also contribute to architecture standards, reusable patterns, technical documentation, and the continued evolution of our cloud networking and infrastructure practices.

Position Description:
Join CGI and help shape the technology architecture powering the future of manufacturing and engineering.
We are looking for a Solution Architect – Manufacturing & Engineering to design and evolve end-to-end technology solutions supporting engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain operations across the enterprise.
In this strategic role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, helping modernize and integrate complex PLM, MES, ERP, and Order-to-Delivery (OTD) ecosystems while ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
Your responsibilities
• Provide end-to-end solution architecture across the Business, Application, Information, and Technology domains and develop supporting solution architecture documentation.
• Define target architectures and technology roadmaps for PLM, MES, ERP, and OTD ecosystems.
• Design end-to-end integration patterns connecting engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain systems.
• Partner with business process owners across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to translate business requirements into effective technology solutions.
• Contribute to the development of a reference architecture repository for manufacturing and engineering domains.
• Support process harmonization, standardization, and automation initiatives across plants and global sites.
• Support system modernization, cloud migration, and application integration initiatives.
• Provide architectural oversight across multiple programs and projects, from initial concept through delivery.
• Lead workshops and presentations to communicate solution options, impacts, dependencies, and trade-offs to stakeholders.
What we're looking for
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 4 years in Solution Architecture within manufacturing or engineering environments.
• Strong experience with PLM platforms, such as Teamcenter or Windchill.
• Experience with MES solutions, including SAP or Siemens environments.
• Strong understanding of ERP platforms, particularly SAP S/4HANA.
• Solid knowledge of manufacturing and supply chain integration flows, including OTD, BOM, routing, and related processes.
• Familiarity with manufacturing shop-floor systems and environments.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
• Strong conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to develop robust solution architecture designs.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive-level stakeholders.
• Strong collaboration and leadership skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams.
• Ability to communicate daily with internal and external stakeholders located outside Quebec or with English-speaking stakeholders.
Why CGI?
This is an opportunity to contribute to large-scale technology transformation initiatives at the intersection of manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, and enterprise architecture, while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and experts across the organization.
Compensation
CGI provides a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The final compensation will depend on factors such as skills, experience, geographic market, training, and relevant licenses and certifications.
Estimated salary range: CAD $90,000–$175,000.

Position Description:
CGI is seeking a Senior SAP Solution Architect to participate in major ERP transformation programs.
The Architect will play a central role in the design and evolution of the target SAP architecture. They will ensure end to end solution consistency, alignment with Clean Core principles, integration with third party solutions, and the quality of architecture decisions throughout the program.
Your future duties and responsibilities:
Define and maintain the end to end SAP application architecture.
Lead SAP solution design activities and ensure consistency across the various functional domains.
Ensure adherence to SAP Clean Core, Fit to Standard, and SAP best practices.
Design the integration architecture with external systems and platforms, particularly using SAP BTP and APIs.
Govern decisions related to interfaces, extensions, and developments.
Define and oversee the data migration approach.
Ensure alignment across functional, application, technical, data, security, and integration architectures.
Work closely with the implementation team.
Lead and participate in client design workshops and architecture reviews.
Identify architecture risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
Challenge requirements and proposed solutions to minimize complexity and unnecessary customizations.
Ensure that solution decisions remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with the SAP roadmap.
Contribute to quality assurance, testing, deployment readiness, and knowledge transfer activities.
Act as the SAP architecture authority for project teams, clients, and technology partners.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:
Mandatory Requirements
Professional fluency in both French and English, written and spoken.
University degree in a relevant discipline or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience implementing and transforming ERP/SAP solutions.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in an SAP Solution Architect or SAP Application Architect role.
Significant experience with SAP S/4HANA, including the design of end to end integrated solutions.
Participation in at least 3 major SAP implementation or transformation projects within the last 10 years.
Demonstrated experience working in complex SAP environments involving multiple functional domains and integrated systems.
Strong understanding of integrated business processes and their interaction with the technology architecture.
Experience integrating SAP solutions with third party applications.
Experience with cloud, integration, data, and security architecture principles.
Demonstrated ability to make and defend architecture decisions with both technical and executive stakeholders.
Excellent communication, workshop facilitation, and ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
Ability to work effectively in a complex, multidisciplinary environment.
Services under the engagement must be performed from within Canada.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition / RISE with SAP.
Experience with SAP BTP, Integration Suite, APIs, and side by side extensions.
Experience applying Clean Core and Fit to Standard principles.
Experience with SAP Finance, Project System / EPPM, Procurement/Ariba, or SuccessFactors.
Experience integrating SAP with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, payroll systems, or enterprise asset management solutions.
Experience in the public sector, infrastructure, or highly regulated organizations.
Relevant SAP certification.
Experience delivering large scale SAP transformation programs involving multiple teams and vendors.

The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. njoyn:cgi:J0926-1532.title: AI Solution Architect
njoyn:cgi:J0926-1532.description:
Design and architect end to end artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions, aligned with clients' business needs and strategic objectives.
 Assess client needs and propose tailored AI architectures, including large language models (LLM), RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), AI agents, and MLOps pipelines.
 Define technology choices (cloud platforms, ML frameworks, generative AI tools) and justify trade offs to stakeholders.
 Collaborate with data, software development, and security teams to ensure the coherent integration of AI solutions into existing systems.
 Design scalable, secure, and responsible architectures (ethical AI, bias, data governance, compliance).
 Support teams in adopting MLOps practices: automation of training pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and model retraining.
 Advise clients on cost optimization for AI model inference and training in cloud environments.
 Conduct proofs of concept (PoC) and prototypes to validate the technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
 Carry out technology watch in AI/ML and integrate the latest advancements (generative AI, LLM, multimodal) into architecture recommendations.
 Act as a technical reference and mentor for internal teams and clients in the adoption of AI technologies.

Required Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years of experience in IT solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on AI/ML.
 Expertise in designing AI/ML solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed services (Azure OpenAI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, etc.).
 Solid knowledge of ML/AI frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex.
 Experience with LLMs (GPT 4, Claude, Llama) and RAG type architectures, AI agents, and fine tuning.
 Proficiency in MLOps practices (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML Pipelines, etc.) and CI/CD pipelines for ML models.
 Knowledge of data governance principles, AI security, and algorithmic ethics.
 Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non technical stakeholders.
 Bilingual (French and English), with advanced writing and presentation skills.

 Additional Assets:
 AI/ML certification on a cloud platform (e.g.: Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP Professional ML Engineer).
 Experience with modern data architectures (lakehouses, feature stores, data mesh).
 Knowledge of responsible AI tools (Responsible AI, Fairlearn, AI Explainability 360).
 Experience deploying multimodal solutions (text, image, audio, video).
 Familiarity with AI related regulatory standards (Law 25, EU AI Act, etc.).

Position Description:
Our Artificial Intelligence practice is expanding rapidly, and we are seeking a Senior AI Solution Architect to play a key role in shaping, designing, and delivering advanced AI and Generative AI solutions for our clients.
This role combines architecture leadership, strong technical judgment, and client engagement, and is suited for a professional capable of guiding complex AI initiatives while collaborating closely with business and technical stakeholders.
Your future duties and responsibilities:
• Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures aligned with client business objectives.
• Lead architectural decisions related to AI platforms, cloud services, and integration patterns.
• Guide the implementation of Generative AI use cases (LLMs, RAG architectures, AI assistants, automation).
• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and platform teams to ensure scalable and secure solution delivery.
• Define and oversee MLOps practices (model lifecycle, monitoring, deployment, governance).
• Lead technical feasibility studies and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
• Ensure AI solutions align with security, privacy, and responsible AI principles.
• Act as a technical advisor in client discussions, helping translate business challenges into AI-enabled solutions.
• Mentor intermediate team members and contribute to the evolution of the AI practice.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:
• 7+ years of experience in technology roles, including 3+ years in AI solution design or architecture.
• Strong expertise in AI and machine learning, with hands-on experience in Generative AI architectures.
• Solid understanding of LLM ecosystems, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and API-based AI services.
• Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Good knowledge of MLOps concepts and tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, CI/CD).
• Strong communication skills with both technical and executive stakeholders.
• Bilingual (French and English).
Nice to Have
• Cloud or AI certifications.
• Experience in consulting environments.
• Exposure to enterprise data platforms and distributed systems.
• Contribution to AI standards, frameworks, or Centers of Excellence.
CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications.
