njoyn:cgi:J0826-1414.title: Product Management – FX Trading & Capital Markets
njoyn:cgi:J0826-1414.description:
CGI is seeking a full-time Product Manager to join our FX Trading and Capital Markets product team. You will help drive product strategy and roadmap priorities, working closely with product, engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver capabilities aligned with evolving FX and capital markets requirements.

This is a hybrid role requiring attendance at our downtown Toronto office and/or another designated work location a minimum of two days per week. This requirement is subject to change at any time.

njoyn:cgi:J0626-2443.title: Solutions Architect (ServiceNow)
njoyn:cgi:J0626-2443.description:
Lead the successful delivery of strategic initiatives at the heart of a dynamic, innovation-driven organization!

CGI is looking for a Solution Architect to join our team and contribute to the implementation, evolution, and governance of a strategic ServiceNow platform for our clients. This role is part of a multidisciplinary team that includes senior ServiceNow developers, a business analyst, and a QA analyst. In this position, you will be responsible for guiding solution direction, ensuring overall architectural consistency, and supporting the delivery of features related to citizen requests, internal services, ITSM processes, integrations, and specialized modules such as PSDS.

As a Solution Architect, you will work in a digital transformation environment where architectural quality, user experience, alignment with ServiceNow best practices, functional and technical rigor, and the ability to support client teams are top priorities. You will serve as the overall architect of the ServiceNow solution and the primary point of reference for both clients and the delivery team. If you are comfortable leading architecture discussions, engaging in functional analysis, validating solution designs, ensuring development quality, overseeing integrations, promoting out-of-the-box (OOTB) governance, and mentoring ServiceNow team members, CGI offers you an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the success of our clients.

Work Model: Hybrid
Location: Sherbrooke or Saguenay

njoyn:cgi:J0526-1715.title: AWS Solution Architect
njoyn:cgi:J0526-1715.description:
CGI is a global business and technology service provider with $11.5B in revenues. CGI is on a mission to help financial services organizations focus on servicing their clients. CGI supports 15 of the top 20 banks worldwide and our top 10 banking clients have worked with us for 26 years on average. Our clients have seen the value and commitment we bring through our products. This is why nearly $1.6 trillion in assets managed through CGI's portfolio management, investment fund and asset management solutions.

This role is hybrid and requires you to be at our downtown Toronto and/or Client office at a minimum 2 days per week - subject to change at any time.

njoyn:cgi:J0826-0403.title: Solution Architect – Functional
njoyn:cgi:J0826-0403.description:
The Solution Architect – Functional translates complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient solution architectures for large scale enterprise modernization initiatives.

Working closely with Business Analysts, Technical Architects, Engineering teams, Product Owners, and Delivery Leadership, the successful candidate will define solution architectures that integrate business capabilities with modern technology platforms.

This role is part of an AI first software engineering organization where Artificial Intelligence is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. Candidates must demonstrate practical experience leveraging AI to improve productivity, quality, and delivery outcomes using modern AI assisted development practices.

njoyn:cgi:J0726-0806.title: Solutions Architect (ServiceNow)
njoyn:cgi:J0726-0806.description:
Contribute to the success of strategic initiatives at the heart of a constantly evolving Agile environment!

CGI Montréal is seeking a Solutions Architect to support our clients in digital transformation, service modernization, and business process automation initiatives related to the ServiceNow platform. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, evolution, and governance of ServiceNow solutions to ensure alignment with business objectives, technology standards, and industry best practices. Within project environments, you will serve as a technical and strategic advisor to both client teams and delivery teams. If you enjoy guiding stakeholders in defining target-state visions, developing roadmaps, designing architectures, and integrating the ServiceNow platform within broader technology ecosystems, CGI offers you an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on the success of our clients.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days/ week onsite
Location: Drummondville

 Our market opportunity is rare in its scale and powered by a strong business model, Silicon Valley based investors and advisors, and a product management team which is global and world-class (if we do say so ourselves)!  Speaking of Product at Clio… we’ve worked hard to develop an excellent product management culture with empowered PMs who are highly regarded and influential within the organization.  Summary

You'll sit in Strategy & Operations, partner with our AI Centre of Excellence, and do two things most roles keep separate: shape the corporate strategy, and build the agents and automations that deliver it.  We are seeking a Senior Strategy & Operations Associate to join our Strategy & Operations team. This role is available to candidates in either Vancouver or Toronto. 

 The team 
 Strategy & Operations partners with leaders across Clio on corporate and business strategy, new opportunities, business performance, and the company’s operating rhythm. We bring analysis, an organization-wide perspective, and the ability to turn decisions into action. As a Senior Strategy & Operations Associate, you will have the opportunity to help determine immediate and long-term business strategy, set OKRs, build business / investment cases, and support our business review rituals to measure business performance. 

 The team also drives work within Clio’s AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) to identify opportunities, build and test AI-enabled workflows, and help teams adopt approaches that improve how work gets done. As a Senior Associate, you will help the team move from the big picture to a working solution: engaging teams cross functionally to understand a problem, set a clear direction, measure impact, define prototypes, and iterate on them. - Partner with teams through the AI CoE to understand recurring work, identify valuable opportunities for AI, and define the problem, desired outcome, and practical path to delivery.

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.  

 We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice . 

 Summary: 

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product for AI Search. Lawyers live in their documents, emails, and matters, and they need to find the right one fast. More and more, they expect search to understand what they mean, not just match the words they typed. This role owns getting us there.

 You will own product for an engineering and ML team that is moving Clio from keyword search to hybrid lexical and semantic search across documents, communications, and records. The tech underneath is changing quickly, so we care more about how you measure and improve search quality than which retrieval technique you like best.

 This role is available to candidates across Canada (excluding Quebec) and the US. If you are local to one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto) you will be expected to be in office twice per week on our Anchor Days.

 What Your Team Does 
 AI Search owns search at Clio end to end. That starts at document ingestion and runs through retrieval, ranking, and the global search bar that shows up in Manage, DMS, Grow, and Work. We build it once as a shared platform (the document pipeline, the search API, and our vector and full-text search platform) so every product gets the same great search. A firm using Manage, Grow, and Work should be able to search across all of it in one place. The same retrieval layer also feeds Vincent and our other AI features, so the work here shows up well beyond the search bar.

 What You’ll Work On 

- Set the product vision for search. Figure out what lawyers are actually trying to find, where keyword search lets them down, and the fastest path to fixing it.

- Turn “why can’t I find my document?” into a roadmap with dates, and have the eval data to show when search actually got better.

- Run planning and execution with a team of engineers and ML engineers. Ship often and keep iterating.

- Own how we measure search quality. Work with engineering and ML on relevance, ranking, and query understanding, and use A/B tests, click-through, and offline evals to decide what ships.

- Work with DMS, Manage, Grow, Unified Comms, and our AI teams to bring documents, emails, and records into one search. Permissions have to be right, customer AI opt-out has to be respected, and we build around what customers are actually searching for.

- Make the product calls on the search experience. Decide which results, filters, and metadata to show, whether name and content search should come together, and how we explain a semantic match. Balance relevance, latency, and cost at our scale.

- Keep the whole Clio suite in mind. Search should pull our products together.

- Stay on top of what is happening in AI retrieval and legal tech, so we know what customers will expect from search before it shows up as a support ticket or a lost deal.

 What You Bring 

- Product management experience, ideally on search, information retrieval, or AI products. Legal tech experience is a plus.

- A track record of shipping search or retrieval that measurably improved relevance, and a good sense for what actually helps people find things vs. what just demos well.

- You can lead and motivate an engineering and ML team in a fast-moving environment where people own their outcomes.

- Strong technical chops. You can hold your own with engineers and ML folks on lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval, embeddings, and ranking across a big multi-product suite.

- Clear communicator. You can connect what customers need with what the tech can do, and get engineering, ML, design, and partner product teams behind one roadmap.

- Good judgment on which search problems to go after, and which ones to leave alone.

- Experience with both 0-1 products and scaling existing ones.

You have a deep understanding of customer pain points and needs, and can communicate complex products in a compelling and impactful way. You are proactive to deliver against timelines and deadlines.

You are known for your strong communication and collaboration skills and are energised by working cross-functionally to bring projects to completion within the projected time frame.

- Building and executing tactical marketing plans that increase product and feature adoption and support retention.

- You have a data-first approach. You’re adept at using analytics platforms and insights to inform your recommendations on program strategies as well as audience segmentation, and you substantiate your approaches.  

- You’re a storyteller. Whether you’re training an internal team on an upcoming release or crafting a go-to-market strategy, you use your strong writing skills to tell compelling stories that speak to your audience.

 We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice .

 Summary: 

 We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager, Mid-Market: Integrations to join our product team. This role is available to candidates across Canada (excluding Quebec) and the US. If you are located near one of our hubs (Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto), you will be expected to work in the office a minimum of twice per week on our designated Anchor Days. 

 Accounting sits at the center of how a law firm operates. Every hour logged, bill sent, and payment received has to land correctly on the books. Clio is an extensible platform, and our goal is to build the best accounting integrations in legal, so that data moves between a firm's practice management and accounting systems seamlessly and accurately.  

 We're looking for a Senior PM who brings a rare combination: experience building enterprise-grade integrations, enough bookkeeping fluency to earn the trust of firm administrators and finance teams, and proven product and design skills that allow you to translate complex workflows into elegant experiences. 

 What Your Team Does 
 Accounting integrations sit at the intersection of practice management and a firm's financial operations, serving law firms from solo practitioners to large enterprises. Your team owns Clio's accounting integrations end to end: maintaining and improving our existing QuickBooks Online and Xero integrations, delivering new ones, and setting the strategy for where the portfolio goes next. The team is also accountable for how those integrations meet the rest of Clio, so that billing, time tracking, and payments move into a firm's accounting system cleanly and stay in sync. 

 This is a domain where accuracy is not optional and compliance is not negotiable. What lands in a firm's books determines what they bill, what they collect, and what they can demonstrate to a client or a regulator. Your team owns that standard: every transaction arriving accurately and completely, for firms of every size, across every platform Clio connects to. 

 What You'll Work On 

 Strategic Product Leadership 

- Define and execute a product vision and roadmap for accounting integrations that balances compliance requirements, the needs of the firms using them, and the capabilities and constraints of the platforms we connect to. 

- Own discovery and definition across the portfolio: what data needs to move, in which direction, how often, and what a complete integration looks like for each platform. 

- Partner with Design, Engineering, and Data to ensure every feature ships with the right metrics, feedback loops, and success criteria in place. 

 Customer and Domain Depth 

- Build deep relationships with firm administrators, bookkeepers, accountants, and managing partners to understand how financial decisions are made inside legal practices. 

- Champion both compliance needs and business insight needs — helping firms not just stay compliant, but actually understand what their numbers mean. 

- Translate complex accounting concepts and regulatory requirements into product decisions that are clear enough for a junior developer to build and compelling enough for an executive to evangelize. 

 Cross-Functional Execution 

- Collaborate across Billing, Payments, Reporting, and Platform teams to ensure Accounting integrates seamlessly into the broader Clio product ecosystem. 

- Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Compliance stakeholders to drive adoption and reduce friction for customers. 

- Communicate roadmap and trade-offs with clarity and confidence across audiences — from engineering stand-ups to executive reviews. 

 What You Bring 

- 6+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in B2B SaaS — ideally in FinTech, accounting software, or business operations tools. 

- Working knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting fundamentals: you don't need to be a CPA, but you should be comfortable discussing double-entry bookkeeping, reconciliation, trust accounting rules, and financial reporting with practitioners. Debits and credits shouldn’t provoke fear. 

- A genuine interest in helping businesses understand and act on their own financial performance — not just track it. 

- Experience applying design thinking and business process analysis to untangle complex workflows and deliver experiences that feel simple on the surface, even when the domain is anything but. 

- An exceptional communicator — equally comfortable presenting strategy to executives and getting into the weeds on technical requirements with developers. 

- Proactively collaborative with a proven ability to work across and align multiple teams and functions to deliver outcomes that matter to both customers and the business. 

- An entrepreneurial mindset. You have a respectful disregard for the boundaries of your role and do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

- Outcomes-focused: you obsess over impact, not output, and you can demonstrate how your work moved the metrics that matter. 

- Customer-obsessed: you talk to customers regularly, bring their voice into every decision, and know when to push back on data with lived experience. 

 Bonus Points 

- Experience in legal tech or an adjacent regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, professional services). 

- Familiarity with trust accounting regulations or legal-specific compliance requirements. 

- Background working with accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Xero, etc.) or building FinTech data pipelines. 

- Experience launching AI-first features in a high-trust or compliance-sensitive context.

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely. 

 We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice .

 Summary: 

 We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager, Clio Accounting to join our product team. This role is available to candidates across Canada (excluding Quebec) and the US. If you are located near one of our hubs (Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto), you will be expected to work in the office a minimum of twice per week on our designated Anchor Days.
 Law firms run on trust — with their clients, their regulators, and themselves. Clio Accounting exists to make the financial side of running a firm as confident, clear, and compliant as the legal work they do every day. We're building accounting and bookkeeping tools that don't just track numbers, but give legal professionals a genuine understanding of the health and performance of their business.

 We're looking for a Senior PM who brings a rare combination: enough bookkeeping fluency to earn the trust of firm administrators and finance teams, enough product and design instinct to translate complex workflows into elegant experiences, and a clear-eyed view of where AI can meaningfully — and responsibly — reshape accounting and bookkeeping processes for legal professionals.

 What Your Team Does
 Clio Accounting sits at the intersection of practice management and financial operations, serving law firms from solo practitioners to mid-sized enterprises. Your team owns core accounting capabilities including chart of accounts, trust accounting, bank reconciliation, expense tracking, financial reporting, and compliance workflows — all deeply integrated with billing, time tracking, and payments across the Clio platform.
 This is a domain where accuracy isn't optional and compliance isn't negotiable. At the same time, it's a space ripe for transformation: most firms are still underserved by tools that were built for general business accounting, or spreadsheets, not the specific realities of legal practice. Your team is changing that.

 What You'll Work On
 Strategic Product Leadership

- Define and execute a product vision and roadmap for Clio Accounting that balances compliance requirements, firm business intelligence, and the emerging opportunity of AI-powered bookkeeping.

- Develop a clear and defensible point of view on where AI can accelerate, automate, and improve accuracy in accounting workflows — and where human judgment must remain in the loop.

- Partner with Design, Engineering, and Data to ensure every feature ships with the right metrics, feedback loops, and success criteria in place.

 Customer and Domain Depth

- Build deep relationships with firm administrators, bookkeepers, accountants, and managing partners to understand how financial decisions are made inside legal practices.

- Champion both compliance needs and business insight needs — helping firms not just stay compliant, but actually understand what their numbers mean.

- Translate complex accounting concepts and regulatory requirements into product decisions that are clear enough for a junior developer to build and compelling enough for an executive to evangelize.

 Cross-Functional Execution

- Collaborate across Billing, Payments, Reporting, and Platform teams to ensure Accounting integrates seamlessly into the broader Clio product ecosystem.

- Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Compliance stakeholders to drive adoption and reduce friction for customers transitioning to or expanding their use of Clio Accounting.

- Communicate roadmap and trade-offs with clarity and confidence across audiences — from engineering stand-ups to executive reviews.

 What You Bring

- 6+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in B2B SaaS — ideally in FinTech, accounting software, or business operations tools.

- Working knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting fundamentals: you don't need to be a CPA, but you should be comfortable discussing double-entry bookkeeping, reconciliation, trust accounting rules, and financial reporting with practitioners. Debits and credits shouldn’t provoke fear.

- A genuine interest in helping businesses understand and act on their own financial performance — not just track it.

- A clear and considered perspective on where AI fits within accounting and bookkeeping processes, with the judgment to distinguish transformative opportunity from hype.

- Experience applying design thinking and business process analysis to untangle complex workflows and deliver experiences that feel simple on the surface, even when the domain is anything but.

- An exceptional communicator — equally comfortable presenting strategy to executives and getting into the weeds on technical requirements with developers.

- Proactively collaborative with a proven ability to work across and align multiple teams and functions to deliver outcomes that matter to both customers and the business.

- An entrepreneurial mindset. You have a respectful disregard for the boundaries of your role and do whatever it takes to get the job done.

- Outcomes-focused: you obsess over impact, not output, and you can demonstrate how your work moved the metrics that matter.

- Customer-obsessed: you talk to customers regularly, bring their voice into every decision, and know when to push back on data with lived experience.

 Bonus Points

- Experience in legal tech or an adjacent regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, professional services).

- Familiarity with trust accounting regulations or legal-specific compliance requirements.

- Background working with accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Xero, etc.) or building FinTech data pipelines.

- Experience launching AI-first features in a high-trust or compliance-sensitive context.

 Summary: 

 We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager, PLG to join our Product Led Growth team. This role is open to remote applicants across the U.S. and Canada, with the exception of Quebec. 
 We are a remote-first team with hub offices in Burnaby, Calgary, and Toronto. If you are local to one of those hubs you will be expected in office a minimum of two days per week on our Anchor Days. 

 What your team does: 
 Clio's PLG team runs two live growth motions at once: helping existing customers discover and adopt more of Clio through Clio Explorer and the unified nav, and bringing net-new prospects into Clio through a self-serve Freemium tier of Clio Work. Both motions increasingly depend on the same underlying machinery, account and license infrastructure, usage caps and trial systems, PQL signal routing, and the CBS platform that powers all of it. 
 This role owns that shared foundation. You will build the PLG platform that lets our Monetization PM and our Onboarding & Activation PM move fast and experiment freely, instead of each rebuilding the same account-state logic, cap-tuning system, or signal pipeline from scratch. This is not a role that competes with theirs for territory. It is the layer underneath both of them. 

 Who you are: 
 You think in systems, not features 

- You have owned a platform or infrastructure layer before, not just a customer-facing feature, and can describe a specific bottleneck you found (a manual process, an inconsistent data model, an undefined handoff) and what you built to remove it. 

- You instinctively ask "what capability, once built, lets five other teams move faster" rather than "what should we ship this quarter." 

 You instrument before you optimize 

- You have defined metrics from scratch across more than one team's motion, and made them consistent, rather than inheriting a dashboard someone else built for a single product. 

- You are comfortable with cohort analysis and funnel metrics, and you know the difference between a metric that's actually causal and one that just moves together with the outcome you care about. 

- Basic SQL proficiency is expected, not aspirational. 

 You can work across teams without owning their roadmaps 

- This role spans Monetization, Onboarding/Activation, CBS, Engineering, and RevOps. You will not control any of their roadmaps. Getting shared infrastructure built and adopted requires influence, not authority. 

- You can give a specific example of shipping a cross-team outcome without direct control over the teams involved. 

 You've built for internal teams before, not just external customers 

- Sales, BDR pods, and CS ops teams are among your users here, the same rigor you'd apply to a customer-facing surface applies to their tooling. 

- You understand that a fix to a manual back-office process (an account merge, a signal handoff) is often worth more than a customer-facing feature. 

 You ship things 

- Consistent track record of shipping end-to-end in B2B SaaS: spec, build, launch, measure, iterate. 

- You do not wait for perfect data or a fully settled number. You are comfortable setting a threshold before evidence exists and revising it once it does. 

 What you'll work on: 
 The PLG Core Foundation 

- Own the account and license model, trial and freemium infrastructure, and usage-cap tuning systems that power both PLG motions. 

- Partner with CBS on the billing and account architecture, license mobility, request-access flows, account merge and reconciliation, that both motions run on top of, and that currently bottlenecks at scale. 

- Build a single, consistent measurement layer (activation rate, cap-hit rate, conversion rate, cost-to-serve) so Monetization and Onboarding/Activation are working from the same numbers, defined the same way, regardless of which motion generated them. 

 Enabling the Motion-Level PMs 

- Build the trial-unlock surfaces, contextual upsell infrastructure, and PQL/signal-routing systems that the Monetization PM and Onboarding & Activation PM build their initiatives on top of. 

- Treat their roadmap needs as your primary input. If they're blocked on platform capability, that's your backlog. 

 Instrumentation and Signal 

- Turn Clio's own usage data, not just industry benchmarks, into platform priorities. (As one example: internal trial data shows that a customer taking output out of the product predicts conversion far better than any cap-hit metric. The platform should be built to surface signals like that, not just cap thresholds.) 

- Build the visibility that lets Product, Data Science, and RevOps see cap-hit, first-value, and conversion data in one place, across both motions. 

 Cross-Team Coordination 

- Partner with CBS on everything that touches billing, licensing, or the account-state model, including the parts that don't feel like "growth" work but block growth work downstream. 

- Work with RevOps and Sales on how product-qualified signal actually routes to a BDR or AE, and close the gaps where that handoff is manual or undefined. 

- Translate ambiguous, multi-team priorities, including the post-launch Agentic PLG roadmap, into a platform roadmap other PMs can plan against with confidence. 

 What you may have: 

- Experience building or owning platform/infrastructure capabilities that other product teams build on top of, alongside more customer-facing PLG work. 

- 6+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with meaningful time in a platform, growth infrastructure, or systems-level role. 

- Hands-on experience defining shared metrics across more than one team or product line, and instrumentation to track them consistently. 

- Demonstrated ability to work across multiple product teams without direct authority over their roadmaps. 

- Strong written communication: a clear platform strategy doc and a concise cross-team update, without a lot of back-and-forth. 

 Serious bonus points if you have: 

- Experience in legal tech, vertical SaaS, or another professional-services context. 

- Experience running two or more growth motions (e.g., cross-sell and net-new acquisition) on shared underlying infrastructure. 

- Familiarity with usage-based billing systems, account merge/reconciliation logic, or PQL/signal routing into a CRM. 

- Familiarity with tools like Segment, Amplitude, or Pendo.

 Summary: 

 Clio is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Clio's Centralized Billing System (CBS) our internal system that powers how we configure, quote, package, and ultimately charge our customers. CBS is mission-critical. It sits at the intersection of product, sales, finance, and go-to-market, and nearly every team at Clio has a stake in it. This means priorities shift frequently, every stakeholder has an opinion, and someone needs to hold the line. This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one, defend it, and drive it forward in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Open to candidates across North America (US and Canada, excluding Quebec). If located near one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, NYC or Toronto), you will be expected to work in the office a minimum of twice per week on our designated Anchor Days. 

 The Problem You're Solving 

 CBS is a complex, high-dependency system, and owning it well is as much about stakeholder management and prioritization discipline as it is about product craft. CBS attracts strong opinions from every corner of the business, and priorities are always competing. Your job is to be a fair, clear, and decisive decision-maker across all of them, while making sound calls about a system that has significant architectural and business consequences. 

 What You'll Own 

- Full product ownership of CBS, the system used to configure pricing, generate quotes, manage packaging, and charge customers 

- Roadmap, health, and evolution of CBS, full accountability for prioritization, sequencing, and long-term direction 

- Stakeholder management across a complex, high-demand landscape. Sales, Finance, Marketing, GTM, and Product all depend on CBS, and you will be the person who sets priorities, communicates tradeoffs clearly, and holds the line when needed 

- Monetization partnership, working closely with the GTM Monetization team as a key stakeholder to ensure CBS enables Clio's pricing and packaging strategy 

- Decision-making under pressure. CBS is a system where everyone has opinions and priorities shift constantly. You will need to form a clear point of view, advocate for it confidently across senior stakeholders, and make calls that don't always make everyone happy 

- Cross-functional alignment, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Data teams to ensure CBS works in lockstep with Clio's broader go-to-market motion 

- Tooling and instrumentation, ensuring we have the data, telemetry, and tooling in place to make confident decisions fast 

 What We're Looking For 

 You are an exceptionally strong stakeholder manager. You've operated in environments where many teams have competing claims on your roadmap and limited patience for hearing no. You know how to listen, synthesize, prioritize, and communicate decisions in a way that maintains trust even when you can't give everyone what they want. You don't avoid conflict, you navigate it well. 

 You are decisive. You form opinions based on evidence and context, you articulate them clearly, and you stand behind them. You don't need consensus to move forward but you know how to build it when it matters. 
 You are hands-on. You don't just set direction and manage up. You're in the weeds, reviewing designs, pushing on tradeoffs, and doing real work alongside engineering and design. 

 You have a technical enough background to own a complex billing or commerce system. You need to understand the architecture, ask the right questions, and make sound product decisions about a system that has significant downstream consequences across the business. 

 You've integrated AI into how you work, running experiments, synthesizing data, moving faster. This isn't aspirational for you, it's already how you operate. 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 6+ years of experience in product management in a B2B SaaS environment 

- A technical background sufficient to own and make decisions about a complex product system with broad business dependencies 

- Proven ability to manage a high-volume, high-stakes stakeholder environment. You've prioritized under pressure, communicated tradeoffs clearly, and held the line on a roadmap 

- Strong data and analytical skills. You are comfortable owning a metrics framework, running analysis, and building the case for investment based on evidence 

- Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner. You've influenced without full authority and brought skeptics along 

- Based in the US or Canada 

 Nice to Haves 

- Experience owning a billing, pricing, or commerce system in a SaaS environment 

- Experience in legal tech or other regulated-industry verticals

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT COHERE AND NORTH

Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:



Agent Loop and Execution. 

Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.



Context Engineering. 

Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.



Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution. 

Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation

 - Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner

Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

 - Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.

greenhouse:d2l:8068064.description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. 

 New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

 D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

 D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

 Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

 Job Summary: 

 You are passionate about education technology and love the deeper technical aspects of SaaS platforms. Your curiosity leads you down paths that promote future technological solutions that make life better for anyone in need. You enjoy seeking out and solving complex challenges that can simplify and improve how many organizations use technology. You are the type of person who sees any problem as an opportunity to build success. You are keen to bring your technical acumen, creativity and enthusiasm to D2L to help us transform the way the world learns.   

 Our customers’ ability to grow and succeed depends on trusted integration with their tech ecosystem. Your mission will be to help customers find solutions that connect their technical and integration requirements to D2L products.    

 As a Solutions Architect, you are the main technical escalation point for our Solutions Engineers (also known as Sales Engineers or SEs). When technical challenges go beyond the scope or expectation of SE knowledge, you will assist with scoping requirements and presenting technical solutions to help win sales opportunities. Additionally,  you will serve in an advisory capacity for selling and positioning implementation and consulting services necessary to achieve a customer’s technical goals, in collaboration with D2L’s Services teams.     

   You demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and understand the concepts of providing an excellent customer experience within a sales support role. You have an equal love for technical solutioning (the how) and deeply understanding a customer’s business challenges, technical requirements, and goals (the why).   

 Major Responsibilities (How Will I Make an Impact?):   

 As a Solutions Architect at D2L, you play a key role in:    

- Sales Support : Partnering with Solutions Engineers (SEs) as a technical expert and escalation point for sales opportunities: scoping complex technical requirements, writing responses, and presenting technical solutions as required.   

- Customer Engagement :   In collaboration with SEs, engaging with prospective and current customers to deeply understand their technical challenges, business goals, and integration needs; and presenting a compelling case for how we will best support.   

- Technical Solution Design : Designing, documenting, and presenting solutions for sales opportunities related to technical and partner integrations, security, data exchange, implementation, and more.   

- Value Orientated Delivery : Building trust with both customers and internal stakeholders by using strong value-orientation to understand the ultimate business goals and challenges to solve for, and designing the most effective technological solution aligned to those goals. Using strong communication skills to clearly articulate the impact of your proposed solution to driving success to goals.      

- Risk Mitigation : Assessing and mitigating potential blockers to a technical win in sales opportunities; assessing and mitigating risks that might hinder the successful delivery and implementation of proposed technical solutions.   

- Implementation Success : Be a liaison between our implementation teams and sales opportunity teams to ensure technical knowledge is documented and transferred for a successful implementation.

- Experience in a technical sales, consulting, or similar client-facing role

- Authentication concepts (SAML/SSO, LDAP, JIT provisioning)   

- Third-party tool integration (LTI, API, IPaaS)    

- Data integration concepts (programmatic flat file transfer, API, relational database management, BI tools, EDW)    

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, effectively articulating technical concepts to a varied audience   

- Strong presentation skills, with the ability to convince and persuade   

- Experience interpreting and responding to technical requirements (such as within RFPs), gathering client requirements, and/or writing SOWs would be an asset    

- Team oriented, collaborative problem solver – Fosters collaborative and positive relationships between team members, sales, services, and other internal teams    

- Leadership, initiative and execution – Identifies organizational and informational gaps; defines and executes plans to close gaps; takes leadership in problem solving in collaboration with others; drives solutioning from problem definition to close   

- Organized and analytical – Sound time management and self-organization skills, managing multiple projects simultaneously with varying complexities    

- Ability to work remotely with a distributed team and travel occasionally   

- Background in teaching and learning industry would be an asset (Higher Education, K-12, and/or Corporate Learning)

workday:desjardins/Desjardins:R2611670.description:
As Product Owner, you will represent the voice of the client in projects and be responsible for the member/client experience. You will consistently prepare a range of products and services to ensure a positive member/client experience. You will work in close collaboration with the project developer and business analyst to ensure the solution meets user needs and that the project’s expected benefits are delivered. You will manage relationships with the project’s various stakeholders. Your ability to engage others will therefore be an essential skill. You will lead and influence your squads’ specialists and the various stakeholders as part of planning, feasibility and development projects that involve strategic, complex, highly innovative interventions involving multiple sectors. In this regard, you will contribute to developing and recommending strategic orientations and business positioning. You will make recommendations on the development and delivery of files and projects involving a very high degree of operational and conceptual complexity that have a major impact on the business sector’s orientations. These tasks will require analysis and an overall, in-depth understanding of the business and the organization. Coordination will be critical. You will be called upon to interact with a very large number of stakeholders who are active in a variety of fields of expertise. You will serve as expert advisor and subject matter expert, as well as a resource person and coach for senior management and decision-making bodies. More specifically, you will be required to :

- Help data producers and users understand how to valorize data for the benefit of members and clients, in keeping with sound data governance.

- Serve as a specialist advisor to teams in developing and applying data management processes and controls.

- Develop, operationalize and improve standards, processes, tools and best practices related to data governance foundations.

- Coordinate identification of the sector's data governance needs and opportunities.

- Help the sector analyze risks and potential gaps between what is set out in the governance documents and their operational practices.

- Oversee the development and implementation of practices and mechanisms to ensure compliance with the governance documents that apply to data.

- Coordinate, monitor, measure and communicate about the performance of the standards and the practices in place, including changes in data governance maturity.

- Lead projects related to the development of data governance.

 What we offer* 

- Competitive salary and annual bonus

- 4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year

- Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement

- Group insurance including telemedicine

- Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment
 *Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria. 

 What you bring to the table 

- Bachelor's degree in a related field

- A minimum of eight years of relevant experience

- Please note that other combinations of qualifications and relevant experience may be considered

- Knowledge of French is required
 Interpersonal Savvy, Strategic mindset 
 Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Accessibility

We're committed to welcoming, respecting and valuing people for who they are as individuals, learning from their differences, embracing their uniqueness, and providing a positive workplace for all. workday:desjardins/Desjardins:R2612066.title: Product Leader, Product Management
workday:desjardins/Desjardins:R2612066.description:
As a product leader, your role is to design, implement and manage a line of high-performing products that meet the needs of members and clients. You are responsible for developing, pricing, improving, implementing and promoting the products offered, based on the needs of members, clients and the distribution networks, and in line with market trends and Desjardins Group’s target position. You lead and influence specialists and different stakeholders with respect to development projects and complex strategic initiatives of a cross-sector and highly innovative nature, in relation to the product line. You make recommendations on the development and execution of strategic initiatives with a very high degree of operational and conceptual complexity. You develop and recommend business directions and positions for the products you are responsible for. This requires analytical skills and comprehensive, in-depth knowledge of the line of business and the organization. You interact with a very large number of stakeholders working in other fields and advise decision-making bodies about improvements to the product line. More specifically, you will be required to :

- Identify and make improvements to the product offer based on member and client needs, business priorities and market developments, in the context of multidisciplinary projects of a strategic scope.

- Define an innovative and engaging target vision for the product line and create the mid- to long-term roadmap in line with the organization's strategic priorities.

- Monitor the competition and market developments, target opportunities to develop the offer, anticipate business impacts and establish and implement strategies.

- Provide leadership in defining the product's directions and represent the target client experience for the the value-added services offered by the product line.

- Monitor the product line's commercial results and financial performance to target opportunities and establish approaches to optimize the offer.

- Perform sound management of the operational, reputational and financial risks associated with the product offer and develop recommendations that could lead to a business position.

- Establish and develop frameworks to make sure that the product line complies with laws and regulations and make recommendations to the decision-making bodies.

About the Team 

 The Canadian DoorDash Growth & Consumer team focuses on making DoorDash a more valuable and accessible part of consumers’ everyday lives. We identify opportunities to grow the business by improving affordability, strengthening the consumer experience, and solving marketplace challenges across consumers, merchants, and Dashers.

 Our team partners across Restaurants, New Verticals, Legal, Product, Finance, and Operations to develop strategies that support sustainable growth across Canada.

 About the Role 

 The Associate Manager role is for a self-motivated, curious, and ownership-minded individual who approaches problems through a customer-first lens. You will use data and market insights to identify growth opportunities, develop strategies, and drive cross-functional execution.

 Your scope may include pricing and affordability, market-specific growth, consumer engagement and retention, and other high-priority strategic initiatives. Success will be measured by your ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear plans and deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.

 You're excited about this opportunity because... 

- Pricing & Affordability: Develop strategies across pricing, fees, promotions, and other value levers that balance customer affordability, growth, and sustainable economics.

- Analysis & Reporting: Analyze performance, build reporting and financial models, identify key trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations for leadership and XFN partners.

- Market Growth & Initiatives: Identify market-specific opportunities and lead high-impact growth initiatives from strategy and experimentation through execution and measurement.

- Big Bets & Innovation: Identify emerging opportunities, test new ideas, and build scalable solutions that can unlock new sources of customer and business growth.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Merchant, Dasher, Product, Finance, Analytics, and other teams to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver measurable outcomes.

 We're excited about you because... 

- You thrive as both a generalist and a specialist. You can develop an overarching strategy while diving deeply into specific customer, marketplace, and operational problems.

- You are a self-starter with a bias toward action who excels in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

- You are comfortable with ambiguity and bring structure, organization, and focus to your work and cross-functional teams.

- You are a structured problem solver who can identify root causes, develop hypotheses, size opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

- You combine analytical rigour with customer empathy and understand the trade-offs between affordability, growth, and business economics.

- You can influence without direct authority, build alignment across teams, and push initiatives from recommendation through execution.

- You are comfortable using SQL and AI tools to analyze data, building dashboards to track key metrics, and developing high-level financial models.

- You have 4+ years of experience in strategy, operations, product, growth, analytics, investment banking, consulting, or a related field.

 New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

 We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You’ll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

 These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

- Operate . Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.

- Analyze . Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.

- Lead, collaborate and Influence. You’ll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line. 

- Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!

- You solve problems from first principles. You resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

- You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up. 

- You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.

- You like data, and you let it win arguments. You’re comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.

You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.

The Product Manager, Due Diligence & Legal Filings, is responsible for implementing the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of key Canadian products within the Due diligence & Legal Filings Portfolio. Reporting to the VP of Product, this role leads the translation of business strategy into prioritized product outcomes, ensuring alignment with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and commercial objectives. The Product Manager provides leadership to Product Owners and Product Analysts, manages key external stakeholder relationships, and drives the adoption of AI-enabled product and operational practices. This role is critical to maintaining portfolio growth, supporting Ministry and vendor partnerships, delivering roadmap commitments, and ensuring the successful execution of strategic initiatives across the Canadian Due Diligence & Legal Filings portfolio. 

Key Responsibilities 

Execute the product strategy and vision for the Due Diligence & Legal Filings portfolio, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer needs. 
Own and manage the product roadmap, including prioritization, sequencing, and trade-off decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery activities to identify opportunities for growth and innovation. 
Contribute to the development of business cases and investment recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes and profitability. 
Lead the product development lifecycle from concept and planning through delivery, enhancement, and retirement. 
Work closely with Product Owners to develop, prioritize, and maintain product backlogs and roadmaps. 
Collaborate with Software Development Managers to align product priorities, development capacity, and delivery plans. 
Partner with UI/UX teams to deliver intuitive, customer-focused product experiences. 
Lead agile product delivery activities, including backlog management, release planning, requirements definition, and prioritization. 
Analyze product performance metrics, user feedback, and business data to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. 
Provide regular updates to senior leadership on roadmap progress, strategic initiatives, risks, and performance metrics. 
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams. 
Ensure organizational readiness for product launches, enhancements, and customer-facing initiatives. 
Serve as the primary product contact for Ministry stakeholders, vendor partners, and external organizations. 
Manage regulatory requirements, program changes, vendor dependencies, and key stakeholder commitments. 
Lead the adoption and governance of AI tools, including though not limited to Microsoft Copilot and Claude, within product management processes and product capabilities. 
Ensure AI initiatives align with organizational governance policies and approved technology standards. 
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Owners and Product Analysts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement. 
Work closely with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to align priorities and achieve business objectives. 
Support strategic planning and portfolio growth initiatives across the Canadian product portfolio. 

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise 

10+ years of Product Management experience within B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments. 
Proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes through product strategy, roadmap execution, and product innovation. 
Experience leading and developing Product Owners, Product Analysts, or other product management professionals. 
Experience in the Due Diligence & Legal Filing domain within Canada. 
Deep knowledge of delivering an API first strategy and partner integration.  
Strong experience managing products throughout the full product lifecycle, from ideation to retirement. 
Demonstrated success working within Agile product development environments. 
Experience creating and managing product roadmaps, business cases, requirements, and prioritization frameworks. 
Strong understanding of software development processes, integrated technology ecosystems, and modern SaaS platforms. 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Engineering, UX/UI, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Compliance. 
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including experience working with government agencies, regulatory organizations, vendors, and executive leadership. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage product and customer data to drive strategic decisions. 
Commercially minded with the ability to balance business objectives, customer needs, revenue goals, and user experience considerations. 
Excellent communication, presentation, storytelling, and influencing skills. 
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and make strategic trade-off decisions. 
Experience with AI technologies, specifically Microsoft Copilot and Claude, and their application within product management, product development, and operational processes. 
Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, and technology adoption frameworks. 
Strong leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development capabilities. ]
Ability to build collaborative relationships and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
Bchelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Benefits 

At Dye & Durham we strive to be visionaries! As a leader in our field, we ensure our employees are ready for the next challenge in their journey with us by offering internal and external training opportunities. We offer competitive salaries and a whole host of benefits including healthcare, pension, company discounts, wellness programs, and paid days off to move house or volunteer for your favourite charity. 

In line with the amended Employment Standards Act 2000, the salary range for this role is up to: $120K dependent on assessment of skills during the interview process.

Hi, we are ecobee. 

 ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives. That was just the beginning. We continue our pursuit to create technology that brings peace of mind into the home and allows people to focus on the moments that matter most. We take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment, all while being part of the exciting, connected home revolution.

 In 2021, ecobee became a subsidiary of Generac Power Systems. Generac introduced the first affordable backup generator and later created the category of automatic home standby generator. The company is committed to sustainable, cleaner energy products poised to revolutionize the 21st century electrical grid. Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

 Why we love to do what we do: 

 We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses. While we’re proud of what we’ve done so far, there’s still a lot we can do—and you can be part of it. 

 Join our extraordinary team. 

 We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.

 The Senior Engineering Program Manager leads cross-functional delivery of product development initiatives, including new product introductions, cost reduction, technology integration, and lifecycle product support. This role is accountable for translating product strategy, requirements, and business objectives into clear, executable delivery plans. The Senior Engineering Program Manager owns end-to-end delivery of programs, manages cross-functional dependencies and risks, and ensures program teams remain aligned on scope, timing, trade-offs, and execution priorities.

The Senior Engineering Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, connects decisions to business outcomes, and maintains visibility across programs within their product line or line of business. This position works closely with product management, engineering, support, manufacturing operations, supply chain, marketing, quality, finance, IT, and other cross-functional partners. Success in this role is measured by predictable execution, clear program ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive risk management, and on-time delivery of business and customer outcomes.

 This role follows a hybrid schedule, with in-office work required on Wednesdays and Thursdays and as needed to support collaboration and program actions .

 Essential Duties & Responsibilities 

- Own end-to-end delivery of assigned programs of moderate complexity through planning, execution, launch readiness, and closeout.

- Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated program plans that reflect scope, timing, capacity, dependencies, risks, milestones, and key decision points.

- Manage dependencies, resource constraints, sequencing, and delivery risks across related programs within the product line or line of business, escalating conflicts with clear recommendations.

- Frame trade-offs with clear options, impacts, risks, and recommendations to drive timely decisions when scope, schedule, cost, capacity, quality, customer needs, or downstream commitments conflict.

- Translate product requirements and business objectives into clear delivery scope, milestones, and product realization plans in partnership with Product and Engineering.

- Lead programs through Generac NPD processes, including milestone, design, and gate reviews using accurate, decision-ready information.

- Drive execution with appropriate urgency by identifying blockers, clarifying ownership, escalating risks, and ensuring teams understand the decisions and actions required to maintain progress.

- Understand technical decisions at a systems level and surface schedule, cost, compliance, integration, or dependency implications proactively.

- Facilitate cross-functional alignment with documented outcomes, clear ownership, and proactive management of inter-team dependencies and conflicts.

- Own change control for material changes to scope or plan, including impact assessment and decision documentation to secure stakeholder alignment.

- Apply lessons learned, propose improvements to program management and NPD practices, and help drive adoption across the PgM team and supported business areas.

 Minimum Qualifications 

- Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology or Management, Computer Science, or another directly engineering-related field.

- 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, product management, or a related field, including 8 years of program management experience leading cross-functional teams through end-to-end delivery.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Demonstrated experience managing new product development programs from end-to-end, using a phase-gate (or similar) development process.

- Experience supporting full-system product releases including hardware, software, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and launch readiness.

- PMP, PgMP, or related certification with demonstrated practical application.

- Experience working with global teams, international suppliers, or distributed development and manufacturing organizations.

 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

- Brings structure to ambiguous cross-functional work and challenges unclear assumptions.

- Builds program plans based on scope, assumptions, dependencies, trade-offs, critical path, and risk.

- Connects program decisions to schedule, cost, quality, operational readiness, portfolio priorities, and customer outcomes.

- Understands product development at a systems level and identifies when technical decisions affect program delivery.

- Raises risks and issues early, explains their impact, and drives mitigation or corrective action in a timely manner.

- Ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct authority while building trust and productive working relationships.

- Provides concise, decision-ready updates to senior leaders.

- Takes ownership of delivery misses, applies lessons learned, and improves planning and execution practices.

Reporting to the Senior Director, PE Technology Systems, you will bring together business insight, data, and emerging technology to help shape how work gets done across People Experience. You will be an important execution and partner to the People Experience Process & Technology Design Lead, translating complex problems into actionable insights, visualizations, and practical solutions. You will provide project management leadership across a defined set of People Experience transformation programs. You will work in a hybrid work model 3 days in office based in out of Vancouver, Canada.

Transformation Execution and Project Management
Project manages identified transformation projects and provides program management across interdependent projects.
Turn transformation strategy, workshop outputs, and cross-functional inputs into actionable insights, recommendations, and deliverables
Lead process of defined analyses and workstreams, investigating business, data, and technology questions to inform solutions
Business & Data Analysis
Break down complex business problems and develop data-backed insights
Quantify opportunities and use data to challenge assumptions, validate redesign, and inform transformation decisions
Work with internal teams and partners to source and analyze data needed to answer critical business questions
Data Visualization & Decision Support
Build dashboards, Airtables, scorecards, decks, and executive-ready materials that turn complex information into insights and recommendations
Establish baselines, KPIs, and measurement approaches to demonstrate transformation impact
Create reporting and tools that provide visibility into performance, progress, risks, and outcomes
Success Measures
Data, insights, and visualizations enable faster, better-informed transformation decisions
Technology, automation, and AI opportunities are translated into practical solutions that accelerate movement from idea to implementation
Increased capacity and pace in moving PE transformation priorities from insight to action

Project Leadership & Delivery
Track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution, delivering measurable outcomes on time and within scope.
Expertise in modern project management frameworks, with demonstrated capability in road-mapping, milestone tracking, and proactive risk/dependency mitigation.
Business Analyst Experience
Expertise deconstructing ambiguous, multi-faceted challenges into structured hypotheses, clear frameworks, and practical, data-backed solutions.
Deep experience collecting and analyzing requirements from diverse cross-functional stakeholders into clear business cases, functional specs, user journeys, and process workflows.
Data Storytelling & Technology
Advanced skill in synthesizing complex datasets into compelling narratives, interactive dashboards, and executive-ready presentations.
Practical, working familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation platforms, analytics platforms, and emerging technologies to streamline workflows and modernize operations.
Work Style & Professional Traits
Experience completing projects in a highly matrixed environment while maintaining alignment with overarching organizational objectives.
Experience translating complex concepts and decisions to team members and project sponsors.

Project Management Professional, Project Management Institute Agile Certified Practitioner, Certified Business Analysis Professional, or equivalent certifications in project management or business analysis.

Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.

Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.
What we're looking for:
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.

Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
