ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is building the future of Canadian financial services — scaling a credit business powered by modern, innovative underwriting and monitoring infrastructure that will unlock new digital-first credit and financial products for Canadian businesses. Fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution already run on this decisioning backbone today. What’s missing is a single owner. 



As the founding Product Manager for Credit & Risk Engineering, you’ll turn this shared decisioning and monitoring layer into a truly owned product: fast, accurate, and relentlessly efficient as volume scales. You’ll sit at the intersection of Float’s credit roadmap and growth funnel, sequencing a small engineering team across real infrastructure debt and a flagship new build — the FlexLine decisioning engine — while ensuring the systems you own keep Float’s day-to-day risk operations safe and scalable.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the roadmap and sequencing for the Credit & Risk Engineering squad across three domains — starting with the trade-off between paying down risk infrastructure debt and building the FlexLine decisioning engine.

 - Own the decisioning and automation systems that drive KYB/KYC approval speed and accuracy, delivered so Float's risk operations team can hit its approval-time targets.

 - Own the tooling behind fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution — daily infrastructure the company already depends on.

 - Own risk decision operating cost per account as your team's primary efficiency metric, proving the systems scale without proportional headcount growth.

 - Own the in-app credit experiences — applying for credit, viewing balances and limits, setting up repayments — and their target speed, in support of Float's credit product roadmap.

 - Be the standing source of truth on where the credit product roadmap ends and credit-engineering scope begins, in ongoing partnership with the GM of Credit.




ABOUT YOU


HERE'S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what's best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time personally owning a credit underwriting or risk-decisioning outcome — not just supporting one.

 - A track record building and owning infrastructure or internal-tooling products where another team, not an end customer, is who you're building for.

 - Real comfort operating inside compliance-heavy domains — KYB/KYC, transaction monitoring, fraud, AML, payments operations, or disputes.

 - An automation-first instinct: your default question is how a decision becomes automatic, not what the screen looks like.

 - Experience sequencing a roadmap under real capacity constraints, including saying no to work that looked mandatory.

 - Comfort negotiating and holding scope boundaries with senior, opinionated stakeholders you don't manage.




THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You want to spend most of your time on customer-facing product experiences — this role is almost entirely about the systems behind them.

 - You're energized by visible launches and find debt-paydown or "keep the lights on" work unrewarding — the first phase here is deliberately about stabilizing existing systems before new build.

 - You want one clear manager and one roadmap — this seat drives outcomes for three separate leaders (credit, growth, and risk operations) who each own a piece of the result.




FLEXIBLE WORK MODEL

Float is Toronto-based with a hybrid model: in-office collaboration days, plus occasional in-person time for workflow-discovery sessions. Remote candidates within Canada considered, with occasional travel to Toronto.




OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is looking for a Product Operations Manager to work alongside the team building our corporate card and spend management products. You'll be the person who decides — with data — what's worth building next, and then proves whether it worked.



This is a hands-on analytical seat with real influence over the roadmap. You'll size opportunities, build the business case for where the team should invest, and own the reporting that tells product and go-to-market teams what's actually happening. The work runs from writing your own queries through to putting a recommendation in front of leadership. Recent projects in this seat have included protecting card spend through a major payments migration and rebuilding how customer feedback gets synthesized into prioritization.



There's a second half to the job that matters just as much: making the team faster. We want someone who looks at how product decisions get researched and made, finds the parts that are slower than they need to be, and builds the automation to fix them.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Size and build the business case for roadmap initiatives, so the team can decide what to invest in with real numbers behind it.

 - Own the reporting and dashboards for the product area — measuring what shipped, and making the results useful to both product and go-to-market teams.

 - Turn customer and field feedback into a prioritization signal the team acts on, rather than a document nobody reads.

 - Lead the analysis behind major forward-looking investment decisions, working across teams to build and present the proposal.

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that make research, synthesis, and reporting materially faster — and pick the ones worth building based on impact.

 - Partner with data engineering to get the data you need, and write your own SQL for everything else.

 - Surface risks and trade-offs early, with options attached.




ABOUT YOU


HERE'S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what's best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.




IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES, YOU BRING: 

 - 3–6 years in product operations, strategy and operations, growth operations, consulting, or a similarly analytical and cross-functional role in a high-growth environment.

 - Strong SQL and spreadsheet modelling, with the ability to work through a messy business question independently and reach a recommendation.

 - Experience building a business case that changed what an organization decided to invest in.

 - Experience building reporting, dashboards, or operating systems that improved how a team made decisions.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, including memos and presentations aimed at leadership.

 - Practical AI fluency, with concrete examples of automating real workflows and the improvement it produced.

 - Comfort working across product, data, go-to-market, and leadership stakeholders, and holding several priorities at once.




THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You are not comfortable being hands-on with data — pulling it, querying it, and modelling it yourself.

 - You prefer clearly defined scope over deciding for yourself what matters most this week.

 - You're happier producing analysis than making a recommendation and standing behind it.

 - You tend to open more than you finish.

 - You treat AI as optional, theoretical, or someone else's job.

 - You're more excited by owning a process than by moving the business.




OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 As Principal Product Manager, Software Factory, you’ll define and bring together GitLab’s end-to-end software creation experience, from planning and specification through coding, review, and verification. You’ll connect capabilities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and the wider GitLab product so customers have a cohesive and delightful experience. This is a senior, high-visibility role for a product leader who can shape product direction, work across organizational boundaries, and clearly present recommendations to executive leaders.

 What you’ll do 

- Define the product vision and strategy for GitLab’s end-to-end software factory experience.

- Bring together planning, specification, coding, review, and verification workflows into a cohesive product experience.

- Partner with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams across GitLab to align priorities and execution.

- Use strong product and design judgment to make complex workflows clear and useful for customers.

- Build support for product decisions through clear communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Present product direction, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior and executive leaders.

- Help shape how GitLab brings its software factory vision to market.

 What you’ll bring 

- Product management experience at principal scope, leading complex products or experiences across multiple teams.

- A strong understanding of the end-to-end software development workflow, from planning through verification.

- Experience with artificial intelligence products, developer tools, DevSecOps platforms, or related technical products.

- Technical judgment that supports effective collaboration with engineering teams and informed product decisions.

- Strong product design and user experience instincts, including the ability to connect separate capabilities into a coherent experience.

- Experience influencing across functions, resolving competing priorities, and moving work forward without relying on direct authority.

- Clear communication and presentation skills, including experience working with senior and executive leaders.

- An ownership mindset and the ability to make progress in a fast-changing product area with some ambiguity.

 We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification.

 This role will work across GitLab to connect the teams building the future of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform.  An overview of this role 

 GitLab is building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, and this role will help shape how teams move from planning to code in an AI-native software development lifecycle.

 As Senior Product Manager, Source Code, you'll shape how planning and managing source code will evolve in an AI-native software development lifecycle. This role is focused on bringing planning and code closer together, so teams can move from requirements and specifications to commits, merge requests, and customer value with speed and quality.

 This area is evolving quickly. We're exploring how AI agents can use specifications, context, and human feedback to build the right thing, not just build the thing right. You'll define new product experiences for spec-driven, human-in-the loop development: how the link between planning intent and the code that implements it gets created, stays accurate as both change, and gets used at review time. The hard part is that this link decays. Code moves, specs might not follow, you will define how to make that connection self-maintaining.

 This is an ambiguous, high-impact opportunity for a product manager who has strong software development lifecycle knowledge, is comfortable working with technical teams, and wants to help create something new in DevSecOps.

 What You’ll Do 

- Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.

- Shape workflows where teams and agents move between intent and code in both directions, so a specification can be traced to the merges that implement it and a diff can be read and reviewed against the intent behind it.

- Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.

- Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes, including which decisions stay with a human and why.

- Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.

- Help teams ship fast with quality, balancing near-term execution with longer-term product direction.

- Explore how planning can better account for reviewing code, reviewing test cases, and validating that work produced by agents matches the intended outcome.

- Collaborate across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI product areas to reduce friction across the software development lifecycle.

 What You’ll Bring 

- Experience as a product manager working on developer tools, DevOps tools, source code management, planning tools, AI-native products, or related software development lifecycle products.

- Direct, hands-on experience with the source code lifecycle, including branches, merge requests, code review, CI/CD, and releases, whether as a product manager or as an engineer, along with a strong understanding of how software moves from ideas and requirements through planning, coding, review, testing, and delivery.

- Experience working with technical product areas and engineering teams, with enough technical depth to understand developer workflows and tradeoffs.

- A data-forward approach to product management, including experience using data to identify customer impact and guide prioritization.

- Comfort operating in ambiguous spaces where there may not yet be a clear market pattern or established product category.

- Experience building or shipping with AI tools and agents, not just using them, and a point of view of your own on where AI helps and where it does not across the software development lifecycle.

- Ability to think creatively about how AI changes the software development lifecycle and how product experiences should adapt.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.

- A bias toward action and the ability to help teams ship meaningful customer value quickly.

 About the team 

 This role sits within the Product organization and will work closely with teams across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI. We are focused on helping GitLab customers plan, build, and deliver software in a faster, more connected way.

 You'll join a group that is rethinking how planning and coding should work as AI changes the speed and shape of software development. Rather than treating planning, coding, and review as separate stages, we're exploring how to bring these workflows closer together so humans and agents can collaborate more effectively.

 An overview of this role 

 As Staff Product Manager, Test & Code Coverage, you'll build product capabilities from initial discovery through launch and adoption. You'll help engineering teams understand why pipelines fail, improve test automation, and use code coverage to make better decisions about software quality and risk.

 You'll turn a technically complex problem space into a focused strategy, roadmap, and developer experience. Working closely with Engineering and Design, you'll explore how agents can diagnose failures, recommend next steps, and help teams recover safely. The goal isn't to add artificial intelligence (AI) for its own sake. It's to reduce manual work and help developers get back to a safe, shippable state without losing trust or control.

 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. You'll contribute to that mission by making testing and coverage insights more useful across the software development lifecycle.

 What you'll do 

- Define and communicate the Test & Code Coverage product vision, strategy, and outcome-focused roadmap, from discovery through a minimum viable product, beta, launch, and continued iteration.

- Identify customer problems across pipeline failure diagnosis, test automation, test optimization, code coverage, and recovery. Build the case for investment, prioritize foundational and customer-facing work, and reshape or stop initiatives that aren't creating value.

- Work with Engineering to understand pipeline failures caused by flaky tests, testing gaps, environment issues, configuration problems, and coverage blind spots. Connect code changes, tests, pipeline behavior, historical patterns, and risk to help developers find a diagnosis and an actionable next step.

- Work directly with customers to understand how they author, maintain, select, prioritize, and debug tests. Connect test selection, test impact analysis, code coverage, and pipeline intelligence to reduce flaky tests, shorten feedback loops, and focus testing effort where it lowers the most risk.

- Partner with Engineering and Design to prototype agent-driven workflows for failure diagnosis, test authoring and repair, optimization, coverage analysis, and recovery. Make actions reviewable through evidence, confidence, human approval, and safe paths to propose code changes and merge requests. Use AI tools in your own product work to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and accelerate learning.

- Define and measure outcomes such as time to diagnose, time to recover, failure recurrence, test signal quality, and developer confidence. Validate problems and solutions with customers and learn from production usage.

- Partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Developer Experience, Customer Success, Support, and Product Marketing to connect testing insights with code review, pipelines, and release decisions. Turn customer evidence into clear narratives that support adoption and future investment.

- Lead through clear written communication, prioritization, and product judgment. Influence senior stakeholders, establish repeatable discovery and measurement practices, and mentor other product managers.

 What you'll bring 

- Experience owning complex technical products, platforms, or developer workflows at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, including building a new product or capability from initial validation through launch and adoption.

- Strong product fundamentals in customer discovery, problem framing, prioritization, roadmap development, outcome measurement, and iterative delivery.

- Technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as software testing, test automation, code coverage, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), developer tools, DevOps, developer experience, quality engineering, or software delivery.

- An understanding of how engineering teams build, test, review, and ship software, and the ability to work with engineers on test architecture, pipeline behavior, code changes, data, integrations, reliability, and scale.

- Experience diagnosing technical problems and turning complex, noisy signals into clear user experiences and actionable workflows.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.



This is a fully remote role.




WHAT WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE:

 - Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.

 - Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.

 - Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.

 - Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.

 - Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.

 - Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.

 - Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
   


AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

 - 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.

 - Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.

 - AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.

 - Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.

 - Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.

 - Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.

 - Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus:

 - Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.

 - Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).

 - Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.

 - Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.
   


PERKS & BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:

 - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

 - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan.

 - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage.

 - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses.

 - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere.

 - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay.

 - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Carrot Cash travel stipend.

 - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.

 - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

 - Open communication with management and company leadership.

 - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.



More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.



The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.



While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.



Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:



Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.



Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.



Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.



Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.



Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.



Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.



Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

Position Summary:  
 At managed.com, we're a remote-first, global team. We're also AI-first, so finding practical ways to use AI is part of every role here. 
 As the Solutions Engineer , you will act as a key technical liaison between partners and internal teams, helping design, implement, and support business and information systems solutions across Hostopia and HostPapa platforms. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, Sales, and Project Management teams to assess partner requirements, guide integrations and migrations, and ensure successful technical delivery and onboarding.  
 What you’ll do 

- Gather, analyze, and document partner business and technical requirements across integrations, migrations, reporting, and platform configurations 

- Evaluate partner technical environments and recommend scalable, efficient solution approaches 

- Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design discussions, proof of concepts, and implementation planning 

- Support API integrations, email and web services implementations, migrations, and onboarding activities 

- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Project teams to align scope, dependencies, timelines, and technical requirements 

- Translate partner needs into technical tasks, project plans, and implementation documentation 

- Deliver technical presentations, walkthroughs, demonstrations, and enablement sessions for partners and stakeholders 

- Provide guidance on solution architecture, integrations, implementation strategies, and technical issue resolution 

- Support ongoing partner relationships by troubleshooting technical and operational challenges as needed 

- Stay informed on relevant technologies, products, hosting platforms, and industry trends  

- Support other tasks or projects as assigned to meet team and business needs 
 About you 

- Experience working in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or similar customer-facing technical roles 

- Strong understanding of technical solution design, integrations, implementation planning, and systems analysis 

- Experience working with APIs, web services, migrations, onboarding projects, or platform implementations 

- Ability to manage technical discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

- Strong communication, documentation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 

- Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong organizational skills 

- Familiarity with hosting, telecommunications, cloud services, email platforms, or web services environments is considered a strong plus 

- Comfortable managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and technical priorities simultaneously 

- Ability to quickly learn new technologies, systems, and partner environments 

- Willingness to travel occasionally for partner discovery, implementation, or enablement activities when required  
 What we offer: 

- Remote-first work, with team members across many countries 

- Competitive pay, benchmarked against the markets we hire in 

- Room to grow, with real ownership of your work and support for professional development 

- Flexibility in how and when you work, within the core hours your team needs 

- Access to the AI tools you need to do your work, and the room to experiment with them 
 About us: 
 Managed.com is the company behind a family of specialist brands spanning business technology, infrastructure, and channel commerce. These include HostPapa, ColoCrossing, Hostopia, CloudBlue, and LogoMaker. Each brand serves its market through its own products and customer experience. Together, we are bringing those strengths closer to create more connected experiences and help businesses build, operate, and grow in the AI era. 
 Our culture is built on trust, respect, and doing work that matters to our customers. As our brands come together, there's real room to grow into new roles and new areas of the business. 
 Managed.com is an equal-opportunity employer. We value the range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences across our team, and we hire and promote based on skills and contribution. 
 We're committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities at every stage of the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, let us know, and we'll work with you to meet your needs. 
 Compensation Range: $80,000 to $129,000 CAD annually

greenhouse:instacart:8275378.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 The Associate Product Operations Manager (APOM) is the delivery layer of Product Ops. That means you own your workstreams from intake to handoff, with the kind of discipline and rigor that makes downstream teams trust what comes from you.

 The core scope includes: PCR intake and triage, Product Enablement Package (PEP) production, and launch readiness. You run the PCR lifecycle with quality and care. You write PEPs that people actually use. You take pride in clean handoffs.

 This is a rotation-based role. Every 6-12 months you move to a new vertical pod: Consumer, Shopper, Enterprise. You build real product sense across all of them. Each rotation is a workstream you own end-to-end, not a support assignment. That breadth is what sets you up for the next level.

 AI fluency isn't optional, but instead it's how the team works and works faster. You use AI tools regularly to accelerate your core deliverables, and you know the difference between a draft that's ready and one that still needs your judgment.

 About the Team 

 Product Operations is organized into three pillars: Vertical Partnership Pods, Intelligence & Systems (the Horizontal), and the Enablement Team. This role is within the Enablement Team.

 The Enablement Team is the shared engine that keeps launches moving. It's a centralized pool of team members, deployed to wherever priorities are highest. We execute inside the verticals, use the infrastructure the Horizontal builds, and feed back the cross-domain patterns we see across rotations. Our work is foundational to the team's promise of making outcomes more likely, faster, and more durable.

 Your manager manages your deployments and development. Your pod partners are your day-to-day collaborators. The Horizontal is the infrastructure team and your systems partner.

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

- Own PCR intake end-to-end: validate problem statements, assess routing, and make sure everything is clean before it hits a vertical pod

- Handle Tier 2 triage, the judgment calls that go beyond what the automated system can resolve on its own

- Write and maintain PEPs, using AI-assisted drafts as your starting point and owning the quality, accuracy, and stakeholder fit of the final version

- Drive launch readiness in your assigned area, coordinating with stakeholders so the people who depend on launches aren't caught off guard

- Pull together customer signal and quality data into structured summaries that feed the Horizontal's intelligence work

- Run PRDs through the PRD enabler and deliver results to POMs and Product with clear framing, not just raw output

- Surface at least one cross-domain insight to the Horizontal per deployment — you're in a unique position to see patterns across pods, and that's part of the job

- Use AI as a real part of your workflow: for triage, drafting, research, onboarding — and always edit before you share

- Build the kind of cross-domain product sense across your rotations that's the foundation for cluster ownership at L5

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 4+ years in product operations, project management, business analytics, or related field, preferably in a technology or product-driven environment.

- Hands-on experience with Jira or a similar project management tool 

- Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in SQL and proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets.

- Demonstrated use of AI-driven or automation tools to streamline operations.

- Proven ability to collaborate across functions, communicate effectively, and advocate for customers.

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 

- Experience in go-to-market planning or product launch operations.

- Prior success in a tech, SaaS, consumer product, or marketplace company.

- Familiarity with BI and data visualization platforms (e.g., Mode, Looker, Tableau).

- Experience establishing customer feedback mechanisms to drive process or product improvements.

- Demonstrated initiative and ownership for cross-team process improvements or automations.

 Overview 

 Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

 People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

 This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

 About the Job 

 Run the operating rhythm 

- Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.

- Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.

- Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.

- Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).

- Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).

- Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.

- Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.

- Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

 Plan executive communication 

- Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.

- Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

 Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health 

- Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.

- Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.

- Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

 Drive priority programs 

- Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.

- Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.

- Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 10+ years of work experience 

- R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization

- Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives

- Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.

- High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level

- Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.

- Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.

- Ability to travel 10% 

 Preferred Experience 

- Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.

- Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.

- Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

 Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success  — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.

 About the Job 

- Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.

- Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

- Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

- Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.

- Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

- Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.

- Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).

- Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.

- Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).

- Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.

- Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.

- Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.

- Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times. 

 Our employee promise represents Intact’s commitment to you in exchange for living our Values, striving to do your best work, being open to change and investing in your career. In return, we promise to provide support, opportunities and performance-led financial rewards at a workplace where you can shape the future, win as a team and grow with us. 

 Pay at Intact is about much more than just salary. 

- Flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work model

- Possibility to purchase up to 5 extra days off per year

- Multiple benefits offered to support physical and mental wellbeing, including telemedicine, Wellness account and much more

- Share plan & other savings: up to 12% of salary or even more (ask how you could earn guaranteed income for life) 

 Salary range (but not limited to):
101,800 - 124,400 
 Annual bonus target, based on the base salary, with a potential payout of up to double the target (subject to personal and company performance):
12% 
 As part of our commitment to Win As A Team , we share our success with employees through our annual bonus plan and Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) – with Intact matching 50% of your net shares.

 Our pension offerings provide flexibility and long-term security for our employees beyond their careers. We are one of the few companies offering the opportunity to receive guaranteed income for life via our defined benefit pension plan.

 Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented above is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well. 

 About the role 

 Our growing team is looking for a Product Manager !

 The Product Manager owns the vision, strategy, roadmap, governance , and value realization for the IT Services Portfolio . The portfolio encompasses service management, employee technology experience, automation, enterprise platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities, enabling transformation from project-based delivery to a sustainable product and platform operating model.

 This role translates business priorities and transformation objectives into executable portfolio strategies, target outcomes, and investment decisions. It directs high-impact initiatives and ensures solutions deliver measurable customer value, operational efficiency, adoption, resilience, and sustainable business outcomes.

 The Product Manager chairs the ITS Product Council and directs portfolio-wide prioritization, governance, roadmap alignment, dependency management, and investment recommendations. Product Owners remain accountable for product-level backlogs and delivery, while Scrum Masters enable team delivery practices.

 What you'll do here: 

 Product Strategy & Roadmap: 

- Define and maintain the IT Services Portfolio vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned with enterprise priorities and transformation outcomes.

- Translate current-state challenges and future-state operating model objectives into sequenced product, platform, process, and adoption initiatives.

- Partner with architecture, engineering, experience design, and operations leaders to shape scalable solution options and balance customer value, feasibility, risk, cost, and time to value.

- Drive transformation from discovery through adoption and optimization, ensuring changes are embedded and measurable benefits are realized.

 Product Governance & Leadership: 

- Establish the IT Services Portfolio strategy and provide strategic direction to Product Owners.

- Chair the ITS Product Council to drive portfolio prioritization, roadmap alignment, dependency resolution, and investment recommendations.

- Own and continuously improve portfolio governance, decision rights, standards, and performance reviews.

- Align business priorities, funding decisions, capacity, and delivery roadmaps across the portfolio.

- Promote product management best practices and foster a product-centric culture.

 Value Realization: 

- Define portfolio KPIs, adoption measures, and value realization targets.

- Track portfolio performance against targets for adoption, customer experience, operational efficiency, realized value, and roadmap delivery.

- Develop business cases and executive-level recommendations supporting investment decisions.

- Continuously identify opportunities to optimize value, efficiency, and customer experience.

 Stakeholder Leadership: 

- Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, architects, UX designers, and delivery teams.

- Facilitate prioritization and strategic planning discussions across multiple stakeholders.

- Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, and value realization to executive leadership.

 People Leadership: 

- Coach Product Owners on product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, prioritization, and value realization.

- Partner with Scrum Masters to strengthen delivery practices, cross-team coordination, and continuous improvement.

- Foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement practices.

 What you bring to the table: 

- Minimum of 7 years of product management experience, including enterprise transformation or portfolio-level accountability.

- Proven experience managing enterprise platforms, digital products, or IT service portfolios from strategy through adoption and value realization.

- Strong understanding of enterprise architecture and solution design concepts, including applications, integrations, APIs, data, cloud, security, resiliency, and technical debt.

- Ability to collaborate with architects and engineering leaders, evaluate solution options, and make informed build-versus-buy, scalability, risk, cost, and lifecycle trade-offs.

- Strong understanding of Agile, lean product management, value-based delivery, product operating models, and organizational change and adoption practices.

- Experience developing business cases and applying financial concepts such as total cost of ownership, investment prioritization, benefits realization, and ROI.

- Experience with automation, AI, ServiceNow, ITSM, ITAM, CMDB, or enterprise workflow platforms is preferred.

- Strong data literacy and experience defining KPIs, using customer and operational insights, and communicating evidence-based recommendations.

- Excellent executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across business and technology audiences.

- ITIL 4 certification or strong working knowledge of ITIL practices is considered an asset.

- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English speaking colleagues across the country.   

- No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.

 About the role 

 We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Development Team!

 You will define priorities, manage the product backlog, and guide the delivery of secure and effective identity lifecycle capabilities.

 You will work closely with development, Security, IT, Compliance, Risk, and business teams to improve how identities and access are managed across the organization. This role also focuses on modernizing IGA processes, increasing automation, improving customer engagement, and creating clear, data-driven reporting.

 What you'll do here: 

- Define and communicate the IGA product vision, goals, priorities, and roadmap.

- Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog.

- Write clear user stories, requirements, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

- Represent the needs of users, customers, business stakeholders, Security, IT, Risk, and Compliance.

- Support identity governance capabilities, including: Joiner, mover, and leaver processes; Access requests and approvals; Automated provisioning and deprovisioning; Role and entitlement management; Access reviews and certifications; and identity data quality and application integrations.

- Balance business value, security risk, compliance requirements, customer experience, technical complexity, and delivery effort.

- Work closely with developers, architects, analysts, testers, and delivery leads.

- Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.

- Provide timely clarification and make decisions throughout the delivery process.

- Review and accept completed work against agreed requirements.

- Drive modernization through automation, self-service, improved integrations, and simplified processes.

- Identify and reduce manual effort, delays, errors, duplicate identities, and unnecessary access administration.

- Establish feedback loops with customers, application owners, access approvers, Security, IT, and business stakeholders.

- Coordinate customer interviews, discovery sessions, demonstrations, and feedback activities.

- Use customer feedback, performance data, audit findings, incidents, and team insights to guide priorities.

- Improve backlog management, refinement, prioritization, release processes, and team ways of working.

- Track and report on delivery progress, backlog health, risks, dependencies, incidents, automation, and improvement initiatives.

- Develop clear dashboards and reporting routines for leadership and stakeholders.

- Ensure decisions, risks, actions, and changes are clearly communicated and tracked.

- Partner with the Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, or delivery leadership to improve team performance and delivery effectiveness.

 What you bring to the table: 

- 2-3 years of experience in a similar role.

- 1-year of product management experience.

- Engineering and development skills.

- Understanding of the product and drive the team.

- Experience working as a product owner, product manager, business analyst, or in a similar role within a software development environment.

- Experience managing and prioritizing a product backlog.

- Experience writing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

- Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar delivery methods.

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional development teams.

- Experience engaging with customers, users, and business stakeholders.

- Knowledge of identity governance, identity lifecycle management, access management, or cybersecurity.

- Strong communication, facilitation, organization, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to use data and feedback to improve product and delivery outcomes.

- Experience creating product, delivery, or performance reporting.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and make clear trade-offs.

- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country. 

- No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.

 Preferred: 

- Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, or similar IGA platforms.

- Experience with provisioning, deprovisioning, access certifications, roles, entitlements, or segregation of duties.

- Experience with identity integrations, APIs, automation, or cloud technologies.

- Experience driving process modernization or continuous improvement.

- Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms.

- Product Owner, Scrum, Agile, identity, or security certification.

 Success in this role: 

- The development team has clear priorities, requirements, and expected outcomes.

- The backlog is healthy, prioritized, and aligned with customer, business, security, and compliance needs.

- IGA processes are more automated, efficient, secure, and user-friendly.

- Identity and access activities are completed accurately and on time.

- Stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, risks, priorities, and delivery performance.

- Customer feedback and data consistently inform product decisions.

- Continuous improvement leads to measurable gains in efficiency, quality, predictability, and customer satisfaction.

 About the role 

 Our growing team is looking for an AI Product Manager ! 

 About the role: 

 At Intact Lab, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions by integrating user-centered design with cutting-edge technology. As part of this ambition, we are seeking a talented and passionate AI Product Manager to join our dynamic team. 

As an AI Product Manager, you will lead the development of AI-powered products that help Claims teams make better decisions, work more efficiently, and deliver better customer outcomes. Working closely with business leaders, designers, data scientists, and engineers, you will identify opportunities, define strategy, and deliver trusted AI solutions that create measurable business value. 

 This opportunity is ideal for someone who is passionate about solving real business problems with AI, thrives in uncertain environments, and enjoys turning emerging technologies into products that people actively use and trust. 

 Reporting to the Manager, AI Products – Claims, your main responsibilities will include: 

 What you'll do here: 

 • Define product vision, strategy and outcomes 
 Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into a clear product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes. 

 • Lead cross-functional product teams 
 Bring together business experts, designers, data scientists, and engineers around a common objective. Facilitate alignment, drive decisions, and create momentum from discovery through delivery. 

 • Deliver AI products that solve real user problems 
 Drive product discovery and AI innovation: Identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful value. Deeply understand user workflows, validate assumptions, and guide experimentation to build products that solve real business problems. 

 • Measure impact and realize value 
 Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously identify opportunities to increase adoption, improve outcomes, and maximize business value. 

 • Foster user trust and adoption 
 Foster trust, adoption, and responsible AI: Ensure AI solutions are understood, adopted, and trusted by users while promoting transparent and human-centered AI experiences. 

 • Balance business value, user experience, and AI perfor mance 
 Evaluate trade-offs and make informed decisions that optimize user outcomes, business impact, solution quality, and long-term sustainability. 

 What you bring to the table: 

- 7+ years of experience building and delivering digital products. 

- Ability to define product strategy and drive measurable outcomes. 

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

- Experience using data to inform decisions. 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

- Understanding of AI, machine learning, or data-driven products. 

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. 

- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country.  

- No Canadian work experience required; however must be eligible to work in Canada. 

 You are : 

- An autonomous leader who drives change and creates clarity. 

- An entrepreneurial thinker who identifies opportunities and turns ideas into outcomes. 

- A data-driven and value-oriented decision maker. 

- A product management professional with strong planning and stakeholder management skills. 

- Highly diplomatic and effective at building trusted relationships. 

- Comfortable navigating uncertainty and making decisions with incomplete information 

- Able to bring together diverse groups of experts toward a common goal. 

- Creative, analytical, curious, and resourceful.

workday:interac/Interac:REQ-2311.description:
Who We Are: 

 Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives. 

Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.

 As the backbone of Canada’s financial ecosystem, Interac facilitates over 20 million transactions daily, supported by trusted partnerships with government and financial institutions. Consistently ranked as Canada’s most reputable financial technology brand, Interac is deeply embedded in the daily lives of Canadians.

 Who You Will Work With: 
 The Product Marketing, Senior Specialist works within the Product Marketing team and across the broader Interac organization, with a mandate to support the storytelling, go-to-market planning, market intelligence, and execution of product marketing activities to drive growth for Interac. Supporting the Product Marketing Leader, this role will work in close collaboration with the Marketing Leads to plan, execute, and measure the success of programs to meet our product goals.

 What You Will Do:   ​
 Storytelling & Go-to-Market Planning

- Support the Product Marketing Leader and collaborate with Product Leads in crafting product narratives, messaging, and positioning that shapes how different audiences think about Interac products on an emotional and rational level.

- In partnership with the Product Marketing Leads for product(s), provide support for go-to-market planning and the development of a cohesive marketing plan that aligns with overall business goals.

 Go-to-Market Execution

- Execute against the go-to-market plan for product marketing with a cross-functional team across paid, earned, and owned marketing channels to reach both consumer and business audiences.

- Support brief development to inspire breakthrough storytelling and creative concepts, rooted in customer insights.

- Guide and direct agency partners and internal teams in campaign development to develop on strategy programs and grow our products and brands.

 Customer Insights, Market Intelligence and Reporting

- Coordinate market research and customer insights to identify key pain points, trends, and opportunities in both merchant and consumer segments.

- Use data-driven insights to recommend refining of messaging and development new campaigns.

- Provide regular reporting on the effectiveness of marketing efforts, using insights to inform ongoing strategy refinement.

 Measurement & Reporting

- Set KPIs for partner marketing initiatives and build new tracking for performance across all campaigns and channels, in partnership with digital and analytics teams.

- Provide regular reporting and summary presentations on the effectiveness of marketing efforts, using insights to inform ongoing strategy refinement.

- Ensure continuous optimization of campaigns based on data and market feedback to maximize impact.

 Sales Enablement

- Lead the development of sales enablement materials to support the CCO sales efforts.

 Budget and Invoicing

- Process invoices and track spending against budget for areas of accountability, ensuring cost-effective initiatives. 

 Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Participate in agile product squads, ensuring alignment between product capabilities, business development needs, and marketing strategies and support timely delivery of campaigns to meet outcomes.

 What You Bring:  

- 5-7 years of experience in marketing or product marketing, preferably within payments, financial services, or retail.

- Experience in harnessing customer insights and market research to inform product positioning and campaign strategies.

- Experience with go-to-market planning and developing strategic product marketing plans and materials.

- Experience with go-to-market execution across paid and owned channels in both B2B and B2C orientations.

- Strong presentation skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to translate technical features into compelling and clear product marketing, sales enablement materials, and clear agency briefings

- Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build cross-functional relationships across Marketing, Comms, Product, and Technology teams. 

- Eligibility to work for Interac Corp. in Canada in a full-time capacity.    

 What We’re Offering:  
 The hiring range for this position is $85,000 – $110,000, and you will also be eligible for our short-term incentive plan. The exact amount will depend on factors such as skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, but Interac’s commitment goes beyond compensation. Our Total Rewards package is designed to support your well-being and future, and includes: 

- Generous vacation and wellness days to help you recharge  

- Comprehensive employer-paid benefits coverage for peace of mind

The role maintains focused oversight of products and services supporting Prominent Payment Systems, including their platforms, participants, critical service providers, and operational dependencies.

 This role ensures that ERM standards, risk appetite, taxonomy, control requirements, and issue management practices are applied consistently to product and payment systems risk. It enables risk informed decisions through independent assessment, credible challenge, monitoring, aggregation, and escalation, with particular focus on operational risk, operational resilience, incidents, deficiencies, risk acceptance, concentration risk, and third party dependencies.

 The Product Risk Lead contributes to the broader Product and Platform Risk mandate by identifying cross product themes, strengthening enterprise insight, and supporting consistent oversight across product teams, business units, and functional groups. The role engages early with the first line while maintaining clear accountability boundaries: the first line owns product delivery, controls, assessments, incidents, and remediation; the Product Risk Lead provides independent oversight, challenge, monitoring, and escalation.

- Maintain focused oversight of products and services supporting Prominent Payment Systems, including platforms, participants, critical service providers, and material operational dependencies.

- Assess product and payment systems risk against enterprise risk appetite, taxonomy, policies, standards, and regulatory expectations.

- Independently review and challenge first line risk assessments, control design, residual risk conclusions, remediation plans, and risk acceptance decisions.

- Independently assess whether risk acceptance decisions are adequately supported, within delegated authority, time limited where appropriate, and escalated when exposure is outside approved appetite or tolerance.

- Oversee operational risk exposure, including incidents, control deficiencies, service disruption, processing risk, concentration risk, third party dependencies, and operational resilience.

- Assess the risk implications of material product, platform, technology, process, and third party changes, and provide independent second line review and challenge of support regulatory notification decisions notifications and supporting evidence without assuming ownership of the notification process where required.

- Aggregate product level insights to identify systemic exposure, cross product themes, emerging risks, and enterprise level implications.

- Assess forward looking product risks, including customer harm, market conduct, fraud evolution, technology concentration, data and artificial intelligence risk, ecosystem change, and unintended product outcomes, where relevant.

- Prepare independent risk reporting for management and Board risk committees, including clear conclusions, trends, decisions, and required actions.

- Promote risk informed decision making by translating ERM requirements into practical guidance without assuming first line ownership.

- Provide oversight of the completeness and quality of product risk, control, deficiency, issue, and risk acceptance records within the enterprise system of record.

- Ability to influence product owners, executives, delivery leaders, and control partners while preserving clear accountability boundaries.

- Ability to translate complex risk and regulatory expectations into clear decisions, actions, and evidence requirements.

- Experience across all listed risk domains is preferred rather than required; candidates must demonstrate deep expertise in second line product or payments risk and the ability to apply that expertise across adjacent risk disciplines.

Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.

You will have the ability to shape key operational improvement initiatives that enable the business and will be responsible for designing processes and systems to ensure efficient performance of the team.

The LCR Strategy and Operations Leader will be a leader, facilitator and enabler of key projects, communications, reports and other activities that support the mandate of the LCR team. Interac requires someone with exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills.
