Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity 

 The Senior Product Manager, Partner Experience will lead the strategy, development, commercialization, and ongoing evolution of the products, platforms, APIs, and capabilities that power the partner experience across Moneris' Distribution Partnerships portfolio.

 This role is responsible for defining how Moneris enables and supports its diverse partner ecosystem, including software platforms (ISVs), embedded payment partners, PayFacs, ISOs, associations, affiliates, referral partners, and other strategic distribution relationships.

 A key initial mandate will be leading the implementation, commercialization, and ongoing optimization of a strategic partner management platform and associated third-party acquiring capabilities. Beyond the initial platform implementation, the role will establish and evolve a broader Partner Experience product strategy focused on creating scalable, digital-first experiences that simplify how partners onboard, manage, support, and grow their merchant portfolios with Moneris.

 This is a senior product leadership role requiring strong product management expertise, strategic thinking, technical and commercial acumen, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives.

 Location: You will be based in our Toronto office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
 Reporting Relationship : You will report to the Director, Product - Distribution Partnerships. 
 Posting Type: New Position.
 Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $155,000.

 Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. 

 Your Moneris Career - What you'll do 

- Own the Partner Experience product strategy: Define and manage the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the Partner Experience portfolio, aligned with the broader Distribution Partnerships strategy.

- Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle: Lead products and capabilities from discovery and business case development through delivery, commercialization, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

- Translate insights into product innovation: Turn partner needs, market trends, business objectives, and competitive insights into product opportunities, priorities, and scalable solutions.

- Shape and enhance the partner experience: Define and continuously improve partner and merchant experiences across onboarding, portfolio management, servicing, reporting, settlement, and related capabilities.

- Drive platform, API, and ecosystem development: Lead the implementation and evolution of partner-facing platforms, APIs, and integration capabilities that enable partners to onboard, manage, and grow merchant portfolios at scale.

- Advance automation and self-service capabilities: Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, increase automation, and support scalable portfolio growth.

- Measure and optimize performance: Establish and monitor product success metrics, using data and partner feedback to drive adoption, prioritization, and ongoing improvement.

- Lead cross-functional execution: Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and external stakeholders to deliver complex strategic initiatives.

- Manage strategic partner and vendor relationships: Build and maintain relationships with technology and distribution partners to ensure capabilities and investments align with Moneris' long-term objectives.

 Your Moneris Career - What you bring 
 Required skills and experience 

- 5+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, platform products, payments, fintech, SaaS, or related fields, including experience operating at a senior product management level.

- Demonstrated experience owning complex products or platforms from strategy and discovery through delivery, commercialization, and ongoing optimization.

- Strong knowledge of product management disciplines, including product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements definition, agile delivery, commercialization, and performance management.

- Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple business and technology teams without direct authority.

- Experience working with APIs, platform products, integrations, or technology-enabled ecosystems.

- Experience developing business cases, evaluating investments, defining pricing or commercial models, and measuring product performance.

- Demonstrated ability to translate customer or partner needs into scalable product solutions.

- Experience presenting recommendations and influencing decisions with senior stakeholders.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

 Experience that would set you apart 

- Experience within payments, acquiring, fintech, banking, or financial services.

- Experience working with ISVs, PayFacs, ISOs, embedded payments providers, marketplaces, or other partner-led distribution models.

- Experience with merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, third-party acquiring, or merchant lifecycle management.

- Experience with partner management, merchant onboarding, underwriting, settlement, residual management, billing, or reporting platforms.

- Experience managing vendor or technology platform relationships.

- Experience developing API-first or platform-based products and services.

 Your Moneris Career - What you get 
 At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.

- Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).

- Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.

- Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.

- Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.

- Flexibility that works for you, including hybrid work arrangements, a Work from Abroad program, and paid time off programs.

- Recognition and rewards, with company-wide recognition programs, exclusive banking perks from RBC & BMO, and access to great employee discounts.

A career as a Senior Solution Architect within the Technology and Operations team at National Bank means acting as a subject matter expert in the design and evolution of Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions. In this role, you will have a direct impact on multiple business domains by accelerating the adoption of a strategic platform, while leveraging your expertise in solution architecture, integration, and AWS technologies to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions.
Your job
Produce the required architecture deliverables.
Ensure solution consistency, quality, and compliance by working closely with development, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams.
Prepare business line integrations and onboard their domains onto the IDP platform.
Industrialize low-code onboarding by automating the transformation of Excel-based configurations into YAML.
Define a self-service model enabling business lines to configure new document types without intervention from the IDP team.
Define the migration of IFRS models to the approved native AWS stack (Textract and Bedrock).
Carry out optimization initiatives aimed at reducing platform operating costs.
Develop the foundations for operational AI agents.
Address traceability gaps identified during operational audits.
Your team
You will report to the Senior Director, Solution Architecture . The Solution Architecture team you will join consists of approximately twenty specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay at the forefront of technology, and continuously improve processes.
Our team stands out through its collaborative spirit, openness to innovation, and constant desire to experiment with new approaches to create value. We aim to provide maximum flexibility to support your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment as well as a flexible and adaptable work schedule.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility.
Our personalized learning programs, based on experiential learning, enable you to master your profession and develop new areas of expertise. Resources such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, as well as coaching and mentoring services, are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, and several years (5-10) of relevant experience in solution architecture within complex environments.
Proven experience with AWS cloud technologies, particularly Bedrock, Textract, Step Functions, Athena, Glue, and Lambda.
Hands-on experience with the following technologies: Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform/IaC, Python (FastAPI), OCR, and IDP.
Experience designing solutions involving data, APIs, Kafka, webhooks, and microservices.
Knowledge of modern software development practices, CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions), application security (OAuth2/Okta, Azure AD), and data governance.
Banking or financial services industry experience is considered an asset.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.

A career as a Senior Data Solutions Architect within the Wealth Management Solution and Data Architecture team at National Bank means leading the definition and implementation of innovative solutions. Through your human leadership and technical expertise, you will have a positive impact on National Bank’s growth.
Your job
Take ownership of the data dimensions of solutions, including flows, authoritative sources, analysis and profiling, integration, modelling, optimization, management and data exposure.
Determine the most appropriate data integration and exposure approaches for the investment domain, considering context-specific needs and the long-term sustainability of the solution.
Contribute to the governance of data-related processes, particularly in relation to data quality.
Align solutions with functional and non-functional requirements, including data volumes, refresh frequency and long-term data growth.
Ensure that data solutions comply with the organization’s data integration patterns.
Document data solutions and maintain related artifacts, such as flows, data models, message models and value domains. Also contribute to data innovation.
Integrate opportunities offered by artificial intelligence, including generative AI, into the design of data architectures to improve data exploitation, value creation and automation.
Collaborate with relevant teams to guide the secure and responsible use of AI in data solutions, particularly with respect to governance, quality, traceability and data protection.
Assess AI use cases applied to data, such as augmented search, classification, enrichment, automated analysis and decision support, based on business value and technological feasibility.
Support delivery teams in the design and production of physical data structures.
Your team
IT is made up of more than 2,300 experts who work in an agile, proactive and collaborative way to seize opportunities, stay at the forefront of technology and continuously improve processes.
Within Wealth Management, you will be part of a large team of 30 colleagues and will report to the Senior Manager, Solution and Data Architecture. We aim to provide you with maximum flexibility to support your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment, as well as a flexible and adaptable schedule.
National Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning through action, enable you to master your profession and develop new areas of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites
Profile primarily focused on data architecture, with complementary expertise in solution architecture, in order to design coherent, integrated solutions aligned with the overall systems architecture.
Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling in transactional and informational contexts.
Solid knowledge and experience in artificial intelligence applied to systems architecture, including generative AI, language models, augmented search, vectorization, vector databases, as well as the assessment of AI-related risks and appropriate mitigation mechanisms.
Good understanding of reference data, master data, authoritative sources, DDD, data governance, enterprise data catalogues, data security and access management concepts.
Proficiency in data integration and exploitation approaches, including APIs, streaming, ETL processes, business intelligence, analytics, data warehouses and data virtualization, with an excellent ability to analyze flows and impacts across systems.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field combined with 8 years of relevant experience; data management certifications, such as Data Management Professional, are considered an asset, as are knowledge of the investment domain and experience with agile methodologies.
Strong ability to synthesize, analyze and explain complex topics in simple terms; ability to facilitate effective workshops and meetings, work collaboratively and under pressure, and demonstrate authenticity and servant leadership.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.

A career as a Senior Advisor, Program Governance and Project Portfolio Management, within Pillar 5 of the Momentum 2030 strategic plan means contributing to the integrated management of a complex transformation portfolio aimed at improving the end-to-end commercial financing process.
Working closely with the Commercial Financing Transformation Program Manager (Pillar 5), pillar leaders, initiative owners and delivery teams, you contribute to the operation and evolution of portfolio governance, performance monitoring and integrated planning mechanisms.
With your judgment, ability to synthesize information and confidence communicating with senior leadership, you bring forward critical information, emerging risks and decisions needed. As you deepen your understanding of the portfolio and its ecosystem, you gradually gain autonomy in coordinating governance, producing an integrated portfolio view and maintaining the roadmap.
Your role
Inform and accelerate decision-making at every level of program governance by highlighting priority issues and clearly presenting implications, options and decisions needed.
Prepare and present concise analyses and recommendations to senior leadership, tailoring the level of detail and message to the responsibilities of each governance body.
Coordinate the Pillar 5 governance cycle, including prioritizing topics, clarifying decisions needed, tracking commitments and, progressively, facilitating certain governance forums.
Produce an integrated, forward-looking portfolio view covering progress, key deliverables, budget evolution, performance indicators, benefits, risks, dependencies and capacity constraints.
Maintain and evolve the integrated Pillar 5 roadmap, ensuring consistency in sequencing, milestones, interdependencies and approved changes.
Analyze and challenge information from teams to identify inconsistencies, blind spots, cross-functional impacts and matters requiring intervention or a decision.
Facilitate the resolution of risks, issues and dependencies across initiatives by engaging the right stakeholders and structuring escalations when intervention by leaders or sponsors is required.
Continuously improve program governance, reporting and project portfolio management practices to enhance information quality, simplify processes and support effective execution.
Your team
Within Commercial and Private Banking 1859, you will join the team responsible for Pillar 5 of the Commercial and Private Banking 1859 Momentum 2030 strategic plan. Its ambition is to improve the efficiency of the end-to-end commercial financing process and help create a simpler, faster and more predictable experience for clients and colleagues.
Pillar 5 brings together several initiatives and projects involving business, financing, credit, operations, technology, data and transformation teams. You work closely with the Pillar 5 Program Manager and regularly interact with pillar leaders, initiative owners, project managers, specialized partners and senior leaders.
Prerequisites
Significant experience in program management, project portfolio management, transformation governance or complex project management.
Experience preparing and presenting analyses, recommendations or decision materials to senior executives.
Excellent ability to synthesize complex information, prioritize what matters most and formulate clear recommendations.
Experience managing integrated roadmaps, milestones, risks, issues and dependencies.
Demonstrated ability to influence and mobilize multidisciplinary stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
Ability to work in a complex and ambiguous environment, exercise independent judgment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to adapt messages for operational and executive audiences.
A bachelor’s degree in a related field and three to ten years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree and three to seven years of relevant experience, or any other combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
Assets
Experience in commercial banking, commercial financing or financial services.
Experience in a transformation portfolio involving business, technology, operations, risk and data teams.
Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI or comparable portfolio management and tracking tools.
PMP, Agile, Lean, program management or change management certification.
Momentum 2030 plan is a fast-moving environment. There are many opportunities to take the initiative on specific projects or other areas of work alongside your main responsibilities. It is a great opportunity to demonstrate your ambition and your ability to take calculated risks. We champion innovation not only in the transformation plan we are implementing, but also in how we work. Each week, we look for ways to simplify and automate project portfolio management tasks, including through the use of AI tools.

English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.

A career as a CI/CD and Continuous Testing (CT) Product Owner in the Methodology, Governance and Practices sector at National Bank means acting as a specialist in the vision, prioritization and delivery of digital products. This job allows you to have a positive impact on our organization thanks to your experience in product management, solution delivery and agile methods.
Your job
Act as a product owner in complex initiatives and transform business needs into clear and value-bearing functionalities.
Drive the delivery of initiatives and contribute to the realization of the solution development roadmap.
Cut and sequence the target vision, then build, prioritize and manage the product backlog according to business value, constraints and interdependencies.
Define the minimum viable product with the delivery team to maximize the value delivered gradually.
Accompany stakeholders in the changes, promote their buy-in and support resistance management.
Continuously improve the product and prioritize fixes to meet current and future needs and improve the experience.
Your team
The Vice-Presidency of Strategy, Practices and Delivery brings together specialists who work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

We aim to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This translates into a hybrid work environment, as well as a flexible and adaptable schedule.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning in action, allow you to master your craft and develop new areas of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites
Have a bachelor's degree in a related field and have 6 years of relevant experience, or have a master's degree in a related field and have 4 years of relevant experience.
Experience in delivering solutions as a product owner.
Master the principles of managing a product backlog, prioritizing by value, and defining a minimum viable product.
Have hands-on experience with agile Scrum, Kanban, or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methods.
Demonstrate experience in the progressive delivery of solutions when specifications change.

Knowledge of bank capital management and the Finance, Risk, or Treasury sectors
Experience working in a regulated environment with high requirements for data quality, controls, and auditability

A career as a Chief Solutions Architect within the Wealth Management team at National Bank means acting as a specialist in the design and implementation of innovative solutions. Through your leadership, experience, and advanced expertise in technology and systems integration, you will have a direct impact on both the client experience and the profitability of the business sector. Your advanced knowledge of technology and solution architecture practices will enable you to support our brokerage and investment specialists in delivering innovative solutions.
Your job
Mobilize various subject matter experts to design solutions that meet both functional and non-functional business requirements while aligning with the organization’s strategic objectives.
Demonstrate authentic leadership and a servant leadership mindset.
Participate in peer reviews and support fellow architects when they require assistance.
Simplify and promote the architecture governance process among project teams.
Contribute to the evolution and continuous improvement of the solution architecture practice.
Evaluate implementation and maintenance costs of proposed solutions.
Stay informed of technological trends and understand their impact on business processes and applications, communicating these impacts effectively to diverse audiences.
Contribute to the preparation and execution of planning exercises (SAFe PI Planning).
Ensure the successful delivery of activities under your responsibility, from development through production deployment, while maintaining high-quality technology solutions.
Your Team
You are part of a team of 20 colleagues in the wealth Management sector and report to a Senior Manager. Our team stands out for its culture of collaboration, mutual support among its members and an environment that fosters expertise sharing, innovation and leadership developmentAs a Senior Architect or Senior Solutions Architect, you will work in a community of practise committed to architectural excellence and continuous improvement. You will work with specialists in various fields to design technological solutions that add high value to the organisation.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.
Prerequisites
Bachelor's degree in a related field and 7 to 10 years of relevant experience.
Experience as a Solutions Architect within the financial services industry.
Minimum 5 years of experience with systems integration technologies, including APIs, microservices, ESBs, Kafka, and similar technologies.
Experience with Java, Kafka, and Kubernetes is considered an asset.
Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Sybase, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
Knowledge of security concepts and standards, including SAML, OAuth, and OpenID.
Experience with AWS cloud solutions (AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification is an asset).
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.

A career as a Generative AI Solutions Architect within the Commercial and 1859 Technology and Innovation team at National Bank means acting as a specialist in the design and evolution of solutions enhanced by generative artificial intelligence. This role allows you to make a meaningful impact on our organization by leveraging your expertise in architecture, data, and emerging AI technologies.
Your Role
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define solutions that integrate generative AI into a variety of business contexts.
Influence technology directions and guide teams in adopting services, tools, and frameworks related to large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered solutions.
Design modular, secure, and scalable architectures that incorporate generative AI models and cloud-based components.
Ensure solution consistency, quality, and compliance by working closely with development, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams.
Contribute to the implementation of end-to-end solutions, including data pipelines, MLOps, system integrations, and monitoring/FinOps mechanisms.
Diagnose complex challenges and recommend approaches that ensure the robustness, performance, and security of deployed AI solutions.
Your Team
The Technology and Innovation Vice-Presidency is composed of more than 20 specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative way to seize opportunities, stay at the forefront of technological advancements, and continuously improve processes.
Within the Solutions Architecture sector, you will be part of a large team of colleagues and report to the Senior Director, Commercial Innovation Architecture. Our team is recognized for its collaborative spirit, openness to innovation, and constant desire to experiment with new approaches that create value. We are committed to providing maximum flexibility to support your work-life balance through a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.
National Bank values continuous learning and internal mobility.
Our personalized development programs, built on learning through experience, enable you to deepen your expertise and explore new areas of specialization. Resources such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, and coaching and mentoring opportunities are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, combined with several years of relevant experience in solution architecture within complex environments.
Hands-on experience delivering projects involving generative AI, advanced language models, or emerging AI solutions.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture concepts, ideally within AWS and Salesforce ecosystems, including services applicable to generative AI.
Experience designing solutions that integrate data, APIs, microservices, and technology governance mechanisms.
Knowledge of modern software development practices, CI/CD, application security, and continuous integration.
Experience or knowledge of the banking industry is considered a strong asset.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.

A career as a Product Director Insurance within the Strategy, Growth and Business Capabilities team at National Bank means acting as the owner of an insurance product portfolio. In this role, you will have a direct impact on growth, profitability, and the evolution of the product offering through your expertise in product development, insurance, pricing, and business strategy.
As part of our ambitious growth strategy in insurance and wealth management, you will help build and evolve new growth platforms. You will be responsible for defining the vision, developing the offering, driving financial performance, and supporting the commercialization of a high-potential product portfolio. Working closely with multiple business partners, you will contribute to creating innovative solutions that meet client needs and generate sustainable value for the organization.
Your Role
Define and evolve the strategy for an insurance product portfolio to support growth and value creation.
Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and client needs to develop new solutions and value propositions.
Manage the entire product lifecycle, from design and launch to optimization and ongoing enhancement.
Analyze financial performance, recommend pricing strategies, and implement initiatives to maximize portfolio profitability.
Develop acquisition, retention, and go-to-market strategies in partnership with various distribution teams.
Influence and mobilize multidisciplinary teams, including actuarial, finance, compliance, marketing, digital, and distribution stakeholders, to achieve business objectives.
Your Team
The Strategy, Growth and Business Capabilities sector is made up of specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative environment to seize opportunities, stay ahead of market trends, and continuously improve processes.
Within National Bank Insurance, you will be part of a highly engaged team and report to a Senior Manager responsible for strategy and growth. Our team is distinguished by its entrepreneurial mindset, collaborative approach, and commitment to turning market opportunities into tangible results.
We strive to offer maximum flexibility to support your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible schedule tailored to your needs.
National Bank is committed to continuous development and internal mobility. Our customized training programs, based on learning through action, enable you to master your profession and develop new areas of expertise. You will have access at all times to resources such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline such as Actuarial Science, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Proven experience in insurance product management and development or retirement solutions.
Experience in pricing, actuarial analysis, or product profitability analysis.

A career as a Product Owner on the Digital Treasury Strategy & Delivery team at National Bank means acting as a leader in delivering major projects related to treasury products in the digital channel. This role allows you to make a positive impact on our organization through your influence, analytical skills, ability to solve complex problems, rigour, attentiveness to business needs, decision-making ability, and mobilizing leadership.
Your role:
Act as a Product Owner (PO – according to the SAFe/Agile methodology) on complex projects by translating the business vision into concrete features that optimize the end-to-end client experience.
Be responsible for delivering initiatives and contribute to the solutions roadmap, taking into account the specific needs of commercial clients and their complete journey.
Break down and sequence a target vision in order to maximize delivered value, prioritizing features related to treasury management products based on their impact on commercial clients, operational constraints, and interdependencies with other projects or sectors.
Build, manage, and prioritize the product backlog to achieve the business vision, define the MVP, and guide the delivery team toward the items that create the most value for commercial clients.
Support and facilitate change adoption, secure stakeholder buy-in, and manage resistance, while maintaining a strong understanding of the operational, transactional, and relationship-related issues specific to commercial clients.
Continuously improve and correct solutions to enhance the client experience, meet current and future needs, and strengthen the relevance of treasury management products offered to businesses.
Your team:
Within the sector, you are part of a team mainly composed of Product Owners and SMEs, totaling 12 colleagues. The team is primarily responsible for delivering initiatives within the large backlog of the BDB program, Business Digital Banking.

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and six years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree in a related field and four years of relevant experience.
Experience delivering solutions as a Product Owner (PO).
Ability to work in Agile mode: Scrum, Kanban, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), and to deliver without having all specifications.
Knowledge of commercial client needs.
Ability to work with external vendors.
Ability to communicate information and ideas effectively.

rippling:nesto:66134be9-3019-44e6-929e-c.title: Senior Product Manager, New Products
rippling:nesto:66134be9-3019-44e6-929e-c.description:
Senior Product Manager, New Products
The bright side of mortgages
[nesto](http://nesto.ca/) is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.
About Us
As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.
Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.
Nesto Group
[Nesto Group](https://nestogroup.ca/) is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.
Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.
Operating through our family of brands— [CMLS](http://cmls.ca) , [nesto](http://www.nesto.ca) , and [Nesto Cloud](http://www.nestocloud.ca) —our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at: [https://nestogroup.ca/](https://nestogroup.ca/)
Life at nesto
At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead 0→1 product development on one of nesto's most strategic bets. In this role, you'll own the vision, roadmap, and execution for a new financial product — defining what we build and partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM to bring it to life.
The right person has strong instincts for complex financial workflows, thrives in ambiguity, and can translate the needs of buyers and users into product decisions that create durable value. This is a senior, highly cross-functional role — you'll work across product pillars and partner teams to build something that meaningfully expands what nesto can offer Canadians.
What You'll Be Doing
Own the Product Vision — Define and execute the end-to-end product strategy for a new product, from concept through launch and scale. Translate the opportunity into a clear roadmap and drive alignment across the organization.
Lead 0→1 Development — Navigate the full arc of new product development: deep customer and market discovery, scoping, prioritization, iterative building, and go-to-market readiness. Make crisp decisions in the face of uncertainty.
Cross-Functional Leadership — Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Risk, Compliance, and GTM to ensure every work stream is aligned. Be the connective tissue across teams.
Commercial Acumen — Partner with GTM and leadership to translate new capabilities into positioning, sales enablement, and customer-facing narratives. Understand how the product creates business value, not just user value.
Define Success — Establish the right metrics for product health, adoption, and impact. Use data to drive iteration and build the feedback loops that keep the team focused on what matters.
Stakeholder Influence — Communicate clearly and persuasively with stakeholders at all levels — from engineers deep in implementation to executives making strategic bets. Bring clarity through complexity.
Who We're Looking For
The Profile
8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years at a Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.
Demonstrated track record of owning and successfully launching complex new products, ideally in fintech, financial services, or data-intensive domains.
Experience building products that handle sensitive data with rigorous security, compliance, and access control requirements — you understand what it means to build responsibly in a regulated environment.
Strong technical acumen — ability to engage deeply with engineering on system design, data pipelines, and architecture without losing sight of the customer problem.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions and levels.
Proven ability to operate with clarity and conviction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — you don't wait for perfect information to move.
Sharp product sense and a high bar for quality — you sweat the details while keeping the big picture in view.
Preferred but Not a Must
Mortgage or regulated financial services experience — curiosity, rigor, and execution matter more.
Familiarity with lending technology, origination platforms, or financial data infrastructure.
Exposure to platform or API-driven product development in an enterprise SaaS context.
Experience with go-to-market motions for complex financial products.

About Us
As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.
Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.
Nesto Group
[Nesto Group](https://nestogroup.ca/) is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.
Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.
Operating through our family of brands— [CMLS](http://cmls.ca) , [nesto](http://www.nesto.ca) , and [Nesto Cloud](http://www.nestocloud.ca) —our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at: [https://nestogroup.ca/](https://nestogroup.ca/)
Life at nesto
At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Where you sit.
You'll be embedded in the Product team, at the intersection of business operations and Nesto Cloud. Your closest partners will be Senior Salesforce Developers, who own the technical architecture, Apex and integrations, alongside stakeholders across sales, mortgage advisory, and operations.
Your job is to own the what and why. The developer owns the how. Together, you're the engine behind everything Salesforce at Nesto.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Own the platform. Shape the experience.
Salesforce Product Ownership
Own the Salesforce product roadmap from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
Translate requirements from sales, mortgage advisory, marketing, and operations into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria your developer can build from immediately.
Manage the backlog and sprint cycles in close partnership with our Senior Salesforce Developers and engineering teams.
Drive user adoption and change management: people should want to use the tools you build.
Define and track KPIs for each feature; use data to continuously improve the platform.
Stay ahead of Salesforce's annual releases, evaluating new capabilities.
Cross-Platform Flexibility
Flex to adjacent platforms: customer portals, partner tools, or other user-facing SaaS, applying the same product discipline regardless of the underlying stack.
Partner with UX and design to ensure a coherent experience across every user touchpoint.
Bring a platform-agnostic mindset: the goal is always the best outcome for users, not loyalty to any one tool.
Market & User Intelligence
Run competitive analysis and market research to keep our platform strategy sharp and ahead of the curve.
Gather and synthesize user feedback through interviews, surveys, and usage analytics to make evidence-based decisions.
Communicate clearly and with conviction to stakeholders at all levels: from ops leads to the executive team.
AI-Augmented Ways of Working
Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, etc.) to accelerate research, writing, analysis, and prototyping. Every day, not occasionally.
Model what high-leverage AI usage looks like and help your colleagues level up alongside you.
Evaluate Salesforce's native AI capabilities (Einstein, Agentforce) as part of your platform roadmap: know when to build vs. buy vs. enable.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
The profile.
Required
5-7+ years in product management, with at least 2 years directly owning a Salesforce environment.
Solid working knowledge of Salesforce's core clouds: Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud at minimum.
Enough platform fluency to hold a conversation with a Senior Salesforce Developer: you don't write Apex, but you deeply understand what it takes to build what you're asking for.
Strong analytical instincts: you use data to frame problems, prioritize features, and measure outcomes.
Excellent communicator who translates naturally between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Proven, active fluency with AI tools in your professional work.
Nice to have
Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Service Cloud Consultant.
Familiarity with Salesforce integration patterns.
Experience managing non-Salesforce platforms.
Background in fintech, mortgage, or lending.
Exposure to UX research methods and user journey mapping.
YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF
Be honest with yourself.
You've never directly owned a Salesforce roadmap. Being adjacent doesn't count: we need someone who has done this.
You can't hold a technical conversation with a senior developer. You don't build, but you need to understand what you're asking others to build.
You think AI tools are a trend to watch rather than a lever to pull. We expect active, productive usage, not awareness.
You need a fully defined problem to get started. The best people here create the structure, they don't wait for it.
You're looking for a slow, consensus-driven environment. Uncomfortable ambition is one of our values, and we mean it.

You’ll be joining the Servicing stream , the product area responsible for the post-funding mortgage journey. This includes borrower self-serve experiences, agent-facing servicing tools, payment and prepayment workflows, renewals, payouts, statements, fees, exceptions management, and core servicing operations.
This is a Senior Product Manager role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own a specific servicing substream. You’ll work closely with the stream lead to define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team’s needs, and the largest opportunities to improve the borrower and agent experience.
Your closest collaborators will include engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, servicing operations experts who manage these workflows every day, and internal stakeholders across compliance, finance, contact centre, and growth operations.

Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, and support teams to validate solutions and ensure they align with servicing best practices and industry standards.
Support backlog refinement by prioritizing servicing-related epics and stories, balancing borrower experience, agent efficiency, technical feasibility, and business value.
Participate in release planning, UAT, and launch readiness to ensure servicing use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
Conduct research on servicing trends, mortgage regulations, servicing technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights that inform product evolution.
Create and maintain clear documentation of servicing workflows, requirements, scenarios, decision logic, and system behaviours to support cross-functional teams.
Act as the go-to expert for your servicing workflows, supporting issue triage, answering questions, and helping the team deliver exceptional servicing experiences across lending products.

Move quickly to test hypotheses using the tools available. Build rough prototypes, pressure-test ideas, and use fast experiments to get to answers sooner.
Stay close to the work. The best people here do not hand things off and wait. They use every tool available to move the work forward.
Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage servicing and bring informed recommendations into the roadmap.
Share what you learn so your way of working improves the team around you.

Strong understanding of end-to-end servicing functions, including payments, prepayments, renewals, payouts, fees, statements, borrower communications, and exception handling.

Experience working with servicing platforms, loan management systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into clear product requirements.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, QA, and support teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate downstream impacts, identify edge cases, and improve complex servicing workflows.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex servicing concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.

Technical Solutions Architect
Join nesto — proudly named Canadian Rocketship 2025*. A Deloitte Fast 50 company evolving alongside Canada’s top tech innovators and disrupting a 2.1 Trillion-dollar mortgage industry at light speed by building the mortgage ecosystem of the future.
BUILD lending technology with the best developers, AI engineers, and mortgage experts in the country. Work on a modern tech stack and a development framework designed to unlock your full potential and accelerate your career.
Why join us
Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 years in a row
Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025*
Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 consecutive years
Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
Trusted technology: powering major financial institutions across Canada
An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients.
Who are you
Builders. Problem-solvers. Curious minds. People who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we’re stronger together.
If you trust your skills and want to build real technology that reshapes an entire industry, join us now.
About nesto and Nesto Cloud
Nesto is Canada’s leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing $73B+ CAD in residential and commercial mortgages, with 1,000+ team members across 12 offices nationwide. You will be working on Nesto Cloud, Canada’s most advanced cloud platform, delivering end-to-end technology solutions for lenders in the digital age.
Why we are hiring
We deliver on our mission by empowering our partners to improve and streamline their mortgage lending operations with the nesto Mortgage Cloud. As Canada's most advanced cloud-based mortgage technology, our SaaS solution offers a best-in-class omnichannel experience. This platform consistently drives volume, boosts productivity, and lowers technology costs. To ensure the successful execution of our upcoming projects, we are expanding our Solution Architecture team.
Work location and time zone
We welcome applications from candidates located anywhere in Canada. This is a fully remote opportunity, with the flexibility to work from home or from any of our offices (Montreal, Quebec, Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver, and others). Please note that the core working hours for this role are based on the Eastern Time Zone (EST).
What success in this role looks like
Success is defined by your ability to translate business requirements into clear, scalable solution blueprints for the nesto Mortgage Cloud. This includes proactively mitigating technical risks and advocating for modern architectural best practices like Microservices and Domain-Driven Design. Ultimately, you will succeed by collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners while ensuring all designs strictly adhere to established enterprise standards.
What you’ll be doing
Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, diagrams, and data models to drive the solution development.
Design an end-to-end solution blueprint for new products, platform enhancements, and integrations.
Evaluate and select tools, frameworks, cloud services, databases, and integration patterns for specific solution
Ensure all proposed solutions strictly adhere to established enterprise architecture standards and the overall technology strategy.
Communicate architectural designs and the trade-offs involved clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Manage risk by proactively identifying and mitigating potential technical risks and challenges within the design.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams, including Product Managers, Developers, and QA.
Engage with external partners and vendors for integration design.
Promote and advocate for modern architectural best practices, including Microservices, Domain-Driven Design, and Event-Driven Architecture.
Who we are looking for
8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a dedicated Solution or Software Architecture role.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and major cloud provider platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), with a preference for GCP.
Experience designing and implementing reliable Microservices architectures, including good practices for API design (like REST/GraphQL) and inter-service communication.
Strong hands-on experience and advocacy for domain-driven Design principles and event-driven architecture, including patterns like event sourcing and command query responsibility segregation.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical designs to both technical (developers, engineers) and non-technical (Product Managers, business leaders) audiences.
Committed to staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends, and continuous learning.
Strong understanding of software development methodologies and software development life cycle (SDLC).
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Preferred but not a must
Experience in start-up or scale-up environments.
Bilingualism in French and English.
You shouldn't apply if
You are not interested in a role that involves frequent client-facing work or high-level stakeholder negotiation.
You have no passion for the fintech or mortgage technology space and are unwilling to develop domain expertise.
Interview Process
Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
Discovery Call with the hiring manager – 30 minutes
Take-home Assignment / Case study followed by a Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
Final Non-Technical Interview with additional stakeholders – 60 minutes
Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer
The Reward
The A-Team: Work alongside high-performing talent in the industry.
Accelerated Growth: The slope of your learning curve here will be vertical. You will touch more production systems in one year than you would in five years at a bank.
Top-Tier Coverage: Premium benefits plan fully paid by nesto, including comprehensive insurance and unlimited access to telemedicine and mental health services for you and your family.
Rest & Recharge: 4 weeks of vacation to ensure you stay at peak performance.
Best-in-Class Tools: Access to the resources and tech you need to execute without friction.
Working framework: the environment that makes you productive and enables teamwork.
Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

greenhouse:okta:8157885.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 We are seeking a Director Product Manager, Okta Identity Threat Detection and Response Products , an individual contributor role, to drive the evolution of Okta’s cutting-edge identity security offerings. This position requires a strong technical foundation, keen product intuition, cybersecurity knowledge, and exceptional collaboration skills to shape the future of our strategic security products. You'll leverage significant cross-functional influence to execute key initiatives in this critical domain.

 Built upon the robust Okta Identity Cloud, our mission is to ensure Okta provides the most comprehensive, user-friendly, admin-friendly, and secure Identity Security product suite available. This team is responsible for products including Okta Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI , Okta ThreatInsight , and Okta Network Zones , among other vital security functionalities. Our customers depend on these solutions to safeguard their digital assets and ensure secure access for their users. This role is pivotal in ensuring that security is seamlessly integrated into every facet of our products.

 Success in this role demands a deep understanding of customer security requirements, a strong empathy for both end-user and administrator experiences, and the ability to strategically prioritize amidst competing demands from various Okta teams.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Roadmap and Vision 

- Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.

- Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.

- Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.

- Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

 Product Delivery and Execution 

- Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.

- Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.

- Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.

- Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.

- Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

 Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering 

- Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.

- Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.

- Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.

- Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.

- Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.

- Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

 Own the Product 

- Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.

- Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.

- Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.

- Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.

- Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

 Qualifications: 

 Required: 

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.

- Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.

- Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).

- Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.

- Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.

- Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.

- Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.

- Strong technical background that allows you to influence technical design and investment decisions, particularly in security architectures.

- Ability to produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous security inputs.

- Strong track record of influencing teams and operating effectively as a player-coach.

- Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences, especially when discussing complex security concepts.

- Strong leadership skills and executive presence.

- Passion for Okta’s immense opportunity and growth potential in the identity security market.

- 8+ years product management experience.

- Experience interviewing and selecting candidates.

- Mentoring early-in-career product managers.

 Preferred: 

- Advanced degree in a technical or business field.

- Deep knowledge of enterprise security products and services, including cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

- Extensive knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) and its intersection with security.

- Understanding of authentication, authorization, and threat detection standards.

- Experience with developing user flows and enabling customizable security experiences.

- Experience creating and managing multi-tenant SaaS security software products.

 The Role 

 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategic evolution of the Auth0 Platform Infrastructure. In this highly visible, high-impact leadership role, you will be the visionary force behind the core infrastructure, consumption models, and platform capabilities that power Auth0’s immense global scale.

 You will own the multi-year strategy for critical platform pillars, with a heavy emphasis on redefining our rate-limiting and platform consumption frameworks. As a Principal product leader, you will navigate multi-dimensional scaling challenges (including the paradigm shift of autonomous AI agents), influence executive stakeholders, and ensure our platform remains the most resilient, secure, and performant identity solution for the world’s largest enterprises.

 What You’ll Do 

- Drive the Long-Term Platform & Consumption Strategy: Define and own the multi-year roadmap for Auth0’s core infrastructure. Align deeply technical platform architecture with broader business objectives, Go-To-Market strategies, and overarching revenue goals.

- Spearhead the Strategic Evolution of Rate Limits & Monetization: Transform rate limits from a protective mechanism into a core business strategy. Pioneer dynamic consumption models, proactive policy-aware observability, and intelligent throttling strategies that align platform costs with customer value, reduce escalations, and unlock new SKUs.

- Architect Global Cloud Resilience & Scale: Champion overarching initiatives for cloud architecture, including Tierless private cloud transitions, Geo HA failover mechanisms, and service-only failovers to guarantee "four nines" reliability while optimizing infrastructure COGS.

- Define the Future of AI Agent Identity & MCP: Lead the industry-level infrastructure strategy for Model Context Protocol (MCP) enablement. Define the standards for how autonomous LLMs and AI agents securely authenticate, consume platform resources at scale, and invoke APIs without destabilizing core human-identity traffic.

- Lead Cross-Organizational Alignment: Serve as the strategic bridge between Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Go-To-Market leadership. Influence without authority across multiple domains, driving consensus among senior engineering leaders and C-level executives.

- Champion Compliance as a Market Differentiator: Ensure infrastructure strategies proactively anticipate stringent global security frameworks , turning security and compliance by design into a competitive advantage for enterprise sales.

 What You Bring 

- Experience: 8–10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3+ years operating at a Principal, Group, or Lead level. Extensive experience managing highly complex, high-scale infrastructure, platform, or deeply backend products at an enterprise SaaS company.

- Strategic Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and infrastructure monetization. Proven track record of turning technical constraints (like rate limits and data streaming) into customer-facing value and revenue drivers.

- AI & Next-Gen Tooling Vision: Forward-looking expertise in the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows, and securing high-velocity machine-to-machine (M2M) communications at a massive scale.

- Advanced Technical Fluency: Ability to spar with Principal Architects and Engineering Directors on complex topics such as serverless scaling, API gateways, deterministic vs. probabilistic rate-limiting algorithms, and high-availability (HA) database topologies.

- Business & Analytical Acumen: Strong data-driven approach to platform economics. Experience defining operational SLAs, managing infrastructure margins (COGS), and structuring pricing/packaging around platform consumption.

- Executive Leadership: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex architectural shifts into compelling business cases for the C-suite, while simultaneously providing crisp, actionable requirements to engineering.

 Bonus Points 
 Prior experience driving multi-million dollar infrastructure monetization strategies, deep expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), or leading the architectural shift from legacy cloud models to tierless/serverless architectures.

 Role Overview 

 As the Okta Research & Design (ORD) Jira Owner & Administrator , nested within the Technical Program Management (TPM) organization, you will define and execute the strategy for how ORD plans, tracks, and reports on engineering work within the full toolchain of Atlassian Jira, Jira Advanced Roadmaps (Plans), Confluence, Rovo, and AI integrations. In this role, you act as a critical bridge between product & technical leadership, agile teams, and cross-functional business units — translating methodology, best practices, and process frameworks into practical workflow improvements that accelerate delivery and reduce manual overhead for a 1,000+ person engineering, product, and design organization.

 By optimizing tooling configurations, automating reporting, and eliminating fragmented management processes, you will directly accelerate ORD’s developer velocity and strengthen operational efficiency.

 Core Responsibilities 

 1. Platform Ownership & Strategic Tooling Direction 

- Strategic Vision: Define, implement, govern an AI-led strategy for utilizing Jira for product planning, tracking, and reporting tooling that supports end-to-end portfolio tracking from high-level corporate objectives down to sprint-level stories.

- E2E Ecosystem Management: Complete ORD ownership of the  toolchain (Jira, Jira advanced Roadmaps, AI integrations, Confluence), overseeing architecture, schema updates, workflow management, screen/notification schemes, custom fields, permission sets, and AI integrations.

- Scale and Automation: Design a highly automated, self-service model that easily scales to accommodate organizational growth in user volume and environmental complexity.

- AI Tool Integration: Lead evaluation, piloting, and rollout of AI-powered tooling (e.g., Atlassian Rovo, Claude for Jira, AI Companion) to automate ticket triage, sprint planning suggestions, and status summarization.

 2. Engineering Process Optimization & Standardization 

- PDLC Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Security to align tool mechanics with the company's release cadences, secure SDLC requirements, and change control policies.

- Workflow Design: Standardize Jira workflows to track key engineering pillars uniformly (e.g., New Feature Development, Architecture Improvements, and Run-the-Business/KTLO operations).

- Eliminate Tool Fragmentation: Actively lead efforts to migrate teams away from disjointed standalone tracking sheets and custom scripts into Jira to create a single, synchronized source of truth.

 3. Data Governance & Analytics Enablement 

- Source of Truth Data: Ensure data integrity within Jira to allow executive leadership to accurately assess resource allocation, identify horizontal dependencies, map organizational priorities, and make informed business investment decisions.

- Metrics Reporting: Oversee configurations for integrated reporting engines (such as Faros.ai) to surface real-time visibility into engineering productivity metrics, cycle time, lead time, pipeline health, and bottleneck identification.

- Change Control & Risk Management: Serve as a core member of the Jira Change Control Board (CCB), assessing the risk levels (Low, Medium, High) of configuration requests to protect the functionality of critical engineering dashboards and tracking filters.

 4. Direct Support & Enablement Packages 

- User Enablement: Create intuitive, scalable enablement packages, documentation, and training guides to ensure seamless platform onboarding for new and existing Oktanauts.

- Ongoing Administration: Act as an independent administrator managing day-to-day configuration requests, custom JQL filtering, role/privilege assignments, and automation rules.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate deeply with internal customers—Developers, Scrum Masters, Engineering Managers, Design Leads, and Product Leads—to capture gaps and build creative process improvements.

 Qualifications & Profile 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Technology, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

- Atlassian Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience in Advanced Jira and Confluence Administration within an enterprise-scale engineering ecosystem (supporting 500+ users).

- Technical Languages: Essential proficiency with Jira Query Language (JQL), basic SQL, or equivalent database queries.

- AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Atlassian Rovo, GitHub Copilot) into product development workflows, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate, pilot, and scale AI capabilities across engineering teams.

- Agile Methodology: Thorough understanding of agile/lean development, Scrum frameworks, sprint execution ceremonies, and SAFe/Portfolio-level planning models.

- PDLC & SDLC Knowledge: Deep conceptual awareness of modern software engineering practices, release management trains, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure deployment models.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Advanced Tools: Deep experience leveraging Jira Service Management, Jira Advanced Roadmaps (Plans), and metrics platforms like Faros.ai.

greenhouse:okta:8214073.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The role

 Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. Okta Customer Identity (OCI) is the identity platform behind that promise for the applications our customers build for their own customers: the login, MFA, and account management layer for millions of end users across B2B, B2B2C and B2C products. OCI sits alongside Okta Workforce Identity (OWI) as one of the two halves of the Okta platform.

 We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to grow OCI's footprint inside our existing enterprise base and to incubate the next generation of platform capabilities. This is a builder's role. You'll spend a good chunk of your time in true zero-to-one territory: sizing a raw opportunity, proving it out with a design partner or two, and turning it into a capability that ships and gets adopted. You'll spend the rest of it as the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, and go-to-market, making sure those bets land in the field.

 What you will own

- New Capability Incubation: Own the pipeline of zero-to-one bets on the Okta’s Okta Customer Identity platform, from a rough problem statement through a validated design and a shipped v1. You'll decide what's worth building before anyone asks engineering to build it.

- Platform Growth: Drive the product side of Okta Customer Identity platform expansion into our existing enterprise base. You'll turn a hypothesis about why they haven't adopted the Okta Customer Identity platform into product changes that remove the reason.

- Cross-functional Delivery: Be the person engineering, design, research, and go-to-market call when a new Okta Customer Identity platform capability needs a decision. You'll write the specs, run the reviews, and keep a dozen loosely connected workstreams moving toward the same launch.

 A day in the life

 Your day splits between zero-to-one thinking and shipping discipline. You might start the morning studying churn or expansion data for a segment we don't serve well yet, trying to figure out whether the gap is a feature gap or a positioning gap. An hour later you're on a call with a design partner customer, walking through a rough prototype and taking notes on what confused them.

 By midday you're in execution mode: reviewing a spec with your engineering lead, debating whether a capability needs its own data model or can extend an existing one, and pushing back on scope that's grown past what the opportunity actually justifies. You write plainly. Your specs read like an explanation to a smart colleague, not a wish list.

 In the afternoon you sync with go-to-market and your PMM partner on how a capability in progress should be positioned once it ships, and you flag anything that changes the pitch. You close the day presenting to a customer or prospect, walking them through what's shipped and what's coming on the roadmap. 

 Responsibilities

- Identify, size, and validate new zero-to-one opportunities on the Okta Customer Identity platform, using customer conversations, usage data, and market signals rather than internal opinion alone.

- Define and execute a roadmap that balances new capability bets against platform reliability, security hardening, and performance

- Write clear, detailed specs and requirements that give engineering and design unambiguous direction, especially in areas with no existing playbook.

- Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing to turn a shipped capability into an adopted one, including understanding why customers who should adopt haven't.

- Track the CIAM market and competitive moves from Auth0, Microsoft, and Ping, and use that context to sharpen where the Okta Customer Identity platform should and shouldn't compete.

- Be the go-to expert for your area of the Okta Customer Identity platform roadmap in front of customers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

 Required

- 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or identity and access management, with at least one zero-to-one launch you can speak to end to end.

- A track record of building and executing a strategy that spans multiple teams, and delivering on it, not just presenting it.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a spec an engineer can build from and a one-pager an executive can act on, without changing the substance between the two.

- Strong analytical and decision-making skills. You can build a credible plan from incomplete or conflicting inputs, and explain the assumptions behind it.

- BS in Computer Science, Business, or an equivalent background, with the ability to hold your own in a design review with engineering and architecture.

 Preferred

- Experience with Customer Identity and Access Management 

- Experience partnering with sales or customer success on an attach or expansion motion, not just a net-new sales motion.

- Public speaking experience, ideally in front of customers or at industry events.

- MBA or equivalent graduate business degree.

 Top 3 qualities we are hiring for

- Zero-to-one conviction: You've taken a fuzzy opportunity from "should we even do this?" to a shipped, adopted capability, without a playbook telling you how. You know the difference between not validated yet and not going to work, and you don't confuse the two.

- Decisive action in the dark : You rarely have perfect data or complete requirements. You confidently make high-stakes calls using a mix of telemetry, customer anecdotes, and sharp product intuition. You explicitly name your assumptions, move fast, and revise them in public without ego when new information arrives.

- Unquestioned influence : You lead without relying on a reporting structure. You naturally align engineering, design, GTM, and the field behind your understanding of the customer. You are the definitive, credible voice of the product in CISO boardrooms and internal executive reviews.

 **You must attend in person orientation physically in the Toronto office on the first Tuesday of employment.
**You must go physically into the Toronto office 2 days a week.
