This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 As Senior Product Manager, Policies, you own product strategy and execution for Okta's authentication policy roadmap. The Policies team owns how Okta evaluates risk and context to decide when, how, and whether a user, machine, or agentic identity is allowed to authenticate and stay authenticated. This includes Application Sign-On Policy, Global Session Policy, Okta Account Management Policy (OAMP), and Device Signal Collection Policy as well as the underlying Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that power them.

 Policies is foundational to the entire Okta product portfolio as it's the decision layer that sits between every authentication event and the security experience a customer wants for their end users. Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional leadership, and agile execution — requiring someone who can both shape long-term direction and deliver with precision.

 We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer’s Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.

 The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.

 A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

 Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap, utilizing data-driven prioritization methods to maximize customer value and business impact. Manage inputs from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.

- Customer Experience: Drive customer research (surveys, interviews, data analysis) to identify top opportunities, optimize the end-to-end customer journey, and ensure product value realization.

- Experience Design: Partner with Product Design on prototypes, wireframes, and concepts, continuously improving the usability of both the UI and APIs for technical and business audiences.

- Agile Execution & Delivery: Maintain active, daily collaboration with engineering teams. Write clear user stories, scope work for sprints, and actively participate in Agile cadences. Proactively solve problems and manage ambiguity to ensure on-time delivery.

- Performance Optimization: Drive continuous data analysis and insights into customer adoption. Establish clear hypotheses and baselines for feature launches, then track progress toward strategic targets and drive continuous product iteration based on learnings.

- Commercial Growth & Value: Partner closely with Product Marketing to run targeted customer campaigns. These efforts will drive trial conversions, accelerate Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, boost retention, and increase high-value usage and adoption.

- Go-to-Market: Proactively monitor the competitive landscape to identify gaps and differentiators. Partner with Product Marketing and pre-sales engineering to refine product positioning, develop engaging customer value messaging, and craft supporting content (blogs, webinars).

- Field & Customer Engagement: Actively engage with the field organization (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers) to build deep knowledge of the voice of the customer. Drive customer conversations during pre-sales, renewals, and at key events to gather feedback and support adoption.

- AI-Powered Productivity: Drive efficiency and strategic insight by leveraging AI tools for high-value activities, including prototyping, synthesizing customer insights, accelerating competitive and market analysis, and rapidly generating high-quality product documentation.

 Required Qualifications 

- AI Agent Experience:  Significant product experience with AI Agent creation, orchestration and the use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for exposing context, tools, and resources to agents. Ability to use this experience to define how Auth0's should securely authenticate, authorize, and monitor non-human AI principals at runtime.

- Agentic Threat Remediation: You have a strong command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI, and can articulate how each attack class manifests in real-world agentic deployments. You bring direct experience identifying, triaging, and driving remediation of agentic threats, with particular depth in: prompt injection attacks, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection. 

- Product Management Experience:  5-8 years of experience in Product Management, whether from startup or high-growth company environments. 

- Education : An Undergraduate and/or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical field.

- General Security Industry Experience : Prior working experience in the security, fraud or compliance industries with foundational knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM/CIAM) concepts (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, MFA, RBAC) and/or familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to identity security (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).

- Communication : Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal, and written) and a highly collaborative approach, working with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.

- Enterprise Software : Demonstrated experience in delivery of global, enterprise software across all aspects of the product lifecycle.

- Results Driven : A clear history of being outcome-driven and achieving tangible business results through the successful delivery of products, features, or capabilities that you have owned.

- Problem Solving : Keen analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a proven capacity to formulate effective action plans even when faced with incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

- Entrepreneurial : Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong intellectual curiosity that drives you to learn and delve deeply into both business and technical aspects of this role.

- Agile Development : Deep experience working successfully with engineering teams in an Agile development environment, including scoping, sprint planning, and backlog management and prioritization.

greenhouse:okta:8247721.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Role Overview 

 AI is rapidly changing how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, deployed, and operated — and the industry playbook is being rewritten monthly. Okta's Developer Productivity and AI Enablement Engineering teams own building and operating the capabilities that make our engineers fast across the inner and outer development loops. This role is the product counterpart, embedded full-time with that organization, that makes those investments compound by uncovering and prioritizing frictions, bringing the outside in, driving standardize-vs-federate decisions, spreading what works across teams, funding and clearing the path for the best tools, and proving the value.

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to own developer productivity as a product across Okta's development lifecycle — AI-native and traditional tooling alike. You will start bottom-up: interviewing engineers, managers, tech leads, and architects; mapping current inner- and outer-loop tooling and the frictions; and baselining dev-cycle metrics. From there, you will own the roadmap with engineering leadership; benchmark how the best engineering organizations build with AI; define tooling requirements and/or run the tooling evaluations engineering needs in a landscape that changes monthly; find the teams inside Okta getting outsized results and turn their patterns into playbooks; lead build, buy, integrate, and standardize decisions, including the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0; clear the security, legal, procurement, and budget paths that slow adoption; and own the measurement that connects investment to engineering outcomes — evidence engineering leaders can take into any room.

 This is a highly technical internal platform role that creates value for Okta through a cross-team, cross-industry, cross-functional layer that turns individual wins into organizational capability.

 What You'll Do 

- Product Strategy & Discovery: Own the vision, PRDs, and prioritized backlog for Okta's internal developer productivity and AI tooling. Treat engineers as your customers: start with deep, bottom-up discovery (dozens of engineer, EM, tech lead, and architect interviews), baseline dev-cycle metrics, and secure tooling budgets with rigorous, ROI-driven business cases.

- Ecosystem Validation (Build vs. Buy): Drive definitive "adopt, build, or pass" decisions. Run hands-on, structured evaluations of inner- and outer-loop tooling — from coding agents and MCPs to build, CI/CD, and code review systems — against strict security and TCO criteria to ensure internal investments amplify vendor capabilities.

- Hands-On Execution: Embed full-time with Developer Productivity Engineering and own the roadmap jointly with its engineering leads. Define MVP scopes, manage sprints, and incrementally ship workflows. You own the strategy and requirements (the what and why); Engineering owns the technical execution (the how).

- Adoption & Outcomes: Own org-wide adoption, clearing security, legal, and privacy hurdles along the way. Measure success by connecting tool usage directly to hard engineering outcomes (cycle time, quality, toil reduction).

- Standardization & Lighthouses: Coordinate the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0 engineering. Study high-performing teams to see who is getting exceptional results, and convert those patterns into scalable playbooks that shift the broader org from passive AI use to agentic workflows.

 What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience with developer platforms, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI products.

- Experience owning internal or platform products where users have alternatives — adoption driven through product quality rather than mandate.

- Strong understanding of modern software development workflows — source control, IDEs, CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, production operations — across the inner and outer loops of development.

- Hands-on, current fluency with AI-assisted software development — coding agents, context management, MCP, evaluation frameworks — and informed views on where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk.

- Demonstrated ability to design and run technology evaluations and controlled experiments, and to define measurement systems for developer productivity with judgment about their failure modes.

- Ability to engage credibly in technical and architectural discussions with senior engineers while maintaining clear boundaries between product outcomes and engineering implementation.

- Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, security, architecture, and finance without direct authority.

- Excellent written communication in a docs-first culture; you can produce solid action plans from incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience deploying or scaling developer tools across a large, multi-org engineering organization — including consolidating divergent stacks and the change management that comes with it.

- Hands-on familiarity with developer AI tools, harnesses, APIs, MCPs, and agent orchestration frameworks.

- Familiarity with developer productivity research (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and its failure modes.

- Experience establishing governance, evaluation frameworks, or spend management for rapidly evolving, consumption-priced technologies.

 Why This Role Matters 

 AI-assisted development is becoming both one of the largest levers on engineering velocity and one of the largest new variable costs in R&D. The playbook changes monthly, and the organizations that win are the ones that learn fastest from the outside, spread what works internally, and measure honestly. That learning-and-leverage layer doesn't build itself — engineering teams optimizing locally, however well, still leave organizational value uncaptured and accumulate divergent implementations that slow everyone down.

 This role exists to capture it: dedicated product leadership that brings engineering the external intelligence, funded tooling, cleared paths, shared patterns, and defensible evidence to build with AI faster than any single team could alone — while deepening Okta's firsthand credibility as the company that secures the AI-powered enterprise for its customers.

**Must attend in person orientation in person the first Tuesday of employment. If you are in Toronto, orientation is in Toronto. If you are in Dublin, orientation is in Dublin. 
**Must go into the local office 2 days a week.
**Must work North American hours.

 Qualifications:

- Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to clearly communicate with senior management, program stakeholders, and business unit leaders on launch activities and potential risks

- Strong leadership, interpersonal, and team skills to lead staff, colleagues, and cross-functional teams

- Strong organizational and project management skills with an ability to create, execute, and adjust plans as needed

- Experience working with go-to-market teams

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

 Staff Product Marketing Manager, Okta Device Access

 We are seeking a Staff Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for Okta Device Access . This role will own positioning, messaging, launches, field enablement, and lifecycle adoption for a strategic product portfolio at the intersection of identity, endpoint experiences, and security.

 Okta Device Access extends identity security to the first moment of the workday: signing in to a computer. It helps organizations strengthen device-login security, simplify onboarding and account experiences, and enable seamless, secure access from device sign-in to the applications employees need. The portfolio supports Windows and macOS environments and complements customers’ existing endpoint-management investments. 

 The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically credible product marketer who can translate sophisticated identity and platform capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated market narratives, and scalable commercial programs. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital Growth, and Pricing to bring new capabilities to market and drive durable customer adoption.

 Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end go-to-market and lifecycle marketing strategy for Okta Device Access, including positioning, messaging, launches, field readiness, customer adoption, and expansion.

- Develop a differentiated narrative for securing device sign-in and enabling seamless, passwordless, phishing-resistant access from device to applications.

- Translate complex identity, authentication, device-security, and operating-system integration capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, use cases, and practical field plays.

- Lead cross-functional launch planning and execution, including launch strategy, sales and partner enablement, customer communications, web and content strategy, internal readiness, and post-launch measurement.

- Build and execute adoption programs that help customers advance phishing-resistant access and FastPass adoption, while identifying and addressing deployment and activation friction. FastPass is Okta’s phishing-resistant, passwordless authenticator for secure access to devices and applications 

- Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insight into product and GTM decisions, shape roadmap communications, and ensure commercialization and packaging changes are customer- and field-ready.

- Enable Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and partners with the messaging, tools, and programs needed to articulate value and drive successful deployments.

- Help shape a cohesive device-access story that can extend to adjacent workforce and frontline-worker needs as the portfolio evolves.

- Define and report on success metrics across adoption, activation, field readiness, pipeline influence, launch performance, and customer outcomes.

 Qualifications

- 8+ years of B2B enterprise product marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity, identity, endpoint management, enterprise software, or a related technical category.

- Demonstrated experience owning GTM strategy for complex technical products—from positioning and launches through field enablement and sustained customer adoption.

- Ability to communicate credibly with security, identity, IT, and endpoint-management audiences.

- Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to make sophisticated technology accessible, differentiated, and commercially compelling.

- Proven cross-functional leadership with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital, Pricing, and partner teams.

- Strong analytical orientation, with experience using customer insight and performance data to shape strategy and improve adoption.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Preferred qualifications

- Experience in identity and access management, authentication, passwordless or phishing-resistant access, endpoint security, device posture, zero trust, MDM/UEM, or device-aware access.

- Experience marketing Windows and/or macOS enterprise capabilities.

- Experience building adoption motions for products where deployment, admin workflows, and end-user change management are meaningful parts of the customer journey.

- Experience marketing products that integrate with broader endpoint-management or security ecosystems.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Staff Product Marketing Manager, Access Management and Security 

 Identity is how organizations unlock AI safely. At Okta, we build the trusted, neutral infrastructure that lets every enterprise embrace this new era with confidence. This is career-defining work for builders and owners who move with urgency and execute with excellence.

 Reporting to the Senior Manager of Product Marketing, you will be the product marketer for the secure-access layer that makes Okta indispensable to the largest enterprises in the world. Your charter is to elevate identity from a sign-in utility to the control plane for security in the AI era. You will do tis by pairing deep technical credibility with executive-grade storytelling across strategy, content, and field execution.

 The ideal candidate will be a unique blend of technologist and business strategist—someone who can dive deep into technical architecture while crafting portfolio-level value propositions that resonate with both CISOs and practitioners. Beyond strategy and content, you must be a self-motivated, execution-oriented individual who stays focused on delivering outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

 What you’ll be doing 

 Strategic GTM for core and hybrid access 

 Build and execute the go-to-market strategy for Okta's foundational access services — including secure access to hybrid and on-premises business-critical applications — positioning them as an essential pillar of Zero Trust and AI security.

 Define the market narrative, ideal customer profile, and competitive positioning that drive Global 2000 expansion, a top company priority.

 AI-forward product and content leadership 

- Collaborate to define and advance Okta's point of view on securing human, machine, and AI-agent identities, and publish thought leadership that shapes the category.

- Use AI tooling across your own workflow, including  research, competitive analysis, content generation, and field enablemen, to produce higher-quality assets in a fraction of the time. This is an expectation of the role, not a nice-to-have.

 Technical Evangelism that closes deals  

- Collaborate and drive, along with Technical Marketing, to build demos, reference architectures, and proof kits that stand up to practitioner scrutiny and shorten security evaluations.

-  Act as a spokesperson with CISOs, architects, and analysts, translating deep technical capability into strategic business outcomes.: 

 Cross-functional revenue activation 

- Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to launch offers

- Equip the field with talk tracks and ROI models, and lead deal-acceleration plays on the largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities.

 What you’ll bring to the role 

- Domain Expertise: 8+ years of experience as a product marketer or product manager in cybersecurity or identity management (IAM, AD, or Entra ID). You know who the players are, where the gaps lie, and how to win.

- Hands-on Technical Proficiency: A technologist at heart. You must have a track record of supporting technical evaluations, and you must be comfortable configuring and demoing the product to technical buyers.

- Execution-Oriented Storytelling: Proven ability to take "under-the-hood" technology and turn it into an emotional and urgent business story. You know how to rise above the noise and create a sense of urgency.

- Fluency in the security implications of AI, and a track record of using AI tooling to raise your own throughput.

- Experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving complex programs to deadline.

 Extra Credit if you have: 

- CS Degree or a strong technical background in systems architecture or engineering.

- Deep experience with modern identity protocols and securing hybrid environments (Cloud and On-Premises).

- Experience in the AI space, specifically regarding the security implications of LLMs and agentic workflows.

phenom:OMEOMECA:JR-8328.description:
Choose a workplace that empowers your impact.  
 Join a global workplace where employees thrive. One that embraces diversity of thought, expertise and experience. A place where you can personalize your employee journey to be — and deliver — your best.  

 We are a purpose-driven, dynamic and sustainable pension plan. An industry leading global investor with teams in Toronto to London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and other major cities across North America and Europe. We embody the values of our 665,000 members, placing their best interests at the heart of everything we do.

 Join us to accelerate your growth & development, prioritize wellness, build connections, and support the communities where we live and work.

 Don’t just work anywhere — come build tomorrow together with us.

 Know someone at OMERS or Oxford Properties? Great! If you're referred, have them submit your name through Workday first. Then, watch for a unique link in your email to apply.

 This Full Time role sits within the Program Management & Delivery team supporting Platform Engineering, AI and Advanced Analytics. In this role, you will help deliver the products, platforms, and strategic initiatives that enable OMERS Investments to analyze investment opportunities, make investment decisions, and optimize portfolio outcomes.

 You will partner with Data & Technology (D&T) Customer Success & Innovation (CSI), investment teams across Capital Markets, Infrastructure, Private Equity, Growth Equity, and Ventures, as well as Finance, Risk & Compliance and other business stakeholders to support demand intake, portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and delivery execution. This position is important because it helps ensure strategic initiatives are aligned, governed, and delivered effectively while enabling strong stakeholder engagement and execution across the enterprise.

 You will be responsible for: 

- Partner with D&T Customer Success & Innovation (CSI), business stakeholders, Program Managers, Project Managers, and other partners to support demand intake, roadmap alignment, prioritization, and business alignment.

- Manage an assigned portfolio of initiatives and workstreams on a day-to-day basis, ensuring priorities are clearly defined, coordinated, and positioned for successful delivery.

- Translate business demand into governed priorities, practical delivery pathways, and clear execution plans.

- Champion clear and consistent communication to ensure stakeholders are informed, engaged, and supported throughout the lifecycle of initiatives.

- Build strong working relationships across business, technology, and delivery teams to align priorities, timelines, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

- Identify, track, and communicate risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions to stakeholders and team members as appropriate.

- Guide and support teams through planning, prioritization, decision-making, and blocker resolution in a collaborative and timely manner.

- Work with cross-functional teams to determine tasks, milestones, resources, and planned and actual dates.

- Support and facilitate Agile and hybrid delivery ceremonies, including planning, prioritization, progress tracking, and blocker resolution.

- Apply workflow management techniques including Kanban, Scrum, and hybrid approaches using Azure DevOps and related delivery tools.

- Help teams and stakeholders maintain clear, concise, and actionable backlog items and delivery artefacts.

- Assist leadership in preparing portfolio updates, governance materials, executive communications, management reporting, and steering committee content.

- Support resource planning, delivery capacity management, sequencing, prioritization, and execution readiness across initiatives.

- Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance portfolio visibility, stakeholder coordination, delivery effectiveness, and operational excellence.

 Required Skills & Experience 

- 5-8+ years of experience in program management, project management, portfolio coordination, or technology delivery leadership.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and competing demands in a complex environment.

- Strong knowledge of project and delivery methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery approaches.

- Proven experience planning, monitoring, governing, and reporting delivery status across projects, programs, or portfolios.

- Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

- Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities while maintaining focus on outcomes and delivery objectives.

- Experience supporting prioritization, roadmap planning, governance processes, and business demand management.

- Strong working knowledge of Agile concepts, delivery practices, and workflow management tools such as Azure DevOps.

- Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information systems, computer science, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

- Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence, coordinate, and drive alignment across business and technology teams.

 Preferred Skills & Experience 

- PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.

- Scrum Master certification or Agile delivery certification.

- Financial services or investment industry experience.

- Experience supporting Capital Markets, Private Markets, Infrastructure, Private Equity, Growth Equity, or related investment teams.

- Familiarity with enterprise architecture, technology governance, and portfolio management frameworks.

- Experience working within a large, complex enterprise environment.

- Knowledge of investment management processes, platforms, and operating models.

- Working toward or holding a CFA designation is considered an asset.

- Experience supporting data, analytics, AI, platform engineering, or enterprise technology initiatives.

- Demonstrated passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and delivery optimization.

 We believe that time together in the office is important for OMERS and Oxford, the strength of our employees, and the work we do for our pension members. In delivering on our pension promise and keeping us connected to our work and each other, our flexible hybrid work guideline requires teams to come into the office 4 days per week . 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.  
The expected salary range for this position is $103,000.00 - $157,000.00 per year.  
 You may also be eligible to receive an annual Incentive Award pursuant to our Short-term Incentive plan and our Long-Term Incentive plan (if applicable), and to participate in our group benefits and retirement plans – details on these elements of compensation are included within OMERS & Oxford offer letters.

 As one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension plans, our people-first culture is at its best when our workforce reflects the communities where we live and work — and the members we proudly serve. 

 From hire to retire, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process that extends all the way through your employee experience. This sense of belonging and connection is cultivated up, down and across our global organization thanks to our vast network of Employee Resource Groups with executive leader sponsorship, our Purpose@Work committee and employee recognition programs. 

 Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support certain stages of the OMERS recruitment process. While AI assists us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain central to our candidate experience.

phenom:OPJOPEUS:53591.description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY 
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

 AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

 Client Success, Senior Program Manager 
 Waterloo, ON, CAN 
 Job Description 
 The Opportunity: 

 The OpenText Client Success Services (CSS) team is responsible for the delivery of Strategic Success Management throughout the Clients’ cloud journey from post-sales to value realization. Our team of experts help organizations build success plans that create value, improve business outcomes, and proactively impact the lifetime value of their OpenText solution. 

 Role Overview: 
 As a Sr. Client Success Program Manager , you will work directly for the Sr Director, Client Success Services and play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing Client Success programs that drive Client adoption, value realization, retention, and growth across OpenText's Cloud portfolio.  
 In this role, you will be Client-obsessed and support Clients directly as required to ensure program success and are accountable to continue to iterate and innovate the services based on Client feedback and operational metrics.  The Sr Program Manager, you will combine the disciplines of Client Success Management, CS Operations, Project/Program Management, and AI serving as a key contributor to the evolution and scalability of the Client Success organization. 
 You will partner with Client Success leaders, Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Support, Renewals, and Operations teams to define scalable Client engagement strategies, improve operational effectiveness, and deliver measurable business outcomes. 

 Skills and Qualifications 
 Required Experience
• 8+ years of experience in Program Management, Customer Success, Customer Experience, SaaS Operations, or related disciplines within a B2B software or cloud environment.
• 5+ years leading complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
• Demonstrated experience designing and scaling Customer Success programs across onboarding, adoption, value realization, retention, renewals, and expansion.
• Experience partnering with executive stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Support, Renewals, Finance, and Operations.

Program Management & Leadership Skills
• Expert knowledge of program management methodologies, governance models, risk management, prioritization frameworks, and change management practices.
• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment without direct authority.

Customer Success & Client Lifecycle Expertise
• Deep understanding of Customer Success operating models, customer journeys, success plans, adoption frameworks, and value realization methodologies.
• Experience defining customer health frameworks, risk indicators, and expansion opportunity programs.

Data, Analytics & Operational Excellence
• Strong understanding of customer success metrics including NRR, retention, adoption, customer health, renewal rates, and expansion performance.
• Advanced ability to develop executive dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.

Technology & AI Competencies
• Experience with Gainsight, Salesforce, Dynamics, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
• Experience evaluating and implementing AI-enabled solutions that improve customer experiences and operational efficiency.

Education & Certifications
• Bachelor's degree required. MBA preferred.
• PMP, Agile, Scrum, Prosci, or Customer Success certifications are strong assets.

Success Profile
The ideal candidate is a strategic, customer-obsessed leader who combines deep Customer Success expertise with strong program management discipline, operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and executive influence. 

 Why This Role Matters: 
 The Sr. Client Success Program Manager plays a critical role in enabling OpenText to scale Client Success efficiently by: 

- 
- Developing repeatable and measurable Client success programs 

- Driving operational excellence through process optimization and automation 

- Improving Client adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes 

- Enhancing visibility through Client health and business insights 

- Thought leadership and aligning Client journey strategies across product, marketing, sales, and Client success teams 

- Enabling Client Success teams to focus on high-value Client interactions 

 Client Success Strategy & Program Management 

- 
- Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Client Success programs across the Client lifecycle 

- Develop scalable frameworks supporting onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion 

- Establish program objectives, success criteria, governance models, and measurement plans 

- Drive strategic initiatives that improve Client outcomes and organizational effectiveness 

- Manage multiple cross-functional programs simultaneously while ensuring alignment with corporate objectives 

 Cross-Functional Leadership 

- 
- Serve as a strategic partner to Client Success, Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Support, Renewals, and Finance

This standardized services catalogue of fixed-scope packages, deployment accelerators, and upgrade and migration paths, spans the entire customer lifecycle, from initial deployment, through functional extensions, upgrades, and cloud transformation journeys. This role will be responsible for defining the value proposition, delivery model, and commercialization framework for their offers, bridging Product Management, Sales, Presales, Delivery, and GTM teams. As customers accelerate the transition from traditional on-premises licenses to modern cloud subscriptions, they will translate OpenText’s enterprise solutions into repeatable, high-value packaged services that drive rapid time-to-value and make it easier to position our value.

 Offer Strategy & Design

 Customer & Market Insight

- Continuously refining offers based on market trends, customer feedback, and adoption metrics.

workday:paypal/jobs:R0137910.description:
The Company 

 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

 We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

 Job Summary: 
This job focuses on leveraging data to derive insights that align with the product’s shared vision and customer needs. Overview of the Role We’re on a mission to modernize insurance - making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a product leader to help us build the future of insurance in Canada - and beyond. We are now seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Accounts & Automation team within our product organization. This role will own several areas of scope, including: Defining the strategy and roadmap to make us the go-to provider for all of our customers’ personal insurance needs, including the platform-wide programs and features that drive multi-product adoption Building trust digitally across the products we offer, so customers feel similar levels of confidence and reassurance as they would get when they speak with one our licensed advisors Evolving our accounts product and internal tools to streamline operations and deliver a seamless customer experience end to end. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role that blends product vision, analytical thinking, structured execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will be responsible for shaping long-term product direction while also driving day-to-day execution across multiple complex initiatives. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will work closely with leaders across Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, Customer Success, and Data to build products that create exceptional customer outcomes and drive meaningful business impact. What you'll be doing:

Define & Own the Product Vision

  • Evolve our product strategy to improve customer delight, retention, referral growth, operational efficiency, and cross-product adoption.
  • Develop a compelling long-term vision for how to make insurance simple for Canadians, from how customers discover new products of ours to how they manage it post-sale.
  • Build and champion a roadmap that balances innovation, operational excellence, and long-term scalability.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer and operational pain points, using those insights to shape strategy and prioritization.
  • Establish clear OKRs and success metrics that align teams around measurable business and customer outcomes.

    • Solve Ambiguous Problems

  • Take open-ended, unstructured problems and break them down into clear opportunities, strategic priorities, and executable plans.
  • Bring creative, first-principles thinking to solve complex challenges that have not been solved before in the Canadian insurance market.
  • Balance customer needs, technical constraints, operational realities, and business priorities when making product decisions.
  • Lead through ambiguity and create clarity for teams and stakeholders across the organization.

    • Drive End-to-end Execution and Delivery

  • Lead the product team through the full product lifecycle: problem definition, discovery, solution design, scoping, execution, launch, and iteration.
  • While you’ll shape the strategic direction, you’re also highly execution-oriented and willing to dive into the details when needed.
  • Ensure we build the right things, the right way, at the right time by balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Design and Engineering to build best-in-class customer and internal product experiences.
  • Write clear, actionable product specifications that connect business goals, customer needs, operational requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Coordinate closely with Growth, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure launches are operationally ready and well-supported.
  • Drive alignment across teams and act as the connective tissue between stakeholders with competing priorities.

    • Measurement, Experimentation and Iteration

  • Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for all major initiatives, including customer engagement, funnel conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and long-term customer value.
  • Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, de-risk larger investments, and accelerate learning.
  • Partner closely with Data to build dashboards, analyze product performance, and translate insights into actionable next steps - including when to pivot, double down, or sunset initiatives.
  • Use data, customer insights, and business context to continuously refine strategy and prioritization.
    • What we are looking for:
  • 8+ years of product management experience, including experience owning and scaling customer-facing digital products in high-growth environments.
  • Strong track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.
  • Experience building both customer-facing D2C products and operational/internal tooling products.
  • Experience building prototypes with AI.
  • Experience scaling products and product practices within high-growth startups or fast-moving technology organizations.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision that aligns teams and stakeholders around long-term outcomes.
  • Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of how product decisions impact revenue, operations, customer success, retention, and compliance.
  • Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.
  • Strong operational discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain momentum, and consistently close loops with stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and a transparent leadership style.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills - able to tailor messaging effectively across executives, engineers, designers, marketers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable leading initiatives with many moving parts and driving alignment across multiple teams.
  • Strong sense of prioritization and ability to define MVP scope while balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with comfort working with product data, defining metrics, building measurement frameworks, and conducting analyses to inform decisions.
    • Why join us:
  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance

Director, Product Marketing



Location:
USA (100% Remote)
Canada (100% Remote)



Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend.
We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend.

Product marketing sits at the center of how we're understood in that market, and we're hiring a Director to lead it.




ABOUT THE ROLE



Procurify is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to define how we compete and win. You'll own the company narrative, the messaging architecture our go-to-market organization builds on, how we segment and prioritize the market, and the analyst relationships that influence how Procurify is understood.



This is a chance to help define Procurify's next stage of growth as the agentic procurement platform. You'll be at the center of translating that strategy into positioning, messaging, assets, and programs that drive demonstrable impact across our go-to-market organization.



This is a senior seat on the marketing leadership team, with full visibility across the company and regular engagement with executives. You'll lead two Product Marketing Managers. You'll raise their craft, sharpen their judgment, and expand what they're capable of owning, building both the team's impact and their careers as leaders in their own right.



This is a true player-coach role. Your PMMs own their product portfolios, and you'll guide their strategy and raise the quality of their work while directly owning company-level and cross-portfolio initiatives yourself. It's hands-on by design: you get the scope and influence of a senior leader while staying close to the craft.



AI fluency is table stakes for this role. We expect AI to be foundational to how you analyze information, build workflows, create and evaluate work, and scale the team's impact without compromising quality.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




POSITIONING AND MARKET STRATEGY

 - Own Procurify's positioning strategy and define how we differentiate in the procurement market.

 - Build and maintain the company-level narrative and messaging architecture as the single source of truth across all surfaces, and translate it into positioning teams can execute against.

 - Own the AI and agentic narrative: make the platform's intelligence concrete, credible, and differentiated for finance and operations buyers.

 - Own market segmentation and use it to direct where we invest and who we talk to.

 - Own the voice of the customer with deep customer research and win/loss analysis.

 - Use product, customer, funnel, and market data to identify patterns, test assumptions, and turn evidence into clear strategic recommendations.

 - Shape Procurify's analyst relations strategy and narrative, building credible relationships with top-tier analyst firms and influencing how the company and category are represented.

 - Act as a credible external voice on procurement and the agentic shift through analyst briefings, press, and webinars.


GO-TO-MARKET

 - Set the execution standard and quality bar for the function, along with the operating rhythms that keep it consistent.

 - Own launch strategy across the portfolio and decide which messages and formats get tested in the market, in partnership with demand generation.

 - Own the strategy for direct-to-customer communications: launch and product-news emails, in-app posts, in-app tours, and lifecycle journeys.

 - Report and analyze product marketing's contribution to pipeline, adoption, and retention.


AI-FIRST PRACTICE

 - Build an AI-enabled Product Marketing practice that improves the quality, consistency, and scale of the function.

 - Establish shared tools, context, and repeatable workflows across core PMM work, and partner with Marketing’s AI specialists to make Product Marketing a model for effective AI-assisted work.


INTERNAL ALIGNMENT AND ENABLEMENT

 - Influence the roadmap, pricing, packaging, and launch sequencing with market, customer, and competitive insight.

 - Own the enablement deliverable set for each product portfolio with your PMMs, including positioning one-pagers, battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, and objection handling, maintained as living resources in our library rather than launch-day artifacts.

 - Train Sales and Customer Success on messaging, use cases, and differentiation.

 - Set the standard for how competitive intelligence gets gathered and used by go-to-market teams.


TEAM LEADERSHIP AND COACHING

 - Coach two Product Marketing Managers: raise their craft, give direct feedback, hold a high bar on the work, and map a clear path to their next level.

 - Own the team's structure, culture, and operations: the processes, templates, and shared standards that keep output consistent across portfolios, whoever is doing the work.

 - Own the team's plan: what it takes on each quarter, what it defers, and how portfolio coverage is split across the two PMMs.
   
   


EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant Product Marketing leadership experience and direct people management.

 - You’ve owned company-level positioning and messaging for a multi-product or complex SaaS platform, including a meaningful repositioning, category shift, or evolution in market narrative.

 - You’ve led go-to-market strategy across a product portfolio, from segmentation and launch strategy through sales enablement, customer communications, and market adoption.

 - You know how to turn customer, competitive, win/loss, and market insight into decisions on positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and where the business invests.

 - You’ve built credibility with senior executives, Sales, Product, Customer Success, customers, and industry analysts, and can influence decisions without relying on organizational authority.

 - You’ve built and coached a high-performing Product Marketing team, raised the quality bar for the function, and helped marketers meaningfully grow their craft and careers.

 - You’re commercially minded and comfortable measuring Product Marketing against business outcomes, including pipeline, adoption, retention, and competitive performance.

 - You’re AI-fluent in practice, not theory. You’ve changed how a team works using AI, built repeatable workflows around it, and can point to meaningful improvements in the quality or scale of the work.

 - You are an exceptional writer and storyteller who still does the work yourself. You can turn a complex platform into differentiated, credible language that a CFO can understand and repeat.

 - You maintain an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensure it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect your role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
   
   


WHY PROCURIFY?




WE’RE BUILDING A PRODUCT THAT MATTERS.

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.



With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.



The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.



If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.




BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:



 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

 - Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Continuous learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

   - Canada: $168,000–$210,000 CAD
   
   - United States: $140,000–$160,000 USD
     
     
     Plus a generous CIP.
     
     (The base pay range for this role depends on location and depth of experience, and doesn't include incentive bonuses, benefits, or equity that form part of your total compensation package.)
     
     


LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.



If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. SOLUTIONS CONSULTANT

Location: Remote (Canada or U.S.)

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement.

We're hiring an experienced Solutions Consultant to be the technical and domain authority on our sales team. This is the person who can walk into a room with a VP of Finance or a Controller, diagnose their procurement and AP pain points in minutes, and show (not just tell) why Procurify is the better platform. The role partners closely with our CRO, VP of Sales, and Executive Leadership Team to help shape how we win competitive deals.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not an entry-level pre-sales seat. We're looking for someone who has already sold or consulted against the players in our space or similar procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation providers. You'll know how to position a challenger platform to win, and you'll own the technical and domain narrative across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in the mid-market and lower-enterprise segment, partnering closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing.

This role sits at the intersection of deep domain expertise, competitive strategy, and consultative selling. Success looks like shorter sales cycles, higher win rates against named competitors, and a Sales org that is measurably sharper because of the enablement and positioning you bring.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



DOMAIN & COMPETITIVE EXPERTISE

 - Serve as the subject-matter expert on Procurify's platform and on the broader procure-to-pay, spend management, and AP automation landscape.

 - Maintain current, detailed knowledge of key competitors and translate that intelligence into sharp, defensible competitive positioning for Sales and Marketing.

 - Codify win/loss themes, battlecards, and objection-handling assets so the whole Sales team benefits from what you learn in the field.

 - Partner with Product Management to relay competitive gaps, market feedback, and integration needs, and help prioritize what gets built next.


DISCOVERY & DEMO EXCELLENCE

 - Lead structured, consultative discovery to uncover a prospect's procurement and AP workflows, technical environment, and business drivers.

 - Design and deliver compelling, story-driven demos that connect Procurify's capabilities to the prospect's stated business case.

 - Build and maintain a reusable library of demo environments, vertical-specific narratives, and proof points that scale across the team.

 - Conduct technical scoping for both out-of-the-box integrations and custom API integrations to client ERP and accounting systems (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks).


SALES CYCLE & DEAL SUPPORT

 - Partner with Account Executives through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, acting as the technical and strategic co-pilot on every deal that needs one.

 - Own RFP/RFI responses, security and IT questionnaires, and solution documentation that build prospect confidence and speed up procurement decisions.

 - Present to and influence economic buyers and executive stakeholders, including CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance and Procurement, translating technical capability into strategic, financial value.

 - Qualify potential customers while understanding and solving their complex workflow and approval-routing questions.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT & ENABLEMENT

 - Help ramp new Sales hires on demo delivery, discovery technique, and competitive positioning.

 - Get new clients set up for success by enhancing their understanding of the platform and services ahead of handoff to Customer Success.

 - Contribute market, competitive, and win/loss perspective to Procurify's Product Team

 - Other related duties as assigned.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales Consultant role in B2B SaaS, with strong preference for candidates coming from a procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation provider 

 - Deep, hands-on domain knowledge of procurement and accounts payable workflows, purchase-to-pay cycles, approval routing, and financial controls.

 - A consultative, curious, quick-thinking approach: diagnose the business problem first, then map the technical solution.

 - Experience owning technical workstreams within full sales cycles, including RFPs, security reviews, technical scoping, and executive-level presentations.

 - Comfort with ERP and accounting system integrations and API concepts; able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to influence a room of executive stakeholders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?



HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

 

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

 

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.



BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

We've created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 - Flexible working: We're a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada or the US!

 - Responsible time off: We trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team's health and well-being with a competitive health, vision, and dental package, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Community initiatives: A strong commitment to giving back, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

 - On Target Earnings Range:  $100,000-110,000 CAD OTE & $105,000-115,000 USD OTE (Range is dependent on experience, with a component of these earnings made up of variable pay, and not inclusive of any benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)


WORK WITH AN AMAZING TEAM

We've welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we're here to embrace them!



LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

 

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

 

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.

 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead planning, development, execution, and delivery of software, emulation, and silicon validation for Networking Products within the Datacenter BU. You will develop, define, and execute plans, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks. You will oversee programs from start to finish, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders on technical matters. You will ensure on-time delivery and achieve program milestones while driving alignment across stakeholders.

 This is an excellent opportunity to join the growing Datacenter Networking Business Unit organization. You will drive the end-to-end software, firmware, emulation, and validation lifecycle across our next-generation Connectivity Products. Expect collaboration during all phases of development, working alongside designers and pre/post-silicon leaders to ensure timely delivery of software that powers the world’s most advanced connectivity technology for AI datacenters!

 Responsibilities 

- Drive requirements scoping, analysis, and planning including interdependencies, staffing constraints, and schedule optimization across technical teams and customers. 

- Establish a clear Plan of Record and drive prioritization across the organization. 

- Apply consistency and best practices through program initiation, planning, execution, and closing phases, enabling business outcomes and benefits tracking. 

- Collaborate with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop program goals, set priorities for deliverables, discuss involvement of business processes, and drive decisions to ensure on-time delivery. 

- Establish execution discipline & communication process: risk management and mitigation, tracking, schedule trends vs baseline, recovery actions, executive reporting and stakeholder communication. 

- Develop program indicators and KPIs to manage program health including quality and timelines. 

- Promote program vision and objectives within the team, ensure program objectives are met or exceeded, present vision to management, and gain buy-in from stakeholders. 

- Own project schedule and track overall execution of baseline software development, ensuring milestones align with program commitments and customer expectations. 

- Develop and manage the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g. on time, on budget, within scope) for multiple software programs which include schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholder identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization. 

- Drive teams to identify program issues/risks and create a risk mitigation plan for multiple medium-sized or single complex program(s).  Maintain and update the risk tracker. 

- Establish key program success metrics and manage action plans to ensure program success when metrics deviate from Plan of Record. 

- Define and drive process frameworks across teams for efficient and consistent execution and quality deliverables. 

- Communicate clearly with executives, engineers, and stakeholders, balancing transparency with thoughtful trade-off discussions. 

- Co-manage multi-year software roadmaps and coordinate across silicon, firmware, software, and emulation teams. 

 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

- PMP Certification and/or Agile Certification.

- Experience with agile program management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

- Experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g. Director level and above).

- Experience working in a large matrixed organization.

- Highly organized, adaptable, with excellent verbal and written skills.

We're looking for our next Senior Product Manager. Could It Be You?

Flexiti is one of Canada's leading point-of-sale financing providers and part of Questrade Financial Group. Through the FlexitiCard® and the Flexiti Network™, we help Canadians pay for the things that matter to them over time, and we help thousands of retail partners across the country grow their sales. Product management at Flexiti means working in a genuinely two-sided business: every decision you make touches both a cardholder and a merchant, and understanding the needs of both while making the appropriate trade-offs is part of the job.

The Senior Product Manager (Sr. PM) is a strategic leader who oversees an entire product entity or a collection of high-impact product areas. Reporting directly to the Group Product Manager, you will lead complex, cross-entity initiatives, ensuring technical architecture, product specifications, and release cycles align with the company's long-term business goals. You will influence ways of working across multiple squads, establish standards for UX and data-driven decision-making, and act as a crucial liaison between product execution and executive strategy.

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Entity specifications: Leading the drafting of specifications for complex, large-scale initiatives that span multiple product areas, identifying and proactively resolving entity dependencies and logic gaps.

Strategic architecture influence: Leveraging product vision to influence technical architecture across the division, ensuring the platform evolves to support future scaling requirements and product ambitions.

Entity-wide delivery leadership: Driving the end-to-end delivery of large-scale initiatives, making clear, accountable trade-offs across multiple squads to mitigate risk and clear organizational blockers.

Quality and design governance: Setting and upholding a high quality and user experience bar across the entity, ensuring consistency in design standards, accessibility, and operational excellence.

Data and financial rigour: Synthesizing complex data from multiple sources to make high-stakes product decisions, and applying strong financial judgment to funding models, budgets, and business case development.

Strategic roadmapping: Defining and aligning the long-term vision and product roadmap across the entity, ensuring all initiatives are complementary and directly support company-wide strategic objectives.

Stakeholder management: Actively managing and influencing senior stakeholders across the company, incorporating cross-functional goals to build broad organization-wide alignment.

Practice and craft leadership: Elevating performance across multiple squads by establishing best practices, mentoring team members, and optimizing product delivery rituals and ways of working.

So are YOU our next Senior Product Manager? You are if you…

Have a Bachelor's degree or higher in a quantitative, engineering, or business field

Have 6+ years of progressive product management experience, with at least 2 years in a lead or principal role managing complex product domains

Have demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and managing technical and architectural dependencies across multiple agile teams

Have experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthtech

Additional kudos if you…

Have experience in consumer lending, BNPL or point-of-sale financing, payments, credit decisioning, retail finance, or merchant-facing B2B tooling

Additional Information…

This position sits within Flexiti Financial Inc., part of Questrade Financial Group, in Product Management.

This position reports to the Group Product Manager and has no direct reports. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Senior Product Managers, and Associate Product Managers.

This is a Full Time Regular position based in the GTA.

Compensation Information:

Base salary range: $110,000 - $150,000

The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

This role will play a crucial role in shaping the future of digital banking and investments and driving the growth of our organization.
As the Head of Product, you will be the company’s senior leader and the go-to expert for the management team on the present and future of Questrade branded Products. You will be responsible for staying abreast of the evolving regulatory environment and global best practices for developing and delivering world-class products, services, and experiences. You will help drive a culture of high performance and new ways of working for both these areas.
You will leverage customer insights to iterate on the digital product development and define the business hypotheses and KPIs to measure product success and ensure delivery of customer value for each iteration of a product release. This role is accountable for the success of the strategy execution, product roadmap, and feature definition at all phases of its lifecycle, delivery against committed timelines and within budget parameters.  
Included in this role’s scope is also accountability for the Enterprise Money Movement. Specifically providing the expertise and thought  leadership for strategy and roadmap development for efficient movement of money across Journey’s.  This includes, implementing internal money movement capabilities to facilitate transactions across QFG products, as well as establishing partnerships with vendors, such as Interac, to support the needs of the enterprise. 
As business evolves and scales, the role, and it’s underlying accountabilities may change.

Need more details? Keep reading…

Strategic Planning and Leadership:

Identify and understand customer requirements, encouraging innovation within Product Leads to develop products and business solutions that anticipate and deliver on customer needs
Serve as a liaison between the customer, upper management, executives, and other stakeholders, and help inform future business strategies and objectives
Create and propel in the whole team, an agile discovery and delivery culture totally based on the modern digital products management practices like experimentation, prototypes, etc. in a real data-driven culture

P&L Management:

Partner on P&L management on run and change activities, ensuring financial investments and return targets are met.
Engage with colleagues and customers to assess the current state of the Enterprise Money Movement;  analysing findings, implications, and opportunities, and reporting insights to the executive team.
Proactively collaborate with regulatory experts to ensure Payment innovation aligns with industry standards while pushing boundaries to drive aggressive growth.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Coordinate all cross-functional initiatives and all enabling functions needed towards the excellent execution of all Build, Run, and Change activities in the Experience Platform

Strong Internal Governance:

Maintain robust internal governance structures to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and Questrade’s brand promise, processes, and policies.

Customer Experience:

Ascertain the delivery of an integrated customer experience within this line of business and across other businesses that exceeds customers’ expectations 
Drive a culture of high customer-centricity, accountability for outcomes, innovation, collaboration and excellence. 

Efficiency:

Streamline operational processes and ensure the efficiency of all Build, Run and Change activities.

So are YOU our next Head of Product, Questrade Experience Platform? You are if you…

Are a thought leader with 15+ years Canadian Fin-Tech experience leading digital product management portfolios with a specialty in financial and investment services
Have significant experience in B2B payments and financial services 
Are an exceptional communicator - verbal and written, across all levels including management. Have the ability to motivate, drive change and challenge status quo, deal with ambiguity and make informed recommendations. Exceptional relationship builder and collaborator
Have strong financial acumen and ability to lead from strategy to implementation. Ability to work and lead in an Agile manner
Have technical competence to provide subject matter expertise and challenge status quo when appropriate
Are able to pivot priorities as required by the business
Have deep experience in P&L management
