jazzhr:ratehubinc:job_20260921172433_VB2.description:
WHO IS RATEHUB? 
 We’re a company on a mission - We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer - Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member, from product & engineering to sales & marketing, finance, operations, and everything in between is obsessed with one thing;  helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses - a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized Credit Card and Loans options, and cheaper auto & home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.  
 Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges; challenges that can be complex and often unexpected, but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right kind of people to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth. 
 Ratehub is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing Product team. Reporting directly to the Chief Product and Technology Officer, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for our Everyday Banking portfolio, partnering closely with the business unit leader to scale this high-growth segment. You’re a strategic, data-driven operator who can anticipate business needs, bring structure to ambiguous problems, and turn complex ideas into world-class digital experiences that empower millions of Canadians to make smarter financial choices. 
  YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Strategic Leadership & Vision 

- Own the product strategy for the Everyday Banking portfolio (including cards, chequing, savings, investments, and loans), translating market data and user insights into a high-growth vision. 

- Set the vision for AI-driven personalization that anticipates user needs and surfaces the right products and guidance. 

- Drive roadmap alignment and prioritization discussions with executive leadership, securing buy-in on critical trade-offs. 

- Develop deep expertise in fintech trends, competitor movements, and open banking to identify new market opportunities. 
   Product Execution & Delivery 

- Translate strategy into clear product requirements, defining scope, success criteria, and edge cases for the cross-functional pod comprising engineering, design, and QA. 

- Lead the pod through backlog sequencing, scrum ceremonies, and end-to-end delivery. 

- Make high-judgment trade-offs across scope, technical scalability, and timelines, backed by data. 

- Define success metrics and establish reporting to evaluate product performance, surface insights, and communicate results to leadership. 

- Optimize delivery processes and prioritization frameworks to reduce friction, mitigate risk, and accelerate team velocity. 

- Orchestrate end-to-end GTM plans across operational readiness, marketing alignment, and launch execution. 
   Growth & Funnel Optimization 

- Optimize user funnels, transforming user research and A/B testing data into opportunities that improve conversion and maximize revenue. 

- Partner with marketing and content teams to build high-converting web experiences that strengthen SEO, GEO, and landing page performance. 
   YOUR QUALIFICATIONS 

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of owning a product line end-to-end (ideally within fintech, personal finance, or a high-growth B2C marketplace). 

- Demonstrated success defining and evolving product strategy, rather than simply executing a pre-determined roadmap. 

- Expertise using web analytics, user testing, and A/B testing to drive conversion rate optimization and measure product performance. 

- Strong Agile/Scrum background with a talent for validating concepts through MVPs and lean testing before committing to a full technology build. 

- Fluency incorporating AI tools into the product workflow to accelerate market research, data synthesis, and rapid prototyping. 

- A passion for UX/design and the ability to translate customer and business needs into outstanding products. 

- Proven ability to influence executive leadership as well as cross-functional teams. 

- Skilled at bringing structure to ambiguous problems, turning vague, open-ended challenges into clear hypotheses, scoped bets, and a sequenced plan. 

- Highly organized and adaptable, able to manage multiple workstreams and re-prioritize as conditions change. 

- A genuine interest in the personal finance space and the problems Ratehub is solving for Canadians. 

 CULTURE FIT: 

- Members first - we prioritize the interests and needs of our members above all else. We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L. 

- Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions. 

- Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.  

- Run after problems - we tackle problems head-on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile. 

- Measure, Learn, Iterate, Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate. 
   BENEFITS & PERKS 

- Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market. 

- Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration. 

- Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance. 

- Comprehensive Benefits: Full health and dental coverage with no employee-paid premiums. 

- RRSP Matching: A company-matched RRSP program to support your long-term financial goals. 

- Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career. 

- Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization. 
   The estimated compensation range for this position, inclusive of a annual performance bonus is $125,000 - 175,000.

phenom:RBCAA0088:R-0000188155.description:
Job Description 

 Senior Technical Product Manager – AI Governance & Compliance  
 What is the opportunity?  
 We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Product Manager to join our Enterprise Architecture team, supporting the AI-Powered Software Delivery initiative. This is a rare opportunity to shape how RBC builds software in the age of AI — and what that transformation means for our people, our governance, and our pace of delivery. 
 AI is fundamentally changing the way software is designed, built, and delivered. As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product vision, direction, and roadmap end-to-end — from plan to launch and beyond — for the capabilities that modernize how software is built across the enterprise. This is a strategy and outcomes role, distinct from day-to-day execution and backlog ownership: you set where the product is going and why, and you ensure it delivers real value. 
 The scope of this role is significant. The products you shape will impact how software is built across the enterprise, ensuring that speed, quality, and control advance together rather than at each other's expense. 
 Why this role matters  
 Governance and delivery processes can be manual, fragmented, and slow. This role exists to define and drive a product strategy that modernizes how RBC builds software with AI - turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, adopted products. 
 The opportunity is transformational. You will own a roadmap that improves developer experience, accelerates delivery, and strengthens governance integrity - delivering measurable value, adoption, and trust by design. 
 This role is guided by a clear vision:  deliver measurable value, adoption, and trust - by design, not by exception.  
 What success looks like in your first six months:  

- A clear, prioritized product roadmap aligned with engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and key stakeholders. 

- Strong early adoption of released capabilities among target users. 

- A repeatable, well-understood plan-to-launch product process. 

- Measurable improvement in product health metrics such as NPS, adoption, and engagement. 
 What will you do?  
 As a Senior Product Manager, you will: 

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered software delivery capabilities, keeping it current as priorities and technology evolve. 

- Set product direction and translate it into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap. 

- Partner closely with engineering and Enterprise Architecture to sequence delivery, resolve trade-offs, and keep the roadmap aligned to feasibility and value. 

- Engage stakeholders across risk, compliance, delivery teams, and leadership to align priorities and secure buy-in. 

- Manage the product end-to-end from plan to launch and follow-up - including release planning, go-to-market communications, user guides, and enablement materials. 

- Define and track success metrics such as NPS, adoption, engagement, and time-to-value; use insights to iterate and improve. 

- Conduct user and market research to validate needs and inform priorities, applying product management best practices. 

- Champion responsible, governed AI - ensuring products advance speed and control together rather than at each other's expense. 
 What do you need to succeed?  
 Must-have:  

- 5-7+ years of product management experience, ideally at a senior level, owning a product from strategy through launch and iteration. 

- Proven experience defining and delivering a product roadmap and vision in a cross-functional environment. 

- Strong collaboration skills with engineering and technical stakeholders, with comfort making prioritization trade-offs. 

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive-alignment skills. 

- Data-informed mindset with experience defining and tracking metrics such as NPS, adoption, and engagement. 

- Experience with go-to-market planning, release management, and product communications/enablement. 

- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and responsible AI considerations. 
 Nice-to-have:

phenom:RBCAA0088:R-0000188154.description:
Job Description 

 Senior Technical Product Owner – AI Governance & Compliance  
 What is the opportunity?  
 We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Product Owner to join our Enterprise Architecture team, supporting the AI-Powered Software Delivery (AI-DLC) initiative. This is a rare opportunity to shape how RBC builds software in the age of AI - and what that transformation means for our people, our governance, and our pace of delivery. 
 AI is fundamentally changing the way software is designed, built, and delivered. As a Senior Product Owner on the Governance & Compliance stream, your mission is to embed governance integrity by design - and make it faster through AI. You will lead the product vision for automating and modernizing how governance is performed across the enterprise, ensuring that speed and control advance together rather than at each other's expense. 
 The scope of this role is significant. The solutions you shape will impact governance workflows across the enterprise, ensuring regulatory requirements are met, controls are consistently applied, and the trust of our customers, regulators, and stakeholders is maintained. 
 Why this role matters  
 Governance is critical to how RBC builds software, but manual, repetitive processes can slow delivery and create redundant effort. This role exists to modernize and streamline governance so that speed and control advance together. 
 The opportunity is transformational — using AI to automate and standardize governance intake and workflows, reducing redundant data requests and manual effort through extensible, reusable solutions. An early proof of concept has demonstrated strong, scalable results, providing a foundation for enterprise-wide governance optimization. 
 This role is guided by a clear vision:  every AI-assisted decision is traceable, every control is mapped, and every governance process is met -  by design, not by exception.  
 What success looks like:  

- Scale a proven proof of concept toward broader enterprise adoption, driving standardization and efficiency across governance workflows. 

- Support automated, audit-ready evidence gathering that strengthens compliance and reduces manual effort. 

- Enable delivery teams by clearing a growing portfolio of AI-powered software programs for execution. 

- Establish governance automation as the trusted default for how RBC governs AI-powered software delivery. 
 What will you do?  
 As a Senior Product Owner, you will: 

- Product Backlog Management:  

- Translate high-level features and epics from product managers into detailed, actionable user stories with clear scope, business context, and acceptance criteria that define development readiness and quality standards 

- Write detailed requirements and product specifications that enable development teams to understand scope, functionality, and success metrics 

- Conduct weekly backlog refinement sessions with the Agile squad to continuously improve story clarity, completeness, and prioritization 

- Scrum & Agile Event Leadership  

- Facilitate and host bi-weekly sprint planning sessions with the Agile squad to define sprint scope, capacity and commitments 

- Host and manage daily standup meetings with the Agile squad, removing blockers and maintaining team momentum 

- Maintain Jira hygiene to ensure accurate tracking, visibility, and traceability of work throughout the sprint lifecycle 

- Serve as the primary point of contact for the development team, clarifying requirements 

- Other  

- Translate complex regulatory and governance needs into simple, clear, and extensible technical requirements. 

- Analyze usage data, stakeholder feedback, and audit findings to continuously improve the governance intake experience. 

- Champion AI-specific risk awareness — ensuring that applying AI to the SDLC does not circumvent risk controls baked into the process and helping evolve controls, so they are tailored for an AI-powered SDLC rather than manual processes alone. 
 What do you need to succeed?  
 Must-have:  

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in an Agile/Scrum environment, ideally at a senior level. 

- Deep understanding of Agile frameworks, user story mapping, and backlog grooming techniques. 

- Experience delivering governance, risk, compliance, or regulatory-driven products (e.g., OSFI, audit, controls). 

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder negotiation skills across business, risk, and technical partners. 

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn complex governance needs into clear, actionable requirements. 

- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and responsible AI governance considerations. 
 Nice-to-have:  

- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile certification. 

- Experience with AI-DLC / SDLC governance and evidence or audit automation. 

- Exposure to enterprise architecture practices and cloud platforms. 

- Knowledge of data governance, controls mapping, and traceability tooling. 

 Job Skills 
Agile Product Development, Communication, Customer Service, Customer Success, Decision Making, Group Problem Solving, Leadership, Long Term Planning, Teamwork, Time Management

ashby:rewind:182ea3c9-5a23-44b4-a82d-14a.description:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50 https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/about/press-room/deloitte-canada-announces-its-annual-technology-fast-50tm-program-winners.html). We invite you to read our startup story https://rewind.io/blog/why-we-started-rewind-backups/ to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here https://rewind.com/about-us/.
To find out more about our perks, click here https://rewind.com/careers/#:~:text=Working%20at%20Rewind%20has%20its%20perks.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

 - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About the role

This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales.

We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest.

We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way.

What you'll do

Launches and go-to-market

 - Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch.

 - Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones.

 - Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming.

 - Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change.

Positioning and messaging

 - Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas.

 - Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence.

 - Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work.

Buyer and competitive insight

 - Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions.

 - Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading.

 - Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market.

Sales and partner enablement

 - Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece.

 - Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work.

AI-powered product marketing

 - Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets.

 - Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse.

 - Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities.

What you'll bring

 - 4+ years of product marketing experience in B2B, including product launches, positioning and messaging.

 - Sales enablement experience, such as training sellers and building the battlecards and collateral they rely on.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, or a clear appetite to learn them fast. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach.

 - Experience working with product teams to define product strategy.

 - Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus.

 - Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling.

 - A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers.

 - Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in.

 - Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly.

 - Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Nice to have

 - Experience building AI workflows or automations for a marketing or sales team.



Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.



Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

 - Flexible work hours

 - Employee stock options

 - Health benefits

 - 3 weeks vacation

 - 7 life leave days

 - 2 Level Up days for professional development

 - 1 volunteer day

 - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

 - Paid parental leave

 - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

 - $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.



AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

Program Manager, EOR
About Rippling
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
Based in San Francisco, CA, [Rippling has raised $1.4B+](https://www.rippling.com/careers#:~:text=GLOBAL%20EMPLOYEES-,%241.4B%2B,-RAISED%20TO%20DATE) from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @ [Rippling.com](http://www.Rippling.com) addresses.
About the role
As an EOR HR Operations Program & Enablement Manager, you will manage the systems, processes, and knowledge base for Rippling's Employer of Record (EOR) HR and Operations teams. You will design scalable workflows, tools, and training to ensure accurate and consistent support while leading cross-functional initiatives such as new country launches, process improvements, and compliance updates. In this role, you will collaborate with stakeholders in Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Payroll/Tax Operations to maintain and improve Rippling EOR’s service delivery.
What you will do
Program & Process Ownership
Design and implement scalable HR operations processes and SOPs spanning onboarding, offboarding, leave management, benefits administration, and regulatory compliance.
Manage EOR operational initiatives across multiple countries, including process redesigns and compliance-driven rollouts, keeping structured plans, milestones, and risks on track.
Help launch Rippling EOR in new countries by checking readiness, setting up workflows, and making sure we follow local laws, in partnership with a local HR Advisor.
Own the end-to-end case management lifecycle and act as business owner for the EOR support, driving improvements in tools, workflows, and automation.
Knowledge, Training & Performance Enablement
Maintain our internal and external guides and help center articles so the team and customers can find answers quickly and reduce the number of support tickets.
Decide what information goes into help articles and policy guides for our clients.
Create the training plan for new EOR team members and keep everyone updated on new features or changes.
Build a program to help supervisors, leads, and managers coach their teams using data and clear feedback.
Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement
Work with managers around the world to collect feedback and find ways to make our service better.
Keep track of how we are performing and turn reports into easy-to-use dashboards.
Analyze data to identify root causes, guide priorities and partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Implementation and Operations on solutions.
What you will need
5+ years of experience in HR operations, EOR services, or managing programs in a fast-paced company.
Experience running big projects with many people, tight deadlines, and international teams. You should also know how to build clear processes and guides from scratch.
Good understanding of international employment laws and how EOR services work.
Experience owning case management systems (e.g., Salesforce) and knowledge management ecosystems (e.g., Confluence, Help Centre), plus designing training curricula and coach-the-coach frameworks for frontline leaders.
Great at planning projects, spotting risks, and keeping everyone updated on progress.
Comfortable using data to build dashboards and using those numbers to make decisions.
Clear writing and speaking skills, with the ability to explain things to anyone from support staff to executives.
Comfort operating across time zones and managing workstreams that span multiple regions simultaneously.
Who You Are
A Builder: You like creating things from nothing and have a track record of building systems and processes.
A Practical Thinker: You see how small tasks fit into the big picture and can build a schedule that keeps everything moving together.
A Collaborator: You don't just follow a list; you look for ways to fix problems before they happen.
A Good Communicator: You can get people on board with new ideas and changes, even if you aren't their boss.
Good with Numbers: You use data to find problems, track success, and show the value of your work.
Action-Oriented: You balance planning for the future with getting things done today.
Clear & Direct: You turn complicated situations into simple plans that everyone can follow.
Additional Information

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity:

 Who we're looking for: 

 We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and deliver scalable, secure, and reusable data and AI solutions.

 This role sits within the Data & AI team and provides technical leadership across end-to-end data and AI architecture, from requirements and design through to implementation. You’ll work closely with business partners, architects, engineers, security, governance and platform teams to translate complex business needs into practical, production-ready solutions across data, integration, and analytics environments.

 What you'll do: 

 Lead Data Solution Design

- Lead the assessment of complex business and technical requirements and translate them into end-to-end data and AI solutions.

- Own solution architecture across data processing, storage, integration, consumption, security and AI enabled capabilities.

- Build High-Level Designs (HLDs) and contribute to Detailed Design Documents (DDD), ensuring consistency across the solution lifecycle.

- Evaluate solution alternatives and make architectural recommendations based on business requirements, technical constraints, cost, scalability, performance, and operational considerations. 

- Identify architectural risks, dependencies, assumptions, and design trade-offs early in the solution lifecycle.

 Define Data and AI Architecture Patterns

- Design conceptual, logical, and physical data architectures and models that promote performance, interoperability, and reuse.

- Define patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including batch, streaming, API, and event-driven integration and consumption.

- Develop reusable architecture patterns for GenAI, RAG, enterprise and vector search, document processing, semantic models, and AI agents.

- Design secure integration patterns across enterprise data platforms, AI/ML platforms, LLMs, APIs, applications, and analytics solutions.

- Incorporate identity, RBAC, least-privilege access, data classification, privacy, and governance requirements into solution designs.

 Provide Technical Leadership Through Delivery

- Provide architectural leadership to project teams throughout the delivery lifecycle, from initial discovery through implementation and production readiness.

- Work closely with engineering teams to ensure designs are delivered as designed

- Participate in design reviews and provide technical direction when implementation decisions require architectural guidance.

About Rootly
At 
Rootly
, we are on a mission to be the go-to way companies respond when things go wrong, helping every organization be more reliable. We do this by building an industry-leading incident management platform that allows companies around the world consistently and quickly resolve incidents. We are not simply transforming an industry, we are carving an entirely new +$B segment ourselves and need incredible talent to achieve this ambitious goal together.
Customers love Rootly. Some of the fastest growing companies around the world such as NVIDIA, Figma, Canva, Tripadvisor, Squarespace and more rely on Rootly to power their critical incident management process. They obsess over our delightful enterprise-ready platform and unique partnership model. See why our customers have reviewed us 
5 stars on G2
.
Investors love Rootly. We are backed by some of the most respected funds in the world from Y Combinator to operators like the CTO of Dropbox and GitHub. We'd be happy to disclose our entire funding and profitability picture live during the interview. As a culture we relentlessly put transparency first. We conduct monthly financial reviews as a team so everyone has a pulse on the health of the business and publish what we are building in our 
weekly changelog
.
About the Role
Join our Solutions Engineering team as a technical expert and trusted advocate, guiding our customers on their journey to success with Rootly.
As a Solutions Engineer you'll bring technical expertise to customer implementations and demos. You will develop best practices and content around Incident Management and On-Call, and collaborate across Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to represent the customers’ voice and drive continuous product improvements.
This role requires hands-on work with the integration surface that matters to our customers, including REST APIs, webhooks, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. You will drive technical conversations with engineering teams at customer organizations and operate as a technical partner internally to ensure that solution requirements are clearly represented.
If you’re a developer or technologist who loves discussing technology, working closely with customers across industries, and possesses a problem-solving, can-do mindset, we’d love to meet you as you’ll be joining a team that delivers real value through an industry-leading product.
What You'll Need
5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Software Engineer with direct customer engagement.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, data mapping, and integration patterns.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Terraform, and familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proficiency with scripting or programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Ruby, or Go.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage engineering and executive audiences.
Ability to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to a rapidly changing environment.
Why Rootly?
We’re not just another startup. We’re building something category-defining and want teammates who crave ownership, love solving hard problems, and thrive in a high-bar, high-impact environment.
Here’s what you can expect when you join Rootly:
Competitive compensation and early equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
3 weeks of vacation, plus unlimited sick and mental health days, and a company-wide end-of-year shutdown to recharge.
$500 stipend for home office setup.
Unlimited token usage and access to AI tools
A fast-moving, high-impact environment where your leadership and ideas directly shape the future of the company.
Our team is growing, and this is a newly created vacancy that we may hire more than one person to fill.
As we build out the team, we may use AI to support parts of our interview process, like reviewing assessments, but it’s a tool that helps our people, not a substitute for their judgment.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge and opportunity you’re looking for, apply now and let’s build something great together.
Rootly is an equal opportunity employer. We aim to create an environment where every team member at Rootly feels like they belong so they can have a greater impact on our business and customers. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

 Job Category 
Customer Success 
 Job Details 

 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 About the Role 
 The Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

 Note: By applying to this Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations role your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

 What You'll Be Doing
 Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

- Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

- Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.

- Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.

- Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.

- Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.

 Strategic Partnerships & Tooling

- Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.

- Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.

- Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.

- Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.

 Technical Expertise & Incident Response

- Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence) , Data 360 (Data Cloud) , Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing) , or Tableau .

- Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.

- Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.

- Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.

 What We're Looking For
 Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.

- Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.

- Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.

- Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.

- Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.

- Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).

- Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.

- Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.

- Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

 Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).

- Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.

 Role and Responsibilities 

 PRODUCT MANAGEMENT (Wearable & Accessories) - 80%

In addition provide clarity as to the business rationale, and product strategies to support business growth.

- Build relationships with US counterparts to learn and share best practices.

Utilize profit simulation models (including impact from a trade spend/sales deductions and COG) to evaluate specific customer opportunities and provide rationale for proposed decisions to reporting manager.

- Forecasting of market size, segments and share to ensure divisional strategic KPI objectives are met.

- Presents monthly promotional plans and gets signoff for from reporting manager. 

- Align with reporting manager on all pricing related matters throughout product lifecycle management.

- Review channel and market feedback from and factor into product category strategy

- Holds accountability on PM forecast and works with SCM on AP2 planning to achieve objectives on financial plans, weekly sales target, weekly PSI and clear aging inventory.

- Presents during internal GTM meeting and works with all stakeholders on product launch strategy.

- Prepares and presents during external partner meetings on category presentation that includes market analysis, category business strategy, roadmap, promotional plans, merchandising, etc., and any partner specific objectives.

- Executes sample management process and tracking inbound/outbound samples.

- Works with technical PMs, HQ, R&D and partners on all items relating to product testing and certification on new product launches factoring schedules and deadlines. Communicates to all parties involved on progress throughout the cycle.

 MARKET INTELLIGENCE - 20% 

- Deliver bottom-up and top-down modelling to fulfill Samsung’s strategy by delivering key insights on consumer sales trend

- Develop an un-biased scenario models to forecast likely outcomes for the quarter, year

- Collecting and analyzing supply data based on Global Supply Chain Management (GSCM), and EDI / POS system such as product sell out, Key model performance, YoY growth etc.

- Analyze Sell Out inputs from the various SCM analysts, and advise on possible efficiencies, and change

 ·        The ability to plan, organize, collaborate on and measure the effectiveness and results of all programs and projects in the IT Division as required

 ·        The ability to negotiate with both vendors and customers on marketing proposals and plans
 ·        Ability to motivate and guide the activities to manage product sales performance with the sales team
 ·        The ability to develop tasks, work assignments, to clearly define objectives and give technical sales and marketing guidance on a day-to-day level
 ·        Ability to assist in long and mid-term business planning
 ·        Ability to manage budgets and determine ROI
 ·        Must have a proven track record on results
 ·        Ability to work in a fast paced environment is a must
 ·         Sense of urgency
 Experience: 
 ·        A minimum of 5 years working in a Product Manager role preferred
 ·        A minimum of three years of experience ideally in the Mobile industry preferred
 ·        5+ years related experience preferred (Market Intelligence, Executive presentation materials, and Planning
 ·        5+ years of hands on experience in data modelling, scenario planning
 ·        Mobile Handsets, Tablets, Wearable or IOT background is an asset

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Windows Workstation OS Platform Principal Engineer & Technical Product Owner is a senior technical expert and product owner for the physical Windows workstation estate (laptops and desktops) across the enterprise. This role owns the platform end to end from a design, solutioning, engineering, and product perspective, so that the Windows client behaves as a resilient, secure, and high-performing service rather than a collection of disconnected settings.
This role leads the technical design and solutioning for the Windows workstation platform. It defines and evolves target-state solution designs, reference designs, engineering standards, and design patterns for how Windows is provisioned, configured, secured, delivered, and operated. It works within the Bank’s architecture direction and standards, partnering with the Architecture function rather than duplicating it, and translates architectural intent into practical, buildable Windows workstation solutions.
The role is defined by genuine mastery of what Windows actually is: the servicing model and release cadence, the boot and sign-in sequence, the kernel and user-mode boundary, servicing stacks and update mechanics, provisioning, policy, security baselines, and the telemetry that explains real-world behavior. The person in this role is a recognized Windows expert who shapes technical direction and reference designs for the Windows client and owns how those decisions land in production.
Critically, this role is forward-looking. It is expected to track the Windows roadmap continuously, understand upcoming features and servicing changes before they arrive, and translate what is coming into practical, sequenced design and solutioning decisions for the Bank’s workstation fleet. Awareness of the roadmap is treated as a core responsibility, not a nice-to-have.

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 
• Leads the technical design and solutioning for the Windows workstation estate, defining and evolving target-state solution designs, reference designs, engineering standards, and design patterns for provisioning, configuration, compliance, application delivery, security, and lifecycle.
• Produces buildable, well-documented solution designs that are secure by design, scalable, and supportable, and that align to the Bank’s architecture direction, risk appetite, regulatory requirements, and technology-governance standards.
• Partners with the Architecture function to apply and inform enterprise architecture and standards, translating architectural intent into practical Windows workstation solutions without duplicating or overlapping the Architecture team’s mandate.
• Acts as technical product owner for the Windows workstation estate, owning the product vision, the technical backlog, and the sequencing of engineering work from concept through build, deployment, and steady-state operations.
• Translates business outcomes, user-experience needs, security and risk findings, operational feedback, and technical debt into a clear, prioritized, and defensible design and delivery roadmap for the Windows client.
• Champions a customer-focused culture, treating end-user experience, reliability, and performance as first-class outcomes for every design and workstation decision.
• Serves as the Bank’s subject-matter expert on the Windows client: servicing model and release cadence, feature and quality updates, hotpatch and update mechanics, the boot and sign-in sequence, kernel and user-mode behavior, drivers, provisioning, policy, and security baselines.
• Acts as a senior technical escalation point for complex Windows design and engineering issues, leading root-cause analysis and driving durable, permanent solutions rather than repeated workarounds.
• Uses experience telemetry and operational data (for example Endpoint Analytics and update reporting) to continuously improve performance, boot and sign-in time, reliability, and update success.
• Operates horizontally across the organization, partnering as a peer expert with other vertical engineering groups (for example virtual workspace, identity, networking, security, application, and infrastructure engineering) and with their product owners to align designs, manage dependencies, and deliver shared outcomes.
• Collaborates with, and provides Windows expertise to, the other Windows and endpoint engineering teams within Enterprise Platforms & EUC Engineering in a partnership model, contributing designs, standards, and guidance without assuming ownership of their backlogs, deliverables, or people, and respecting each team’s remit.
• Acts as a connective technical authority for Windows workstation topics, offering solutioning support, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing that raise the quality and consistency of Windows engineering across teams while avoiding duplication or overlap of responsibilities.
• Builds consensus across teams through influence and technical credibility, resolving design trade-offs collaboratively and escalating to leadership only where alignment cannot be reached.
• Continuously tracks the Windows roadmap and Windows Insider signals, maintaining a current view of upcoming releases and platform-enablement updates (for example the 26H1 platform release for next-generation silicon and the 26H2 annual feature update), and advises leadership and peer teams on timing, readiness, and impact.
• Assesses upcoming Windows capabilities and servicing changes, including AI and Copilot+ PC experiences and their NPU hardware requirements, WinUI modernization of core shell components, hotpatch adoption, and resilience features such as point-in-time restore, cloud rebuild, and Quick Machine Recovery, and translates them into practical enterprise designs, hardware standards, and adoption or deferral decisions.
• Evaluates hardware and silicon direction (including Copilot+ PC and Arm-based devices) so that the Bank’s workstation designs, refresh, and standards remain aligned to where Windows is heading, not only where it is today.
• Provides clear, evidence-based guidance to leadership and the broader project community on what is coming in Windows, what it means for the fleet, and what the Bank should do to prepare.
• Partners with Cyber Security, Risk, and Identity teams to embed security-by-design and Zero Trust principles into the Windows client design, including security baselines, encryption (for example BitLocker and hardware-accelerated BitLocker on capable devices), and update compliance.
• Ensures day-to-day design, solutioning, and operational decisions align with the Bank’s risk appetite, operational controls, AML/ATF and regulatory requirements, and technology governance standards.
• Contributes to a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in clear ownership, technical excellence, and knowledge transfer.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
• 7+ years designing, solutioning, engineering, and operating enterprise Windows workstation or end-user-computing platforms at scale.
• Demonstrated experience leading technical design and solutioning for the Windows client, including target-state solution designs, reference designs, and standards, delivered in partnership with an enterprise architecture function.
• Deep, demonstrable expertise in the Windows client: servicing and release cadence, feature/quality and hotpatch updates, boot and sign-in sequence, kernel and user-mode behavior, drivers, provisioning, policy, and security baselines.
• Proven track record of tracking the Windows roadmap and Windows Insider program and turning upcoming features and servicing changes into enterprise-ready designs and standards.
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Entra ID, including Conditional Access, compliance, and configuration at enterprise scale.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60657.description:
Requisition ID: 275115 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Role   

 The Senior Manager – Data Product Manager  leads the strategy, lifecycle and value realization of data products and shared data capabilities for International Banking. Reporting to the Director, Data Engineering, the incumbent acts as the senior product authority for the portfolio in scope: defining product vision and outcomes, owning roadmaps and prioritized backlogs, setting measurable success criteria, and aligning business, engineering, architecture, governance, risk and country stakeholders around a common direction. The role translates strategic priorities and customer needs into governed, reusable, domain-aligned data products published on Harbour, the bank's Azure Databricks data platform, following the Harbour target architecture and its producer/consumer model ("engineer once, consume many"). This includes the migration and rationalization of legacy on-premises and Google Cloud Platform workloads onto Harbour. The incumbent also leads a small team of Data Product Managers/Product Owners, establishing product management standards and coaching, developing and directing their work across concurrent initiatives and markets.  

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- 
 Define and own the product vision, strategy and outcome-based roadmap for the data products and shared data capabilities in scope (e.g., curated Gold-layer domain data products, analytics-ready datasets and reusable data services), organized by business domain (BIAN-inspired) and aligned with International Banking strategic priorities and the Harbour target architecture.   

- 
 Own and prioritize the product backlogs for the portfolio in scope, balancing business value, regulatory commitments, technical debt and platform capacity; make clear trade-off decisions and communicate the rationale to stakeholders.   

- 
 Engage business, Analytics, Risk, Finance, Data Office and country stakeholders to understand data consumer needs, use cases and pain points, and translate them into product requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.   

- 
 Define measurable success criteria and KPIs for each data product (adoption, consumer satisfaction, data quality, timeliness/SLA, reuse and cost-to-serve) and track value realization after release.   

- 
 Partner with Senior Data Engineers, Architecture and the Harbour Platform team (Data & AI Technology) to shape data products that follow approved Harbour patterns. These patterns include standard ingestion (metadata-driven batch through Azure Data Factory into ADLS Gen2 and, where applicable, change data capture), data contracts, medallion layering (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and a clear producer/consumer separation, so data is engineered once and reused across consumers rather than rebuilt for each use case.   

- 
 Lead product-level planning for the migration and rationalization of legacy workloads (on-premises platforms such as DB2, SQL Server, Hadoop and SAS, and existing Google Cloud Platform estates) onto Harbour. This includes source inventory, value and risk classification, prioritization of operational (mirrored) sources as the preferred source of truth, historical load strategy, decommissioning of temporary legacy analytical assets, consumer transition, and sequencing aligned with country workspace onboarding.   

- 
 Embed governance by design into every data product, in partnership with the Data Office, Risk and Compliance: clear data ownership, domain catalogs within the centralized Unity Catalog governance model, metadata and semantic definitions, lineage, data quality monitoring, data classification, and role-based access controls that support both country-specific and approved regional (e.g., AML) consumption through country-segregated workspaces.   

- 
 Ensure data products comply with enterprise security, privacy, data residency and local regulatory requirements across International Banking markets, including the country-specific regulatory approvals and attestations required to use Harbour. Contribute product inputs to required assessments (e.g., TRA, PIA, technical design documentation) and support the evidencing of controls and on-time closure of audit and regulatory commitments.   

- 
 Manage the full product lifecycle, discovery, design, launch, adoption, enhancement and retirement—working with Delivery Managers and Agile squads on release planning and incremental value delivery.   

- 
 Own the product business case for the portfolio in scope: benefits definition, funding requests, cost-to-serve and Azure/Databricks consumption (FinOps) attributed through the IB application APMs, including the legacy license and platform costs avoided through decommissioning, with timely escalation of variances.   

- 
 Communicate product strategy, roadmap, progress and key decisions to senior leadership and stakeholders through clear, executive-ready materials, managing expectations across competing priorities.   

- 
 Lead, coach and develop a team of Data Product Managers/Product Owners, including work assignment across products and markets, objective setting, performance feedback, career development and participation in hiring; set product management standards (discovery, roadmapping, OKRs, backlog practices) and promote a culture of customer focus, collaboration and continuous improvement.  

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:    

 Education:   

- 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics or a related field. A Master's degree (e.g., MBA or MSc in Data/Analytics) is a plus.   

- 
 Product management certifications are highly desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner / Advanced CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Pragmatic Institute); data and cloud certifications (e.g., DAMA CDMP, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900, Databricks Fundamentals) are an asset.  

 Experience:   

- 
 5+ years of progressive experience in product management, data management or data and analytics roles, including at least 3 years as a Product Manager or Product Owner for data products, data platforms or analytics capabilities.   

- 
 Proven track record defining, launching and scaling data products with measurable business outcomes and consumer adoption in a global, matrixed organization across multiple countries.   

- 
 Demonstrated experience directly supervising, coaching and developing product professionals (Product Managers, Product Owners or Business Analysts), including work assignment, performance feedback and hiring.   

- 
 Experience in banking or financial services, with working knowledge of regulatory and audit expectations (e.g., OSFI, local LATAM regulators, GDPR and data residency/privacy requirements) and how they shape data product design.   

- 
 Solid understanding of modern lakehouse architecture on Microsoft Azure: Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, change data capture/event streaming (e.g., Azure Event Hubs), data contracts, medallion patterns, producer/consumer design, and consumption through Power BI and SQL. Knowledge should be sufficient to shape solutions, challenge trade-offs and hold credible technical conversations; exposure to AI/ML consumption patterns is an asset.   

- 
 Experience with product discovery and prioritization practices (user research, value/effort frameworks such as WSJF or RICE, OKRs) and with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence and Power BI for product metrics and reporting.   

- 
 Experience building business cases, securing funding and managing product cost-to-serve, including cloud cost (FinOps) awareness.   

- 
 Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, metadata, semantic layers and catalog tools (e.g., Unity Catalog), domain-oriented data ownership (data mesh concepts, BIAN domain models) and control evidence requirements in a regulated, multi-country environment.  

 Skills:   

- 
 Strategic product thinking, with the ability to set a compelling vision and translate it into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap.   

- 
 Exceptional communication, storytelling and influencing skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and present clearly to senior leadership.   

- 
 Strong customer focus and understanding of data consumers, turning ambiguous business needs into clear, valuable product definitions.   

- 
 Sound judgment in prioritization and decision-making under competing demands, with strong negotiation and conflict-resolution abilities in high-visibility environments.   

- 
 Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to measuring product value, adoption and quality.   

- 
 Ability to coach product teams, leaders and stakeholders on product management practices and a product-oriented operating model for data.   

- 
 Spanish language ability is a strong asset given the International Banking footprint across Latin America and the Caribbean.

 The Senior Product Manager, Decisioning & Orchestration leads the product direction for next-best-action, multi-layer decisioning, and orchestration capabilities that enable relevant, timely, and connected client experiences across marketing, digital, and assisted channels.

- Strong understanding of customer data foundations, decisioning logic, eligibility frameworks, propensity models, real-time decisioning, and omnichannel activation.
