lever:eqbank:a2fbe9be-696b-41a5-b699-bc8.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work   This role is responsible for overseeing the delivery of cyber security outcomes and driving enterprise-wide changes in meeting the Organization’s cyber security strategic objectives. This role is responsible for planning, overseeing and organizing resources required to achieve the corporate cyber objectives. This role facilitates the governance, monitoring, communication/escalation and presentation of cyber security roadmap.  The Core Responsibilities!:

  • Facilitate and support the strategic planning processes for identifying priorities for the cyber security program and articulating the strategy and roadmap. 

  • Develop budget and financial planning documents and facilitate approvals. 

  • Oversee assignment of delivery leads or project managers and ensure proper project governance to realize outcomes. 

  • Financial planning, forecasting and budgeting for the cyber security program. 

  • Monitor the cyber program execution and delivery. 

  • Drive complicated and enterprise-wide initiatives with cyber security impact for the organization and provide Executive reporting. 

  • Collaborate and negotiate with technology and business leaders to gain support for initiatives and resource needs for program success. 

  • Ensuring program delivery success by addressing challenges to success and promptly escalating as required. 

  • Provides leadership and coaching for delivery leads and project managers in gap areas such as financial planning, change management or as required to achieve needed outcomes. 

  • Measure, monitor and report on benefit realization 

Let's Talk About You!:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of experience in IT/Cyber, with at least 5 years in leading enterprise programs. 

  • Proven track record in leading cyber transformation or digital modernization programs. 

  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and security frameworks. 

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. 

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or TOGAF are a plus. 

  • Good understanding of accounting and financial management 

  • Good understanding of benefit realization measurements techniques. 

  • People & resource management  

  • Strategy and Financial Planning 

  • Process & capability Management 

  • Technology Roadmaps 

  • Ownership & Accountability 

 

Communication Skills: 

  • Good documentation skills 

  • Strong communication and presentation skills 

  • Good interpersonal skills, with proven track record of developing relationships and communicating conceptual information effectively to individuals unfamiliar with subject material. 

  • Strong organizational skills: demonstrated ability to manage time and adhere to tight deadlines. 

  • Confident, personable, credible professional presence.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

 An overview of this role 

 As a Senior Partner Solutions Architect, Strategic Partnerships, you'll own the technical strategy and validation of joint work with GitLab's strategic partners: hyperscalers, artificial intelligence (AI) labs, AI-native companies, and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) vendors. You'll work with partners, Product, and Research and Development (R&D) to turn partner and customer needs into integrations, influence product design, and build the business case for each joint effort, from the first architecture review to a shipped integration. In this role you will also own the AI model evaluation process with our model partners, working closely with our R&D teams to assess new models ahead of release and ensure GitLab is built on the best-performing models for our customers. Unlike a customer-facing Solutions Architect role focused on adoption, you'll work with partners to make GitLab better. This role has no sales quota or variable pay.

 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform doesn't just bring people together-it unites teams and organizations, breaking down barriers and redefining what's possible in software development.

 What You’ll Do   

- Own the end-to-end technical strategy for assigned strategic partners, connecting technical requirements with joint business objectives.

- Turn partner technology and roadmaps into integration, architecture, and product opportunities across the GitLab platform, from planning to monitoring and AI agents and model integrations.

- Resolve complex technical issues across GitLab and partner systems, including cloud architecture, tool integrations, and AI model and agent evaluation and integration. Build working prototypes to validate concepts with partners.

- Manage the end-to-end AI model evaluation process with our model partners, coordinating with R&D to secure early access, align on evaluation criteria and timelines, and translate results into partnership and product roadmap decisions.

- Design and facilitate partner workshops, architecture reviews, and cloud financial management (FinOps) sessions, bringing in the right participants and documenting outcomes and next steps.

- Build business cases for joint technical efforts, defining expected gains, costs, and resources, and securing agreement from partner managers, R&D, and leadership.

- Bring partner requirements and technical feedback into Product and R&D discussions to influence product design and the roadmap.

- Coordinate Engineering, Product, FinOps, Finance, Sales, and Marketing with partner technical teams to move joint work from evaluation to delivery.

- Track cloud, AI, and DevSecOps developments to advise partnership investment, and share reusable findings through documentation, the handbook, reference architectures, and technical content.

 What You’ll Bring  

- Experience as a Senior Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Partner Engineer, or in a similar senior technical role. Experience with technology partners or alliances is strongly preferred.

- An end-to-end understanding of the software development lifecycle, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and DevSecOps, with the ability to use GitLab in depth.

- Hands-on cloud architecture experience with at least one hyperscaler: Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure. Cloud cost or FinOps experience is a plus.

- Working knowledge of AI model evaluation frameworks and agent technology, including large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs), agent frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how they fit into developer workflows.

- Experience designing and facilitating technical workshops with senior technical and business stakeholders, and building business cases that scope work, estimate gains and costs, and size resources.

- An autonomous, ownership-driven approach: you identify work and move it forward without waiting for a project backlog.

- Clear, concise written and spoken communication, adapting technical and commercial trade-offs for audiences from engineers to executives.

- Ability to travel about once a quarter and work hours that overlap with Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). If you're on the US West Coast, expect to start around 7 a.m. Pacific Time; when the day ends is flexible.

 About the team 

 You'll join Strategic Partnerships and report to the VP, Corporate Development and Strategic Partnerships. The team manages GitLab's relationships with hyperscalers, AI companies, and select DevSecOps companies, acting as the business owner and coordinating work across hosting contracts, product integrations, go-to-market activities, purchasing, and partner-specific marketing. Partner managers and directors lead each relationship; you'll own the technical side across partner types and collaborate with R&D, Engineering, FinOps, Finance, Sales, and Marketing. The role is remote, with Eastern Time preferred and other US time zones possible.

 How GitLab will support you 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off  

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental leave  

- Home office support

 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits.  About the role 

 We're looking for a Senior Solution Data & AI Architect to join our growing team!

 Why join us? 

 We believe great architecture is about much more than technology. It's about enabling innovation, empowering teams, solving meaningful business problems, and building platforms that scale for the future.
 As a Senior Solution Data & AI Architect, you'll work with talented engineering teams, data scientists, and business leaders to shape the next generation of data and AI capabilities. You'll have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, explore emerging technologies, and help transform ambitious ideas into production-ready solutions that deliver real business value.

 If you're passionate about AI, cloud platforms, modern architecture, and helping teams succeed, we'd love to meet you.

 What you'll do here: 

 Design architecture that delivers business value: 

- Lead the architecture and design of Data, AI, and GenAI solutions supporting strategic business initiatives.

- Create solution architectures, architecture blueprints, design patterns, and implementation roadmaps that guide delivery teams from concept to production.

- Ensure architectures are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.

- Translate business requirements into practical, actionable solution designs.
 Shape the evolution of our Data & AI platforms: 

- Drive adoption of modern architectural approaches including cloud-native, event-driven, API-first, and serverless patterns where appropriate.

- Design AI and machine learning architectures, orchestration, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance capabilities.

- Help define reusable platform services, reference architectures, and technical standards that accelerate delivery across multiple products.

- Assess emerging technologies, industry trends, and market solutions to identify opportunities that create business value.
 Provide technical leadership across delivery teams: 

- Partner closely with product, engineering, data, security, and platform teams to guide architecture decisions throughout the delivery lifecycle.

- Lead architecture discussions with senior technology and business leaders and help shape strategic technology decisions.

- Facilitate architecture reviews and provide architectural oversight for complex initiatives.

- Help teams navigate technical trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and implementation challenges.

- Promote engineering excellence and architectural consistency while enabling teams to innovate.
 Drive architecture practices and standards: 

- Contribute to architecture governance, principles, standards, and best practices across the Data and AI ecosystem.

- Foster alignment across multiple product teams through reusable patterns, reference architectures, common services, and shared architectural approaches that accelerate delivery while reducing complexity.

- Lead technology assessments, proof of concepts, and build-versus-buy evaluations to support strategic technology decisions and platform investments.

- Perform risk assessments and build-versus-buy analyses and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
 Mentor and influence: 

- Coach and mentor architects, engineers, and technical leaders.

- Advocate for architecture quality, simplicity, maintainability, and operational excellence.

- Build strong partnerships across teams and help create a collaborative architecture community.

- Act as a trusted advisor who can challenge assumptions and guide teams toward better outcomes.

 What you bring to the table: 

 Experience: 

- 10+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Data Architecture, Application Architecture, or related technology leadership roles.

- Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data-driven solutions in cloud environments.

- Track record of successfully leading architecture for complex, cross-functional initiatives.

- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country. 

- No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.
 Data & AI architecture expertise: 

- Experience designing modern Data and AI architectures

- Strong understanding of data platform architecture, data integration patterns, and large-scale data processing.

- Experience defining architecture patterns for AI and ML solutions, including experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and operationalization.

- Familiarity with GenAI architectures, orchestration frameworks, retrieval patterns, AI agents, and model integration approaches.

- Experience with AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Databricks, Apache Iceberg, LangChain and LangGraph, Snowflake.
 Cloud and engineering foundations: 

- Strong knowledge of AWS cloud services and cloud-native architecture patterns.

- Experience with event-driven architectures, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, MLOps, observability, and automation practices.
 Leadership and collaboration: 

- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

- Strong experience working with Agile product and delivery teams.

- Natural collaborator who enjoys mentoring others and building consensus around architectural direction.

- Ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams and organizational boundaries.

- Ability to balance business value, technical excellence, cost, risk, and delivery objectives.

 The NetSuite Certification Program Manager provides progressive, role-based credentials that validate a candidate's ability to apply NetSuite leading practices, from foundational Associate certifications through advanced Professional-level expertise. The Senior Exam Development Program Manager shapes the strategy, governance, and operating model that sustain this global credential portfolio. 

 We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Senior Program Manager to lead the strategy, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of NetSuite certification exams and related credentials. This role partners with senior leaders, subject matter experts, product teams, Customer Education, assessment vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure exams are valid, reliable, secure, scalable, and legally defensible. 

 The ideal candidate is a strategic program leader and exceptionally strong executor who can lead a broad portfolio of exam-development workstreams, establish rigorous governance and documentation standards, navigate complex dependencies, and drive work through to closure. They bring deep expertise in professional certification programs, credential governance, exam-development practices, and assessment quality, along with the influence and judgment to guide high-impact decisions across the team. 

 Responsibilities 

 Key Responsibilities 

- 
 Execute on the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end lifecycle governance for the NetSuite certification exam portfolio, from initiation through release, maintenance, and retirement 

- 
 Own delivery planning across multiple concurrent certification initiatives, establishing priorities, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risk registers, and stakeholder reporting 

- 
 Define and maintain scalable frameworks, standards, tools, and operating rhythms for job task analyses, exam blueprints, item development, review, approval, release readiness, and post-launch maintenance 

- 
 Ensure assessment quality, collaborating with psychometric and assessment vendors on item performance analysis, standard-setting activities, and defensible credential decisions 

- 
 Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and senior subject matter experts to translate product strategy, customer needs, and role requirements into high-quality certification assessments 

- 
 Apply rigorous governance for exam content, credential requirements, and approvals. 

- 
 Monitor product releases, candidate feedback, and exam-performance insights to identify, prioritize, and drive required credential and exam updates 

- 
 Ensure certification exams and related materials accurately reflect current product functionality, role-based competencies, and leading practices across the credential portfolio 

- 
 Drive resolution of complex risks, issues, and dependencies; facilitate decision-making, ensure clear ownership, and escalate blockers or platform defects when needed 

- 
 Build and maintain portfolio health reporting, dashboards, and decision-ready insights on delivery status, quality, risks, candidate outcomes, and maintenance priorities 

- 
 Practice responsible use of AI technologies to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making as well as improve exam development operations. 

 Qualifications 

- 
 6+ years of experience in certification exam development and certification programs, including experience leading complex programs or portfolios 

- 
 Bachelor's degree in education, learning and development, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience 

- 
 Proven success leading job task analyses, training and guiding item writers, facilitating technical reviews with senior subject matter experts, and participating in or leading standard-setting exercises 

- 
 Strong knowledge of psychometrics, assessment quality, exam development, and certification-industry standards, with the ability to apply that expertise to high-stakes credential decisions 

- 
 Demonstrated ability to define portfolio strategy, apply governance and operating frameworks, and execute across multiple concurrent, interdependent initiatives 

- 
 Significant experience partnering across product, education, technical, vendor, and senior leadership teams to translate business priorities into clear requirements, actionable plans and measurable deliverables 

- 
 Demonstrated experience managing complex delivery plans, management-level status reporting, risks and dependencies, decision tracking, and stakeholder communications 

- 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and explain complex assessment, credential, and program decisions clearly 

- 
 Ability to travel up to 10% of the time 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- 
 Professional certification in program or project management, assessment, credentialing, or a related discipline 

- 
 Familiarity with enterprise software training programs 

- 
 Experience leading certification programs for enterprise software, cloud technology, or professional services audiences 

- 
 Expertise with credentialing models, certification frameworks, assessment quality standards, exam maintenance, and exam-security practices 

- 
 Strong command of developing exam blueprints, item-writing workflows, managing subject matter experts, exam forms, standard setting, and psychometric analysis 

- 
 Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify systemic risks, inconsistencies, and process gaps and turn findings into scalable solutions 

- 
 Proven analytical skills and experience using dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and data visualization to guide portfolio decisions 

- 
 Proficiency with item-banking tools such as Webassessor and Item Workshop 

- 
 Experience using AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve program operations, assessment quality, and decision-making

phenom:RBCAA0088:R-0000186402.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 

 Deploying AI at scale in Canada's largest bank is the opportunity of a lifetime. This role focuses on one of the most critical enablers of AI at RBC, connecting deep evaluation of agents' performance and accuracy with the risk-based governance that allows AI to be enabled for safe use.

 Own product strategy for the evaluations and governance capabilities that let the bank build and scale agentic AI responsibly — the layer that assesses AI system quality and safety before and after deployment, and turns those assessments into risk and compliance reporting that business leaders across the bank can act on. This is the single accountable product leader for a capability area that sits at the center of how the bank governs its growing AI footprint, partnering closely with engineering leadership, risk, and compliance stakeholders to keep pace with an area that's evolving quickly both technically and regulatorily.

 What will you do? 
 Product Strategy & Roadmap 

- Own end-to-end product strategy and a multi-year roadmap for the evaluations and governance capability area, prioritized against business risk, regulatory need, and platform adoption

- Lead discovery and requirements definition, translating input from engineering, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders into clear product requirements

- Own portfolio-level prioritization and sequencing across the capability area's roadmap, balancing near-term regulatory/compliance needs against longer-term platform investment

- Evaluate build-vs-buy-vs-partner options for evaluation and governance tooling, weighing internal investment against third-party solutions

 Delivery Partnership 

- Partner with engineering and architecture leadership on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs, converging on a plan both sides can commit to

- Work with the project-management function to convert prioritized requirements into a funded, scheduled program of work

- Stay engaged through delivery, resolving product-scope questions and re-planning trade-offs as they arise

 Stakeholder & Business Engagement 

- Represent the capability area to risk, audit, and compliance stakeholders across the bank's business lines

- Serve as the primary product voice to senior leadership on the health and trajectory of the capability area

- Represent product considerations within architecture reviews, governance forums, and vendor evaluations

- Partner with adjacent product and engineering leaders across the platform so requirements are considered early, not retrofitted later

 Launch & Value Input 

- Help define value messaging and target user personas for the capability area's launches, in partnership with your peer Principal for go-to-market

- Define and track success metrics for the capability area and use them to inform ongoing prioritization

- Contribute the capability area's inputs into the broader business case articulating value delivered

 People Leadership 

- Build, mentor, and lead a team of product managers focused on evaluations and governance, giving them ownership of their individual areas

- Help your team apply consistent discovery, prioritization, and delivery practices as they build out their own areas

- Foster a culture of iterative delivery, understanding of user needs, and decision-making backed by data

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must-have: 

- 10+ years of product management experience, including several years focused on risk, compliance, safety, or governance-oriented technology products or services

- Demonstrated experience delivering production AI/ML systems in an enterprise environment, including hands-on experience with LLM API integration (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent) and direct ownership of how those systems are tested, evaluated, or monitored for quality and risk

- Experience operating in a regulated industry (e.g., financial services, healthcare, government) with direct exposure to audit and regulatory review processes

- Strong technical foundation — able to engage credibly with engineers and architects on system design, API integration patterns (authentication, rate limiting, observability), data pipelines, and vector database/retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture as it relates to evaluating AI system outputs

- Excellent communication skills, with proven ability to represent a complex technical and risk-related agenda credibly to both senior executives and engineering teams

- University degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, or related), or equivalent experience

 Nice-to-have: 

- Experience leading and developing other product managers, or a track record of stepping into a people-leadership role from an individual-contributor/lead-level product position

- Demonstrated experience building products that convert regulatory or audit requirements into automated processes or tooling

- Experience defining shared interfaces or working agreements between two or more engineering teams building interdependent systems

- Prior experience specifically with AI safety, model risk management, or automated evaluation of AI/ML systems, rather than general software QA/compliance

- Experience with observability or monitoring platforms for distributed or ML-based systems

- Familiarity with AI-specific financial-services regulatory and risk-management frameworks (e.g., OSFI Guideline E-23, NIST AI RMF, SR 26-2, ISO/IEC 42001) — familiarity with the direction these are heading is more relevant than hands-on implementation experience, since several (e.g., OSFI E-23) are not yet in force Experience standing up a net-new function inside a scaling organization, rather than in a steady-state team

 What's in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

- A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable

- Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

- Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

- Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team

- A world-class training program in financial services

- Flexible work/life balance options

- Opportunities to do challenging work

 About the AI Group 
 RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations.

 Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment 
 RBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodations during the application process are available upon request.

 Propósito 

 El Director, Digital Product Owner, plataforma Scotia Protect es responsable de liderar la gestión de productos empresariales y la ejecución de hoja de ruta de la plataforma ScotiaProtect a través de los mercados de la banca internacional. La persona a cargo establecerá una visión integral de las prioridades de la plataforma, traducirá las necesidades del mercado y de los clientes en soluciones digitales escalables e impulsará una ejecución exitosa mediante la colaboración con los países, las áreas de Digital, Tecnología, Operaciones, Datos, Riesgos y Cumplimiento y los equipos de las aseguradoras aliadas. 

 Esta función es responsable de lo siguiente: adopción de la plataforma, gobernanza de la ejecución, preparación para lanzamientos, materialización del valor esperado y evolución continua de la plataforma, garantizando al mismo tiempo la alineación con los objetivos empresariales, los requisitos regulatorios y las necesidades de los mercados locales. 

 Lo que hará 

 Estrategia de productos principales y ejecución de la hoja de ruta 

- Liderar y ejecutar la hoja de ruta de la plataforma ScotiaProtect en los mercados de banca internacional, traduciendo las prioridades estratégicas en funcionalidades de la plataforma, nuevas versiones e implementaciones en los distintos mercados. 

- Gestionar y priorizar el backlog del producto, equilibrando las necesidades del mercado, el valor empresarial y la capacidad de ejecución. 

- Definir medidas de éxito y resultados empresariales para apoyar el crecimiento y la escalabilidad de la plataforma. 

 Estandarización de la plataforma Drive e implementación en los distintos mercados 

- Impulsar la adopción de funcionalidades reutilizables de la plataforma y componentes compartidos en los distintos mercados. 

- Trabajar conjuntamente con los equipos de seguros y banca minorista de cada país para definir las estrategias de implementación, los recorridos del cliente, los modelos operativos y los planes de lanzamiento. 

- Promover la normalización y la simplificación teniendo en cuenta las necesidades específicas de cada mercado local cuando corresponda. 

 Gestionar la ejecución y la implementación 

- Liderar la gobernanza integral de la plataforma, lo que incluye planificación, gestión de hitos, seguimiento de dependencias y presentación de informes ejecutivos. 

- Garantizar que los requerimientos de la empresa, los recorridos del cliente, los procesos operativos y los entregables del proyecto estén claramente definidos y se gestionen a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto. 

- Identificar y mitigar los riesgos de ejecución que puedan afectar el alcance, los plazos, la calidad o los resultados de la empresa. 

- Fomentar la adopción de prácticas ágiles de gestión de productos entre equipos multidisciplinarios para lograr una ejecución eficaz y eficiente. 

 Desarrollar alianzas estratégicas 

- Colaborar con aseguradoras aliadas, proveedores, partes interesadas de cada país, equipos de tecnología y líderes de la empresa para impulsar la implementación y adopción de la plataforma. 

- Comunicar la estrategia, las prioridades, los avances, los riesgos y las decisiones a la alta dirección y a las organizaciones aliadas. 

- Desarrollar y mantener relaciones fuertes que apoyen la ejecución exitosa de la plataforma y el crecimiento a largo plazo. 

 Garantizar la gestión del riesgo y la capacidad operacional 

- Trabajar conjuntamente con los equipos de Riesgos, Cumplimiento, Privacidad, Asuntos legales, Seguridad, Tecnología y Operaciones para garantizar que los controles y mecanismos de gobernanza adecuados estén incorporados en todas las etapas de la ejecución. 

- Apoyar la preparación para el lanzamiento mediante realización de pruebas, capacitación, preparación operativa, planificación de soporte técnico y seguimiento posterior al lanzamiento. 

- Garantizar el cumplimiento de los requisitos regulatorios aplicables, los estándares de riesgo operativo y las políticas internas. 

 Resultados basados en datos 

- Establecer y monitorear indicadores clave de desempeño, incluidos adopción digital, experiencia del cliente, desempeño operativo, estado de la ejecución y materialización del valor para la empresa. 

- Aprovechar los conocimientos sobre los clientes y la retroalimentación del mercado para mejorar continuamente las funcionalidades de la plataforma y la experiencia del usuario. 

- Trabajar conjuntamente con los equipos de Finanzas y Analítica para alinear las inversiones contempladas en la hoja de ruta con las prioridades estratégicas y los resultados esperados para la empresa. 

 Liderar y desarrollar equipos de alto desempeño 

- Construir, entrenar y desarrollar un equipo de gestión de productos de alto desempeño. 

- Fomentar una cultura colaborativa, inclusiva y de alto desempeño centrada en innovación, rendición de cuentas mejora continua. 

- Apoyar la planificación de la sucesión, el desarrollo de talentos y la excelencia en la gestión de productos en toda la organización.

Requisition ID: 276237 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior Program Manager, Program Management, Strategy Planning & Execution is a senior transformation leader responsible for driving the Bank's largest, most complex and strategically significant change initiatives. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is accountable for translating business strategy into executable transformation roadmaps, governance structures, and delivery approaches. 

 As a trusted advisor to executive sponsors and senior leaders, the Senior Program Manager influences strategic decisions, facilitates alignment across multiple business units, and proactively manages enterprise-wide risks, dependencies, and competing priorities. The role is expected to navigate ambiguity, shape delivery strategy, and resolve complex challenges to ensure transformational outcomes are achieved. 

 In addition to leading program execution, the Senior Program Manager contributes to the advancement of Strategy Planning & Execution by providing guidance, coaching, and thought leadership to Program Managers and project teams, helping strengthen program management capability across Canadian Banking. 

 The Senior Program Manager oversees a broad portfolio of initiatives that may span multiple functions, business lines or strategic objectives. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will:   

- Champions a client focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge. 

- Strategic Leadership & Governance; Manage program objectives, scope, and success metrics aligned with organizational strategy. Follow governance frameworks, support steering committees, and decision-making protocols. Provide executive-level reporting on program health, risks and issues. 

- Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management: Influence and align senior executives, sponsors, and business leaders across multiple functions to drive consensus on priorities, funding, scope, sequencing, and delivery outcomes. Resolve complex stakeholder conflicts and navigate competing interests to maintain program momentum. 

- Planning & Delivery: Lead the delivery of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives spanning multiple business units, functions, and strategic priorities. Establish integrated delivery roadmaps, manage complex interdependencies, and ensure execution remains aligned to enterprise objectives while balancing cost, risk, and business value. 

- Risks & Issue Management: Anticipate emerging risks, organizational impacts, and systemic delivery constraints before they materialize. Develop mitigation strategies, facilitate executive decisions, and drive resolution of high-impact issues that could affect strategic outcomes, customer experience, financial performance, or regulatory commitments. 

- Communication & Change Management; Deliver concise, executive-ready updates and presentations focused on insights and decisions. Champion change initiatives/management, ensuring stakeholder buy-in and adoption of new processes. 

- Leadership & Capability Building: Serve as a recognized leader within Strategy Planning & Execution by promoting delivery excellence, sharing best practices, and providing coaching and guidance to Program Managers and project teams. Contribute to the continuous improvement of program delivery methodologies, governance practices, reporting standards, and transformation operating models. 

- Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions. 

- Actively pursue effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk. 

- Champion a high performance environment and contributes to an inclusive work environment. 

 Dimensions   

- Number of employees / span of control – none 

- Countries / regions  / business units supported – focus on Canadian Banking 

- Financial dimensions (e.g., capital budget, annual project cost, operating budget, etc.) - budgets between $5-$15 MM 

- Number of programs/portfolio/ Number of systems – varies 

- Regulatory bodies and special requirements – familiarity with Canadian Banking regulatory bodies 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role?  We’d love to work with you if you have:      

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or related field; MBA preferred 

- 7 years of experience in program management, valued at over $5MM 

- Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, or MSP are highly desirable 

- Expert knowledge in the financial sector, banking regulations and related regulatory requirements 

- Ability to lead multiple programs at the same time, weighing often conflicting priorities, and delivering results 

- Influence to ensure priority change initiatives are understood, obtaining Executive and stakeholder buy-in 

- Strong communication skills with sound interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to resolve escalated issues effectively to reduce business impact 

- Excellent organization skills and effective coaching skills to foster development of others 

 Working Conditions   

- Primary location will be in Toronto. Limited travel domestically.

Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver) 

 Job Description: 
 Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

 As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

 The opportunity: 

- Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.

- Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.

- Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.

- Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.

- SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.

 Key Responsibilities: 

- Deliver SafeSend.  Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.

- Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy.  Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer

- Componentize the portfolio.  Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.

- Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration.  Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.

- Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel.  Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.

 What success looks like: 

- Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.

- The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.

- Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.

- Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.

 Required Qualifications: 

- 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.

- Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.

- A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.

- Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.

- Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.

- Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred

- Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-processing workflows.

- Experience partnering with large, demanding enterprise customers as design partners.

- Comfort owning commercially consequential product decisions.

- Advanced business or technical degree preferred

Company Description
Acumatica is a company on a mission. We are a leading innovator in cloud ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions with growing businesses worldwide. But don’t take our word for it—read what analysts like G2, IDC, Nucleus Research, and Info-Tech have to say about us.
Acumatica is different by design and purposely built to help small and midsized companies thrive in today’s digital economy. Our industry-specific business management solution is engineered to address real-world needs—featuring intelligent workflows and market-leading usability that enable companies to manage risk, anticipate disruption, and seize new opportunities. Our principled business practices, growth-friendly licensing, and flexible deployment options put organizations in control of their own future. Acumatica is more than just a product—we are a community of partners, customers, and creators committed to elevating business performance. Our ecosystem is driven by collaboration, merging leading technology and real-world insights to put organizations control of their future. In May of 2025, Acumatica was acquired by Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm focused on enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses.
Acumatica’s culture is collaborative and high-energy. We are passionate about our product and our mission, and we are loyal to each other and our company. We value work/life balance, efficiency, simplicity, freakishly friendly customer service, and making a difference in the world. Acumatica offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about Acumatica’s mission, please visit: [http://www.acumatica.com.](http://www.acumatica.com./)
Job Description
Acumatica's Product Marketing team is looking for a strategic Product Marketer to own the product marketing for our QuickBooks Graduates program — the positioning, messaging, and content strategy that helps growing small businesses "graduate" from QuickBooks to a modern, cloud ERP platform. You have proven experience in ERP or SMB accounting/finance software, and a strong point of view on why and when small businesses outgrow QuickBooks. You'll craft compelling, differentiated messaging that speaks to QuickBooks users at the exact moment they're hitting the ceiling of their current system, and you'll tailor that story to the industries where those breaking points show up most: construction, manufacturing, distribution, professional services, and their related micro-verticals. This role is a full-time opportunity reporting directly to the VP of Product Marketing.
Primary Responsibilities:
QuickBooks Graduates Positioning & Storytelling
Own the positioning and messaging that fuels the QuickBooks Graduates program, working alongside marketing teams, sales, and partner teams who drive its broader execution. Shape clear, compelling narratives that translate product functionality into meaningful business value for small businesses that have outgrown QuickBooks — helping prospects understand not just what Acumatica does differently, but why it matters at their stage of growth, while clearly differentiating our cloud ERP platform from QuickBooks and other SMB accounting and.ERP tools.
Industry & Micro-Vertical Messaging
Go beyond a one-size-fits-all QuickBooks-replacement narrative. Build and maintain positioning and content that applies the QuickBooks Graduates story to our targeted industries — construction, manufacturing, distribution, and professional services — and their related micro-verticals, so messaging speaks directly to the specific triggers, workflows, and pain points that push each industry beyond QuickBooks.
Thought Leadership & Market Insight
Create differentiated thought leadership assets, messaging, and positioning that establish Acumatica as the trusted destination for growing QuickBooks customers. Ground our storytelling in an ideal customer profile — the QuickBooks user hitting the limits of their system — along with industry and market insights, to ensure our communications deeply resonate with real-world growing pains: multi-entity complexity, inventory and job costing limitations, lack of automation, and reporting gaps.
Go-to-Market Leadership
Work collaboratively with the broader marketing organization to support end-to-end go-to-market strategies for QuickBooks Graduates campaigns.
Customer-Centered Narratives
Partner with our customer advocacy team to review and elevate customer stories and videos from businesses that made the switch from QuickBooks, weaving authentic, real-world outcomes — by industry — into marketing assets. Use customer evidence to build trust, credibility, and emotional connection across the buyer journey.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work hand-in-hand with product, sales, and industry/vertical teams to stay aligned on roadmaps, priorities, and upcoming capabilities relevant to QuickBooks migration. Serve as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring marketing materials accurately reflect product evolution while amplifying shared goals.
Data-Informed Strategy
Leverage performance data and analytics to guide QuickBooks Graduates marketing strategies, evolve content, and evaluate campaign effectiveness by industry segment, and continuously refine our approach — balancing insight with creativity to drive stronger outcomes.
Content Experiences & Demos
Create engaging video scripts and perform light video edits in collaboration with professional design and video partners. Develop polished QuickBooks-comparison and product overview videos, along with intuitive, point-and-click demos that bring key workflows and "how-to" scenarios to life for growing businesses in our targeted industries.
Marketing Enablement
Maintain and evolve core QuickBooks Graduates assets — including website messaging, comparison guides, datasheets, infographics, brochures etc. — for both the overarching program and its industry-specific variants, to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy. Support release planning and help keep internal and external teams aligned on positioning as offerings grow and change.
Events, Speaking & Community Engagement
Support industry trade shows and events with strong messaging and content targeted at QuickBooks users evaluating a move to ERP. Contribute to partner and customer events through presentations, webinars, and thought leadership sessions — including opportunities to present live — sharing Acumatica's vision and expertise with confidence and authenticity.
Messaging and Positioning
Translate functionality and benefits into real value that resonate with small business buyers, tailoring that value story to both the overarching QuickBooks Graduates program and its industry-specific extensions.
Qualifications
Experience: A minimum of three to five years of product marketing experience is required. At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Revenue team 

 The Revenue team drives Affirm's top-line growth through strategic partnerships, growth initiatives, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm's products.

 About the Role 

 GTM Strategy & Operations takes product and pricing initiatives and creates commercially viable, operationally sound go-to-market motions. We partner with Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Rev Ops, and Pricing to design rollout groups, coordinate implementation, and equip the field — CSMs, AEs, and TAMs — with the processes they need to create world-class go-to-market. 

 As an individual contributor, the Lead owns the go-to-market operations for a specific product line or segment end to end. You're handed the objective and you decide how to execute: building the target lists, assigning appropriate account actions, segmenting customers by contractual and pricing eligibility, and tracking adoption. You turn high-level product and pricing inputs into a plan a rep can actually execute.

 What You'll Do 

- 
 Own go-to-market operations for field teams executing on strategic initiatives — segmenting potential customers and managing the legal and pricing operations.

- 
 Turn inputs from cross-functional stakeholders like Product, Legal, Risk, and Pricing into an executable process.

- 
 Manage Affirm’s first-in-class AI contract dashboard for field teams to understand legal and pricing eligibility for product initiatives.

- 
 Build and maintain the tools and playbooks the field needs for strategic initiatives, including contract renewal planning, pricing standardization, and new product GTM.

- 
 Fluently navigate different perspectives on the same launch — the exec "why it matters," the customer value proposition, and the field-facing analysis.

- 
 Sit close to the field, and turn what you hear into recommendations for cross-functional teams.

- 
 Analyze performance data to find where a launch is stalling, and flag risks early.

 What We Look For 

- 
 6+ years of experience in business operations, revenue or sales operations, ideally in FinTech, SaaS, or another high-growth environment.

- 
 A track record of owning a go-to-market motion or customer-facing initiative end to end, rollout through adoption, within a defined scope.

- 
 You've been handed vague "go make this work" instructions, then built a solution that resonated with stakeholders and customers.

- 
 Experience working cross-functionally with Product, PMM, Client Success, Sales, Analytics, Legal, or Pricing.

- 
 Comfort translating product and pricing strategy into practical, field-ready execution.

- 
 Solid analytical instincts: you use adoption and performance data to decide what to do next, not just to report what happened.

- 
 Clear, action-oriented writing and speaking.

- 
 You do your best work in ambiguity and move fast without waiting to be told the approach.

- 
 Familiarity with merchant, payments, or SaaS sales motions is a must-have.

- 
 Experience using SQL to query, manipulate, and analyze data to support business insights and decision-making.

- 
 Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to improve workflows, automate processes, and drive efficiency, with an understanding of how to apply and validate AI-generated outputs.

 Pay Grade - K 
Equity Grade - 4 

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you 
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

 About You 

 AppDirect sits at the center of that shift, the infrastructure connecting technology sellers to the partners and marketplaces where buyers actually transact. This role drives the product strategy that, in collaboration with engineering, go-to-market, and other cross-functional partners, turns that position into growth: more products distributed, more sellers succeeding on the platform, more GMV/NMV flowing through it. The mandate is to find the highest-leverage bets in distribution (catalog reach, discoverability, partner and co-sell motions, packaging and incentives) and ship them, with a team you lead and outcomes you own.

 You’re a product leader who’s energized by the mechanics of technology distribution: how products get found, chosen, and bought at scale. You’ve built and scaled products in marketplace, cloud, commerce, or platform environments, and you know how to turn partner ecosystems into measurable revenue.

 You're commercially sharp and credible in a room with senior stakeholders at companies like Amazon or Microsoft, but you're also close enough to the details to make hard product calls yourself. You lead through clarity and outcomes, and you use AI as a working system to move faster, sharpen judgment, and build a real point of view on how AI is reshaping software distribution and buying behavior.

 What You’ll Do and How You’ll Have an Impact 

- Run the product strategy. Set the product vision and roadmap for AppDirect’s partner integration and Tackle offerings to help sellers with go-to-market across a broad ecosystem, and lead a team of PMs against a clear mandate: grow NMV and GMV across the platform.

- Find and pull the growth levers. Identify what actually drives adoption, conversion, and sales of distributed products, then ship the work that moves those metrics. Strengthen the pathways AppDirect can provide sellers to reach market: catalog reach, discoverability, partner channels, co-sell motions.

- Build with the biggest players in the industry. Partner directly with large cloud providers and strategic technology partners, translating their priorities and AppDirect's opportunity into product bets that create mutual growth.

- Align the company around distribution and partner selling opportunities. Work across multiple teams such as Engineering, Design, Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to keep the org rowing toward the priorities that compound distribution advantage.

 What We’re Looking For 

- 6+ years in product management, with meaningful time in B2B platforms, marketplaces, cloud, commerce, or distribution

- 3+ years leading and developing product managers

- A track record of owning products or portfolios that drove material revenue, GMV/NMV, or marketplace growth

- Strong commercial judgment across distribution economics: packaging, incentives, partner motions, growth loops

- The range to operate at strategy level and execution level, with the communication and influence to move executives, partners, and cross-functional teams

- Proven experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP, Salesforce), SaaS/ISV distribution, or multi-party commerce

- AI-pilled approach and perspective on how AI changes technology sales and distribution

- A bias for experimentation, measurable impact, and action over polish

 Preferred qualifications 

- Depth in marketplace systems: catalog, discovery, conversion, billing, entitlements, and/or co-sell

- Experience applying AI to product discovery, seller tooling, personalization, forecasting, or marketplace optimization

 About AppDirect 

 Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world.  AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service.  We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations.  We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

 About you 

 As a Product Marketing Manager at AppDirect, you will craft and execute go-to-market plans for our procurement suite – the subscription commerce platform built to serve two distinct audiences at once: the technology advisors who sell from our platform, and the companies who purchase and manage that technology. Some days you will use your right-brain skills to conceive and develop innovative sales enablement and demand generation programs, or craft compelling stories that position our procurement suite and drive sales. Other days, you will go left-brain with your analytical skills to conduct in-depth market research and win/loss analysis that helps our product teams prioritize roadmap plans and shape launch strategies. You have attention to detail and can translate complex ideas into compelling stories for both audiences – representing what buyers need to purchase and manage technology, and what advisors need to sell and close. You will work on the Procurement Product Marketing team. 

 What you'll do and how you'll make an impact 

- Own the go-to-market strategy for our procurement suite's product launches, from positioning and success criteria through cross-functional execution.

- Be the expert on our buyers — how they purchase and what drives their decisions — and equally the expert on our technology advisors, how they sell, and what they need to successfully sell and manage solutions from our procurement suite.

- Partner closely with sales, marketing, product, PR, and executives to build and execute GTM plans, and work directly with sales enablement to identify and drive cross-sell and upsell within our existing customer base.

- Analyze sales, market, and customer data across audiences, translating findings into sales insights and input for roadmap prioritization, pricing, and improvements that drive adoption and retention.

- Uniquely message and position our solutions in-market, communicating their value to our sales team through dynamic, engaging sales enablement and content. 

- Plan the launch of new products and manage the cross-functional implementation of the launch plan.

- Develop pricing strategies for our solutions, including models that support bundling, cross-sell, and upsell.

- Define product marketing outcomes and success metrics tied to pipeline and revenue targets, and track performance against them.

 What we're looking for 

- 3+ years of consulting, channel/partner or product marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy.

- Experience in B2B SaaS is a strong plus.

- Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, or win/loss research, and translating findings into positioning, pricing, or roadmap recommendations.

- Comfort leveraging AI tools to shape GTM strategy and accelerate day-to-day work — from synthesizing data and market intelligence to drafting enablement content and positioning.

- Strong written and oral communication skills, with masterful storytelling range to speak to both end buyers and technology advisors; work samples will be requested and presentation skills tested via a live presentation.

- Detail-oriented and comfortable turning data into compelling sales enablement insights and roadmap prioritization input, not just describing trends.

- A resourceful, resilient self-starter who thrives with minimal guidance — you'll take true ownership of your projects in a fast-paced environment.

- A fast learner who can pick up a new market segment in days and a new technology in hours, and who's curious about what comes next.

- Comfortable working across sales, product, engineering, PR, marketing, and executive leadership to research, plan, and execute your work.

- B2B software experience, product-led growth (PLG) experience, and experience or strong interest in partnering with sales/sales enablement teams on expansion motions (cross-sell, upsell) are all a plus.

Company Description
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.
At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.
Job Description
Who You’ll Work With
Are you a top-tier Technical Support Engineer with a passion for solving customer problems? At Arista, we are obsessed with making our customers successful and believe that giving our customers direct access to a top-level engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, helps streamline the support process and nurture customer success.
We are seeking world-class technical solutions engineers (TSE) to come join our team, to help support our products and solutions. A TSE at Arista is equivalent to a Tier 3 TAC or Escalation Engineer in most support organizations. We drive the success of our customers through passion and teamwork and via ensuring quick response times. You will work with a diverse, multicultural team of top-notch engineers who act as our customers’ champions. You will also work closely with members of software/hardware engineering, product management, customer engineering and sales teams. The team culture is one of collaboration among highly technical individuals, as we work as One Team to deliver the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
What You’ll Do
The ideal candidate possesses the ability to troubleshoot complex and dynamic Hyperscaler customer environments, including networks built to support AI and accelerated computing workloads, while balancing the communications needs of each case. A strong analytical mind is required, as is the ability to triage. As we are continually releasing new features and products, a high aptitude for both learning and teaching are required.

ashby:ashby:390e266b-4b6c-4490-ad74-05ff.description:
Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/all/a-letter-from-chris-geoghegan-on-joining-ashby I’m looking for a growth-oriented product manager to help users onboard and expand their usage of the product.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles (more on that below). As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!




THE CHALLENGE

The surface area of our flagship ATS product is growing, and we are launching new products. This means customers are less likely to organically adopt the things that create value for them.

Historically, onboarding has been human-driven by our amazing Customer Success team https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/customer-success. And now, we’re ready to productize our learnings. As Ashby grows, we need a single owner who can think deeply about the customer journey and design the product and email experiences that help users achieve their desired outcomes and get the most out of Ashby.

This isn’t just about onboarding individuals. It requires thinking about how to onboard organizations with different roles and stakeholders with different goals. It’s going to be a fun challenge.




WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

 - Customer Journey: This role isn’t focused on conversion rate optimization or running A/B tests. Instead, you’ll gain a deep understanding of the entire Customer Journey. Then you’ll design a thoughtful onboarding experience for each role, prioritizing how we can use the product and email to help users at different stages.

 - Product Led Growth: You’ll spearhead our product-led growth motion by working closely with our Customer Success team. They own our human-led onboarding and, in many respects, have designed the first version of this. You’ll also own transactional email (i.e. email triggered by product signals) as it is an extension of the product experience.

 - Adoption Metrics: This is our first-ever product team focused on growth and onboarding, so you’ll be responsible for defining and tracking key metrics to assess whether our onboarding experience helps customers realize value sooner. We have a small but mighty data team that you’ll partner with, but for the most part, you’ll be responsible for defining and analyzing these growth metrics yourself.

 - Product Qualified Leads: You’ll also work closely with our Revenue Operations team to figure out the bridge between product signals that initiate go-to-market activity. You’ll own the definition of a Product Qualified Lead (PQL) and work with the RevOps team to determine how to route them.

 - User Experience: Finally, you’ll own changes to features to make onboarding easier and drive adoption. If you think changing how a given feature works is critical to making onboarding easier, it isn’t off limits. Eventually, we’ll want you to create frameworks and consult with other product teams to help them drive adoption for their product areas.




YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You’ve owned onboarding, expansion, or growth for a B2B SaaS product

 - You have strong product taste, and you think of growth as more art than science

 - You’ve built a growth strategy rooted in principled thinking, research, and data

 - You can show evidence of driving long-term growth results

 - You have an unnatural curiosity and excitement about the end-user and the jobs they do

 - Your written communication skills are excellent

 - You’ve developed product metrics deeply connected to customer value

 - You can point to exceptional relationships with customer success teams

 - You know how to coach and motivate high-agency engineers and drive urgency




WE WORK DIFFERENTLY

At Ashby, the role of Product Managers is different from what I’ve seen in most product orgs. At a high level, PMs are responsible for shipping impactful product changes at high velocity, consistently and over an extended period. When we think about impactful product changes, our primary goal is to remove frustration and add delight.

At many organizations, PMs are required to write detailed specs that handle every edge case. Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. This is reflected in the engineers Ashby hires: they own projects end-to-end and deeply understand the problems they are solving. PMs are expected to give significant white space in their specs. As a result, PMs can spend less time managing tickets and more time with customers and thinking deeply about the product strategy.

At Ashby, PMs need to be the pace-setters for their product areas. This means they bring a healthy level of impatience and time-paranoia to the table. This does not mean cutting corners or demanding that engineers work unreasonable hours. As a PM, you can help engineers by managing the project scope well, identifying when it’s appropriate to bring in help, or being ruthless about prioritization.

In particular for this role, we think it’s unlikely you’ll be able to A/B test your way to the right solution. We think it’s more likely to build great onboarding through deep thinking. A big part of that is research; you should expect to spend a significant amount of your time researching and understanding customer problems, and then a significant amount of time writing down your thinking.

Finally, Ashby isn’t simply an ATS. Right from the foundations, it was designed to be much more than that. It’s a platform modelled around how organizations (from early-stage startups to massive enterprises) think about recruiting, managing, and retaining top talent. As a PM at Ashby, you should, over time, get familiar with our most common building blocks. You’ll invest not only in product improvements but in platform thinking.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates that advance to the interview process here is what you can expect:

 1. Intro Call with Geo (VP, Product) - 30 mins

 2. Product Experience Deep Dive - 45 mins

 3. Assignment
    
    1. Prepare written assignment (expect to set aside ~2 hours)
    
    2. Present assignment - 60 mins

 4. Final Round Interview - 2 hours
    Mostly focused on cross-functional Interviews to meet more of the team. This is a critical hire for us and a role that will touch a lot of functions - we want to make sure you'll meet folks you'll be working closely with




BENEFITS

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.

 - If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

To request reasonable accommodations, please contact hiring@ashbyhq.com.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
