Req Id:  433121 

 Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.  

 We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell. 

 Summary 

 Bell's Fibe TV Product Management team is seeking a motivated individual to help define, deliver, and evolve the next generation of television and streaming experiences across Bell’s entertainment platforms. In this product leadership role, you will contribute to the strategy, roadmap, launch, and ongoing optimization of customer-facing television products across set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming devices, mobile applications, and web experiences.
 Working across Product, Technology, Digital, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, Business Intelligence, and external partners, you will help transform customer and business needs into scalable product solutions that improve customer satisfaction, drive business growth, and support Bell’s long-term television modernization strategy.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Product Roadmap & Strategy: Support the development and execution of the Fibe TV product roadmap, ensuring product initiatives align with customer needs, business objectives, competitive market trends, and long-term platform strategies.

- Product Definition & Requirements Management: Translate customer, operational, business, and technical requirements into clear product documentation, user journeys, business requirements, use cases, and acceptance criteria that guide solution design and delivery.

- Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Technology, Architecture, UX/UI, Digital, Marketing, Customer Care, Field Operations, Billing, Provisioning, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, and Business Intelligence teams to deliver integrated and sustainable product solutions.

- Platform Modernization & Service Evolution: Support strategic initiatives related to platform modernization, digital transformation, hardware-free television services, customer migrations, application enhancements, content integrations, and the continued evolution of Bell’s television platforms.

- Customer Experience Ownership: Participate in the design and validation of end-to-end customer journeys, ensuring product experiences are intuitive, reliable, and aligned with Bell’s customer experience objectives across acquisition, activation, viewing, billing, service management, and support interactions.

- Launch Readiness & Operational Excellence: Coordinate activities required to support successful product launches, including business readiness reviews, stakeholder alignment, risk assessments, operational readiness planning, customer communications, and production deployment activities.

- Testing, Validation & Quality Assurance: Plan and coordinate end-to-end testing activities, operational readiness testing, friendly user validations, defect triage, production monitoring, and issue resolution to ensure high-quality customer experiences and operational stability.

- Analytics & Performance Optimization: Monitor product performance through operational reporting, customer feedback, analytical insights, and business intelligence dashboards. Identify improvement opportunities and drive initiatives that enhance customer outcomes and business performance.

- Business Cases & Financial Governance: Support the development of business cases, investment analyses, benefit tracking, financial forecasts, and funding recommendations to help evaluate and prioritize product initiatives and strategic investments.

- Stakeholder Communications & Executive Reporting: Develop executive presentations, status updates, decision materials, risk assessments, and governance documentation that provide clear visibility into strategy, delivery progress, business outcomes, and key decisions.

 Critical Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Commerce, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline.

- 1 – 3 years of experience in product management, technical project management, telecommunications, digital products, media, technology delivery, or related fields.

- Demonstrated experience supporting the delivery of complex cross-functional initiatives from definition through implementation and post-launch support.

- Strong ability to translate business and technical concepts into actionable product requirements and stakeholder communications.

- Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate customer, operational, technical, and financial impacts.

- Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience collaborating with technical and business teams across diverse functions.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

- Proven ability to build alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities and objectives.

- Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and quality.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and Outlook.

- Ability to work effectively with English and French-speaking stakeholders across Canada.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience working within Agile product-delivery environments, including backlog management, sprint planning, and software-development lifecycles.

- Experience developing business cases, cost-benefit analyses, financial forecasts, or investment recommendations.

- Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and modern product-management tools.

- Experience with business intelligence, analytics, reporting platforms, or dashboarding tools.

- Experience documenting customer journeys, process flows, business requirements, or service designs.

- Knowledge of IPTV, streaming-video platforms, connected-TV applications, content aggregation, authentication, entitlements, billing, provisioning, or digital television services.

- Experience supporting regulatory, privacy, accessibility, or legal reviews.

- Experience working with external vendors, technology suppliers, or strategic partners.

- Bilingualism in English and French is considered an asset.

 Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.  

 Additional Information: 
 Position Type: Management  
Job Status:  Regular - Full Time  
Job Location: Canada : Ontario : Mississauga   
 Work Arrangement: Hybrid   
 Application Deadline: 10/30/2026   

 For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Bell office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Bell offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs. 

 Please apply directly online to be considered for this role.  Applications through email will not be accepted. 

 We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace. As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive compensation package that includes a competitive salary and a wide range of benefits to support the well-being of you and your family. As soon as you join us, you'll be eligible for medical, dental, vision and mental health benefits that you can tailor to your specific needs. Plus, as a Bell team member, you'll enjoy a 35% discount on our services and access exclusive offers from our partners.  

 At Bell, we are proud of our focus on fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all team members feel valued, respected, supported, and that they belong. 

 Bell is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise. We also want to make sure that everyone has an equal opportunity to join our team. We encourage individuals who may require accommodations during the hiring process to let us know. For a confidential inquiry, email your recruiter or  recruitment@bell.ca to make arrangements. If you have questions or feedback regarding accessibility at Bell, we invite you to complete the Accessibility feedback form   or visit our Accessibility page   for other ways to contact us. 

 Artificial intelligence may be used to assess parts of your application. Please review our privacy policy ( see Phenom for details ) to learn more about how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information.

ashby:benevity:a392c740-29e3-4e75-b7fc-a.description:
MEET BENEVITY

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!



As a seasoned product marketer and leader, you possess a knack for being able to identify business and market needs, conduct research and build strategic plans, craft compelling messaging and positioning, work directly with clients, and collaborate with teams across the business to bring game-changing products to the market. You see the big picture while managing seamless execution for your portfolio.


What you’ll do:

Team Leadership & Coaching

 - Mentor and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketers, providing regular coaching on core competencies such as messaging, GTM execution, and cross-functional influence.

 - Establish a culture of professional growth by creating tailored development plans that align individual career goals with company objectives.

 - Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, offering actionable feedback to help team members navigate complex projects and evolve their strategic thinking.

 - Define and prioritize the team’s roadmap, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across product launches, sales enablement, and demand generation efforts.

 - Standardize PMM workflows by implementing scalable processes for launch tiering, messaging frameworks, and competitive intelligence to ensure consistent quality across the team.

 - Act as a strategic influencer, navigating internal stakeholder dynamics and clearing hurdles to ensure the team can execute on-time and with high impact.

 - Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team.

 - Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market.

Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role)

 - Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas.

 - Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio.

 - Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level.

 - Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops.

 - Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.

 - A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.

 - Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy.

 - Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

 - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members.

 - An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing.

 - Outstanding presentation and business writing skills.


BONUS POINTS

 - Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits.


DISCOVER YOUR PURPOSE AT WORK

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.



WHERE WE WORK

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.



JOIN A COMPANY WHERE DEIB ISN’T A BUZZWORD

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Are you a strategic storyteller who thrives at the intersection of product, sales and marketing? Are you already thinking about how AI is influencing all three? As a Benevity Product Marketing Manager, you will be a driving force behind how Benevity solutions are positioned, launched and brought to market. You are equally comfortable digging into market research as you are crafting a compelling narrative. The blend of analytical rigor and creative instinct is what you thrive on when  translating complex product capabilities into simple, resonant, value-first messaging. You will work on both strategy and execution, partnering with Product, Pricing, Sales, Client Success, Enablement and Marketing teams to strategize, position and market our solutions to drive sales, adoption and retention.

This role is ideal for a marketer who is comfortable owning the end-to-end product launch process from supporting personas, pricing, value messaging, sales plays and launch plans, as well as managing product lifecycles through growth, maturity and sunset. If you're ready to join a collaborative, fast-moving product marketing team helping power purpose at work, we would love to hear from you!




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Go-to-Market Strategy: Lead messaging and go-to-market strategy, identifying and staying ahead of market trends and buyer and user persona evolution to maintain messaging, sales enablement and client adoption throughout product lifecycles.

 - Voice of Customer: Provide VoC  insights to product management and sales/marketing to help inform product strategy, roadmap decisions, value messaging  and sales velocity.

 - Positioning & Messaging: Develop and maintain persona-based value messaging, sourcing fresh market insights and proof points to help drive immediate relevancy and adoption.

 - Product Launch Ownership: Own the end-to-end product launch process — from market research and pricing through cross-functional launch plans to support sales  win rates and drive adoption of products and enhancements.

 - Internal Product Advocacy:  Own the internal connections, in partnership with Product and Enablement, to advise on and update the organization on key product developments, value proposition, and competitive differentiation.

 - Enablement Content: Develop and collaborate on content for the Sales Enablement, Digital and Client Success teams.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with website, content marketing, demand generation, brand, sales and customer success teams to ensure product messaging proliferates throughout the buyer and client journey.
   
    


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4-7 years in B2B product or portfolio marketing role, SaaS ideal

 - Proven ability to manage a product launch cycle

 - Confidence and experience driving and executing cross-functional projects

 - Independent self-starter: ability to think clearly, think differently, and manage multiple priorities in a high-growth, fast-paced environment while maintaining a professional, collaborative demeanor

 - Highly developed interpersonal and written/spoken communication skills

 - Strong communication and business skills; ability research and to articulate a PoV, build a business case, adapt to new ideas and present with confidence

 - An analytical mind and a balance between a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing (with a lot of common sense!)

 - Demonstrated  writing, editing, and content creation skills

 - PMA or Pragmatic Marketing certification is an asset

 - Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits is an asset


DISCOVER YOUR PURPOSE AT WORK

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.



WHERE WE WORK

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

greenhouse:block:5442203008.title: Sales Enablement Program Manager
greenhouse:block:5442203008.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 The Role 

 We’re looking for a proactive and highly organized Sales Enablement Program Manager to help drive clarity, consistency, and continuous learning across Block’s global sales and Account Management teams. You’ll play a critical role in operationalizing our everboarding strategy—ongoing education beyond onboarding. This role requires a strong blend of content operations, learning science, stakeholder management, and sales context awareness.

 You Will 

- Support ongoing learning initiatives by helping to plan, build, facilitate, and maintain scalable sales enablement content beyond onboarding.

- Curate and maintain centralized knowledge resources, partnering with subject matter experts (SMEs) across Product, Marketing, and Sales to ensure accuracy and consistency.

- Help operationalize the everboarding strategy, coordinating timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.

- Organize and update internal learning assets, ensuring documentation is easy to find, up-to-date, and aligned with sales priorities.

- Manage internal communications related to enablement, such as newsletters, training calendars, training decks, and update broadcasts to reduce noise and increase clarity.

- Collect feedback and track program impact, using data to assess adoption, knowledge retention, and performance improvements.

- Support regional Canada enablement needs, ensuring content is localized and relevant for diverse sales teams across markets.

- Promote knowledge-sharing practices, including documenting playbooks, building FAQs, and contributing to internal wikis or LMS content.

 You Have 

- 4+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales, or Account Management.

- Strong understanding of adult learning theories and experience applying them to training design, content delivery, or knowledge-sharing systems.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with an ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels.

- Proven ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and maintain clarity under ambiguity.

 Nice to Have 

- Background in instructional design, content strategy, or sales operations.

- Exposure to coaching methodologies such as GROW to support learner development and behavior change.

 We're working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. Want to learn more about what we're doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Check out our I+D page .

 Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

 Use of AI in Our Hiring Process 

 We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

 Contact us here  with hiring practice or data usage questions.

 Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people.  Square  makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers.  Cash App  is the easy way to spend, send, and store money.  Afterpay  is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time.  TIDAL  is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs.  Bitkey  is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin.  Proto  is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

lever:caseware:aeb64915-118e-45b8-be6e-f.title: Director of Product — Ecosystem
lever:caseware:aeb64915-118e-45b8-be6e-f.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! The Director of Product, Ecosystem leads Caseware’s third-party ecosystem strategy and owns the roadmap for the ecosystem product surface — the requirements for interoperability capabilities, connectors, marketplace, and developer tooling through which third parties connect to Caseware.  As Director of Product, Ecosystem, you will understand the technology solution landscape and the priority of partnerships and integrations with technology vendors, own the build, buy, or partner framework applied to ecosystem capability decisions, and design the partner program that governs intake, certification, and the marketplace.  You will lead on ecosystem strategy, on the interoperability requirements and integration workflows Caseware supports, on the marketplace, and on the third-party developer experience.  The role reports to the VP, Product — Enterprise Solutions & Ecosystem.  ❗This is a Full-time permanent position  ❗This is a new position  📍Location: This is a hybrid role requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office, located at 351 King St E, Suite 1100, Toronto, ON.    What you will be doing::

Third-Party Ecosystem Strategy 

  • Lead Caseware’s third-party ecosystem strategy and keep it current as the market moves. 

  • Understand the technology solution landscape and the determine the priority of partnerships and integrations across customer integration use cases and third-party technology integrations 

  • Bring the evidence behind those decisions: firm technology-stack data, customer demand signals, and competitive position. 

  • Set out the strategy for senior leadership and the trade-offs within it. 

Ecosystem Product Surface 

  • Own the roadmap for the ecosystem product surface – inclusive of interoperability capabilities, integrations, connectors, marketplace, and developer tooling. 

  • Identify and communicate delivery risks against the roadmap. 

  • Own the marketplace as a product surface, including how partners and their capabilities are presented and discovered. 

  • Decide what enters the ecosystem surface and what is deprecated. 

Build, Buy, or Partner Framework 

  • Own the build, buy, or partner framework and apply it to ecosystem capability decisions. 

  • Maintain the classification that determines whether a capability is built, acquired, or partnered. 

  • Produce the analysis and recommendation behind each decision, including the case for the option not taken. 

  • Take recommendations through to a decision with senior leadership, working with corporate development and finance where the answer is to acquire or invest. 

Interoperability Requirements and Integration Workflows 

  • Lead the understanding of what interoperability capabilities customers and partners need and translate it into product requirements – inclusive of Agentic Interoperability 

  • Define the integration workflows Caseware supports, and the technical standards an integration must meet. 

  • Manage integrations as products, with defined adoption targets, quality expectations, and support models. 

  • Recruit and run design partners to validate integrations before general availability. 

Third-Party Developer Experience 

  • Lead on the experience of third parties building against Caseware, and inform the product requirements for the APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling they use. 

  • Define what self-service onboarding looks like for a partner or customer developer. 

  • Advocate for the platform capabilities the ecosystem surface depends on, including security, performance, and extensibility. 

Partner Program Design 

  • Design the partner program, covering intake, evaluation, certification, and the marketplace. 

  • Set the bar a partner must meet to be certified, and the criteria applied at intake. 

  • Define partner onboarding and enablement so partners can integrate at scale 

  • Define the operating model for the program, including governance, tooling, and reporting cadence. 

Working with Engineering 

  • Partner with engineering on interoperability requirements, technical standards, and sequencing. 

  • Provide the customer and market context behind each requirement, not only the requirement. 

  • Surface trade-offs and constraints that affect roadmap commitments, and agree the path through them. 

Commercial Collaboration 

  • Provide the product and technical position into partner contracting and negotiation. 

  • Contribute to the ecosystem monetisation model, including marketplace, referral, and revenue-share approaches. 

  • Work with Legal on NDAs, term sheets, and the technical terms of partnership agreements. 

Go-to-Market and Customer Enablement 

  • Work alongside Sales, Support, and Marketing on go-to-market for ecosystem capabilities. 

  • Inform product positioning and the market narrative for the ecosystem. 

  • Define the ecosystem performance measures and report against them on a set cadence. 

Team Leadership 

  • Lead and grow the ecosystem product team as the ecosystem scales. 

  • Set the standard for how the team defines requirements, sizes opportunity, and reports delivery risk. 

  • Represent the partner and developer perspective within Caseware. 

What you will bring::

  • 8+ years in product management, including ownership of platform, integration, or ecosystem products. 

  • Experience owning a roadmap for a product surface used by third parties. 

  • Working knowledge of API-based integrations, MCP, interoperability standards, marketplaces, and developer experience. 

  • Experience applying a build, buy, or partner framework, including evaluating partnerships or acquisitions. 

  • Experience defining a partner program, including intake and certification criteria. 

  • Commercial fluency: able to contribute to contracting and monetisation decisions without owning them. 

  • Able to set out a product strategy and the evidence behind it to a senior audience. 

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, and willing to set direction and do the hands-on work. 

  • People leadership experience, or a clear appetite to build and lead a team over time. 

  • Experience in audit, accounting, or professional services software is an asset. 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field.

lever:caseware:3f96d364-def9-46af-9c0b-b.description:

You will be a key contributor to the product strategy and execution for our cloud-based assurance workflow capabilities - platform features and tools that power financial audit engagements and are leveraged by Caseware's global solutions.  What makes this role unique is the balance it demands: understanding of audit methodology on one side, and proven product management craft on the other. You strive to understand how auditors work, and you translate that expertise into platform decisions that keep Caseware's solutions relevant, compliant, and ahead of market developments.   This role sits at the intersection of audit practice and technology at a pivotal moment. Caseware sees AI not as an add-on, but as the future foundation of audit – integral to how auditors work, how engagements are run, and how our platform evolves. You will help shape what AI-driven audit looks like in practice, working closely with global product and engineering teams to define and prioritize AI capabilities that are grounded in real audit methodology.  ❗This is a full-time, permanent position.  ❗This is a new role. 📍 Location:  This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office located at 351 King Street East, Toronto, Ontario. What you will be doing: :

  1. Strategy Development: In collaboration with the Director of Product, define the overarching strategy for platform products, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Demonstrate deep knowledge of each product managed by your team, including market position, value proposition, and competitive landscape. Continually assess and refine product suite, identifying new business opportunities and optimal resource allocation. Cultivate expertise in AI to grasp the full scope of technological capabilities, informing and inspiring a visionary product roadmap.  

  1. Influence and Leadership: Foster a culture of process improvement and employee engagement within and across teams. Mentor team members and other employees, ensuring the inclusion of relevant stakeholders in decision-making processes. Build a supportive culture that empowers teams to take on more responsibilities.  

  1. Execution and Collaboration: Articulate the concept of incremental value delivery to a wide range of stakeholders, including customers, partners, and internal teams. Define and manage initiatives that align with the broader organizational vision. Engage with strategic key accounts to understand product usage patterns and motivations. Diligently tracks and proactively manages key KPIs and product metrics to optimize performance, drive strategic decision-making, and achieve targeted outcomes.  

  1. Customer Insight: Champion a culture of data-driven decision-making. Serve as an authority on customer and user insights, leveraging them for product enhancements. Ensure consistent integration of user research into decision-making processes. Leverages deep insights into the customer journey and pain points to shape product requirements, design, and development, ensuring solutions that effectively address customer challenges and elevate satisfaction 

What you will bring::

  • 8+ years of experience and a proven track record in leading complex product launches and projects. Ability to guide long-term vision for analytics products and drive towards that vision. 

  • 8+ years conducting external audit engagements on financial statements at a Public Accounting Firm (not consulting or internal audit), OR experience designing or implementing software solutions for external audit teams within the national office of a Public Accounting Firm 

  • Strong people management skills and experience in coordinating cross-functional projects. Ability to represent the team across all levels of management and with external stakeholders. 

  • Confidence in making strategic decisions, using data and prioritization techniques to pivot when necessary. Experience in enabling teams to operate autonomously. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate the value of the team's work clearly and engage in difficult conversations when needed. 

  • CPA or equivalent accounting certification. 

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and strategic thinking skills. 

  • Agility in adapting to rapidly changing technology landscapes.

lever:caseware:35366087-6670-40a2-ba0e-7.title: Product Analyst — Growth & GTM
lever:caseware:35366087-6670-40a2-ba0e-7.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! Building something great is only half the job. The other half — deciding who it's for, proving it's worth paying for, and making sure it actually catches on — is just as hard, and just as often gotten wrong. This role owns that other half.  You'll take a product from “we think this could work” to “we know it works, and here's the number that proves it.” You'll define who it's for, sharpen how we talk about it, help price it right, run the beta that tells us the truth, launch it, watch what actually happens, and feed everything you learn straight back into what we build next. Nobody hands this role a finished plan. You build it — end to end.  ❗This is a full-time, permanent position.  ❗This is a new role. 📍 Location:  This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office located at 351 King Street East, Toronto, Ontario. What you will be doing::

Know the User Before Anyone Else Does 

  • Dig into who a new capability is really for — which users, which behaviors, which unmet need — before the roadmap hardens around a guess 

  • Turn scattered signals (usage data, sales conversations, support tickets) into a sharp, specific point of view on the target user that the whole team can rally around 

Shape How We Talk About It 

  • Define the positioning: what this is, why it matters, and why now — the story that has to be true before anyone can sell or explain it well 

  • Make it concrete enough that sales, support, and leadership all end up telling the same story, without needing a script 

Price It Like You Mean It 

  • Work through the monetization question early: what's this worth, to whom, and how should it be packaged or priced 

  • Bring real analysis to that conversation — usage patterns, willingness-to-pay signals, comparable value — instead of “what feels right” 

Run the Beta That Tells the Truth 

  • Design and run the beta program: pick the right users, define what success actually looks like up front, and resist the urge to declare victory early 

  • Turn beta feedback into a real go/no-go call, backed by data, not enthusiasm 

 

Launch It, Then Actually Watch What Happens 

  • Own the launch and the metrics that tell you whether it's working — adoption, retention, revenue impact, whatever matters for this bet 

  • Build the reporting that makes this visible to leadership without anyone having to ask 

Close the Loop 

  • Turn user feedback and post-launch data into a clear, prioritized set of changes for the product team — not just a pile of quotes 

  • Make sure what you learn on this launch makes the next one sharper 

What you will bring::

Table stakes 

  • 3–5 years of experience touching at least part of this arc already: user research, positioning, pricing, beta programs, or launches 

  • Strong analytical foundation — comfortable with SQL/Excel or equivalent, and genuinely good at turning data into a decision, not just a chart 

  • Excellent storytelling instincts — can turn “here's what the data shows” into a narrative people remember and repeat 

What actually differentiates candidates 

  • Comfort owning the whole arc — from “who is this for” to “did it actually work” — instead of one slice of it 

  • A genuine dual fluency: rigorous enough that people trust your numbers, persuasive enough that people remember your story 

  • A bias to ship, test, and learn quickly, rather than wait for a certainty that never quite arrives 

  • Real passion for this kind of work, paired with the autonomy to run with it — you don't need someone checking in to know what's next 

Nice-to-have 

  • Background in product management, growth, or product marketing 

  • Experience with monetization or pricing strategy 

  • B2B SaaS or enterprise software experience

  • Proficiency in SQL and a scripting language (Python or R) for data wrangling and analysis and working with APIs. 
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI (Microsoft Fabric a plus). 
  • Exposure to product analytics and feedback platforms such as Pendo 
  • Experience working with data platform or engineering teams to improve pipelines and data quality. 
  • Self-starter who thrives in ambiguous environments, with strong communication and data storytelling skills. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement

lever:caseware:21db6ea3-e03c-45ca-98d8-f.description:

While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! As Product Manager for the Domain Platform, you sit at the intersection of audit practice and technology. You will be a key contributor to the product strategy and execution for our cloud-based assurance workflow capabilities - platform features and tools that power financial audit engagements and are leveraged by Caseware's global solutions.  What makes this role unique is the balance it demands: understanding of audit methodology on one side, and proven product management craft on the other. You strive to understand how auditors work, and you translate that expertise into platform decisions that keep Caseware's solutions relevant, compliant, and ahead of market developments.  This role sits at the intersection of audit practice and technology at a pivotal moment. Caseware sees AI not as an add-on, but as the future foundation of audit – integral to how auditors work, how engagements are run, and how our platform evolves. You will help shape what AI-driven audit looks like in practice, working closely with global product and engineering teams to define and prioritize AI capabilities that are grounded in real audit methodology.  ❗ This is a full-time permanent position  ❗ This is a new vacancy   📍 Location:   This is a hybrid role requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office, located at 351 King St E , Toronto, ON.  What you will be doing: :

Assurance Subject Matter Expertise: 

  • Serve as a key internal subject matter expert on assurance workflows and financial audit methodology — for product, engineering, sales, and partner teams. 

  • Engage with global partners and key customers at a professional, peer level — understanding their workflows, challenges, and evolving expectations. 

  • Ensure that platform features are developed to enable and support compliant solutions. 

  • Bring credible audit practice perspective into product decisions, helping teams bridge the gap between what auditors say they want and what they actually need. 

  

AI & the Future of Audit: 

  • Actively engage with AI tools in your own daily work – Caseware expects and enables this across the entire team. 

  • Contribute your expertise to the development of AI-driven product capabilities, help define what AI-assisted audit should look like, what makes sense methodologically, and where AI creates real value for auditors. 

  • Stay current on how AI is reshaping audit workflows, regulatory expectations, and the profession as a whole – and bring that perspective into product decisions. 

Product Strategy & Ownership: 

  • Own the product roadmap, collaborate with other PMs to ensure key pain points/solutions are understood and prioritized. 

  • Define and prioritize requirements based on customer feedback, and market trends. 

  • Coordinate cross-functional release readiness with platform, consulting, support, and partner-facing teams  

  • Act as a primary product contact for global partners, translating their needs into actionable platform improvements. 

  • Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Support, and Consulting to channel customer insights and escalation feedback into the roadmap. 

  • Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs clearly to a diverse set of stakeholders across geographies 

What you will bring: :

  • 3–5 years of product management experience 

  • Meaningful hands-on experience in financial audit or assurance — you understand audit workflows from the inside and can engage with auditors at a peer level. 

  • Strong ability to translate domain expertise and customer feedback into clear, prioritized product requirements. 

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams in a global environment. 

  • Openness and genuine curiosity about AI — you actively engage with AI tools and see them as part of how modern product work gets done. 

  

Nice to have: 

  • Familiarity with audit standards and regulatory frameworks relevant to financial engagements (e.g., ISA, GAAS, PCAOB). 

  • Experience with Caseware's audit or engagement management software. 

  • Exposure to platform thinking — building capabilities that are consumed by downstream partners or product teams rather than end users directly. 

  • Experience in a global or multi-market product environment 

 

What you can expect: 

  • Real ownership over a globally impactful platform — you will see the direct effects of your decisions in how partners and customers run audit engagements. 

  • Close collaboration with experienced global product and engineering teams. 

  • The opportunity to shape the future of audit technology at a pivotal moment — AI is a core strategic investment at Caseware, not a feature on top of existing products. 

  • Active use of and access to modern AI tools in your daily work — both an expectation and something Caseware actively enables. 

  • A product culture that values audit expertise and domain depth alongside product management craft

Strategy and roadmap 

  • Own the product strategy for Caseware's North American financial reporting solutions, and keep it aligned with the overall product and company vision.

Quality and compliance

By taking a consultative approach, you will be their partner to guide them through all aspects of their software evaluation, helping them understand not only current solutions but also how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can drive efficiency, enhance quality, and create new opportunities within their organizations. You will also liaise with team members in account management, training, professional services, support and product to help ensure customer needs are addressed on a timely basis, and professionally.  This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across North America and may require availability to accommodate meetings across Eastern Time (ET) to Pacific Time (PT) business hours, with notice, to effectively collaborate with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams. ❗This a full-time, permanent position  ❗This a new vacancy 📍 Location:  The role is a remote role and is available to all applicants residing and eligible to work in Canada.  What you will be doing::

•    Lead evaluation activities including presentations, trials & pilots, sharing information on solutions expertise and best practices with customers, while coordinating with technical or product SMEs where appropriate.
•    Strategize with customers on their migration & implementation journeys, from their existing accounting and audit tools, and work with them and the Professional Services team to ensure they have a clear direction and key requirements are addressed. 
•    Support customer evaluations and implementations, providing information on tools, processes and resources to customers, and helping to ensure timelines and tasks remain on track.
•    Create and maintain product demonstration strategies, use cases and related assets that are value and benefit-driven, not feature walk throughs. 
•    Act as the bridge between customers and Product teams, gathering and translating customer feedback into clear, actionable insights that inform product development while helping prospects understand how our roadmap addresses their business needs.
•    Attendance at Conferences and Events, maintaining relationships with customers and staying up to date with industry standards and trends. 
•    Participate in speaking engagements and thought leadership events or publications, as comfortable.
•    Design and implementation of processes and systems to support the delivery of consistent, scalable services.  Assist in the development and execution of improvement plans internally that are scalable to support future growth.

Required:

•    Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills.
•    Effective communicator with ability to understand and interpret stakeholder needs.

•    Strong organization skills with experience tracking and managing multiple deliverables and tasks.
•    A resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and problem-solving skills are required.
•    Have a sound understanding of technology within the audit and accountancy sector, or an enthusiasm to learn.
 
Preferred:

•    CPA, Charted Accountant or equivalent, with 3+ years Audit or Accounting experience.
•    Experience leading technology adoption, training, methodology, or other innovation efforts in an accounting firm.
•    Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field
•    Experience and/or qualifications in project, product or program management.
•    Practical experience utilizing AI tools, including for software development.

•    Experience with CRM systems and tools for sales and lead management
•    Product, Product Marketing, Sales experience, or experience working closely with those functional teams
•    Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software (E.g., Salesforce)

Salary Range:

The annual base salary for this position is between $110,000 CAD and $125,000 CAD per year. 

This role is also eligible for discretionary bonus and/or commission, as well as other benefits. Actual pay within the listed range will be determined based on factors such as transferable skills, relevant experience, market conditions, and primary work location. The posted range is subject to change and may be updated periodically.

lever:caseware:0503fb40-b703-4002-b40c-0.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own how Caseware builds, evaluates, and raises the quality of AI across the platform. You are the product owner of our core AI surfaces: the agents and agent builder practitioners use to do real work, the eval builder and eval roadmap that let us measure quality, and the agentic memory that lets the platform improve as it is used. You decide what we build, in what order, and whether it clears the bar before it reaches someone's audit file.  You are also the closest thing the product has to a practitioner in the room. Acting as an SME proxy, you carry the voice of the auditor into every decision: shadowing real workflows, validating outputs against what a qualified practitioner would actually sign off on, and turning "this doesn't feel right" into specific, actionable failure modes. You partner closely with applied scientists, engineering, domain experts, and external partner firms. You own the product outcome and the quality bar; the applied science team owns the science underneath it.  This role demands high agency. You'll operate with real autonomy, make decisions without waiting for permission, and own the outcome — success measured by results, not activity. You're intellectually curious, collaborate easily across teams, and take real pride in getting it right.  This work sits in the financial audit and assurance domain. Independent audit is one of the quiet foundations of the global economy — when investors, lenders, and regulators can trust that financial statements are accurate, capital flows and markets function. That trust rests entirely on the quality of the work, which is why the bar for AI here is so high. You don't need an accounting background to start, though one — or any real connection to the profession — adds high value. What you do need is genuine curiosity about the complexity of auditing and a deep appreciation for why quality is non-negotiable. You'll build that fluency on the job alongside experienced domain experts, and it will sharpen your judgment on what "good" really means.  ❗This a full-time, permanent position  ❗This a new vacancy ❗This role is hybrid. You will be required to work from our Toronto office 3-days a week, located at 351 King Street East, Toronto, ON    What you will be doing::

  • Own agents, the agent builder, the eval builder, and agentic memory as products: their roadmap, sequencing, and the business outcomes they drive, using results and practitioner feedback to shape what ships. 

  • Own the applied-science delivery roadmap and cross-team orchestration for the Caseware AI platform — sequence the evaluation, agentic-memory, and platform workstreams into a single plan, and keep delivery moving. 

  • Own the product acceptance bar for every AI feature — decide when an output is good enough to put in front of practitioners, and set the eval baseline so every agent and skill is measured against a stated bar. 

  • Embed with domain experts and partner accounting and audit firms to validate AI outputs against professional standards — not just user preferences, but what a qualified practitioner would actually sign off on.  

  • Be the voice of the practitioner as an SME proxy — shadow real audit workflows, test prototypes in context, and translate "this doesn't feel right" into specific, actionable failure modes the team can act on. 

  • Work daily with engineering to turn precise problem statements into well-scoped requirements, with acceptance criteria agreed before development begins. 

  • Stay ahead of the AI landscape — monitor model developments, new architectures, emerging agent patterns, and competitor moves, and bring a clear product point of view on what matters for Caseware. 

  • Define and own product health metrics for AI features: task completion, correction rates, override frequency, trust signals, and time-to-completion — and use them to drive product decisions. 

What you will bring::

  • 6+ years of experience in technology-focused product management or product development, including 3–4 years working deeply with AI or machine learning–driven products. Software engineers transitioning into PM are welcome. 

  • Proven ability to drive delivery across multiple technical teams coordinating dependencies, shared interfaces, and timelines across applied-science, and platform-engineering pod. 

  • Direct experience building and running eval frameworks for production AI products: defining acceptance bars, running human-in-the-loop, practitioner validation, regression tracking across releases, and using results to decide what ships.  

  • Technical fluency in LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and agentic patterns, enough to drive substantive conversations with engineers and know when a product problem is a model problem. 

  • High agency: you identify what needs to happen, move without waiting to be told, and take ownership of outcomes rather than just activities. 

  • Intellectual curiosity about AI — you follow model releases, read research, understand what frontier labs are shipping, and form your own views on what matters. 

  • Experience being the voice of the customer or practitioner: working with domain experts or subject matter specialists to define quality bars in high-stakes, regulated, or professional-grade contexts. 

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by it. Many of the problems this role works on do not have clear playbooks, when there is no established benchmark for the work, you can go and find out how it should be measured.

greenhouse:clutch:6180068004.description:
About Clutch:   

 We’re on a mission to reinvent how people buy, sell, and own cars. Are you game?

 Clutch is Canada’s largest buyer and seller of cars, offering a digital-first, hassle-free experience. Customers can browse thousands of cars online, have their chosen vehicle delivered right to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

 Looking to sell? We buy over $3 million worth of cars every day, providing a firm, AI-generated offer every 15 seconds—and when you sell to us, you get paid instantly, now that’s Clutch.

 Recognized four years running on The Globe & Mail’s list of Canada’s Top Growing Companies—and with back-to-back spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ —we’re seeking curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to join our growing team.

 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Toronto, Clutch currently operates in Ontario, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Our world-class investors include Altos Ventures, Canaan, FJ Labs, BrandProject, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca .

 Executive Operations at Clutch 

 Clutch is scaling quickly, and as we grow, the way we communicate, operate, and execute becomes increasingly important. We need strong systems to keep teams aligned, move priority work forward, and ensure information flows clearly across the company.

 We’re looking for someone to help build and run the operating engine around the CEO and leadership team — from internal communications and company-wide meetings to executive coordination, cross-functional workstreams, government relations support, and high-priority special projects.

 About the role:   

 We’re hiring a Chief of Staff to support the CEO and leadership team in driving clarity, alignment, and execution across the company.

 This is a high-ownership, hands-on generalist role for someone who can operate across communications, project management, operations, administration, and cross-functional coordination. You’ll help translate company priorities into clear communications, run important operating cadences, manage company-wide meetings, support executive workflows, and drive priority workstreams that do not sit neatly within one function. You’ll work closely with the CEO and partner cross-functionally with People, Finance, Legal, Operations, Product, Marketing, and other teams to help keep the company focused and moving quickly.

 This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys ambiguity, and wants to work close to the center of a scaling company.

 What you'll do:  

 Drive internal communications and company alignment   

- Draft, edit, and coordinate internal communications from the CEO and leadership team, including company updates, announcements, FAQs, employee notes, and leadership messages.

- Help ensure company communications are clear, timely, practical, and aligned with Clutch’s voice and priorities.

- Build and maintain an internal communications calendar across company updates, town halls, leadership meetings, employee events, and key business milestones.

- Partner with leaders across the business to gather updates, identify important themes, and translate them into clear employee-facing communications.

- Help employees understand company priorities, performance, decisions, and changes in a clear and useful way.

 Own town halls and company-wide meetings   

- Own the planning and execution of company-wide town halls, all-hands meetings, leadership updates, and Q&A sessions.

- Build agendas, coordinate speakers, gather content, prepare slides, manage timing, and own the run-of-show.

- Work with the CEO and leadership team to shape the narrative for each company-wide meeting.

- Track employee questions, feedback, themes, and follow-up items.

- Continuously improve the quality, clarity, and usefulness of company-wide meetings.

 Coordinate internal events and employee moments   

- Plan and execute internal events such as leadership offsites, company celebrations, team-building events, onboarding moments, and employee engagement initiatives.

- Manage event logistics, including venues, catering, invites, budgets, vendors, materials, and onsite coordination.

- Partner with People, Workplace, Finance, and department leaders to ensure events are well-run and aligned with company priorities.

- Help create moments that build connection, culture, and alignment across the company.

 Drive process, workstreams, and special projects   

- Own and drive cross-functional workstreams tied to company priorities, operating improvements, strategic initiatives, and executive team needs.

- Bring structure to ambiguous problems by creating clear plans, owners, timelines, and follow-up processes.

- Identify bottlenecks and gaps in how work gets done; help design and implement practical process improvements.

- Develop templates, trackers, playbooks, and lightweight operating systems that create consistency and enable scaling.

- Help keep internal stakeholders aligned through clear updates, escalation paths, and disciplined follow-through.

 Support government relations and external stakeholder work   

- Support government relations initiatives, external stakeholder engagement, and public affairs-related workstreams.

- Help prepare briefing materials, talking points, meeting notes, follow-ups, and stakeholder updates.

- Coordinate meetings, events, and logistics with external partners, government stakeholders, industry groups, and advisors.

- Work with Legal, Finance, Operations, and external partners to ensure materials are accurate, polished, and well-coordinated.

- Track action items, deadlines, and follow-ups across government relations and external affairs projects.

 Support executive operations and administration   

- Help run the operating cadence for the CEO and leadership team, including agendas, meeting notes, action items, follow-ups, and decision tracking.

- Support preparation for executive meetings, leadership offsites, planning sessions, board meetings, and investor updates.

- Provide administrative support to the CEO and executive team where needed, including scheduling, meeting coordination, travel planning, expenses, and logistics.

- Help ensure key decisions are documented, owners are clear, and follow-through happens.

- Jump in where needed to remove friction and help the CEO and leadership team operate more effectively.

 What we're looking for: 

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Political Science, Public Policy, Marketing, or a related field.

- 5–10 years of experience in business operations, internal communications, executive operations, consulting, project management, government relations, public affairs, people operations, or a similar high-ownership role.

- Excellent written communication skills — you can turn complex, messy, or sensitive topics into clear and thoughtful messages.

- Strong project management skills and the ability to bring structure where none exists.

- Proven ability to thrive in a high-ownership environment — you take initiative, move fast, and drive outcomes with limited oversight.

- Strong organization and attention to detail, especially when managing multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and moving pieces.

- Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.

- Comfort working directly with senior leaders, external stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to balance strategic context with hands-on execution, including administrative and coordination-heavy work.

- Comfortable preparing polished slides, meeting materials, notes, briefings, and communications.

- Low ego, high ownership, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves.

 Strong assets 

- Experience working at a high-growth technology company.

- Experience supporting a CEO, founder, executive team, or leadership group.

- Experience with government relations, public affairs, policy, or external stakeholder engagement.

- Experience planning company-wide town halls, all-hands meetings, offsites, or employee events.

- Experience creating executive communications, briefing materials, FAQs, board materials, or company-wide announcements.

- Comfort using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Asana, Canva, PowerPoint, Google Slides, or similar platforms.

- Experience in automotive, marketplaces, fintech, consumer technology, logistics, or regulated industries.

 This role is based in Toronto and requires on-site presence — remote candidates will not be considered. 

 Why you'll love it at Clutch: 

- Be part of a disruptive, tech-driven company that is transforming the automotive industry — one of the largest and fastest-growing B2C startups in Canada.

- A unique opportunity to work at the center of the company, helping shape how Clutch communicates, operates, and executes as we scale.

- Freedom to innovate and ownership of your role — work on meaningful and challenging projects that have a direct impact on the business.

- Collaborate with a talented and passionate team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- Competitive pay and equity incentives.

- Comprehensive health and dental benefits.

- Opportunities for growth and development in a rapidly scaling company.

 Compensation & Benefits: 

- Salary range: $120,000 - $190,000 (plus equity)

- Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. 

- Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

 Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca . 

 We use AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess applications. Final hiring decisions are made by our team.

 About the role 

 We’re looking for a smart, resourceful, and analytically strong individual to join our Revenue team as  Strategy and Operations Manager (Revenue) . This role is an exceptional opportunity for someone early in their career (1–5 years post-grad) who’s hungry to drive impact across a high-growth sales organization—working side by side with our VP of Sales on strategic initiatives, performance insights, and cross-functional projects that unlock growth.

 What You'll Do 

 Project-Based Execution

- Lead and execute small to medium-sized strategic projects that drive incremental improvement across the sales team—ranging from process optimization to frontline tools to performance analysis.

- Take ownership of project scoping, planning, execution, and results measurement—working across disciplines to see initiatives through end-to-end.

 Work Cross-Functionally to Drive Change

- Collaborate with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Engineering to remove friction in the sales process and bring structure to ambiguity.

- Be equally comfortable building a business case in Excel, presenting findings to the VP Sales, or jumping into a call with a distressed customer to understand root causes.

- Translate complex problems into actionable insights—and ensure action happens.

 Data-Driven Insights & Sales Strategy

- Dive deep into sales and funnel data to uncover insights and opportunities. You’ll be expected to bring a strong analytical toolkit and be an 8+/10 when it comes to working with data.

- Support forecasting, territory planning, performance dashboards, and root cause analysis to inform sales leadership decision-making.

- Develop simple, clear, and persuasive recommendations backed by data and common sense.

 Self-Learning & Experimentation

- Take initiative to self-learn new tools, frameworks, and strategies—whether it’s mastering ChatGPT, learning how to write SQL, or figuring out how a new system works with minimal handholding.

- Be proactive in experimenting with new ideas, rapidly testing assumptions, and applying learnings in real-time.

- Develop comfort navigating ambiguity and unfamiliar territory—you’ll regularly tackle challenges that don’t come with a playbook.

- 1–5 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, sales strategy, business operations, or a high-performing startup environment.

- 8+/10 with data: Strong proficiency with Excel/Sheets required; experience with SQL, BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau)

- Proven ability to lead structured projects and think strategically, while also rolling up your sleeves to get things done.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and change—able to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

- Intellectually curious, fast learner, and someone who brings strong judgment and common sense to every conversation.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills—you’re just as comfortable with execs as you are with frontline staff or developers.

- Gritty, humble, and high-agency: you take initiative, own problems, and don’t wait to be told what to do.

 Nice to Have 

- A genuine interest in Clutch’s industry—automotive, marketplaces, consumer tech, or the future of retail.

- Passion for building things from the ground up and a desire to grow into a leadership role in the future.

 Why Clutch 

- Partner directly with the VP Sales on initiatives that materially impact top-line performance.

- Solve meaningful problems, fast: You’ll be in the room where decisions happen and have the chance to influence direction across the business.

- Build your career: Whether your goal is GM, Product, Strategy, or Ops—this role sets a strong foundation for growth.
