About Coursera + Udemy 

 Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our  blog .

 Why join us now? 

 AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

 Shape what comes next 

 By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

 Job Overview 

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Applied AI to own customer deployments from initial discovery and product scoping through delivery, adoption, and value realization.

 In this role, you will work directly with enterprise customers to understand their most important workflows, translate business objectives into clear product and technical requirements, and build a sequenced deployment roadmap. You will partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, internal Product and Engineering teams, and cross-functional partners across Sales, Customer Success, Data, Security, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

 You will serve as the product owner for the customer engagement: accountable for the problem being solved, the scope and success criteria, the deployment roadmap, and the business value ultimately delivered. You will also help identify which customer needs represent repeatable product opportunities and work with the internal teams to incorporate those insights into the broader product roadmap.

 This is an opportunity to join an emerging motion at an early stage and requires people with entrepreneurial mindset. Beyond delivering individual customer engagements, you will help define the product, operating model, playbooks, and decision frameworks required to scale this new product and motion.

 What You’ll Do 

 Own Customer Discovery and Product Strategy 

- Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technical stakeholders, and end users.

- Lead discovery to understand customer objectives, workflows, user needs, data and technical constraints, and desired business outcomes.

- Identify and prioritize high-value use cases, define the minimum viable deployment, and establish clear success and acceptance criteria.

- Translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product requirements, prioritization decisions, and a sequenced product and deployment roadmap.

 Lead End-to-End Customer Deployment 

- Translate customer objectives into a clear product and deployment roadmap covering milestones, workstreams, dependencies, risks, decision points, and launch criteria.

- Create high-quality product artifacts, including problem statements, product requirements, workflow definitions, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and executive decision documents.

- Own delivery governance across Coursera + Udemy and customer teams, maintaining clarity on scope, timelines, responsibilities, risks, and unresolved decisions.

 Partner on Technical Solution Design and Deployment 

- Work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers and internal Engineering teams to translate business workflows into deployable technical solutions.

- Participate credibly in discussions involving system architecture, APIs, data flows, integrations, identity and access management, infrastructure, security, privacy, scalability, reliability, and deployment models.

- Evaluate technical and product trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and ensure that proposed solutions are feasible, supportable, secure, and aligned with customer outcomes.

- Partner with engineering teams on AI-specific considerations such as data quality, evaluation approaches, human oversight, model limitations, responsible AI, and production-readiness criteria.

 Own Business Value and Create Product Leverage 

- Define the value hypothesis for each customer engagement and establish the business, adoption, and product metrics required to measure success.

- Evaluate effort, implementation complexity, cost-to-serve, and expected customer value when making scope and prioritization decisions.

- Partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success on scope boundaries, business cases, commercial assumptions, and material changes to customer engagements.

- Translate deployment results into clear narratives on adoption, ROI, customer impact, and future opportunities.

- Identify recurring customer workflows, requirements, and technical patterns that can become reusable product capabilities.

- Partner with Product and Engineering teams to bring field insights into the broader roadmap and build repeatable discovery, scoping, deployment, and measurement playbooks.

 What We’re Looking For 

- 8+ years of relevant experience across B2B product management, enterprise software, technical consulting, solutions delivery, or related roles, with clear ownership of product or customer outcomes.

- Demonstrated experience taking technically complex enterprise products, platforms, or customer deployments from discovery and scoping through production launch and adoption.

- Experience working with B2B products involving platforms, data, APIs, integrations, infrastructure, or complex enterprise workflows.

- Strong customer-facing experience working directly with senior business leaders, technical stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

- Excellent product judgment with the ability to convert ambiguous problems into clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

- Strong program and delivery management skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, changing scope, and executive-level communication.

- Strong technical fluency and the ability to reason about enterprise software architecture, data and integrations, cloud environments, security, privacy, and software delivery.

- Strong understanding of AI- and LLM-enabled products, including where these technologies create value, their limitations, and the considerations involved in deploying them in enterprise workflows.

- Hands-on prototyping experience with AI-assisted or low-code development tools such as Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Retool, or similar platforms.

- Financial and commercial acumen, including experience evaluating business cases, effort versus value, delivery economics, ROI, and the implications of scope and prioritization decisions.

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, influence cross-functional teams without formal authority, and communicate equally well with executives, product teams, and engineers.

- Willingness to collaborate across global time zones and travel periodically for customer discovery, delivery, and executive engagements.

 Nice to Have 

- Experience deploying AI, machine-learning, LLM, RAG, or agentic solutions into production enterprise environments.

- Familiarity with AI evaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, model performance, and responsible-AI practices.

- Experience working in education technology, workforce transformation, talent intelligence, skills, learning platforms, or other enterprise environments involving complex stakeholder and data ecosystems.

- Experience delivering products or programs across multiple regions, industries, or regulatory environments.

 Why join us? 

- Help build a new motion from the ground up. You will play a formative role in defining how Coursera + Udemy scopes, delivers, measures, and scales customer-facing AI solutions.

- Own the complete customer-to-product loop. Work directly with enterprise leaders, partner with Forward Deployed Engineers, see solutions move into production, and use field learning to shape reusable product capabilities.

- Move beyond experimentation. This role is accountable not only for prototypes or recommendations, but for adoption, operationalization, and measurable customer value.

- Work on consequential problems. Apply AI and product thinking to complex workforce, learning, and organizational challenges faced by institutions around the world.

- Operate with meaningful autonomy. Join a high-ownership, cross-functional team that values speed, rigorous product thinking, practical execution, and demonstrated business impact.

- Contribute to Coursera + Udemy’s mission. Help organizations build the capabilities they need while advancing Coursera + Udemy’s mission to transform lives through learning.

 Compensation 

 Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is $164,000 - $205,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice . 

 To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page.

 If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our  Fraudulent Activity Submission Form. 

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera.org.

Shape the platform behind every model
What if your product decisions could shape how every machine learning model at Coveo is built, deployed and operated? As a Technical Product Manager in our ML Platform unit, you'll help shape the platform our applied scientists and ML engineers rely on to train, evaluate, deploy, serve and monitor the models and AI capabilities behind Coveo's products.
Working alongside the unit's director, dev managers, technical leads, applied scientists and product managers, you'll turn complex needs into clear priorities and actionable plans, balancing what our internal users need today with reliability, cost, scalability and the long-term health of the platform.
As one of our Technical Product Managers, you will:

Help define and evolve the ML Platform product roadmap, balancing the needs of our ML and AI teams with reliability, cost efficiency, scalability and technical debt.
Partner closely with technical leads across model building, model serving, experimentation and the LLM platform, validating direction with them before committing teams to it.
Understand how applied scientists and ML engineers work, and reconcile their needs into feature briefs, written proposals and clear priorities.
Stay current on MLOps, LLMOps and AI infrastructure trends, and bring build versus buy options to the table with evidence.
Lead product discovery for new capabilities, helping teams validate technical approaches and user value before work starts.
Coordinate across teams and partners such as Security, Legal and Data Platform to manage dependencies, track progress and ensure successful delivery.

Here is what will qualify you for the role:

5+ years of experience in technical product management or a closely related role, including owning a roadmap and setting priorities, not only managing delivery.
Hands-on understanding of machine learning systems in production (training pipelines, deployment and serving, monitoring), gained through a software engineering, ML engineering or data science background.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to write clear proposals and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.
A proactive problem-solving mindset, with the habit of validating ideas early with technical experts and users before committing to them.

What will make you stand out:

Experience as a product manager of an internal ML, data or developer platform whose customers are engineers or data scientists.
Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps tooling such as MLflow, SageMaker, Kubernetes-based serving, model monitoring, LLM gateways and evaluation.
Experience driving platform adoption, including deprecating legacy tools and migrating teams to new ones.
A track record of improving product practices in teams that worked without a product manager, and of building trust with experienced engineers.

Do you think you can bring this role to life? Send us your application, we want to hear from you!
Join the Coveolife!
We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of, for example, age, gender, disability, gaps in CV, national or ethnic background.
This job description was written by humans, assisted by AI. We may leverage technology in our hiring process to help us see the person behind the resume.
Coveo is committed to providing accessible employment practices. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any point during the recruitment process, please contact HR@Coveo.com to discuss your needs.

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.




We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.




So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.




🚀 THE ADVENTURE AHEAD

As our Technical Product Manager for Connectors, you are the master orchestrator of the enterprise ecosystem, ensuring Docebo talks seamlessly to the tools our customers love most. You aren’t just managing a list of integrations; you are building the mission-critical bridges between HRIS, CRM, and Productivity suites that power global learning at scale. Your mission is to define "what good looks like" for native integration quality and hold the organisation accountable to it through clear, measurable outcomes.




🛠️ THE DAY-TO-DAY

 - Architect the Roadmap: Strategically prioritize our native integration portfolio by balancing customer demand, ARR impact, and competitive benchmarks across the HRIS and CRM landscapes.

 - Deep-Dive Discovery: Lead technical reconnaissance by interrogating vendor APIs, testing authentication models, and inspecting payloads to ensure our PRDs are airtight before a single line of code is written.

 - Own the Lifecycle: Manage the full "cradle-to-grave" journey of every connector, including proactive versioning, deprecation strategies, and navigating upstream vendor changes.

 - Measure What Matters: Define and track the heartbeat of our portfolio through connector adoption rates, sync reliability, and SLOs that prove our impact to GTM leadership.

 - Eliminate Ambiguity: Write precision-engineered specifications—covering field mapping, conflict resolution, and error handling—so Engineering and QA can execute with total clarity.

 - Enable the Field: Partner with Technical Writers and Sales to create "field-ready" guides and represent Docebo as the technical authority in high-stakes enterprise deal cycles.

 - Evaluate the Build: Make the high-level call on whether to build, co-build, or partner for new categories, using a blend of technical depth and commercial savvy.


⚡ YOUR SUPERPOWERS

 - Integration Specialist: You have a black belt in enterprise APIs (REST, OAuth, SCIM) and understand why webhook reliability varies and how data model gaps create sync chaos.

 - Hands-on Explorer: You don’t wait for a demo; you jump into Postman, call sandbox APIs, and prototype sync flows yourself to answer the tough questions.

 - Precision Architect: You thrive in the details, crafting requirements that leave zero room for interpretation and ensuring our connectors are as reliable as they are functional.

 - Metric-Minded Leader: You speak the language of SLOs and ARR, translating technical performance into commercial evidence that resonates with executive stakeholders.

 - SaaS Savant: With 4+ years in Technical PM or Integration Engineering, you’ve managed complex portfolios and know the HCM or LMS ecosystem inside and out.

 - Commercial Navigator: You know exactly which integrations protect revenue at renewal and which ones unlock new market segments, and you can explain the "why" to anyone.






OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.




OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

 - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
   




OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍

 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

 - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

 - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

 - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

 - Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.




ABOUT DOCEBO 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO https://www.docebo.inc/home/default.aspx), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. 



Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

 At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

 Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

 PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

 What We Do 

 Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

 What You'll Do 

 As a Director of Product Management, you will be a key leader within the Discovery product org. You will help define the strategy and flywheel of the Discovery system, working closely with Development, Design, and Data Science teams to ship features and optimize systems that connect players with the right content at the right time. You will translate high-level strategic goals into actionable roadmaps, write detailed requirements, and drive cross-functional execution. You will partner with marketing, content strategy, and creator initiatives teams to ensure their needs are reflected in the product.

 In this role, you will 

- Own product strategy and execution for defined areas of the Discover surface, developing roadmaps that improve player discovery and drive growth

- Write detailed business and product requirements that guide design and technical specifications, partnering directly with Development and Data Science to ship high-quality systems and features

- Develop and refine "playbooks" and operational strategies that leverage Discover features to achieve initiative goals, using data to measure effectiveness and iterate

- Build and present product and feature concepts to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, clearly articulating impact, rationale, and expected outcomes

- Drive live operations execution for Discover initiatives, ensuring consistent quality and identifying opportunities for improvement through data analysis

 What we're looking for 

- 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to discovery systems, content platforms, recommendation engines, or large-scale consumer products

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions, define success metrics, and evaluate feature performance

- Passion for games and a solid understanding of growth, retention, and monetization mechanics that deliver value for players

- Interest in creator ecosystems, with the ability to understand and advocate for developers building on a platform

- Track record of shipping products in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with multiple stakeholders

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing product requirement documents and presenting to senior leadership

- Experience managing or mentoring other PMs is a plus

 EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

 We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. 

 Pay Transparency Information 

 The expected annual base pay range(s) for this position are detailed below. Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs). 
 British Columbia Base Pay Range
 $269,967 — $395,952 CAD 

 ABOUT US

 Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

 Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! 

 Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

 Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

greenhouse:guidepoint:8751110002.description:
Overview: 

 The Senior Product Manager sets a clear, compelling product vision and is accountable for executing it. They are a self-starter, a visible organizational leader, a hands-on problem solver, and a relationship builder. The Senior Product Manager continuously builds institutional knowledge that spans all teams and functions within the company as well as a deep understanding of the evolving competitive landscape. They translate that vision into an executional roadmap, and drive it to delivery across web, mobile and MCP. They go deep into how each client segment actual works by sitting with users, mapping end-to-end workflows, and translating what they learn into product features. They own feature prioritization and the backlog. They will author stories and participate in the agile product development cycle.  

 This is a hybrid position based in Toronto. 

 What You’ll Do:   

- Segment Depth: Develop an expert-level understanding of each client segment's end-to-end workflow. Translate that understanding directly into product requirements, features, and prioritization decisions, so the roadmap reflects how clients actually work rather than how we assume they do. 

- Customer Focus: Champion the voice of the customer across all initiatives. Gather and synthesize customer needs and pain points through both quantitative data (and qualitative insights. 

- Product Vision & Roadmap: Own, articulate, and execute a clear product vision and strategy, and rally the organization behind it. Leverage insights from market research, competitive analysis, customer feedback, and performance metrics to prioritize and shape the product roadmap. Lead quarterly and annual planning, ensuring clear goal-setting and metric tracking aligned with business objectives. 

- Product Evangelism: Serve as the primary advocate for your product internally and externally. Lead product rollouts, including developing training materials, documentation, and leading both virtual and in-person product demonstrations. Represent the product vision and benefits in meetings, presentations, and customer-facing engagements. 

- AI-Enablement: Drive the integration of AI-driven solutions within your product, ensuring alignment with the company's strategy. Identify where AI can improve clients' processes and ship those capabilities into the workflows clients already use. Be hands-on: prototype with current AI tooling, evaluate models and vendors, and write the prompts, agents, and evals that turn a concept into a shippable feature. Ensure the responsible use of AI technologies with a focus on transparency, and ethics. 

- Delivery Excellence: Collaborate closely with design, engineering, and quality assurance teams to ensure the timely and high-quality delivery of product features. Actively participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews, driving a culture of continuous improvement and effective iteration. 

- Metrics & Data-Driven Decisions: Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) for your product. Build processes to track, analyze, and review data to inform ongoing product development, prioritization of new features, and customer experience improvements . 

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams by effectively coordinating between stakeholders across departments, such as sales, marketing, legal, and customer support. Drive alignment on priorities and ensure that feedback is gathered pre- and post-development to drive continuous improvement. 

 What You Have:   

- 7-10 years of relevant experience as an Agile Product Manager 

- Experience developing both a SaaS web and mobile app 

- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.  

- Experience leading and motivating product teams in a fast-paced environment.  

- Exceptional problem-solving, strategic thinking, and analytical abilities  

- Demonstrated ability to set a product vision and execute against it by developing and delivering product strategies and roadmaps for scalable SaaS platforms. 

- Proven track record of learning a customer segment's workflow in depth and converting that insight into shipped features.  

- Working fluency with AI technologies — hands-on experience applying LLMs and AI tooling to real product problems — plus a command of ethical AI practices and human-in-the-loop design principles.  

- Familiarity with OKR process and agile development methodologies.  

 What We Offer:   

 The annual base salary range for this position is 140,000-160,000 CAD . Additionally, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on performance. 

 You will also be eligible for the following benefits: 

- Paid time off   

- Comprehensive benefits plan   

- Company RRSP match   

- Development opportunities through the LinkedIn Learning platform  

 About Guidepoint:   

 Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams. 

 Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process—from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions. 

 At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed. 

 #LI-TA1 

 #LI-HYBRID 
 This job posting is for an existing vacancy.  The salary offered will be based on the successful candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

 Compensation
 $140,000 — $160,000 CAD

ashby:jobber:49072a3c-b6d3-4c75-b6f9-8cb.description:
ARE YOU AN EXPERIENCED SENIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPER WITH A PASSION FOR INTEGRATIONS AND PARTNERSHIPS SOLUTIONS WHICH WILL HELP TRANSFORM A CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE??

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to be part of our Product Engineering & Partnerships ecosystem.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! 

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.

The team:

Our Senior Solutions Engineer will join a rapidly growing group integral to Jobber’s core strategy. This team plays a key role in expanding our software solutions to meet all our Service Providers needs. Our app marketplace is growing with interest from a variety of external partners of all stripes. You will work closely with our Partnerships group, specifically our Platform Experience Engineering team and our Business Development group. You’ll also work with external development teams of all shapes and sizes. All of these groups work hand in hand to get valuable integrations shipped and added to Jobber’s marketplace. 

At Jobber we never stop growing and learning, and you shouldn’t either. Through continuous 1:1’s, dedicated feedback and support from your manager and our Learning and Development team, and your own sense of curiosity, we hope you develop to another level with your skill set.

The role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering, as a Senior Solutions Engineer you will leverage your expertise in application marketplaces and APIs to drive the success of our integration initiatives. You will work closely with both technical and non-technical teams, as well as leadership, to create impactful solutions to help our customers and their small businesses be successful. You will collaborate with the partnerships team and external partner groups to deeply understand their technical operational needs and translate those conversations into actionable engineering plans. You will work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, marketers, sales and leadership to bring these products to life and accelerate partner growth. 

We’re looking for people who are ready to solve problems that millions of entrepreneurs are facing, using their experience to influence both a product and our team, all the while still working on developing their own craft. At Jobber we never stop growing and learning, and you shouldn’t either. Through continuous 1:1s, dedicated feedback and support from your manager and our Learning and Development team, and your own sense of curiosity, we hope you develop to another level with your skill set.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will:

 - Work with Business Development, Jobber Engineering and External Third Parties to propose and design solutions that meet all parties needs.  

 - Develop and implement integration strategies that enhance our application marketplace offerings.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and optimize API solutions (REST and GraphQL).

 - Act as a liaison between technical teams and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals.

 - Provide technical support and guidance to partners throughout the integration process.

 - Identify opportunities for innovation and process improvement within the integration landscape.

 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to conceptualize, design, and iteratively deliver high-impact features that address customer needs

 - Partner with Product and Design teams to shape and define the strategic product roadmap

 - Actively participate in code reviews and testing processes to ensure code quality and maintainability

 - Champion the development of consistent engineering practices and reusable code solutions to enhance overall efficiency

 - Participate in discussions to drive consensus on optimal solutions for complex customer problems

 - Research, promote, and implement industry best practices within your team's domain, staying at the forefront of technological advancements

 - Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Provide mentorship and guidance to team members at all levels, fostering their professional growth and career development

To be successful, you should have:

 - Previous experience in a solutions engineering or similar role.

 - Proven experience in application marketplace development and management.

 - Strong knowledge of API technologies, including REST and GraphQL.

 - Strong communication skills 

 - Collaborative problem solving skills coupled with the ability to think on your feet

 - Demonstrated expertise in developing highly scalable, robust software solutions across multiple layers of the technology stack

 - Proven leadership experience championing complex, high-impact projects and serving as core contributor

 - Exceptional proficiency in software design, architecture, and coding, with a focus on maintainability and performance

 - Outstanding collaboration and communication skills, coupled with the ability to significantly amplify the team’s productivity and effectiveness through mentorship/coaching

 - Strong self-motivation and resourcefulness, with the capacity to independently identify and leverage necessary resources for project delivery and problem-solving

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity and prioritize tasks effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments

 - Passionate commitment to continuous learning and professional growth, with a track record of staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends

It would be really great (but not a deal-breaker) if you had:

 - Exposure or experience in a tech leadership role

 - Experience with our development stack: React, React Native, TypeScript, GraphQL API layer, and Ruby on Rails on AWS.

Hiring Process:

 - An interview with a Talent team member (45 mins)

 - A Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins)

 -  A take-home challenge with a follow-up Functional Interview (90 mins)

 - A Senior Leadership Interview (30 mins)

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $125,800, a midpoint of $147,900, and a maximum salary of $170,100, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. 

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. 

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

Small business owners don't just need software - they need a financial partner.

Running a home service business means juggling cash flow, fronting the cost of materials, protecting the business from risk, and helping customers afford bigger jobs. Today, most small business owners stitch this together with personal credit cards, generic bank accounts, insurance brokers who don't understand their trade, and financing options their customers can't access at the moment they need them. It's fragmented, it's expensive, and none of it is built for how they actually work.

That's the opportunity for Fintech New Bets.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets to discover, validate, and launch Jobber's next generation of financial products - in areas like insurance, consumer financing, and spend and money management (think a card offering and business banking built for Pros). This is a high-impact, highly senior individual contributor role at the intersection of zero-to-one product building and deep fintech domain expertise. You'll take loosely defined opportunities and turn them into live products with real customers and real revenue.

The team

Fintech is one of the fastest-growing parts of Jobber, and a core strategic priority for us as a company. We're investing in this growing area because we believe embedding financial tools within our product deepens our ability to help small businesses be successful.

Whether it's helping small businesses get paid using Jobber Payments, getting access to capital to invest in growth, or offering financing to our customers' customers, we believe small business owners should have seamless access to financial tools that allow them to thrive.

New Bets is the team charged with finding what comes next. As Jobber's fintech business scales beyond payments, we're expanding into new, high-impact financial products - and this role is the product leadership engine of that expansion. You'll work in close partnership with your commercial and strategy counterparts on the New Bets team, who own business cases, partner negotiations, and unit economics - together, you'll take new bets from idea, to business case, to shipped product.

Simply put, we care much more about our customers than any financial institution ever will. That's our superpower.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets who brings deep product expertise, strong zero-to-one instincts, and the ability to lead through influence across a complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes domain.

In this role, you'll own the product side of Jobber's newest fintech bets. You'll look across the financial life of a home service business - how they spend, borrow, insure, and bank - and identify which products Jobber should build, buy, or partner to deliver. You'll run rapid discovery and validation, shape build-vs-partner decisions with embedded finance and banking-as-a-service providers, and lead the first versions of these products from pilot through to scale.

Unlike our established product areas, there is no playbook here. You'll be expected to operate with high autonomy, form conviction from thin data, kill ideas that don't clear the bar, and bring cross-functional partners along with clarity and speed. This is a role for someone who is energized by ambiguity, moves fast without breaking trust, and has shipped financial products before.

As a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets you will:

 - Take new bets from zero to one: frame the customer problem, size the opportunity, design and run lean validation experiments and pilots, and make evidence-based go/no-go recommendations.

 - Lead build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions, evaluating embedded finance, banking-as-a-service, insurance, and lending partners on capabilities, economics, risk, and customer experience - and shaping those partnerships alongside our commercial team.

 - Ship and scale first versions of new financial products, defining the MVP, sequencing the roadmap, and iterating quickly based on customer and market feedback.

 - Partner deeply with Design, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and GTM to navigate the regulatory and operational realities of launching financial products.

 - Use qualitative and quantitative insights - including unit economics, adoption signals, and risk performance - to form deep conviction about which bets deserve further investment.

 - Elevate product thinking across the fintech group, shaping how other PMs and leaders evaluate new opportunities, frame trade-offs, and make decisions in emerging financial domains.

 - Balance the urgency of proving new bets quickly with the rigor required to build durable, trustworthy financial products at scale.

To be successful, you should have:

 - Extensive product management experience, with a proven track record of taking new products from concept to launch - ideally including at least one financial product with meaningful revenue accountability.

 - Experience operating at a staff or principal level - defining strategy across ambiguous problem spaces, influencing without authority, and shaping org-wide product direction.

 - Deep familiarity with fintech products such as card issuing, spend management, business banking, insurance, or lending - and an understanding of the partner, risk, and compliance ecosystems behind them.

 - Exceptional product sense and commercial rigor. You can pressure-test unit economics and business cases as comfortably as you can critique a customer flow.

 - A bias for validated learning: you know how to de-risk a bet cheaply, when to double down, and when to walk away.

 - The ability to connect deep customer insight to long-term business strategy and communicate it clearly to senior stakeholders, external partners, and cross-functional teams.

 - A high bar for quality, ownership, and outcomes - combined with the judgment to know when to go deep and when to zoom out.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience launching embedded fintech products in a vertical SaaS or platform business

 - Experience working with banking-as-a-service or embedded finance providers, card networks, sponsor banks, insurance carriers or MGAs, or consumer lending partners.

 - Experience serving small businesses, particularly in home and field services.

ashby:jobber:8f88e508-9c9f-4562-a602-644.description:
Jobber helps small home service businesses - plumbers, electricians, painters, landscapers - quote, schedule, invoice and get paid, while giving their customers an easy and professional experience. Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Automations Platform to be part of our AI Workflows product organization.



The team:

The Automations Platform team builds the system that lets Jobber Teammate, our AI teammate for home service businesses, do a service provider's work for them. Every automation in Jobber runs on what this team builds.



The role:

You'll make it possible for Jobber Teammate to automate every task in Jobber.

Today a handful of automations exist and each one is expensive to build. The ambition is that every task a service provider repeats in their week has an automation that does it for them. Getting there takes two things at once, and this role does both.

You'll build the platform: the authoring, execution and evaluation models that let any product team at Jobber ship an automation without first becoming AI specialists. Skill files, tool calls, and evals that make an automation measurably better over time.

You'll also build on the platform: choosing the automations that matter most, shipping them yourself, and making them easy to find, enable and trust. Being the platform's hardest customer is what keeps it honest.

Over time you'll open it up, so service providers create their own and the best ones spread to businesses like theirs.

This suits someone equally at home in an architecture discussion and a customer interview.



As Senior Product Manager you will:

 - Build a deep understanding of home service businesses and the repeated work that consumes their week.

 - Own the automation platform: how automations are authored, how they execute, and how they're evaluated and improved.

 - Make it fast and cheap for any Jobber team to ship an automation, and measure yourself on their throughput rather than your own.

 - Build the highest-impact automations yourself, and make them easy for service providers to find, enable and trust.

 - Build an Evals platform, that makes it easy to iterate on and improve automations so the quality bar is constantly raising

 - Bring the product requirements to our AI Foundations engineering team, who build the underlying agent infrastructure.

 - Define the metrics that tell you the platform works: cost and speed of building an automation, engagement with the ones we ship, and growth of the library.



To be successful, you should have:

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of shipping real AI products and seeing them through to long-term outcomes.

 - A growth mindset and someone who thrives in change and ambiguity. The AI Org you’ll join is a fast moving space and we expect that the technology, positioning, scope and roles will all continue to evolve as we learn together

 - Experience building an AI platform was genuinely adopted - won through advocacy, tooling, and documentation.

 - Experience shipping LLM-backed or ML-backed products, with real respect for how they fail.

 - A track record of making a contested technical decision and making it stick.

 - Comfort thinking in unit economics, because the cost of building an automation decides whether this strategy is real.



Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling, or evaluation and observability systems for AI.

 - Experience with workflow automation, or no-code and low-code builder products.

 - Experience in home services, field service, or SMB software.



Hiring Process:

 - An interview with a Talent team member (45 mins)

 - A Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins)

 -  A take-home challenge with a follow-up Functional Interview (90 mins)

 - A Senior Leadership Interview (30 mins)

 

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person. This role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Toronto, Edmonton, Vancouver, and Boston.


Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $145,900, a midpoint of $171,600, and a maximum salary of $197,400, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. 

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. 

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

greenhouse:maximizer:4379612009.description:
About the role:   

 We are building the CRM and AI operating system for wealth management — and to do that, Maximizer has to become the single source of truth for a client's financial picture.   

 That picture is scattered. An advisor with 200 to 3,000 clients has investment data sitting in custodians, back-office platforms, and sometimes their firm's own data lake, while policies live in systems never designed to be read by anyone else. Advisors stitch it together by hand, or not at all. Every source you open changes that — for every advisor on our platform, on the day it goes live.   

 This is the rare product role where the hard part is genuinely unsolved. Some of these systems have clean APIs. Some have nothing at all, and getting data out of them takes invention.   

 We care more about what you know than what your last title was. You need to be the person who can walk into an undocumented system and come out with clean data. This role could be a fit for former Integration Consultants, System Architects, Wealth Operations IT staff, and more   

 What you'll do:   

 Bring the data in   

- Own the roadmap for getting wealth and insurance data into Maximizer — from custodians, back-office and wealth platforms, aggregators and exchanges, carriers, MGAs, and more.   

- Build integrations into enterprise customers' own data lakes, and make them repeatable rather than bespoke each time.   

- Define the canonical schemas — accounts, holdings, transactions, policies, coverage, beneficiaries — and own the mapping from each source's format into them.   

- Choose the right acquisition method per source: API, SFTP or batch file, secure automated capture where no API exists, and a well-designed upload path as the fallback.   

- Own data quality end to end — matching records to the right client and household, reconciliation, freshness, and what an advisor sees when a feed breaks — and the security and compliance posture behind it.   

 Open new sources, a few at a time   

- Run each new source as a pilot: find the right people, learn what data exists and how it can be reached, prove it on a small scale, then decide whether to build for scale.   

- Support leadership in partner conversations — evaluate feasibility, work through partner specs, and size the effort. Leadership owns the relationship and commercial terms; you own the judgment on what is buildable and what it is worth.   

- It helps if you have exposure to any of the following: NBIN, Fidelity Clearing Canada, Croesus, Univeris, Dataphile, NDEX, Fundserv, APEXA, iPipeline/WealthServ, Wealthica, or Flinks.   

 Turn it into product   

- Own the adjacent product areas where this data surfaces, so integrations become visible value rather than a plumbing project.   

- Run discovery with advisors and head offices, write clear specs, and work hands-on with Engineering through delivery.   

 What you'll bring:   

- 3–6 years driving integrations in B2B SaaS or financial services — as a product manager, consultant, implementation lead, systems architect, integration analyst, or solutions consultant.    

- Experience driving new integrations with external partners end to end: opening the conversation, working out what data is available, agreeing how to get it, and seeing it through to live.   

- Skill navigating stakeholders on both sides — partner operations, security, and legal teams externally; engineering, compliance, and leadership internally.   

- Real fluency with data structure and movement — schemas, mapping, normalization, reconciliation, APIs, batch and SFTP feeds, authentication. You do not need to write the code, but you can read a partner spec and hold your own with engineers.   

- The ability to lead without authority, and comfort with ambiguity: many of these sources are undocumented or inconsistent, and you will set direction anyway.   

- Nice to have: familiarity with how investment or insurance data moves in Canada — custodians, back-office and wealth platforms, carriers, and MGAs. Useful, not required.   

 Why you should apply:   

 💰 Competitive Salaries with RRSP matching program   

 🏝 Generous paid vacay and sick days   

 💻 A powerful Laptop   

 📚 Budget for courses, books, and personal development   

 ❤️ Peer to peer recognition and rewards   

 🍹 Team building events, happy hours and more   

 🧒🏻 Flexible, remote & hybrid work   

 About Maximizer   

 Maximizer was launched in a garage on Vancouver Island in 1987 and helped pioneer contact management, sales force automation, and modern CRM, attracting over 100,000 customers and 1 million users along the way. Today we are focused on financial professionals — building the CRM and AI operating system for wealth management, purpose-built for advisor teams and the head offices behind them.   

 Interest? We'd love to hear from you!   

 If you're interested in a career with Maximizer, please submit your resume and cover letter. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, faith, colour, cultural background, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.   

 Salary Range
 $95,000 — $115,000 CAD

Company Description
MEDFAR Clinical Solutions was founded in 2010 by two aeronautical engineers who realized that the healthcare system was not exploiting the full potential of technology. Supported by a large community of medical experts and focused on clinical success and patient safety, MEDFAR was the first company to certify a cloud-based Electronic Medical Record in Canada: MYLE (Make Your Life Easy).
Committed to promoting excellence and effectiveness in healthcare worldwide, MEDFAR differentiates itself by offering a unique healthcare management solution for clinics, which replaces inefficient processes with a faster and safer technological alternative.
Job Description
At MEDFAR, we are shaping the future of digital healthcare. As a Senior Product Owner, you will play a key role in defining and executing our product vision, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that improve patient care and streamline clinical workflows. You will lead strategic initiatives, mentor junior team members, and drive impactful decision-making at the leadership level.
Responsibilities
Own the solution strategy for your product domains, translating the vision and roadmap set by Product Management into how each domain delivers on them, informed by market analysis, competitive intelligence, and user research.
Own the user experience of your product domains as a whole, not only what ships: end-to-end workflows, consistency across features, and known experience gaps. Product Designers support you on the UI and interactions; you remain accountable for the experience delivered.
Lead user research initiatives, translating complex user needs into clear and actionable product requirements.
Own and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with the development team and Product Management, balancing technical, business, and user needs with data-driven decisions to align with strategic goals.
Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to execute successful product releases, managing timelines, risks, and resource allocation.
Mentor and coach junior and intermediate product owners, fostering professional growth and promoting best practices.
Drive strategic R&D initiatives across multiple development teams and projects.
Guide development teams by answering questions, defining priorities, identifying opportunities for incremental delivery, and removing roadblocks.
Represent the product team in leadership-level discussions, influencing strategic decisions and providing progress updates.
Facilitate collaboration across teams through proactive communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management.

Permanent full-time position (40 hours per week).
Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement.

Candidates must reside in the province of Quebec.

Deep expertise in Agile methodologies and software development lifecycles.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and critical thinking abilities.
Deep understanding of the market and competitive landscape, enabling informed product decisions.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Figma) and software management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
Experience in building large-scale product solutions with third-party system integrations.

Experience working with electronic medical records (EMRs), clinical workflows, and patient engagement tools.

About the Company: Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.    Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us! About the Role As an Agentic Product Manager at Netomi, you will be the strategic and technical owner responsible for designing, architecting, and deploying large-scale Agentic AI solutions for enterprise customers. You will translate complex business processes into AI-driven workflows, define integration blueprints, and guide customers through their transformation to autonomous AI agents.   You will work closely with Customers, CSM, Integration Engineers, QA, Product, and Engineering to ensure end-to-end success of every deployment. Responsibilities:

  • Lead discovery sessions with enterprise customers to understand business processes, operations, workflows, KPIs, and constraints.

  • Identify automation opportunities and design agentic orchestration strategies using Netomi’s AI platform.

  • Build detailed solution blueprints — workflows, data exchanges, escalation logic, guardrails, analytics, and agent lifecycle design.

  • Define end-to-end Agentic AI architectures, covering intents, actions, tools, integration points, and decision logic.

  • Work with customer technical teams to map integration dependencies (APIs, events, SSO, CRMs, ticketing systems, internal tools).

  • Own the creation of integration design documents and support Integration Engineers during implementation.

  • Ensure agent workflows comply with enterprise standards (security, reliability, audit, governance).

  • Collaborate with Product & Engineering to translate customer requirements into features or enhancements.

  • Serve as the product owner during deployment — driving priorities, clarifications, acceptance criteria, and workflow evolution.

  • Validate solution behavior end-to-end with QA and guide test plans, scenario tests, and success criteria.

  • Conduct user-experience reviews of agent outputs and behavior tuning.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders (CX, Ops, Digital Transformation, Engineering).

  • Present architectural recommendations, best practices, and roadmap suggestions.

  • Train customer teams on agentic workflows, governance, and performance improvement strategies.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time with high quality, low rework, and measurable impact.

  • Drive continuous improvement through playbooks, reusable workflow templates, and integration patterns.

  • Maintain deep expertise in agentic AI, LLMs, workflow orchestration, and enterprise systems.

    • Requirements:

  • 4–10 years in Solutions Architecture / Implementation Consulting / Product Consulting / Workflow Design for enterprise SaaS or AI platforms.

  • Experience designing complex workflows and integrations across enterprise systems.

  • Ability to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and drive execution.

  • Customer-facing consulting experience with strong communication & facilitation skills.

  • Understanding of REST APIs, event-driven systems, data flows, and enterprise integrations.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with CSM, engineering, product, and QA teams.

    • Nice-to-Have:

  • Background in Conversational AI, Agentic AI, RPA, Automation, CRM/Ticketing, or LLM-based products.

  • Hands-on experience defining business logic, decision trees, or automated workflows.

  • Experience with enterprises such as airlines, BFSI, telecom, retail, or large-scale customer support environments.

PLEASE NOTE: While this position is open in US and Canada, there is a strong preference for candidates located in Austin, TX or Nashville, TN 

 Job Description 

 NetSuite Customer Education creates learning experiences that help customers use the product effectively and realize greater value from their investment. The team builds high-impact learning assets to a consistently high standard, with a video-first approach. The Senior Program Manager sets the strategic direction, standards, and operating model that are growing our portfolio. 

 We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Senior Program Manager to lead learning content programs from intake through publication and to define how the program management function itself operates. This role partners with senior leaders, instructional designers, learning strategists, curriculum program leads, subject matter experts, multimedia and editorial teams, analytics, in-application learning, and go-to-market stakeholders to make sure programs deliver on schedule and customers can learn from what the team built. 

 The ideal candidate is a strategic program leader and exceptionally strong executor who can run a broad portfolio of production workstreams, establish the intake, scoping, and review model the wider team works from, and carry judgment calls through significant ambiguity with little precedent to follow. Hands-on editing happens occasionally, to prototype a format or set a standard others follow, and it is not the core of the role. 

 Responsibilities 

 Key Responsibilities 

- 
 Own learning content programs end to end, from intake and scoping through production, review, publication, and post-release review. 

- 
 Identify, prioritize, and successfully execute a broad portfolio of learning content initiatives and programs, planning and directing schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously. 

- 
 Partner closely with global cross-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs, then navigate complex dependencies between cross-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path. 

- 
 Facilitate intake and scoping sessions with instructional designers, learning strategists, curriculum program leads, and subject matter experts that close with the learning objective, the modality, the audience, the measure of success, and the owner of each deliverable documented. 

- 
 Convert leadership direction and subject matter input into production briefs a team can execute against, covering the learning objective, the outline, script direction, capture requirements, and review checkpoints. 

- 
 Prepare product and industry experts for capture and direct them through remote recording sessions, coaching them toward a natural delivery that holds up on camera and takes fewer takes and shorter sessions to get. 

- 
 Work from long recordings, transcripts, and technical source material to find the teaching sequence inside it, then shape that into an outline a producer can build to. 

- 
 Address and mitigate risks by driving mitigation plans, establishing ownership for each item, and following up regularly through to program closure, escalating as necessary so risks and issues get resolved. 

- 
 Influence internal and external teams to prioritize the work, holding a tight review loop of timestamped feedback, scheduled revision rounds, and clear status across instructional design, multimedia, editorial, analytics, in-application learning, and go-to-market partners through intake, review, and sign-off. 

- 
 Establish scalable frameworks of process and tooling for end-to-end program delivery and manage stakeholders by applying project management standards and documentation best practices. 

- 
 Write and maintain the standard operating procedures, production and brand standards, review checkpoints, and reusable templates that hold quality steady as production volume increases. 

- 
 Build and maintain consistent reporting across numerous programs, run standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned, and report status to stakeholders on a regular cadence. 

- 
 Provide rigorous management and analysis of program budget, including spend and forecasted spend against budget, spend per program, and historical trends, and forecast production capacity against the roadmap so programs are scoped to the resources available and conflicts surface before they affect delivery. 

- 
 Map how short instructional assets, long-form courses, and supporting material connect across the learning platform and approved public-facing learning channels, so every asset gives the learner a clear next step. 

- 
 Run post-release reviews with the analytics team to understand how published assets performed and carry what that shows into the next program. 

- 
 Set priority across the full content portfolio when demand exceeds capacity, deciding what gets built, deferred, or retired, and making those calls with limited precedent to follow. 

- 
 Represent learning content programs to senior leadership, presenting portfolio status, trade-offs, and recommendations with a clear point of view on what to do next. 

- 
 Determine methods and procedures on new assignments where little precedent exists, and define the operating model the wider team works from. 

- 
 Coach producers, editors, and designers through review and working sessions to raise the standard of the work, mentor less experienced program and production staff, and coordinate the activities of other personnel as needed. This role has no direct reports. 

- 
 Leverage AI technologies throughout content and video workflows to promote innovation and enhance efficiency, quality, and decision-making. 

 Qualifications 

- 
 Eight or more years of experience managing content, video, or multimedia programs, including accountability for scope, schedule, and delivery across multiple contributors and experience leading a portfolio rather than a single program. 

- 
 Experience operating without an established playbook, standing up a program or a function where the process did not exist beforehand. 

- 
 Experience facilitating working sessions with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts, converting those discussions into documented direction, decisions, and next steps, and holding a recommendation when a senior stakeholder pushes in a different direction. 

- 
 Experience planning and directing schedules for multiple programs running at the same time, and managing dependencies across cross-functional teams. 

- 
 Demonstrated track record of building repeatable production processes and documenting them, including standard operating procedures, templates, review gates, and quality standards. 

- 
 Experience directing non-professional on-camera talent remotely and coaching subject matter experts to a natural, credible delivery. 

- 
 Ability to turn dense technical or written source material into a clear instructional sequence with a stated outcome for the learner. 

- 
 Practical experience using AI-assisted tools in content and video workflows, including rough assembly, transcript cleanup, audio repair, captioning, assisted animation, upscaling, prompt libraries for repeatable production steps, or other repetitive production tasks. 

- 
 Working proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, sufficient to set production standards, review work credibly, and prototype a new format. 

- 
 Sound judgment on instructional structure, including a clear outcome for the learner and a reason for every minute of runtime. 

- 
 Familiarity with a timestamped video review platform and with project intake and tracking tools. 

- 
 Professional written and spoken English; the role produces English-language video content. 

- 
 Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent programs, respond constructively to feedback, and meet deadlines during United States business hours. 

- 
 Bachelor's degree in education, learning and development, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- 
 Ability to travel up to 10% 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- 
 Experience preparing or publishing video assets for eLearning or learning-management-system environments. 

- 
 On-camera presentation or voiceover experience. 

- 
 Experience supporting learning or enablement content for a business software audience. 

- 
 Familiarity with Oracle NetSuite, enterprise resource planning concepts, or software product education. 

- 
 Proficiency with project-management and collaboration tools such as Wrike, Jira, SharePoint, and presentation tools. 

 Experience mentoring or developing other program managers, producers, or editors

Please see above.
