lever:quandri:423ac9bc-333d-48d9-86fc-a2.description:
What You'll Do::
  • Discovery & Product Definition: Take the commercial discovery already underway and drive it to conclusions. You'll spend real time with account managers, producers, and agency leaders at agencies of different sizes, mapping the commercial renewal workflow end to end. What you learn becomes the product definition, covering what we build, what data it needs, and how the experience should feel.
  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: You'll set the commercial product strategy and own the roadmap. That means deciding which parts of our platform carry over and where we need net-new capability, then sequencing deliberately, starting with the highest-leverage workflows and the lightest approach that gets us to market and learning quickly.
  • 0-to-1 Product Development: Commercial has genuinely hard problems, and you'll own them from problem definition through launch and iteration. Expect to validate solution approaches with cheap prototypes before committing engineering, and to design experiments that test the riskiest assumptions early.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Shipping this product takes the whole company. You'll drive alignment across engineering, design, implementation, and customer success, influence platform and architecture decisions so commercial strengthens the product rather than fragmenting it, and help the organization understand where commercial differs from personal lines.
  • Go-to-Market & Early Adoption: Getting to market is part of the job, not a handoff. You'll partner with Sales and Marketing on commercial positioning, target customers, and early-adopter criteria, then choose the right design partners from our existing customers and fold what they teach us back into the product and the messaging.
  • Measurement & Iteration: You'll define the metrics that connect product usage to broker outcomes. At this stage, learning velocity matters as much as absolute numbers, so you'll build measurement to match and change course quickly when the outcomes aren't there.
    • The right person for this role will have: :

    Product judgment matters for this role. We're looking for someone who thinks rigorously about customer problems and ships outcomes and we're glad to take a shot on an excellent product thinker and teach them the insurance. Commercial P&C knowledge is preferred rather than required, and if you bring both, even better.

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products that drive measurable business outcomes in fast-moving environments

  • 0-to-1 experience taking a product from concept through discovery, launch, and early scaling, under ambiguous requirements and with limited historical data

  • Strong discovery skills. You've run customer research that uncovers root workflow problems rather than surface requests, interviewed brokers or account managers, mapped operational workflows, and turned the findings into product requirements

  • Platform thinking. You can judge how a new product area fits an existing platform, where to lean on shared infrastructure like extraction pipelines, analysis engines and agency/brokerage management systems integrations, and where to build net-new

  • Prioritization against outcome hypotheses rather than feature requests. You think in business impact and customer behavior change

  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority, and navigating conflicting priorities across engineering, design, sales, and customer success

  • Excellent communication. You can explain commercial insurance nuance to engineers, product tradeoffs to brokers, and priorities to any audience

  • A bias toward action and comfort deciding with imperfect information

  • Fluency with AI-first prototyping tools such as Replit, Lovable, Make, and Claude Code for rapid solution exploration and validation

    • Bonus points if you have::

  • Direct experience at a commercial lines carrier, MGA, wholesale broker, or insurtech serving the commercial market

  • Hands-on time with broker management systems (Applied Epic, AMS360, Hawksoft), including how commercial policy data differs from personal lines in structure and storage

  • Understanding of ACORD standards and commercial data exchange, from ACORD forms to certificate issuance and carrier submission workflows

  • A past move of an existing platform into a new market segment, such as SMB to enterprise, personal to commercial, or single market to multi-market

  • Time at high-growth, venture-backed companies, balancing speed to market against domain complexity

    • Our guiding principles::

  • Customers at the core. We put the customer at the center of all we do. At a basic level, we believe business success comes down to talking to customers and building something they want. We don’t listen to customers and just take what they say blindly, but we think critically about it and build what they need. Customers are the core of everything we do, and our business exists to serve them. We prioritize their needs over all else within the company.

  • Move with urgency. There are times when we need to move slowly and deliberately, but we default to acting fast and with urgency. We slow down when necessary, but this should be a deliberate choice. Businesses become more lethargic as they grow, this principle is designed to fight this fact.

  • Be curious. We understand the world by being curious and asking why. We aren’t satisfied with surface level understanding, and seek a deeper understanding of why things are the way they are. Don’t take someone’s word for it or the answer “because that’s how we do it.” Understand why and dig deep.

  • Excellence in execution. We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.

  • Act like an owner.  We’re all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long-term.

  • Fight for simplicity. The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.

  • AI-first. We believe AI is a fundamental shift in how work gets done, not just a tool we occasionally reach for. At Quandri, we lead with AI, in how we build our product, how we run our operations, and how we think about every process and workflow. This isn't about replacing people; it's about unlocking them to do higher-value work.

    • Compensation and Benefits::

  • The range for base pay is $150k - $200k CAD, dependent on level of experience, performance and choice of stock option compensation. US-based candidates will receive location-adjusted compensation.

  • Employee stock options reflecting a senior-level role

  • Comprehensive health benefits, including Lifestyle Spending Account

  • Four weeks of paid vacation per year

  • Work anywhere in the world for 60 days of the year

  • Parental leave top-ups: 6 months for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents (up to $100,000 annual salary)

  • Enhanced mental health benefits through Dialogue, providing unlimited access to mental health practitioners at no cost

lever:quandri:887db332-bc0e-4a0a-a550-db.description:
Who we are 
Our mission at Quandri is to transform insurance into a trusted and delightful experience using AI. We are building the AI operating system for North America’s best insurance agencies and brokerages. 

For the first time ever, we have the technology to fundamentally change how insurance operates, and the stakes are human. Better insurance means families protected from harm, businesses able to take risks, and communities more resilient when the worst happens. For insurance practitioners, the ability to deliver this level of service finally becomes possible.
What we do
Quandri brings deeply specific, vertically-focused AI to the industry’s most critical stakeholders:insurance agencies and brokerages. 
Agents are the lifeblood of the industry, the place where most property and casualty insurance is sold and serviced. Yet operating an agency is harder than ever. Peak product complexity, accelerating consolidation, a deepening talent crisis, and the AI revolution are all reshaping how agencies work.
Quandri sits at the cutting edge of this shift, rebuilding how agencies operate one workflow at a time. We pair a deep understanding of insurance processes, systems, and data with serious technical capability and proprietary models, so the transformation is tangible and operational rather than aspirational.
We’re making insurance better for policyholders, while helping insurance brokerages deliver a better client service, grow faster, and harness AI so that they control the future of insurance distribution.
Why join us?
You'll join a fast-moving team with real ownership, direct access to leadership, and a genuine hand in shaping the company's next chapter.
We are headquartered in beautiful Vancouver, BC, backed by leading US and Canadian investors, and the recognition has followed:
LinkedIn’s Top Canadian Startups in 2024 & 2025
Deloitte’s Fast 50
CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 and Fintech 100 
The Globe and Mail’s Top Growing Companies in Canada.
About the Role: 
Canadian brokerages have been with Quandri from the start, and are a core part of our business. We're doubling down on Canada and hiring a Product Manager to lead it.
Think of this role as the CEO of Quandri Canada from a product perspective. You’ll own the Canadian market across our entire product portfolio, including Quoting, Analyze, Intelligence and our shared platform. You’ll be accountable for understanding what Canadian customers need, deciding where we invest, and showing the return on that investment. You’ll deliver through our existing product and engineering teams rather than a dedicated team, so your ability to build a compelling case and influence without authority will be key.
This is a rare chance to own a market, with a high level of scope and impact.
What you’ll do:  
Own the success of the Canadian market across Quandri’s product portfolio, including the return on what we invest in Canada.
Meet our Canadian customers to understand the state of the market, their workflows, and where our product falls short.
Build and own our investment strategy in the Canadian market: the most important unmet needs, a prioritized set of investments, and the resources and outcomes tied to each.
Make the case for your priorities: present and justify your approach to leadership stakeholders.
Partner with the wider Product Management team and engineering leads across our products, coordinating dependencies and following through on delivery.
Find and deliver quick wins, make sure Canadian customers know about the value Quandri already delivers for them.
The right person for this role will have:
6+ years of experience, with significant time in product management. Business-focused and technical backgrounds are both welcome.
A business-outcomes mindset. You think in terms of ROI, revenue and customer impact, not just features shipped, and you see the bigger picture of the business.
Exceptionally high ownership. You act like the CEO of your product, take responsibility for its success or failure, and find a way to make it work.
Comfort with a high degree of ambiguity. You can define the problem as well as solve them.
A proven ability to influence without authority and to sell your ideas, building a compelling case for leadership and cross-functional partners.
Experience working directly with customers and turning what you learn into a prioritized, justified plan.
Strong commercial and analytical skills, including comfort building and owning a P&L or investment model.
Bonus points if you have: 
A background in business development, management consulting or another commercial role before moving into product.
PM experience at an early-stage startup.
Experience owning a market, region or P&L, or a GM-style scope.
Familiarity with the Canadian P&C insurance industry, insurance brokerages or insurtech.
Experience with B2B SaaS or AI products.

Our guiding principles:
Customers at the core. We put the customer at the center of all we do. At a basic level, we believe business success comes down to talking to customers and building something they want. We don’t listen to customers and just take what they say blindly, but we think critically about it and build what they need. Customers are the core of everything we do, and our business exists to serve them. We prioritize their needs over all else within the company.
Move with urgency. There are times when we need to move slowly and deliberately, but we default to acting fast and with urgency. We slow down when necessary, but this should be a deliberate choice. Businesses become more lethargic as they grow, this principle is designed to fight this fact.
Be curious. We understand the world by being curious and asking why. We aren’t satisfied with surface level understanding, and seek a deeper understanding of why things are the way they are. Don’t take someone’s word for it or the answer “because that’s how we do it.” Understand why and dig deep.
Excellence in execution. We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.
Act like an owner.  We’re all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long-term.
Fight for simplicity. The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.
AI-first. We believe AI is a fundamental shift in how work gets done, not just a tool we occasionally reach for. At Quandri, we lead with AI, in how we build our product, how we run our operations, and how we think about every process and workflow. This isn't about replacing people; it's about unlocking them to do higher-value work.
Compensation and Benefits:
The range for base pay is $150k - $200k CAD, most hires land around the midpoint of the range, while candidates with standout experience may land closer to the top.
Employee stock options, granted based off experience level upon hire and subject to a standard vesting schedule
Employee stock options based on experience level
Comprehensive health benefits, including $500 Lifestyle Spending Account
Four weeks of paid vacation per year
Work anywhere in the world for 60 calendar days of the year
Parental leave top-ups: 6 months for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents (up to $100,000 annual salary)
Quandri is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an equal opportunity employer, Quandri adheres to Canadian labour laws and does not engage in discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected under Canadian law.
Don’t let imposter syndrome stop you from applying. Great people sometimes don’t have the “right” experience. If you think that you’ll be amazing at this role then we encourage you to apply.

ABOUT QUORA:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

 - Quora http://quora.com: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

 - Poe https://poe.com/: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.




ABOUT THE TEAM AND ROLE:

Our product managers excel at and are responsible for guiding, enabling, and accelerating the efforts of our designers, engineers, and data scientists to build and ship successful products. Even though we've experienced significant growth, we're still a small team where each PM needs to own a significant portion of the product experience, so in this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive company-level impact, influence overall company strategy, and interface regularly with product leadership and the executive team.

We're looking for a Product Manager to lead user-centric growth initiatives across Quora's core product experience, focused on expanding our top-of-funnel acquisition, improving activation, and unlocking new growth levers across web and mobile. This includes crafting engaging user experiences, running a high-velocity experimentation program, aligning cross-functional teams, and generating user insights that inform long-term platform strategy.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the end-to-end user growth funnel, with a focus on top-of-funnel acquisition, activation, and early retention across web and mobile surfaces

 - Deeply understand users both on and off the platform and build engaging experiences that expand Quora’s reach to new demographics

 - Manage ambiguity, complexity, and cross-functional interdependencies in a fast-paced environment, doing what it takes to make the product successful

 - Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and product operations to define, build, iterate, and ship high-quality growth experiences at scale

 - Define objectives, metrics, and guardrails to guide prioritization and measure success

 - Run structured experimentation across the funnel, using quantitative and qualitative insights to inform product strategy and roadmap

 - Monitor and analyze industry and product trends to identify new strategic growth levers that drive user growth, audience expansion, and product retention




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours https://quora.com/coordination_hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

 - 5+ years combined experience in Product Management

 - Demonstrated experience driving user growth on a consumer product, with a track record of measurable impact on acquisition, activation, or retention metrics

 - Excellent communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level -- within teams, within the company, to users, and other audiences

 - Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to drive decisions and scale products through experimentation

 - Strong foundation in user research and design principles, with a track record of leveraging insights to launch winning user experiences




PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

 - Experience working on user-generated content (UGC) platforms, marketplaces, aggregators, or content-driven consumer products

 - Experience growing UGC products with heavy SEO traffic and a strong understanding of organic search as an acquisition channel

 - BA/BS degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience

lever:sophos:17629a84-3537-4127-9665-10e.title: Director, Product Marketing, AI Solutions
lever:sophos:17629a84-3537-4127-9665-10e.description:
About Us Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.   Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.   Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com. Role Summary As Director of Product Marketing for AI Solutions, you will lead go-to-market strategy, positioning, and messaging for Sophos' AI security portfolio and the emerging categories reshaping how defenders operate, including Sophos AI Defense and Fusion AI.   This is a build-and-launch role, working across product management, Sophos X-Ops research, sales enablement, demand generation, and channel marketing to turn technical innovation into pipeline and customer outcomes. You must be AI-native in how you work, using AI as a multiplier for your own judgment to research faster, draft sharper, and ship at the pace the market demands.  In your capacity as an Individual Contributor within the Sophos Product Marketing team, you will work closely with your Product Marketing colleagues to develop the AI narratives for our broader solution portfolio, including AI-augmented MDR, AI-native detection and response, and protections built for an AI-accelerated threat landscape. What You Will Own :

Positioning and Messaging 

  • Own positioning and messaging for Sophos' AI solutions portfolio, including the new and emerging categories where Sophos is defining the market. 

  • Build the category narrative around AI-native cybersecurity defense, anchored in Sophos' position that AI handles scale and humans handle judgment and accountability. 

  • Guide the AI-related messaging for the broader Sophos portfolio, ensuring consistency at every point. 

  • Translate deep technical capability into clear, differentiated, channel-ready stories that resonate with security buyers, MSPs, and end customers. 

  • Develop and maintain the messaging frameworks, value propositions, competitive positioning, and proof points that ladder to the broader Sophos narrative. 

 
Launch and GTM Execution 

  • Lead end-to-end go-to-market planning for new AI solutions and category launches, from internal readiness through external announcement, partner enablement, and demand generation. 

  • Partner with Product Management to shape launch scope, sequencing, and tiering decisions that align market readiness with product reality. 

  • Build the asset library that powers each launch: pitch decks, solution briefs, web copy, video scripts, demo narratives, FAQs, battlecards, and partner playbooks. 

  • Drive cross-functional execution with Brand, Digital, Channel Marketing, Sales Enablement, PR, and Events to deliver coordinated, high-impact launches. 

Channel and Sales Enablement 

  • Equip the Sophos channel network (MSPs, MSSPs, resellers, VARs) to sell, position, and operationalize Sophos’ AI solutions with confidence. 

  • Build enablement programs in partnership with Sales Enablement and Channel Marketing that meet sellers and partners where they are, from first pitch through technical deep dive. 

  • Author the talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive positioning that frontline sellers and SEs need to win in AI-influenced deals. 

 
Market and Competitive Intelligence 

  • Maintain a working point of view on the AI cybersecurity market, including category boundaries, competitive moves, analyst coverage, and where Sophos is uniquely positioned to lead. 

  • Partner with Competitive Intelligence to track and respond to AI-related claims and product launches from established competitors and emerging entrants. 

  • Brief the analyst research community (e.g., Gartner, IDC, Omdia, etc.) on Sophos' AI portfolio, with the goal of shaping category definition and positioning. 

 
Customer and Voice-of-the-Market 

  • Build a feedback loop with customers, partners, and the field to test, refine, and validate messaging in-market. 

  • Work with the Customer Marketing and Channel Marketing teams to develop the customer and partner evidence, including case studies, quotes, references, and outcome data, that proves the value of Sophos AI solutions. 

What You Bring :

You might be a product marketer who’s embraced an AI-native approach to your craft, a product manager who has shipped and positioned technical solutions, or an AI builder who can tell a story as well as you can build. What matters is the combination of technical fluency, market instinct, and storytelling you bring to the role. 

 
Required 

  • AI-native in how you work: you use AI as a default part of your daily workflow, not an occasional experiment, with fluency across frontier tools for research, competitive analysis, drafting, and synthesis, and the judgment to know when output is ready to ship and when it needs human rework.  

  • 7+ years in roles that combine technical depth and market-facing communication: product marketing, product management, developer relations, founding or building AI products, or similar 

  • Proven track record bringing new products or categories to market, whether through positioning, launch, or building the thing itself 

  • Demonstrated ability to translate deep technical capability into clear, differentiated stories that land with buyers, partners, and the field 

  • The ability to build the full launch asset library and the judgment to know what belongs in it: pitch decks, solution briefs, web copy, competitive battlecards, and enablement playbooks 

  • Fluency in a channel-led model, or the ability to learn one fast, positioning and enabling through MSPs, MSSPs, resellers, and distributors as the operating model, not just the route to market 

  • A bias for automating your own toil: you build lightweight tools, prompts, and workflows for repetitive work (campaign analysis, message testing, launch workflow automation) that make GTM teams measurably faster, and you share them across sales, channel, and marketing rather than keeping them personal. 

  • Hands-on competitive instincts: you do primary research yourself rather than waiting for analyst coverage, getting into competitor trials, demos, documentation, release notes, and pricing and packaging pages, and you can tell what a competitor markets from what it actually ships. 

  • A track record of turning competitive findings into positioning, battlecards, and objection handling that sellers use in live deals, and of keeping that intelligence current. 

  • Sharp writer and communicator comfortable briefing analysts, enabling sellers, and presenting to senior stakeholders 

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, on short timelines, in a fast-moving market 

  • This is a 100% remote role however willingness to travel on occasion is required  

 
Preferred 

  • Direct experience marketing or building AI products, or a background at an AI-native company 

  • Direct experience with AI security, MDR, XDR, SIEM, or other cybersecurity solutions 

  • Working knowledge of the AI threat landscape, enough to hold a credible technical conversation 

  • Established relationships with industry analysts (Gartner, IDC, Omdia) and a track record shaping category definition 

How we work with AI :

At Sophos, AI is part of how we work every day. It is not a future state, and it is not a bonus skill. It is a tool we trust our team to use, and a capability we invest in together. 

In this role, that means using AI to move faster on competitive and market research, sharpen positioning and messaging, build and refine launch and enablement frameworks, draw insight from campaign and market data, and collaborate more effectively across a global organization. 

We are a cybersecurity company that sells AI-native defense. The most powerful thing we can do for our customers is live the same fluency we advocate for them. That means learning out loud, building together, and raising the bar for what marketing can be.

lever:sophos:be174b49-4458-4663-906d-e8b.title: Global Solutions Engineer
lever:sophos:be174b49-4458-4663-906d-e8b.description:
About the Role Sophos is seeking a Global Solutions Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across two strategic growth areas: our Managed Security Service Provider program and our expanding portfolio of AI security solutions. This is a highly visible individual contributor role for someone who can combine deep cybersecurity expertise, hands-on technical capability, partner engagement, and strong business acumen. In this role, you will help MSSP partners design, launch, and scale differentiated managed security services powered by Sophos technologies. You will also serve as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, helping customers and partners understand, evaluate, and secure the use of AI across modern environments. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading executive-level technical conversations, advising SOC and security engineering teams, building labs and demonstrations, supporting proofs of value, and translating complex cybersecurity and AI concepts into clear business outcomes. What You Will Do:

MSSP Program Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary Solutions Engineer for Sophos’ global MSSP program and strategic partner opportunities.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture workshops, demonstrations, and proofs of value with MSSP partners.
  • Help partners design and scale managed security services using Sophos Fusion and the broader Sophos cybersecurity portfolio.
  • Advise partners on service architecture, integrations, automation, operational readiness, and repeatable service delivery.

    • AI Security Domain Leadership

  • Act as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, including AI Defense and future AI offerings.
  • Lead demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of value that help customers and partners evaluate AI security risks and solutions.
  • Build hands-on AI security demos, lab environments, attack simulations, and repeatable technical evaluation methods.
  • Share field and market insights with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams.

    • Global Leadership and Field Impact

  • Create reusable technical assets, enablement materials, service blueprints, and field-ready best practices.
  • Mentor Sales Engineers, partner engineers, and other technical stakeholders to strengthen global field capability.
  • Represent Sophos in customer briefings, partner events, webinars, technical communities, and industry forums.
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with partners, customers, security leaders, and technical decision-makers.
    • What You Will Bring:
  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Security Architecture, security consulting, MSSP engineering, or a similar customer-facing cybersecurity role.
  • Experience supporting MSSP sales, partner engagements, service architecture, or managed security service development.
  • Strong knowledge of modern security operations, including MDR, XDR, SIEM, SOAR, endpoint security, cloud security, threat detection, incident response, and security integrations.
  • Deep understanding of MSSP business and technical models, including the requirements for delivering repeatable services to multiple customers.
  • Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI systems, AI application architectures, and the security risks associated with adopting and operating AI technologies.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, operating, and troubleshooting cybersecurity products and tools.
  • Experience building labs, demonstrations, workshops, proofs of value, and technical validation environments.
  • Ability to work with APIs, automation, cloud platforms, modern application architectures, Linux and Windows environments, networking, identity systems, and security telemetry.
  • Exceptional technical discovery, consultative selling, presentation, storytelling, demonstration, and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical engagements with partners, customers, and internal teams across multiple regions.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% across North America and internationally.

    • Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working in a Security Operations Center, security engineering organization, incident response team, or cybersecurity leadership role.
  • Experience designing, operating, or bringing managed security services to market.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud AI platforms, AI agents, model APIs, local or private models, open-source AI technologies, containers, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience speaking at industry events, publishing technical content, or representing an organization as a cybersecurity subject matter expert.
  • Relevant cybersecurity, cloud, architecture, or AI certifications.
  • Experience with Sophos technologies.
    • Why Sophos:

    Sophos helps organizations and service providers reduce cyber risk through an integrated portfolio of cybersecurity technologies, managed security services, threat intelligence, and expert-led security operations.

    As a Global Solutions Engineer, you will help shape how MSSPs build the next generation of managed security services while contributing to emerging AI security solutions that help customers and partners adopt AI securely. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, strategic partner engagement, product influence, public thought leadership, and global field impact in a role with meaningful visibility and scope.

Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.   Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. What You Will Do:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and measurable business outcomes for Sophos EDR within the Sophos Endpoint portfolio.

  • Partner with Sophos X-Ops, Sophos MDR Ops, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ship EDR capabilities that serve both IT generalists and security analysts.

  • Strong fluency across Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint platforms for endpoint security outcomes.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering, threat research, security operations, product marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams to define product-market fit and execute go-to-market plans.

greenhouse:stay22:4434438009.description:
À propos de Stay22 

 Basée à Montréal, Stay22 aide les créateurs ambitieux et les plateformes numériques à forte intention à transformer leur trafic existant en revenus additionnels, grâce à une technologie qui fonctionne discrètement en arrière-plan.

 Aujourd’hui, plus de 6 500 créateurs et plateformes font confiance à Stay22, avec plus d’un milliard de dollars en transactions annuelles transitant par la plateforme. Initialement conçue pour le secteur du voyage, l’entreprise accompagne désormais des partenaires dans les domaines du commerce de détail, du lifestyle, de l’édition, des événements et du transport, alors qu’elle poursuit l’expansion de son infrastructure de monétisation pour l’économie moderne des créateurs.

 Aperçu du poste 

 En tant que Chief of Staff, tu seras un·e partenaire stratégique de l'équipe de direction et tu aideras à transformer les priorités de l'entreprise en résultats concrets. Tu piloteras le rythme opérationnel de l'entreprise, mèneras des projets à fort impact entre les équipes et t'assureras que la direction a l'information, l'alignement et le suivi nécessaires pour prendre de bonnes décisions rapidement. Tu travailleras avec les équipes Commercial, Produit, Ingénierie et Finance. C'est un rôle très visible, parfait pour quelqu'un qui veut comprendre comment toute l'entreprise fonctionne et contribuer à définir la suite.

 Responsabilités principales 

- Stratégie et exécution : Travailler avec l'équipe de direction pour établir les priorités et les OKR de l'entreprise, suivre l'avancement et responsabiliser les équipes face aux résultats.

- Soutien aux initiatives clés : S'impliquer à fond dans la mise en œuvre des initiatives stratégiques à l'échelle de l'organisation, en commençant par l'opérationnalisation du nouveau plan commercial du CRO.

- Rythme opérationnel : Prendre en charge le rythme de la direction, y compris les rencontres de direction et les revues d'affaires, pour que les décisions soient prises, documentées et mises en action.

- Alignement interfonctionnel : Faire le pont entre les équipes de revenus et le reste de l'entreprise, débloquer le travail et garder une communication claire entre les départements et les niveaux de direction.

- Événements d'entreprise : Façonner l'agenda, le contenu et les sessions des retraites et des kickoffs pour qu'ils fassent avancer nos priorités stratégiques.

 Aperçu du poste 

 Nous bâtissons le pilier Ventes de RevOps et nous cherchons une personne qui a déjà porté un quota de ventes, pas seulement suivi ou présenté les résultats. C'est un rôle senior, à forte propriété, qui travaille aux côtés du leadership des ventes — pas derrière un tableau de bord. Tu prendras en charge la planification des territoires, les prévisions du pipeline et le deal desk de bout en bout. Tu seras la personne que le leadership des ventes appelle en premier quand quelque chose ne concorde pas.

 Tu seras un membre fondateur du pod GTM au sein de RevOps, en collaboration avec les opérations du succès partenaire et les opérations marketing pour bâtir un moteur de revenus cohérent.

 Principales responsabilités 

- Planification des territoires : bâtir et maintenir le suivi de la productivité des représentants, de l'atteinte des quotas et de la performance par territoire et par pod.

- Prévisions : prendre en charge la gouvernance du pipeline, l'hygiène du CRM et la précision des prévisions pour les ventes, de bout en bout, sur tous les pods d'AE et les SDR. Diriger et améliorer la cadence de commit du pipeline et les revues de transactions, et être capable de parler de la santé de toute transaction sur demande.

- Deal desk : être le premier point de contact pour les questions, exceptions, approbations et besoins de structuration liés au deal desk.

- Concevoir et opérer les étapes de l'entonnoir de ventes, les critères de sortie et les cadres de qualification dans HubSpot.

- Faire ressortir de façon proactive les risques liés au pipeline, les écarts de prévision et les bris de processus avant qu'ils ne s'aggravent.

- Assurer des transferts propres et fiables entre les ventes et le succès partenaire.

- Transformer les demandes ambiguës du leadership en cadres évolutifs : une recommandation structurée, pas simplement l'exécution de la première idée proposée.

- Avec le temps, contribuer à la conception des processus de ventes et aux mécaniques de rémunération et d'incitatifs, aux côtés du leadership RevOps.

 Collaboration transversale 

 Tu opéreras au cœur du moteur de revenus, dédié aux ventes mais jamais en silo. Tu travailleras en partenariat étroit avec :

- Le leadership des ventes, comme partenaire de performance de premier plan.

- Le leadership RevOps senior, pour la direction et les priorités.

- Un analyste RevOps, pour la modélisation approfondie et l'analyse de performance.

- Un coéquipier des opérations systèmes, qui gère les outils, l'automatisation et l'infrastructure.

- Les opérations marketing et les opérations du succès partenaire, pour garder tout le cycle de revenus aligné de bout en bout.

 Expérience recherchée 

- 4 ans et plus en RevOps ou opérations de ventes, avec une réelle prise en charge du pipeline, des prévisions et du deal desk — pas seulement du soutien.

- Une expérience concrète en ventes : expérience comme account executive, gestionnaire des ventes, ingénieur commercial ou dans un autre rôle directement impliqué dans les transactions, et pas uniquement dans un rôle d'opérations de soutien aux ventes.

- Un historique de création ou de prise en charge d'une méthodologie de prévision, d'une conception de territoires ou d'un processus de deal desk — pas seulement l'exécution d'un modèle existant.

- À l'aise de tenir ton bout avec un leader des ventes : tu sais challenger de façon structurée, pas seulement extraire des données.

- Un instinct analytique aiguisé : tu sais quand un chiffre ne tient pas la route avant même que quelqu'un le signale, et tu vas trouver pourquoi.

- Une solide maîtrise de HubSpot, avec suffisamment d'aisance pour prendre des décisions d'architecture CRM, pas seulement assurer l'hygiène des données.

- Une grande prise en charge : tu signales le problème avant qu'on te demande de le régler.

- À l'aise dans un environnement rapide où le modèle de revenus n'est pas de type SaaS.

- Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, une forte curiosité et un réel alignement avec les valeurs de Stay22.

 À quoi t'attendre pendant notre processus de recrutement 

 Nous savons que ton temps est précieux, voici un aperçu rapide des prochaines étapes :

- Appel avec notre conseiller en acquisition de talents (30 min).

- Entrevue avec le ou la gestionnaire d'embauche (45 min).

- Entrevue technique et étude de cas en direct avec des membres de l'équipe RevOps (en personne, 60 min).

- Entrevue en panel avec d'autres membres de l'équipe (60 min).

- Entrevue finale avec notre PDG (30 min).

- Offre et intégration 🎉

 Note : ce processus peut évoluer selon les besoins de l'équipe.

 Pourquoi rejoindre Stay22 ?

- Emplacement de choix à Montréal : Travaillez depuis notre dynamique siège social situé dans la Petite-Italie, avec une allocation pour la cafétéria, un accès complet au gym, ainsi qu’une terrasse sur le toit comprenant un terrain saisonnier de basketball/pickleball et une patinoire de hockey.

- Une gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : Couverture santé et dentaire, contribution de l’employeur au REER, titre de transport STM entièrement payé, ainsi que des activités d’équipe, événements et retraites réguliers.

- Une flexibilité adaptée à votre réalité : Horaires flexibles, possibilités de travailler de n’importe où, fermeture des bureaux en fin d’année et journées flexibles.

 (Stay22 est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées. Si vous avez un handicap ou des besoins particuliers nécessitant des aménagements, contactez-nous à careers@stay22.com .)

 About the role 

 Stay22 helps content creators monetize travel content while giving travelers better ways to discover and book travel. The Integrations squad connects Stay22 to travel suppliers and turns their inventory and transaction data into scalable revenue opportunities.

 As Senior Technical Product Manager, you will own the product direction for travel supplier integrations, from supplier APIs and ingestion workflows to Allez links, attribution, reporting, and reliability. You will work across Product, Engineering, Supply/Partnerships, Data, Hub, Neuro, and Forge to improve integrations with suppliers such as Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Trip.com, Viator, and others.

 This is a senior individual-contributor role with real ownership. You will bring technical depth, manage supplier relationships, hold the squad accountable for delivery and quality, and use data to make clear product and business trade-offs. You will report to the GPM, Suppliers Experience.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Product st rategy and prioritization 

- Own the Integrations roadmap, prioritizing supplier opportunities, platform improvements, and reliability investments based on business impact estimates, technical feasibility, and data.

- Turn ambiguous opportunities into clear problems, requirements, trade-offs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, rollout plans, and measurable outcomes.

- Turn performance data into concrete actions for Supply, Engineering, and other teams.

 Technical product leadership 

- Build deep technical understanding of suppliers inventory ingestion workflows (API, SFTP…), schemas, normalization, link generation, attribution, reporting, observability, and downstream product impacts.

- Become a source of truth for integration flows, provider behaviour and known limitations

- Partner closely with Engineering and Technical Leads on architecture, technical risks, quality, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability, while keeping implementation ownership with Engineering.

- Create accountability across the squad by making ownership for every initiative: QA, tracking validation, monitoring, launch readiness, and post-launch measurement, not just a happy-path implementation.

- Continuously reduce time-to-integration and make supplier onboarding more repeatable

 Supplier and partnership leadership 

- Act as the product counterpart for strategic travel supplier relationships, working closely with Supply and Strategic Partnerships.

- Turn supplier conversations into structured inputs and prioritized decisions rather than an unbounded request queue.

- Lead the product side of supplier discovery, qualification, integration planning, launch readiness, and post-launch performance reviews.

 Requirements 

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, including substantial experience with technically complex products, platforms, APIs, data products, infrastructure, or integrations.

- Demonstrated ownership of a product area or roadmap slice end to end, from discovery and prioritization through delivery, launch, and measurable impact.

- Strong technical fluency: you can read API documentation, understand data flows and system boundaries, reason about schemas and contracts, identify technical risks, and have credible trade-off conversations with senior engineers.

- Experience working with external partners, suppliers, vendors, or enterprise customers where requirements, timelines, technical constraints, and commercial interests need to be reconciled.

- Strong data and analytical skills: you can define useful metrics, work with dashboards and event data, assess experiment results, build an order-of-magnitude business case, and use evidence to change priorities.

- A track record of creating accountability without formal authority: setting clear expectations, following through, surfacing risks, and getting cross-functional teams to deliver against a quality bar.

- Excellent written communication. You make complex technical and business topics clear for engineers, commercial teams, leadership, and external partners.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete information while clearly documenting assumptions and risks.

 Nice to have 

- Experience in travel, affiliate, e-commerce, marketplaces, ad tech, or another ecosystem with multiple suppliers and attribution flows.

- Experience building or operating integrations with travel suppliers, booking platforms, affiliate networks, or other external APIs.

- Experience with deep linking, link swapping, redirect systems, transaction attribution, commission reporting, or data normalization.

- Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, supplier selection, or partner performance management.

- Experience improving integration platforms, onboarding workflows, observability, reliability, or developer experience.

- Previous engineering, data engineering, solutions architecture, or technical implementation experience.

 À propos du poste 

 Stay22 aide les créateurs de contenu à monétiser leur contenu lié au voyage tout en offrant aux voyageurs de meilleures façons de découvrir et de réserver leurs voyages. L’équipe Integrations connecte Stay22 aux fournisseurs de services de voyage et transforme leurs inventaires et leurs données transactionnelles en occasions de revenus évolutives.

 En tant que gestionnaire de produit technique senior, tu seras responsable de la direction produit des intégrations avec les fournisseurs de voyage, des API fournisseurs et des flux d’ingestion jusqu’aux liens Allez, à l’attribution, aux rapports et à la fiabilité.  Stratégie produit et priorisation

 Exigences

- Expérience démontrée dans la prise en charge complète d’un domaine produit ou d’une partie de feuille de route, de la découverte et de la priorisation jusqu’à la livraison, au lancement et à l’obtention d’un impact mesurable.

- Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires externes, fournisseurs, vendeurs ou clients d’entreprise, dans des contextes où il faut concilier les exigences, les échéanciers, les contraintes techniques et les intérêts commerciaux.

- Solides compétences en analyse et en données : tu sais définir des indicateurs utiles, travailler avec des tableaux de bord et des données d’événements, évaluer les résultats d’expériences, bâtir une analyse de rentabilité de haut niveau et utiliser les données pour faire évoluer les priorités.

- Expérience dans la création de responsabilisation sans autorité hiérarchique : établir des attentes claires, assurer le suivi, faire ressortir les risques et amener des équipes interfonctionnelles à livrer selon un niveau de qualité élevé.

- Excellente communication écrite. Tu sais rendre des sujets techniques et commerciaux complexes accessibles aux équipes d’ingénierie, aux équipes commerciales, à la direction et aux partenaires externes.

- Aisance à travailler dans l’ambiguïté et à prendre des décisions avec des informations incomplètes, tout en documentant clairement les hypothèses et les risques.

 Atouts 

- Expérience dans le secteur du voyage, de l’affiliation, du commerce électronique, des marketplaces, de l’ad tech ou dans un autre écosystème comptant plusieurs fournisseurs et flux d’attribution.

- Expérience dans la création ou l’exploitation d’intégrations avec des fournisseurs de services de voyage, des plateformes de réservation, des réseaux d’affiliation ou d’autres API externes.

- Expérience avec les liens profonds, le remplacement de liens, les systèmes de redirection, l’attribution des transactions, les rapports de commissions ou la normalisation des données.

- Expérience avec l’expérimentation, l’optimisation de la conversion, la sélection de fournisseurs ou la gestion de la performance des partenaires.

- Expérience dans l’amélioration de plateformes d’intégration, de processus d’intégration de fournisseurs, de l’observabilité, de la fiabilité ou de l’expérience développeur.

- Expérience antérieure en ingénierie, en ingénierie des données, en architecture de solutions ou en implémentation technique.

 Processus de recrutement

lever:tracktik:b7756fb2-0ef7-4437-b1fc-4.title: Product Manager – Workforce Management
lever:tracktik:b7756fb2-0ef7-4437-b1fc-4.description:
At Trackforce, we are transforming physical security operations that are managed around the world. As the leading SaaS platform for physical security workforce management, we provide security companies and organizations with a streamlined solution to manage their guard forces, respond faster, operate more efficiently, and reduce costs — all while staying focused on safety and protection. We support 4,600+ clients across more than 50 countries and are proud to be a growing team of 300+ professionals. With our headquarters in Dallas, Texas, and Centers of Excellence in Montreal, Quebec and Wroclaw, Poland, we collaborate across regions and time zones in a hybrid work environment that combines flexibility, connection, and meaningful impact. At Trackforce, we operate in both hybrid and remote models, offering flexibility to balance in‑office collaboration with WFH. This approach allows our teams to stay connected while maintaining autonomy and work‑life balance. We are highly focused on delivering value to our customers, and our recent merger has strengthened our position as the market leader in security workforce management software. The Product Manager, Workforce Management, will take hands-on ownership of our workforce management (WFM) solution’s squad operations – including owning the day-to-day execution, backlog quality, and delivery velocity. As you grow, you will increasingly carry the product delivery engine on a day-to-day basis.  As your product knowledge grows, you will be the go-to subject-matter resource and become more customer engaged. This is a high-growth, high-visibility role reporting directly to the Group Product Manager. Previous product managers who have thrived in this role did not arrive as WFM or private security experts. They succeeded because of their tenacity, their collaborative spirit, their willingness to read documentation, experiment hands-on with the software, and their genuine excitement about growingwith the product.  Key Responsibilities:

Day-to-Day Squad Leadership

  • Own and facilitate squad ceremonies – dailies, refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Become the primary product voice in the squad; resolve day-to-day blocking questions as much as possible before escalating to the Group PM.
  • Maintain and actively manage the squad’s backlog: write, refine, and prioritize tickets with clear acceptance criteria.  This is a very important, regular and ongoing process.
  • Track and actively drive ticket velocity from a product management perspective, removing ambiguity that slows engineering.
  • Collaborate closely and respectfully with engineers, QA, and design to ship high-quality increments.

    • Product Mastery

  • Become a deep subject-matter expert on our major WFM (aka ‘BOSS’) modules: Scheduling, Time & Attendance, Payroll, and Billing.
  • Learn the private security domain including: WFM workflows, the significance of key metrics, break-rule compliance, and how security companies win and lose on margins.
  • Use the product hands-on—explore it, break it, understand every configuration option—so you can have credible conversations with clients and engineering alike.
  • Study available documentation such as the help guide with genuine curiosity.

    • Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with Engineering, QA, and Design; act as a collaborative partner rather than a gatekeeper.
  • Participate in customer-facing conversations as your expertise grows, supporting the Group PM’s client engagement efforts.
  • Communicate product decisions and trade-offs clearly and tactfully; create dialogue rather than declarations.  Be tenacious without being pugnacious.

    • Strategic Support

  • Assist the Group PM with competitive research, market analysis, and synthesis of client feedback.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning and prioritization discussions with well-reasoned, data-informed input.
  • Proactively surface risks, gaps, and opportunities observed at the squad level.→ List core responsibilities in bullet format. Bold key areas and deliverables so they stand out. Group under subheadings if helpful for readability.
    • Required Qualifications:
  • 2-4 years of product management, business analysis, or equivalent hands-on experience (implementation consultant, scrum master, support specialist, etc.).
  • Working in agile/scrum environments; Jira tools or equivalent
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria coupled with strong verbal communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or computer science, or equivalent practical experience
    • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Exposure to WFM, payroll, billing, or scheduling software in any industry.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, professional services, or field-service-adjacent domains.
  • Familiarity with the private security industry
  • Understanding of software development concepts (APIs, data models) to facilitate richer engineering dialogue.
    • Success Metrics:
  • Demonstrate and lead walkthroughs on assigned/core functionality
  • Deliver on assigned roadmap timeline commitments
  • Increase velocity on agile rituals (grooming, refinements, etc.)
  • Meet roadmap key benchmark metrics (post release)
  • Clear and referenceable documentation / record of work
    • Why Trackforce:

    Trackforce is the market leader in security workforce management software!  The industry is in the midst of a digital transformation from heavily manual and/or disjointed processes to a more streamlined technology infused operating model.  AI will become core and you can be in the middle of the journey helping our clients be even more successful.

    The roadmap matters – clients large and small need what we are building.  Your work will have visible, measure impact in delighting our customers and building our moat.  The domain is complex enough to keep you challenged and growing for years, with career pathways into more senior or specialist roles as you grow.

    At Trackforce, we operate in a hybrid model of work, offering flexibility to balance in‑office collaboration with remote work. This approach allows our teams to stay connected while maintaining autonomy and work‑life balance.

lever:veeva:54011d58-cec6-4bcf-9758-ac56.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.   At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.   As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.   Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Veeva Network team. Veeva Network is a world-class Master Data Management (MDM) application that cleanses, standardizes, and de-duplicates master data to provide a single source of truth for commercial teams.   You will build the critical integration bridges that connect our master data platform to the broader enterprise ecosystem and drive the strategy for seamless data synchronization with next-generation tools like Vault CRM, Veeva Vault, and SAP Concur, ensuring commercial and compliance teams operate on a single source of truth.   This is a unique opportunity to solve complex interoperability challenges that directly impact the efficiency of the global life sciences industry. What You'll Do:
  • Lead the end-to-end journey of new features—from initial ideation and pitching through design, development, and delivery—to bring high-impact innovations to market
  • Partner with Product Management leadership to synthesize market trends, customer insights, and emerging technologies into clear, forward-thinking product requirements
  • Optimize high end-use cases by leading the ideation and development of new Artificial Intelligence (AI) features within Veeva Network
  • Work closely with UX, Architecture, Engineering, and QA teams to translate business needs into detailed specifications that balance technical feasibility with an intuitive user experience
  • Author detailed technical specifications for APIs, data connectors, and middleware logic, precisely defining how data is mapped, transformed, and validated between Veeva Network and external systems
  • Coordinate intimately with the Vault CRM team and external partners to ensure seamless interoperability, aligning on release schedules, API dependencies, and shared data models
  • Present product roadmaps and demo cutting-edge features to customers and internal stakeholders, using these interactions to gather feedback and validate product direction
  • Serve as the dedicated subject matter expert and product evangelist, equipping Solution Consulting, Services, and Support teams with the deep technical knowledge they need to succeed
    • Requirements:
  • 3+ years of product management experience for a software company
  • Proficiency in SQL and a strong grasp of data analysis techniques; you should be comfortable querying data to validate hypotheses
  • Proven ability to synthesize disparate customer feedback and complex business needs into a cohesive, high-value product design
  • Strong analytical skills with a relentless drive to peel back the layers of a problem and understand the "why" behind every requirement
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and independent, willing to go the extra mile to make our product and customers successful
  • Demonstrated ability to write requirements specifications, manage backlogs, and guide engineering and QA to deliver in an agile environment
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation)
  • High degree of professional ethics and integrity to doing the right thing
    • Nice to Have:
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries
  • Direct experience with Master Data Management (MDM), Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or sophisticated Data Quality and cleansing tools
  • A track record of working with highly configurable enterprise software where business logic and workflows are customized for the client
  • Hands-on experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes, including defining logic for data extraction, complex transformations, and loading into target systems
  • Technical familiarity with the Veeva Vault platform or Salesforce.com, specifically regarding data models and integration points
  • Background in software development or computer science
    • Interviewing with Veeva:

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
    • Perks & Benefits:
  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program
    • Compensation:
  • Base pay: $100,000 - $150,000 CAD

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. greenhouse:novisto78:4717306005.description:
We are looking for a Product Manager, Sustainability Content & Methodology Governance to own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Novisto’s ESG framework, questionnaire, and carbon methodology capabilities. 

 This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of product management, sustainability domain expertise, data governance, regulatory change, carbon accounting, and enterprise SaaS delivery. You will help ensure Novisto’s platform stays aligned with evolving ESG frameworks, CDP questionnaires, S&P questionnaires, carbon protocols, emissions factors, and calculation logic while translating complex methodology changes into scalable product capabilities.

 This role is ideal for a structured, customer-oriented product manager who can bring discipline to a fast-changing sustainability domain and create a repeatable operating model for monitoring, assessing, prioritizing, implementing, validating, and communicating content and methodology changes.

 Why This Role Matters 

- Customers need confidence that their ESG and carbon data is accurate, current, traceable, and ready for reporting and assurance.

- Frameworks, questionnaires, protocols, emissions factors, and calculation methodologies are changing continuously and must be managed through a disciplined product lifecycle.

- Novisto’s differentiation depends on combining deep sustainability expertise with scalable software, strong governance, and a clear customer experience.

- This role will help Novisto move from content maintenance to a repeatable, productized methodology governance model that supports enterprise adoption and customer trust.

 Your responsibilities will include : 

 Own the product roadmap for frameworks, questionnaires, and methodologies 

- Define and maintain the roadmap for ESG frameworks, CDP questionnaires, S&P questionnaires, carbon protocols, emissions factors, and calculation logic.

- Translate evolving standards and questionnaire changes into product requirements, data model needs, workflow changes, reporting outputs, QA requirements, and release plans.

- Prioritize work based on customer impact, regulatory deadlines, business value, risk, implementation complexity, and strategic fit.

 Build a scalable monitoring and governance process 

- Establish a recurring monitoring process for supported frameworks, questionnaires, protocols, and carbon methodologies.

- Work with ESG experts, carbon experts, data analysts, external advisors, and customer-facing teams to identify changes and assess product implications.

- Create clear governance for content updates, methodology changes, emissions factor updates, calculation logic, templates, mappings, standard phrases, and release documentation.

 Lead structured impact assessments 

- Assess whether each change impacts existing implementation, data structures, calculations, downstream reporting, customer workflows, assurance readiness, or exports.

- Separate routine updates from non-routine changes that require deeper analysis, working groups, customer SME input, or new product capabilities.

- Produce clear implementation scope, product requirements, acceptance criteria, QA approach, and release readiness plans.

 Partner cross-functionally to deliver high-quality product outcomes 

- Collaborate with Product, ESG experts, Carbon experts, Engineering, QA, Design, Customer Success, Implementation, Product Marketing, and Sales Enablement.

- Ensure domain interpretation is translated into clear, buildable, testable product requirements.

- Support release readiness, internal enablement, customer-facing documentation, and customer communications for major changes.

 Improve carbon calculation transparency and trust 

- Own product requirements for carbon calculation traceability, methodology documentation, emissions factor versioning, data quality checks, variance detection, and audit-ready evidence.

- Help ensure carbon outputs are explainable, repeatable, and aligned with recognized protocols and enterprise customer expectations.

- Support the evolution of Novisto’s carbon capabilities across Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, supplier data, and calculation governance.

 What we’re looking for: 

- 5+ years of product management, product ownership, regulatory content management, sustainability software, carbon accounting, ESG reporting, EHS, compliance, or enterprise SaaS experience.

- Experience translating complex domain, regulatory, methodological, or data requirements into product capabilities.

- Familiarity with ESG reporting frameworks, sustainability questionnaires, carbon accounting, data governance, assurance readiness, or regulatory change management.

- Strong structured thinking and ability to manage complex, recurring update cycles with cross-functional contributors.

- Ability to work with subject-matter experts and engineering teams to create clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to write customer-facing release notes, internal enablement materials, and executive-level updates.

- Strong judgment and prioritization skills across regulatory timelines, customer commitments, implementation complexity, and commercial impact.

 Nice to Have 

- Experience with CDP, S&P Global CSA, GRI, SASB, ISSB, ESRS / CSRD, TCFD, SDGs, or other sustainability frameworks.

- Knowledge of GHG Protocol, Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, emissions factors, supplier data, or product carbon footprint concepts.

- Experience with taxonomy management, calculation engines, reporting workflows, audit trails, controls, or evidence management.

- Experience working with consultants, assurance providers, external advisors, customer advisory groups, or enterprise implementation teams.

- Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

 What we offer 

- Join an early-stage, well-financed company

- Advance Novisto’s purpose of contributing to the sustainability of the economy, environment, and society by empowering companies to make better decisions and disclosures through our ESG data management software

- Contribute your knowledge and insights to increase awareness and knowledge of sustainability

- Generous health benefits (100% Insurance coverage & access to Dialogue's telemedicine app)

- Flexible schedules & opportunity to work remotely

- 4 weeks of vacation

- Stock option plan

- Summer hours

- If you prefer to work at the office, we have a beautiful office in Old Montreal, close to downtown and steps away from a metro (subway) station

greenhouse:novisto78:4741486005.title: Sr. Product Manager

equity.quote: - Stock option plan

greenhouse:novisto78:4741486005.description:
Carbon is Novisto's broadest and most technically demanding product area — spanning Corporate Carbon Accounting (including Scope 3), Financed Emissions, Product Carbon Footprint, and Decarbonisation. It's also the area under the most active evolution: extended through partnership and acquisition, expected to incorporate AI capabilities as a baseline market expectation, and held to audit-grade standards of accuracy and traceability by the regulations it serves.

 This role owns product outcomes across that full suite. It's a broad, technically deep, customer-facing remit that calls for a PM who can move fluidly across multiple product lines, hold real domain and regulatory complexity, and operate with the rigor an audit-ready product demands — while raising the bar for the wider team's product practice in the process.

The Opportunity 

- Full ownership of a multi-product suite — not a single feature or workstream — requiring strong prioritisation and comfort with constant context-switching across genuinely different problem spaces.

- A build/partner/acquire execution model: some capability is built in-house, some delivered through partners, some inherited through acquisition — this PM works across all three, not just one.

- Direct customer exposure at a strategic level: roadmap and strategy presentations, live requirements conversations, and escalations, with real commercial and reputational stakes attached to accuracy and delivery.

- Product evolution into AI-enabled capability as the suite matures, rather than steady-state maintenance of a settled product.

 Your responsibilities will include: 

 Own outcomes across the Carbon suite

- Hold end-to-end product accountability across Corporate Carbon Accounting (incl. Scope 3), Financed Emissions, Product Carbon Footprint, and Decarbonisation as one connected remit.

- Prioritise ruthlessly across competing, genuinely different problem spaces, making trade-offs that are legible to engineering, leadership, and customers.

- Build sufficient domain depth in each area to drive solutions forward independently, rather than waiting for fully-specified requirements from customers or SMEs.

- Be accountable for measurable product outcomes — adoption, retention, delivery against commercial commitments — not just features shipped.

 Operate a build/partner/acquire model 

- Work directly with external partners to define scope, resolve product gaps, and manage the product-level relationship as capability is delivered through partnership rather than built in-house.

- Assess and integrate acquired or partnered capability into a coherent product experience, rather than treating it as a bolt-on.

- Bring enough commercial fluency to input into build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions and hold your own on partner terms that affect the product — SLAs, data rights, and roadmap influence.

 Bring audit-grade rigor to everything you ship 

- Treat reporting rules and regulatory requirements as first-order product constraints, not compliance overhead layered on afterwards.

- Apply meaningful attention to detail across validation logic, edge cases, and UX — the standard our live customer integrations have already shown gets tested in production.

- Track evolving disclosure requirements as an active input to roadmap decisions, not a background concern.

- Translate genuinely technical, regulation-driven requirements into decisions engineering can build against with confidence.

 Run modern discovery and delivery practice 

- Lead discovery — customer interviews, problem framing, prototyping with UX/UI — rather than working from a pre-built backlog.

- Partner closely with Engineering on solution design to the degree the problem demands, while creating enough space for the team to own how problems get solved.

- Operate in the spirit of empowered product teams: outcome-driven, discovery-led, and evidence-based, even where the wider organisation's process isn't fully there yet.

- Design within a shared platform architecture and design system, balancing Carbon-specific needs against platform-wide consistency and reuse.

 Evolve the product with AI 

- Identify where AI capability should be embedded in the Carbon suite as it becomes a baseline market expectation rather than a differentiator.

- Bring genuine curiosity and hands-on experimentation with AI tools into your own process, and use them to accelerate discovery, delivery, and product quality.

 Be the face of Carbon to customers 

- Lead strategy and roadmap conversations directly with customers, including senior stakeholders.

- Take ownership of live customer feedback, requirements, and escalations — this is a highly customer-facing role with no back office to hide in.

 Work across the business

Employees also have the option to participate in Ericsson’s Stock Purchase Plan.

 Your Time 
Your work-life balance is important to us. New employees are provided a minimum of 18 days of accrued vacation, plus at least 3personal days, minimum 10 holidays, 1 volunteer day, and sick days. Please note paid time off is pro-rated based on the employee’s start date. Furthermore, Ericsson provides up to 10 weeks of paid maternity leave and 6 weeks of parental or adoption leave at 100% of pay.

 Additional Benefits 
Ericsson offers many other company-paid benefits such as financial wellness programs, educational assistance, matching gifts, wellness account, and recognition programs.
