lever:eqbank:a20b80c5-53c4-4c34-b8de-c6d.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work   The Technology Workplace Services AI Solutions Engineer identifies, designs, builds, governs, and improves AI-enabled and automated solutions that strengthen TWS service delivery, employee productivity, operational efficiency, and the digital workplace experience. The role combines business analysis and process improvement with hands-on solution engineering using approved enterprise AI, automation, analytics, scripting, and low-code platforms. The incumbent works with TWS, business stakeholders, technology teams, and control functions to deliver secure, scalable, supportable, and measurable solutions with appropriate testing, documentation, change management, monitoring, and human oversight. Targeted TWS operational support remains part of the role to maintain service context, validate outcomes, and support business continuity. The Core Responsibilities! :

AI Enablement, Business Analysis & Process Improvement (30%)

  • Partner with TWS and business stakeholders to identify, assess, prioritize, and document high-value AI, automation, and process-improvement opportunities.
  • Analyze current-state workflows, pain points, controls, dependencies, exception paths, data requirements, and measurable improvement objectives.
  • Determine whether AI, workflow automation, scripting, process redesign, or a non-technical change is the most appropriate response to a business or operational need.
  • Translate business requirements into process designs, solution requirements, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, implementation plans, support models, and measurable success criteria.
  • Develop use cases for ticket summarization, triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval, trend analysis, and service-quality checks.
  • Maintain a prioritized AI and automation pipeline aligned with TWS objectives, capacity, risk tolerance, and measurable business value.
  • Gather user feedback, identify adoption barriers, and recommend process or solution improvements that increase usability and sustained value.

    • AI Engineering & Solution Development (40%)

  • Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support secure, scalable, and maintainable AI-powered copilots, agents, automations, scripts, analytics, and low-code solutions for TWS and digital workplace use cases.
  • Build proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and production-ready solutions using approved platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, APIs, PowerShell, Python, and other sanctioned technologies.
  • Develop enterprise search, retrieval, grounding, orchestration, agent, and workflow solutions using approved TWS and enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Create reusable prompts, workflows, templates, connectors, scripts, integrations, and solution components to improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
  • Integrate AI capabilities with Microsoft 365, ServiceNow, HR platforms, collaboration tools, endpoint, asset, identity, reporting, knowledge, and operational workflow systems.
  • Define grounding sources, data mappings, permission boundaries, validation rules, structured outputs, and controls so solutions are accurate, traceable, and fit for purpose.
  • Apply approved engineering practices for environment management, configuration, credentials, source control, testing, release, monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, recovery, rollback, and retirement.
  • Complete functional, security, privacy, accessibility, regression, and user acceptance testing before production release.
  • Create and maintain technical runbooks covering ownership, dependencies, access, recovery, rollback, incident response, monitoring, support handoff, and retirement.
  • Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Privacy, Risk, Service Management, Data, platform teams, and vendors to validate designs and address gaps before implementation.

    • AI Governance, Risk & Responsible Use (15%)

  • Ensure AI and automation solutions comply with approved architecture, security, privacy, data governance, records-management, acceptable-use, change-management, audit, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform preliminary risk and impact assessments and engage Information Security, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Data, Architecture, or other control partners as required.
  • Implement responsible AI controls, including access management, data protection, auditability, output validation, exception handling, escalation, rollback, and human oversight.
  • Document solution purpose, users, data inputs, processing logic, outputs, limitations, risks, dependencies, controls, approvals, testing, changes, exceptions, incidents, and periodic reviews.
  • Ensure AI-generated outputs and automated actions are validated and are not used as the sole basis for material operational or access decisions.
  • Escalate material risks, control failures, data exposure, inaccurate outcomes, production issues, and high-priority service impacts to the Manager, TWS and appropriate partners.

    • Knowledge Management, Adoption & Continuous Improvement (5%)

  • Develop and maintain AI-assisted knowledge articles, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, prompt guidance, playbooks, standards, reference architectures, job aids, and support documentation.
  • Validate AI-assisted content for accuracy, clarity, accessibility, currency, and alignment with approved processes before publication.
  • Build AI literacy and adoption through demonstrations, workshops, training, coaching, knowledge sharing, enablement programs, and office-hour support.
  • Advise teams on AI best practices, prompt engineering, output validation, data handling, responsible use, solution design, and automation opportunities.
  • Monitor solution accuracy, reliability, security, privacy, cost efficiency, adoption, exceptions, user satisfaction, and business outcomes; implement improvements based on evidence and feedback.
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting that demonstrate adoption, quality, productivity gains, automation savings, service improvements, risk reduction, and operational impact.

    • Technology Workplace Services Technology Support & Operational Continuity (10%)

  • Provide targeted support for endpoints, collaboration tools, audio/visual equipment, enterprise applications, and related workplace technology services when required.
  • Use operational knowledge to validate that AI-enabled improvements function effectively within TWS support processes and meet user needs.
  • Manage assigned incidents, requests, problems, and changes in accordance with ITIL practices, documented procedures, service expectations, and escalation requirements.
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, device deployment, software rollout, inventory, and other TWS activities during priority events or coverage needs.
  • Monitor and respond to production issues affecting AI-enabled workflows, automations, or related TWS services.
    • Let's Talk About You! :
  • College diploma or university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Technology, Data and Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 or more years of experience in IT service delivery, workplace technology, AI enablement, process improvement, automation, business analysis, or a related technical role.
  • Practical experience analyzing requirements and designing, documenting, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting AI, automation, scripting, analytics, or low-code solutions.
  • Working knowledge of generative AI and solution patterns, including prompt design and orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, grounding, structured output, tool or function calling, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and approved enterprise AI and automation platforms, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, PowerShell, APIs, and related tools used by the Bank.
  • Knowledge of API integration, authentication and authorization, managed identities or service accounts, secrets management, data transformation, secure connector design, source control, solution packaging, environment configuration, release management, monitoring, logging, and technical runbooks.
  • Understanding of ITIL practices, including Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Asset, and Service Level Management.
  • Strong knowledge of security, privacy, data lifecycle, governance, classification, minimization, access, retention, lineage, appropriate use, and AI evaluation principles.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, collaboration, prioritization, and change-adoption skills, with the ability to evaluate effort, dependencies, risk, business value, and technical trade-offs.
  • Commitment to continuous learning as AI technologies, engineering practices, security expectations, and regulatory requirements evolve.

We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Overview

 Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. As a Senior Design Program Manager, you'll drive operational excellence and programmatic execution across the Design organization—building AI-enabled systems, scaling critical processes, and managing the tools and vendor relationships that power our creative work.

 This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll work closely with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team, requiring technical fluency to bridge design, engineering, and tooling infrastructure.

 About the Role

 You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

 You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

 About the Job

- Programmatic Execution: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.

- AI Enablement: Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management tasks—status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Champion AI fluency in Design to accelerate design-first thinking and increase operational efficiency.

- Operations & Vendor Management: Own strategic vendor relationships and contract management for design tooling (Figma, prototyping, asset management, collaboration platforms). Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.

- Systems & Tooling: Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.

- Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.

- Design Craft Integration: Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

 About You

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.

- Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market. 

- Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.

- (component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)

- Technical fluency to collaborate with design system and engineering teams—understanding system architecture, component APIs, design-to-code workflows, and technical constraints

- Proven track record driving complex, cross-functional programs from 0→1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments

- AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs

- Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance

- Deep knowledge of design and program management tooling ecosystems (Figma, Linear, Jira, Dovetail, asset management, prototyping tools)

- Ability to drive organizational change and influence cross-functional partners—bringing clarity to complexity

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to executive leadership

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Design systems expertise: building/scaling systems, managing component libraries, defining tokens, driving adoption programs

- Experience building AI-powered workflows for creative operations or design tooling integrations

- Success translating leadership vision into actionable roadmaps and operating models

- Experience in hybrid/embedded team models with deep cross-functional partnership

- Comfort balancing hands-on execution with strategic oversight

- Track record using data and storytelling to influence leadership and secure buy-in for operational investments

This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY 
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

 AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

 Principal Product Manager:  Location: Waterloo, Ontario - FULL TIME - ON-SITE 

 Role Summary 
 OpenText Fortify is seeking a mid-career Product Manager to lead key Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) capabilities across WebInspect, SC DAST, and Dynamic Security Research. This role owns product direction from discovery through delivery and adoption, partnering closely with engineering, security research, sales, marketing, and customers. 
 You will translate market needs and technical signals into clear roadmap priorities, shape differentiated security outcomes, and ensure our DAST portfolio delivers measurable customer value. Strong AI knowledge is required, including practical understanding of how AI can improve security testing efficacy, user workflows, and product competitiveness. 

 Your Impact: 

- Product strategy and execution for WebInspect, SC DAST, and Dynamic Security Research capabilities. 

- End-to-end lifecycle management: discovery, requirements, prioritization, launch, and post-launch optimization. 

- Cross-functional alignment among R&D, research teams, sales, marketing, support, and customer success. 

- Customer and field engagement to gather insights, validate problems, and drive adoption outcomes. 

- AI-enabled roadmap opportunities across DAST workflows, including prioritization of high-impact use cases. 

 What the role offers: 

- Define and maintain product roadmap, release priorities, and success metrics for assigned DAST areas. 

- Partner with Dynamic Security Research and engineering to convert findings into product capabilities and user value. 

- Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with a strong focus on customer outcomes. 

- Work with architecture and development teams on tradeoffs, feasibility, and delivery sequencing. 

- Collaborate with sales and marketing on positioning, messaging, enablement, and launch readiness. 

- Engage directly with customers and prospects for discovery interviews, roadmap validation, and feedback loops. 

- Use quantitative and qualitative inputs to prioritize backlog and measure feature impact. 

- Champion AI-driven enhancements (for example: intelligent crawl guidance, finding triage assistance, risk prioritization, and workflow automation) while ensuring responsible and trustworthy use. 

- Monitor market and competitive trends in application security, DAST, and AI-enabled security tooling. 

- Support GTM and customer-facing activities including briefings, webinars, and strategic account conversations. 

 What you need to succeed: 

- 4-8 years of product management experience, preferably in cybersecurity, AppSec, or enterprise software. 

- Hands-on understanding of DAST concepts, web application security, and vulnerability management workflows. 

- Proven ability to work effectively with both R&D/research and commercial teams (sales/marketing/customer success). 

- Strong customer engagement skills with experience synthesizing feedback into product decisions. 

- Demonstrated AI knowledge relevant to product strategy and execution, including practical use of AI in software products. 

- Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to drive prioritization and measure results. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

- Experience delivering products in Agile environments. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with Fortify, WebInspect, SC DAST, or adjacent AppSec platforms. 

- Background in vulnerability research, security testing tools, or DevSecOps workflows. 

- Familiarity with enterprise buying cycles and security practitioner personas. 

- Experience launching AI-assisted features in regulated or high-trust environments. 

 One last thing: 
 OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.  
 Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference. 

 OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

 If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR . Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

 Compensation: At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.
 AI Usage Disclosure: As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 The Director of EIAM Strategy & Technical Product Management is responsible for defining and executing integrated product strategy across Royal Bank of Canada's Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) platform. 

 This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep engineering involvement and direct accountability for identity lifecycle management, authorization frameworks, governance capabilities, privileged access management, secrets management, and enterprise-wide identity architecture. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence across core security and compliance requirements while leveraging advanced technologies—including AI where appropriate—to enhance EIAM capabilities. 

 This role demands a technologist with proven hands-on experience designing and implementing complex identity systems, not a product manager focused on go-to-market or business development.

 What will you do? 

- Own unified EIAM platform strategy and roadmap that incorporate emerging technologies and best practices spanning identity lifecycle for platforms such as authorization, authentication, governance, privileged access management, and secrets management

- Work closely with lines of business to define and interpret business requirements and map them to appropriate technical specifications which can be leveraged to drive solution architectures and design

- Act as a strategic liaison between vendor capabilities and RBC product requirements, ensuring solutions align with enterprise needs and maximize value delivery including driving direction of vendor product roadmap decisions

- Evaluate vendor offerings against RBC's technical and business criteria to validate fit and identify capability gaps - Translate business requirements into actionable product roadmap items

- Work with Solution and IAM Architects to facilitate disciplined decisions on access related solutions that address business needs within a resourcing and bandwidth context that include IAM engineering, integration and application support, operations and program teams

- Prioritize, update, and modify strategies and roadmaps as business needs and vendor landscapes evolve while continuing to drive product strategy and accelerate multiple enterprise IAM initiatives

- Serve as the primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on IAM strategy and vendor integration decisions

- Develop forward-looking roadmaps aligned with 2-year technology vision (including AI and PAM innovation trends)

- Collaborate with Compliance and Risk teams to embed regulatory controls into product design

- Mentor product and technical team members on identity architecture, governance strategy, and technical best practices

 What do you need to succeed?

 Must have: 

- 10 + years of IAM experience, preferably in a financial institution/ large enterprise environment, with one of more of the following: Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secrets Management, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Authentication, Authorization, or Cloud/AI IAM solutions

- 5+ years of demonstrated experience translating business and compliance requirements into technical architecture and policy frameworks

- Proven experience evaluating and liaising between vendor products and organizational requirements to ensure optimal solution alignment and value

- Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining program and project-level roadmaps that align with architectural and organizational strategies

- Proven ability to develop and own comprehensive IAM strategies that leverage emerging 
technologies and industry trends to address IAM requirements while aligning with Enterprise Architecture

- Experience working with one or more of the following: Idira (CyberArk), SailPoint, HashiCorp, Secrets Manager, Entra ID and other IAM related tools and platforms.

- Strong track record of creating feasible, realistic roadmaps by incorporating cross-functional perspectives from IAM teams, Cyber Security, and different stakeholders groups

- Strategic vision and proven track record translating complex IAM concepts—including authentication architecture, authorization frameworks, identity governance, privileged access management, and compliance landscapes—into cohesive product strategy and roadmap that drives business value.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical teams in complex, regulated banking/financial services environments

- Proficiency with agile product delivery frameworks and automation technologies

- Highly skilled at presenting to senior leadership and executives. Strong ability to communicate IAM strategy, progress, and critical updates in a clear, business-focused manner that resonates with C-suite audiences

- Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.

- Deadline-driven and results-oriented; able to meet consistently high quality standards while handling a variety of tasks and deadlines simultaneously

- Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate across functions and businesses

 Nice-to-have : 

- CISSP, CISM or other IAM specific certification

- Experience with cloud identity platforms (Azure AD, Okta, AWS IAM); knowledge of zero-trust architecture and security frameworks; familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001)

- Experience leading digital transformation initiatives

-  Background in Agile or Scrum methodologies

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60604.description:
Requisition ID: 273402 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior Manager, Fraud Analytics & Strategy provides regional strategy, and subject matter expertise for application fraud in digital channels across International Banking (Mexico, Peru, Chile, Uruguay, Caribbean). The role focuses specifically on first party, synthetic, and non–stolen identity fraud, which reside within credit risk rather than enterprise fraud operations.

 This leader defines the risk strategy and controls for digital channel originations fraud, and works with country teams to build capabilities and reduce losses.

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

- Champions a customer focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge.

 Regional Strategy & Frameworks

- Enforce the digital application fraud strategy for International Banking, including standards for identity proofing, fraud scoring, escalation thresholds, and lifecycle controls.

- Establish and maintain a first‑party and synthetic fraud framework aligned to global policies and IB digital growth objectives.

 Capability Building Across Countries

- Act as the regional subject‑matter expert to support countries in strengthening digital application fraud controls.

- Partner with Data and Analytics teams to develop fraud detection capabilities, monitoring solutions, and analytical use cases.

 Monitoring & Trend Analysis

- Maintain a regional view of fraud trends, attack vectors, and performance indicators across digital origination channels.

- Analyze fraud performance data across digital channels and origination journeys to identify fraud patterns, emerging threats, and control opportunities.

 Governance & Standards

- Review and challenge major fraud‑related initiatives (digital onboarding changes, data/identity tools, new product flows).

- Ensure compliance with global policies and alignment with the Retail Credit Risk framework.

 Digital Transformation & Data/Decisioning

- Lead fraud‑related components of digital transformation programs, including device intelligence, behavioural biometrics, and next‑generation scoring models.

- Assess existing data assets and identify opportunities to enhance fraud detection through additional internal and external data sources.

- Research emerging fraud technologies, market solutions, and vendor capabilities.

- Design and enhance fraud prevention use cases supporting digital onboarding and origination processes.

 Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and maintain relationships with country risk teams, Digital Banking, Risk Technology, Enterprise Fraud, and Global Retail stakeholders.

- Communicate fraud insights and recommendations to senior audiences in a clear, actionable way.

- Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

- Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

- Builds a high performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? - We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.

- 5+ years of experience in data analytics, fraud risk, credit risk, or consumer lending.

- Strong expertise in first‑party and synthetic identity fraud, digital KYC, data enrichment, and fraud scoring.

- Experience with digital strategy implementation, risk management and data strategy

- Ability to influence and lead in an evolving, multi‑country environment.

- Fluency in English and Spanish preferred.

greenhouse:alayacare:8865478002.description:
About AlayaCare

 At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

 With 600+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.

 About the Role

 As a Project Manager on our U.S. Homecare team, you’ll play a pivotal role in delivering successful, high-quality software implementations for our clients. Reporting to the Manager, PMO, you’ll lead a portfolio of large and enterprise-level projects from initiation through completion.

 You’ll serve as a trusted partner to clients and an internal leader across cross-functional teams, coordinating consultants and specialists to deliver predictable outcomes. You’ll manage project scope, timelines, resources, risks, budgets, communications, and change, while setting clear expectations around the AlayaCare delivery model and stakeholder responsibilities.

 What You’ll Do

- Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure of assigned implementation projects.

- Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and success measures with clients and internal stakeholders.

- Create project plans, estimates, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.

- Work with resource managers to allocate project resources effectively.

- Monitor project progress, deliverables, utilization, backlog hours, risks, and issues, and provide clear updates to stakeholders.

- Manage project scope by evaluating change requests, negotiating their impacts, securing agreements, and obtaining sign-off.

- Identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle. Escalate critical issues promptly and strategically.

- Apply AlayaCare’s project management methodologies, templates, and tools consistently across assigned projects.

- Foster clear communication and collaboration among client leaders, consultants, specialists, and other stakeholders.

- Use your understanding of the homecare market and AlayaCare’s products to resolve challenges and keep implementations moving forward.

 What You Bring to the Team

- 4–6 years of project management experience, ideally managing large-scale or enterprise software implementations in a professional services environment.

- A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Strong skills in project planning, estimation, scheduling, scope management, risk management, budget management, and change management.

- Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- The ability to communicate clearly and concisely in plain English, both verbally and in writing.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to work with client leadership.

- The ability to identify, explain, and resolve complex project challenges.

- A client-focused mindset and a genuine interest in understanding client needs and developing practical solutions.

- Strong leadership, influencing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage workloads across teams and move initiatives forward.

- Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to work independently.

- The ability to learn quickly, adapt to process changes, and contribute proactively to team initiatives.

- A project management certification, such as PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or a comparable certification, is considered an asset but is not required.

- Willingness to travel occasionally, as required.

 Location and Work Model

 This role is based in Toronto, Ontario.

 At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.

 Why Join AlayaCare?

 Work With Purpose

 At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.

 Grow in a High-Trust Culture

 We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.

 Balance That Works for You

 We value flexibility and well-being. From “Wellness Fridays” to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.

 Benefits That Matter

- Equity in a well-funded, scaling company.

- Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.

- Parental leave top-up and family support programs.

 Inclusive by Design

 We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities, both in-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.

 Ready to Join Us?

 Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.    

 AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically you will be notified and you may request a human review.    

 We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to careers@alayacare.com   

 At AlayaCare, we consider a range of factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, experience, and market data. These factors may cause compensation to vary. The expected hiring range is what we reasonably anticipate offering for this position at the time of posting.

AlayaCare offers a comprehensive benefits program, which may include medical, dental, wellness, life insurance, equity participation, paid parental leave top up, and paid time off.

This expected hiring range applies only to candidates hired to perform work in Ontario. This role represents an existing vacancy at AlayaCare. AlayaCare uses artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

 Expected Hiring Range
 $75,000 — $100,000 CAD

amazon:amazon:10581582.description:
Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. a un poste à combler immédiatement pour un gestionnaire de programme technique (Technical Program Manager, TPM) chargé de soutenir l'expansion de l'infrastructure de livraison de capacité au Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services assure la conception, la planification, la livraison et l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale et des centres de données d'AWS. Autrement dit, nous sommes ceux qui font fonctionner l'infonuagique en fournissant les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous nous attaquons aux problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure — et nous sommes à la recherche de personnes talentueuses qui souhaitent y contribuer. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale diversifiée de 15 à 20 autres TPM, principalement situés dans le Nord-Ouest du Pacifique, travaillant dans des régions de tailles variées à travers les Amériques, au sein d'une organisation plus vaste comprenant des ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité, des gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme. Vous travaillerez avec un haut degré d'autonomie, tout en partageant les leçons apprises et en favorisant la cohérence dans l'ensemble de la région. Le TPM agira à titre de responsable unique (single-threaded owner) de la livraison de capacité dans les grappes de centres de données qui lui sont attribuées, en coordonnant des équipes interfonctionnelles de la conception jusqu'au déploiement. La gestion de l'échéancier et des parties prenantes englobera des équipes disparates, notamment la planification, la conception, les finances, l'immobilier, l'énergie, la construction, la mise en service, les contrôles et autres. L'objectif principal de ce rôle est de collaborer à l'échelle de l'organisation afin de garantir que la livraison de capacité répond aux besoins de l'entreprise, voire les dépasse, tout en communiquant et en atténuant les risques. La personne idéale sera une communicatrice exceptionnellement solide, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral, et possédera au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion tactique de projets d'initiatives hautement techniques, ainsi qu'en gestion stratégique de programmes. Une expérience de la gestion de déploiements d'infrastructure de centres de données constitue un atout. Un baccalauréat ou une expérience technique additionnelle est exigé. Les candidats possédant une formation en architecture/conception, en génie mécanique/électrique, en génie logiciel/matériel, en infrastructure/exploitation de centres de données et/ou en construction, qui ont fait la transition vers une discipline de gestion de programme, bénéficieront d'un avantage certain. La personne candidate doit être à l'aise de gérer des équipes de livraison de projet à distance et posséder la capacité d'animer des séances techniques de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre les problèmes de mise en œuvre des projets et éliminer les obstacles à leur réussite. Il est essentiel de savoir mettre sur pied des équipes interfonctionnelles, d'établir un climat de confiance avec diverses parties prenantes réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires, de gérer des budgets d'immobilisations, d'éliminer les activités sans valeur ajoutée, de concevoir des solutions, de lever les obstacles et de trouver des moyens créatifs d'accélérer la livraison des projets. Le TPM maîtrisera parfaitement une variété d'outils, de méthodologies et de techniques de gestion de projet pour toutes les phases du cycle de vie du projet, et fera preuve d'une compétence démontrée dans les disciplines fondamentales de la gestion de projet, notamment la gestion de la portée, de l'échéancier, du budget, des ressources, de la qualité et des risques, ainsi que la production de rapports et l'élaboration et le suivi des indicateurs. Les autres exigences comprennent la maîtrise de MS Office, MS Project et MS SharePoint. Une expérience de Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL et de l'intégration de systèmes constitue un atout. Ce poste exige des déplacements à hauteur de 25 % (voyages nationaux et internationaux vers les grappes de centres de données d'AWS). Si vous répondez à ces qualifications, débordez de passion et aimez les défis liés au déploiement de projets hautement techniques et innovants à très grande échelle, cet emploi est pour vous!

Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) supporting capacity delivery infrastructure expansion in Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure and data centers. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running by providing servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the infrastructure supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse regional team of 15-20 other TPMs, mostly located in the Pacific Northwest, working in various sized regions across the Americas, within a broader organization including software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy while sharing lessons learned and driving consistency across the region. The TPM will serve as the single-threaded owner for capacity delivery in assigned data center clusters, coordinating cross-functional teams from inception through deployment. Schedule and stakeholder management will include disparate teams including planning, design, finance, real estate, energy, construction, commissioning, controls, and others. The primary objective of this role is to work across the organization to ensure capacity delivery meets or exceeds business needs, while communicating and mitigating risks. The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess 3+ years of experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. A Bachelor's Degree or additional technical experience is required. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage. Candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must. The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL and systems integration a plus. This position requires 25% Travel (Domestic and International trips to AWS Data Center Clusters). If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
• Assumer la responsabilité globale de l'échéancier, de la portée et de la gestion des risques des programmes de livraison de capacité d'infrastructure dans les grappes de centres de données attribuées, en prenant des décisions nettes et en levant les obstacles afin de maintenir les projets sur la bonne voie. 
• Coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles — notamment la planification, la conception, la construction, la mise en service et les contrôles — afin de livrer des constructions d'infrastructure qui peuvent nécessiter une modification des gabarits définis pour atteindre les objectifs du programme. 
• Communiquer clairement et de façon concise l'état d'avancement, les risques et les compromis du programme aux parties prenantes de tous les niveaux, en veillant à ce que les bonnes personnes participent à la conversation et que les décisions soient bien éclairées. 
• Repérer et atténuer tôt les risques de livraison en analysant les interdépendances entre les systèmes en amont et en aval, et faire remonter l'information de manière appropriée lorsque les constructions proposées sont trop complexes ou présentent un risque élevé. 
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en appliquant des méthodologies d'amélioration des processus, en définissant des indicateurs de réussite et en intégrant des pratiques d'excellence opérationnelle aux plans de programme.

• Own the overall schedule, scope, and risk management for infrastructure capacity delivery programs across assigned data center clusters, driving crisp decisions and clearing blockers to keep projects on track. 
• Coordinate cross-functional teams — including planning, design, construction, commissioning, and controls — to deliver infrastructure builds that may require modification from defined templates to meet program goals. 
• Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring the right people are part of the conversation and that decisions are well-informed. 
• Identify and mitigate delivery risks early by analyzing interdependencies across upstream and downstream systems, escalating appropriately when proposed builds are too complex or carry elevated risk. 
• Drive continuous improvement by applying process improvement methodologies, defining success metrics, and incorporating operational excellence practices into program plans.

A day in the life
Vous commencez votre matinée en passant en revue les tableaux de bord de livraison de capacité et en triant les problèmes survenus durant la nuit et signalés par les équipes partenaires. En milieu de matinée, vous dirigez une réunion debout (stand-up) interfonctionnelle avec les responsables de la conception, de la construction et de la mise en service afin de vous aligner sur les jalons et de régler les points en suspens. Après le dîner, vous pourriez animer une séance technique de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre un défi de mise en œuvre, puis passer à la mise à jour de votre registre des risques et à la préparation d'un compte rendu de situation pour la direction. Tout au long de la journée, vous échangez avec des parties prenantes réparties sur différents fuseaux horaires, en conciliant la résolution tactique de problèmes et la planification stratégique afin de faire progresser vos programmes.

You start your morning reviewing capacity delivery dashboards and triaging any overnight issues flagged by partner teams. By mid-morning you are leading a cross-functional stand-up with design, construction, and commissioning leads to align on milestones and resolve open items. After lunch you might facilitate a technical whiteboard session to troubleshoot an implementation challenge, then shift to updating your risk register and preparing a status narrative for leadership. Throughout the day you connect with stakeholders across time zones, balancing tactical problem-solving with strategic planning to keep your programs moving forward.

About the team
Notre équipe fait partie d'AWS Infrastructure Services, l'organisation responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. Nous faisons fonctionner l'infonuagique en veillant à ce que les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement soient en place afin que les clients aient un accès continu aux services dont ils dépendent. Avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure, nous nous attaquons à certains des problèmes de logistique et d'ingénierie les plus complexes chez Amazon. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale inclusive de gestionnaires de programme travaillant à travers les Amériques, soutenue par des ingénieurs matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité et des gestionnaires des opérations. Nous valorisons les idées audacieuses et vous donnons l'autonomie nécessaire pour les mener à terme, tout en partageant les leçons apprises dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe diversifiée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes de partout chez AWS pour nous aider à offrir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sûreté et de sécurité, tout en fournissant une capacité pratiquement illimitée au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Amazon has the world’s most complex supply chain: we fulfill global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lightning fast delivery speeds. We need your skills to optimize our supply chain, with the end goal of delighting our customers. A core part of the supply chain operations is Demand Forecasting: We forecast the demand of tens of millions of products. These forecasts are used to make many decisions, such as automatically order hundreds of millions worth of inventory, decide where to place that inventory, and establish labor plans for hundreds of warehouses.

We need a creative, smart and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer. Your mission will be to improve forecast accuracy and enable partner teams and customers to optimize supply chain decisions. You will do this by detecting, diagnosing and correcting forecast problems and generating metrics and insights. You will have the resources and tools to help you deliver this mission - support from partner teams like Data Engineering/Data Science/Program, rich datasets and tools like AWS Redshift and Tableau.

Key job responsibilities
As a Business Intelligence Engineer in forecasting, you will be responsible for:
- Understanding the opportunities for improvement and partnering with PMs, Science and Engineering to design solutions to complex forecasting problems.
- Come up with innovative solutions working with our machine learning & research scientists that solves forecasting challenges for new businesses that Amazon keeps inventing.
- Communicate and earn trust with our customers in retail & our downstream systems.
- Develop strong reporting mechanisms for internal and external teams.

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

Amazon has the world’s most complex supply chain: we fulfill global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lightning fast delivery speeds. We need your skills to optimize our supply chain, with the end goal of delighting our customers. A core part of the supply chain operations is Demand and Inbound Forecasting: We forecast the demand and arrival of tens of millions of products. The forecasts are used to make many decisions, such as automatically order hundreds of millions worth of inventory, decide where to place that inventory, and establish labor plans for WW warehouses.

We are looking for a Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer to join a team developing new tools and metrics to oversee the delivery of analytics solutions across the product development lifecycle, from entitlement through implementation and ongoing business operations. 

A successful candidate will be customer obsessed - the Forecasting org has 50+ unique customers. You will need to balance long-term thinking with short-term actions. You will be comfortable navigating an ambiguous environment, know how to confirm and reconfirm assumptions, and be able to harmonize disparate points of view.

Key job responsibilities
Analytics & Insights

• Build tools to analyze large amounts of data that uncover forecasting issues and convey insights which highlight forecast performance and explain variance 
• Oversee the development and maintenance of recurring reporting frameworks

Product Development Support

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. RRSP

About the team
We are ASIN Forecasting Analytics Team. We monitor the ASIN demand and inbound inventory forecasts for Amazon businesses WW. We report on historical forecast performance, the changes of future forecasts, and the health of future forecasts. We partner with stakeholder teams across supply chain, retail, and operations to assess the future forecast against existing supply conditions. Lastly, we develop intervention models to correct forecasts when defects exist or for scenarios that are not addressed adequately by core models. In addition to forecast accuracy, we help manage forecast volatility.

 About AppDirect 

 Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

 About You 

 AppDirect is looking for an ambitious, tech-curious Associate Project Manager with a consultative mindset and exceptional communication skills. You are naturally structured, organized, and driven to bring clarity to complex or virtual team environments. Rather than just executing tasks, you ask critical questions, solve problems proactively, and strive to continuously grow.

 On larger projects, the Associate Project Manager works to assist project managers with the coordination of resources, equipment, meetings and information. You will organize projects with the goal of getting them completed on time and within budget. On smaller projects, you will assume the role of Project Manager.

 What you'll do and how you'll have an impact 

- Support delivery of AppDirect's enterprise and platform engagements by maintaining project plans, schedules, budgets, and expenditure tracking.

- Own end-to-end project coordination on smaller initiatives, and assist a senior Project Manager on complex, high-visibility engagements.

- Organize and attend stakeholder meetings, document minutes and action items, and follow up to ensure commitments are met.

- Prepare and maintain presentation materials, project calendars, and status reports that keep all stakeholders aligned.

- Coordinate change management and risk management activities, escalating issues to the senior PM when needed.

- Support quality assurance activities to ensure projects adhere to established frameworks and documentation standards.

 What we're looking for 

- 1–2 years of experience in project coordination or project management within a technology or professional services environment.

- Technical affinity and comfort with IT concepts.

- Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira or equivalent).

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to effectively collaborate across internal teams and external stakeholders.

- Strong structured mindset with a proven ability to bring organization, clarity, and structure to complex or virtual environments.

- Critical thinking abilities to proactively evaluate project risks, solve problems, and streamline workflows.

- Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira or equivalent).

- PMI certification (CAPM or PMP) is an asset.

 At AppDirect, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment that houses diversity of excellence, experience and thought. We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. We foster an environment of inclusion without regard to race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity enabling AppDirectors to embrace their uniqueness to do their best work. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.

 At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice: https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice

AI tools do not make hiring decisions or solely automated decisions about your candidacy – all decisions are made by our people. greenhouse:appdirect:8795450002.description:
About AppDirect 

 Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

 About PartnerStack, an AppDirect Subsidiary 

 PartnerStack is the leading partner ecosystem platform for B2B SaaS — purpose-built to help software companies find, activate, and scale partnerships as a primary growth channel. Through a two-sided marketplace, PartnerStack connects vendors with high-quality affiliate, referral, and reseller partners, while giving partners a single destination to discover and grow inside the programs worth their time. As part of the AppDirect family, PartnerStack sits at the center of how modern B2B companies go to market through partners — complementing AppDirect's subscription commerce infrastructure and Tackle's cloud marketplace capabilities to give customers a complete partner-led growth platform.

 About You 

 As an Revenue Ops Systems Analyst, you are the person who treats our GTM tech stack like a product, not a maintenance job. You own the infrastructure behind Salesforce and every system that touches it — Planhat, Zendesk, Gong, HubSpot — and you make sure they work as one connected engine, not a pile of disconnected tools duct-taped together. You don't wait for a broken workflow to blow up in someone's pipeline before you fix it; you're already in the data, hunting for what's slow, what's messy, and what's about to break. You see AI and automation as first-class tools, not side projects — evaluating and shipping the ones that actually move the needle, not the ones that just look good in a demo. You partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, translating what they need into systems that are scalable and actually intuitive to use. You are comfortable working independently and helping others see what can be accomplished when we invest in the right processes and bring data into our decision making. You are resourceful, independent, and good-natured with strong communication skills and a deep attention to detail.

 What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact 

- Own the GTM technology stack, ensuring Salesforce and adjacent systems (Planhat, Zendesk, Gong, Hubspot) operate as one connected system, data flows cleanly, integrations stay healthy, and the tech stack scales with the business.

- Proactively identify & resolve gaps by leveraging internal data to perform detailed investigations to reveal insights into root causes, areas of most impact, priorities of focus, and recommend paths forward to optimize all GTM processes. Do not wait for GTM teams to flag a problem.

- Build and manage automation workflows that reduce manual work and improve team efficiencies.

- Design and ship AI-powered workflows that go beyond simple triggers — multi-step agents, structured data extraction, and automations that make judgment calls, not just move data from A to B.

- Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to identify and translate business needs into scalable & intuitive processes.

- Evaluate, pilot, and implement AI tools (ex. Claude, Devs.ai, Clay, Workato) that improve GTM efficiency and rep productivity, with a clear eye toward ROI and adoption.

- Drive data integrity across systems, workflows, and reporting (deduplication, standardization, and enforcement of data entry standards)

- Support and automate processes for commissions, territory management and data enrichment.

- Manage incident response with change management, monitoring/alerting automation, and documented processes so information is not siloed.

- Lead cross-functional GTM systems projects end to end — scope the problem, decide the technical approach, get buy-in from Sales/CS/Marketing/Finance leads, and drive implementation to a shipped outcome, not just a recommendation.

 What we’re looking for 

- 3+  years of business experience, with deep experience working in an operations role within go-to-market (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue, etc) or forward deployment role with experience setting up operational flows for go-to-market clients.

- Enjoy digging into quantitative and qualitative data to spot process gaps, generate solutions, and back decisions with evidence rather than intuition.

- Deep Salesforce administration experience - configuration, workflow/flow building, data modeling, and reporting at minimum; formal admin certification a plus.

- Experience building and managing modern GTM systems and integrations - such as Zendesk, Hubspot, Default, Planhat, Seamless, Gong, Sale Nav, etc.

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs directly — prompt design, tool/function calling, context and memory design, output evaluation — beyond configuring no-code automation tools like Workato or Zapier. Comfort with basic scripting (TypeScript/JavaScript and Python) to connect systems.

- Strong project management skills and an ability to support key priorities from ideation through to execution.

- Experience identifying problems, providing creative solutions, and ruthlessly prioritizing projects based on business impact, rather than working purely off inbound requests

- Strong SQL or data analysis skills sufficient to investigate data quality issues and build reporting independently. Experience with BI/reporting tools (Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or similar) beyond native CRM reporting.

- Self-motivated, action-oriented and able to adapt to a fast paced environment while working independently

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, since documentation and cross-functional alignment are core to the job.

- Able to challenge other’s opinions, assumptions, and actions, but also willing to support ultimate decisions that may go in a different direction.

 THE TEAM 
 The mission of the Project Management Office is to bring the most important projects to realization.

 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 Aritzia is growing and our Project Management Office (PMO) is growing with it. You will play a pivotal role in leading business expansion and setting up people and process infrastructure to drive business growth initiatives that are a strategic fit with Aritzia’s long term goals. You will be responsible for supporting and defining the strategic direction for key initiatives and delivering their successful completion, on time and on budget using best project management practices. You will be working collaboratively with business leaders and cross-functional support partners to obtain executive alignment and approvals to drive projects forward. With people at the heart of everything we do, you will support your high-potential people to grow rewarding careers at Aritzia — while enjoying one yourself.

 As the Senior Project Manager / Project Manager, Business Initiatives you will: 

- Work with the appropriate Business Support partners to seamlessly lead the day-to-day function of the department in support of corporate objectives, while enabling progressive career development and an incredible employee experience

- Spearhead the successful strategy, planning and delivery of large scale multi-disciplinary projects that directly contribute to our corporate growth initiatives 

- Continually evolve Aritzia project management methodologies and support with developing the necessary capabilities to staff and resource for the highest project success 

- Partner with executive stakeholders and other support partners enable a collaborative approach to project delivery, fostering teamwork and driving successful outcomes 

 THE QUALIFICATIONS 
 The Senior Project Manager / Project Manager, Business Initiatives has: 

- Proven and best-in-class skills, education, and/or applicable certifications that are an asset to perform in the role, including relevant Project Management experience, PMP and/or retail experience preferred 

- A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles 

- The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners 

- A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business

 At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.

The range for roles at this level is $100,000 - $300,000 per year. Total compensation may include base, bonus and/or equity depending on the role, which has the potential to be greater than this range.

With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.

 THE PERKS 
 Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

- Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.

- Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.

- A-OK Commissary & Cafe — Everyday Luxury dining, exclusive to Aritzia. Our in-house bistro and cafe is a private oasis where employees can enjoy curated, subsidized Everyday Luxury dining. 

- The SET — Our in-office fitness studio and gym with state-of-the-art equipment, custom-created classes and optional personal training. Open 7 days a week, it works out well. 

- Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial. 

- Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration. They’re also dog friendly. Woof.

- Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.

- The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like dry-cleaning, hotel and restaurant discounts, self-care promos and on-site medical care.

This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.

THE ROLE

Ashby's GTM engine runs on a set of interconnected systems. Keeping them accurate, efficient, and trusted is the foundation everything else is built on. As our GTM Systems Analyst, you'll own the daily maintenance and configuration of technical layer that powers our Go-to-Market organization: the CRM configurations, integration architecture, and data quality practices that let our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams move fast with confidence.

This role sits within Revenue Operations, the horizontal function that makes the entire GTM system work. You'll be embedded in daily operations (triaging issues, implementing new tooling, and translating business requirements into scalable configurations) while also contributing to longer-term systems strategy as we move up-market and expand our product suite.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS NOW

We're in an active expansion phase: new products, new segments, new GTM motions. Our systems need to keep pace. The person in this role will shape how we build the technical foundation for the next chapter of Ashby's growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - System Administration: Own the day-to-day health of our core GTM platforms. You'll manage configuration, user permissions, custom objects, and workflow automation across our CRM stack — making sure the systems actually reflect how our teams work, not just how they were set up two years ago.

 - Integration Support: Maintain clean data flows across our GTM toolset ( including intent data, conversation intelligence, and sales engagement platforms). You'll be the person who knows how signals travel between systems and why, and who makes sure they're flowing reliably.

 - Data Governance: Enforce standards for data quality, deduplication, and field taxonomy. Revenue reporting and forecasting are only as good as the data underneath them, along with our GTM Engineers and our System Architect, you'll build the infrastructure of trust that makes those outputs credible.

 - Stakeholder Support: Be the go-to technical partner for frontline GTM teams. You'll triage issues, gather business requirements, and deliver solutions that scale. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners and know when to say "that requires a bigger conversation" rather than patching around a root cause.

 - Tooling Evaluation: Help evaluate new GTM tech and AI tools as our needs evolve. You'll assess how new tools will integrate with our existing systems, support contract renewals, and support implementation of emerging solutions, with a practical bias toward what will actually get adopted and maintained.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Advanced proficiency in CRM administration: Salesforce Administrator or HubSpot Administrator certification strongly preferred

 - Experience connecting marketing automation, CRM, and revenue intelligence tools (e.g., 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Gainsight)

 - Ability to translate abstract business goals into documented, scalable technical configurations

 - Strong analytical skills: you can diagnose data discrepancies, form a hypothesis, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Instinctive troubleshooter:  you don't wait for a problem to be fully described before you start hypothesizing

 - Clear written communicator; we're a remote-first company and documentation is how work gets shared

 - 2–4 years in a RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops systems role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with SQL or data warehouse querying (Snowflake, BigQuery) for ad hoc analysis

 - Experience with AI-assisted workflow automation or prompt-based tooling in a GTM context

 - Exposure to multi-product or multi-segment GTM motions
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You have used CRM systems extensively, but have not owned CRM administration work directly. Hubspot is our current CRM.

 - You prefer strategy and architecture work over hands-on systems ownership.

 - You do your best work when requirements are fully specified, rather than when you need to diagnose ambiguous issues and triage incoming requests.

 - You are looking for a role focused on one GTM function, rather than broad partnership across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS
