Hi, I'm Jace Talamantes jace@ashbyhq.com. I founded Ashby's Customer Education function in 2025 and now lead the team. I am excited to be hiring a Customer Education Program Manager, Live Learning!



Our team is built on a simple belief: Ashby Academy should feel like every customer's personal CSM. Regardless of tier or team size, every Ashby customer deserves content that meets them where they are — practical, accurate, and genuinely useful. That standard shapes everything we build, and it's what's driven the development of our growing Academy courses, webinar program, and playbook library. We have ambitions to expand both the depth of our content and the formats we deliver it in, and this hire is a meaningful part of getting there.



As our first dedicated live-learning hire, you’ll help define what this program becomes and build the practices that make it work. Our Startup Customer Success and Recruiting Operations Consulting teams already run live sessions that customers value. You’ll lead how those experiences should come together, bring a point of view on where we should invest next, and define what great live learning at Ashby should feel like.



This role needs both vision and execution. You’ll shape the direction and stay close to the work: planning the calendar, simplifying registration, developing a workshop with an expert, coaching presenters, and hosting selected sessions yourself. You should be as interested in getting next week’s session right as you are in imagining what the program could become over the next year.



You’ll report to me and partner with Customer Success, Customer Education, and Marketing. There’s a foundation to build on and people to partner with, alongside plenty of room to set direction and drive the work. If you enjoy forming a point of view, turning it into something practical, and improving it as you learn, there’s a lot to make your own here.




WHAT YOU’LL DO AT ASHBY

 - Own the Customer Success live-learning program, bringing existing programs together under a shared calendar, planning process, and consistent customer experience. Establish a clear process for evaluating, prioritizing, and developing new ideas.

 - Make sessions easier to run. Own registration, reminders, session setup, presenter preparation, live production, surveys, follow-up, and recording handoffs. Build reusable templates and clear operating practices that reduce repeated work.

 - Design learning around customer needs. Partner with presenters and Customer Education Program Managers to define the audience, intended outcome, format, and supporting resources. Develop session outlines, exercises, facilitator guides, and other materials that help customers apply what they learn.

 - Help experts become effective presenters. Define what a high-quality session looks like, run rehearsals, coach presenters, and improve how sessions handle questions, participation, pacing, and mixed experience levels.

 - Host and facilitate selected sessions. Lead or co-facilitate learning where it serves the program, moderate questions and activities, model effective teaching, and help test new formats. Build a program that supports multiple presenters rather than depending on you to teach every session.

 - Own the live-learning recording library. Make useful sessions easy to find and learn from after the live event. Decide what to publish, how to organize it, and when to refresh or retire it. Partner with Academy operations on publishing and with presenters and CEPMs on accuracy, supporting resources, and opportunities to turn sessions into other learning formats.

 - Make sessions easy to discover and join. Work with Marketing on the website experience, audience communications, packaging, and connections to broader programs. Give customers a clear way to find the right session and their next learning step.

 - Measure and improve the program. Track registration, attendance, engagement, learner feedback, and operational effort. Define the product behavior each program is intended to support and work with partners to assess whether customers take action.

 - Expand deliberately. Use customer needs and program evidence to recommend additional audiences and formats, including onboarding sessions, RecOps clinics, applied workshops, and customer spotlights.

Our teams currently run roughly two to three sessions each week. Your initial priority is to establish reliable delivery of the existing program. You’ll work with your manager to prioritize improvements and expand formats, balancing customer needs with presenter availability and operational capacity.




HOW YOU’LL WORK WITH OTHER TEAMS

 - Startup CSMs and RecOps consultants will continue to lead the subject-matter content and delivery for their audiences. You’ll partner with them on learning design, preparation, and quality while owning the overall program and its operations.

 - You’ll work together with Customer Education Program Managers to decide where live learning fits and how it connects with existing courses, playbooks, and release education.

 - Marketing will partner on website presence, promotion, packaging, and broader program alignment. Operations and systems partners will support platform setup and integrations. You’ll define program requirements and work with those partners to improve workflows.

 - This role focuses on scalable customer learning. Individual customer training and consulting engagements remain with the teams responsible for those services.




EXAMPLES OF WORK YOU MIGHT OWN

 - Bring Startup and RecOps sessions into one coordinated calendar with a consistent registration and follow-up experience.

 - Turn a presentation-heavy session into a workshop where customers practice a workflow and receive feedback.

 - Create a presenter kit with an outline, rehearsal checklist, production plan, and guidance for handling questions.

 - Work with Marketing and Event Ops to simplify webinar setup and connect registration and attendance data with our reporting.

 - Package a useful session into a recording, a short practical resource, and a clear next step in Academy.

 - Review a series with strong attendance but limited follow-through and recommend what to change before running it again.





YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You’ve owned recurring live education or a comparable customer-facing program and can show how you made it more useful, reliable, or scalable.

 - You come from customer education, product training, customer success, enablement, learning design, or webinar program management. What matters most is evidence that you can combine strong operational ownership with thoughtful teaching and a strong understanding of customer needs.

 - You own recurring work reliably. You can manage a calendar, multiple contributors, deadlines, and dependencies while keeping the customer experience consistent.

 - You’ve helped people learn something complex. You can explain clearly, use practical examples, and check whether someone can apply what you taught.

 - You’re comfortable facilitating live. You can guide participation, respond to questions, adjust your approach, and keep a session useful when something unexpected happens.

 - You help other people teach effectively. You can give specific, constructive feedback and help an expert turn deep knowledge into an accessible learning experience.

 - You learn products firsthand. You explore workflows, use documentation, test your understanding, and know when expert validation is needed. Prior Ashby experience is helpful, but not required.

 - You’re comfortable with the operational details. You’ve worked with webinar or virtual-learning platforms and understand registration, communications, recordings, surveys, and reporting. Experience with HubSpot or a comparable system is useful.

 - You bring a point of view and turn it into practice. You can assess an existing program, recommend what to keep, change, or build next, and personally drive the work with the right partners.

 - You use evidence to improve. You can use learner feedback and behavior to assess whether a session helped customers apply what they learned.




YOU MAY NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You want to focus exclusively on presenting. A substantial part of this role is planning, production, systems, and supporting other presenters.

 - You want to focus on program strategy without staying close to delivery. This role includes hands-on setup, production, follow-up, and troubleshooting alongside improving how the program runs.

 - You measure success primarily by the number of events delivered. We care about whether the right customers participate, learn, and apply what the program teaches.

 - You need an established playbook for every decision. There is a foundation to build on, and you’ll help determine how it develops.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want the process to give you a clear picture of the work and give us practical evidence of how you approach it. Here's what you can expect:

 - An introductory conversation with Recruiting (30 minutes)

 - A hiring manager conversation about programs you’ve owned (45 minutes)

 - A bounded take-home exercise (one week to complete)

 - Final Round interview (two hours)
   
   - A discussion of your approach to the take-home exercise (45 minutes)
   
   - A conversation about facilitation and presenter coaching (30 minutes)
   
   - A cross-functional partnership conversation (30 minutes)
   
   - Closing questions with the myself, the Hiring Manager (15 minutes)

We’ll share the full schedule, preparation expectations, and evaluation criteria before the exercise.




ABOUT ASHBY

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website:  https://www.ashbyhq.com/%EF%BF%BC%EF%BF%BCWehttps://www.ashbyhq.com/

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. Following our Series D in 2025, we’re continuing to grow ARR at more than 100% year over year, serving over 5,000 customers, including industry leaders like Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, Reddit, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers. We’ll share more details once we meet. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀

 


ABOUT GO TO MARKET

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

 - We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

 - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-leadership-principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.




BENEFITS

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

 26WD101507, Senior Program Manager, Operational Workforce Planning 

 Position Overview 
 As a Senior Program Manager focused on the Operational Workforce Planning Capability, you will play a critical role in enabling Autodesk to effectively operationalize its workforce plans and ensure the right people are in the right roles at the right time. You will be responsible for driving process excellence, coordinating cross-functional execution, and ensuring consistent, data-driven workforce planning practices across the organization. This role emphasizes translating strategy into action, optimizing mid-term workforce capacity, managing headcount planning cycles, and ensuring alignment between business demand and talent supply.

 You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners including Workday Adaptive Planning Product Management, Finance, People Insights & Solution Design (PISD), Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and People Business Partners to deliver scalable operational planning solutions.

 Responsibilities 

- Establish and manage operational Workforce Planning frameworks, guidelines, and playbooks to enable efficient workforce execution aligned with Autodesk’s business objectives

- Lead the annual planning cycles, ensuring coordination across business units, Finance, and HR teams

- Own program governance for operational workforce planning processes, ensuring consistency, transparency, and accountability across the organization

- Design and optimize workflows for headcount planning and reporting in partnership with IT, Finance, and PISD

- Manage Roadmap to enhance the Workday Adaptive Planning model and related tools to support accurate, timely workforce and headcount planning

- Develop and track metrics to measure planning accuracy, plan-to-actual variance, and stakeholder satisfaction

- Partner with Finance and Talent Acquisition to ensure alignment between workforce demand, hiring plans, and financial constraints

- Facilitate regular cross-functional meetings to align on priorities, identify bottlenecks, and drive execution improvements

- Benchmark and analyze operational workforce planning practices to identify continuous improvement opportunities

- Enable capability-building across People Business Partners and other PPL Centers of Excellence to strengthen workforce planning maturity

- Manage relationships with external partners or consultants supporting workforce planning operations

 Minimum Qualifications 

- Prior experience managing operational or headcount planning programs at scale

- 10+ years in operations, planning, and programs, or combination of these skills

- Deep expertise in program management, governance, and process optimization

- Strong ability to translate strategic plans into executable operational processes and actionable insights

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

- Skilled in data-driven decision-making and reporting

- Proficiency with Workday Adaptive Planning and/or other workforce planning tools

- Experience using program and project management tools (e.g., Airtable, Miro, Smartsheet)

- BA/BS in Business, Operations, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in Professional Services or Consulting

- Prior experience in a global organization managing multi-region workforce planning

- Master’s degree in a relevant field preferred but not required

Job Requisition ID # 

26WD100755 

 Position Overview 
 The Industry Strategy Manager of Digital Project Delivery will help define the strategy and go-to-market growth strategies for project delivery in the Autodesk Forma industry cloud, spanning design collaboration, design management, data management, and coordination.

 You will contribute to a team that defines and executes on the industry strategy, including market opportunity analysis, customer value propositions, competitive analysis, partnerships, target audiences, and business models. You will work with cross-functional teams across Product, Platform, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, among others.

 You must possess deep knowledge in BIM and have delivered digital projects across multiple disciplines. This includes design collaboration and coordination across firms, the handoffs across the project lifecycle, and the ISO 19650 information management practices and Common Data Environments that hold them together. You will need to be an effective communicator and coalition builder who thinks strategically, writes concisely, and presents as easily to a working group as to a conference stage. You must be able to work across a matrixed organization, use data to drive business decisions, and bring recommendations forward rather than wait for direction.

 Autodesk is in a period of exciting and dynamic change as we continue to expand market share through various business growth initiatives and our transition to cloud. The successful candidate will have input into the shape, direction, and growth of the organization as we transition through this change and plan for the future.

 Responsibilities 

- Contribute to the digital project delivery vision and strategy for Autodesk, informed by internal and external research across the market, competitors, and customer audiences

- Lead cross-functional programs that take a digital project delivery initiative from strategy through launch, coordinating across teams to a shared plan and timeline

- Help shape the strategy for design management, the system that gives project teams control and visibility of design production, from deliverable planning through progress measurement and forecasting

- Support the regionalization of our offerings, working with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Legal on packaging, positioning, compliance requirements, and how public owners buy

- Work with product teams to translate how project teams design, coordinate, and deliver work into product requirements, value propositions, and market-facing positioning, representing the voice of the customer on price, package, position, and business models

- Work with the strategy team to create business cases to drive sales channels, partnerships, and mergers & acquisitions, and the executive briefings that carry them

- Monitor business performance; document and report on usage, adoption, customer acquisition and retention, and adjust go-to-market plans

- Build and maintain the business plan for digital project delivery growth, including adoption, expansion, and customer migration paths

- Work with sales to develop and achieve success, define and develop appropriate sales plays and tools, and support marketing execution to create the content behind them

- Represent Autodesk within industry organizations and at industry events, and as a point of contact for industry specialists, research analysts, key press, and other third parties

 Minimum Qualifications 

- BS, BArch, BEng or equivalent degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related field

- 8+ years of experience working within the AEC industry, or in strategy, product management, consulting, or go-to-market roles serving it

- Demonstrable experience delivering projects across multiple disciplines, including design collaboration and coordination across firms

- Experience planning or managing design production at project or program scale, including deliverables, schedule, progress measurement, and forecasting

- Working knowledge of ISO 19650 information workflows and of how information requirements are defined and validated

- Experience with cloud-based design, collaboration, and management tools targeting architects, engineers, contractors, and owners

- Ability to travel, including internationally

 Preferred Qualifications 

- MBA

- Knowledge of cloud and SaaS technology and business landscape

- Exposure to US public sector owners at federal, state DOT, or municipal level, or familiarity with public procurement and contract vehicles

- Familiarity with ERP and project controls data, and how resource, cost, and progress data connect to design production

- A track record of research that changed a decision — a market sizing, competitive read, or customer study that redirected a plan

- Experience building business cases and forecasts for a product or portfolio, and reporting results against them to senior leadership

ashby:beaconsoftware:81011b99-50f0-4099-.title: Technical Project Manager, Integrations
ashby:beaconsoftware:81011b99-50f0-4099-.description:
THE ROLE

Beacon acquires vertical market software companies and brings them onto a common operating standard. Integration is the function that runs the window between close and steady state, coordinating IT, Finance, GTM, Legal, and HR so that a newly acquired company lands cleanly rather than by improvisation.

You will run that window. Each integration is a fixed, fast-moving program with a defined start and a defined handoff, and you will be the person holding the plan, the cadence, and the escalations across every function involved. This is a hands-on role. You will drive the plan and you will do work inside it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Run integrations from close to handoff. Own the integration plan for each acquisition: scope, sequencing, owners, and dates across every function. Drive the recurring cadence, keep the plan current, and land the handoff on time.

Be the coordination point for the acquired company. Work directly with the GM and their team through their first weeks inside Beacon. Translate between how they operate today and how Beacon operates, and make sure nothing lands on them twice or not at all.

Move companies onto the Beacon standard. Identity, devices, security baselines, and core business systems. You will partner with IT, Security, and the systems owners to sequence the migrations and to unblock them when they stall.

Hold the line on status. Report progress honestly to leadership, including the parts that are behind. Escalate early and with a recommendation attached rather than late and with a surprise.

Run and sharpen the playbook. Each integration should be faster and cleaner than the last. Find the steps that keep breaking, fix them in the playbook, and make the improvement stick across the next one.




REQUIRED

 - 5+ years in project or program management, running cross-functional programs end to end

 - Experience coordinating across IT, Finance, GTM, Legal, and HR, or an equivalent set of functions with competing priorities

 - Comfort with technical systems: identity, device management, and core SaaS platforms. You do not need to configure them, but you need to follow the work and ask sharp questions

 - Experience building process, templates, and structure where none existed

 - Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time

 - A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan

 - The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you


NICE TO HAVE

 - Post-close M&A integration experience, in-house or in advisory

 - Exposure to IAM, MDM, or SSO rollouts

 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or SOX ITGC programs

 - Automation experience

 - A habit of spotting the smarter way to do something and then doing it


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

 

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

ashby:beaconsoftware:670f3807-7a5b-45f1-.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a delivery-focused Project Manager to run acquisition migrations end-to-end as Beacon standardizes each newly acquired company onto a common GTM stack. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who runs several projects at once against a hard deadline, keeps a lot of moving parts coordinated, and raises the bar on the quality of work around them.

Beacon acquires roughly one software company per week which is then integrated into our standardized GTM stack. This role partners with newly acquired companies starting from the first discovery call, through CRM and Support Ticketing builds, until systems are fully rolled out. This role coordinates internal resources and ensures the portfolio company is trained on the tech stack while adhering to an SLA and making the process more repeatable with every acquisition.

This role is responsible for running the project, meaning holding the timeline, managing the stakeholders, directing the build resources, and making sure what ships is right. This role will be partnered with a technical RevOps resource to help with deeper technical support, but this role will be responsible for speaking to the toolset at a high-level.





WHAT YOU WOULD OWN

 - Migration delivery. Acquisition migrations against our SLA, owned end to end: scoping, project planning, sequencing the CRM and Support Ticketing builds, coordinating data migration, and making sure the team is trained and confident at go-live. You would lead discovery calls to assess their current stack and map it to Beacon's standards, hold the plan and the timeline across several concurrent migrations, manage dependencies and risks before they become slips, and own the status.

 - Contractor direction and quality. You would direct the work of pooled implementation contractors assigned to your migrations, pull in technical support when a problem genuinely needs it, make day-to-day scope and sequencing calls within the documented playbook, and escalate only genuine exceptions.

 - Delivery process. Improving the migration playbook as you run against it — tightening the plan, the checklists, and the handoffs so each acquisition goes faster and more predictably than the last.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 3–5 years project or program management, running implementation, migration or change management projects — ideally in B2B SaaS, professional services, or consulting. You ideally have managed multiple projects concurrently against firm deadlines..

 - You are literate in Go-To-Market systems. You understand how a CRM and a support platform are put together and can scope a build, and hold a credible conversation with a founder about their GTM tech stack.

 - You have directed the work of others — contractors, an agency pod, or junior admins — even without formal people management.

 - A confident stakeholder-facing communicator. You’re a people person who can understand hesitant stakeholders and help them feel excited during a period of a lot of change.

 - Strong judgment under ambiguity. You make defensible calls from a playbook instead of escalating everything, and you know which exceptions genuinely warrant escalation.

 - A quality bar you set rather than inherit. You care how the build looks six months after go-live, not just at handoff.

 - Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time

 - A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan

 - The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you


NICE TO HAVE

 - Formal project management training or certification (PMP or similar).

 - Familiar with project management tools (Asana, JIRA, Monday.com http://Monday.com).

 - Hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, PipeDrive, Zoho, etc.)

 - Hands-on Support experience (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, etc.)

 - M&A exposure, particularly post-close systems consolidation.

 - Familiarity with migration tooling or scripting that moves data faster and more reliably than manual imports allow.

 Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.   

 We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.  

 Launch your career at Bell and join the best-in-class Internship/Graduate Program. You’ll be empowered to shape your future and inspired to bring your best ideas to work. Throughout the program, you’ll have the chance to connect with mentors and senior leaders who will support your professional and personal growth journey. You’ll develop real-world skills and join other interns and grads attending exclusive events and networking opportunities.  

 At Bell, innovation drives us. With advanced tech, AI tools, and a collaborative culture, you’ll shape the future and grow your career. Join us! 

 Why Join Us 

 Join Bell's Corporate Strategy, Value Creation & Business Transformation team and help shape the decisions that drive the future of the business. You'll gain exposure to enterprise-wide strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, operational improvements, and value creation opportunities. Working alongside experienced leaders and executives, you'll develop consulting-style problem-solving, financial, strategic, and analytical skills while building a broad understanding of how Bell creates value across its business. You'll also benefit from mentorship, formal development opportunities, and a strong graduate and alumni network designed to accelerate your career growth.  

 What You'll Do 

 Through a structured 30-month rotational program, you'll help solve complex business challenges where strategy, economics, operations, technology, and execution intersect. You'll work on high-priority initiatives that influence business decisions, drive transformation, and deliver measurable outcomes across the organization.  

- Conduct market, competitive, customer, financial, and operational analyses to identify insights and value drivers.  

- Break down complex business problems into structured workplans, hypotheses, and actionable recommendations.  

- Develop business cases, financial models, executive presentations, implementation plans, and value-tracking frameworks.  

- Support strategic and transformation initiatives from problem definition through execution and results measurement.  

- Assess investment opportunities through ROI, CAPEX, TCO, NPV, and related financial analyses.  

- Contribute to product, operational, and business transformation roadmaps.  

- Collaborate with teams across Finance, Operations, Technology, and other functions to deliver business outcomes.  

- Leverage data, technology, and AI-enabled tools to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of analysis.  

- Present evidence-based recommendations and insights to leaders and senior stakeholders.  

 Education & Eligibility 

- You graduated/will graduate between 2024 and August 2027 with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Business Technology Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, with no more than a three-year gap between degrees.   

- You have less than three years of combined professional experience, excluding internships.   

 Core Capabilities & Technical Skills 

- Strong structured problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex business, financial, and operational challenges.  

- Experience developing business cases, financial models, or quantitative analyses through academic, internship, or extracurricular experiences.  

- Ability to synthesize large amounts of information into clear insights, recommendations, and executive-ready presentations.  

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Query, or AI tools is an asset.  

- Strong business and financial acumen, including familiarity with investment analysis, value creation, and performance measurement concepts.  

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams.  

- Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work.  

- Comfort working through ambiguity, exercising sound judgment, and translating analysis into practical business actions.  

- Curiosity for strategy, technology, operations, telecommunications, infrastructure, and large-scale business transformation.  

- Demonstrated leadership, ownership, and continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of creating impact through academic, professional, or community involvement.  

 Applying is simple 

 Our application process is designed to be straightforward, so you can show us who you are and we can easily spot your #TeamBell potential.  

- Review our programs and apply for up to 3 roles ONLY.  

- Complete your video interview within 72 hours.  

- If selected, you may be invited to complete a phone interview or technical assessment to better understand your skills and experience.  

- If selected further, you will be invited to a virtual panel interview.  

 Get started by clicking Apply on this page. Submit a resume, and most recent transcripts (unofficial accepted) to be considered.  

 * Offers will be made to qualified candidates ongoing from September 2026 to November 2026 or until all positions are filled.  

 Please apply directly online to be considered for this role. Applications through email will not be accepted.

 Be at the forefront of shaping the best digital connections and next-generation technology in Canada. You’ll join the largest, award-winning, high-tech team in our country, working with the brightest minds across many industries.   

 Bring your ideas and skills as we grow cutting-edge fibre and 5G networks, develop advanced products and services to run on these networks and then enable the delivery of content from our top media properties and services – ensuring that our customers can stay entertained and connected anytime, anywhere.  
 Summary 

 The Applied AI and Operational support's Transformation & Training team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, Training Program Management to lead the evolution of learning programs that enable employee performance, productivity, and operational readiness.  
 As the Senior Manager, Training Program Management, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the training strategy, ensuring our programs evolve alongside changing business priorities, technologies, and workforce needs. You will lead a team responsible for delivering impactful and scalable learning solutions while partnering closely with Operations, business leaders, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for national training programs across support agents, BTS technicians and field operations technicians.  

 Key Responsibilities 

 •    Training Strategy & Leadership: Lead the development and execution of training strategies and programs aligned with organizational priorities, operational requirements, and evolving workforce capabilities. 
 •    Program Management & Governance: Oversee the end-to-end training portfolio, from needs identification and prioritization through development, deployment, measurement, and continuous improvement. 
 •    Business & Operational Partnership: Build strong relationships with Operations, leadership teams, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners to understand business needs and translate them into effective learning solutions. 
 •    Workforce Readiness: Ensure employees have the knowledge, skills, and resources required to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, products, and ways of working. 
 •    Learning Innovation & Transformation: Champion new approaches to learning, including digital learning, automation, AI-enabled solutions, immersive learning, and other emerging technologies that improve effectiveness and scalability. 
 •    Learning Experience & Content Evolution: Drive the evolution of training content and delivery methods to create engaging, accessible, relevant, and learner-focused experiences. 
 •    Performance Measurement & Insights: Establish clear measures of training effectiveness, leverage feedback and data to identify opportunities, and demonstrate the impact of learning programs on employee and operational performance. 
 •    Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify processes, optimize training delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase the scalability and efficiency of the training organization. 
 •    Change & Transformation Leadership: Support major organizational and technology transformations by ensuring training strategies are integrated into change and deployment plans and employees are prepared for successful adoption. 
 •    People Leadership: Develop, coach, and lead a high-performing team while fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous development. 
 •    Portfolio Adaptability: Respond to emerging business priorities and evolving operational requirements, adjusting resources and training programs to ensure the organization remains agile and responsive. 

 Critical Qualifications 

 •    Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Education, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Communications, Technology, or a related field. 
 •    Demonstrated experience leading complex training programs or portfolios in a large organization. 
 •    Experience managing and developing teams, including employees working across multiple locations or in virtual/hybrid environments. 
 •    Experience supporting large-scale operational, technology, or organizational transformation or process improvement initiatives is considered a strong asset. 
 •    Experience working in an operational, technical, telecommunications, or field-services environment is considered an asset. 

 Technical Qualifications 

 •    Strong program and project management capabilities, including planning, prioritization, risk management, execution, and performance tracking. 
 •    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and collaboration tools. 
 •    Strong proficiency and understanding of AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, and the ability to identify and implement practical use cases. 
 •    Experience leveraging data, analytics, dashboards, and employee feedback to measure learning effectiveness and inform decisions. 
 •    Experience with Learning Management Systems, digital learning platforms, content development tools, or similar learning technologies is considered an asset. 
 •    Experience with automation, immersive learning, or other emerging learning technologies is considered an asset. 

 Leadership 

 •    Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
•    Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
•    Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence across functions and leadership levels.
•    Ability to translate complex operational and technical requirements into clear learning strategies and solutions.
•    Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
•    Passion for innovation, employee development, and creating meaningful learning experiences.
•    Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, transformation, and organizational change.
•    Experience coaching, developing, and inspiring high-performing teams.

 On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks. 

 At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments. 

 Summary 

 Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan. 

 As Program Director , you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.    

 Key Responsibilities 

- Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites. 

- Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.

- Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.  

- Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery. 

- Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight. 

- Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls. 

- Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales  

- Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.  

- Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners. 

 Critical Qualifications 

- 15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred) 

- Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management. 

- Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.  

- Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover. 

- Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners. 

- Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting. 

- Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders. 

- Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage. 

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; PMP/PgMP, P.Eng., or equivalent strongly preferred. 

- Willingness to travel nationally between build locations as the portfolio scales.

greenhouse:block:5369959008.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

 The Role 

 You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

 As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

 You Will 

- Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.

- Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.

- Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.

- Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.

- Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.

- Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.

- Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.

- Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.

- Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.

- Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.

- Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.

- Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

 You Have 

- 5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.

- Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.

- Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.

- Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.

- Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.

- Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.

- Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.

- Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

 Preferred Experience 

- Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.

- Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.

- Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.

- Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.

- Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.

- Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.

- Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

Technology 

 The Director & Business Architect, Investment Management provides strategic business leadership for the Portfolio Management workstream within BMO’s Wealth Technology Transformation Program. The role defines and advances the future-state capabilities, target operating model, processes and technology requirements supporting BMO Wealth’s full-service brokerage, self-directed brokerage and private investment counsel businesses. 
 Key Accountabilities  
 Strategic Business Architecture & Future-State Design  

- Define the scope, vision and future-state architecture for the Portfolio Management workstream, including business capabilities, operating models, processes and experiences. 

- Develop and maintain the business architecture roadmap, aligning strategic objectives with program priorities and delivery. 
 Business Transformation & Delivery  

- Translate the target-state architecture into prioritized business requirements and implementation plans across the Portfolio Management workstream. 

- Challenge existing approaches, introduce industry-leading practices and drive timely decisions across stakeholder groups. 

- Balance transformation priorities with operational and delivery commitments. 
 Portfolio Management Subject-Matter Leadership  

- Act as the senior business authority for portfolio-management capabilities, processes and operating models. 

- Apply industry, competitive and investment-management expertise to evaluate proposed capabilities and guide business decisions. 

- Ensure future-state solutions reflect portfolio-construction practices, managed-account trends and advisor and client needs. 
 Cross-Pod Integration & Stakeholder Leadership  

- Partner with leaders across the Program and the broader organization to manage dependencies and deliver integrated end-to-end solutions. 

- Coordinate across Investment Management, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Product, Client Experience and other stakeholder groups. 

- Influence senior stakeholders, build consensus and resolve competing priorities. 

- Lead workshops, design sessions and “Day in the Life” validation exercises. 

- Translate complex information into clear recommendations and executive-level decision materials. 
 Governance, Risk & Regulatory Oversight  

- Embed regulatory, compliance, risk, governance, audit and operational-resilience requirements in future-state design. 

- Support the design of controls across Portfolio Management, Performance Measurement, Fees, IPS and Risk Assessment processes. 

- Identify business risks and recommend mitigation strategies throughout design and implementation. 
 Qualifications  
 Education  

- University degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Commerce or a related discipline. 

- MBA, CFA Charterholder or CIM designation considered an asset. 
 Experience  

- Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in private wealth, investment or portfolio management, business architecture, product management, consulting or business transformation. 

- Firsthand experience leading a team or function responsible for end-to-end investment solutions for HNW/UHNW clients. 

- Experience leading large-scale transformation or platform-modernization initiatives in a regulated, risk-sensitive environment. 

- Working knowledge of wealth-management operations, including SMA/UMA centralized trading and Advisor-as-Portfolio-Manager programs. 

- Experience working with technology delivery teams; familiarity with agile methods, tools and terminology is preferred. 
 Knowledge & Leadership Capabilities  

- Deep understanding of Canadian private wealth, portfolio-management operating models, fees, performance reporting, IPS frameworks and risk-assessment methodologies. 

- Strong business architecture, process-design and requirements-management capabilities. 

- Ability to influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity and drive decisions across complex stakeholder groups. 

- Exceptional analytical, facilitation, communication and presentation skills. 
 Portfolio Management Workstream Scope  
 The Portfolio Management workstream encompasses the managed-account lifecycle, including discretionary and advisor-managed models, IPS management, portfolio customization, asset-allocation models, bulk trading, loose-securities modelling, performance measurement, tax-loss harvesting and client fees.

What you'll do: 

 As a Senior Analytics & BI Developer, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights. You will work across the full analytics lifecycle, partnering with business stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver scalable analytics and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision making across marketing, loyalty, merchandising, and promotional initiatives.
 In this role, you will:

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements, translating business questions into scalable data and visualization solutions.

- Identify, source, and integrate data from multiple enterprise systems to support business intelligence and analytical initiatives.

- Design, develop, and maintain automated data pipelines and curated analytical datasets using SQL, Python/PySpark, and cloud-based analytics platforms.

- Leverage modern analytics technologies such as Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Power BI to build efficient, scalable, and maintainable reporting solutions.

- Design and develop robust data models, semantic models, and reporting datasets that enable trusted, high-performing self-service analytics.

- Apply data modeling best practices, including dimensional modeling, star schema design, fact and dimension structures, and measure governance to support enterprise reporting needs.

- Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualization solutions that provide meaningful insights to business users and leadership teams.

- Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, performance metrics, custom tooltips, drill-through experiences, and other interactive reporting features to enhance analytical capabilities.

- Conduct analysis of campaign, customer, loyalty, sales, and promotional performance to identify trends, opportunities, and business drivers.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality by implementing validation processes, data governance standards, and reporting best practices.

- Communicate complex analytical findings through clear visualizations, presentations, and business-focused storytelling.

- Continuously improve reporting frameworks, data assets, and analytical processes through automation, optimization, and innovation.

   What you bring: 

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.

- 3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics, performance measurement, or a related field.

- Strong SQL skills with experience querying, transforming, and validating large datasets.

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI solutions, including data modeling, DAX development, report design, and dashboard visualization.

- Strong understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, fact and dimension tables, star schema design, and semantic model development for Power BI.

- Experience developing automated data pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, or similar technologies.

- Experience working with cloud-based analytics and data engineering platforms.

- Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or similar modern analytics platforms is highly desirable.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:

- Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

- Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs

The Business Analyst, Real Estate and Construction Data is responsible for translating complex construction and financial forecasting data into clear, actionable insights while supporting the administration, testing, and continuous improvement of Lucernex and related business systems. This role bridges data, finance, operations, and technology by explaining forecast drivers, variances, risks, and assumptions; maintaining system access, roles, workflows, configurations, and data integrity; coordinating the onboarding and ongoing support of internal and external Lucernex users; and supporting system enhancements through requirements gathering, testing, issue resolution, documentation, and user training. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and analytical problem-solver with system administration experience and working knowledge of SQL and JavaScript, capable of using AI-enabled tools and Microsoft technologies to improve system functionality, strengthen forecast accuracy, automate processes, and clearly explain the rationale behind the numbers.

 What You’ll Do: 
 Forecasting Insights & Analysis 

- Interpret and synthesize construction and financial forecasting data, including cost, revenue, cash flow, productivity, and schedule impacts.

- Identify forecast drivers, trends, risks, and variances, and clearly explain their implications to non-technical audiences.

- Support short-term and long-range forecasting cycles, ensuring assumptions are well-documented and understood.

- Partner with estimating and project teams to validate inputs, challenge assumptions, and close forecasting gaps.

 Data Storytelling & Communication 

- Translate complex datasets into concise narratives, dashboards, and executive-ready materials.

- Prepare clear explanations for forecast changes, gaps, and anomalies, including root-cause analysis.

- Present insights to finance, construction leadership, and senior management with confidence and clarity.

- Proactively surface insights and recommendations rather than simply reporting results.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

- Collaborate closely with Finance, Construction, and Estimating teams to align forecasts and assumptions.

- Facilitate discussions to resolve discrepancies between financial and operational forecasts.

- Ensure consistency in forecasting methodologies and definitions across teams.

- AI, Automation & Microsoft Tools

- Leverage AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and other approved solutions, to accelerate analysis and identify trends.

- Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical models using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 tools.

- Automate recurring analyses and reporting processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.

 Lucernex & Systems Administration 

- Use SQL and JavaScript to query data, build reports, and support configuration of workflows

- Routinely monitor data quality and integrity with audits and coordinate coorections with data owners

- Support the onboarding and ongoing assistance of internal and external users in Lucernex, including account setup coordination, access validation, orientation, training, issue resolution, and guidance on Lucernex processes, workflows, and controls.

- Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for Lucernex enhancements, system changes, and new workflows, including developing test scenarios, documenting results, identifying issues, and partnering with stakeholders to validate solutions before implementation.

- Stay current on emerging AI and analytics capabilities and recommend workflow improvements.

 What You’ll Bring: 

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Construction Management, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related field.

- 3-5+ years of experience in financial forecasting, construction analytics, project controls, or a similar analytical role.

- Strong understanding of construction cost drivers, estimating concepts, and financial forecasting principles.

- Working knowledge of SQL and JavaScript

- Experience administering a system or enterprise platform, including onboarding user access, workflow configuration, and testing

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools.

- Experience using AI-enabled analytics tools to support decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience with Lucernex (Accruent) or similar capital project or cost management system, as well as UAT Testing

- Experience in construction, infrastructure, or capital-intensive environment.

- Familiarity with ERP systems, project management platforms, or cost control systems.

- Experience onboarding and supporting external users in systems, including access coordination, user communication, training, and resolution of account, access, or system issues.

- Experience with scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, or long-range planning.

- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive cross-functional alignment.

 Key Competencies 

- Data storytelling and executive communication

- Analytical thinking and problem-solving

- Attention to detail and data integrity

- Cross-functional collaboration

- Forecasting and financial acumen

- Continuous improvement and curiosity

- Responsible and effective use of AI tools

Servicing Delivery Lead 

 About Capital One Canada. 
 For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated. 
 We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking. 
 We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.  
 Are you ready to redefine what’s next? 

 About the Team 
 The Servicing Delivery team operates as the strategic engine behind our customer and internal operations. We function as a versatile, high-impact group of operational leaders and transformation experts deployed across the enterprise—from Customer Resiliency and Fraud to Payments and Customer Service. Our mandate is to architect operational excellence, drive digital modernization, and oversee critical business processes that deliver on our customer promises. 
 As a team, we combine a rigorous analytical approach with the execution power of industry-leading operations. You will be part of a highly fungible, strategic cohort that leads cross-functional process transformations, manages complex vendor ecosystems, and leverages data and AI to build next-generation risk and quality management frameworks. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where you can shape strategy, influence enterprise stakeholders, and drive measurable operational shifts, this team is your catalyst. 

 Your Responsibilities 

- Direct an expansive, hybrid operational ecosystem, including an internal Quality Management Office (QMO), Mailroom operations, and an outsourced Customer Service back-office function. 

- Lead, mentor, and scale a multi-tiered organization comprising direct associates, onshore contractors, and a broad team of Quality Assurance analysts. 

- Cultivate a high-performance culture focused on operational rigor, continuous improvement, and robust talent development. 

- Serve as the primary Process Owner (PcO) for multiple servicing processes, ensuring seamless execution, strict control adherence, and continuous risk mitigation. 

- Oversee core quality assurance and intent monitoring functions utilizing KPI frameworks and advanced data analytics to diagnose process health and prevent breakdowns. 

- Architect and execute a comprehensive modernization roadmap for the QMO organization, actively integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated capabilities into assessment workflows. 

- Continuously re-engineer existing workflows into target-state solutions, reducing manual effort and driving enterprise-wide operational efficiency. 

- Act as a trusted advisor and negotiator across distinct business lines, aligning Servicing Delivery capacity and strategic focus with the broader objectives of the Bank. 

 Basic Qualifications: 

- At least 5 years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, process management, or operational risk management. 

- At least 5 years of experience driving cross-functional strategic initiatives, managing enterprise stakeholders, and influencing senior leadership. 

- At least 3 years of experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams. 

- At least 1 year of experience leveraging data analytics and business intelligence (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Alteryx) to optimize processes, assess risk, or drive strategic decision-making. 

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Proven track record leading digital enablement, workflow automation, or enterprise technology implementations (e.g., SaaS rollout, AI integration). 

- Experience using Lean Six Sigma tools and methodologies to drive continuous improvement and optimize workflows. 

- Experience operating within the Financial Services industry or highly regulated, complex enterprise environments. 

- Experience working in Agile workplace environments. 

- Experience managing outsourced vendor relationships, BPOs, or third-party operations. 

 Working at Capital One. 
 You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.  

- Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory. 

- Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments. 

- Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies. 

 You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

- Simplify Technical Complexity: Translate intricate technical constraints, API contracts, and distributed cloud risks into crisp, executive-ready choices for leadership.

- Operationalize Delivery Excellence: Define and enforce rigorous standards for project intake and delivery estimate accuracy; implement rapid escalation paths for product or business-related roadblocks; and ensure company-wide visibility into an up-to-date, stack-ranked priority list of projects.

njoyn:cgi:J1026-1481.title: Solution Architect, Cybersecurity
njoyn:cgi:J1026-1481.description:
We are looking for a Security Architect (SA) who will report to the Manager of Enterprise & solution architecture. The SA will primarily work in the design and implementation of robust cybersecurity design in order to protect BRP's infrastructure, applications, data, and users from evolving cyber threats. As part of his/her role, the SA will review and understand the risks and impacts of several business initiatives, in order to develop comprehensive security architectures, and guide secure deployment practices while respecting the guiding principles of the Enterprise Architecture within the actual BRP context. Deep exposure on the latest security tooling such XDR, EDR, SIEM, SOAR is a strong asset.
 Responsibilities
 Design advanced endpoint protection strategies, Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), Extended Detection & Response (XDR), endpoint firewall controls, and security coverage for legacy operating systems.
 Define security architecture for proactive threat detection and response capabilities, including Managed Detection and Response (MDR), threat hunting programs, advanced threat intelligence integration, incident management workflows, and Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR).
  Design Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) capabilities to support large scale log collection, cyber analytics, and security monitoring, ensuring integration with XDR platforms, threat intelligence feeds, incident response workflows, and long term log retention strategies.
 Architect solutions that ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and availability, including encryption mechanisms, secure storage practices, access control policies, and endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capabilities, in compliance with data protection regulations.
 Design cloud security architectures covering cloud workload protection (CWPP), cloud security posture management (CSPM), container security, and cloud native application protection platforms (CNAPP), including integration with cloud based MDR and threat hunting services.
 Design solution architecture documents for endpoint, network, infrastructure, cloud, application, identity, OT/IoT, and data security in alignment with BRP goals and industry best practices.
 Define secure Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks, including multi factor authentication (MFA), single sign on (SSO), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and identity threat protection capabilities to safeguard user identities and access points across enterprise and cloud environments.

 Qualifications & Skills
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related study, or equivalent project related experience.
 Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT, with at least seven years in an architecture or senior technical role focusing on security
 Relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCSP,...).
 Experience designing security architectures supporting EDR/XDR platforms, MDR services, threat hunting operations, SIEM analytics platforms, and SOAR driven incident response automation. CrowdStrike exposure is a strong asset 
 Experience contributing to the production and maintenance of architecture patterns related to SIEM, Identity and Access Management, vulnerability management, exposure management, cloud security, endpoint protection, data protection, and application/network/infrastructure security.
 Hands on experience with cloud security platforms and technologies including CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, container security, and integration of enterprise security platforms such as the Microsoft Security Suite.
 Knowledge of Industrial Control Systems (ICS), OT/IoT security architectures, and protection of industrial environments including SCADA, HMI, historian systems, and connected operational assets.
 Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms, advanced detection analytics, and automated incident response workflows into enterprise security monitoring capabilities.
 Ability to align security initiatives with business objectives, balancing risk mitigation with operational feasibility and organizational priorities.
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to lay audiences. Some experience of working with leadership level stakeholders. 
 Ability to communicate with internal and external stakeholders outside of Quebec or unilingual English speaking on a daily basis
