Your future duties and responsibilities:
• Analyze payment transaction data to ensure data integrity and prevent business or technical data leakage.
• Support the analysis, implementation, and enhancement of New Wire payment processing solutions, including domestic and cross-border wire payment workflows.
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to support payment modernization initiatives, including New Wire and ISO 20022 changes.
• Understand application architecture, payment flows, and system dependencies; identify process improvement opportunities.
• Support project planning by contributing to scope, timelines, deliverables, and governance documentation.
• Troubleshoot business and system issues while ensuring business continuity and recovery readiness.
• Ensure system security, data integrity, and compliance with quality standards and best practices.
• Support solution implementation, production readiness, testing, user training, documentation, change management, and post-implementation support.
• Communicate project progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely escalation when required
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:
• 3–7 years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role within banking or financial services.
• Strong experience with payment applications, including wire processing (SWIFT and FED), and knowledge of ISO 20022 standards.
• Experience supporting end-to-end wire payment lifecycles, including payment initiation, validation, routing, exception processing, reconciliation, and settlement activities.
• Strong data analytical skills including SQL.
• Knowledge of reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Jaspersoft, Tableau) is an asset.
• Self-starter with solid interpersonal skills - projecting a uniquely positive customer-service-oriented attitude.
• Ability to work alone and with other members of a team. Must be a team player with exceptional verbal and written communication skills
• Create and maintain thorough, up-to-date, functional and technical systems documentation for projects, design, customization and maintenance actions taken
• Ability to negotiate winning solutions for customers and projects.
• Ability to effectively manage multiple efforts simultaneously and adjust to changes in direction as needed to meet business objective; Make recommendations for system enhancements and changes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong presentation and communications skills.
• Knowledge of project methodologies (SDLC, Agile).
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience within financial services, banking, payments, treasury services, or cash management environments.
• Experience working with payment modernization initiatives and ISO 20022 migration programs.
• Familiarity with reporting, data visualization, and business intelligence solutions.
• Knowledge of cloud-based technologies and modern integration platforms is considered an asset.

Position Description:
We are seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst to support the analysis, design and delivery of digital solutions. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate business needs into functional requirements and designs while supporting solution validation throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Experience with Incident Case Management (ICM) or similar case management solutions is a strong asset.
Your future duties and responsibilities:
• Lead requirements elicitation, analysis and stakeholder workshops.
• Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Create functional designs, mockups, workflows, user flows, reports and/or web service requirements.
• Collaborate with business, development, product and QA teams throughout solution delivery.
• Support Functional Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate solutions against business requirements.
• Support requirements traceability and defect resolution.
• Produce clear business and technical documentation.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:
• 7+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Functional Analysis or a similar software delivery role.
• Strong experience with requirements elicitation, functional analysis and solution design.
• Proven workshop facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
• Experience creating mockups, workflows, user flows and functional documentation.
• Experience defining acceptance criteria and supporting Functional Testing, SIT and UAT.
• Strong written, verbal, presentation and documentation skills.
Assets
• Experience with Incident Case Management (ICM), LaMPSS or similar case management solutions.
• Experience with public sector or citizen-facing digital services.
• Experience working within Agile, Scrum or product delivery teams.
• Experience with usability testing and interpreting user research findings.
• Experience creating SQL-based queries.
• Experience with requirements traceability and defect management.
CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $75,000–$125,000. This role is a future opportunity.

This role is hybrid and requires you to be at our downtown Toronto and/or Client office (Downtown, Toronto) at a minimum 4 days per week subject to change at any time.
Coordinate the IT delivery of a project spanning across various risk functions, compliance, fraud and AML.
You will be responsible for a subset of these projects in a hybrid role primarily as a Project Manager but also a Business Analyst ensuring completeness of integration in each of the functions.
Your future duties and responsibilities:
. Maintain project oversight and governance
. Ensure project compliance to PMO standards and provide project linkage to the Strategy & Performance Management team to meet project/program KPIs and strategic objectives.
. Drive project through full lifecycle from initiation through planning & execution to closure.
. Facilitates risk management, escalating risks, issues, impediments and dependencies.
. Work with IT development teams in each of the functions on the functional delivery
. Project requirements gathering, management and communication and maintenance
. Stakeholder analysis and effort estimation
. Coordinate UAT all new software in isolated systems simulations
. Observe and identify all current and potential gaps and improvement opportunities
. Schedule meetings with stakeholders and business users to provide status updates on projects
. Keep track of schedule and resources and provide timely status updates to the business and the senior management team
Required qualifications to be successful in this role:
Must have:
. University degree and/or equivalent work experience
. Excellent business communication and stakeholder management skills
. Broad knowledge of Investment banking environments
. Strong organizational, project management and time management capabilities.
. 8+ years if strong understanding of technology and/or financial services industry.
. Scrum and/or PMP
. Experience of managing large projects across multiple user groups
. Prior background in requirements analysis and/ or hands on development will be a big plus
Nice to have:
. Requirements elicitation techniques such as Document analysis, Interviews, facilitated workshops, observation, prototyping, focus groups, surveys
. MS Office Suite, Jira, Confluence, Tableau,
. Requirements analysis and documentation
. Requirements management and communication"

workday:cibc/search:2613585.title: Agile Coach
workday:cibc/search:2613585.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients. 

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What you’ll be doing 

 As a member of the Enterprise Capabilities and Organizational Agility team, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we deliver value at CIBC by championing agile principles and practices. As an Agile Coach, you’ll empower leaders and teams through guidance and mentorship, fostering a culture rooted in agility, continuous improvement, and client-centricity. You’ll work to address organizational challenges and drive meaningful change, accelerating business agility and the achievement of strategic objectives.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you’ll succeed 

- Coach and Empower Teams – Provide expert coaching and mentorship to Squads, Crews, and senior stakeholders on advanced agile principles and practices. Influence leaders to build empowered, high-performing teams and embed agile mindsets across the organization.

- Champion Continuous Improvement – Advocate for data-driven decision-making, prioritization frameworks, and ongoing refinement of processes to achieve sustained enhancements in agile delivery and business outcomes.

- Remove Barriers and Foster Collaboration – Identify and address systemic challenges that hinder business agility and effective delivery. Promote cross-functional collaboration to enhance agile capabilities and support enterprise-wide scalability.

- Partner and collaborate – Work closely with leadership, stakeholders, and Product Owners to drive culture change, embed agility, and improve delivery of valuable outcomes. This includes supporting them to manage roadmaps, create resource plans, and facilitate agile ceremonies. Cultivate strong relationships with internal and external partners to advance agile adoption.

 Who you are 

- Agile/Adaptable- You embrace and advocate for change. You continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.

- Technical skills- You have deep expertise in agile coaching, organizational change, and business agility, with a demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior stakeholders, as well as advanced facilitation, mentoring, and advisory skills. You possess proven experience with agile techniques and frameworks such as User Stories, Sprints, Continuous Integration, and Testing, as well as other agile approaches including XP, Kanban, and Design Thinking. You are skilled at introducing these practices to the appropriate teams at the optimal time. You are experienced with agile tools (i.e., Jira, Confluence).

- Certified Professional - It would be an asset if you hold certifications such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or PMI-ACP highlighting your expertise and commitment to agile coaching.

- You give meaning to data . You enjoy investigating complex problems and making sense of information. You communicate detailed information in a meaningful way.

- You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one.

- You’re outcome oriented . You’re motivated by accomplishing desired outcomes and developing actions plans to do so. You track progress to help inform next actions.

- Values matter to you . You bring your real self to work and you live our values—trust, teamwork, and accountability.

 What CIBC Offers 

 At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

- We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

- Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

- We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

 *Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

 What you need to know 

- CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com 

- CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

- You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.

- We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency). 

- We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us. 

 Job Location 
Toronto-81 Bay, 5th Floor 
 Employment Type 
Regular 
 Weekly Hours 
37.5

Agile Adoption, Agile Learning, Agile Management, Agile Team Practices, Continuous Improvement, Critical Thinking, Data-Driven Decision Making, Enterprise Agile Coaching, Prioritization, Results-Oriented, Scrum, Systems Thinking

greenhouse:clutch:6212017004.title: Senior Data Analyst
greenhouse:clutch:6212017004.description:
About Clutch: 

 Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

 Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

 About the Role 

 At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

 As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

 This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

 What you'll do: 

- Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.

- Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.

- Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.

- Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.

- Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.

- Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.

- Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.

- Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.

- Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

- Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.

- Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.

 What we're looking for: 

 Must Haves 

- 5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).

- Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.

- A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.

- Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.

- Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.

- Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.

- A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.

- A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.

 Nice to Have 

- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.

- Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.

- Python or another coding language.

- Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.

 Why you'll love it at Clutch: 

- Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.

- Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.

- Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.

- We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.

- Above market health & dental benefits.

 Employment Type: 

- New, Permanent Full-Time

- Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

 Compensation & Benefits: 

- Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000

- Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)

- Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

About Coursera + Udemy 

 Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our  blog .

 Why join us now? 

 AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

 Shape what comes next 

 By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

 Location:

We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

 About this role: 

 The Global Skills & Credentials organization is seeking a Senior Content Business Analyst to strengthen how we evaluate and improve the performance of our educational content. In this role, you’ll transform complex data into clear insights and strategic recommendations that inform executive decision-making and contribute directly to the growth and efficiency of our content portfolio. You’ll partner closely with finance, data science, data engineering, revenue operations, content strategy, and other cross-functional teams to analyze performance at both the individual course and portfolio levels. The best candidates are analytical, resourceful problem-solvers who can uncover meaningful trends, resolve complex data challenges, and communicate a compelling story that drives action.

 About your skills: 

- Business Analytics:  Translating complex content, learner, operational, and financial data into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.

- Performance Measurement:  Developing and monitoring meaningful KPIs that accurately reflect content performance, learner engagement, and progress against company-level objectives.

- Executive Storytelling:  Turning data and trends into polished, compelling presentations that enable cross-functional and executive audiences to make informed decisions.

 What you’ll be doing: 

- Use advanced content analytics to answer critical business questions and guide strategic decisions related to content performance, learner engagement, and portfolio growth.

- Develop, implement, and monitor detailed KPIs that accurately reflect the health and effectiveness of our courses, credentials, and programs in support of company-level OKRs.

- Investigate and resolve legacy data challenges to unlock new analyses, reporting capabilities, and deeper views of content performance.

- Partner closely with finance, content strategy, revenue operations, data science, data engineering, and other cross-functional teams to connect data insights with financial and operational priorities.

- Leverage generative AI tools to automate and improve data analysis processes, making reporting and insight generation more efficient and effective.

- Build polished presentations and clear storylines that explain trends, surface opportunities, and inspire action across large cross-functional teams and executive audiences.

- Manage multiple analytical initiatives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy, clarity, and strong stakeholder alignment.

 Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of experience in business analysis, analytics, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or education-focused environment.

- Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools.

- Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Experience using generative AI technologies to improve or automate data analysis processes.

- Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as finance, strategy, operations, data science, or data engineering.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

- Experience with business intelligence tools, Salesforce, spreadsheets, statistical software, and SQL.

 Preferred Qualifications:  

- Experience in educational technology or a related field.

- Advanced degree in business, analytics, or a related field.

 Compensation:  

 Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is $96,000-$120,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As a Senior Business Analyst, TFM Risk & Total Fund Management, you will play a key role in supporting technology initiatives that enable effective portfolio management and rebalancing processes at CPP Investments.

You will partner with investment professionals, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate complex business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions. Leveraging your understanding of investment processes, analytical expertise, and technology knowledge, you will help enhance operational efficiency, strengthen business processes, and support the delivery of technology solutions aligned with investment objectives. 

 The Team 

 The Total Fund Management Technology team supports the enterprise-level investment structure and processes used to manage CPP Investments’ Total Portfolio. Within the team, Portfolio Management Engineering builds platforms and analytical capabilities that enable portfolio construction, monitoring, and decision-making at scale, working closely with investment professionals, Risk, Operations, Product Managers, and peer Technology teams.

 The Senior Business Analyst will support technology initiatives related to portfolio management and rebalancing, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to enhance investment processes and systems.

 Accountabilities 

- Lead requirements gathering sessions with investment professionals and business stakeholders, translating business needs into clear functional requirements and system specifications.

- Apply knowledge of portfolio management and rebalancing concepts to analyze business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and support technology solutions.

- Collaborate with technology teams and subject matter experts to evaluate solution alternatives and recommend approaches aligned with business requirements.

- Facilitate process design workshops, document current- and future-state workflows, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology.

- Conduct process walkthroughs and validation sessions, documenting key risks, mitigating controls, performance measures, and business continuity considerations.

- Investigate business and system issues, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement practical solutions.

- Maintain comprehensive requirements, functional specifications, and project documentation, providing clear updates on deliverables, risks, issues, and progress to stakeholders.

 What You Bring

D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. 

 New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

 D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

 D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

 Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

 About this Role:  

 As a D2L  Solutions Engineer , you'll spend every day helping those around you get the most out of D2L products and services. You'll help prospective clients and educators by l earning about their unique needs and proposing solution s including D2L products and services to meet those needs. Your passion for teaching and learning makes people want to  open up  to you, and your expertise in learning technology and how to accomplish nearly anything using the D2L platform makes you a trusted advisor. You're excited to speak to everyone from students and instructors to a CIO, Professors, Vice Chancellors or Chancellors, and your demos and presentations provoke gasps of amazement, if not outright applause.     

 How You'll Make an Impact: 

- Be come a hands-on expert in the Brightspace platform. You won’t just need theoretical knowledge of how things work, but you will be expected to try things out and make sure they work in practice. You will need to get creative and sometimes approach and re-approach a solution until you find the right fit .     

- Support the sales process by becoming an expert in D2L products and services, including functionality, usage, architecture, and deployment.   

- Prepare and present persuasive and expertly tailored product demonstrations before a wide variety of audiences and under challenging circumstances. Audiences could be new or seasoned users, executives at a conference table, university faculty in a lecture theatre or HR and L&D professionals piled into stadium seating. Needs could be vague or extremely unique, and timelines to prepare can vary .         

- Build compelling, value-oriented presentations while partnering with your sales team to prep for such presentations.     

- Conduct needs analysis sessions with prospects to understand their infrastructure, needs and potential  customizations  they may require .   

- Provide feedback to product management teams regarding use cases and trends in the field .     

- Create technical documentation and materials as required for your prospects .       

- Be the conduit through which internal SMEs are contacted and engaged in sales opportunities .     

- Attend sales presentations, meetings, and conferences as required (travel 25 - 50%) , and be willing to work various hours across North America from PST to EST.         

- Engaging in proposal writing - review requirements , identify optimal product mix, address gaps and assessing competitive alignment, and culminating in the creation of clear, concise responses 

- Work with Customer Success and Account Management teams to help existing customers understand Brightspace features, supported configurations, product behavior, and available workarounds.   

- Provide focused product demonstrations, feature guidance, and adoption support when customers need more expertise than the Customer Success team can provide.   

- Help customers adopt Brightspace through webinars, office hours, reusable demonstrations, adoption campaigns, and other customer-facing resources.   

- Review requests involving system architecture, integrations, reporting, automation, implementation planning, or technical governance, and redirect clients to the appropriate specialists in Professional Services, Support, or Product.   

- Work with internal teams to prioritize, coordinate, and assign customer adoption and technical support requests as distinct activities from presales responsibilities, such as sales presentations and opportunity support. 

 What You'll Bring to the Role:  

- 3+ years' e xperience as a Brightspace user either as an admin istrator or an instructor having used the platform extensively .   

- E xperience in a higher education institution in an edtech role will be advantageous .       

- C omfort with other learning management systems and other learning platforms that might integrate with the LMS.     

- Have a deep interest in educatio n a nd educational technology including familiarity with technology ecosystem and the LMS.     

- Must be very comfortable with presenting complex education and technology concepts to a variety of stakeholders .     

- Be highly engaging in person and virtually .       

- Must have excellent writing and comprehension skill s.   

- Be  able to work remotely in a professional manner.   

- Attend sales presentations, meetings, and conferences as required (travel 25-50%), and be willing to work various hours across North America from PST to EST.      

- Experience meeting multiple objectives in an entrepreneurial environment with minimal supervision .

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.




We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.




So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.




THE ADVENTURE AHEAD 🚀

As a Data Analyst within the Product Engineering family, you will hold the keys to transforming raw information into the strategic compass that guides our entire organization. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics, your mission is to leverage company-wide data to generate actionable insights and build beautiful visualizations that enhance performance across the business. You will act as a critical collaborator with the Data team, serving as a vital contributor to our core data-driven decision-making processes while ensuring the ultimate accuracy and reliability of our data. 

We are looking for an analytical thinker who goes beyond simple request fulfillment—someone who actively interprets data, challenges assumptions, and turns complex datasets into compelling, actionable business insights that drive real-world impact.




THE DAY-TO-DAY 📈

 - Decode the Data: Manipulate and analyze various complex datasets to uncover actionable insights and support key business decisions across the company.

 - Architect the Visuals: Design and deploy interactive dashboards using advanced data visualization tools to clearly visualize data and track performance metrics.

 - Bridge the Teams: Partner closely with the Data team and cross-functional teams across the organization to deeply understand business requirements and deliver tailored analytical solutions.

 - Predict the Future: Conduct advanced analytics, including predictive modeling, correlation analysis, and statistical evaluations to identify upcoming trends and strategic opportunities.

 - Guard the Governance: Implement rigorous data validation and governance processes to maintain the absolute highest standards of data accuracy and reliability.

 - Streamline and Automate: Reverse engineer data requirements to help Data Engineers streamline and automate data collection, processing, and reporting to improve efficiency and scalability.

 - Champion Clarity: Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations to improve business strategies, delivering findings through effective verbal and written communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Master the Databases: Query and manage databases with precision, utilizing tools and languages like SQL and Snowflake to extract and manipulate data for analysis.

 - Optimize the Engine: Continuously refine and improve reporting systems and workflows to align seamlessly with evolving business needs
   
   


YOUR SUPERPOWERS ⚡

 - The Data Track Record: 3+ years of proven experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or reporting, showing a passion for solving business problems through data.

 - The Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Business, Math, Statistics, or a related field.

 - The Tech Toolkit: Strong SQL and Python skills, with a proficiency in data visualization tools and their advanced functionalities (experience with Snowflake is a big plus!).

 - Data Modeling Familiarity: Comfort and working knowledge with basic data modeling concepts (e.g., star schemas, fact vs. dimension tables) to effectively consume and structure data for reporting and analytics.

 - The Math Magician: Deep expertise in statistical analysis, data pivots, predictive modeling, and designing scalable data solutions.

 - The Detail Detective: High attention to detail, a detail-oriented mindset, and an unyielding commitment to maintaining data accuracy and quality.

 - The Proactive Collaborator: A self-motivated, proactive individual with a collaborative mindset who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is driven by process improvement and innovation.

 - The Master Communicator: Strong communication skills with a proven ability to deliver analytical insights effectively to diverse, cross-functional audiences.




OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.




OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

 - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
   




OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍

 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

 - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

 - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

 - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

 - Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.




ABOUT DOCEBO 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO https://www.docebo.inc/home/default.aspx), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. ashby:Dominion Dynamics:a3423449-5432-4e.description:
Reports to: ACP Program Manager

Type: Full-Time


THE ROLE

You own the engineering scope, schedule, development cost and risk for the ACP aircraft as a whole. Not a single subsystem. The vehicle. Every discipline building it, Aerodynamics, Structures, Avionics, GNC, Propulsion, Mission Systems, Autonomy, resolves its trades against the baseline you hold, and you're technically fluent enough to monitor that resolution yourself, not just track it on a schedule someone else built.

You carry the program the full distance: concept, requirements, design, integration, ground test, flight test. When a design decision creates a conflict between two disciplines, or the schedule and the physics disagree, you ensure the right decision maker is on it, and quickly. When the Program Manager needs a straight answer on where the engineering effort stands, that answer comes from you and it has to be right. Things have to move at the right pace, and that pace is on you.

You work closely alongside the ACP Program Manager, who carries the business case, partnerships, procurement and manufacturing strategy, and the customer relationship. Your job is the engineering effort behind the aircraft: the disciplines, the baseline, the integration, and the pace. The Program Manager tracks the development program as a whole and needs a reliable read from you on scope, schedule, cost and risk to do it.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Hold accountability for the engineering scope, schedule and development cost of the ACP aircraft against the baseline set by the Program Manager. Technical decision authority lies with your peers, but you own scope, schedule and costs.

 - Maintain the integrated program schedule and risk register, and ensure the resolution of conflicts between disciplines before they become schedule risks.

 - Define scope of work and timeline across Aerodynamics, Structures, Avionics, GNC, Propulsion, Mission Systems and Autonomy as the accountable leader, not just a coordinator relaying status.

 - Carry the program from concept and requirements through integration, ground test, and flight test.

 - Ensure that the technical teams complete the configuration and program reviews (SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR) and build the data packages that go with them.

 - Manage the technical execution of engineering subcontracts and development partner statements of work once they are in place: scope, schedule and deliverables.

 - Give the ACP Program Manager a reliable read on engineering scope, schedule, cost and risk, and provide the inputs the Program Manager uses for customer (CAF) and DD management reporting. Represent the engineering baseline at technical reviews with customer engineering staff when asked.

 - Provide engineering inputs to the Program Manager's manufacturing, procurement and partnership plans, including design-for-manufacture and supplier technical requirements.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 10+ years progressing complex technical programs in aerospace or defence, with real authority over scope, schedule, and cost.

 - Technically fluent enough to monitor engineering trades across multiple disciplines for completeness.

 - Experience carrying a program the full lifecycle: concept through flight test or fielding.

 - Experience briefing status, risk and trade-offs to senior internal leadership and to customer technical staff at design reviews.

 - Degree in Engineering.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with an Integrated Master Schedule and standard PM tooling (MS Project, JIRA, Confluence, or Smartsheet).

 - Background on an uncrewed or autonomous aircraft program specifically.

 - Supplier and technology-partner management experience on a flight hardware program.

 - PMP or equivalent program management certification.

 - Exposure to RCAF, DND, or NATO airworthiness pathways for uncrewed systems.

No defence background required.

We've hired people who didn't tick every box. If this is the work you want to do, please apply anyway.

 


WHY JOIN US

Building something meaningful starts with the right people.

At Dominion Dynamics, you’ll:

 - Shape Canada’s future by building real defence capability for the CAF and our allies.

 - Make decisions that ship in a high-trust environment with short feedback loops and rapid iteration.

 - Move fast, field faster, and work directly with the operator — our systems are in the field with the CAF now.

 - Have an impact from day one with equity, responsibility, and direct access to leadership.

If you’re curious, hands-on, and driven by the opportunity to make a difference, this is where you belong!

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary and company equity*

 - Comprehensive health benefits

 - Additional equity granted based on impact*

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada.

*Equity awarded to full time employees only.

We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. 

 For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

 Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

 The Engineering Program Manager leads cross-functional delivery of assigned product development programs, including new product introductions, technology integration, product improvements, cost reduction, and lifecycle initiatives.  

 This role is accountable for managing assigned programs end-to-end, translating defined product and business objectives into executable delivery plans and maintaining clear visibility to schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, scope, and program health. The Program Manager independently drives day-to-day execution and ensures blockers are escalated with the context and recommendations needed to maintain forward progress.  

 This position works closely with product management, engineering, service, manufacturing operations, supply chain, marketing, quality, finance, and other cross-functional partners. Success in this role is measured by predictable execution, proactive risk and dependency management, strong stakeholder relationships, accurate program visibility, and ownership of program outcomes.  

 Essential Duties & Responsibilities:   

- Own end-to-end delivery of assigned programs through planning, execution, launch readiness, and closeout.   

- Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated program plans covering scope, schedules, milestones, actions, risks, dependencies, and key decision points.   

- Translate defined program goals and business objectives into executable program activities and milestones.   

- Identify scope ambiguity, customer requirements, and emerging scope concerns and ensure they are surfaced to the appropriate decision-makers.   

- Apply Generac NPD processes and lead required program activities, reviews, and deliverables.   

- Identify blockers early, clarify ownership, and escalate issues with appropriate context and a recommended path forward.   

- Actively manage program risks and dependencies before they become execution issues.   

- Lead cross-functional program meetings with clear objectives, decisions, actions, owners, and follow-up.   

- Collaborate with engineering teams using working knowledge of hardware, firmware, software, BOMs, subsystems, and development milestones to accurately understand program status and identify when work is off track.   

- Execute established change management plans, communicate program changes clearly to affected stakeholders, and flag changes requiring broader alignment or review.   

- Contribute to improvements in PgM practices, planning, dependency management, and support adoption within assigned programs.   

 Minimal Qualifications:   

- Bachelor's degree; 

- 7+ years of relevant professional experience, 

- 5+ years of program management experience leading cross-functional teams through end-to-end delivery.   

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.   

 Preferred Qualifications:   

- Experience managing new product development programs using phase-gate (or similar) development processes.   

- Experience working across hardware, firmware, software, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and quality functions.   

- Experience with industrial, commercial, connected, or other integrated hardware products.   

- PMP or equivalent training or certification with practical application.   

- Experience working with global teams, suppliers, or distributed development organizations.   

 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:   

- Ability to independently manage a program from planning through launch.   

- Ability to understand program goals and connect execution decisions to business and customer outcomes.   

- Strong schedule, action, risk, and dependency management skills.   

- Ability to recognize scope ambiguity and surface concerns before they become delivery problems.   

- Working knowledge of hardware, firmware, and software development processes.   

- Ability to lead effective cross-functional meetings and drive actions to closure.   

- Ability to influence teams without direct authority while maintaining trust and productive relationships.   

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to technical and non-technical audiences.   

- Strong ownership mindset and willingness to take responsibility for commitments and outcomes.  

 Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting; close vision and ability to adjust focus. Occasional travel.  

 Generac is committed to fair and equity compensation practices. The salary range for this role based in Waukesha, WI is $110,300 - $143,400. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible, spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, eight paid holidays in 401(k) retirement benefits.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting
Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.
What you'll do on our team:
Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.
What we're looking for:
A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

 An overview of this role 

 We're looking for an experienced Sr Manager, Technical Program Management to lead a team of TPMs in our Engineering org. Our R&D PMO is a new team within GitLab Engineering, so this is a great opportunity to help build out a new function and define the future of Program Management at GitLab.

This individual will be responsible for leading a team of TPMs of varying levels, all working on different areas of the Product. The Sr. Manager, Technical Program Management will work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure that TPMs are assigned to high priority programs and that they are successfully delivering results for customers. In addition to managing a team, this leadership position will also contribute to the long-term operational success of the R&D organization by partnering with leaders to develop new planning cadences and other improvements to our ways of working.

 What You’ll Do   

- Responsible for directly GitLab team members performing in the role of Technical Program Manager. Lead and mentor a team of Technical Program Managers, including providing regular feedback to foster their growth and ensure their success.

- Responsible for staffing requirements for the PMO, in partnership with the Director of Technical Program Management and the Product and engineering Leadership groups. Align TPM team resourcing / assignments with the company’s business objectives.

- Create and maintain program management standards for elements including program documentation, project plans, status reports, post-mortems as well as a team direction north star; work to continuously improve and iterate on these processes.

- Create and maintain a long-term strategy and vision for the Program Management function, in alignment with broader company goals. Develop and expand upon the job family, CDF, and long-term hiring and growth objectives for the Technical Program Management function.

- Build strong relationships  with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Security, and GTM teams.

- Identify and mitigate risks, resolve conflicts, and remove obstacles for the Technical Program Management team to ensure timely program delivery.

- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for programs and team members and hold the team accountable for meeting commitments.

- Lead strategic planning with direct influence over staffing decisions, project timelines, and planning stakeholders.

- Demonstrate leadership as expected of Managers across GitLab and Embody our CREDIT values in your work

 What You’ll Bring  

- Prior experience as a people manager and as an IC TPM, ideally in a position of seniority

- Ability to prioritize and delegate work effectively

- Proven track record of successful collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

- Experience developing and executing on strategic team development plans 

- Ability to coach others on driving cross functional product-driven initiatives, without direct control of the programs

- Proven ability to position oneself and the team as trusted partners and thought leaders

- More information about the Sr Manager Job Family is available in our handbook .

 About the team 

 Our Technical Program Management function is relatively new to GitLab; we are building out a PMO that is centralized within Engineering and looking for strong TPMs that are interested in developing a newly formed PMO and standardizing on best practices for the business. You can learn more about the PMO in our handbook page. 
 How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off  

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave  

 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

 Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also  GitLab’s EEO Policy  and  EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires  accommodation , please let us know during the  recruiting process .

We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 Instacart Business (inclusive of Instacart Health) is scaling fast, and our commercial teams, leadership, and external partners need reliable, high-quality data to keep pace with it. We're hiring a Business Insights Lead to own this end to end — building the reporting infrastructure, analytical frameworks, and insights delivery that turn raw data into decisions. This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and commercial execution: you'll be the go-to analytical partner for internal leadership and the single point of accountability for external partner reporting. A year from now, GTM leaders will trust the numbers, partners will get consistent and timely reporting, and the business will have a repeatable system for surfacing growth opportunities before they're obvious.

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

- A reporting system GTM leaders trust: partner-level insights and dashboards that give every leader timely, accurate visibility into business performance without having to ask for it.

- An external partner reporting program running like clockwork: clear frameworks, reliable delivery cadences, and consistent data quality across every partner-facing output.

- A track record of surfaced opportunities: deep-dive analyses that diagnosed performance gaps and pointed the business toward real, actionable growth across Instacart Business and Health.

- Recurring analytical programs — retention, cohort analysis, pipeline health — running on their own and tracking the metrics that matter most to commercial success.

- A stronger analytics foundation for the business: closed gaps in reporting coverage, scalable self-service tools, and cross-functional partnerships that make the underlying data infrastructure work harder for everyone.

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 This role calls for someone who's equally comfortable building analytical infrastructure and telling the story behind the numbers — an operator who can move from a SQL query to a stakeholder-ready narrative without losing rigor along the way.

 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

- 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or insights, including 2+ years in a B2B, commercial, or GTM-facing context.

- A track record of owning end-to-end reporting programs — from data sourcing and modeling to delivery and stakeholder communication.

- Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one BI/visualization tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Mode).

- Experience building and maintaining recurring, full business-line reports and analytical frameworks at scale.

- Strong communication skills — able to frame analytical findings clearly and influence decision-making across cross-functional partners and leadership.

- Familiarity with sales performance metrics, pipeline tracking, and customer retention frameworks.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve and business context matters as much as technical skill.

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience in a technology, marketplace, or B2B sales environment.

- Familiarity with CRM data (e.g., Salesforce) and how it connects to downstream reporting and analytics.

- Experience building or contributing to external partner-facing reporting programs.

- A track record of turning ambiguous problem statements into clear, scalable analytical outputs.

 The Senior Financial Insights Analyst sits at the center of Instacart's Finance organization, with a mandate to identify and close areas of P&L leakage through rigorous financial and transactional data analysis and compelling narratives that drive action. 

 The team works through invoice challenges with retailers and serves as experts in the broader Instacart financial ecosystem. Invoicing retailers correctly is a key operational responsibility that impacts financial success and builds trust with retailer partners. 

 This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who is relentlessly optimistic, eager to learn, and excited about combining deep financial expertise with AI and automation tools. We are looking for a great team member who helps carry the culture and gets things done in a no-ego way.

 What you'll cook up in your first year

- P&L leakage is identified and closed through rigorous analysis of Instacart's financial and transactional data. 

- AI and automation tools are used to build and maintain alerting capabilities that surface issues in real time.

- An expert-level understanding of Instacart's marketplace data, reporting capabilities, and invoicing processes is developed and applied. Invoice challenges are diagnosed, retailer partnerships are leveraged to resolve them, and financial outcomes improve as a result.

- Complex datasets from multiple systems are connected and analyzed using advanced SQL, Excel or Google Sheets, and Python. Findings are synthesized into clear, visually compelling narratives and presented to internal and external stakeholders via Google Slides or PowerPoint.

- Strong stakeholder relationships are maintained internally and externally. Time is continuously prioritized toward the highest-impact problems, with ambiguous challenges deconstructed into efficient, high-quality approaches to resolution.

- 5+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting supporting commercial deals or growth initiatives in technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, or retail

- Ability to combine insights into an easy to understand, visually appealing story that helps convince retailers to take action

- Ability to connect large data sets from multiple systems and establish real-time alerting capabilities

- Experience with Powerpoint / Google Sides

- Experience writing advanced SQL queries

- Ability to deal with ambiguity; the ability to quickly deconstruct a problem into its most important components, have a good sense of where digging deeper will likely yield results, and coming up with an efficient and high quality approach to solving the problem

 Skills

workday:interac/Interac:REQ-2351.description:
Who We Are: 

 Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives. 

Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.

 As the backbone of Canada’s financial ecosystem, Interac facilitates over 20 million transactions daily, supported by trusted partnerships with government and financial institutions. Consistently ranked as Canada’s most reputable financial technology brand, Interac is deeply embedded in the daily lives of Canadians.

 Who You Will Work With: 
 The vacant Business Systems Analyst role will report to Leader Process and Operational Excellence as part of a team providing operational oversight for the Real Time Rail payments systems. This role requires strong experience working with ServiceNow.

 What You Will Do: 
 Understand business needs 

- Meet with stakeholders to understand problems, objectives, and desired outcomes

- Understand business processes, policies, and controls

 Gather and document requirements 

- Conduct interviews, workshops, and process reviews

- Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements

- Write user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and requirements specifications

 Analyze business processes 

- Map current-state (“as-is”) and design future-state (“to-be”) processes

- Identify gaps, redundancies, manual work, and opportunities for automation

- Recommend process improvements

- Translate between business and IT

- Explain technical concepts to business stakeholders

- Explain business requirements to developers, architects, and technical teams

- Resolve ambiguity ensuring everyone has the same understanding of the requirement

 Define system solutions 

- Help determine how systems should support business processes.

- Evaluate configuration vs. customization vs. new functionality.

 Support development and implementation 

- Clarify requirements for developers

- Review proposed solutions against business requirements.

- Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement and demos

- Help manage scope and requirements changes.

 Testing and quality assurance 

- Develop or review test scenarios and acceptance criteria

- Support system/integration testing and UAT.

- Validate that the delivered solution meets requirements

- Help investigate and resolve defects.

 Stakeholder management 

- Facilitate workshops and decision-making

- Manage conflicting requirements and priorities.

- Obtain stakeholder approval/sign-off.

 Documentation and governance 

- Maintain requirements, process diagrams, decision logs, and system documentation.

 What You Bring: 

- 5+ years of experience working as a Business Systems Analyst on ServiceNow platform.

- ServiceNow Platform related certifications (ITSM, IRM, SIR, VR etc).

- Extensive experience implementing new solutions and integrations on ServiceNow Platform.

- Eligibility to obtain Security Clearance is mandatory for the role. 

- Eligibility to work for Interac Corp. in Canada in a full-time capacity 

 What We’re Offering: 
 The hiring range for this position is $120,000 - $135,000, and you will also be eligible for our short-term incentive plan. The exact amount will depend on factors such as skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, but Interac’s commitment goes beyond compensation. Our Total Rewards package is designed to support your well-being and future, and includes:

- Generous vacation and wellness days to help you recharge

- Comprehensive employer-paid benefits coverage for peace of mind

- Market-leading employer-funded RRSP program to invest in your future

- Flexible hybrid work model for better work-life balance

- Access to a free and confidential 24/7 employee & family assistance program to offer support for you and your immediate family

- Pregnancy and parental leave top-up to support growing families

- Charitable donation matching with United Way to amplify your impact

 At Interac, the impact we make, and the people who drive it, is profound. When you become part of our team, you’re joining a purpose-driven organization that’s shaping the future of digital finance in Canada. Here’s what you can expect:

- Investing in the Future – Help us unlock digital prosperity for all Canadians.

- Innovative Thinking – Collaborate on products, practices, and platforms that redefine what’s possible.

- Inclusive Culture – Be empowered to bring your whole self to work and realize your full potential.

- Inspiring Community – Work in an ecosystem where we lift each other up and rise together.

- Intentional Support – Enjoy flexible, supportive offerings that prioritize your total wellness.

 Additional Pre-Employment Requirements: 

 To ensure the integrity of our organization, successful candidates will be required to complete background checks, which may include, Canadian Criminal Credit Check, Canadian ID Cross-Check, Public Safety Verification, 5-year Employment Verification, Education Verification, Credit Check, and Social Media Check.

 Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe that innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together. That’s why we are committed to providing fair and equitable employment opportunities for all individuals, without discrimination based on race, color, ancestry, ethnic origin, place of origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
