talentbrew:jobs.intuit.com:100723853600.description:
We are hiring for a Senior Operations Growth and Retention Leader in Toronto. This person will own the delivery and the commercial performance of the Customer Success Growth and Retention (G&R) programs for Canada’s QuickBooks platform, and you will set the standard for how G&R work is done across every international market we operate in.

 Canada’s G&R programs are delivered entirely through outsourced (BPO) delivery partners. Customer onboarding and activation, cancellation saves, and sales through service via Product Support contacts all reach the customer through experts (agents) you do not employ, working in sites you do not directly manage. Your job is to make that delivery work. You will take the G&R strategy and roadmap set upstream, convert it into an executable delivery plan, build the BPO partner performance strategy that gets it delivered, and hold the Canada revenue number personally.

 Alongside Canada, you will be the Craft Lead for Growth and Retention across International Service Delivery. Where your delivery accountability is Canada, your craft accountability is international: you will own the operating model, the playbook, the definition of quality, and the calibration for how G&R work is done in every market the function operates in, including markets you do not deliver yourself.

 This is a senior individual contributor role, and it is built for someone who is effective without formal authority. You have no reporting line into the markets you lead on craft, and no line of control into the partner organizations that deliver your business. What you achieve, you will achieve through a standard worth following, evidence, credibility, and influence.

 Intuit has embraced a hybrid working model, and this role will be based out of our Toronto office, 3 days a week.

 Responsibilities 
 Own The Canada Growth and Retention Programs 

- Own the day to day operational delivery of every Canada G&R program, and be personally accountable for performance against onboarding, retention, and sales through service targets

- Translate the G&R strategy and roadmap set at global and market level into a delivery plan with clear sequencing, site-level ownership, milestones, and go or no-go decisions

- Own the leading and lagging indicators that show whether the Canada G&R business is healthy, run the business reviews that interrogate them, and drive corrective action the moment performance moves off target

- Direct the training, knowledge, quality, and calibration requirements for the experts delivering G&R programs, working through partner training functions and internal learning teams

- Own the design and operation of expert incentive programs, and the audit and quality routines that confirm G&R is being executed as designed 

- Provide the G&R input into forecasting, demand planning, and staffing decisions for the Canada business 

- Contribute to the design of experiments, and run them to size expected impact before an initiative is scaled market-wide, and feed delivery evidence and market performance insight back into the upstream strategy and roadmap

 Own Partner Performance For Growth and Retention 

- Define and own the BPO partner performance strategy for G&R in Canada: what good looks like at site level, how it is measured, how it is reviewed, and what happens when it is missed

- Hold outsourced delivery partners to their commitments through the weekly, monthly, and quarterly review cycle, and own the improvement plans that close performance gaps

- Build the operational relationships across partner delivery leadership that let you move performance quickly, without contractual or line authority over the people delivering the work

 Lead the Growth and Retention Craft Across International Service Delivery 

- Own how G&R work is done in every international market: the operating model, the quality standard, what good looks like, and the performance framework, and keep the G&R section of the international Service Delivery playbook current

- Hold one standard of execution across markets. Run the calibration that keeps judgment consistent wherever the work is delivered, act as the escalation point for craft questions, and find divergence between markets and either close it or fold it into the standard 

- Decide directly on changes to how G&R work is executed within this remit, keeping International Service Delivery leadership informed, and seek approval where a change carries material cost, headcount, cross-functional, commercial, or risk implications

- Lead practitioners outside your reporting line through standard, credibility, and influence. You will not direct their day to day work, set their priorities, or own their performance, all of which remain with their line manager

 Influence Across The Business 

- Own cross-functional relationships across Go-to-Market teams, as well as enabling functions within Customer Success such as Data Science and Analytics, needed to build a single, coherent Canada G&R plan

- Present performance, insight, and recommendations to senior Canada and global Customer Success leadership with enough clarity and conviction to drive timely decisions

- Represent Canada in the global Customer Success G&R community, and bring what works elsewhere back into the Canadian business

 Qualifications 
 We are looking for scope of ownership, not just years served. The bar is someone who has already carried a commercial number end to end, delivered it through people they did not manage directly, and set a way of working that others adopted.

- 5+ years of relevant experience in customer success, growth and retention, or commercial operations, ideally in a SaaS or subscription business

- Full personal accountability for a retention, churn, or monetization metric at scale, with a track record of hitting or exceeding it

- Substantial experience delivering commercial outcomes through outsourced or BPO partners, including holding partners to performance without direct authority over them

- Experience setting and holding an operating standard, playbook, or quality framework across multiple markets, and getting practitioners outside your line to adopt it

- Comfortable moving between delivery planning and the operational detail of a live business, and equally comfortable when the picture is incomplete and a decision is still needed

- Operationally rigorous and data-driven, able to read performance quickly and act on it before a miss compounds

- Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and influence senior stakeholders and partner executives

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent experience preferred

 Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits ). ABOUT THE ROLE

We're rebuilding how we manage data and analytics at Jane. Our goal is to establish a trusted data foundation that powers self-service analytics, AI, and consistent business metrics across the company.

This role is great for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguous business questions, and brings a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders to define requirements, validate logic, and deliver high-quality data products that guide critical financial decisions.

At Jane, we value transparency, ownership, and a problem-solving mindset. If you love working with data, care deeply about accuracy, and enjoy partnering with Finance and Payments to drive impact, this role is for you.



THE IMPACT YOU COULD HAVE

 - Partner closely with the Finance and Payments teams to build, refine, and maintain the metrics, models, and dashboards that power Jane’s financial reporting.

 - Own end-to-end analysis: from understanding business questions → writing SQL/dbt models → building Looker dashboards → sharing insights clearly with stakeholders.

 - Develop and optimize Looker dashboards to support financial planning, revenue analysis, cost insights, and transaction-level reporting.

 - Maintain and evolve core financial data models in dbt.

 - Troubleshoot data quality issues, validate calculations, and ensure trusted, reconciled datasets that Finance and Payments can rely on.

 - Work with ambiguous requirements, identify gaps, ask the right questions, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions.

 - Support the modernization of our data architecture by applying our best practices in modeling, documentation, QA, and performance tuning.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Product, Support, and Marketing when financial data intersects or is needed.
   


THE EXPERIENCE WE FEEL WE NEED

 - 5+ years experience as a Data Analyst or BI Analyst in a high-growth or complex product environment.

 - Strong hands-on experience with SQL, dbt, and Looker, able to write complex queries, model data, and build insightful dashboards.

 - Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics and financial logic to non-technical audiences.

 - Ability to take initiative and ownership, work independently, and drive projects from concept to delivery.

 - High attention to detail, especially with reconciliation, financial logic, metric definitions, and QA.

 - Experience working with stakeholders in Finance (FP&A, Accounting, Payments, Revenue Ops).

 - Experience with GitHub/version control.
   


MORE ABOUT JANE

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we’re committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of $100,000 to $156,300. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this https://vimeo.com/880258361 short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here https://jane.app/documents/hiring/jane_benefits_overview.pdf!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app http://jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

ashby:jobber:62a5728b-07dd-4877-b175-a87.description:
Are you passionate about the design and development of analytical assets and interactive BI solutions to help small businesses thrive?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Senior BI engineer to be part of our Data org.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.

We help employees grow professionally; we have a ton of onboarding resources, tutorials, hackathons and buddies to support learnings and provide opportunities to innovate. We have a range of experience levels on teams which allows for mentor/mentee opportunities. Leaders at Jobber work with empathy and support employees to build healthy work-life harmony. Bring your dedication and passion to this job to fulfill your goals.

The team:

The Business Intelligence team is responsible for building core data models, governed semantic layers, and data pipelines necessary for enterprise-level reporting and dashboards. This team also provides data support and governance standards for consumers of core data models, ensuring metrics remain accurate, consistent, and trusted across the company. The team takes queries and requirements from stakeholders and transforms them into scalable data models for the pipeline. This team is on the path to creating a governed, self-serve data environment for Jobberinos and is critical for all strategic business decisions that ultimately support Jobber’s Service Providers (SPs).

The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence, the Senior Business Intelligence Engineer will champion data literacy, governance, and adoption across the business, leading the design and development of analytical data assets, centralized semantic layers, and interactive BI solutions (reports, dashboards, and other business decision tools). This role will support strategic decisions and operational performance monitoring across all functional areas (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Customer Growth & Retention, Product). The purpose of the role is to establish robust data governance and standardized metric definitions so all information stakeholders need is readily available, governed, and easy to consume - driving a trusted, scalable self-service analytics environment.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will

 - Design and develop scalable, efficient data models and governed semantic layers that support business requirements and enable accurate, standardized reporting and analysis.

 - Translate complex SQL queries into scalable data models and reusable semantic models with emphasis in pipeline performance and query optimization

 - Work closely with the Analytics team to model key business metrics in the Data Models for consumption into the semantic layer

 - Create and maintain high-quality enterprise reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

 - Develop and maintain data pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient data transformation, and loading processes.

 - Manage and configure our BI platform, including user access, data governance, performance tuning, and security.

To be successful, you should have:

 - Extensive experience in data architecture and dimensional modeling (star / snowflake schemas), with practical experience or strong familiarity in implementing semantic layers to support self-service analytics.

 - Expert-level SQL programming skills

 - Experience in building and maintaining data pipelines using DBT

 - Proven understanding or experience in data governance practices, including metric standardization, data quality enforcement, and access control.

 - Advanced proficiency in designing and constructing dashboards utilizing data visualization tools like Tableau or equivalent.

 - A solid understanding of complex relational data structures and modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).

 - A passionate champion for data who can drive data literacy, advocate for self-service analytics, and influence business teams to adopt governed data solutions.

 - A proactive and relentless approach to problem solving. You are comfortable seeking information independently, solving conceptual problems, corralling resources and delivering results.

 - A strong and confident communication style. You can listen, empathize and consult with stakeholders actively, and you can take something complex and difficult and make it easy to digest.

 - A sense of comfort in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day - what worked yesterday might not work tomorrow.

Highly desired, but not a dealbreaker:

 - DBT certifications

 - Tableau certifications

 - Data Engineering certifications

Compensation:

At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $125,800 CAD, a midpoint of $147,900 CAD, and a maximum salary of $170,100 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!



We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst, VoC Insights who will own the business strategy, implementation, and enablement of Lightspeed's customer health score program. You sit at the intersection of customer data, CX operations, and commercial decision-making, turning customer health signals into an accurate, robust and consistent view of account risk, retention opportunity, and expansion potential.



What you’ll be doing:

 - Own the strategy and implementation Lightspeed’s customer health score program, from scoring component improvements to segmentation, thresholds, and the playbooks tied to each score state. This includes leading the implementation of health score changes in our CX platform ChurnZero, partnering with key stakeholders on configuration and underlying data models.

 - Build the enablement layer for health scores across GTM, CX Ops, and leadership, including documentation, training, dashboards, and the operating cadence for how scores get reviewed and acted on. Expand the usefulness of health scoring to focus on growth and on enterprise impact beyond GTM (P&T, Finance, etc.)

 - Validate health score/sentiment performance against actual customer outcomes (renewals, churn, expansion, NPS movement) and recalibrate the model as the business evolves.

 - Translate health score/sentiment patterns into business recommendations for leadership across GTM, P&T and Finance stakeholders, with a clear point of view on where to intervene and why.

 - Lead impact analysis on CX initiatives that close customer account health gaps (customer adoption, retention, growth). You lead the analysis to provide definitive, data-backed answers on whether specific operational changes or workflows successfully moved the needle on customer behavior, retention, and LTV.

 - Supporting QBRs and executive readouts with health-score-driven account narratives, and running ad hoc deep dives when leadership needs a fast, defensible read on a cohort, segment, or risk pattern.
   

And a little bit of…

 - Health Score Data Accuracy: Statistical correlation between health score states and actual renewal, churn, and expansion outcomes

 - Enablement & Internal Adoption: % of GTM reps actively using health scores in their account planning, measured through ChurnZero usage

 - Customer Experience Impact: Ability to influence positive changes in customer health, retention and LTV (e.g., % of CX operational pivots, plays, or workflow changes directly attributed to health score insights surfaced)

 - System Utility: The successful "Operationalization" of ChurnZero, measured by the depth and frequency of dashboard usage by CX leadership

 - Time-to-Insight: Leadership analysis requests delivered timely and thoroughly



What you need to bring:

 - 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, CX Strategy, or Ops in a high-growth SaaS environment.

 - Account Health Ownership: Direct experience designing or owning a customer health score program, including input selection, weighting, validation, and rollout

 - Mastery of ChurnZero (or equivalent CS platform): Extensive experience extracting insights from health scores, segments, and adoption models.

 - Analytical Toolset: High proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or Sigma) to supplement native system reporting.

 - Proven Strategic Impact: A track record of turning complex data into clear, executive-level narratives that lead to measurable business outcomes.

 - Collaborative DNA: Experience enabling cross-functional teams, including building documentation, training, and operating rhythms that get adopted.

 - The "Internal Consultant": You are comfortable being handed a vague business problem and returning with a data-driven solution and a suggested plan of action.

 - The Pattern Recognizer: You have a "sixth sense" for the story in the numbers—you can identify feature decay or engagement spikes before they become broader trends.

 - Strong Communicator: You translate technical system metrics into clear, actionable bullet points that a VP or Director can act on immediately.

 - Proactive Problem Solver: You don't just report on the data; you identify where workflows are failing to capture the right data and partner with the team to fix it.

 - Operator's mindset: You care as much about whether the health score or sentiment analysis gets used as whether it is technically correct.

 - Influencer / Trust Builder: GTM agents and executives rely on your numbers because you have shown your work and earned the credibility.

 - Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

Company Description
At Loblaw Digital, we know that our customers expect the best from us. Whether that means building the best, most innovative online shopping experience, or designing an app that will impact the lives of people across the country, we’re up for the challenge. From our office in Downtown Toronto, we’ve created leading eCommerce experiences in the online grocery shopping, beauty, pharmacy, and apparel spaces, and we’re only just getting started.
Job Description
You’ve heard this before: With rapid growth and a laser-focus on shipping, data and insights were capabilities that fell off the priority list. This is natural when you’re focused on building a product, especially with tight timelines and commitments. Fast-forward to today, we’ve grown a lot and created three businesses in three years! We’ve got data in multiple spots - e-commerce platforms; web analytics platforms; order management systems; customer survey platforms and more; but we haven’t tied them together.
Our business teams have made great efforts to gather, cleanse and organize this data in order to gain insights into how our customers are using our products. Naturally this doesn’t scale. We’re at a point in our journey where there’s a focus on organizing our data and getting the cross-system view of what our customers are doing.
To this end, we’re looking for an expert at building and maintaining data pipelines to help expand our BI platform by integrating data from internal and external sources into our Oracle data warehouse as well as feeding other application systems that depend on the data warehouse for reporting and analytics. The successful candidate will also empower our business by training and enabling business users to self-serve data from our platform to drive insights and fact-based analytics.
Responsibilities:
Develop and scale quality and performant data pipelines using our in-house data framework
Build and implement robust data models and structures using dimensional modeling techniques
Be a subject matter expert on the entire stack of our BI framework
Support reporting and analytics needs from all areas of the business. For example: Developers, Product Managers, Product Designers, Merchandizers, Marketers, and Operations Analysts
Help us in our mission to be a hypotheses-driven product development organization which means data is at the centre of everything we do
Be an enabler by showing others how to master the reporting tools available to them, thereby empowering our team and getting us to scale
Qualifications
5+ years of solid hands-on experience with relational databases (e.g. Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, etc.)
2+ years of Python experience building automated data pipelines that source and push data across various application and data systems is a must
Experience with ETL/Data Modelling/Star Schema design and development
Hands-on experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Qlik, Microstrategy, etc.)
Experience working with sourcing and feeding data from REST/SOAP apis (e.g., Omniture, Salesforce, SurveyMonkey, etc.) is nice to have
Experience with data pipeline automation using a code focused scheduling tool (e.g. Rundeck, Airflow, Luigi)
Strong oral and written communication skills
Solid stakeholder management skills
Proven team player that will work well in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
Experience working in an agile environment
Strong desire to learn and to push the boundaries of what can be done to better empower our business with data
How You’ll Succeed:
At Loblaw Digital, we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.
We’re able to keep innovating because our colleagues are passionate about their work and excited about the future of eCommerce.
If you have big ideas, undeniable enthusiasm, and thrive in a collaborative, creative, and diverse group, we’ll get along just fine.
Looking for a challenge? Good. Love an innovative work environment? Even better.
Apply today.

We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the products we sell, the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization. Supply Chain Project Manager
who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating and equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
The Supply Chain Project Manager is responsible for overseeing specific projects within the Global Supply Chain program portfolio. This can include work within complex cross-functional transformations, standing up new go-to-market initiatives, and targeted efforts within specific geographies and locations. The Project Manager will partner with Global Supply Chain leadership to stand up and lead a project within the strategic PMO portfolio across several functions, including work to plan, design, and deliver against the project deliverables and milestones while helping to enable business priorities, including growth, guest service and cost improvements.
a day in the life: what you'll do
Manage a large, medium-to-high complexity project or multiple smaller concurrent projects within a specific Global Supply Chain portfolio and partner with PMO leadership to build detailed project plans, charters, including integration touch points, dependencies, and sequencing
Monitor project performance against plan as measured by milestones, KPIs, and supporting metrics
Provide line-of-sigh to PMO and functional leadership to issues, risks, and required decisions across the project workstreams
Maintain consolidated resource and timeline views across the projects
Collaborate cross-functionally to identify opportunities to reduce costs, drive productivity, better leverage resources, and increase capital efficiency
Work with internal stakeholders to create project charters (scope, objectives, cost, benefits, resourcing, risks) and work plans
Partner with Technology organization to ensure the delivery of defined business capabilities and value within the project scope
Collaborate with and oversee 3rd party partners based on specific project scope of service requirements
Develop presentation content and support executive-level updates and business reviews
Establish, evaluate and maintain performance standards for all areas of project management to ensure performance targets are achieved while continually looking for ways to enhance delivery and reduce costs
Ensure the project team works closely with peers across Global Supply Chain, ensuring alignment and consistency in planning, management, and execution.

Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn't take yourself too seriously.

greenhouse:lyft:8761492002.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Data is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our products and make business decisions. This will involve performing rigorous product deep dives, identifying opportunities for product enhancements, and measuring the impact of product changes.

 The Airports team, within the Driver organization, focuses on the airport marketplace and the unique products designed for this use case. Airports are one of the most important, impactful, and complex parts of Lyft’s Rideshare business, as they are a key part of both the rider and driver Lyft experience and have unique dynamics. As an Analytics Lead on the Airport team, you will collaborate with our team of engineers, product managers, and designers to conduct thorough data deep dives on airport performance, challenge our current strategy, and recommend enhancements to facilitate market growth.

 The ideal candidate can apply strong business acumen to propose product and marketplace changes, and is comfortable working with a highly cross functional team. In this role, you will help us tackle problems such as:

- How should we determine pricing and earnings for airport rides? 

- Who are our current airport drivers and what segment can we focus on to grow our supply? How does this strategy interact with driver bonuses?

- Which airports are underperforming and which key metrics can we use to identify and classify airport performance? What targets should we set for these key metrics and how do we efficiently monitor these metrics?

- What is driving high cancellation rates today and which types of riders/drivers are cancelling?  What product changes can we implement to reduce cancellation rates? 

- How are riders and drivers using different ride modes at airports, and how do we design products to address this behavior? 

 Responsibilities: 

- Leverage data and analytic frameworks to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency, recommending solutions to drive business impact specifically related to pricing and earnings 

- Establish metrics that measure the health of our products, the business, and the rider and driver experiences

- Develop dashboards and analytical frameworks to monitor business and product performance

- Manage, build, and automate models and reporting to provide regional and national teams with actionable insights on volume, efficiency, and rider and driver experiences

- Understand the complex business dynamics at Airports, specifically how Airport products differ from traditional rideshare marketplaces, to propose enhancements that compliment Lyft-wide products

- Partner with product managers, engineers, marketers, designers, and operations to translate data insights into decisions and action

- Present findings, recommendations, and results to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

 Experience:  

- 4-7+ years experience in strategic data science/analytics roles in a technology company, or an equivalent analytical role in a high growth startup

- End-to-end experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization, to provide actionable insights and reusable frameworks

- Proficient in SQL and quantitative analysis - you can deep dive into large amounts of data, draw meaningful insights, dissect business issues and draw actionable conclusions

- Uses SQL in current role

- Experience in leading high visibility projects and influencing others in a cross-functional team environment

- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to craft a compelling story and concisely present recommendations across teams and levels including both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to manage, influence, negotiate, and inspire others in a fast-moving environment

- Strong business and product sense, meaning the ability to understand business issues, think strategically about complex and unstructured business problems, and build decision making frameworks

- Entrepreneurial self-starter - you naturally take ownership, look for opportunities, and do whatever it takes to drive results

 Benefits: 

- Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account

- RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service 

- Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.

- Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

 Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.  Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

 Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

 The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is CAD $102,000 - CAD $127,500, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

 Lyft may use artificial intelligence to screen applicants, however, Lyft employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 The Marketplace team at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business and for delivering our top business/company goals around financial metrics and marketplace performance. The team provides analysis and use cases to support Product teams, build automated tooling, and manage growth investments. 

 We are looking for an analyst to join the Central Market Management team and help us grow our market share.  You will work with cross-functional stakeholders to analyze and improve existing product and financial levers leveraged in the marketplace. You will influence growth strategy with your data analysis and competitive insights while getting a ton of executive exposure along the way.  We’re looking for an intellectually curious individual who has extraordinary attention to detail, a track record of analytical problem-solving and skilled communication.

 Responsibilities: 

- Support marketplace operations to provide world-class analysis, forecasting and reporting to stakeholders.

- Become an expert in marketplace trends and support weekly reporting structures for the Rideshare organization.

- Develop domain-specific subject matter expertise in our lever portfolio and support cross-functional initiatives to improve existing products and develop new ones.

- Analyze marketplace product & financial levers and provide cross-functional teams with actionable insights on improvements and problem areas.

- Operate within Rideshare decision-making frameworks with a critical lens, evaluating areas of improvement and business growth opportunities.

- Prepare regular business reviews for leadership, highlighting key areas of focus.

- Work with stakeholders and other teams to track, report, and reconcile budget allocation across marketplace programs.

- Analyze data, conduct research and synthesize feedback into plans, processes and playbooks.

- Roll up your sleeves and get stuff done. No one can be counted on to execute faster or better than you.

- Identify opportunities and make them happen.

 The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

 We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

 This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

 Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs

- Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives

- Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet

- Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions

- Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data

- Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives

- Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries

- Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics

- Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately

- 4+ years of experience in data or business analytics

- 3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments

- Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically

- Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)

- Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred

- Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis

The Senior Product Manager, Cross Platform Experience will own the horizontal product responsibility for stitching the member experience together across platforms, business units, and channels. This role ensures the end-to-end member journey is coherent, consistent, and scalable at the enterprise level.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 1. Enterprise Member Experience Strategy & Delivery 

- Lead the end-to-end strategy, design, and delivery of a unified member experience across platforms and lines of business.

- Drive initiatives from discovery through launch, measurement, and optimization, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, and aligned with enterprise objectives.

- Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and trade-offs across multiple platforms and stakeholders.

- Maintain alignment with senior leaders on priorities, scope, milestones, and outcomes.

 2. Platform Ecosystem & Partner Management 

- Manage strategic platform and digital health partners, ensuring integrations deliver a seamless and consistent member experience.

- Align partner roadmaps and capabilities with enterprise priorities and long-term member experience objectives.

- Evaluate new partnership opportunities and contribute to build, buy, and integration decisions.

 3. Enterprise Roadmap Planning & Prioritization 

- Co-lead the enterprise member experience roadmap in partnership with Product, Technology, Architecture, Data, Operations, and Business leaders.

- Identify and prioritize opportunities that deliver the greatest value for members and the enterprise.

- Balance competing priorities across business units while driving a cohesive enterprise experience strategy.

 4. Cross-Platform Integration & Capability Development 

- Lead the development and optimization of shared services, configurable capabilities, and standardized integration patterns.

- Drive cross-platform integration initiatives including APIs, data exchanges, and shared technology services.

- Ensure solutions are scalable, reusable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

- Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Design teams to deliver high-quality member experiences.

 5. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement 

- Define and monitor KPIs and success metrics related to adoption, engagement, satisfaction, operational efficiency, and member outcomes.

- Use data insights, experimentation, and member feedback to continuously improve the end-to-end experience.

- Provide recommendations to leadership based on performance trends and business impact.

 6. Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management 

- Translate complex technical and business topics into clear recommendations and executive-level communications.

- Build strong relationships across business units and functions to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution.

- Present strategic recommendations, progress updates, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.

 Required Qualifications: 

- Minimum of 7+ years of Digital Product Management experience, with demonstrated horizontal ownership across multiple platforms or business units — not solely single-platform delivery.

- University Degree in Business, Technical, or a Quantitative Field. A master's degree / business-oriented education is a strong plus combined with a technical background.

- Demonstrated ability to prepare and present clear, concise memos and recommendations to senior leadership across multiple business units.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex, technical, and architectural topics — spanning several platforms — into practical, business-relevant narratives.

- Exceptional relationship-building skills with senior business leaders, technology partners, and external vendors / health partners across the full platform landscape.

- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple competing priorities across platforms, and adapt to changing demands.

- Proven experience integrating and scaling services and solutions from initial build (0 to 1) to enterprise-wide adoption (1 to n) across multiple platforms.

- High level of self-motivation, ownership, and accountability for enterprise outcomes vs. activity. 

- Highly developed financial and commercial acumen, including comfort with business casing, ROI, and ongoing value tracking at a cross-platform scale.

- Comprehensive expertise on platform services, APIs, and SDKs, specifically in multi-line-of-business or enterprise environments — core to this horizontal role rather than a nice-to-have.

 When you join our team: 

- We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want. 

- We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words. 

- As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

The Senior Product Manager, Product Operations Member Experience & Digital Health will lead the operational performance, optimization and continuous improvement of our Member Experience & Digital Health product ecosystem. They will own the operational health of the Member digital experience and ensure member-impacting issues are identified, triaged, resolved and converted into long-term product improvements.

 This role will focus on strengthening the backend systems, data flows, integrations and operational processes that enable scalable and reliable digital experiences. The Senior Product Manager will identify and lead system improvements, manage complex technology and DTS-related issues, drive root-cause resolution, and coordinate cross-functional teams to improve platform performance, stability and member outcomes.

 Working across Product, Technology, DTS, Data, Architecture, Operations and external partners, this role will serve as a key connector between product needs and technical execution, ensuring issues are resolved sustainably, recurring problems are eliminated, and the underlying platform continues to scale effectively.

 Position Responsibilities: 

- Own the operational health, stability, and optimization of Member Experience & Digital Health capabilities, ensuring platforms are reliable, scalable, and deliver a seamless member experience.

- Lead the identification, triage, and resolution of complex product, platform, data, integration, and technology issues, driving timely remediation and clear accountability across stakeholders.

- Conduct root cause analysis to identify systemic issues, eliminate recurring problems, and implement sustainable solutions that improve long-term platform performance.

- Partner closely with Product, DTS, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, and external vendors to translate member and business needs into technical and operational improvements.

- Monitor platform performance, operational metrics, KPIs, and service levels to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Analyze member journeys, operational processes, and platform capabilities to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to enhance the digital member experience.

- Own and prioritize a Product Operations backlog and roadmap, balancing member impact, business value, risk, technical feasibility, and delivery effort.

- Identify opportunities to improve backend systems, APIs, integrations, data flows, shared services, workflows, and platform processes to increase reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

- Coordinate cross-functional initiatives by establishing clear ownership, priorities, dependencies, milestones, and escalation pathways.

- Collaborate with Product, Technology, Architecture, and Data teams to optimize integrations, data flows, and shared services while reducing technical debt and operational complexity.

- Translate complex technical, operational, and data-related issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, and actionable decisions for stakeholders and senior leaders.

- Champion scalable, enterprise-wide solutions that can be leveraged across multiple business areas rather than creating one-off fixes.

- Foster a culture of continuous improvement through proactive monitoring, operational excellence, problem management, and optimization initiatives.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience: Minimum 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Technology Delivery, Platform Operations or a related discipline.

- Strong understanding of backend systems, APIs, integrations, data flows, shared services and enterprise technology environments.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex incidents and problems through triage, root-cause analysis, remediation and continuous improvement.

- Proven ability to work effectively with technology and enterprise IT organizations and navigate complex technology dependencies.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical and operational issues into clear business implications and recommendations.

- Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure environments, manage competing priorities and drive resolution of critical issues.

- Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills across Product, Technology, DTS, Data, Architecture, Operations and external partners.

- High level of self-motivation, ownership and accountability for outcomes, with a bias toward action and resolution.

- Demonstrated experience identifying systemic improvements, reducing operational friction and improving platform performance and reliability.

- Experience with APIs, SDKs, integration patterns, data pipelines and enterprise platform environments is strongly preferred.

This role leads complex, global HR technology and transformation initiatives from definition through adoption and value realization. You’ll coordinate cross-functional teams, manage delivery across predictive, Agile, and hybrid approaches, and balance business outcomes, colleague experience, risk, privacy, security, compliance, cost, and sustainable support.

 This high-visibility role helps shape the future of work by delivering integrated platforms, automation, data, and responsible AI capabilities that improve how HR services are experienced and operated globally.

 What You Can Expect 

- Boundless opportunities: Build future-ready skills through complex global assignments, continuous learning, coaching, and exposure to leading HR platforms, automation, data, and responsible AI.

- A global impact: Think big, challenge the status quo, and deliver changes that improve how colleagues experience HR services across markets.

- A supportive environment: Bring your perspective, be yourself, and work with an inclusive global team that values flexibility, well-being, recognition, open collaboration, and shared success.

 Position Responsibilities:

- Select and apply predictive, Agile, or hybrid delivery methods based on the work, risk profile, dependencies, and organizational readiness.

- Establish a sustainable transition to Day 2 operations, including ownership, support processes, service measures, release planning, documentation, and continuous improvement.

- Coach project teams, strengthen delivery discipline, and foster transparent accountability, inclusive collaboration, and learning.

 Required Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of progressive project management experience delivering large-scale, cross-functional technology or transformation initiatives in global, matrixed environments; experience in HR technology, employee experience, or financial services is preferred.

- Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise platforms, preferably Workday Learning, Talent, Performance, or Succession, and learning technologies such as Sana Learn.

- PMP is strongly preferred. A recognized Agile or scaled delivery credential, such as PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, or SAFe Agilist, is an asset.

- Demonstrated ability to deliver complex initiatives within a broader portfolio environment by balancing competing priorities, resource constraints, cross-program dependencies, and sequencing impacts while ensuring alignment to strategic objectives and overall Book of Work commitments.

- Strong command of predictive, Agile, and hybrid delivery, including business cases, integrated planning, financial management, vendor delivery, dependency management, governance, benefits realization, and transition to operations.

- Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, integrations, APIs, data flows, testing, release management, controls, and service management; technical depth is not required, but the ability to challenge assumptions and connect decisions across these areas is essential.

- Experience with project, product, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft 365, or equivalent platforms, including responsible use of AI-enabled productivity tools.

- Executive-level communication, facilitation, influence, and decision support skills, with the ability to make complex technical, regulatory, and delivery issues clear to diverse audiences.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in business, technology, human resources, engineering, or a related field.

Are you an experienced Business Analyst with expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and a passion for delivering scalable digital experiences? We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to serve as a key partner between business, product, design, and technology teams, translating complex business needs into effective AEM solutions and supporting publishing needs across enterprise web and mobile channels.

 As a Senior Business Analyst, you will leverage deep AEM expertise to lead requirements analysis, solution design, stakeholder alignment, and initial troubleshooting of web and publishing issues. Partnering with Marketing, Digital Experience, Engineering, Accessibility, and QA teams, you will define requirements, evaluate solutions, support issue resolution, and deliver scalable, user-centered digital experiences.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) & Design System Expertise 

- Leverage strong knowledge of AEM templates, components, content architecture, and authoring and publishing workflows, along with familiarity with Figma libraries and Storybook, to validate requirements and guide business, design, and technical discussions.

- Translate accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and brand compliance criteria into system-level requirements.

- Collaborate with designers and engineers to ensure technical feasibility and consistency with the GDS architecture and token strategy.

- Perform initial troubleshooting to reproduce web issues, document findings and business impact, and engage the appropriate teams for further investigation and resolution.

- Provide AEM publishing support for high-priority requests or urgent fixes, as needed.

- Partner with Marketers, Design Leads, Technical Leads, and Product Managers to capture, clarify, and translate business and product objectives into AEM and design system requirements.

- Evaluate requirements against existing AEM capabilities and recommend component or template reuse, enhancement, or development.

- Document functional and non-functional requirements for components, patterns, templates, and tokens—capturing dependencies, edge cases, authoring and accessibility needs.

- Write and maintain user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures in alignment with Agile delivery practices.

- Review and refine requirements, designs, authoring workflows, and implementation plans, resolving gaps before development begins.

- Help manage and triage publishing requests by clarifying requirements, assessing priorities, and coordinating next steps.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Alignment 

- Collaborate with Marketing, Editorial, Design, Development, QA, Analytics, Compliance, Accessibility, and project management partners.

- Facilitate requirements sessions, design reviews, planning discussions, and decision-making forums.

- Document key decisions, actions, owners, dependencies, and next steps to keep initiatives moving forward.

- Identify and manage delivery risks, open decisions, dependencies, blockers, and requirements requiring further review or approval, escalating issues when broader stakeholder alignment or formal approval is needed.

- Participate in sprint ceremonies, requirements walkthroughs, refinement sessions, user acceptance testing, and release activities.

- Support internal communication and alignment across segments to ensure shared understanding of priorities and progress.

 Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role within digital product, platform and/or design system teams.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline.

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, templates, authoring, publishing workflows, and content management practices.

- Direct experience with design systems (enterprise or global-scale preferred).

- Strong understanding of UX/UI design and front-end development practices (Figma, Storybook, component-driven development).

- Proven ability to write clear and comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience in Agile delivery environments, with comfort managing backlogs and running refinement sessions in Jira/Confluence.

- Excellent facilitation and communication skills; adept at bridging business and technical perspectives.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities across global time zones and business lines.

- Experience working within a global enterprise or financial services organization.

- Background in web publishing, content operations, or digital experience.

 Title and Summary 

Manager, Product Management 

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Mastercard’s Services team is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Role:
Advanced Analytics drives AI-based solutions and products at a globally scalable level across different customer lifecycle stages, credit risk management, operational and strategic analytics. Customer engagement and acquisition using our data assets serve as key differentiators to optimize and grow revenue for our retail and commercial clients.

We are seeking a visionary and customer-centric product leader to drive the evolution of our Merchant Analytics Products. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong analytical background, capable of leading globally distributed teams and collaborating closely with engineering to deliver innovative solutions that enhance customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the development and execution of product strategies that prioritize customer experience and drive measurable outcomes.
• Mentor and manage large, cross-functional teams across various geographies, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
• Collaborate hands-on with engineering teams to plan and execute product development across multiple quarters and sprints.
• Integrate AI and data analytics into product offerings, working closely with data science teams to inform decision-making.
• Ensure adherence to existing roadmaps while proactively identifying and mitigating potential risks, including developing contingency plans.
• Translate complex features into tangible benefits for customers, enhancing product adoption and satisfaction.

All About you:
• Proven experience in product management with a deep understanding of customer experience and merchant analytics, advertising ecosystem, third party data sources, and AI
• Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor large, diverse teams in a global setting.
• Exposure to marketing campaigns, while interacting with CMOs
• Exhibit ownership, agility, and a strong entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and driving results in a fast-paced, evolving market.
• Excellent communication skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

- Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. About Miovision: 

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

 - All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 - One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 - Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 - Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 - Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, but to keep our internal operations moving at highway speeds, we need a highly adaptable Operations Project Manager. Consider yourself the master traffic controller for our most critical operational initiatives. From navigating the complex intersections of new facility setups and fulfillment rollouts to seamlessly merging newly acquired units into our ecosystem following M&A activity, you will ensure our projects never hit a bottleneck. If you are an ambitious professional ready to step into a high-visibility role, clear roadblocks across scaled manufacturing and logistics environments, and keep our operational timelines cruising in the fast lane, green means go!



Objectives and Responsibilities:

 - Project Execution: Actively manage day-to-day project schedules, track critical milestones, and keep cross-functional teams perfectly aligned across multiple high-impact operational initiatives.

 - Facility Expansions: Coordinate the heavy lifting for facility buildouts and assembly line expansions, taking charge of equipment tracking, installation schedules, layout implementation, and hands-on trial run support.

 - Production Transfers: Orchestrate the seamless, step-by-step transition of tooling, inventory, and assembly lines between internal sites or external suppliers to minimize disruption and maintain output.

 - M&A Integration: Play a pivotal role in onboarding newly acquired operational units, consolidating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), tracking integration checklists, and aligning reporting metrics to unify our growing ecosystem.

 - The Central Hub: Serve as the ultimate point of contact and communication bridge, seamlessly connecting Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and external vendors.

 - Risk Mitigation: Diligently maintain project documentation, risk logs, and weekly status dashboards to keep executive leadership informed and clear potential blockers before they derail timelines.



The Ideal Profile:

 - The Experienced Operator: Progressive, hard-earned experience in project management, manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial operations.

 - The Manufacturing Whiz: You possess strong, practical operational exposure and familiarity with hardware/electronics manufacturing, facility staging, product transfers, or complex warehouse setups.

 - The Project Master: You have a rock-solid grasp of core PM principles (task mapping, critical path tracking, risk mitigation), and if you hold a PMP or CAPM certification, you jump to the front of the line!

 - The Financial Hawk: You bring practical experience tracking project budgets, expertly managing CAPEX/OPEX spend, monitoring cost variances, and forecasting financial requirements across the entire project lifecycle.

 - The Tool Specialist: You are highly proficient with modern project management software (such as Asana, Jira, MS Project, or Smartsheet) and boast advanced spreadsheet and data tracking capabilities.

 - The Proactive Problem Solver: You boast exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a relentless problem-solving mindset, naturally stepping up to clear hurdles.

You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

 This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

- Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.

As a Project Manager in the AI Factory team at National Bank, you’ll coordinate the delivery of our technology projects and provide value. In this role, you’ll have a positive impact on our organization with your leadership, your outstanding organization skills and your project delivery experience in an Agile/Safe context.
Your role
Manage and implement large-scale technology projects prioritized by the sector by creating a motivating environment
Continuously optimize the use of project resources to achieve the sector’s objectives
Diagnose problem situations, take action and help resolve complex problems by implementing solutions
Identify and manage the risks and issues inherent to the project in a consistent, proactive manner
Produce various reports to track the progress of the project and provide progress reports while adapting your communications to your audience

Be an agent for change, promoting our values and ensuring constant communication with all internal and external stakeholders
Your team

Our team stands out through the delivery of high-impact AI (Artificial Intelligence) capabilities, AI coaching and advisory services, as well as the development of AI performance assessments. We want to contribute to your quality of life by offering you as much flexibility as possible. The Bank values ongoing development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs with on-the-job learning help you to master your role and develop new fields of expertise. Experience leading workshops and coaching

Familiarity with Agile delivery mode

Leveraging your expertise in information management, knowledge architecture, data, and information governance, you will help transform dispersed knowledge into a strategic asset that supports intelligent search engines, AI agents, and decision-support systems. You will act as a guardian of information quality and contribute actively to the continuous improvement of the organization's knowledge ecosystem.
Y our job
Ensure the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of NBDB's knowledge base.
Prepare and optimize knowledge assets for use by intelligent search engines and artificial intelligence solutions.
Perform data analysis and validation using SQL to ensure information accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
Collaborate with business, data, AI, and technology teams to improve knowledge quality and resolve information-related issues.

As a Chief Business Analyst in the IT Delivery Wealth Management - ADVICE train team at National Bank, you’ll liaise with business teams and delivery teams.
You’ll work in Agile mode and will be part of a squad that manages and delivers business and technology projects for different sectors. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to use your business analysis skills to help implement new technologies and make a positive impact on our organization.
Your job
Support product owners, business line partners and IT teams in their decision-making and deliveries
Define the scope of processes to be optimized and proactively take charge of planning activities for the various deliverables
Lead workshops with multiple stakeholders with varied levels and expertise
Model current and target processes based on the Bank’s existing mapping practices
Carry out high level and detailed impact analyses on all angles of processes, with the help of experts
Know and apply best practices to identify, articulate, classify, and write business requirements, stakeholder requirements, and solution requirements (functional, non-functional, informational, transitional), understand the links between them, and ensure their traceability (traceability matrix).
Define and identify user test scenarios and support users with operational transfer
Make proposals for change management strategies for users of the solution.
Your team
The IT team is made up of more than 2,300 proactive, collaborative experts who work with agility to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology, and continuously improve our processes.
As part of the IT Delivery Wealth Management, you’ll be on a large team of colleagues, and you’ll report to the Asset Manager. We want to contribute to your quality of life by offering you as much flexibility as possible. For example, we offer a hybrid work environment along with a flexible schedule that you can adapt to your needs.
The Bank values ongoing development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs with on-the-job learning help you to master your role and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, Harvard Manage Mentor, coaching, and mentoring support are always available.
Prerequisites
University degree in a related field and several years of relevant experience
Business analysis skills in a tech-based ecosystem
Experience in the end-to-end transformation of business processes, change management and continuous improvement
Knowledge of business process improvement and mapping: modeling, BPMN, Lean approach
Experience with testing scenarios and user support
Ability to think strategically, analytical, synthesis and communication skills
Knowledge of Agile methodology (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and Atlassian suite tools (Jira, Confluence, ...)

English, French
