 About Stay22 

 Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.

 Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.

 Every creator and platform that works with Stay22 relies on clear, trustworthy data to understand whether their content and traffic are creating value. In this role, you will help make that picture reliable. You will join a small but high-impact Data & Analytics team and work across three squads: Hub, where partners sign up, manage their accounts and track performance; Integrations, which connects supplier and partner data; and Social, which helps creators turn social content into revenue opportunities.

 This is a true analytics role, not a position limited to dashboard production. You will turn ambiguous product and business questions into analysis and recommendations, validate data quality and limitations, and help teams make better decisions. You will use SQL, Python, funnels, cohorts, experimentation and dashboards, while bringing curiosity, asking thoughtful questions and owning problems from the first question through to the next step.

 Key responsibilities 

- Partner with Product Managers, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to support product and business initiatives through data. 

- Turn unclear questions into clear hypotheses, success metrics and analysis plans. 

- Support product experiments and A/B tests by validating setup, defining KPIs and analyzing results. 

- Deliver end-to-end analysis for Hub, Social and Integrations, using funnels, cohorts, segmentation, retention and other practical methods. 

- Build, maintain and improve dashboards, recurring reports and trusted metrics. 

- Validate data quality by checking definitions, duplicates, missing events, freshness and differences between sources. 

- Present findings, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

- Help teams become more self-sufficient in using data and interpreting results through documentation, clear definitions and reusable analysis. 

- Partner with Data Engineering to improve data quality and analytical workflows without owning ETL architecture or infrastructure.

 Requirements 

- At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, growth analytics, strategy, insights or a related field.

- Strong SQL skills and experience owning analyses from clarifying the question through validation, interpretation and recommendation.

- Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or a comparable platform.

- Practical Python experience for data cleaning, exploration, automation, prototyping or working with larger datasets.

- A solid understanding of statistics, metric definition, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, experimentation and A/B testing.

- Strong data-quality judgment, including the ability to identify anomalies, missing events, duplicates, inconsistent definitions and limitations across sources.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into practical recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Curiosity, autonomy and comfort asking questions, working through ambiguity, adapting to changing priorities and validating AI-assisted analysis when used.

 What to expect during our hiring process 

 We know your time is valuable, here is a quick look at the next steps:

- Call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor (30 min). 

- Interview with the hiring manager (45 min). 

- Technical interview and live case with members of the Data team and a Product partner (60 min). 

- Final interview with our CEO (30 min). 

- Offer and onboarding 🎉

 Note: this process may evolve based on the team's needs.

 Why join Stay22? 

- Prime Montreal Location : Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.

- Comprehensive Benefits: Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass’, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.

- Flexibility That Works: Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days.

 (Stay22 is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at careers@stay22.com ) 

 Your application will be reviewed by Nayo , our internal recruiter- even if you don’t meet every requirement but you’re excited, let’s talk.

 Aperçu du poste 

 Chaque créateur et chaque plateforme qui travaille avec Stay22 dépend de données claires et fiables pour comprendre si son contenu et son trafic génèrent de la valeur. Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras à rendre cette lecture fiable. Tu rejoindras une équipe Data & Analytics à taille humaine et à fort impact, et tu travailleras avec trois squads : Hub, où les partenaires s’inscrivent, gèrent leur compte et suivent leur performance; Integrations, qui relie les données des fournisseurs et des partenaires; et Social, qui aide les créateurs à transformer leur contenu social en opportunités de revenus.

 Il s’agit d’un véritable rôle en analytique, et non d’un poste limité à la création de tableaux de bord. Tu transformeras des questions produit et business ambiguës en analyses et recommandations, tu évalueras la qualité des données et leurs limites, et tu aideras les équipes à prendre de meilleures décisions. Tu utiliseras SQL, Python, les analyses de conversion et de cohortes, l’expérimentation et les tableaux de bord, tout en faisant preuve de curiosité, en posant de bonnes questions et en prenant en charge les problèmes de la première question jusqu’à la prochaine étape.

 Principales responsabilités

- Transformer des questions peu précises en hypothèses claires, indicateurs de succès et plans d’analyse. 

- Soutenir les expérimentations produit et les tests A/B en validant leur mise en place, en définissant les KPI et en analysant les résultats. 

- Mener des analyses de bout en bout pour Hub, Social et Integrations, à l’aide d’entonnoirs, de cohortes, de segmentation, de rétention et d’autres méthodes pratiques. 

- Construire, maintenir et améliorer les tableaux de bord, les rapports récurrents et les indicateurs fiables. 

- Vérifier la qualité des données en contrôlant les définitions, les doublons, les événements manquants, la fraîcheur des données et les écarts entre les sources. 

- Présenter clairement les constats, les limites et les recommandations à des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques. 

- Aider les équipes à devenir plus autonomes dans l’utilisation et l’interprétation des données grâce à une bonne documentation, des définitions claires et des analyses réutilisables. 

- Collaborer avec Data Engineering pour améliorer la qualité des données et les méthodes d’analyse, sans être responsable de l’architecture ETL ou de l’infrastructure.

 Expérience recherchée

- Solide expérience en SQL et capacité à prendre en charge une analyse, de la clarification de la question jusqu’à la validation, l’interprétation et la recommandation.

- Expérience avec des outils de BI ou de visualisation comme Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou une plateforme comparable.

- Expérience pratique avec Python pour nettoyer et explorer des données, automatiser des tâches, créer des prototypes ou travailler avec de grands volumes de données.

- Bonne compréhension des statistiques, de la définition des métriques, de l’analyse d’entonnoirs, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’expérimentation et des tests A/B.

- Bon jugement en matière de qualité des données, notamment pour repérer les anomalies, les événements manquants, les doublons, les définitions incohérentes et les limites entre différentes sources.

- Excellentes aptitudes de communication et capacité à transformer une analyse complexe en recommandations concrètes pour des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.

- Curiosité, autonomie et aisance à poser des questions, à avancer dans l’ambiguïté, à s’adapter aux priorités changeantes et à valider les analyses assistées par l’IA lorsque nécessaire.

 À quoi t'attendre pendant notre processus de recrutement

Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

 What you'll do 

 In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

 Who you are 

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

- MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles

- Proficiency in SQL

- Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail

- Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact

- Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations

- Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities

 Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company

- Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines

- Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing

- Strong statistical knowledge

- Working knowledge of Python

- Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs

- Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

 Stripe builds the most powerful and flexible tools for running an internet business. We handle hundreds of billions of dollars each year and enable millions of users around the world to scale faster and more efficiently by building their businesses on Stripe. To further this important mission, Stripe is building a world class Internal Audit (IA) team. Our IA mission is to make the business better as it grows. We are consumed with the goal of being agile with the business, powered by technology and an accelerator to the speed of controls integration and compliance adoption.

 About the team

  Our IA team is responsible for providing objective feedback and insights across the company in relation to the design and effectiveness of Stripe’s business processes, its compliance with laws and regulations and its risk management framework. Unique in our purpose is a cross-functional mandate that invites viewing through a wide lens and collaborating across the business. To enable this engagement, we must build and scale in a rapid-growth, high-volume environment. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing Data Analytics team within audit and work on providing data driven insights across the IA lifecycle. The DA Lead will support Data Analytics and audit fieldwork in execution of the approved Global Audit Plan. They will help develop embedded audit analytics as part of audit planning, fieldwork, and reporting through the execution of data analytics test steps. The DA Lead will also help drive the usage of AI to help drive more efficient and effective audits and will be a key member of the IA team who will help us elevate the ambitions of Stripe. 

 This position can be based in Toronto, New York, San Francisco, Atlanta or Seattle. 

 What you’ll do

 Responsibilities

-   Complete data analytics as part of audit engagements in collaboration with the IA team. 

- Drive the use of AI across the audit team and leverage it in audit engagements

- Participate in audit walkthroughs and develop work programs for the in scope areas

- Lead DA brainstorming sessions with the audit team to discuss best use of data analytics techniques in audit planning and fieldwork

- Assist with substantive testing of audit findings during reporting

- Document the data analytics and audit tests in work papers.

 Who you are 

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

 Minimum requirements 

- 5-10 years of professional experience working in audit data analytics

- Expertise with SQL, schema and ETL design, and data pipeline development/maintenance (e.g., Airflow).

- Familiarity with scripting/programming for data mining and modeling (R, Python) and ETL development (Python).

- Experience with and knowledge of machine learning techniques. 

- Experience with reporting and visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau).

- Exquisite attention to detail.

- A passion for building unreasonably good products and for driving defining impact.

- Versatility and willingness to learn new technologies on the job.

- High tolerance for rapid change and ability to navigate ambiguity.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify and share succinctly. 

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

- Experience working with basic git command

 Preferred qualifications 

-   Previous experience in a high volume transactional payment environment

- Passionate about audit and data

 Job Description: 

 Sun Life's Corporate Real Estate (CRE) team is looking for a Portfolio Strategy Lead to guide real estate planning and decisions across a portfolio of sites. This role calls for someone who can manage the details of individual projects while stepping back to identify portfolio-wide priorities, patterns, and opportunities.

 The Portfolio Strategy Lead brings together business needs, financial analysis, market insights, and input from CRE workstreams to develop practical recommendations. They build trusted relationships, drive work from early assessment through executive-ready materials and approvals, and keep stakeholders aligned and decisions moving.

 We recognize that no candidate brings every skill or experience listed below. We are intentionally seeking individuals with robust technical proficiency, strong curiosity, a growth mindset, and a demonstrated willingness to learn – shown through past experiences, problem-solving approaches, or taking on new challenges – alongside the core capabilities for the role. 

 What will you do? 

 Lead portfolio and site strategy 

 ·  Own the strategic planning and decision pipeline for an assigned portfolio of sites, under direction of the Portfolio Strategy Program Manager.
 ·  Assess renewals, relocations, consolidations, investments, and other site decisions in the context of broader portfolio objectives.
 ·  Identify upcoming decision points, dependencies, risks, and opportunities across the portfolio.
 ·  Translate site-level findings into clear portfolio insights and recommendations.

 Develop analysis and recommendations 

 ·  Lead the development of business cases, options analyses, financial comparisons, and decision materials.
 ·  Work with relevant workstreams including leasing, facilities, design, project management, finance, and business stakeholders to gather and validate inputs.
 ·  Test assumptions, reconcile details across workstreams, and clearly articulate trade-offs, risks, and implications.
 ·  Apply sound judgment when information is incomplete, distinguishing established facts from assumptions and open questions.

 Build relationships, drive alignment and secure approvals 

 ·  Build strong, trusted relationships with business partners and CRE workstreams to understand priorities, anticipate concerns, and support well-informed site decisions.
 ·  Coordinate work across teams, driving timely contributions and deliverables without direct reporting authority.
 ·  Communicate effectively and set clear expectations, leveraging differing stakeholder perspectives to strengthen outcomes and establishing controls to keep work aligned to the objective and on track.
 ·  Prepare concise, executive-facing presentations and approval packages that make the recommendation and decision required clear.
 ·  Track feedback and follow-up actions through to resolution.

 What do you need to succeed? 

 ·  3-5+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, leasing, workplace strategy, finance, consulting, or related field.
 ·  University degree in business, real estate, finance, or a related field.
 ·  A strategic mindset and the ability to connect detailed project analysis to broader portfolio priorities. A structured and curious problem-solving approach, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, test assumptions, and develop practical recommendations.
 ·  Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to manage assumptions, data, timelines, and approval requirements accurately.
 ·  Strong analytical and financial-modelling skills, including experience developing business cases, comparing capital and operating cost scenarios, and applying concepts such as cash flow, NPV, sensitivity analysis, and run-rate impacts.
 ·  Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and drive inputs, decisions, and approvals to completion.
 ·  Clear, concise communicator with experience presenting decision materials for VP-level and senior audiences.
 ·  Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to establish credibility, collaborate across teams, constructively challenge inputs, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
 ·  Advanced Excel skills, including the ability to organize, reconcile, analyze, and quality-check data from multiple sources.
 ·  Confidence using AI and other digital tools to improve efficiency, analysis, and communication.

 Nice to Have 

 ·  Experience with multi-site real estate portfolios or financial services.
 ·  Familiarity with real estate market research, scenario analysis, or portfolio planning tools.

 What's in it for you? 

- The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential

- Flexible Benefits from the day you join to meet the needs of you and your family

- We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful environment. Our goal is to make sure all our employees have the chance to live up to their full potential

- We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2025 Best Workplaces in Ontario by Great Place to Work® Canada

- We are thrilled to be recognized by Excellence Canada with their top-level certification, the Canada Order of Excellence for Mental Health at Work®,  for prioritizing employee well-being, fostering a positive work culture, and achieving excellence in mental health

 *LI-MS

 Job Description: 
 Role Summary 

 The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

 Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

 Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

 Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics: 

 Fierce curiosity . You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.
 Understanding business . We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.   
 A passion for solving problems.  The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.
 Technical skills . How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

 What will you do?

- Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.

- Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end

- Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations

- Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders

- scalability, and team capacity.

- Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities

 What will you need to succeed? 

- 5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)

- Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources

- Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other

- Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda

- Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role

- An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills

- Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders

- Ability to document work

 Job Description: 
 Department Overview 

 TD Securities provides a wide range of capital market products and services to corporate, government and institutional clients who choose us for our knowledge and experience in six key areas of finance: Investment Banking, Debt Capital Markets, Institutional Equities, Private Equity, Precious Metals and Foreign Exchange & Money Market. Our services include the underwriting and distribution of new debt and equity issues, providing advice on strategic acquisitions and divestitures, and executing daily trading and investment needs. 

 With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we help clients meet their needs today and prepare for tomorrow. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. 

 We are growth-oriented, people-focused, and community-minded. As a team, we work to deliver value for our clients every day. 

 About This Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Analyst to support the delivery and evolution of Credit Risk Systems used by TD Securities. You will translate complex business, risk, data, and technology needs into clear solution requirements and work closely with business and technology partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, from discovery and impact assessment through testing, implementation, and production adoption.

 Meaningful work is fueled by meaningful performance and career development conversations with your manager. The main responsibilities are:

 Business Analysis and Delivery

 EMPLOYEE / TEAM

- Contribute to a fair, positive and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce

- Act as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally

- Support enhancement and integration initiatives involving Third Party Risk applications and data sources.

 BREADTH & DEPTH 

- 
- Key subject matter expert professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas

- Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring delivery teams focus on the highest-value initiatives.

- Lead agile ceremonies and work closely with technology teams to deliver product enhancements.

- Manage dependencies, risks, and release planning across multiple initiatives and platforms.

- Drive continuous improvement through user feedback, process optimization, and emerging industry practices

- Accountable for specialized product development support based on sound product expertise and knowledge of Agile/Scrum processes, roles and practices

- Build strong relationships across Procurement, Risk, Technology, Compliance, and Audit teams.

- Present insights, recommendations, and progress updates to senior leadership and governance committees.

 EXPERIENCE AND / OR EDUCATION

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

 We’re looking for a Field Sales Engineer who’s wired for AI/ML, fluent in real-world problem-solving, and excited to build with the people actually using what we make. You will collaborate closely with the sales team and enterprise customers, leveraging your deep technical knowledge in AI to drive the adoption of our products and solutions. This is a customer-facing role that requires both technical expertise and excellent communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

 This role is remote based out of North America with preference near one of our main hubs Santa Clara, CA; Boston, MA; or Toronto,ON.  

 We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. 

 Who You Are 

- You’ve lived in the AI/ML trenches, whether as a field engineer, a solutions architect, or the one tapped in when things needed to “just work.”

- You speak both machine and human. Whether it’s a researcher or a skeptical executive, you know how to break things down and bring them to life.

- You’re fired up about generative models, LLMs, and the edge of what’s possible when software meets purpose-built silicon.

- Work directly with customers in pre-sales meetings, presentations, and workshops to understand their technical challenges and provide effective solutions.

- Partner closely with sales operations and product teams to provide feedback from customers and help shape future product enhancements.

 What We Need 

- Strong customer-facing skills with 5+ years of relevant technical, enterprise experience (such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Account Manager).

- Your field insight will help shape our roadmap, our features, and the way we show up for developers.

- Proven expertise in AI technologies and frameworks, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP),computer vision, PyTorch or TensorFlow.

- Experience with embedded systems, FPGA Architecture or AI accelerators. 

- Good understanding of data center, server architecture and deployment, thermal/power, and infrastructure management.

 What You Will Learn 

- How to explore and push the boundaries of AI performance on custom silicon and help developers do the same.

- What it’s like to build the future from scratch, working alongside teams creating hardware, software, and everything in between.

- To master the craft of fine-tuning LLMs, optimizing vision models, and building AI pipelines that run at scale.

- An understanding of why field roles drive real impact turning on-the-ground insight into product breakthroughs and platform momentum.

 Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made. 

 Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 
 This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

ABOUT THE ROLE 🚀



Are you energized by complex, cross-functional challenges — the kind where you’re the person who brings clarity to ambiguity, momentum to high-stakes initiatives, and trust to every room you walk into? We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join us at Thinkific.

This role sits within our Program Management team inside Research & Development — a small but mighty team that operates at the heart of how Thinkific delivers. This team is a strategic force multiplier, owning complex end-to-end initiatives operating at the intersection of people, product, and AI-augmented delivery.

A note from the Hiring Manager

Hi! I am Afro, Manager of Program Management. I’m passionate about tackling complex cross-functional problems and excited for this person to join our team. This role is not just about organizing meetings and doing follow-ups. You will be highly engaged in owning projects end-to-end, solving interesting problems, and making meaningful decisions that contribute to Thinkific’s goals and our customers’ success. If this and a fast, AI-driven, and highly collaborative environment excites you, I can’t wait to meet you.

Your goal will be to drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives and raise the bar on how we ship. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this:

 - Own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes initiatives, leading programs that cut across engineering, product, data, and go-to-market teams from scoping through launch. You’ll define what “done” looks like and hold the organization accountable to it

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at every level — engineers, product managers, executives, and external partners. You’ll surface trade-offs clearly, manage competing priorities, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction

 - Leverage AI as a force multiplier. You already integrate AI tools into how you work — drafting status updates, synthesizing risk signals, generating meeting summaries and documentation, and accelerating decision-making

 - Translate business objectives into executable project plans by identifying dependencies, sequencing work intelligently, and proactively flagging when scope, timeline, or resources need to shift

 - Anticipate problems before they become blockers. You’ll build contingency plans, facilitate hard conversations early, and keep stakeholders informed

 - Define and reinforce standards for how we ship — quality gates, rollout plans, retrospectives, and post-mortems that actually lead to change

 - Own executive-level AI-assisted reporting with clear, opinionated status updates, risk dashboards, and decision-ready briefings


The person we have in mind likely:

 - Has 5+ years of experience in technical project management or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a software or SaaS environment

 - Is genuinely technical. They don’t need to write code, but understand how software is built and what makes an architecture decision hard

 - Is AI-fluent. They actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Notion AI, or similar) in their day-to-day work. They’re comfortable helping teams define guardrails for responsible AI use in workflows

 - Is a systems thinker who holds the whole picture — dependencies, risks, resource constraints, business context — while staying sharp on the details that matter most

 - Communicates with clarity and confidence. They write concisely, adapt their message to their audience, and can explain technical blockers in plain language

 - Is experienced with modern delivery frameworks (Agile, Scrum, Kanban)

 - Is data-informed and uses metrics to track progress and make decisions

 - Loves to learn and grow. They’ve found (and keep looking for) ways to level up their skills in this field, whether that’s through formal education, gaining professional experience, or maybe even building their own business

These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job:

 - Experience in a B2B SaaS or learning product company

 - Familiarity with evaluating and rolling out AI tooling within engineering or product teams

 - PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification

 - Experience managing vendor relationships or third-party integrations at scale


The recruitment compensation range for this position is $93,100 – $116,400 – $139,700 CAD (this range is base salary only). Your specific compensation within this range is determined based on your job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and our internal equity assessment. The range is designed to capture the full journey from developing skills to excelling in the position. Most new hires start between the minimum and midpoint, which aligns with being fully capable in the role.

Here’s what it means to work at Thinkific:

We're a high-performing team on a meaningful mission, and the way we work reflects that. Thinkers are customer-obsessed and ownership-driven — we talk to customers constantly, take full accountability for outcomes, and operate with a high degree of autonomy and trust. We care deeply for each other and believe the best ideas come from honest debate, real feedback, and diverse perspectives. It's a culture built on trust, exceptional work, and genuine respect for the people around us.

Who thrives here:

Thinkific may be the right place if you're energized by a fast-paced environment, enjoy high autonomy, and work well with ambiguity and change. You thrive in highly collaborative teams and make the people around you better. You're results-driven, take ownership without being asked, have hard conversations even when it's uncomfortable, and celebrate diverse perspectives. AI is a tool you embrace to move faster and think bigger.

Who doesn't thrive here:

If you prefer highly structured environments, need to wait for clear direction to move, dislike ambiguity and change, or find direct feedback uncomfortable, Thinkific may not be the right fit.




ABOUT THE ROLE 🚀



What makes customers choose a platform and stay for it? For many Thinkific Plus customers, the answer is Commerce, and we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own it.



On the Acquire and Monetize team, you'll own multiple product lines focused on enabling our customers to sell, earn and scale their businesses. The primary offering is our Thinkific Commerce https://www.thinkific.com/features/thinkific-payments/ product, our built-in payments offering with seamless payment processing, advanced sales tools and effortless tax management. Commerce is a key reason we win Plus customers and a significant source of revenue, so it needs to be highly competitive. You'll shape the strategic vision for Commerce, and decide how we match the market where we need to and where we build Thinkific Commerce to be more differentiated.

You'll be as strong at execution as you are at strategy. We expect Commerce to be built with the quality and depth to fully solve our customers' problems, and to be rolled out in a way that customers feel as a seamless upgrade. On top of Commerce, you’ll also own our customer onboarding, website building features and lastly the execution of pricing and packaging changes strategically led by our VP, Growth.

Reporting to the Director, Product, you'll collaborate across Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success and Sales to deliver best-in-class monetization and buyer experiences that help our customers grow their revenue.

Your goal will be to drive Thinkific's commerce product strategy and execution, ensuring our solutions deliver substantial value to customers and align with our business objectives. Here's how you'll accomplish this:

 - Define the strategic vision for our Commerce product, integrating market insights, customer needs, and business outcomes across areas like payments, checkout, subscriptions, pricing, and tax

 - Execute with quality and depth, taking the time to fully solve customer problems rather than shipping partial solutions, and holding a high bar for what "done" means

 - Own a wide surface area, including our other payment processing integrations, execution of pricing and packaging changes, customer onboarding, and our site building product

 - Work AI-first across feedback triage, competitive insight, scoping, and prototyping, increasing both the amount and the quality of what you can scope so we keep pace with engineers who are moving faster than ever

 - Think end to end, from how we retain and win customers, through discovery and scoping, to launch considerations like pricing and packaging, user experience, in-product and customer communication, and team readiness, so new and updated features feel like seamless upgrades and customers get the most value from them

 - Stay deeply connected to our customers by talking with them regularly, understanding their businesses inside and out, and turning what you hear, along with support and sales signal, into clear problems worth solving

 - Drive measurable outcomes by defining success metrics, using data and experiments to guide priorities, and tracking impact on revenue, conversion, retention, and Plus wins

 - Collaborate across Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success and Sales to ship work that moves these metrics, and run retrospectives to keep improving how we work

The person we have in mind likely:

 - Has 6+ years of experience in product management in mid size companies

 - Has at least 2 years product managing commerce products specifically

 - Has a proven track record of driving product strategy and execution and delivering measurable business impact, particularly in monetization or commerce-focused domains

 - Thinks end to end, planning the rollout from the start, including pricing, user experience, migration, and how we tell customers, and has shipped changes to live products that customers had to adopt

 - Executes with depth and quality, sweating the details, shipping solutions that fully solve the problem, and holding a high bar for quality at speed

 - Is customer-obsessed, and has a strong foundation in Jobs-to-be-Done and direct experience engaging customers

 - Demonstrates an exceptional ability to synthesize data, market trends, and customer feedback into strategic product decisions

 - Has a deep understanding of AI's role in product development, uses AI in their daily workflow, and believes it can unlock our ability to solve more customer problems better

 - Thrives in fast-paced, agile environments, and takes a proactive approach to navigating change and ambiguity

These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job:

 - Experience in e-commerce or online learning

 - Experience with pricing and packaging, onboarding, or site builders

 - Knowledge of marketing principles, customer acquisition strategies, and monetization models

The recruitment compensation range for this position is $150,000 - $175,000. Your specific compensation within this range is determined based on your job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and our internal equity assessment. The range is designed to capture the full journey from developing skills to excelling in the position. Most new hires start between the minimum and midpoint, which aligns with being fully capable in the role.


The Hiring Journey

 1. An exploratory call with our Talent team

 2. An impact-focused interview with our Director of Product and TA

 3. Technical Stage with our Head of Product and Design & our Director of Product

 4. Stakeholder Interview with our VP of Engineering and R&D Ops

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY

Trulioo is seeking a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy & Development to help shape the company’s strategic direction and translate it into coordinated action across the business. Working closely with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer, this leader will own the continued evolution of Trulioo’s strategic blueprint, strengthen alignment between corporate strategy and functional priorities, and guide execution of the company’s most important strategic initiatives.



This role will build the intelligence, governance, and execution capabilities that allow Trulioo to anticipate market change and make informed choices about where and how to compete. The Senior Director will bring together customer, competitive, regulatory, economic, industry, and product insights to test strategic assumptions, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and inform decisions across organic investment, partnerships, and acquisitions.



This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role at the intersection of strategy, product, transformation, capital allocation, and corporate development. The ideal candidate combines forward-looking strategic judgment with the ability to operationalize ideas—building roadmaps, mobilizing accountable leaders, guiding complex programs, and creating the governance needed to turn strategy into measurable results.



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position, working remotely.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Corporate Strategy and Strategic Blueprint Support

 - Continuously test the strategy against market forces, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, customer needs, technology shifts, and emerging opportunity areas.

 - Partner with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer to prepare strategic recommendations and decision materials for executives, the Board, external advisors, and other key stakeholders.

 - Design scenario analyses that evaluate strategic assumptions, alternative market outcomes, competitive responses, investment choices, and potential disruptions.

 - Identify material risks to the strategy and partner with the Enterprise Risk Office to assess exposure, define responses, and integrate strategic risks into enterprise governance.

 - Develop clear points of view on competitive positioning, market adjacencies, thematic investments, and the capabilities Trulioo will need to win over the long term.

 - Co-lead recurring strategy reviews and recommend when elements of the strategic blueprint should be accelerated, refined, reprioritized, or recast.

Strategy Alignment and Execution

 - Translate the strategic blueprint into enterprise priorities, functional goals, measurable outcomes, and clear execution roadmaps.

 - Partner with executive and functional leaders to align their strategies, investments, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and/or incentives with the company’s strategic direction.

 - Define the scope, activities, sequencing, investment requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, and measures of success for major strategic programs.

 - Establish and chair governance forums that track progress against strategic priorities and create clear paths for decision-making and escalation.

 - Partner with the Transformation Office and accountable workstream leaders to mobilize initiatives, resolve cross-functional blockers, measure progress and performance, and redirect execution when outcomes move off course.

 - Create recurring feedback loops, including shared metrics reviews and strategy check-ins, to identify misalignment early and improve execution.

 - Communicate the strategy across the organization in ways that build understanding of Trulioo’s direction, strategic choices, and highest-priority activities.

MAPS and Capital Allocation Governance

 - Lead MAPS—Trulioo’s quarterly Market Aligned Product Strategy program—to connect corporate strategy and market intelligence with product strategy, investment decisions, and roadmaps.

 - Bring together Product, Engineering, Strategy, Risk and Reg, Sales, Marketing, and GTM leaders to evaluate emerging customer needs and market opportunities.

 - Guide structured decisions on whether Trulioo should build, buy, partner, watch, or pass in response to identified opportunities.

 - Oversee the development of MAPS insight packages covering regulatory change, voice of the customer, competitive moves, market potential, cost of missed opportunity, industry trends, and product performance.

 - In coordination with the Office of the CFO, develop and operate a disciplined capital allocation governance program that connects strategic priorities with investment decisions.

 - Build decision frameworks that clarify opportunity, strategic fit, expected value, investment requirements, trade-offs, risks, and measures of success.

 - Produce a forward-looking point of view on capital allocation priorities informed by Trulioo’s competitive position, portfolio performance, and emerging growth opportunities.

Corporate Development and M&A

 - Support the development of Trulioo’s Build, Buy, and Partner strategy by identifying capability gaps and evaluating inorganic paths to accelerate the strategic blueprint.

 - Support market mapping, opportunity screening, target identification, strategic fit assessments, and ongoing target monitoring.

 - Coordinate cross-functional due diligence, including workstream planning, information synthesis, issue escalation, decision support, and executive reporting.

 - Contribute to due diligence activities and deal-structure considerations in partnership with Finance, Legal, Product, Technology, Risk, and external advisors.

 - Develop scalable models, AI agents, and analytical tools that strengthen opportunity screening, target intelligence, diligence, and transaction decision-making.

 - Capture relevant integration considerations during diligence and translate findings into clear implications for value creation, execution complexity, and transaction risk.

Market Insights and Strategic Intelligence

 - Design and operate Trulioo’s enterprise market insights program as a continuously running intelligence engine for strategy, product development, investment, and commercialization.

 - Produce forward-looking insights, including market landscapes, competitive positioning, opportunity sizing, thematic investment perspectives, regulatory outlooks, and voice-of-the-customer analysis.

 - Build repeatable methods for gathering, validating, synthesizing, and distributing intelligence across the organization.

 - Translate complex signals into clear strategic implications, executive-level reporting, and actionable recommendations.

 - Deliver relevant insights to executives, Product, Engineering, Risk and Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and GTM teams through recurring briefings, dashboards, decision forums, and targeted analyses.

 - Develop measures that demonstrate how market intelligence improves strategic decisions, product prioritization, capital allocation, and commercial outcomes.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 15+ years of experience across corporate strategy, corporate development, strategic finance, management consulting, market intelligence, transformation, or related leadership roles.

 - Significant experience in one or more relevant sectors, including payments, financial services, banking, marketplaces, SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, or RegTech.

 - A degree in economics, business, finance, strategy, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

 - A builder mindset and strong experience working and deploying AI tools and models to improve functional processes, drive automation, rethink problem solving, and transform traditional ways of working.

 - Demonstrated experience developing corporate or product strategies and translating them into enterprise priorities, functional roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.

 - Experience operating in complex, global, and highly cross-functional organizations.

 - Experience leading large-scale strategic or transformation programs involving multiple executives, functions, and dependencies.

 - Meaningful experience supporting acquisitions, including opportunity assessment, target screening, due diligence, transaction analysis, and integration planning.

 - Advanced analytical and scenario-planning capabilities, with the ability to work through ambiguity and make clear recommendations from incomplete or conflicting information.

 - Exceptional executive communication skills and experience preparing materials for executive leadership, Boards, and external advisors.

 - The judgment and executive presence to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, facilitate difficult trade-offs, and drive decisions.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Exposure to identity verification, fraud prevention, credit insights, financial crime, or regulatory technology.

 - Experience supporting IPO readiness, public-company strategy, or Board-level capital allocation processes.

 - Direct experience leading post-acquisition integration or value-creation programs.

 - An advanced degree in economics, business, finance, or a related discipline.





Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.



We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification. 



Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn https://ca.linkedin.com/company/trulioo, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com http://www.trulioo.com



If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.



Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy https://www.trulioo.com/website-privacy-policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

lever:veeva:29fabe4e-f12a-4120-aed4-ba90.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.   At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.   As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.   Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role Veeva Ostro sits at the intersection of life sciences, marketing, and artificial intelligence. We empower pharmaceutical brands, healthcare providers (HCPs), and patients by orchestrating AI-enabled omnichannel engagement across the entire patient and prescriber lifecycle.   As the Data Analytics Lead, you will own the data systems and associated measurement analyses that sit at the intersection of our products, customers, and commercial strategy. Our products generate significant data as users ask questions and take action, and you will work with the product team to surface and execute on insights that govern how our product evolves. This data is also used by our customers in their planning efforts, and you will work closely with our client service and implementation teams to enable and deliver on customized analyses that reflect the nuances of each client’s strategy. To deliver on the above, you will proactively architect, build, and scale the next generation of our data platform to make it modern, scalable, and AI-ready. What You'll Do:
  • Modern Data Architecture & Engineering: Work alongside platform and data engineers to upgrade our existing data architecture to be high fidelity, AI-ready, and easily accessible for both internal and external users
  • Customer Data Integrations: Guide the execution of data integrations into select customer systems in partnership with our solutions engineering team
  • Product Analyses: Uplevel our standard suite of analytics and measurement insights in partnership with our product team
  • Custom Analyses: Execute on client-specific, custom analytical requests in partnership with our client services team
  • Leadership & Team Mentorship: Direct and grow a team of data analysts and data engineers
    • Requirements:
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL / Python and strong capabilities in data modeling, advanced quantitative analysis, and working with large data sets
  • Strong command of modern data architecture particularly in enabling AI readiness. You will not be the sole engineer building every component yourself, but you need enough technical depth to actively participate in the design and build
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data science/analytics and/or data engineering roles including in a managerial capacity leading teams
  • Recent work experience should relate to the pharmaceutical / life sciences industry (not necessarily at a pharmaceutical / life sciences company)
  • Undergrad or masters in a technical discipline (computer science, statistics, engineering, math, physics, etc.)
    • Interviewing with Veeva:
    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision. 
    • Perks & Benefits:
  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • PTO and company-paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program
    • Compensation:
  • Base pay: $200,000 - $300,000 CAD
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

About Xanadu: Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere.

At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

 Your role and responsibilities:
 We are looking for a motivated and technically capable Technical Project Manager (TPM) to join our Engineering / Program Management team in Toronto to help drive complex engineering projects from planning through successful delivery. In this full-time role, you will work closely with engineering, R&D, and cross-functional teams to establish project plans, track execution, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure teams remain aligned on priorities, milestones, and deliverables.

- Lead the planning and execution of technical projects from initiation through completion.

- Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and dependencies.

- Develop, track, and maintain project schedules and execution plans using project management tools to improve visibility, accountability, and execution.

- Identify schedule, resource, technical, and execution risks early and drive mitigation plans.

- Partner closely with engineering leads, architects, and other stakeholders.

- Facilitate project kickoffs, planning sessions, status reviews, and retrospectives.

- Establish clear ownership and accountability across project activities while managing cross-team dependencies and resolving execution blockers.

- Drive alignment when there are competing priorities or changing requirements.

- Understand and communicate the impact of technical decisions on schedule, scope, cost, and resources.

- Maintain clear and accurate project documentation, ensuring important decisions and action items are documented and followed through.

- Provide concise project status updates to engineering leadership and stakeholders, establishing effective communication mechanisms across teams and time zones.

- Identify opportunities to continuously improve project execution, planning, tracking, communication, and project management best practices.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- 2–5 years of experience in technical project management or engineering roles.

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- Experience working with software, hardware, systems, or other technical engineering teams.

- Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to identify risks, dependencies, and blockers and drive them toward resolution.

 Preferred qualifications and experience:

- Experience working in a startup or fast-paced technology environment.

- Experience managing projects involving multiple engineering disciplines or teams.

- Experience with technical product development, hardware/software integration, semiconductor, quantum computing, or other advanced technology environments.

- Experience creating project schedules, roadmaps, dashboards, and status reports.

- PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or other project/program management certification.

- Technical background or previous experience working as an engineer, developer, systems engineer, or technical analyst.

This is for a new position. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and internal benchmarks. The base salary range is 90,000 - 120,000 CAD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive, safe, and equitable culture and fostering an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We are committed to meeting the needs of all individuals and support a barrier-free workplace. ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Delivery Manager to act as a senior implementation leader within our Solution Consulting organization. While our Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects guide customers through day-to-day deployments, the Solutions Director steps in as the strategic anchor for our largest, most complex, and highest-stakes enterprise implementations.

In this role, you will be responsible for three core pillars:

 1. Executive Oversight of Complex Deployments: Taking ownership of implementation success for strategic, global, and highly complex customer deployments (multi-entity, multi-ERP integrations, complex change management).

 2. Team Strategy & Process Scalability: Re-architecting and refining our implementation methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery playbooks to support hyper-growth.

 3. Leadership Development: Mentoring, coaching, and upskilling a team of talented Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects, cultivating the next generation of professional services leaders at Zip.

If you are an experienced consulting or professional services leader who loves combining big-picture strategy with hands-on technical problem-solving, we want to hear from you.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead Our Most Complex Projects: Serve as the Executive Sponsor and senior implementation authority on strategic, Fortune 500, and highly customized enterprise deployments. Partner directly with C-suite executives and key customer stakeholders to navigate organizational complexity, mitigate deployment risk, and ensure time-to-value.

 - Define Implementation Strategy & Playbooks: Evaluate current delivery methodologies and design scalable, repeatable processes for discovery, solution architecture, workflow design, and testing. Drive standardization across the team without sacrificing flexibility.

 - Drive Leadership Development: Act as a player-coach and mentor to Senior Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects. Provide strategic guidance on project governance, stakeholder management, and technical delivery while fostering a high-performance, collaborative team culture.

 - Cross-Functional Executive Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership. Translate complex implementation learnings and customer feedback into actionable product roadmap inputs and pre-sales scoping improvements.

 - Establish Governance & Quality Standards: Implement rigorous project health monitoring, risk escalation frameworks, and quality assurance standards to maintain exceptional customer satisfaction (CSAT) and net revenue retention (NRR).




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Senior Implementation Experience: 10+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation, professional services, solutions architecture, or management consulting—with at least 4+ years in a senior leadership or director-level capacity at a SaaS or B2B enterprise technology company.

 - Proven Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated success overseeing complex, multi-workstream deployments for large-scale enterprises (e.g., integrations with major ERPs like Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle; global rollouts; complex compliance and security requirements).

 - Strategic Process Builder: A track record of scaling professional services or implementation teams from startup/mid-market to enterprise maturity by designing robust methodologies, playbooks, and KPIs.

 - Passionate People Leader: Exceptional focus on mentorship and leadership development. You take pride in coaching individual contributors into top-tier strategic advisors and future team managers.

 - Executive Presence: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Comfortable challenging assumptions, managing scope creep, and guiding C-level customer stakeholders through transformative change.

 - Domain Expertise: Familiarity with procurement, finance, accounting, accounts payable (AP automation), or supply chain workflows is a strong plus.




WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

 - High Impact: You will play a defining role in shaping how Zip delivers value to our largest customers, directly influencing our growth and operational maturity.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a world-class team of builders, problem-solvers, and industry experts who are passionate about customer success.

 - Competitive Compensation: Top-tier salary, generous equity packages, and comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.

 - Flexibility: Work in an environment that values autonomy, ownership, and results over micromanagement.

This posting is for a current vacancy.

As part of our hiring process, Zip uses AI-enabled tools to assist in screening and assessing candidates, including resume review and interview documentation. All hiring decisions are made by people.





PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈  Start-up equity

 - 🦷  Health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️  Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

 - 🌴  Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️  ClassPass membership

 - 🚍  Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻  Home office stipend

 - 🛜  Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🏠  Hybrid model + 5 flexible remote days per quarter

 - 🍼  Paid parental leave 

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒  Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

 - 🤖  Unlimited AI token usage



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

 About the Role 

 We're looking for a business, product, and customer-oriented Senior Product Data Scientist to be the analytics partner for the Workday Data Cloud business. This role requires focused passion and excitement unlocking data insights that directly tie to strategic execution. 

 This role sits at the intersection of Workday's Data Cloud business, partnering directly with the Data Cloud organization (SVP/GM, Product Management, Engineering, and GTM teams) to bring analytical rigor and powerful business insights to a fast-growing, consumption-based product line. You will be the investigatory lead on a number of broad business questions. You will dive into the raw business data, find the root cause, and deliver an opinionated, decision-ready conclusion, not just more data.  

 You'll need to become a genuine subject-matter expert in Workday Data Cloud's business data landscape, working closely with the Workday Data Cloud GM and Product Management team. - Operate directly with SVP/GM-level stakeholders, translating a stream of layered, high-velocity questions into structured analysis without needing fully scoped requirements up front. 

- Translate ambiguous business, data, and platform questions into simple and focused conclusions, independently and with strategic judgment 

- Support consumption-based pricing and impact analysis for Workday Data Cloud, including sensitivity analysis, exploring new business models and driving business growth 

- Navigate real data-maturity and instrumentation gaps with autonomy: identifying what already exists, what must be built, and when to escalate. 

- Contribute well-documented, curated data assets and context back into the shared knowledge base so that analysis compounds over time and can eventually be self-served. 

- Design and influence Workday Data Cloud internal business data connections, collaborating with Product Management and engineering teams on the design, scalability, and sustainability of associated pipelines. 

- Leverage strong data ETL and data processing expertise to manage multi-step flows across product telemetry and observability systems 

- Demonstrate urgency and autonomy in problem-solving, proactively navigating cross-functional teams to identify and implement solutions for both known and emerging business challenges.

- 6-8 years experience working autonomously in a highly matrixed, collaborative corporate environment.

- 5+ years experience in enterprise BI platforms (e.g.,Tableau, Sigma )
