1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



Team Description

The Technical Account Management team ensures customers realize long-term value from their 1Password investment. We combine technical expertise with customer advocacy, guiding organizations from implementation through adoption, expansion, and renewal. Our team partners closely with Onboarding and Implementation, Customer Success Managers, Product, Support, and Enablement to ensure customers experience a seamless journey post-sale.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password and moving with urgency to solve what matters most.

Summary

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you’ll own the technical side of the post-sale customer lifecycle. You’ll guide implementations, drive adoption, and act as a trusted technical advisor on identity, access, device trust, and SaaS security, driving tangible outcomes for our customers and helping shape the future of access management.  You’ll take on strategic accounts, mentor peers, and influence how we scale customer engagement, processes, and best practices across the organization. You’ll balance technical depth with business acumen, always with an eye on driving customer value and retention.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Consultant) within  a SaaS or security focused B2B environment.

 - Proven ability to lead technical onboarding and implementation conversations with both technical and business stakeholders throughout the entire post-sale journey.

 - Strong communication, storytelling, and demo skills. You are able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.

 - Experience driving customer adoption, expansion, or renewal through proactive technical engagement.

 - Strong understanding of modern security frameworks SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR) and identity protocols (e.g. SSO-SAML/OIDC, SCIM).

 - Advanced real-world experience with various SaaS products and cloud-based infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes, and command-line interfaces to name a few.

 - Previously working in or adjacent experience to the DevOps space.

 - Experience working directly with scripting/automation or software development.

 - The ability to take on new technologies with the challenges they bring and quickly become a subject matter expert for the rest of your team.

 - Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment, while collaborating cross-functionally.

 - Familiarity with AI technologies and the ability to advise customers on evolving product roadmaps.

 - Experience mentoring peers, shaping enablement, and improving customer lifecycle processes.

 - Experience with 1Password (or other password managers), SaaS lifecycle management, MDM or device posture tools is a strong plus.

What You Can Expect

 - Own post-sale technical relationships, guiding customers from onboarding through adoption and renewal.

 - Lead technical implementation, including integrations, configuration, and security reviews.

 - Act as the technical advisor for assigned accounts, ensuring customers are set up for long-term success.

 - Partner with Customer Success Managers to proactively identify risks, drive expansion opportunities, and maximize customer value.

 - Contribute to strategic customer health reviews and success planning across the full 1Password ecosystem.

 - Represent the customer voice internally by sharing feedback with Product, Marketing, and Support.

 - Create and maintain resources (playbooks, knowledge base, etc) that scale customer impact.

 - Mentor junior team members, contribute to enablement, and shape scalable processes.

 - Act as an escalation point for complex technical challenges and strategic accounts.

 - Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

Success looks like:

 - Customers achieving full technical implementation within target timelines.

 - Increased adoption of integrations (EPM (SSO, SCIM), EPM Dev Tools, SaaS Manager, Device Trust, Privileged Access).

 - Positive customer feedback and renewal growth driven by proactive technical guidance.

 - Mentoring peers and helping mature TAM processes for scale.

 

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $124,000 USD and $180,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $113,000 CAD and $164,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

 - Comfort working in changing environments where teams are building new programs, processes, and operating models from the ground up.

 - Preferred: experience using Artificial Intelligence tools to support program design, experimentation, and campaign optimization; experience with 1Password and/or cybersecurity is also valued.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

• 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales strategy and operations within Business-to-Business (B2B) software, including 3+ years leading teams.

• Deep experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, and operating rhythms across multiple segments.

• Experience leading annual planning, territory design, quota setting, and in-year adjustments.

• Experience supporting sales organizations across multiple regions, including Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).

• Ability to build trusted relationships with senior Sales leaders, communicate clearly, and influence decisions using sound judgment and data.

• Experience hiring, developing, and coaching strong sales or revenue operations leaders.

• Experience using Salesforce and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve forecasting, pipeline management, or sales productivity.



What you can expect:

• Partner with Sales leaders to set quarterly priorities, align hiring plans and trade-offs, and create recovery plans when teams fall behind.

• Establish consistent global standards for forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

• Develop independent forecasts for each team, lead large-deal reviews, and turn insights into clear decisions.

• Improve sales productivity through stronger coverage, faster ramping, and effective support from solution engineering and Privileged Access specialists.

• Lead the use of AI in forecasting and pipeline work, helping managers reinvest time saved into selling and coaching.

• Run annual planning with Sales Strategy and Planning and Enablement so that teams begin each year with clear territories and quotas.

• Lead and develop a high-performing global field sales operations team.





USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $187,000 USD and $257,000 USD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $160,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future

💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

lever:achievers:fbcb0714-5365-4f9d-b3ff-.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
lever:achievers:fbcb0714-5365-4f9d-b3ff-.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth.  From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage,  you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role. How you'll help shape FP&A at Achievers::

Marketplace P&L Ownership & Forecasting:

  • Own the end-to-end Marketplace P&L (revenue and expenses), driving data analyses for the Marketplace Division with a goal of improving net margin contribution.
  • Build and maintain complex and dynamic forecasting models that track Marketplace potential vs. performance across key revenue pillars — including promotions, merchandising, pricing, and product enhancements.
  • Develop enhancement models for initiatives such as Top-Up programs, pricing reviews, merchandising improvements, and share-of-wallet expansion.
  • Translate high-level revenue and volume targets into actionable, customer-tier-level operating plans that enable clearer execution and performance tracking.
  • Partner with Accounting to reconcile reporting discrepancies, improve data integrity, and increase confidence in reported numbers.
  • Deliver Marketplace forecasting materials to support FP&A and Board deliverables.
  • Drive deep expense and cost driver analysis, identifying efficiency opportunities and optimizing resource allocation to improve Marketplace margin performance.
  • Own and standardize executive KPI reporting cadences, delivering consistent performance insights to senior leadership and Board stakeholders.
  • Build and scale the Marketplace analytics foundation — including structured data workflows, documentation standards, data governance, quality controls, and request prioritization — to ensure analytical consistency, scalability, and reduced dependency on ad hoc analysis.

    • NRR & Existing Customer ARR Forecasting:

  • Forecast existing customer ARR to support Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets and provide visibility into renewal and expansion performance.
  • Integrate Finance data (ARR, customer segmentation) with Marketplace redemption data to close the loop between commercial performance and customer behavior.
  • Develop share-of-wallet models to quantify expansion opportunities across customer segments and inform growth strategies.
  • Track changes in user and member counts for key customers over time, surfacing the impact of organizational changes on Marketplace activity and retention.
  • Provide financial insight into customer cohort behavior using Salesforce attributes (industry, tier, start date) to strengthen NRR-related decision-making.

    • Strategic Analysis & Modeling:

  • Conduct advanced analysis using statistical methods and predictive modeling to derive actionable insights on redemption volume, margin, and customer behavior.
  • Build models depicting potential business outcomes driven by changes in product and/or member behavior, framing recommendations to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Enable mix-rate reporting that isolates the true sources of performance impact across customers, products, and regions.
  • Drive member balance distribution analysis to improve understanding of redemption potential, breakage risk, and regional behavior patterns.
  • Create and maintain dashboards (rebate/commission, promotions, KPI scorecards) for senior leadership review and executive presentations.
  • Support RFP positioning, feature pricing analysis, and product/partnership ROI assessments.

    • Customer Success (CSM) Support & Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Present regularly at Customer Success forums to explain Marketplace performance, key drivers, and the financial impact of recent initiatives.
  • Meet directly with CSM partners to evaluate and refine margin drivers, ensuring alignment between customer actions and financial outcomes.
  • Create periodic customer target lists to focus CS efforts on the highest-impact growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Merchandising to optimize assortment decisions — including catalog curation, margin drivers, and new product margin requirements.
  • Partner with Product leadership to shape and prioritize the strategic roadmap, balancing customer experience innovation with initiatives that drive redemption growth and marketplace performance.
  • Collaborate across the Marketplace Senior Leadership Team to drive operational excellence, improve forecasting and planning rigor, and remove friction across the end-to-end marketplace ecosystem.
  • Support vendor review materials and scorecards to inform supplier performance discussions.

    • Ad Hoc Analysis & Financial Alignment:

  • Respond to emerging leadership questions with ad hoc analysis and forecasting to address evolving business needs.
  • Support cross-departmental analysis initiatives that influence Marketplace performance — including product campaign efficacy, promotional impact, and SWAG initiative evaluation.
  • Partner with BI and IT to advance the Marketplace data agenda, surface new insights, and improve analytical infrastructure.
  • Lead efforts to consolidate Marketplace data into structured formats for advanced analysis using tools such as Tableau Pulse and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Improve predictive modeling during peak periods (e.g., holiday redemptions) to enhance forecasting accuracy for float requirements and daily volume swings.

    • What Success Looks Like:

  • Self-starter mindset: Demonstrates a strong bias for action by independently identifying high-impact opportunities, building momentum around new ideas, and driving initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Analytical infrastructure: You've built a comprehensive data and modeling framework connecting redemption activity, customer behavior, and financial performance — giving the organization a clear lens into Marketplace outcomes.
  • Forecast accuracy & depth: You maintain a suite of forecasting and enhancement models that allow leadership to understand the drivers needed to close gaps between baseline and stretch targets.
  • Cross-functional impact: Teams across Finance, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product rely on your insight to make better decisions about volume, margin, and revenue.
  • Operational clarity: High-level targets have been translated into actionable, customer-level plans that teams can execute and track throughout the year.
    • Experience we feel will set you up for success::
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in strategic analytics or FP&A within a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Strong background in advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and predictive forecasting techniques.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) and querying languages (SQL).
  • Advanced Excel skills (macros, arrays, pivots, lookups, conditional logic).
  • Ability to interpret complex data sets and translate findings into compelling, executive-ready narratives.
  • Deep understanding of P&L dynamics, margin analysis, and revenue forecasting.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive outcomes without direct authority.
  • Independent self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset and strong sense of urgency.

    • Preferred - A Huge Upside:

  • E-commerce, retail, rewards, or marketplace experience: candidates who understand redemption dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior will have a significant head start in this role.
  • Familiarity with NRR / ARR forecasting and customer retention analytics.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboard creation.
  • Exposure to tools like Tableau Pulse, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI-enabled analytics platforms.

lever:achievers:f86a7af7-2346-4cef-99ca-.title: Senior Deal Desk Analyst ⭐
lever:achievers:f86a7af7-2346-4cef-99ca-.description:
We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Senior Analyst, Deal Desk to help evolve and mature our Deal Desk function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines day-to-day deal execution with subject matter expertise and functional ownership. You will operate as both a player and a builder—owning deal desk ticket execution and complex deal support while driving process optimization, automation, and scalable improvements.    You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to structure high-quality deals across land, expand, and renewal motions, directly impacting ARR growth, deal velocity, and long-term customer value. You will enable efficient deal progression while also building the frameworks, guardrails, and processes that create consistency and scale. You will balance strong collaboration and commercial flexibility with clear standards and operational rigor, ensuring deals support both immediate revenue objectives and sustainable growth, while reducing friction in the deal process by improving upfront clarity and enabling stronger deal structuring at the source. How you'll own the Deal Desk function at Achievers::
  • Own and execute day-to-day Deal Desk support, including managing deal reviews, pricing requests, discount approvals, and contract structuring across new business, expansion, and renewal deals
  • Lead complex and non-standard deals, providing strategic guidance on pricing, licensing models, and commercial constructs
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to structure competitive, scalable, and complian deals, acting as a thought partner to drive the right deal outcomes—not simply an approval step
  • Provide clear guidance and transparency on pricing, approvals, and deal structures to help Sales and Customer Success navigate trade-offs and drive more efficient deal execution
  • Apply sound judgment to balance sales velocity with pricing integrity, margin protection, and long-term revenue outcomes
  • Act as the primary liaison between Sales, Legal, and Finance to align on contract terms, approvals, and deal strategy
  • Support commissions processes during monthly and quarterly cycles by contributing to crediting validation, exception review, and payout accuracy, stepping in during peak periods or planned absences and applying Deal Desk judgment to ensure consistent, compliant compensation outcomes.
  • Serve as an escalation point for high-impact or non-standard deals, providing clear and data- driven recommendations
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for deal structuring, pricing strategy, and contracting best practices across the organization
  • Mentor and support Deal Desk Analysts, sharing subject matter expertise and elevating team capability, consistency, and judgment
  • Define and evolve pricing frameworks, discount matrices, approval governance, and deal guardrails
  • Build, document, and standardize Deal Desk processes, playbooks, and operating procedures to drive consistency, clarity, and scalability
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, automation, and workflow improvements to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency
  • Streamline deal approval and contract workflows to accelerate deal cycle times while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance
  • Develop reporting and dashboards to track deal performance, discounting trends, and operational effectiveness
  • Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through training and ongoing guidance on pricing, deal structuring, tools, and processes, empowering teams to structure stronger deals upfront
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, balancing collaboration and responsiveness with strong operational discipline, accountability, and consistency
    • Experience we feel will set you up for success::
  • 6+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Commissions, Sales Operations, or Revenue Operations within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Proven ability to operate in a high-volume, hands-on deal environment while contributing strategically as a subject matter expert
  • Strong expertise in SaaS pricing models, discounting, contract structuring, and deal strategy
  • Experience building, documenting, and optimizing scalable processes and workflows
  • Demonstrated experience driving process improvements and automation initiatives
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience with Sales, Customer Success, Legal,
  • Finance, and related stakeholders
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (or equivalent CRM), CLM tools, and workflow/automation systems
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills with strong analytical and data interpretation capabilities
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
  • Demonstrated ability to balance a collaborative, solution-oriented approach with adherence to business policies, guardrails, and operational consistency
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Job Description
We are looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to join our Sales Operations team and support the continued growth and evolution of our commercial organization.
This role will initially focus on Deal Desk operations , developing a strong understanding of our commercial processes, quoting and order workflows, policies, systems, and cross-functional dependencies. As the individual builds expertise and demonstrates proficiency, the role will progressively expand into broader Sales Operations initiatives, including process improvement, analytics, sales planning, technology optimization, and strategic projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving operational problems, working cross-functionally, and developing a deep understanding of how a SaaS business operates.
Key Responsibilities:
Deal Desk & Commercial Operations
Review and process sales orders to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established commercial policies and processes.
Identify order defects or process issues and work with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
Support the creation and processing of orders that cannot be completed through standard quoting or pricing workflows.
Provide day-to-day support to Sales, Customer Success, Partner teams, and other internal stakeholders on quoting, ordering, and commercial processes.
Develop expertise in pricing, quoting, approvals, order management, and the overall quote-to-order process.
Serve as a trusted resource for questions related to commercial processes and policies.
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, rework, defects, and unnecessary process complexity.
Help document, standardize, and improve Sales Operations workflows and procedures.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify root causes of operational issues and implement scalable solutions.
Support automation initiatives that improve Sales and Partner productivity.
Help ensure processes can scale as transaction volumes and business complexity increase.
Reporting, Analytics & Business Insights
As proficiency in the commercial process develops:
Support the development and maintenance of key Sales and GTM performance metrics.
Assist with dashboards, reporting, and analysis used to manage the business.
Analyze operational and sales data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Move beyond reporting what happened to helping the organization understand why it happened and what actions should be taken .
Support efforts to provide more predictive and forward-looking visibility to Sales leadership.
Sales Operations & Strategic Initiatives
Over time, participate in broader Sales Operations initiatives such as:
Sales planning and regional planning.
Quota and commission administration.
GTM technology and Sales Operations systems initiatives.
Direct Sales process and customer journey development.
Partner and Sales productivity initiatives.
QBR and business performance reviews.
New product, market, or commercial program launches.
AI and automation initiatives within GTM workflows.
Cross-functional strategic initiatives involving Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Marketing, Product, and other teams.
Nous recherchons un(e) Spécialiste des opérations de ventes pour se joindre à notre équipe des Opérations de ventes et soutenir la croissance continue et l'évolution de notre organisation commerciale.
Ce poste se concentrera d'abord sur les opérations du Deal Desk , permettant d'acquérir une solide compréhension de nos processus commerciaux, de nos flux de travail de soumission et de commande, de nos politiques, de nos systèmes et des interdépendances entre les équipes. À mesure que la personne développera son expertise et démontrera sa maîtrise, le poste s'élargira progressivement vers des initiatives plus vastes en Opérations de ventes, notamment l'amélioration des processus, l'analyse, la planification des ventes, l'optimisation technologique et les projets stratégiques.
Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion pour une personne qui aime résoudre des problèmes opérationnels, collaborer avec plusieurs équipes et développer une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d'une entreprise SaaS.
Principales responsabilités
Opérations du Deal Desk et opérations commerciales
Réviser et traiter les commandes de vente afin d'en assurer l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité et la conformité aux politiques et processus commerciaux établis.
Repérer les défauts ou problèmes de processus liés aux commandes et collaborer avec les équipes concernées pour les résoudre.
Soutenir la création et le traitement des commandes qui ne peuvent être complétées par les flux de travail standards de soumission ou de tarification.
Offrir un soutien quotidien aux équipes des ventes, du succès client, des partenaires et à d'autres parties prenantes internes concernant les soumissions, les commandes et les processus commerciaux.
Développer une expertise en tarification, soumission, approbations, gestion des commandes et dans l'ensemble du processus de soumission à commande.
Agir comme ressource de confiance pour toute question relative aux processus et politiques commerciaux.
Amélioration des processus et excellence opérationnelle
Repérer les occasions de réduire le travail manuel, les reprises, les défauts et la complexité inutile des processus.
Contribuer à documenter, normaliser et améliorer les flux de travail et procédures des Opérations de ventes.
Collaborer avec des équipes transversales pour cerner les causes profondes des problèmes opérationnels et mettre en œuvre des solutions évolutives.
Soutenir les initiatives d'automatisation qui améliorent la productivité des ventes et des partenaires.
Contribuer à faire en sorte que les processus puissent s'adapter à l'augmentation des volumes de transactions et de la complexité commerciale.
Rapports, analyses et perspectives d'affaires
À mesure que la maîtrise du processus commercial se développe :
Soutenir l'élaboration et le maintien des principaux indicateurs de performance des ventes et de la mise en marché (GTM).
Contribuer aux tableaux de bord, aux rapports et aux analyses utilisés pour gérer l'entreprise.
Analyser les données opérationnelles et commerciales afin de dégager des tendances, des risques et des occasions.
Aller au-delà du simple compte-rendu des faits pour aider l'organisation à comprendre pourquoi ils sont survenus et quelles mesures doivent être prises.
Soutenir les efforts visant à offrir à la direction des ventes une visibilité plus prospective et prédictive.
Opérations de ventes et initiatives stratégiques
Avec le temps, participer à des initiatives plus vastes en Opérations de ventes, notamment:
La planification des ventes et la planification régionale.
L'administration des quotas et des commissions.
Les initiatives technologiques liées à la mise en marché et aux systèmes d'Opérations de ventes.
Le développement des processus de vente directe et du parcours client.
Les initiatives de productivité des partenaires et des ventes.
Les revues trimestrielles d'affaires (QBR) et les bilans de performance commerciale.
Le lancement de nouveaux produits, marchés ou programmes commerciaux.
Les initiatives d'intelligence artificielle et d'automatisation dans les flux de travail liés à la mise en marché.
Les initiatives stratégiques transversales impliquant les ventes, le succès client, les finances, le marketing, le produit et d'autres équipes.

greenhouse:ada18:5248458007.description:
About Us 

 Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

 Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

 Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

 At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

 Learn more at  www.ada.cx .

 Our Role 

 The Accelerate Account Manager owns a portfolio of around 60 customers representing roughly $2.5M in annual revenue. Your main job is keeping those customers happy, healthy, and renewing. You'll make sure they're getting real results from Ada, catch risk early, and run renewals from start to finish. You'll also carry an expansion target and will give you real experience owning a number and spotting growth opportunities, with coaching and support around you as you build those skills. 

This is a scaled, high-volume role. You won't go deep on a handful of accounts. You'll learn to manage a full book: knowing where to spend your time, which accounts need attention this week, and how to keep everyone else moving forward without a lot of hand-holding.

 About You 

- 1+ year of experience in a customer-facing or commercial role, such as Account Manager, BDR/SDR, Customer Success, or Account Executive, ideally in B2B SaaS.

- You're organized and comfortable juggling a lot of accounts at once without letting things slip.

- You like talking to customers and you're good at figuring out what they actually care about.

- You're curious about how a business runs and want to understand the numbers behind your customers' results.

- You stay calm when a customer is frustrated and you follow through on what you say you'll do.

- You're coachable. You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better quickly.

- You can explain what a customer needs to internal teams like Support, Product, and Solutions in a clear, simple way.

- You're comfortable in tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, or MS Office, and pick up new software fast.

- Bonus: you've carried a quota or target before, even a small one.

 Outcomes 

- Retain your book. Own renewals across your portfolio and hit your retention target. Start renewal conversations early and don't let anything show up as a surprise.

- Keep customers healthy. Track usage, automation rates, and account health. Spot at-risk accounts early and build a plan to turn them around.

- Show customers the value they're getting. Run regular check-ins and business reviews that connect Ada to results the customer cares about, like resolved conversations, cost savings, or team capacity.

- Grow where it makes sense. Find expansion opportunities inside your book, such as higher conversation volume, new channels, or new use cases, and work toward your expansion target.

- Build relationships. Get to know your day-to-day contacts well and build connections with the decision-makers who own the budget and the renewal.

- Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce up to date and give a clear, honest read on renewals and pipeline every week.

- Know when to escalate. Recognize when an account has outgrown Accelerate or needs more senior help, and bring in the right people.

 The expected salary range for this position is $130,000 - $170,000 OTE. Actual pay will be determined based on several factors such as past experience and qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

 #LINS1 
 Benefits & Perks 

 At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer:

 Benefits 

- Unlimited Vacation: Recharge when you need to.

- Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance.

- Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle.

- Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones.

 Perks 

- Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life.

- Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub.

- Learning & Development Budget: Invest in your long-term growth goals and skills.

- Work from Home Budget: Equipping you with the tools and support for a seamless remote work experience.

- Access to Cutting-Edge AI Tools: Work with the best AI tech stack in the industry.

- Hands-On with LLMs: Enhance your expertise in leveraging large language models.

- A Thriving Industry: Join the forefront of innovation in AI, shaping the future of technology.

 The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI enabled tools to support certain aspects of hiring, such as interview note-taking. All hiring decisions are made by our team.

 Thank you for your interest in joining us at Ada. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact candidates whose qualifications match closely to the requirements of the position. We appreciate the time you have invested in learning more about us.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Brand & Communications team

Brand and Communications shapes how the world sees Affirm, and how Affirm chooses to be seen. That means showing up where perception takes shape: in culture and press, across Affirm's owned and paid channels, and within the company. We hold a high standard for craft and clarity, and we work to make Affirm a brand people understand, trust, and are proud to choose.

 About the Role

We're looking for a Brand Manager to turn business priorities and consumer insight into campaigns that shift perception and drive measurable demand. You’ll own campaign strategy from brief through launch and retros, aligning partners, sharpening priorities, and ensuring every expression builds a more distinctive, trusted and effective Affirm brand.

 What You’ll Do 

- 
 Own campaign strategy and architecture for priority brand and partner moments, including co-marketing projects with key merchants and ongoing merchant and promotional campaigns outside the major seasonal moments. Translate business goals, audience insight, and brand strategy into briefs and recommendations that shape how Affirm invests in these moments, not just how individual campaigns execute.

- 
 Drive early strategic thinking and lead brief development for partner campaigns, shaping how Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Creative, Social, Paid, and Comms work together on audience, narrative, channel roles, and definition of success. Advise these teams on tradeoffs and complex calls, and review creative to ensure execution teams have what they need to build and ship excellent work.

- 
 Set campaign GTM strategy and investment priorities across brand and partner moments, determining how Brand Operations resources timelines and workflow and how channel leads allocate budget.

- 
 Build a learning culture. Define what's working across campaigns and turn it into reusable frameworks and standards that make every future effort stronger.

- 
 Own brand measurement and reporting in partnership with paid and analyst functions, both for brand overall and campaign by campaign. Maintain the integrity of the brand health tracker, hold execution partners accountable to the brief, and give leadership a clear, recurring read on what's working and what needs to change.

 What We Look For 

- 
 You have 8-10 years in brand marketing, integrated marketing, or a closely related discipline, with experience managing full campaigns from strategy to launch, ideally at both an agency and in-house teams.

- 
 As a natural creative thinker and problem solver yourself, you know how to partner and get strong creative out of a team. You've briefed and run creative work that landed sharp, on strategy, on budget and on time.

- 
 You have a track record of building brand awareness, equity, and differentiation through data and consumer insight, and can evaluate performance against business KPIs.

- 
 You're comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed marketing organization, and you’re capable of  building alignment across cross-functional partners through influence.

- 
 You use data to develop and articulate a clear point of view, while staying collaborative and open to new information changing your mind.

- 
 Bonus. Experience with extending campaigns to global markets, and working in fintech, financial services, or another trust-sensitive category is a plus.

 Pay Grade - L

 The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

 About the role 

 Affirm is seeking a Compliance Manager to own compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program. You'll make independent, risk-based calls across card marketing, onboarding, disputes, and remediation, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations to ship card features that are compliant and built to last.

 What you'll do 

- 
 Own end-to-end compliance advisory for the Affirm Card program, including card marketing, checkout, onboarding, wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), disputes, and servicing, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Operations throughout the development lifecycle

- 
 Bring an appetite for the unknown: much of what we build on Card is genuinely new and without precedent, and you take on that ambiguity rather than wait for a playbook

- 
 Apply sound judgment under EFTA (Reg E), TILA (Reg Z)/CARD Act, UDAAP, to navigate novel regulatory questions, escalating only where it's genuinely warranted

- 
 Partner with Compliance Testing, Legal, and Risk to prepare for and support regulatory exams and bank partner audits related to the Card program

- 
 Maintain and contribute to the Card program's compliance risk assessment and control inventory, proactively identifying and closing coverage gaps

- 
 Develop and maintain compliance training and reference materials specific to Card regulatory requirements

- 
 Serve as the go-to compliance expert on new and evolving Card features, surfacing risk early in the product lifecycle rather than after launch

 What we look for 

- 
 8+ years of experience in a compliance advisory role within financial services with a Bachelor's degree (6+ years with a Master's degree, or 3+ years with a PhD, or equivalent), with meaningful experience on card, payments; compliance certifications a plus

- 
 Deep working knowledge of EFTA (Reg E) and TILA (Reg Z)/CARD Act as applied to card products, plus familiarity with TISA (Reg DD) and UDAAP; hands-on experience with card network rules (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) is a big plus

- 
 Comfortable partnering closely with Product from the early stages of a build, whether a new product, feature, or servicing program, in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- 
 Experience owning issues from root-cause analysis through sustainable remediation, with a bias toward fixing the underlying control rather than the immediate symptom

- 
 Experience advising and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Operations stakeholders on a card, lending, or payments program

- 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present complex, nuanced regulatory issues to non-compliance audiences

- 
 Self-directed with strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills; comfortable being the compliance voice in the room on card-specific questions, including presenting to senior leadership and leadership committees

 Inquisitive and proactive in identifying problems and proposing practical, business-aware solutions

greenhouse:affirm:8009661003.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm, you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams.

 This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy—monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery—while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6–12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership.

 A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team.

 What You'll Do

- 
 Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries—so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.

- 
 Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.

- 
 Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.

- 
 Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives—expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations—that grow the value of the accounts after launch.

- 
 Design and deliver high-scope, often-custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations—combining, extending, and tailoring them to complex, open-ended problems while balancing speed, quality, maintainability, reliability, and scalability.

- 
 Act as a technical lead for internal projects, defining and delivering well-scoped milestones and executing the project roadmap.

- 
 Operationalize best practices by creating and updating playbooks, runbooks, alerting, and UAT certification plans across the strategic alliance portfolio and continuously reduce keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work.

- 
 Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.

- 
 Mentor and level up less-experienced TAMs, share learnings from your integrations and investigations, and contribute to interviewing and team development.

- 
 Over your first 6–12 months, grow into owning a dedicated book of strategic alliance accounts—carrying operational ownership through to end-to-end account ownership.

 What We Look For

- 
 Professional Background: at least six years in a technical, external-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions/Partner Engineering, or Solutions Architecture—ideally within FinTech, payments, or SaaS—with a demonstrated track record of owning the operational health of technical accounts and delivering against SLAs.

- 
 Operational Ownership: proven ability to run alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical inquiries across a set of accounts, balancing reactive operational work with proactive initiatives.

- 
 Ownership & Autonomy: proven ability to independently scope and deliver complex, open-ended technical work, and to partner with stakeholders on launch initiatives, with strong project management and follow-through.

- 
 API Expertise: deep understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and the HTTP protocol, with hands-on experience using tools like Postman to debug and validate integrations.

- 
 Architecture Fluency: Experience in API integrations and the ability to design custom solutions on top of them to solve complex merchant challenges.

- 
 Coding & Code Fluency: ability to read and understand production-level code (HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and ideally one server-side language such as Python) and to author new, novel queries to diagnose merchant or system issues.

- 
 Troubleshooting Acumen: ability to diagnose issues using browser developer consoles, log analysis and observability platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Chronosphere), and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Notion).

- 
 Technical Communication: excellent verbal and written communication; able to tailor explanations to both non-technical leaders and technical teams, read a room and adjust in real time, and synthesize technical challenges back to internal teams.

- 
 Relationship Management: ability to discover and develop relationships with technical decision-makers, secure written consensus on integration milestones, and drive cross-team collaboration.

- 
 Leadership & Mentorship: demonstrated ability to mentor teammates, set best practices, and lead technical initiatives; a growth mindset with self-awareness and a habit of seeking and acting on feedback.

 Nice to Have

- 
 Familiarity with the payments ecosystem.

- 
 Familiarity with web/mobile application architecture.

- 
 Experience implementing or customizing e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, or in-store point-of-sale systems.

- 
 Experience acting as a technical lead on cross-functional projects and influencing product roadmaps.

 Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. 

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $133,000 - $183,000

 Location - Remote Canada
 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

 #LI-Remote 

 Remote-first with flexibility built in 
 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you 
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

 We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

 About Our Team 

 Visual Design turns complex financial products into experiences customers can understand, trust, and remember. Through motion, illustration, and visual storytelling, we connect brand promise to product reality, bringing clarity and cohesion to every moment, from discovery and onboarding to everyday use.
We partner with Product Design, Brand, Content Design, Engineering, and Product Marketing to create expressive, accessible, and scalable experiences across Affirm’s ecosystem. Our role is to elevate the quality of execution, build visual systems that help teams move with consistency, and use craft to guide attention, explain value, and create moments of confidence and delight. We ensure Affirm does not simply work well - it communicates clearly, feels unmistakably our own, and earns customer trust at every touchpoint.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a motion-forward Visual Designer who brings strong craft in animation, visual storytelling, and illustration. You’ll help elevate the quality and consistency of customer experiences across Affirm’s product ecosystem, using motion to guide attention, explain product behavior, improve comprehension, and create moments of clarity and delight.

 This role sits at the intersection of product and brand. Your work will range from in-product interactions and animated illustrations to web, email communications, lifecycle journeys, and product launches. You’ll pair deep motion and visual-design craft with UX thinking and an understanding of design systems to create experiences that are cohesive, accessible, scalable, and purposeful.

 You think holistically about end-to-end customer journeys, care deeply about craft, and understand how thoughtful motion and visual systems can make experiences both functional and emotionally engaging.

 What You’ll Do 

- Design motion-forward experiences across in-app surfaces, web, email, lifecycle comms, and product marketing, with a focus on clarity, accessibility, performance, and storytelling.

- Create animations, motion studies, animated illustrations, iconography, and interaction patterns that explain product behavior, guide attention, and improve customer comprehension.

- Own defined visual and motion-design projects from concept and storyboarding through production and implementation, maintaining a consistently high level of craft.

- Contribute to product-design initiatives by mapping user flows, developing interaction concepts, and carrying solutions through high-fidelity design and prototyping.

- Create and extend reusable visual assets, motion patterns, guidelines, and components that strengthen Affirm’s product and communication systems.

- Collaborate with Product Design, Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Brand, Content Design, Lifecycle, and Growth partners to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.

- Prepare production-ready assets and specifications, partnering with engineers to ensure motion and visual details are accessible, performant, and implemented as intended.

 What We Look For 

- 3+ years of professional experience in motion, animation, visual, communication, or product design within a product-driven environment.

- A portfolio demonstrating strong motion and visual-design craft, including animation, interaction, illustration, and storytelling across digital product experiences.

- Strong knowledge of animation principles, including timing, pacing, easing, transitions, and choreography, and proficiency with tools such as After Effects, LottieFiles, Rive, or comparable software.

- Mastery of tools including Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, LottieFiles, and relevant 2D/3D animation tools.

- Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of production environments (especially in email and mobile).

- UX and product-design experience, including an understanding of user flows, interaction design, information hierarchy, and how motion can support an end-to-end experience.

- Ability to storyboard, prototype, and articulate design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

- Ability to independently deliver defined projects, communicate design rationale, incorporate feedback, and collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, marketers, and other cross-functional partners.

equity.quote: - Experience with NetSuite is a strong asset; Big Four/public accounting, Shareworks, and equity compensation experience are considered assets.

greenhouse:alayacare:8635701002.description:
About AlayaCare

 At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.     

 With 550+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career. 

 About the Role

 As Controller, North America, you will play a key role in ensuring the integrity and accuracy of AlayaCare's financial reporting and accounting operations across Canada and the United States, supporting our mission to transform home and community care worldwide. You'll combine deep technical accounting expertise with emerging leadership responsibilities, ensuring North American financials are reported accurately under IFRS, internal controls remain strong, and the accounting team is supported and developed.

 Reporting to the Director, Finance, you'll partner closely with FP&A, the global Controller function, Revenue Operations, and external auditors while leveraging automation and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve the efficiency and quality of our financial operations. As AlayaCare continues to scale as a SaaS business, you'll help ensure our accounting function evolves alongside the complexity of subscription-based revenue, multi-currency operations, and changing regulatory requirements.

 What You’ll Do

- Lead the North American month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, delivering timely and accurate financial statements in accordance with IFRS.

- Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, intercompany transactions, and key account reconciliations for Canadian and U.S. entities, ensuring complete and accurate financial records.

- Review and reconcile revenue transactions under IFRS 15, including deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and contract modifications, to ensure accurate SaaS revenue recognition.

- Oversee subscription revenue accounting for multi-element arrangements and variable consideration, including deferred revenue and unbilled accounts receivable schedules.

- Manage Canadian and U.S. indirect tax filings and reconciliations, and support corporate income tax compliance and incentive programs such as SR&ED and CDAE.

- Lead the annual and interim audit process for North America, acting as the primary liaison with external auditors and preparing supporting schedules and documentation.

- Coach, mentor, and develop members of the North American accounting team, providing guidance on complex accounting matters while supporting hiring and onboarding.

- Partner with FP&A, Revenue Operations, and the global Controller function on financial reporting, forecasting, and strategic initiatives, while driving process improvements through NetSuite, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

 What You’ll Bring to the Team

- 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2+ years in a senior or supervisory role.

- CPA designation required (CPA, CA or CPA, CMA).

- Strong knowledge of IFRS, including IFRS 15, multi-entity consolidation.

- Experience in a SaaS or technology environment, with familiarity with subscription revenue models and ARR/MRR metrics.

- Working knowledge of Canadian and U.S. tax compliance requirements.

- Experience leading or supporting external audits.

- Strong leadership, coaching, analytical, and communication skills.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and manage competing priorities.

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve accounting processes and efficiency.

- Experience with NetSuite is a strong asset; Big Four/public accounting, Shareworks, and equity compensation experience are considered assets.

 Location and Work Model

 This role is based in Toronto. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes 2 set in-office collaboration days/week, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.

 AI at Work

 At AlayaCare, AI is a core part of how we work. Success in this role requires bringing a working knowledge of AI, having used AI tools in practice, and being able to demonstrate how AI has helped improve the quality, efficiency, or impact of your work. We look for people who can adapt to new tools and ways of working and use AI responsibly in line with our privacy and security standards. We’ll support you with the tools, training, and coaching needed to succeed in an AI‑enabled environment.

 Why Join AlayaCare?   

 Work With Purpose   

 At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.  

 Grow in a High-Trust Culture   

 We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.  

 Balance That Works for You   

 We value flexibility and well-being. From “Wellness Fridays” to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.  

 Benefits That Matter   

- Equity in a well-funded, scaling company.  

- Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.  

- Parental leave top-up and family support programs.  

 Inclusive by Design   

 We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities, both in-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.  

 Ready to Join Us?   

 Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.  

 AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically, you may request a human review.  

 We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to  careers@alayacare.com .  

 At AlayaCare, we consider a range of factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, experience, and market data. These factors may cause compensation to vary. The expected hiring range is what we reasonably anticipate offering for this position at the time of posting.

AlayaCare offers a comprehensive benefits program, which may include medical, dental, wellness, life insurance, equity participation, paid parental leave top up, and paid time off.

This expected hiring range applies only to candidates hired to perform work in Ontario. This role represents an existing vacancy at AlayaCare. AlayaCare uses artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

 Expected Hiring Range
 $115,000 — $130,000 CAD

 What great looks like in this role 

- You own outcomes, not tasks. You act without waiting to be asked and make sound calls that connect to where AlayaCare is going.

- You turn complexity into value. Leaders leave a conversation with you with a clear recommendation, not just more analysis.

- You hold the bar with care. You coach leaders to set clear expectations, differentiate performance using evidence, and act with fairness and timeliness.

- You argue hard, then commit. You challenge leaders directly and respectfully, then fully back the decision once it is made.

- You are curious about how AI changes the work. You experiment with new tools without being asked and bring leaders and teammates along.

- You adapt quickly when priorities shift, and you treat leaders, employees, and colleagues as your clients.

- Leaders in your client group run consistent, evidence-based performance and calibration conversations and rely on you as a trusted advisor.

- Complex employee relations matters are handled with sound judgment and the right legal partnership, with no surprises for leadership.

- Workforce and talent data are used to guide decisions on structure, capacity, and investment across the Revenue organization.

- AI is part of how you and the PBP team work, with visible examples of manual workflows simplified or automated and shared across the team.

- The associate People Business Partners you mentor are growing and delivering consistently.

- Lead highly complex or sensitive employee relations cases, investigations and organizational risks, partnering with Legal and other stakeholders as required.

- Lead or co-lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of organization-wide HR policies, programs, and practices.

- Analyze organizational and workforce, talent data and trends, developing proactive strategies and long-term solutions.

- Support the execution of AlayaCare’s talent strategy by translating our talent principles into practical approaches to hiring, performance, calibration, development, succession, and workforce planning that strengthen talent density and business outcomes. 

- Partner with leaders to hold a consistently high bar for performance and talent decisions: coach managers to set clear expectations, differentiate performance using evidence, run rigorous and fair calibration conversations, and act with timeliness, care, and compliance when expectations are not met.

- Advise leaders on designing clear roles and lean, high-impact teams, using workforce and business-outcome data to guide decisions on structure, capacity, and investment, and ensuring organizational changes are planned with sound judgment, legal compliance, and care for employees.

- Partner with Total Rewards and business leaders so that pay, recognition, and growth opportunities are tied to impact and expectations, and support leaders in communicating people and organizational changes with clarity, consistency, and empathy.

- Lead cross-functional People & Culture initiatives and projects with organization-wide impact

- Support AI adoption as a change leader by helping leaders translate AI expectations into role expectations, team ways of working, capability building, and performance conversations, and by identifying where AI changes how work is organized and which skills teams need next.

- Deliver advanced training, coaching and workshops that build manager capability and accountability Champion diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, and fairness in talent and people decisions across the organization.

- 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant senior HRBP experience in complex and fast-paced environments balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

- Experience supporting Revenue and Sales teams with an understanding of sales performance, and incentive-driven rewards.

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management or a related field.

- CHRP/CPHR designation strongly preferred.

- Deep knowledge of Canadian employment legislation and demonstrated experience with US employment law (multi-state).

- Experience translating talent strategy into practical approaches to performance, calibration, succession, development, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.

- Experience partnering with Total Rewards and business leaders on the design, implementation, administration, and communication of variable compensation plans, including incentive eligibility, target setting, and governance.

- Demonstrated comfort leveraging AI-enabled tools and HR technology to streamline workflows, and support the effective delivery of People practices.
