Job title: Territory Account Executive, New Brunswick, Canada 

 Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

 This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

 You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

 If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

 You will:

 Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution 

- Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.

- Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

 Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city 

- Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.

- Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.

- Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

 Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up 

- Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.

- Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

 Master your verticals and sell with precision 

- Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.

- Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

 Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment 

- Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.

- Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.

- Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

 You have:

- 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience

- Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals

- Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 

- Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)

- Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving

- A collaborative and team player mentality

- Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent

- Even better:

- 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)

- 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

gem:blue-j:am9icG9zdDpIf7Cnt_kiQrxzUjD2d.description:
About Blue J
Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence.
Backed by a $122M USD Series D funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.
We’re looking for a 
Senior Product Designer
 to help shape the future of our product experience, elevate design excellence, and establish consistent design systems that scale with us.
A Note on Location
This role is open to remote anywhere in Canada, with the expectation that you can travel and can join in-office meetings a few times per quarter at our Toronto based office location. All candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.
The Opportunity
This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape the product design function at Blue J. You'll uphold and evolve the standard for design quality, contribute to our design system, and craft seamless experiences that make complex tax research simple.
You'll work hand-in-hand with Product and Engineering to turn user insights into creative solutions, helping our product stay smooth, delightful, and loved by our customers.
This Role is a Great Fit if You:
Are excited to be part of a lean design team and help set the direction for our design systems and standards.
Have experience shipping thoughtful, user-centered products and can show how your work made an impact.
Enjoy collaborating across teams, building strong relationships with developers, PMs, and stakeholders.
Love solving challenging design problems and turning complexity into simple, intuitive experiences.
Are comfortable wearing multiple hats - from designer to systems thinker to front-end contributor - to bring great ideas to life.
Value curiosity, creativity, and collaboration — and bring a positive, playful spirit to your work.
What You’ll be Doing
Support in the design process: research, discovery, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and developer handoff.
Building and maintaining a design system, style guide, and component library that scales with our growing product.

About Blue J
Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence.
Backed by a $122M USD Series D funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.
A Note on Location
We’re excited to meet with qualified candidates and are grateful for everyone’s interest. Candidates who are within driving distance of our Kitchener–Waterloo or Toronto offices will be expected to work from the office a couple of days each week. The role also includes occasional travel for industry events, trade shows, and conferences. All candidates must be eligible to work in Canada or the US.
To help you get off to a great start, we bring all new team members together for their first three days of onboarding. If you’re based outside of our local commuting area, Blue J will arrange and cover your travel and accommodation.
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a VP, Growth Marketing to build and scale growth for the category leader in AI for tax, with funding and executive support.
You’ll lead Demand Generation, Events, and Partner Marketing, owning strategy, budget, and execution to drive qualified pipeline, revenue, and paid customer growth through account-based marketing (ABM) and trial acquisition.
In our product-led segments, you’ll grow qualified trial sign-ups aligned with our ideal customer profile and improve acquisition efficiency and website and campaign conversion. You’ll partner with Product-led Growth, which owns activation and trial-to-paid conversion, alongside Revenue Operations and Finance to refine targeting, messaging, and investment.
In our sales-led segments, you’ll engage priority accounts and buying groups, generate qualified opportunities, and support deal progression in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Brand, and Revenue Operations. Partner marketing will also contribute directly to partners’ annual recurring revenue targets.
We’re looking for a growth leader with experience developing teams and delivering measurable growth through strategic planning, practical execution, and experimentation. You’ll use data to guide decisions, explain what contributed to results, and collaborate across the business to build alignment.
What You’ll be Doing
Scale product-led acquisition
Translate annual recurring revenue (ARR) goals into trial acquisition plans by segment, market, and source, using activation and conversion assumptions agreed with the Product-led Growth team.
Grow qualified trial sign-ups from customers who align with our ideal customer profile (ICP) through paid and organic channels, content, growth loops, and partners, while improving offers, landing pages, and sign-up journeys.
Partner with Product-led Growth to understand performance across customer cohorts and refine acquisition to improve activation, paid conversion, and payback.
﻿
Scale sales-led growth through account-based marketing
Translate ARR goals into pipeline targets and account-based marketing (ABM) plans by segment, market, and account tier.
Collaborate with Sales on target accounts, buying groups, and messaging, coordinating engagement across campaigns, events, partners, and outreach.
Grow qualified pipeline volume across mid-market and enterprise segments, using closed-revenue outcomes to refine targeting and investment.
Build a culture of experimentation
Establish ongoing testing and learning across audiences, messaging, offers, channels, and conversion, with clear hypotheses and decisions informed by results.
Expand effective approaches, adjust or discontinue those that aren’t meeting objectives, and turn insights into repeatable practices.
Use AI and automation to support research, execution, personalization, and analysis.
Connect demand generation, events, and partner marketing
Build integrated campaigns that engage relevant prospects and support trial acquisition and meaningful sales conversations.
Develop events that contribute measurably to opportunity creation and deal progression.
Develop joint plans with partners to engage their audiences, support co-selling, and contribute to partner ARR targets.
Adapt programs for the UK market and allocate budget based on evidence and expected return.
Collaborate across the revenue organization
Partner with Sales, Product-led Growth, Product Marketing, Brand, and Revenue Operations on targeting, qualification, customer journey design, messaging, and consistent, reliable measurement.
Share performance insights with executive leadership, including progress, changes, learnings, and decisions that need input.
Build and support an effective team
Coach and support the development of leaders across Demand Generation, Events, and Partner Marketing, setting clear priorities and creating opportunities to experiment and learn.
Develop a mix of internal team members, agencies, and specialist expertise that supports team and business needs.
Support the team in strengthening strategic thinking, analytical practices, effective execution, and contributions to business outcomes.
What You Offer Blue J 
B2B SaaS growth at scale.
 You’ve helped scale a business from $40M to $150M ARR, with measurable contributions from trial acquisition and qualified pipeline. You can quantify your results, investment, and revenue impact, and distinguish your contribution from other factors.
Product-led acquisition expertise.
 You’ve scaled qualified trial acquisition, improved visitor-to-trial conversion, and used growth loops, and can show how your programs affected activation, trial-to-paid conversion, and payback.
Account-based marketing expertise.
 You’ve built coordinated ABM programs with Sales that engaged buying groups and grew qualified pipeline and revenue, adapting by account tier and sales cycle.
UK and European pipeline experience.
 You’ve delivered qualified pipeline and revenue in the UK and/or Europe, adapting targeting, messaging, channels, events, and partner programs to local buyers.
Performance and organic marketing depth.
 You’ve built acquisition programs and conversion journeys that diagnose performance beyond channel metrics, and grown qualified traffic through SEO, AEO, GEO, and content, including reaching professionals in consumer-dominated topics like tax.
Strong commercial judgment.
 You understand pipeline quality, sales cycles, acquisition economics, and the trade-offs between immediate returns and future growth, and you’ve integrated events and partner marketing into a measurable revenue strategy.
An experimental, adaptable approach.
 You move quickly with imperfect information, challenge assumptions, and change course when the evidence warrants it.
Leadership and influence.
 You’ve built strong teams with high standards and shared accountability, earned trust across functions, and can shape company growth strategy while still getting into the funnel data when needed.
Experience with commercial partner ecosystems or software for tax, accounting, or other professional markets is a plus.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, improve workflows, and stay ahead of industry trends 
What Success Looks Like
You’ll connect marketing investment to our ARR goals with a credible plan and a faster, more accountable operating rhythm. Success means sustained growth in qualified pipeline and trial sign-ups from our target segments, and a team that can tie its work directly to revenue.

A rare opportunity to build the growth engine for an AI SaaS company at a pivotal moment for the tax market.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
Flexibility in how you work: primarily remote, with occasional travel to our Toronto office and conferences as needed.

About the Role 

 As an Account Executive, Enterprise, you will build and grow relationships with global organizations as they transform for the AI era. Our clients are leaders in their industries, operating across markets worldwide, and we work with their C-suites and business leaders as well as the executives who run their AI, Product, Marketing, Design, and Data teams. The role operates on two fronts. First, you will help these enterprises build durable, organization-wide AI capability: the skills, processes, tools, and digital operating models their people need to work differently. On the second, you will advise senior leaders on the digital and AI innovation opportunities emerging in their industries, including how AI will reshape the products they build and the customer experiences they deliver. 

 This is transformation work. You will own a portfolio of client relationships and the pursuits within them, from the first conversation through discovery, solution shaping, proposal, and commitment, and you will stay close to the work once it begins. You will lead discovery with clients, form a view on where they stand and what they need, and work with our Strategy and delivery teams to shape engagements that deliver it. You follow developments in AI and digital technology closely and you can translate them into implications an executive will act on. You are comfortable leading conversations with executives, you can turn an ambiguous business problem into a structured point of view, and you hold a high standard for the quality of the work you put in front of a client.

 Responsibilities 

- Build and grow relationships with C-suite executives, business leaders, and the leaders of AI, Product, Marketing, Design, and Data teams, and lead strategic conversations about how their organizations build enterprise-wide AI capability

- Own a portfolio of client relationships and the pipeline of opportunities within it, and carry accountability for its growth and health

- Lead pursuits end to end, from opening the conversation through discovery, solution shaping, proposal, and commercial agreement

- Lead discovery with clients across people, process, and technology, and form a clear view of their current state, priorities, and the capability they need to build

- Work with our Strategy and delivery teams to shape engagements that address the client's needs, and remain the client's senior point of contact as the work progresses

- Develop and present our advisory point of view on digital and AI innovation, including how AI is changing products, customer experience, and competitive dynamics within a client's industry

- Design and facilitate executive workshops and working sessions that build alignment and move decisions forward

- Own the structure and quality of proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, and shape the scope and commercial structure of new engagements

 Requirements 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience 

- 3–6 years of professional experience in a client-facing role with responsibility for growing relationships with enterprise or corporate clients; experience in consulting, strategy, advisory, or professional services business development is a plus

- Track record of building a pipeline, leading pursuits, and securing new work with senior stakeholders

- Demonstrated ability to structure complex, ambiguous business problems and to develop and defend a clear point of view

- Strong executive presence and communication skills, with a track record of presenting to and advising senior stakeholders

-  Experience leading client workshops, discovery sessions, or working sessions

- Disciplined approach to pipeline management, prioritization, and follow-through across multiple pursuits concurrently

- A genuine and current interest in AI, digital technology, and how organizations transform their capabilities and operating models

- Genuine enthusiasm for in-person work and collaboration; this role follows a hybrid model with four or more days per week in the office

- Willingness to travel globally for client work as required

 Perks and Benefits 

- Mentorship Program

- Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits Package

- Retirement Planning

- Parental Leave Program

- Flexible Working Hours

- Work from Home Flexibility

- Service Recognition Programs

- Socials, Outings & Retreats

- Culture of Learning & Development

 BrainStation is the global leader in AI and digital skills training, trusted by the world's leading brands and over 40,000 professionals. Established in 2012, BrainStation empowers professionals and leading companies to build essential skills in AI, Data, Design, Marketing, and Product through live, expert-led training, and partners with organizations to build scalable, enterprise-wide AI capability.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead the Banners team, which owns Braze's in-product messaging surfaces: Content Cards and Banners.

 These are the channels that reach users inside the app experience rather than outside it. They're persistent, native, and always available, with no opt-in required and no deliverability tax. Content Cards is a mature, widely adopted surface. Banners is our newest channel and our fastest growing, having gone from launch to full feature parity with Content Cards in under a year, and now serving well over a billion impressions a day.

 Braze operates at massive scale, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end users daily. In-product surfaces are a growing share of that. The constraint on this part of the business is no longer capability. It's adoption, programmability, and making creation genuinely fast.

 The goal here is to find someone who can take a portfolio that's technically deep and commercially material, and push it into its next phase. Here's what you'd focus on in your first year:

- Drive adoption, not just delivery. The work is turning shipped capability into activated customers and sustained usage. That means better defaults, faster time to first banner, self-serve setup, and out-of-the-box integrations with platforms like Shopify

- Make creation faster and more intelligent. Banners already supports three ways to build: drag-and-drop, raw HTML, and AI-generated. Braze is investing heavily in Operator, our AI assistant, and a big part of this role is making sure these surfaces are ones Operator can actually work with. Marketers are shifting from building things themselves to letting AI build it for them. A core part of this role is pushing that path forward: making Operator, our AI assistant, a natural and differentiated way to act on a marketer’s intent

- Set the measurement bar. You'd define what good looks like for adoption, usage, and performance, and hold the team to baselines and targets that are real

 Main responsibilities:

- Define and own the roadmap for Content Cards and Banners, pulling from customers, sales, support, usage data, and competitive signal to figure out what matters most next

- Partner with engineers and designers to execute that roadmap in a lean, entrepreneurial start-up environment

- Own the commercial outcomes for your area (adoption, consumption, expansion) and understand the unit economics well enough to make good investment tradeoffs

- Establish and manage internal and external customer expectations, including with enterprise accounts and in renewal and expansion conversations

- Deeply understand our technology, business, customers, and market

- Build best-in-class infrastructure for your products, treating reliability, performance, and observability as product requirements rather than cleanup work

- Partner across the division to build reusable capability instead of channel-specific implementations. Shared editors, shared design patterns, shared APIs

 WHO YOU ARE

- 8+ years of Product Management experience, including owning a product line at scale

- Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and persuasion skills. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports and a lot of influence. You'll need to align engineering, design, our SDK team, and go-to-market without positional authority

- A proactive, positive, can-do attitude. You drive projects to completion excellently, and you're always looking for new ways that processes and products can be improved

- Comfortable being technical. You can reason about client-side rendering, SDK integration, API design, and caching well enough to make real tradeoffs with engineers rather than relaying them

- You build rich user experiences and work closely with designers. These are content creation products, so the quality of the authoring experience is the product

- Data-driven by instinct. You go to the adoption funnel and the usage data before the anecdote, and you're rigorous about baselines

- Customer-focused and commercially fluent. You understand how your product area drives consumption and expansion, and you can hold a credible conversation with an enterprise customer about why they should adopt a new channel

- Eagerness to learn and grow.

 Bonus points:

- Experience with in-product or embedded messaging surfaces. Inbox, feed, banner, or in-app content products

- Experience building rich content creation flows. Drag-and-drop editors, template systems, or WYSIWYG authoring

- Experience shipping AI features inside an existing authoring tool

- Experience with products that depend on customer-side SDK integration, and the adoption dynamics that come with that

- Strong technical experience and the ability to understand and discuss product architecture

- Experience at a high-growth technology startup

- Experience at a high-scale technology startup. We operate at the scale of billions of users

 For candidates based in the Canada, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between CA$175,000 and $274,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between CA$194,000 and $304,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  WHAT WE OFFER 

 Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. 

 From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

- Competitive compensation that may include equity

- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

- Flexible paid time off

- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

 ABOUT BRAZE 

 Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

 The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

 Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

 The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

 BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

 Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. - Define and track success metrics such as adoption, SKU attach and retention, and customer uplift, and connect product decisions to revenue impact

- Make AI transparent and trustworthy. Help marketers understand what the models are doing and why, and equip go-to-market teams to explain the value and competitive advantage of Braze Intelligence

- Work closely with Engineers and Product Designers to bring new products and features to life

- Stay close to the competitive landscape of marketing AI, and make sure Braze's lead is clear and wins deals

- Run point on launches for the Intel team, partnering with Product Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM functions

- Establish and manage internal and external stakeholder expectations, and communicate progress and decisions effectively

- Ability to work within a cross-functional team and balance multiple projects at once

- Eagerness to learn and grow

- Previously shipped ML or AI-powered products such as recommendations, personalization, optimization, or decisioning

- Performance or lifecycle marketing experience

- Experience with recommendation systems, multi-armed bandits, or reinforcement learning

- Experience working at a B2B SaaS company

- Experience at a high-scale technology startup (we operate at the scale of billions of users)

From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

 What you'll do 

 You'll lead the Product Operations team and own the operational readiness for Brex's product launches: the enablement that must be in place before a customer ever touches a new feature. You'll also own Brex's product knowledge, the Help Center, and our internal knowledge base, plus the measurement that tells us whether it lands.

 This is a role for someone who combines product manager, data, and operations skills and behaviors. You'll inherit a team that has already automated a large share of its own workflow, with a suite of production agents running much of the recurring work. Your job is not only to keep that running, but to push it further: expand what AI carries and reinvest the capacity it frees into the judgment work only people can do. We want to raise our evidence bar by using key metrics to hold ourselves accountable, focus on where the impact is greatest, and celebrate our wins. We treat AI as leverage, not as a deliverable, and we measure it by how it improves our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables.

 Where you'll work 

 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Launch readiness and enablement 

- Own launch readiness, ensuring documentation, release notes, training, and tooling are ready for each release. Adapt processes and team capacity as EPD’s release cadence evolves.

- Lead and improve OLAB, the weekly cross-functional board that assesses launch impact and aligns teams on readiness.

- Engage early in launches, using customer and product insights to shape the product experience.

- Lead customer-facing escalations and crisis response, establishing a single source of truth, coordinating communications, and running retrospectives.

 Documentation and product knowledge 

- Own the lifecycle and quality of product documentation, keeping Help Center articles, internal knowledge, service descriptions, and implementation guides accurate, current, and clear.

- Partner with leadership and Engineering to structure and maintain product knowledge for people and AI systems.

- Turn AI support agent failure patterns into documentation improvements, with human validation of every AI-suggested change.

 Data and automation 

- Define actionable metrics for self-service, chatbot containment, knowledge adoption, and queue health, with clear thresholds, owners, and responses.

- Expand team automation and set standards for effective AI use, including where human judgment remains essential.

 Team and cross-functional leadership 

- Lead and develop a team of four product-domain owners, setting clear expectations and managing performance and career growth.

- Partner across product and customer-facing teams to deliver accurate, timely enablement, balancing readiness with delivery speed and making practical trade-offs.

- Communicate performance and strategy to CX leadership and executives, translating data into clear insights that drive decisions.

 Requirements 

- 4+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, or a related function, ideally in fast-paced tech or fintech.

- Experience partnering with Product and Engineering through full launch cycles, with confidence navigating scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

- Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or developing others. First-time managers are welcome.

- Proven ability to scale cross-functional processes and influence partner teams without formal authority.

- Experience owning documentation or knowledge at scale, maintaining quality as products evolve.

- Strong analytical skills, including defining metrics, building useful dashboards, and using data to prioritize.

- Hands-on experience integrating AI agents and automation into workflows, with measurable improvements in efficiency or outcomes.

- Clear, precise communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting data to leadership.

- Sound prioritization under competing demands and adaptability as processes and business needs change.

 Bonus points 

- Background in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.

- Experience as a Product Manager.

- 1+ years managing or developing a team of 3+ individual contributors.

- Familiarity with structuring and maintaining product knowledge for AI systems at scale.

- Experience with self-service and containment metrics.

- Proficiency with tools such as Linear, Guru, Sanity, and Hex.

- Experience running cross-functional governance forums or advisory boards.

- A track record of turning operational insights into product roadmap changes.

 Compensation

lever:caseware:cbc177fa-b99f-4baf-b09e-c.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!   We are looking for an Intermediate UX Designer who is excited to work at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making. At Caseware, our UX Design Team is actively transforming how design work gets done, integrating tools like Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit into everyday practice. In this role, you will help shape that evolution while designing user experiences for our cloud-based audit, financial reporting, and data analytics solutions used by accounting professionals in over 130 countries.  You will work closely with the Product, Engineering, and Design Teams to create intuitive, user-centred designs that help our customers work more intelligently, gain deeper insights, and deliver impactful results.  ❗ This is a full-time permanent position  📍 Location: This is a hybrid role requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office located at 351 King St E Suite 1100 Toronto ON.  What you will be doing: :

    • Design exceptional user experiences for Caseware's cloud-based audit, financial reporting, and data analytics products, using a modern toolkit that includes Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit alongside traditional UX methods. 

    • Bring AI tools into your day-to-day design practice, using them to accelerate ideation, generate and pressure-test prototypes, and explore a wider solution space than would be possible working manually alone. 

    • Evaluate and refine AI-generated design output critically, making sure that speed never comes at the cost of accessibility, usability, or intentional design thinking. 

    • Conduct user research and usability testing, feeding real user insights back into your design and AI-assisted iteration cycles to keep work grounded in what people actually need. 

    • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to define solutions and ensure that AI-assisted design artifacts translate clearly into implementation. 

    • Help shape how our team works, contributing to shared practices around prompting, output review, and the integration of AI tools into our design and development workflow. 

    • Think beyond individual features to design cohesive auditor journeys where AI and agentic capabilities enhance how audit work gets planned, executed, and delivered. 

    • Maintain and evolve our design system, establishing clear standards for how AI-generated components are evaluated, adapted, and incorporated. 

    • Participate actively in design critiques, and stay curious about where UX practice, AI tooling, and the accounting software industry are heading. 

What you will bring::

    • A genuine enthusiasm for working at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making, along with the critical thinking skills to ensure that speed and automation never come at the cost of user-centred outcomes. 

    • Approximately 2 to 3 years of professional UX experience, with a portfolio that shows not just what you designed but how you think through problems and make decisions. 

    • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or Replit as part of your design workflow, including the ability to prompt effectively, evaluate generated output, and refine it to meet design system and accessibility standards. 

    • The ability to contribute to evolving team practices around AI tooling, including shared prompting conventions, output review standards, and integration with development workflows. 

    • Proficiency with design and prototyping tools including Figma and related platforms, and experience working within and contributing to a component-based design system.

lever:caseware:63bb7bd5-420e-42cb-9d8e-2.title: Legal Operations Manager
lever:caseware:63bb7bd5-420e-42cb-9d8e-2.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! Caseware is looking for a Legal Operations Manager to help scale our in-house legal function.  This is a unique opportunity for an operationally minded individual to join a 4-lawyer in-house team supporting a global company. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, you will be the operational backbone of the department, bringing structure, efficiency, and scalable processes to how the team works at a fast-paced SaaS company. You will own the systems, processes, vendor relationships, and metrics that allow the lawyers to focus on legal judgment.  You will have a wide range of responsibilities, with a focus on legal technology and systems, process design, and outside counsel and vendor management. As the first dedicated Legal Operations hire at Caseware, you will have the opportunity to shape and own legal operations processes from an early stage, with direct exposure and access to the General Counsel and senior leadership. This is a hands-on, generalist role suited to someone with strong technology and AI skills who is motivated to help others succeed.    ❗This is an existing vacancy. ❗This is a full-time, permanent position.  📍This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to work three days a week at our Toronto oﬃce  (351 King St E, Toronto, ON). What you will be doing :
  • Administer and continuously improve the contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform, e-signature tools and matter management systems, driving adoption across the business. 
  • Design, document, and maintain repeatable workflows for contract intake, review routing, approvals, and escalations so the legal team can scale with the business. 
  • Manage relationships and budgets with outside counsel and legal vendors, including negotiating rates, tracking spend against budget, and reviewing invoices. 
  • Maintain the legal department budget, prepare spend and matter-volume reports, and build dashboards and metrics that demonstrate the legal team’s impact to the business. 
  • Support the end-to-end contract process, including templates, playbooks, clause libraries, and self-serve tools for the Sales and Procurement teams. 
  • Maintain corporate records for all legal entities, handle all statutory and annual filings, ensure corporate compliance in all jurisdictions, and respond to UBO and KYC requests independently. 
  • Design and maintain the department’s internal knowledge base, training materials, and onboarding resources for new hires and business stakeholders. 
  • Identify gaps and design process improvements, and where appropriate, take the lead in legal technology implementations and use of AI to achieve objectives. 
  • Keep legal documents and records accurate, organized, and easy to access; provide support to lawyers and other stakeholders. 
    • What you will bring :
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, legal studies, or a related field; a paralegal diploma or equivalent experience is an asset. A law degree is not required for this role. 
  • 3–7 years of experience in legal operations, paralegal work, or a similar operational role; an in-house legal team or law firm operations background is strongly preferred. 
  • Hands-on experience implementing and using CLM and e-signature tools and other legal technology, including AI. 
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to independently prioritize across multiple concurrent initiatives in a lean team. 
  • Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, and outside counsel spend and invoicing. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with lawyers and business stakeholders at all levels. 
  • A high degree of discretion and judgment when handling confidential and sensitive information. 
  • Experience building a legal operations function from the ground up in a small legal department is an asset. 
  • Exposure to data analytics or BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for legal reporting is an asset.
  • Strong AI aptitude, with experience applying AI tools to drive operational efficiency and process improvement.

lever:caseware:004dc438-7775-4e99-8fcc-6.title: Senior UX Designer
lever:caseware:004dc438-7775-4e99-8fcc-6.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! We are looking for a Senior UX Designer who is ready to take ownership of complex design problems that sit at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making. At Caseware, our UX Design Team is actively transforming how design work gets done, integrating tools like Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit into everyday practice. In this role, you will help shape that evolution while designing user experiences for our cloud-based audit, financial reporting, and data analytics solutions used by accounting professionals in over 130 countries.  You will work closely with the Product, Engineering, and Design Teams to shape experiences that help accounting and audit professionals navigate complex, regulated work with confidence and clarity.  ❗ This is a full-time permanent position  ❗ This is a new vacancy   📍 Location:   This is a remote location open to candidates legally authorized to work in Canada.     What you will be doing::

  • Design exceptional user experiences for Caseware’s cloud-based audit, financial reporting, and data analytics products, taking features from problem framing through to implementation with a modern toolkit that pairs Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit with traditional UX methods. 

  • Shape how the team brings AI into its everyday design practice, evaluating new tools, sharing what works, and moving fluidly between AI-assisted and manual modes so design judgment stays at the centre of every decision. 

  • Design the human oversight moments inside agentic workflows, deciding what users need to see and choose, and working with engineering on trigger conditions before features reach the build phase. 

  • Help evolve Caseware’s design system, raising the quality bar for component patterns and making sure AI-generated UI meets our design-system and accessibility standards before it reaches users. 

  • Plan and lead user research, using AI to synthesize findings and surface patterns across usability testing sessions, so insights reach the team quickly and in a usable form. 

  • Lead the cross-functional design conversations that shape product direction, driving the dialogue around end-user and business requirements with Product and Engineering, and using AI-generated prototypes to model scenarios rapidly and validate assumptions before the team commits. 

  • Represent the team to Team Leads, Development, Product, Industry contacts, and other external stakeholders, and drive cross-team initiatives that require sustained collaboration across multiple product areas. 

  • Develop the design team, mentoring junior and intermediate designers through hard design problems and decision-making under ambiguity, and helping them grow in both design craft and AI-assisted practice. 

  • Participate actively in design critiques, and stay curious about where UX practice, AI tooling, and the accounting software industry are heading. 

What you will bring::

  • A genuine enthusiasm for working at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making, paired with an understanding of responsible AI principles (bias, transparency, accountability, designing for trust) and the critical thinking to keep speed and automation from compromising user-centred outcomes. 

  • At least 3 years of professional UX experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates not just what you designed but how you led others through the problem and made design decisions under ambiguity. 

  • Fluency with AI-assisted tools like Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit, including prompting effectively, building custom workflows, evaluating generated output, and refining it to meet design-system and accessibility standards. 

  • Design experience with, or a clear perspective on, human oversight moments in agentic or AI-driven features, including how to think about accountability, transparency, and user control in that context. 

  • Experience planning and leading end-to-end user research programs, including the use of AI to synthesize findings and identify patterns across usability testing cycles. 

  • Proficiency with Figma and related design and prototyping tools, substantial experience working within and evolving a component-based design system, and a strong working knowledge of accessibility standards, including the ability to evaluate AI-generated components for compliance and usability gaps. 

  • Confidence representing design direction to senior stakeholders like Team Leads, product leadership, and external partners, and the ability to drive cross-team initiatives that require sustained collaboration and consensus-building without formal authority. 

  • Experience mentoring junior or intermediate designers, giving clear and constructive feedback that helps them grow, alongside strong communication skills in both facilitating design discussions and presenting design reasoning to non-design audiences. 

  • Knowledge of accounting, audit, or financial services industries is a bonus, as is prior experience designing for AI-powered or conversational product features.

lever:caseware:32ed2d11-eb7f-471c-b6e7-a.title: Staff UX Designer
lever:caseware:32ed2d11-eb7f-471c-b6e7-a.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! We are looking for a Staff UX Designer who is ready to take on our hardest design problems and work at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making. At Caseware, our UX Design Team is actively transforming how design work gets done, integrating tools like Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit into everyday practice. In this role, you will help define what that evolution looks like while designing user experiences for our cloud-based audit, financial reporting, and data analytics solutions used by accounting professionals in over 130 countries.  You will work closely with the Product, Engineering, and Design Teams, and with Design leadership, to set the standards and shape the experiences that help accounting and audit professionals navigate complex, regulated work with confidence and clarity.  ❗ This is a full-time permanent position  📍 Location: This is a hybrid role requiring the successful candidate to work 3 days a week in our Toronto office located at 351 King St E Suite 1100 Toronto ON.      What you will be doing::

    • Own the design of Caseware’s most complex and ambiguous product areas across audit, financial reporting, and data analytics, taking work from problem framing through to implementation, and set the direction and documentation that other designers build on. 

    • Design AI-native interaction patterns, including agentic-driven and conversational UI, intelligent defaults, and predictive interfaces, deciding how much the system should infer and when it should ask. 

    • Design the human oversight moments inside agentic workflows so an auditor stays in control of work they are accountable for, setting the Caseware pattern by designing against over-trust rather than only for confirmation UX. 

    • Think in whole auditor journeys rather than individual features, shaping how AI and agentic capabilities change the way audit work gets planned, executed, and reviewed. 

    • Produce working prototypes that engineering can build directly from rather than static mockups, using AI to close the distance between designing and building, and to pressure-test assumptions before the team commits. 

    • Decide which research questions are worth answering, and lead the studies that resolve real strategic uncertainty, using AI to synthesize findings and surface patterns quickly. 

    • Shape what gets built before the scope is set, bringing design into roadmap and sequencing conversations with Product and Engineering, and turning high-level requirements into work the team can act on. 

    • Lead cross-team design initiatives that no single team owns, spotting the critical risks early and building agreement without formal authority. 

    • Contribute to Caseware’s design system and raise the quality bar for how AI-assisted work reaches users, making sure generated output meets our component and accessibility standards before it ships. 

    • Mentor designers at any level of experience through their hardest problems, and turn what you work out together into practices the whole team can reuse. 

    • Participate actively in design critiques, and stay curious about where UX practice, AI tooling, and the accounting software industry are heading. 

    • What you will bring::

    • Eight or more years of experience in user experience or related fields, with a portfolio built on depth: complex product problems, the design decisions you made under ambiguity, and the direction others built on. 

    • A track record of designing at the journey level in complex, regulated, or data-heavy domains, where the hard part is making expert work legible. 

    • A genuine enthusiasm for working at the intersection of design craft and AI-assisted making, and the judgment to keep speed and automation from compromising user-centred outcomes. 

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and processes, and the appetite to go further with them. We use Figma Make, Claude Code, and Replit, and we care more about how you evaluate and refine generated output than about which tools you have already used. 

    • Experience designing AI-native interaction patterns, such as conversational or predictive interfaces, or a clear point of view on designing for transparency, accountability, and user trust. 

    • Experience owning the research agenda for a product area and leading the studies that answer it. 

    • Proficiency with Figma, experience contributing to a component-based design system, and enough command of accessibility standards to judge whether AI-generated components meet them. 

    • Confidence setting design direction with Product and Engineering leadership early enough to shape scope, and a track record of mentoring experienced designers, not only those early in their careers. 

    • Knowledge of accounting, audit, or financial services industries is a bonus, as is prior experience designing for AI-powered or conversational product features. 

    The Tech Stack you will be working with: :

     

    • Figma, Replit and Claude Code for UI/UX design and prototyping 

    • Design systems implementation and management 

    • Angular UI framework and components (for implementation reference) 

    • User research and testing platforms 

    • Collaboration tools including Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Confluence

  • A team player who loves collaborating, learning and brings a positive, solutions-oriented attitude

➕ Experience recruiting for AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or other emerging technology roles within a SaaS or technology organization. 

➕ Experience implementing or optimizing AI-driven recruiting workflows, sourcing strategies, talent intelligence platforms, or automation tools.

 Summary

 As a Director of Sales Engineering for Celestica, you are the primary technical lead resource for the account management sales force providing both pre-sales and post sales activities leadership for new and existing customers. This may consist of one very large customer or a small number of mid-sized customers. 

 The Director, Sales Engineering is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. That said, this is a position with expectations of a seasoned candidate with strong leadership skills in assembling and leading cross functional teams made up of people from Celestica’s design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and technical Marketing teams.  You will clearly articulate technology and product positioning and develop value propositions for both business and technical users. This is all in support of formulating and presenting complex solutions while working closely with the execution teams as they onboard those solutions. 

 The Director, Sales Engineer must be able to establish and maintain strong relationships - in particular with customer’s technical and engineering teams - with assigned customers throughout the complete sales cycle and post-sales account support processes.

 You are accountable to apply a deep market and technology understanding in the Cloud Datacenter and Enterprise Datacenter Solutions space encompassing networking, server, storage, node and rack level integration. You will lead and manage the technology evaluation stage of the sales process.  You will work closely with our sales and business teams to understand our customers’ challenges and assemble specific technical solutions to solve for their needs. Upon award you will also be involved in supporting the transition to implementation at the site as needed.
#HPS-NA 

 This position is best suited for candidates in the Silicon Valley Area 

 Required Skills

- Experience with AI / ML applications in both enterprise and edge deployments 

- Domain knowledge in networking for enterprise and AI deployments

- Experience with standards, organizations and consortiums of relevant technologies is a plus

- Understand complex test and development activities required for the design and manufacturing of electronics including PCBA, node and rack level integration

- Understand the key stages in solution development for complex electronic manufacturing in Joint Development Manufacturing (JDM) projects: EVT, DVT, PVT, production ramp

- Be able to communicate effectively with members of other teams, departments and customers at a high degree of liaison

- Communicate professionally and consultatively in written responses to emails, presentations, proposals and reports

- Be organized and analytical, and able to overcome sales challenges through creative and collaborative approaches

- Be a self-motivated individual capable of working with a minimum of supervision in a dynamic team environment.

 Travel Requirements

- Overnight travel within North America (Canada, USA, Mexico) requirements: 25% - 40% depending on location of employee

- International (overseas) travel requirements: approximately 2 to 3 trips per year.

 Typical Experience

- 7 to 12 years of relevant industry experience.  7+ of those years being direct experience in Cloud Datacenter and Enterprise Datacenter Solutions encompassing networking, server, storage, node and rack level integration.

 Typical Education

- B.S in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field

- Industry recognized certifications is a plus

 Salary

 $158,000 - 214,000 USD/year

 The salary range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including by not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate. 

 Notes

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Celestica’s policy on equal employment opportunity prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran or disability status, or other characteristics protected by law.

 COMPANY OVERVIEW: 

Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world’s best brands. Through our recognized customer-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development – from drawing board to full-scale production and after-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers. 

 Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

greenhouse:clutch:6218116004.description:
About Clutch: 

 We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars.

 Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse thousands of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

 Named five years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Canaan, Real Ventures, BrandProject, and BMO. To learn more, visit clutch.ca .

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for an experienced Brand Manager to help bring the Clutch brand to life across every touchpoint. You’ll own the day-to-day execution of our brand strategy, from managing our agency of record and leading creative briefs to ensuring campaigns, retail spaces, and brand initiatives are delivered at a high bar.

 This is a highly hands-on role for someone who understands what makes a great brand and knows how to turn strategy into action. You’ll work cross-functionally, push for best-in-class creative, and help us build Clutch into Canada’s next household name.

 What You’ll Do 

- Manage the Agency of Record Relationship: Serve as the primary point of contact for our agency of record, ensuring alignment on brand strategy, creative direction, and deliverables. Build a collaborative, high-performing relationship that keeps the agency accountable to timelines, budgets, and brand standards.

- Own the Briefing Process: Lead campaigns from ideation through execution, writing and delivering creative briefs to the agency, managing production timelines, and ensuring all assets are approved and launched on time. You're the connective tissue between strategy and delivery.

- Own Real Estate Design Approval: collaborating closely with the Real Estate team to ensure all retail spaces are executed in accordance with our approved Design Control Document. 

- Drive Brand Planning: Be an active participant in brand planning sessions, contributing ideas, identifying opportunities, and helping shape the direction of upcoming campaigns and initiatives.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with the Marketing Coordinator and Social Media Manager to ensure current brand plans are executed consistently across all channels and touchpoints.

- Champion the Brand: Ensure every campaign, asset, and piece of communication reflects Clutch's brand voice, visual identity, and tone acting as a steward of the brand across all external and internal touchpoints. Regularly audit work across teams to make sure brand guidelines are upkept across all channels. 

- Advocating for Best in Class Creative: our creative mantra is extremely important and we strive to stand out and be unique as a brand manager on this team you will help push the right teams to create creative tension. 

- Monitor Trends and Competitors: Stay on top of industry trends, competitor activity, and market shifts, bringing fresh ideas and insights to keep our brand ahead of the curve.

- Measure and Report: Track campaign performance and key brand metrics, synthesizing insights and recommendations to inform future planning.

 What We’re Looking For 

- You’ve got 4-6 years of brand or marketing work experience at either a startup, agency or CPG.

- You have a bachelor degree (marketing preferred but not required) .

- You have experience managing agency or vendor relationships, and are comfortable holding external partners accountable to timelines and quality.

- You're highly organized and can juggle multiple campaigns and briefs at once without dropping the ball.

- You're comfortable navigating fast-paced, changing environments.

- You're a self-starter who takes ownership without being asked.

- You're eager to roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to help the brand succeed.

- You want a direct hand in building Canada's next household name.

 Preferred Skills 

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

- Experience working at an agency and/or in-house brand team.

- Experience in a startup or high-growth environment is a strong asset.

 Why you’ll love it at Clutch:  

- Autonomy & ownership -- create your own path, and own your work

- Competitive compensation

- Generous time off program

- Health & dental benefits 

- Parental leave top-up 

- In office environment 

 Employment Type: 

- Existing, Permanent Full-Time

- 4 Days on site, Toronto Office

 Compensation & Benefits: 

- Salary range: 110,000 - 125,000

- Benefits: Healthcare, dental, vision, prescriptions, life insurance, and dependent coverage from day 1.

- Pay decisions reflect skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions.

 Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca .

greenhouse:coconutsoftware:6218663004.description:
Reporting to the Chief Product & Engineering Officer, as a Lead Product Manager here at Coconut, you’ll drive a critical company-level growth, product vision, strategy, and data driven roadmap that delivers! Your familiarity with the environments and needs of large enterprise customers make identifying market and customer requirements almost second nature. You believe in a customer-centric experience and are passionate about the full product life cycle, from ideation through the collaborative development process across teams to deliver winning products. You prefer a highly visible role where you will have a chance to make significant contributions with an immediate and lasting impact on company growth. You bring proven success in ownership, bias for action, and innovative product strategies. You exhibit excellent judgment, and leverage data to prioritize between the needs of existing customers versus new ones and between features, architectural improvements, and operational excellence.

 YOU’RE FIRED UP TO CONTRIBUTE TO 

 Product Strategy 

- Lead multiple of our core product offerings within our suite that provides great experiences for the staff of our customers (eg. bankers and advisors). You’ll partner with Engineering to help ensure our Platform is the engine that empowers the end customer through pre-meeting activities

- Roll up your sleeves to help determine the future of our platform in areas through AI, addressing our customer’s needs to offer their customers modern tools to self-serve or start the engagement 

- Bring teams together. You love working cross functionally across business and tech to align around goals and develop insights

- Give Product Demos, present to the company, and present to internal and external stakeholders

 AI Product Leadership 

- Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities where AI can improve customer and staff experiences. Work with Engineering, Design, Data, Security, and customers to translate these opportunities into responsible, testable product experiences

- Leverage AI to develop prototypes and customer experiments to validate desirability, usefulness, and trust

 Team Leadership 

- As one of the more senior members of the Product team, you’ll help support, share knowledge with, and mentor ascending members of the team including Product Owners

- In particular, you’ll take a primary role in elevating our product management craft by contributing perspective on our tools, and taking the lead role in evolving several key internal processes and workflows

 Project Management 

- Manage product roadmap, define key milestones, customer requirements, key product metrics, develop product epics and partner with Engineering on accountability for OKRs 

- Maintain a clear communication line between Product and Engineering ensuring that Engineering fully understands customer requirements and the direction Product has planned in regards to new product development, existing product maintenance or enhancement and feature deprecation

- Ensure products and releases are launched correctly and on schedule

 Customer Experience 

- Regularly meet with customers to better understand their needs in general, their Coconut specific friction points and wants. 

- Validate requirements and the resulting product with customers and customer success teams to ensure we’re delivering value 

- Act as customer advocate - be the voice of the customer, articulating their needs 

- Manage customer feature requests 

 Product Research 

- Work with Product Marketing and Product Designers to determine what problems are aligned with the company objectives to solve

- Be a market expert - understand the reasons customers purchase products, the competition, and how customers think of and buy our product

- Aid in developing product positioning 

 Finance 

- Understand the cost of development and product overhead and the impact this should have on pricing

- Help set pricing to meet revenue and profitability goals 

 WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM 

- 8+ years of product management experience (Bonus points if it’s in SaaS or Banking)

- An exceptional ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders across Engineering and market-facing departments, showing a high degree of skill in conflict management, change management, and leading by influence

- A technical background (APIs, Integrations, etc) especially in SaaS companies that are scaling their product and features

- Demonstrated ability to work with technical teams on AI-enabled products, including a practical understanding of LLMs, structured data, model limitations, evaluation, privacy, security, and usage economics. Candidates do not need to be data scientists or ML engineers, but must be able to ask strong technical questions and make sound product trade-offs

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You’re ready to speak in front of execs or the entire company

- A growth mindset. You’ve got a track record of pursuing professional growth through teaching or mentorship

- Demonstrated knowledge of design principles for mobile and web

- Success in defining and launching products that meet and exceed business objectives

- Proven experience managing multiple products in parallel as part of a portfolio strategy

- Proven ability to think strategically and execute tactically. You think beyond products and releases, and are able to elevate the organization to think about value streams and strategic levers

- A keen business sense and are able to leverage data to develop and prioritize strategic objectives

- Ability to travel - expect to travel to customers or our head office from time to time (possibly up to once a quarter)

 This posting is for a vacant contract position. The expected hiring range for this role is $130,000 - $170,000.

 The base salary for this position is listed to support candidates to align themselves within the target range. The range is grounded in comprehensive analysis of national compensation data for similar roles and company sizes in the technology sector, alongside a review of our internal compensation framework to ensure pay equity across the company. Note that ranges may evolve over time.  We aim to provide a fair offer and hire within this specified range. The final offer for this position will take a candidate's background, experience, skills, and internal equity into consideration. Top performers’ compensation will be reviewed annually, as part of our Performance Acceleration program (Performance Reviews, Compensation Reviews, etc.).  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or synthesizing interview notes. These tools assist our talent team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please talk to your Talent Partner. We believe in using AI thoughtfully and transparently, so we ask candidates to take the same approach and disclose the use of AI at any stage in their application or interview process.

The GL Operations team ensures the integrity of our global consolidation, the accuracy of our general ledger, and the scalability of our financial infrastructure. - Lead global intercompany operations including billing, cash settlements, transfer pricing execution, foreign exchange gain/loss analysis, and elimination entries.

- Drive the design, implementation, and documentation of SOX-compliant internal controls across GL operations and intercompany processes.

- Execute strategic GL projects including M&A integration, new entity set-ups, and ERP enhancements in NetSuite.

- Strengthen team capability by mentoring and developing direct reports, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

- CPA with 9+ years of experience in accounting or finance, including 2+ years managing direct reports, with public accounting experience (Big 4 preferred).

About CoLab 

 At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

 We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. About CoLab
