 Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C , been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte ( Fast 500™ ), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier , and grown to a team of 250+.

 About the Role 

 The Manager, Revenue Operations Systems will be the technical backbone of CoLab’s revenue operations team. You’ll own the architecture, build, and integration of the tools and data model that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success run on — and the reporting infrastructure that leadership uses to inspect the business.

 This is a hands-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You’ll design the data governance architecture alongside the SVP of Operations and then build it yourself. You’ll partner closely with a Revenue Operations counterpart who owns process, hygiene operations, and rep-facing enablement, and you’ll be the technical depth behind that partnership.

 What you’ll do: 

- Revenue tech stack ownership:

- Own the implementation, integrations, workflow design, and ongoing management of the tools serving the revenue organization, including CRM (Salesforce), business intelligence (Tableau), sales engagement (Salesloft/Outreach), CPQ and quoting, conversation intelligence (Gong), data enrichment (ZoomInfo), product analytics (Mixpanel), internal app building (Retool), AI assistants, and the Slack and Google Workspace integrations that connect them.

- Ensure all systems are optimized for performance and scale with the business, and stay aligned to how revenue teams actually work.

- Technical Integrations:

- Oversee integrations across the tech stack to ensure seamless data flow and functionality.

- Own implementation and rollout once a tooling decision is made, including migration planning and cutover, partnering with IT on provisioning and security.

- Process Automation and Optimization : 

- Develop and implement automation workflows to streamline revenue operations and measurably reduce manual work across Sales, Marketing, and CS.

- Continuously evaluate systems for process improvement opportunities.

- Data model and governance architecture:

- Own the Salesforce data model and the governance architecture that protects it: object and field design, validation rules, required-field and stage-gating logic, permissions, and record-type structure.

- Design governance standards in partnership with the SVP of Operations, then build and maintain the enforcement layer that makes those standards hold — so data quality is structural rather than dependent on cleanup after the fact.

- Partner with Sales Operations, who maintains governance standards day to day and drives the rep behaviour that keeps data clean inside the architecture you build.

- Build and maintain the reporting layer that powers the revenue operating cadence: pipeline health views (stage and aging flags, at-risk identification, segment benchmarks), forecast and quota attainment reporting, and GRR/NRR views.

- Ensure reporting is accurate, accessible, and trusted without rework, including at the SLT and board level, and document data definitions so the business shares one version of the truth.

- Request intake and systems debt:

- Own the RevOps request queue: intake, triage, and prioritization of system, reporting, and data requests from across the revenue organization — balancing fast turnaround on transactional work against the architectural fixes that reduce the volume of requests over time.

- Take on a standing backlog of systems debt, including enforcement gaps in the CRM (stage validation and required-field logic that doesn’t yet exist), price book consolidation and product SKU structure, field and product data that has drifted out of alignment, and manual provisioning workflows that should be automated.

- Distinguish between requests that need a fix and requests that signal a structural problem, and make the case for the second when it’s the better use of time.

- Adoption and enablement:

- Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to align system capabilities with business needs.

- Provide training and assistance to teams on tools and best practices, and build reusable documentation and how-to assets.

- Collaborate with Enablement to land system and process changes, anchoring them in how each team actually works day to day rather than in how the system is configured.

- Tooling evaluation and rollout: own evaluation end to end — requirements, technical and integration assessment, security review, and business case. Sales Operations co-owns the decision and owns commercial negotiation with vendors.

- Cross-functional project ownership: own operational initiatives that sit outside any single team’s ownership — for example a lead-to-close process audit across Sales and Marketing, or a reporting consolidation spanning CS and Sales — owning the project plan, stakeholder communication, and outcome, not just the technical execution.

 What you’ll need: 

- Experience:

- 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, business systems, or a comparable systems-ownership role in B2B SaaS.

- Track record as the primary owner of a revenue tech stack — not a contributor to someone else’s.

- Technical Skills:

- Deep Salesforce administration experience (Admin certification or equivalent): data model design, Flow, validation rules, permissions and sharing, and integration architecture. Apex or scripting experience is an asset, not a requirement.

- Hands-on experience with Tableau or similar BI tools for advanced data visualization — dashboards the business relies on, not one-off reports.

- Experience with a sales engagement platform such as SalesLoft or Outreach.

- Experience integrating a revenue stack across tools, with an understanding of where data breaks between systems and how to prevent it.

- Nice to have: CPQ or quoting configuration, Gong, ZoomInfo, Retool or similar low-code app building, Mixpanel or comparable product analytics, Chili Piper, Zendesk, HubSpot, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Experience building revenue reporting: forecasting, quota attainment, pipeline health, and GRR/NRR.

- How you work:

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, customer success and finance teams.

- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

- Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

- Focus on quality and rigor - assessing and surfacing impacts of changes before they are deployed

- Ability to prioritize requests for development work based on business needs

- Strong project management skills with experience championing cross-departmental initiatives.

- Proven ability to drive adoption of systems and process change across Sales, Marketing, and CS — earning alignment without positional authority, and navigating friction directly rather than escalating or deprioritizing.

- Fluency with how a B2B SaaS revenue organization runs: pipeline stages and exit criteria, forecast categories, segmentation, quota and comp mechanics, renewals, and GRR/NRR reporting.

D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. 

 New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

 D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

 D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

 Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

 Job Summary:   

 You’re a recognized expert in the use of technology to support learning. You bring a wealth of knowledge in D2L products and services, a passion for solving problems with technology, and the steadfast will of a servant leader.   

 The Manager, Customer Success is responsible for leading a high performing team. Working in the Higher Education segment across North America, this leadership role will oversee and coach a team of Customer Success staff to continually strive to exceed loyalty, adoption, and retention targets. This role will work cross functionally to ensure that success of our customers is the primary measure of our success at D2L.    

 How Will I Make an Impact?:   

- Coach, lead, and develop team members by setting the strategy and prioritizing Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)   

- Hire, train, and continuously develop a high performing team   

- Align Customer Success activities to growth initiatives, revenue goals that drive adoption, loyalty, and retention of Brightspace      

- Develop sound risk management and mitigation initiatives    

- Responsible for developing and reinforcing account planning and documentation of engagement activities   

- Responsible for supporting team members in proactively identifying risks to revenue retention and aligning programmatic interventions to mitigate those risks   

- Develop and foster executive level relationships with key accounts   

- Foster a culture of customer empathy, partnership, and continuous value creation   

- Support Account Management teams in identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities   

- Advance initiatives to build long term customer advocacy 

- People Leadership and Performance   

- Manage a team of D2Lers and champion a high-performing culture   

- Connect your team’s day-to-day accountabilities to D2L’s mission by setting clear objectives and performance expectations with your team members.   

- Coach, provide regular feedback, provide career path and development or growth opportunities, and create a collaborative and open environment.   

- Collaborate through cross-functional teams to accomplish established corporate and team goals and effectively manage relationships with other D2L teams

- Responsible for supporting vision, planning, and defining team objectives, and leading execution of objectives

- Support coaching and professional development specific opportunities to maintain the domain expertise needed support our diverse customers

- Work with your peers and leaders to drive productivity, efficiency, and hold the team accountable for high-quality outcomes

- Play a key role in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new team members. Provide expertise and coaching/mentorship to the team members.

- Produce and actively participate in knowledge sharing as well as professional development initiatives   

 What you’ll bring to the role):   

- 5+ years’ experience in a Customer Success (or equivalent) role; with experience leading teams in the adoption of educational technology   

- Experience hiring, onboarding, managing, and developing high-performing teams while still contributing to the team’s deliverables   

- Extensive knowledge and experience in educational technology, with a focus on supporting scaled growth and adoption initiatives   

- Previous experience and focus on customer advocacy, risk management, retention and adoption programs   

- Ability to effectively communicate to stakeholders at all levels of the organization – with excellent written, oral, and presentation skills    

- Ability to quickly establish rapport with all levels of personnel up to and including C-Suite executives   

- Model high energy level, demonstrated drive to succeed, with a sense of urgency    

- Ability to anticipate and adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced and rapidly growing organization   

- Experience within a growth-oriented SaaS companies is ideal    

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills   

 Education Recommendations:   

- Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, or related industry of field; MEd/MBA preferred   

- At least 5 years’ experience in related industry   

 The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

This position is within a subsidiary of the Desjardins Group called Collabria Financial Inc. Making it Possible - Collabria Financial  

 Collabria Financial Inc. is a leading Canadian credit card issuer. We specialize in white-label credit card programs tailored for Canadian credit unions, helping them serve both consumer and commercial members more effectively. Our client-centric approach emphasizes convenience, security, and value—empowering credit unions to deepen relationships with their members and remain competitive in a rapidly evolving financial landscape. What sets Collabria apart is our foundation in partnership, collaboration, and responsiveness. We offer credit unions the ability to personalize product offerings under their own brand, enhancing the overall member experience. As a fast-growing organization, we offer exciting opportunities for career advancement and innovation. As a Salesforce and ITSM Platform Administrator and Developer, you will administer, support, configure and enhance Collabria's Salesforce and Halo platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud and Halo, including user access, platform configuration, workflows, reporting, case and incident management processes, and system enhancements, while contributing to the transition to Marketing Cloud Next. You will collaborate with different areas of the business, including, Customer Service, Marketing, Data, Technology teams and external partners, to troubleshoot complex issues, support integrations and platform changes, maintain documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. More specifically, you will be required to: 

- Configure, develop, test and deploy Salesforce enhancements. 

- Support case management, routing, escalation, notification, knowledge management and reporting processes within Service Cloud. 

- Contribute to the transition to Marketing Cloud Next and support the integration of data, audiences, communication preferences, customer journeys and automation capabilities. 

- Collaborate with the Data team on the configuration and use of Data 360, including profile unification, data quality, segmentation, data models and activation within Salesforce. 

- Contribute to the assessment, configuration and deployment of Agentforce use cases while ensuring appropriate data security, access controls, human oversight and response quality. 

- Investigate and resolve incidents, automation errors, integration failures and data issues affecting Salesforce, Halo and related platforms. 

- Plan and execute platform changes in accordance with approved change management, version control, testing, approval, deployment and post-production validation practices. 

- Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to manage complex incidents, dependencies, upgrades, roadmaps and knowledge transfer to Collabria. 

 What we offer* 

- Competitive salary and annual bonus 

- 4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year 

- RSP Contribution option 

- Group insurance including telemedicine 

- Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment

- Experience supporting production applications, resolving incidents

Your role as Enterprise Account Executive, West
The mission of the Enterprise Account Executive, British Columbia will be to build and execute a go-to-market strategy across the province , grow the Dialogue brand, and drive new business growth.
This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of a growing market. While Enterprise accounts will be a key focus, full-market coverage across British Columbia will be critical to the success of this role. We’re looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, experiment, create relationships, and help shape how Dialogue grows in the region.
The ideal candidate is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on sales professional who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, figuring things out, and taking ownership of their territory. You may have a strong track record selling into Enterprise organizations, or you may be a high-performing Mid-Market seller ready to take the next step into larger, more complex accounts.
Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of Canadians.
What you’ll be doing:
Own the British Columbia market and develop a go-to-market strategy to build Dialogue’s presence, brand, and customer base across the region
Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close, with a focus on complex Enterprise opportunities
Build and grow relationships with Enterprise organizations, while maintaining a strong understanding of the broader BC market and identifying opportunities across segments
Develop and execute strategic account plans for key organizations, understanding their business priorities, challenges, stakeholders, and buying processes
Build a strong understanding of your territory, identifying target accounts, market opportunities, brokers, advisors, and strategic partners that can contribute to Dialogue’s growth
Take an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach to building your business — testing ideas, creating opportunities, and figuring out what works in the market
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Success, and other internal teams to develop compelling sales strategies, content, and customer experiences

Leverage multiple channels — including Marketing and Business Development leads, strategic partnerships, brokers, advisors, and direct outreach — to generate new business opportunities
Build and maintain strong relationships with key brokers, advisors, and other strategic partners both locally and nationally
Confidently present Dialogue’s value proposition to senior and executive-level stakeholders through virtual meetings and in-person presentations
Continuously learn and adapt, using insights from customers, the market, and your own performance to refine your approach and grow the territory

Passionate professionalism – You’re not just selling a product; you’re representing health and care to some of Canada’s leading organizations. Your energy, credibility, curiosity, and presence are key differentiators
An entrepreneurial mindset – You enjoy owning a business, rolling up your sleeves, and figuring things out. You’re comfortable operating with autonomy and creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to come to you
Strategic and hands-on – You can think strategically about your territory and accounts while also being comfortable executing at the ground level — prospecting, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing business
Proven experience in complex B2B sales – You bring 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally including experience selling into Enterprise and/or Mid-Market organizations, with a track record of building relationships, developing opportunities, and closing new business

A growth mindset – You’re curious, coachable, and motivated by continuously learning and taking on greater responsibility and complexity
A mission-driven mindset – You believe in making healthcare more accessible and are motivated by the opportunity to help improve access to quality physical and mental healthcare for Canadians

ABOUT THE POSITION  

 As the Associate Influencer Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in working with influencers and content creators across major online platforms (Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, etc.) to support global marketing and communication campaigns for Digital Extremes’ games, including Warframe and Soulframe. 

 With a Global focus, develop relationships with influencers and content creators, research and explore new and creative opportunities to work with them, and, where appropriate, partner with agencies and regional teams for global campaigns. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES   

- Develop strategic influencer marketing plans, activations, media buys and partnerships through paid, earned and owned channels to create and execute effective programs across various platforms to improve reach, engagement and acquisition efforts of a new launch title 

- Effectively collaborate with or manage Digital Extremes’ influencer marketing agencies in supporting campaigns, taking full advantage of their capabilities across building streaming programs, creative content development, event planning, gifting, reporting and more. 

- Collaborate with the Digital Extremes Community Management team to help support the Community Creator Program. Integrate with Digital Extremes Community and Marketing stakeholders to ensure alignment and synergy across all relevant initiatives, while partnering with the Development team to become a game expert that effectively communicates their vision. 

- Forecast outcomes, track performance, and report on established KPI’s and metrics to help inform consumer insights and how we can continue to improve campaign capabilities, effectiveness and efficiencies 

- Support the day-to-day project management and execution of influencer marketing initiatives, track tasks, resources, and deadlines across various cross-functional groups primarily related to paid social, video, promotions and livestreams on channels such as YouTube, Twitch, Twitter, TikTok and similar. 

- Explore ways to create new partnerships, innovative programs, leverage new channels and integrate new tools to improve performance of existing channels and to expand influencer marketing capabilities helping support multi-platform game releases including mobile. 

- Attend consumer shows and industry events as an active and contributing member of the greater global influencer community to build and foster lasting relationships with creative partners across channels and nearly all markets. 

- Contribute responsibly as an accountable member of the Marketing group which includes forecasting marketing budgets, accurately tracking, and reporting on program costs. 

- Assist with central support tasks for Digital Extremes, while also maintaining project management tools such as JIRA,  Google Docs, Confluence, Basecamp. 

- Other responsibilities as assigned. 

 REQUIREMENTS  

- 4+ years in publishing for video games or entertainment industries, including live service games, with at least 2 years of direct experience working with influencers and content creators. 

- Experience planning and executing Influencer Marketing programs, with AAA titles and live service games as a bonus. 

- Strong understanding of marketing, communications, and influencer / content creator platforms (e.g., YouTube, Twitch). 

- Creative skills to develop unique marketing programs and leverage analytics tools like Gamesight, Streamhatchet, or Sullygnome. 

- Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment, while working closely with cross-functional stakeholder groups, including marketing, development, and community teams .

 PREFERRED EXTRAS 

- Experience working with or managing agencies in the planning and execution of short and long-term marketing campaigns 

- Understanding of live-service marketing strategies to engage and retain players 

- Basic skill in Photoshop / Rush / OBS 

- Basic skill with JIRA, Trello, Basecamp and Asana 

 Please note that the salary range mentioned in this job description should serve simply as a guide. The final compensation offered may vary based on a variety of factors, including bonuses and/or incentives, or a candidate’s experience, skills, budget and location. Digital Extremes is committed to providing a fair, equitable, and competitive package that reflects the value a candidate brings. 

 Salary Range: $70,000 - $85,000 CAD

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.




We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.




So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.




🚀 THE ADVENTURE AHEAD

As a Business Development Representative for our North American team, you are the primary engine behind Docebo’s rapid global expansion! You’ll act as a strategic consultant, helping massive organizations transform their training from a mundane "checkbox" into a competitive superpower through world-class AI innovation. By establishing trust with high-level stakeholders, you won't just be filling a pipeline—you’ll be the first person to show these companies a better way for their employees to grow and thrive.




🗓️ THE DAY-TO-DAY

 - Strategize the Hunt: Identify and map out key stakeholders within our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to ensure we are engaging with the organizations that will benefit most from Docebo.

 - Craft the Narrative: Leverage and create high-impact, compelling messaging that cuts through the noise and sparks genuine curiosity about the future of learning.

 - Master the Outreach: Connect with potential clients via outbound calling, using active listening and rapport-building to turn cold introductions into warm opportunities.

 - Elevate the Experience: Provide a world-class first impression for inbound prospects, acting as a knowledgeable guide to how Docebo can help their teams excel.

 - Architect Your Success: Manage your calendar with precision, dedicating time to high-value activities that ensure you hit your goals and fuel the Docebo growth engine.

 - Drive the Impact: Focus relentlessly on pipeline generation, growing both the business and your own professional career as you contribute to our global mission.




⚡ YOUR SUPERPOWERS

 - Command the Conversation: You have the elite ability to qualify prospects, plan your approach, and maintain control of high-level business discussions.

 - Fuel the Fire: You are a self-motivated, results-oriented "go-getter" who thrives on hitting targets and exceeding expectations.

 - Communicate with Clarity: You possess exceptional communication and problem-solving skills, allowing you to explain complex AI solutions with ease.

 - Maintain the "Glass-Half-Full": You bring an infectious, positive energy to the team and approach every challenge with a solution-oriented mindset.

 - Think Outside the Box: You use your creativity and hustle to find unique ways to get in front of the right people and establish immediate credibility.




🌟 BONUS POINTS

 - Sales Veteran: You have 1+ years of experience in Inside Sales, a Call Center environment, or a Demand Generation/Marketing function.

 - Customer-Facing Pro: You’ve spent a year or more in Retail, Hospitality, or another high-touch customer service role.

 - Mid-Market & Enterprise Expertise: You have previous experience navigating the complexities of Mid-Market and Enterprise-level BDR or Sales cycles.




OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.




OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

 - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
   




OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍

 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

 - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

 - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

 - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

 - Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.




ABOUT DOCEBO 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO https://www.docebo.inc/home/default.aspx), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

This is not a traditional UX writing role or a localization-operations role. You’ll be a hands-on Product Designer who shapes product behaviour as well as product language. You’ll design complete workflows, build reusable terminology and content patterns, improve AI review and confidence experiences, and embed language guidance into our design system and delivery practices.

You’ll shape problems before solutions are fixed, choose appropriate discovery and validation methods, and connect customer evidence, product data, business context, technical constraints, accessibility, and localization risk to clear product decisions. You’ll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX Research, Elemental / Design System, Accessibility, Technical Writing / Localization, AI teams, and other Product Designers—building a shared quality capability without becoming a bottleneck or approval queue.




THE DAY-TO-DAY 💻

 - Frame Ambiguous Workflow and Language Problems: Turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear problem statements, hypotheses, decision questions, and an actionable path to learning.

 - Lead Discovery and Define Outcomes: Select appropriate research and validation methods; combine customer evidence, product analytics, business context, technical constraints, and localization insight to establish measurable success signals and visible trade-offs.

 - Design Complete Product Workflows: Lead interaction, information-architecture, and content decisions across roles, permissions, states, edge cases, accessibility, responsive behaviour, errors, confirmations, approvals, and recovery.

 - Build Docebo’s Product Language System: Establish terminology, product voice and tone, reusable microcopy patterns, audience guidance, and language principles that improve clarity across product areas.

 - Design Trustworthy AI Moments: Create patterns that help people understand what AI did, what informed it, what needs attention, and how to review, edit, regenerate, approve, reverse, or recover.

 - Embed Guidance into Product Systems: Partner with Elemental / Design System to create component-level guidance, default strings, usage examples, do-and-don’t guidance, and reusable quality checks.

 - Design for Localization Readiness: Own product-side standards for translation-ready writing, terminology reuse, variables and placeholders, language previews, and localization constraints while partnering with Technical Writing / Localization on operational workflows.

 - Prototype and Audit with AI-Assisted Methods: Use appropriate-fidelity prototypes and AI-assisted workflows to explore product behaviour, evaluate alternatives, audit language, and assess usability and technical feasibility before significant implementation investment.

 - Partner Through Shipped Quality: Work closely with Engineering on implementation strategy, design QA, product polish, and post-release iteration using customer feedback and product evidence.

 - Create Reusable Leverage: Turn repeated workflow and language needs into patterns, assets, documentation, terminology, prompts, or practices that improve more than one feature.

 - Mentor and Facilitate: Help designers and cross-functional partners build stronger product-language judgment through critique, decision reviews, workshops, concise documentation, and practical guidance.
   
   


YOUR SUPERPOWERS 🦸‍♀️

 - Your portfolio shows ownership of complex, ambiguous workflows or significant product-area work with visible customer and product impact—not only writing samples

 - You can explain how you triangulated qualitative research, quantitative evidence, business risk, localization considerations, and technical constraints

 - You demonstrate strong interaction, visual, information-architecture, content-design, accessibility, and product-language judgment across difficult states and edge cases

 - You have created or contributed to product-language systems, terminology frameworks, component guidance, content pattern libraries, or other reusable product standards

 - You show how prototypes, experiments, audits, or validation changed product direction before or after release

 - You can define meaningful outcomes, distinguish signal from activity, and explain what the team learned after launch

 - You have influenced Product and Engineering decisions early, managed disagreement constructively, and stayed accountable through implementation quality

 - You understand how product language must work across design systems and languages, including translation readiness, terminology reuse, variables, layout constraints, and inclusive communication

 - You use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully for research, synthesis, language exploration, prototyping, quality review, or implementation critique while retaining human judgment and accountability

 - You have helped other designers or cross-functional partners build stronger judgment through mentorship, critique, facilitation, and practical guidance
   
   


BONUS POINTS 🌟

 - Experience designing language and interaction patterns for AI-assisted, agentic, recommendation, conversational, generated-output, or automation workflows

 - Experience with localization tooling and practices such as Lokalise, terminology management, localization previews, translation-quality review, or localization-to-codebase workflows

 - Contributions to design systems, accessibility maturity, product-language systems, research practices, or reusable interaction patterns

 - Experience with enterprise learning, HR technology, content authoring, analytics, knowledge management, administration, or skills platforms

 - Practical experiments with tools such as Codex or similar systems—for AI-assisted audits, product-language linting, prompt packs, prototypes, plugins, scripts, or app-level language guidance—that show you learn by making

 - Build account-based programs using intent data and buying signals to prioritize in-market accounts and reach full buying committees, not just ad hoc contacts.

 - Partner with enterprise AMs, AEs and BDRs through structured cadences on targeting, messaging, and pipeline reviews. You build trust and collaboration with the sales team.


ENTERPRISE EXPANSION — CROSS-SELL / UPSELL (YOU OWN THIS)

FEDERAL / GOVERNMENT SUPPORT

 - Support enterprise federal campaigns. This includes content syndication, event execution, targeted account lists, and campaign support alongside product marketing and the broader gov motion. This is a support function within your book of work, not a standalone track.


ENTERPRISE PARTNER MARKETING

 - Run partner campaigns with a small number of select partners that move ENT/Gov pipeline (think Deloitte, AWS, Carahsoft) — joint programs and co-hosted events. If it generates measurable, Enterprise pipeline, it’s in scope.


MEASUREMENT & ITERATION

 - Using AI to scale what works.

 - Measure everything — pipeline created, influenced, and accelerated, with clear attribution across new business, expansion, and partner-sourced.

 - If something isn't working, you say so and change course. No sunk-cost loyalty to a channel or a partner.

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.




We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.




So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.




THE ADVENTURE AHEAD

This is a partner marketing role built for pipeline. You'll turn a small number of high-potential partnerships (think AWS, Deloitte, and Carahsoft) into real, measurable revenue channels. You'll also be our enterprise marketing lead for regulated industries, specifically life sciences and government, where trust, compliance, and the right partner relationships decide who wins.

The objective is clear, but the playbook is yours to define. Some weeks you'll build an account plan with an AWS demand gen partner. Other weeks you'll plan a field event for healthcare or federal buyers, or work with sales on a named account list. The goal is to leverage partner channels to generate Enterprise, public sector and life sciences pipeline.


🗓️ THE DAY-TO-DAY

Partner Marketing That Generates Pipeline (the core of the job)

 - Run joint programs with a small number of select partners (AWS, Deloitte, Carahsoft, and others as we prove what works) that move Enterprise and Gov pipeline.

 - Make AWS work harder. Partner with our AWS demand gen resource by supplying what's been missing: target account selection, strong assets, account intelligence, seller engagement, tracking, and a packaged pitch AWS sellers can use.

 - Use partner relationships to open doors at named ABM accounts, through formal partner workflows and one-off introductions, and build a repeatable process around both.

 - Work closely with the Partnerships team on joint planning, co-funded activity, and accountability on timelines and lead commitments.

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced attribution with RevOps so we know what's working and where to invest.

Field Events

 - Plan and run field events that put us in front of enterprise buyers, including Supper Clubs and partner co-hosted dinners, roundtables, and executive gatherings.

 - Work with partners to co-fund and co-host events, with registrant targets and clear roles agreed up front.

 - Partner with AEs, BDRs, and partner managers before and after every event so meetings, follow-up, and pipeline actually happen.

 - Support our presence at industry events (for example, HR Tech, Unleash, DevLearn, and GovLoop) and turn them into pipeline.

Regulated Industries: Healthcare and Government

 - Own the enterprise marketing approach for healthcare and public-sector buyers, where long cycles, compliance requirements, and buying committees shape everything.

 - Build account-based programs for healthcare systems and government agencies using intent data and buying signals.

 - Support federal campaigns alongside product marketing and the gov sales team: content syndication, event execution, targeted account lists, and partner-led plays (such as Carahsoft).

 - Develop messaging and programs that speak to the real concerns of regulated buyers, like security, compliance, procurement paths, and contract vehicles.

Account-Based Execution and Sales Partnership

 - Build account-based programs that reach full buying committees, including expansion into new teams inside existing accounts.

 - Partner with enterprise AMs, AEs, and BDRs through structured cadences on targeting, messaging, and pipeline reviews.

Measurement & Iteration

 - Use AI to scale what works.

 - Measure everything: pipeline created, influenced, and accelerated, with clear attribution across new business, expansion, and partner-sourced.

 - If something isn't working, whether a channel, an event, or a partner, you say so and change course. No sunk-cost loyalty.


💪 YOUR SUPERPOWERS

 - Pipeline-obsessed marketer: 4–6 years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, with at least 1–2 years targeting enterprise buyers (5,000+ employees). You've driven measurable pipeline and revenue, not just lead volume.

 - Partner builder: You've made partnerships produce pipeline, not just co-branded content. You know how to get a partner's sellers to care about your accounts.

 - Field event operator: You've planned and executed events that turned into meetings and opportunities, and you know how to get sales and partners in the room.

 - Buying-committee thinker: You're fluent in intent data, buying signals, and account engagement, and you use them to decide where to focus.

 - Sales trust-builder: You win as a team with sales, through in-the-weeds collaboration and shared accountability.

 - Ruthless about scope: You orient around what gets results and can stay focused on a few partners and programs without losing sight of the goal.

 - "I can figure this out" mindset toward tools: UserGems, Influ2, ReachDesk, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Claude. Bonus points if you've used some, but curiosity matters more than a checklist.

 - Active AI practitioner: You're already applying AI anywhere and everywhere.


🎁 BONUS POINTS

 - Experience marketing to healthcare, government, or other regulated or public-sector buyers.

 - Experience with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure), co-sell, or global systems-integrator partnerships (Deloitte-style) where you made the relationship produce pipeline.

 - Experience with government channel partners or reseller/contract vehicle models (Carahsoft-style).

 - Familiarity with compliance and procurement considerations in healthcare or federal sales.

 - Experience in learning, HR tech, or skills-focused technology.




OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.




OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

 - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
   




OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍

 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

 - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

 - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

 - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

ashby:docker:3458c40b-e757-4bb3-8b53-235.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



As Docker continues its rapid growth, we're seeking an inspiring and experienced Director of Partner Solution Engineering to lead a world-class team. Docker helps organizations solve complex challenges in modern software supply chains, security governance, and AI-driven development. This role offers the opportunity to shape how our strategic partners, including ISVs, CSPs, SIs, and VARs, adopt and deliver transformative technologies that make developers more productive and secure.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Partner Solution Engineering, you will lead a high-performing technical organization responsible for driving partner enablement, joint go-to-market initiatives, and technical excellence across Docker's partner ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Partner Sales, Technical Alliances, Product, and Engineering to develop scalable technical partnership strategies that help partners successfully integrate, sell, and deliver Docker's platform. Your focus will be on enabling your team to drive partner technical readiness, co-innovation, and mutual customer success while building repeatable models for partner engagement at scale.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

 - Lead, develop, and inspire a team of Partner Solution Engineers, ensuring professional growth and high performance across multiple partner segments (ISVs, CSPs, SIs, VARs).

 - Build and scale the Partner SE organization to support Docker's expanding partner ecosystem and geographic coverage.

 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning focused on partner success and technical excellence.

 - Coach, mentor, and empower your team to engage effectively with diverse partner organizations and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.


PARTNER ENABLEMENT & TECHNICAL STRATEGY

 - Establish repeatable processes and programs for partner technical enablement, including scalable learning paths, certifications, technical deep-dives, and integration workshops.

 - Design and deliver both 1:1 strategic enablement for key partners and 1-to-many programs that drive adoption across the broader partner ecosystem.

 - Create technical content, integration guides, architectural diagrams, reference architectures, and enablement videos tailored for partners.

 - Develop partner-specific technical sales plays, solution validation frameworks, and proof-of-value methodologies that highlight Docker's differentiated value.


JOINT GO-TO-MARKET EXECUTION

 - Partner with the Partner Sales organization to drive joint account planning, co-selling opportunities, and "sell-with" and "sell-through" motions.

 - Guide partners through solution design, technical validation, and evaluation processes to achieve joint customer success and sales goals.

 - Support product positioning and technical validation during joint sales engagements, ensuring clarity on what's GA and ready for delivery.

 - Define and track metrics for partner technical readiness, engagement quality, and revenue impact.


PRODUCT & ALLIANCE COLLABORATION

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share Voice of the Partner, influencing roadmap priorities and co-building initiatives.

 - Guide beta/EAP program participation with strategic partners, gathering feedback on new features and integration requirements.

 - Work closely with the Technical Alliances team on roadmap alignment, technical integrations with CSPs and ISVs, and partner-driven feature requests.

 - Champion regional partner technical needs and priorities in internal planning discussions (FedGov, EMEA, APAC).


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

 - Collaborate with Field SEs to ensure alignment with market-specific requirements, share learnings, and avoid duplication of effort.

 - Partner with Marketing to support partner events, conferences, webinars, and demand generation programs.

 - Work with Sales leadership to define partner success metrics, performance standards, and technical excellence measures.

 - Represent Docker at partner events and conferences as a technical expert and evangelist.


OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Create an environment of continuous improvement focused on partner outcomes, operational excellence, and scalable processes.

 - Develop internal enablement programs that enhance partner SE capabilities and share best practices across teams.

 - Establish tools, systems, and workflows that enable efficient partner engagement and measurement.

 - Build strong feedback loops to iterate on enablement strategies based on data-driven insights and partner performance.




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - 8+ years of experience leading technical partner engineering, partner solutions, or pre-sales teams for distributed systems, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure companies.

 - Proven success in guiding teams that support channel partnerships, strategic alliances, and joint go-to-market initiatives.

 - Minimum of 5 years in management, including hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing partner-facing technical teams.

 - Deep understanding of partner ecosystems including ISVs, CSPs (AWS, Azure, GCP), Systems Integrators, and VARs.

 - Strong experience in software supply chain security, security governance, DevOps, DevSecOps, or developer productivity technologies.

 - Deep technical understanding of containerization, cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tools.

 - Demonstrated ability to build scalable partner enablement programs (technical learning paths, certifications, workshops).

 - Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to build trust across technical and business audiences at both partner and customer organizations.

 - Strong strategic thinking with proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive complex initiatives.


PREFERRED

 - Operational experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container-based platforms.

 - Experience with application security principles and securing the software supply chain, including SBOMs, image scanning, and secure delivery pipelines.

 - Background in software development, scripting, or infrastructure-as-code.

 - Experience enabling developer productivity through coding assistants, AI integrations, or AI agent development.

 - Familiarity with partner operations tools including Salesforce and enablement platforms like MindTickle.

 - Experience working in both direct and channel sales models, understanding the nuances of partner-led vs. partner-assisted sales.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

 - Willingness to travel (~30% expected) to support key partner engagements and events.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


30 DAYS

 - Successfully onboard, gaining familiarity with Docker's platform, partner ecosystem, and partner go-to-market strategy.

 - Establish relationships with your team, Partner Sales, Technical Alliances, Field SE leadership, and key cross-functional partners.

 - Begin shadowing partner calls, reviewing existing enablement materials, and understanding current partner technical capabilities.

 - Learn tooling (Salesforce, Looker, Docker platform, PRM) and connect with internal stakeholders.


90 DAYS

 - Develop and align a 12-month strategic plan with Partner Sales, Technical Alliances, and Product leadership.

 - Begin executing key initiatives focused on improving partner technical readiness, enablement program quality, and joint sales effectiveness.

 - Lead enablement sessions for selected strategic partners and support joint-account planning activities.

 - Produce initial partner-facing technical content and establish your voice as a technical leader in the partner ecosystem.


1 YEAR

 - Scale and enable a high-impact Partner Solution Engineering organization that drives measurable partner success and revenue growth through the channel.

 - Own the technical strategy for one or more partner segments with documented processes, metrics, and success stories.

 - Become a trusted advisor across Partner Sales, Product, Engineering, and Technical Alliances by championing partner insights and technical excellence.

 - Demonstrate quantifiable improvements in partner technical closure rates, joint sales velocity, and partner satisfaction scores.

 - Build a reputation as a thought leader in the partner ecosystem, representing Docker effectively at partner events and conferences.




WHY JOIN DOCKER

Docker is at the forefront of developer productivity and software supply chain security. As Director of Partner Solution Engineering, you'll have the opportunity to:

 - Shape the technical strategy for how Docker scales through its partner ecosystem

 - Build and lead a world-class team of Partner Solution Engineers

 - Work with industry-leading partners including major cloud providers, security vendors, and global system integrators

 - Influence product direction based on partner and customer insights

 - Make a measurable impact on Docker's growth through the channel

 - Collaborate with passionate, talented teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Alliances

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic partnership development, and team building. If you're excited about enabling partners to deliver exceptional outcomes for joint customers while building a best-in-class Partner SE organization, we'd love to hear from you.



Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

 

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$327.6K– CA$468K OTE + equity

United States: $226.1K – $323K OTE + equity



______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

 - Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

 - Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

 - Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

 - Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

 - Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

 - Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

 - Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

 - Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

 - Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.



Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.



#LI-REMOTE

Docker is seeking a results-oriented Account Executive, Mid-Enterprise. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a proven track record of success selling to strategic level accounts.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Meet with prospects to generate interest in purchasing commercial Docker products

 - Meet with customers to identify areas to expand their partnership with Docker via additional products and services

 - Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets quotas of sourced qualified opportunities and closed business

 - Accurately forecast business on a monthly and quarterly cadence

 - Spearhead the growth & adoption of Docker within our existing user base

 - Establish and maintain active engagement with clients that demonstrate usage patterns that indicate a propensity to acquire our commercial offering

 - Respond to and qualify incoming inquiries regarding interest in Docker products

 - Craft a great first impression to our prospects and customers by adding value during every customer touchpoint

 - Partner with cross-functional teams to share customer feedback, inform product road map and drive strong marketing campaigns

 - Engage in team development and mentoring
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ year(s) of sales experience selling to mid market and/or enterprise customers; preference for selling technical products to developer and engineering personas

 - A demonstrated track record of success

 - Experience working with a technical product or the aptitude to quickly learn complex technical concepts

 - Experience with Open Source Software business models is preferred but not required

 - Experience with all aspects of B2B technology sales aspects, including pre-call planning, opportunity qualification, objection handling, and closing opportunities

 - The ability to structure, control, and lead calls

 - High integrity and a team-first mentality

 - Positive and upbeat phone skills, excellent listening skills, and strong writing skills

 - Sales training and Salesforce experience a plus

 - 4-year college degree or equivalent experience preferred




WHAT TO EXPECT


FIRST 30 DAYS

 - You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program

 - You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as; Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Sales Navigator, and Docker

 - You will begin core AE functions; prospecting, lead qualification, discovery meetings, Account Management/Introductions, Salesforce hygiene, and pipeline management.

 - You will work closely with your manager, shadow your peers, and partner with your BDR to develop prospecting strategies unique to your territory

 - At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role




FIRST 60 DAYS

 - During your second month, you will be laser-focused on Account Management, Opportunity Generation, identify target accounts and prospecting strategies in your territory

 - You will have connected with all of your primary customer accounts (both net-new opportunities in flight and partner with Renewal Managers on upcoming renewals)

 - Build prospecting lists for target accounts, understanding key decision-makers and then reach out to them using all communication channels (cold call, email, chat, and social media)

 - You will comprehend and maintain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and have a great pitch

 - Adhere to team KPI metrics and prospecting standards

 - You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in the AE role

 - You will ideally be able to close your first transaction


FIRST 90 DAYS

 - In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to fully immerse yourself in your day job

 - You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and daily activities

 - You will be an accomplished seller of Docker products with multiple transactions (renewals, upsell, net-new) under your belt

 - You will be ready to independently operate at full speed

Lifecycle marketing is one of the fastest-scaling parts of that team: it already owns user and admin nurtures, renewal automation, and first-touch outreach for PQLs and inbound leads, running against a marketable base in the tens of millions.

As Senior Lifecycle Marketer, you'll report directly to the VP of PLG and partner closely with our existing lifecycle marketing lead. You'll take ownership of assigned products, audiences, and lifecycle stages, with real input into shaping the approach for what you own, not just shipping someone else's plan, and you'll help turn a fast-growing list of priorities into a structured, scalable lifecycle engine.




WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

 - Lifecycle Fluency: You think in full user journeys, not campaigns. You've done lifecycle marketing specifically, not just growth or demand gen, and you know how nurture, activation, retention, and renewal connect across a product's full lifecycle.

 - Builder's Mindset: You'd rather own a program end to end, strategy, build, QA, and send, than hand pieces of it off. You bring structure to ambiguity: turning a fast-growing list of priorities into themes, a build queue, and a sequenced roadmap.

 - Audience & Signal Validation: You know how to validate an audience and its underlying signal before it ships: spot-checking record-level data, sanity-checking targeting logic, and catching a bad segment before it reaches users. You don't need to write SQL yourself, but you can work directly with data teams to confirm a list is right.

 - Cross-Functional Operator: You operate well across marketing, sales (BDR and renewals), data, and design/agency partners, and you know how to keep programs moving even when you don't own every dependency.

 - Marketing Automation Execution: You've personally built campaigns in Marketo or an equivalent platform, not just briefed them: audience builds, suppressions and contact governance, pre-send QA and live proofs, and launch monitoring, including troubleshooting a broken data sync in the moment.

 - Technical Translation: You can take a technical product or a raw usage signal, a feature adoption event, a usage threshold, a new capability, and turn it into messaging that reads credible to a developer or admin, not generic marketing copy.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build the Lifecycle Engine: Own and build lifecycle campaigns (email and in-product messaging) across Docker's Container and AI Platform products, including Sandboxes and AI Governance, for both end users and admins.

 - Scale Programmatic Sends: Design and run large-scale programmatic sends, such as recurring account health checks, to a base in the tens of millions, working within the team's marketing automation stack (currently Marketo and Mailgun; expect a platform transition in the next 6–12 months).

 - Automate Lead and Renewal Motions: Stand up and run automated first-touch flows for PQLs and inbound leads, in partnership with BDR and renewals stakeholders.

 - Validate Audiences & Signals: Partner with data and growth engineering to pull the usage signals campaigns depend on (Snowflake and internal data tools), and validate that an audience and its underlying signal are correct before every send.

 - Manage Suppressions & Contact Governance: Own suppression lists and contact governance rules so campaigns stay compliant and don't over-message or reach the wrong audience.

 - QA, Launch Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Run pre-send QA and live proofs on every campaign, monitor launches as they go out, and troubleshoot issues in real time, including broken data syncs.

 - Translate Signals into Messaging: Turn technical product usage and adoption signals into messaging that reads credible and useful to developers and admins, not generic marketing copy.

 - Shape and Sequence Strategy: Take a fast-growing list of priorities and turn it into a concrete build queue: itemize the work, sequence it, and flag capacity or dependency issues early.

 - Coordinate Design & Agency Partners: Work with design and agency partners to keep campaign quality and turnaround on track.

 - Operationalize Reporting: Own naming, tracking, and reporting on programs so the rest of the team has visibility into what's live, what's next, and what it's driving.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Lifecycle Marketing Experience: A background specifically in lifecycle marketing, not pure growth or demand gen, ideally inside a PLG or self-serve motion.

 - Proven Program Ownership: A track record of owning campaigns end to end (strategy, build, QA, send) and shipping programs that moved a real metric: activation, retention, or renewal conversion.

 - Marketing Automation Build Experience: Hands-on build experience in Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform: audience builds, program/campaign setup, suppressions and contact governance, pre-send QA and live proofs, and launch monitoring.

 - Data & Targeting Validation: Comfortable working directly with data teams to validate record-level data and targeting logic, for example auditing who's actually in a segment or spot-checking a list against expectations. Writing SQL yourself is a plus, not a requirement.

 - Technical-to-Message Translation: A track record of turning a technical product or a raw usage signal into messaging that reads credible to a developer or admin audience, not generic marketing copy.

 - Technical Familiarity: Comfort navigating developer ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, or complex multi-product software platforms.

 - Independent Ownership: Senior-level judgment and ownership as an individual contributor: you can run with ambiguity and drive a program without every step spelled out, and you collaborate well with another senior peer on the team.


WHAT TO EXPECT


FIRST 30 DAYS

 - Immerse & Align: Get up to speed on Docker's PLG motion, product surface area (Container and AI), and the programs lifecycle already owns. Build a working relationship with data, BDR, renewals, and design/agency partners.

 - Program & Tooling Audit: Audit the current state of user and admin nurtures, renewal automation, and PQL/lead outreach, and get familiar with the Marketo/Mailgun stack and its upcoming transition.

 - Roadmap Calibration: Work with the lifecycle team to turn the current priority list into themes, a build queue, and a sequenced roadmap.


FIRST 90 DAYS

 - Ship Owned Campaigns: Take ownership of at least one full program, such as an admin nurture flow or a PQL first-touch sequence, from build through send.

 - Contribute to Renewal Automation: Stand up a first version of automated renewal outreach in partnership with the renewals team.

 - Build the Reporting Cadence: Put in place naming, tracking, and reporting so the team has clear visibility into what's live and what it's driving.


ONE YEAR OUTLOOK

 - Own a Mature Program Set: Own a mature, scaled set of lifecycle programs across your assigned products, audiences, and lifecycle stages.

 - Prove Impact: Show measurable lift in activation, retention, or renewal conversion tied directly to your programs.

 - Scale the Function: Help lifecycle marketing operate as a predictable, automated engine rather than a set of one-off campaigns, as scope keeps expanding across the Platform.

greenhouse:doordashcanada:8230450.description:
About the Team 

 The Sales Compliance team is responsible for ensuring revenue assurance and designing effective OTC compliance and controls across DoorDash’s and Deliveroo’s Merchant organization. The Sales compliance team is part of the larger Sales Strategy & Operations team, which accelerates productivity and develops go-to-market strategies and processes to support our sales organization. This group builds the engine and foundation for DoorDash to achieve the best selection for our platform and grow revenues across all business lines.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking a Manager, Sales Compliance to build the vision and roadmap for DoorDash and Deliveroo’s Merchant revenue assurance program. This role will oversee our key revenue related SOX controls, which ensures all commission rate changes and merchant pricing terms are contractually supported, accurately configured in system, and correctly applied to charges.

 This role is responsible for overseeing monthly contract-to-system-to-charge reconciliations, investigating exceptions and partnering cross-functionally with product, engineering, accounting, legal and audit teams to remediate underlying root cause issues that help accelerate DoorDash and Deliveroo’s revenue growth. They will also demonstrate operating effectiveness for all order-to-cash controls to Accounting, Internal and External Audit. This role will support all of DoorDash’s and Deliveroo’s marketplace products, business lines and countries/geos. 

 You will report to the Senior Manager, Sales Compliance. This role is hybrid, based in Vancouver, Canada.

 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 

- 
 Own the end-to-end effectiveness of key SOX revenue controls, holding the program to the standard of 100% of merchants charged correctly, 100% of the time

- 
 Be accountable for the effectiveness of contract → system → delivery-level charge reconciliations, reviewing and challenging outputs to ensure accuracy, identify trends and assess risk areas

- 
 Drive the shift toward automation, validating DoorDash’s contract source of truth, automated reconciliations and anomaly detection.

- 
 Provide oversight on commission rate changes and new merchant onboardings, ensuring adherence to established controls and policies

- 
 Guide investigations into mismatches, including reviewing root cause analysis, validating exposure assessments, and ensuring timely remediation

- 
 Oversee refunds, corrections, and rep outreach at scale, defining correction strategies that resolve exposure while protecting the merchant relationship

- 
 Partner with Engineering and cross-functional teams to build and enhance reconciliation data views, scripts, and SOPs, improving control efficiency and enabling scalable execution by junior team members

- 
 Own audit-ready documentation, with clear support for control conclusions and reviewer sign-off standards

- 
 Drive expansion of control scope to additional geographies and product areas, including defining approach, risks, and developing a scalable reconciliation framework

- 
 Identify systemic control gaps and recommend scalable process improvements

- 
 Synthesize and present control outcomes, key risks, and insights to Sales leadership, Engineering and Internal Audit

 We’re excited about you because…

- 
 You have 7+ years of experience in external audit (Big 4 preferred), internal audit, or SOX compliance

- 
 You have experience testing or operating revenue-related controls

- 
 You understand revenue recognition and order-to-cash processes

- 
 You are highly proficient in Excel and comfortable working with large datasets

- 
 You have experience partnering with data teams

- 
 You have strong attention to detail and enjoy investigating data discrepancies

- 
 You are comfortable owning a recurring control and interacting directly with auditors

- 
 You are organized, process-driven, and thrive in a controlled environment

- 
 You are fluent in AI tools and concepts, with the ability to identify and deploy AI-forward solutions to improve efficiency, controls, and insights

 Compensation 

 Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. 

 In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

 DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

 Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

 To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .

 The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
 $121,000 — $151,500 CAD 

 About DoorDash 

 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. 

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

 The SMB Business Development team works with DoorDash partners across Canada to help grow their business on the platform. We focus on growing, retaining, and expanding partnerships with high-value restaurant partners. Meal Boxes is DoorDash’s ambitious effort to help customers access craveable, high-quality meals at compelling value. We partner with standout restaurants in each community to create curated, filling meals that customers love and return to regularly. As we scale in Canada, this team will play a critical role in building the merchant base, refining the model by market, and establishing a repeatable path for growth.

 About the Role 

 As an SMB Business Development Executive – Meal Boxes , you will help launch and scale Meal Boxes across Canada. You will own high-impact merchant partnerships, support new-market expansion, and help shape how we take an early model from 0 → 1 and scale it nationally. This is a highly consultative sales role focused on securing strong restaurant partners that can deliver both customer value and sustainable merchant economics. You will work closely with Canada leadership, Account Management, and cross-functional teams to refine the Canadian go-to-market strategy, develop sales playbooks, and identify what works across diverse markets.You will report to the Manager of SMB Business Development. - Refine sales playbooks: Develop and iterate on talk tracks, pitch materials, and sales strategies to unlock high-volume, high-retention partners

- Work closely with leadership: Partner directly with the General Manager of Affordable Meals on strategy, execution, and daily decision-making

- Lead in-market efforts: Travel to priority markets to meet merchants, build relationships, and close high-impact deals

- Operate entrepreneurially: Act as an independent problem solver who can adapt quickly, move fast, and lead through ambiguity

- 5+ years of experience in high-impact sales, business development, or partnerships, ideally within fast-paced or entrepreneurial environments

- Strong understanding of restaurant operations and unit economics, including margins, cost structures, and profitability drivers

- Proven ability to use data and financial modeling to tell a compelling business story and support strategic sales conversations

- Experience building or scaling repeatable sales playbooks and go-to-market strategies
