Role Description 

 The Dropbox Business Development team builds and grows strategic partnerships that expand Dropbox's reach, deepen product adoption, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. As a Business Development Manager, you will own a portfolio spanning AI, platform/developer, hardware, AI, and SaaS ecosystems. You will manage the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and commercial strategy through launch, ongoing growth, and partner success. 

 You will play a key role in shaping Dropbox's partnership strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business cases, and translating partner needs into integrated customer experiences. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute partnerships across device distribution and AI agent ecosystems. This role offers significant exposure to senior leaders and external executives while owning partnerships with meaningful strategic and commercial impact. 

 AI and automation are increasingly embedded in our workflows, accelerating research, partner preparation, and administrative work. Success in this role comes from using these capabilities to increase efficiency while focusing your time on strategic decision-making, commercial negotiations, and relationship management. 

 Responsibilities 

- Own and grow strategic distribution and ecosystem partnerships to drive customer acquisition, product adoption, and revenue growth. 

- Identify, evaluate, and develop commercial opportunities with existing and prospective partners. 

- Build business cases and financial models that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions. 

- Lead or support commercial negotiations while balancing strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes. 

- Build trusted executive relationships through regular business reviews, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration. 

- Analyze partner performance and leverage data, experimentation, and AI-enabled tools to optimize commercial outcomes. 

- Partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute complex partnership initiatives. 

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in business development, distribution partnerships, product management, or related commercial roles within SaaS, cloud services, or technology. 

- Demonstrated success building and growing strategic business partnerships that drive measurable business results. 

- Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with experience evaluating partnership investments and ROI. 

- Excellent negotiation, communication, and executive presentation skills. 

- Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments. 

- Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve research, analysis, communication, or workflow efficiency. 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

 Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, consulting, or corporate strategy experience. 

- Strong understanding of consumer technology ecosystems. 

- Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across product and commercial organizations. 

- Demonstrated success using AI-enabled workflows to improve commercial execution.

greenhouse:dropbox:8233087.description:
Role Description 

 As a Scaled Customer Success Manager at Dropbox, you will drive adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness across a portfolio of mid-market and small business managed customers. You will use customer and product signals to identify where engagement can have the greatest impact, then deliver timely, relevant experiences through targeted campaigns, group programs, digital touchpoints, and selective personalized outreach. 

 You will play a central role in connecting our Programmatic and Digital Customer Success team with the Renewals Desk for scaled segment accounts. You will ensure customer health, sentiment, risk, and adoption signals translate into clear renewal-readiness actions, while identifying and qualifying customer-backed growth opportunities as Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) for handoff to Sales. 

 Within the scaled portfolio, you will provide more focused engagement for a priority group of customers and translate customer health, retention, renewal, and growth signals into regular executive-level updates that support forecasting and business decisions. You will also own shared inbound customer channels, ensuring questions and requests are triaged, resolved, or routed to the right partner with clear follow-through. 

 The successful candidate is a customer-focused operator who is equally comfortable analyzing a portfolio, building repeatable engagement programs, writing clear customer communications, and speaking directly with customers to understand their experience. You will bring recent experience managing or materially influencing customer renewals, including the ability to interpret retention metrics, identify churn and contraction risk, execute save plays, and surface customer-backed growth levers. You will help Dropbox scale Customer Success while retaining the judgment, curiosity, and customer voice that come from real customer conversations. 

 Responsibilities 

- Own adoption, customer health, and renewal readiness across a scaled customer portfolio, using lifecycle, product usage, engagement, sentiment, and retention signals to prioritize action and improve renewal outcomes. 

- Provide focused engagement for a priority group of customers, partnering closely with Renewal Managers and other account stakeholders to coordinate retention and growth actions and deliver regular executive-level portfolio and forecast updates for top accounts in the scaled portfolio. 

- Design and execute targeted campaigns and scaled touchpoints that help customers adopt key capabilities, realize value, prepare for renewal, and address common risks at the right moments in their journey. 

- Serve as the coordination point between Programmatic and Digital Customer Success and the  Renewals Desk, ensuring timely handoffs, shared visibility, clear ownership, and coordinated save plays for customers with renewal-readiness gaps or identified churn and contraction risk. 

- Own and manage shared inbound customer email channels, triaging questions and requests, coordinating timely responses, and ensuring issues are resolved or routed to the appropriate partner with clear follow-through. 

- Use data to segment customers, identify patterns, test engagement strategies, measure impact, and continuously improve playbooks, content, workflows, and automation. 

- Engage customers directly when a focused 1:1 conversation is needed to validate a signal, understand sentiment, address risk, gather product feedback, or capture a representative customer example. 

- Synthesize customer voice across the portfolio and share actionable insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Experience partners to improve the product and customer journey. 

- Partner cross-functionally to operationalize repeatable customer programs, resolve gaps in the customer experience, and identify customer-backed growth levers such as broader adoption, new use cases, license utilization, or additional product fit. Qualify relevant opportunities as Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and route them to Sales with clear customer context and supporting signals. 

 Requirements 

- 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, Digital Customer Success, lifecycle programs, or a comparable post-sale customer role. 

- Recent experience directly managing or materially influencing customer renewals across a book of business, with measurable examples of save plays, churn or contraction mitigation, and retention outcomes. 

- Demonstrated success managing customer outcomes across a broad or high-volume portfolio through a combination of one-to-many programs and targeted 1:1 engagement. 

- Strong analytical judgment and fluency in SaaS retention metrics, including renewal rate, gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, churn, contraction, and expansion, with experience using those measures alongside customer signals to identify risk and growth levers. 

- Experience designing or executing customer lifecycle, adoption, retention, or renewal-readiness campaigns and measuring their impact on customer behavior or business outcomes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear customer-facing content and lead effective discovery or feedback conversations. 

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate across Customer Success, Renewals, Sales, and other teams, clarify ownership, and move shared retention and growth outcomes forward while managing concurrent programs and changing priorities. 

- Experience with Customer Success platforms, CRM systems, marketing automation, business intelligence tools, or related customer-data systems. 

 Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a Customer Success model that partners with a centralized Renewals Desk or specialized renewals team. 

- Experience facilitating webinars, office hours, group enablement, customer communities, or other one-to-many programs. 

- Experience applying test-and-learn methods to improve engagement, adoption, retention, or conversion outcomes. 

- Experience supporting collaboration, productivity, content, or AI-enabled SaaS products.

greenhouse:dropbox:8067367.title: Vice President, Revenue Operations
greenhouse:dropbox:8067367.description:
Role Description 

 Dropbox is seeking a Vice President of Revenue Operations to define and lead the operating strategy for the company’s global B2B go-to-market organization. This executive will be responsible for building a high-performing, scalable revenue engine that enables predictable and efficient growth across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments while supporting Dropbox’s evolution across product-led, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions. 

 This leader will serve as a key strategic partner to the Chief Business Officer and broader executive leadership team, translating company strategy into the operating model, planning frameworks, systems, insights, and execution mechanisms required to deliver durable growth. The role will own Revenue Operations and Marketing Operations across the customer lifecycle, ensuring tight alignment between demand generation, pipeline creation, sales execution, retention, expansion, and overall revenue performance. 

 The VP of Revenue Operations will have enterprise-wide accountability for revenue planning, forecasting, segmentation, capacity and coverage strategy, incentives, GTM systems, analytics, operating cadence, and revenue productivity. This leader will play a central role in shaping how Dropbox allocates resources, evaluates performance, scales new products and motions, and modernizes its GTM organization through data, automation, and AI. 

 Responsibilities 

- Define and lead Dropbox’s global revenue operating strategy, ensuring the company’s GTM model is designed to support long-term growth, efficiency, and increasing enterprise complexity

- Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Business Officer and executive leadership team, bringing data-driven insights and recommendations to critical decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, organizational design, and GTM strategy

- Own the end-to-end revenue operating model across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support, including segmentation, coverage models, territory architecture, role design, operating rhythms, and cross-functional accountability

- Lead company-wide annual and long-range revenue planning, including bookings targets, quota strategy, capacity and workforce planning, territory design, productivity assumptions, investment scenarios, and resource allocation

- Establish a best-in-class forecasting and pipeline management framework that increases predictability, strengthens executive visibility, and enables earlier intervention against business performance risks

- Define and evolve the company’s revenue performance architecture, including the KPIs, operating cadences, inspection mechanisms, and executive business reviews used to assess growth, productivity, efficiency, retention, and expansion

- Lead Revenue Operations across the full customer lifecycle, creating scalable and integrated processes from demand generation and lead management through opportunity conversion, renewal, expansion, and customer growth

- Partner with Marketing leadership to oversee Marketing Operations and ensure strong alignment between demand generation investments, pipeline creation, segmentation, campaign performance, and downstream revenue outcomes

- Partner closely with Finance on revenue strategy and planning, pricing and packaging operations, investment allocation, deal governance, incentive compensation, and performance management

- Partner with Product and GTM leadership to define the operating strategy for new products, new customer segments, pricing changes, packaging evolution, and emerging sales motions

- Own the strategy and evolution of Dropbox’s GTM technology ecosystem, ensuring systems, data architecture, automation, and workflows scale effectively with the business

- Lead the adoption of AI across Revenue Operations and the broader GTM organization, identifying opportunities to fundamentally improve seller productivity, forecasting, customer targeting, planning, decision-making, and operational efficiency

- Simplify legacy processes, systems, and organizational structures where needed, driving enterprise-wide transformation and change management across a complex stakeholder environment

greenhouse:elastic:8122170.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.  What is The Role 

 We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) within Elastic Security. Attackers not only break in - they log in. Identity is now a major target for attacks. These attacks can happen in on-premises setups, cloud environments, or with self-directed agents. Detecting and responding to identity-based attacks is essential for any modern Security Operations Center (SOC).

 In this high-impact role, you will define how Elastic detects, investigates, and responds to identity-based threats, building on our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation to deliver a credible, differentiated ITDR function. You will also own the roadmap for securing non-human and AI agent identities within Elastic Security, one of the fastest-growing and least-governed attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will work at the intersection of identity, detection engineering, and AI, partnering with threat researchers, data scientists, and engineers, and evangelizing our approach to a global community of security practitioners.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a credible ITDR function within Elastic Security, evolving our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation from behavioral analytics into an identity-defense outcome.

- Manage the plan for non-human and AI agent identities in Elastic Security. This involves modeling service accounts, workloads, secrets, and self-directed agents as important identities. Each identity will have its own behavior standards, ownership, and lifecycle. You will also establish how to detect identities that operate continuously and at machine scale.

- Work with threat research and detection engineering. Focus on identity-specific threats. These threats include credential access, privilege escalation, and identity-based lateral movement. They also involve the abuse of identity providers and tokens. Ensure that these threats relate to real-world adversary tactics.

- Drive the response and containment strategy. This is the 'R' in ITDR. Turn detections into action. Use identity-system integrations and automated responses. Make sure there is human oversight for important actions.

- Work closely with our enterprise customers. Collaborate with security operations teams, sales, and solution architects. Your goal is to understand the requirements for identity attacks. You will also discuss priorities and clarify product needs.

- Work with the design team to develop investigation and response experiences. These experiences will emphasize identity in the analyst workflow. Integrate identity signals with endpoint, cloud, and network data in the SIEM and XDR functions of our security operations platform.

- Gain deep knowledge of the identity-security market. Know its major trends and the changing threat landscape. Use this information to develop a unique strategy and engage with analysts.

- Be the product expert and evangelize Elastic's identity capabilities through content such as blog posts, talks, and open community interaction.

 What You Bring 

- Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for security products such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, identity security, or detection and response. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.

- Identity Security Depth: A solid knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and the identity fabric. This includes Active Directory, cloud identity providers, SSO, OAuth, and privileged access. It also involves knowing how identity threats can occur in both on-premises and cloud environments. Knowledge of ITDR as a discipline and with entity behavioral analytics (UEBA).

- You need to be fluent in non-human identities. This includes service accounts, workloads, secrets, and AI agents. You should also understand why traditional human-identity rules don't apply to identities that act independently and continuously.

- AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical comprehension of the AI/ML landscape, including behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, LLMs, and agentic systems. You are comfortable working closely with data scientists and engineers, and you treat AI agents both as a subject to be secured and as a tool that consumes identity context.

- Bias to action: You are able to advance fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions.

- Management and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment. You operate with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.

- Communication Excellence: Outstanding spoken and written communication skills and practices. You can distill complex detection engineering and identity concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.

- Customer Obsession: An interest for industry trends and a commitment to solving real-world customer problems. You are an advocate for the security analyst and detection engineer, and you are focused on building products that help defenders stay ahead of identity-based threats.

Description & Requirements
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
EA's CFO organization is a diverse group of finance disciplines working closely with teams across the company to deliver profitable creativity. Our mission is to partner with the business to enable great player experiences through strong financial insight, planning, and decision support.
Across our finance teams, we combine curiosity, analytical rigor, and collaboration to tell the story behind the numbers - identifying opportunities, understanding risks, and helping teams make smarter decisions.
ROLE OVERVIEW:
We are looking for a Senior Finance Manager to lead EA Mobile Finance, partnering with leaders across EA Mobile's portfolio of live service titles and new product investments. Reporting to the Director of FP&A, you will serve as a trusted finance partner to EA Mobile portfolio, product, commercial, and finance leaders, helping connect financial planning, business performance, and mobile growth strategy. You will work a hybrid schedule defined as three days in an EA office.
This is a highly visible role for a strong thinker, communicator, and player-coach who can operate across a complex, dynamic mobile business. You bring, clear financial storytelling, and are skilled at influencing decisions across portfolio performance, investment prioritization, resource allocation, and return on investment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Partner with EA Mobile leaders to evaluate strategic choices, investment priorities, and business performance through a clear financial and ROI lens.
Translate mobile franchise economics, player behavior, monetization trends, KPIs, cost drivers, live service performance, and new product investments into clear insights and recommendations that support growth, profitability, and long-term business success.
Own financial planning and performance analysis across EA Mobile, including full P&L management, forecasting, close analysis, risks and opportunities, scenario analysis, consolidation, and executive reporting.
Lead and coach EA Mobile FP&A team members, setting clear priorities, providing thoughtful guidance, and enabling high-quality decision support and strong business impact.
Enhance team productivity and impact through prioritization, simplification, automation, standardization, and thoughtful change management.
WHAT YOU BRING:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment analysis, corporate finance, or a related field; gaming, mobile, or live service experience helpful.
Experience mentoring and coaching finance talent in a complex, cross-functional environment.
Demonstrated financial modeling skills, including driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, business case development, portfolio analysis, and full P&L management.
Solid foundation of accounting principles and GAAP; experience with BI and planning tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, or similar platforms preferred.
Familiarity with and willingness to adopt AI-powered business tools, including generative AI and LLM applications, to enhance financial analysis, reporting, decision support, and workflow efficiency, while maintaining appropriate standards for data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance.

3–6 years of progressive experience in compensation analysis and design.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (can perform complex functions)
Data modeling/analytics capability (able to translate complex analysis into relevant business insights)
Experience with annual pay cycles, salary structure modeling, job leveling, survey submission, compensation benchmarking and geo-pricing
Experience with short and long-term incentive programs

Review and validate complex data sets with accuracy.
Collaborate with global teams across departments and time zones.
A team player who is comfortable to meet the shifting demands of a growing and evolving business

Role Summary
Reporting to the VP, Business Development, the Director, Business Development serves as the EA SPORTS business development lead for strategic initiatives that extend our franchises beyond the core game experience. Working in close partnership with EA Ventures, the business owner of EA's Beyond Game strategy, this role identifies, evaluates, structures, and executes partnership opportunities that create new ways for fans to engage with EA SPORTS brands across digital media, emerging data and technologies, platforms, and connected experiences.
You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, translating enterprise-level Beyond Game priorities into commercially viable opportunities for EA SPORTS. The role collaborates closely with the broader EA SPORTS Business Development organization to leverage and evolve existing league, federation, club, athlete, and commercial partner relationships while identifying new ecosystem partners that accelerate innovation and long-term franchise growth.
Success in this role requires exceptional cross-functional leadership, business and commercial acumen, and the ability to align multiple internal and external stakeholders to deliver partnerships that support scalable, fan-centric experiences that complement EA's core gaming business. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days a week in our Vancouver office.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Partnership Development
You will partner with EA Ventures to support EA's Beyond Game strategy within the EA SPORTS portfolio.
You'll dentify strategic partnership opportunities that extend EA SPORTS franchises into new fan experiences, platforms, and business models.
You will be responsible for executing partnerships that support commercial strategies and business cases for new initiatives that align with franchise, corporate, and partner objectives.
You'll evaluate emerging opportunities across sports media, creator ecosystems, AI, digital platforms, connected experiences, and other adjacent markets.
You will manage partnerships from opportunity identification through execution, launch, and ongoing governance.
Cross-Functional Business Development
Work collaboratively across the EA SPORTS Business Development organization to identify opportunities within the existing partner ecosystem, including leagues, clubs, federations, athletes, data and technology partners, and commercial rights holders.
Ensure Beyond Game initiatives complement and strengthen existing strategic partnerships while creating incremental value for EA and its partners.
Coordinate with franchise Business Development leads to align priorities, partnership approaches, and go-to-market strategies.
Ecosystem Development
Cultivate relationships with established and emerging partners across sports, media, technology, entertainment, and fan engagement.
Expand EA SPORTS' external innovation ecosystem by identifying companies and capabilities that support long-term franchise growth.
Collaborate with EA Ventures and Corporate Development to assess strategic investment, incubation, or partnership opportunities where appropriate.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with:
EA Ventures
EA SPORTS Business Development
Franchise Leadership Studios and Product Management
Brand & Marketing
Legal
Finance
Corporate Development
External strategic partners
to align priorities, evaluate opportunities, and bring new experiences to market.
Market Intelligence & Innovation
Monitor market trends across sports, media, entertainment, technology, and interactive experiences.
Assess competitive activity and emerging partnership models.
Develop strategic recommendations that position EA SPORTS at the forefront of fan engagement beyond gameplay.
Success Measures
Strategic partnerships executed in support of Beyond Game initiatives.
Incremental commercial value created for EA SPORTS franchises and partner ecosystem..
Successful collaboration with EA Ventures and cross-functional Business Development teams.
Expansion of the strategic partner ecosystem.
Speed and effectiveness of opportunity identification through launch.
Long-term contribution to franchise growth and innovation.
Experience
7–10+ years in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships and Product Development within gaming, sports, media, or technology.
Proven experience developing and negotiating complex strategic partnerships..
Strong understanding of the global sports product ecosystem and digital media landscape.
Experience working across matrixed organizations and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Build commercial partnerships and execute cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent financial modeling.

greenhouse:workleap:5204706007.description:
Company Description 

 Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines:  Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and  ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. 

 Your role

 You're the first voice prospects hear — and the first impression that sets the tone for every deal. As an SDR at ShareGate, your job is to start conversations with the right IT buyers, whether they raised their hand or not, and hand them to the AE team with everything they need to win. You'll work alongside your own AI agent that handles outbound batches and the easy-to-convert leads, while you focus on calls, high-value accounts, and the manual work that needs a human. This role exists because we're growing, because we promote from within, and because we're looking for someone who wants to build a real B2B sales career with a team that actually invests in making them better.

 Your impact:  

- Drive consistent, qualified pipeline for the AE team by starting conversations with IT buyers, through outbound prospecting and inbound follow-up, at a volume and quality that moves the needle on ARR;

- Qualify every prospect with a consultative lens: understand their reality, challenge, and readiness before pushing forward, so every handoff lands with context, not just contact info;

- Build outbound pipeline by researching target accounts, multi-threading into IT teams and running sequences and calls that start real conversations;

- Run and improve your own AI agent that handles outbound batches and easy-to-convert leads, so you can focus on calls, high-value accounts, and the manual work that needs a human;

- Own your product knowledge across both ShareGate products (Protect and Migrate) and the IT personas we serve, so every conversation is grounded in real expertise rather than a generic pitch;

- Build and refine AI systems for your workflow (prompts, custom assistants, automations for call prep, account research and follow-ups) and share what works so the whole team levels up;

- Bring fresh ideas and new approaches to the team's process, especially around AI, contributing to a culture where everyone makes the whole team better.

 Your team

 You're joining a four-person SDR team, all focused on ShareGate, feeding the AE org. That means the quality of what you pass downstream matters as much as the volume. The team is coached closely — Gong call reviews, roleplay sessions, custom AI tools, and a manager whose job is to help you grow. We move fast, share what's working, and hold each other to a high standard.

 What you'll bring 

- An active daily user of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) — not experimenting, actually using them to do better work, and ready to pick up new tools quickly;

- Strong verbal communication in English — confident on the phone and on video, with a presence that creates a memorable first impression for the right reasons;

- Experience in a sales or performance-driven role (SDR, BDR , inside sales) with a track record of hitting targets;

- Outbound prospecting experience (cold calling, multi-touch sequences) and the resilience that comes with it;

- The ability to quickly learn complex products and understand the buyers who use them in a B2B context;

- Pipeline discipline: you can prioritize, track, and advance multiple conversations in parallel without things slipping through;

- Bonus: SaaS or tech background; familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or HubSpot; ability to communicate in French; examples of AI workflows or tools you've built yourself.

 Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

 What the job comes with 

- Base salary: $55k - $60k/  OTE : $85k - $90k.  This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions. 

- LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.

- RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.

- Flexible vacation policy.

- Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.

- In-person gathering twice a year.

- Claude access, for everyone.

 What drives us 

 At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

 We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

 If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

 How we hire  

 Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

 Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

 We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

 We can't wait to meet you.

 By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy .

greenhouse:workleap:5250739007.description:
Company Description 

 Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines:  Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and  ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. 

 Your role

 Almost every company now runs on Microsoft 365, and almost nobody has it fully under control. Work has to be moved into it and around it, through mergers, acquisitions and reorganizations that touch millions of files and can't afford to lose a single one. And once it's there it sprawls faster than anyone can track, with people sharing things they shouldn't and no clear view of what's actually going on. ShareGate is what IT professionals use to do both jobs. Taking something this complex and this consequential and making it feel simple and trustworthy is what we're here to do.

 Your impact:  

- Own a whole product area end-to-end, from framing the problem with your team to shipping the solution customers actually use, and monitoring for learnings after.

- Design AI-first flows where the product does the real work for customers while they stay fully in control.

- Turn genuinely complicated situations into something a busy person can understand at a glance and feel confident acting on.

- Put bold bets in front of real customers early, measure what happens, and let the result change the plan, including when it proves you wrong.

- Bring AI into your own way of working so you can go from a question to something real and testable in days, and put it in front of customers while it's still rough.

- Raise the bar for everyone around you through critique, through the standards you hold, and by making your thinking clear enough that the team can carry a decision without you in the room.

 Your team

 You'll join our design team at ShareGate and partner with a product lead and an engineering lead on every project you own, from first idea to launch. We're hiring across two sides of the product right now: one focused on moving companies into and around Microsoft 365, one focused on keeping it secure and organized once they're there. Both are big, high-stakes problems, and we'll work out together which one fits you best.

 We're builders. We care a lot about craft and taste, we expect people to own their work rather than wait to be handed it, and we'd rather take a big swing on what's genuinely best for customers than ship the safe version. AI is part of how we work every day; it helps us move faster and try more ideas, not think less. Work gets shared early and often, feedback is direct, and decisions get made quickly and revisited just as quickly when we learn something new.

 The people we design for run IT at their companies. They're experts who get the call when something breaks. Our job is to earn their trust and make complex, high-stakes workflows feel simple.

 What you'll bring 

- 6+ years designing complex software for businesses, with shipped work you owned from the first question to the last detail;

- A systems mind: you design the whole journey and think about what happens next, not one screen at a time;

- The judgment to make design decisions that are hard to take back: what people see first, what they confirm, what they can reverse;

- A weekly habit of talking to real customers, and the discipline to let what they actually do change your direction;

- Design rationale you can defend out loud to designers, engineers, and executives alike: the problem, the options you turned down, the trade-off you made;

- Real fluency using AI in your own workflow, with the judgment to know where it helps and where it gets in the way;

- The drive to take your work the last mile yourself: refining and polishing in the real product and pushing those changes straight to production;

- Comfort working without a clear brief: you name the assumption, pick a direction, and learn in the open;

- Bonus: experience designing for IT, security, data or any audience where the user is an expert and a wrong move is expensive.

 Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

- Annual bonus program. 

- LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.

- RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.

- Flexible vacation policy.

- Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.

- In-person gatherings twice a year.

greenhouse:epicgames:5979338004.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

 At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

 Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

 UX DESIGN

 What We Do 

 We design customer and user-focused experiences that are fresh and innovative, while problem solving by anticipating user behavior and hurdles. We approach the most complex of problems and address them with simple, intuitive, and useful solutions.

 What You'll Do 

 As an experienced Senior Technical UI Designer, you will work closely with UX Designers, UI Artists, and UI Programmers to implement UI systems and features. Much of our work starts undefined, and you will help to shape the direction. You will raise the bar for the discipline through the standards you set, the workflows you improve, and the people you mentor. Above all, you advocate for the player experience.

 In this role, you will 

- Break a feature or wireframe down into clear, scoped tasks, surfacing unknowns and dependencies early

- Prototype and prove out new UI techniques, pushing the limits of UMG and shaping the patterns the team adopts 

- Design robust, reusable component systems that stay flexible as designs change 

- Implement data-driven UI through ViewModels and view bindings, working closely with UI Programming 

- Build for every player, accounting for screen sizes and safe areas, localization, and accessibility 

- Design within performance and memory budgets, profiling the cost of UMG, Slate, C++, and texture memory 

- Collaborate closely with UX, UI Art, and Programming, improving workflows, pipelines, and documentation, and giving feedback as readily as you accept it 

 What we're looking for 

- You are a project expert in technical UI implementation, having previously built UI in game engines that has shipped to a large audience across PC, console, and mobile on a regular basis. Comparable experience with transferable skills is welcome 

- You have hands-on Unreal and UMG experience, or strong experience in another game engine, custom or commercial, and a real appetite to go deep in Unreal 

- You are at your best in ambiguity, quickly picking up new and sparsely documented toolsets and technologies like AI, finding a path where there is no precedent, and asking the questions no one else has thought to ask 

- You have proven experience with data-driven UI and the separation of data from presentation, through MVVM and ViewModels or an equivalent, and have strong component-architecture instincts, designing for flexibility by nature 

- You have a strong visual eye and working knowledge of UX and UI, layout, composition, hierarchy, and interaction patterns, reflexively anticipating states, edge cases, overflow, localization, dynamic content, and responsive scaling 

- You have a strong feel for controller-first navigation and for building UI that works across input methods and platforms 

- You design with performance and runtime cost in mind, comfortable profiling and working to a budget 

- You have real craft in UI materials and motion, or the adjacent skill and appetite to grow it quickly. 

- You translate fluidly across UX, UI Art, Programming, production, and leadership, meeting non-technical teammates where they are, and documenting work so a distributed team can build on it 

- You have solid programming fundamentals, object-oriented design, data structures, and game systems, and you are comfortable with the math UI and motion work depend on, such as transforms, geometry, and interpolation 

 EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

 We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.
 ABOUT US

 Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

 Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! 

 Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

 Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

lever:eqbank:ecf5ddae-1dac-40a2-9bf0-b48.description:

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work The Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis leads the Bank’s enterprise financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and management reporting activities and oversees the Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence within the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis portfolio. The role establishes an integrated view of financial performance, outlook, risks, and opportunities to support executive decision-making and disciplined resource and capital allocation.  The role partners with business and functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, challenge assumptions, assess performance drivers, and provide timely, decision-useful insight. It is accountable for the quality, consistency, governance, and continuous improvement of planning and forecasting processes and for establishing a high-performing Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence that scales common standards, tools, models, data, and insight across the Bank.  Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management:
  • Lead the annual budget, periodic forecast, and multi-year financial planning processes, integrating business plans, economic assumptions, balance sheet and income statement drivers, and enterprise priorities.
  • Establish planning calendars, standards, controls, accountabilities, and review forums that support complete, accurate, timely, and comparable submissions across the Bank.
  • Provide an integrated view of actual and forecast performance, including revenue, net interest margin, expenses, profitability, return on equity, capital implications, and key non-financial drivers.
  • Lead scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess the financial implications of changing market conditions, strategic choices, investments, and emerging risks.
  • Identify material variances, trends, and forecast risks; ensure clear ownership of actions and provide concise recommendations to senior leadership.
    • Capital Forecasting, Strategic Capital Allocation, ICAAP & Stress Testing:
  • Lead enterprise capital forecasting and provide a forward-looking view of regulatory capital, leverage, capital generation, and deployment under the strategic and financial plan.
  • Assess capital capacity, requirements, and trade-offs to support the allocation of capital to strategic investments, business growth, acquisitions, and other enterprise priorities.
  • Partner with Treasury, Risk Management, business leaders, and other Finance teams to align capital forecasts with earnings, balance sheet growth, risk-weighted assets, funding plans, internal capital targets, and management buffers.
  • Lead the consolidation of financial forecasts and capital impacts for the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process, enterprise-wide stress testing, regulatory stress testing, and related scenario analysis.
  • Evaluate adverse but plausible scenarios, key sensitivities, and management actions; identify potential capital constraints or vulnerabilities and recommend actions to protect resilience and support strategic objectives.
  • Establish robust governance, controls, documentation, and executive reporting for capital assumptions, methodologies, forecasts, stress-testing outputs, and capital-allocation decisions.
    • Executive & Strategic Financial Storytelling:
  • Lead the development and presentation of clear, Board-ready financial narratives that explain enterprise performance, outlook, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Translate complex financial, operational, and strategic analysis into concise, decision-oriented messages tailored to the Board, executive leadership, and management governance forums.
  • Provide strategic oversight of consolidated financial results and outlook, ensuring consistency across the income statement, balance sheet, capital, business segments, and key performance indicators.
  • Connect actual and forecast performance to the Bank’s strategy, external environment, and value-creation priorities, highlighting the implications of trends, trade-offs, and emerging issues.
  • Establish executive communication standards that are punchline-first, analytically sound, and supported by clear evidence, sensitivities, and actionable recommendations.
  • Coordinate across Finance, Treasury, Strategy, Investor Relations, Risk Management, and business finance partners to maintain a consistent enterprise financial story across Board, executive, regulatory, and external materials.
    • Management Reporting, Data & Insight:
    • Oversee recurring management reporting and dashboards, ensuring that measures, definitions, commentary, and source data are consistent and decision-useful.
    • Establish and monitor key performance indicators and financial drivers that connect strategic objectives, operating activity, and financial outcomes.
    • Strengthen data quality, model governance, documentation, controls, and review practices for material planning and management reporting outputs.
    • Drive automation and simplification of planning, forecasting, modelling, and reporting processes to improve speed, accuracy, transparency, and analytical capacity.
    • Partner with Data and Technology stakeholders on requirements, prioritization, testing, implementation, and adoption of financial planning and analytics capabilities.
    Leadership, Governance & Continuous Improvement:
    • Establish and oversee the Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence, including its mandate, governance, operating model, service catalogue, priorities, measures, and capability roadmap.
    • Develop common planning, forecasting, modelling, reporting, and business-partnering standards, and support adoption across Financial Planning & Analysis and partner teams.

lever:eqbank:67b711ac-3fe8-4abe-8054-918.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work We’re looking for a strategic, operationally focused marketing leader to build the operating system, capabilities and ways of working that enable modern marketing to scale.  As Senior Director, Marketing Enablement & Operations, you will define how marketing plans, executes and governs work across the enterprise. You will establish scalable processes, integrated planning practices, technology enablement, governance frameworks and operational discipline that help teams move faster, work smarter and deliver measurable business impact.  You will build, lead and evolve a multidisciplinary function spanning marketing operations, automation, CRM/email operations and enablement. As a people leader, you will attract, develop and retain top talent, create clarity and accountability across the team, and foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence.  If you’re energized by building high-performing teams, driving transformation and enabling marketing through technology, automation and AI, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of marketing within a growing enterprise.  The Core Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Capability Development 

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team across marketing operations, automation, CRM/email operations and enablement. 

  • Build organizational capabilities that improve planning, delivery, governance, technology adoption and operational effectiveness across marketing. 

  • Establish clear priorities, goals and development plans that align individual performance with enterprise objectives. 

  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

Marketing Operations & Organizational Enablement 

  • Design and lead the enterprise marketing operating model, including planning, intake, prioritization and workflow processes. 

  • Establish consistent ways of working that improve collaboration, accountability and execution across marketing teams. 

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, visibility and speed to market. 

  • Build scalable frameworks and standards that support organizational growth and evolving business needs. 

Marketing Technology Enablement, Automation & AI 

  • Lead the marketing team’s effective use of key platforms, including CRM and email automation tools, in partnership with Technology and platform owners. 

  • Partner with Technology and platform owners to support platform enhancements, integrations and adoption that improve marketing delivery. 

  • Identify opportunities to automate workflows and streamline delivery processes. 

  • Champion responsible AI enablement across marketing through capability building, governance and workflow integration. 

Go-to-Market Excellence & Integrated Planning 

  • Lead the enterprise go-to-market framework and marketing processes to maximize quality and efficiency. 

  • Own the integrated marketing planning process and enterprise marketing calendar. 

  • Drive alignment across brand, product, channel and partner initiatives. 

  • Ensure resources, timelines and priorities are coordinated to support strategic objectives and divisional OKRs. 

Governance, Risk & Compliance 

  • Establish governance frameworks that support effective decision-making and marketing execution. 

  • Lead compliance and approval processes in partnership with Legal and Compliance teams. 

  • Ensure marketing activities adhere to regulatory requirements, corporate policies, brand standards and the responsible use of data and technology. 

  • Support regular compliance tracking and reporting requirements. 

Agency & Vendor Management 

  • Lead agency operating models, governance and performance management. 

  • Manage relationships with key external partners and marketing service providers. 

  • Establish processes for resource planning, workflow management and delivery oversight. 

  • Ensure agency partnerships deliver strong business outcomes and operational effectiveness. 

Measurement & Performance 

  • Develop operational KPIs, dashboards and reporting frameworks. 

  • Monitor marketing effectiveness, workflow performance and team capacity. 

  • Provide insights and recommendations that improve operational efficiency and organizational performance. 

  • Support budgeting, resource planning and investment prioritization activities. 

Let's Talk About You:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in marketing operations, business operations, marketing transformation, enablement or related functions. 

  • Proven success building and scaling operating models within complex, matrixed organizations. 

  • Experience leading enterprise-wide transformation, process improvement and organizational change initiatives. 

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across marketing operations, marketing technology, project delivery, automation or business enablement functions. 

  • Demonstrated success attracting, developing and retaining high-performing technical and operational talent. 

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, go-to-market execution and modern marketing practices. 

  • Experience leading marketing operations teams that use CRM, email automation or other marketing platforms to deliver 360 campaigns and customer communications. 

  • Financial services, regulated industry or risk-aware operating environment experience is an asset.

About eSentire:
eSentire, the Authority in Managed Detection and Response (MDR), protects the critical data and applications of 2000+ organizations in 80+ countries across 35 industries from known and unknown cyber threats by providing Exposure Management, Managed Detection and Response and Incident Response services designed to build an organization's cyber resilience & prevent business disruption. Founded in 2001, eSentire protects the world's most targeted organizations, with 65% of its global base recognized as critical infrastructure, vital to economic health and stability. By combining open XDR platform technology, 24/7 threat hunting, and proven security operations leadership, eSentire's award-winning MDR services and team of experts help organizations anticipate, withstand and recover from cyberattacks.
About the Role:
The Senior Campaigns Marketing Manager is a senior individual contributor who owns eSentire's prospect campaigns from ideation through execution and reporting. You are the coordinating point across campaign workstreams: you keep the campaign calendar and tracking current, move stakeholders and deliverables forward, and focus the team on improving lead-to-MQL-to-SQL conversion. You work as part of a small campaigns and customer marketing team and partner daily with content, digital and paid media, web, and SDR colleagues. This is a hands-on campaign operator and project manager role, not a people-management role.
Responsibilities:

Own the full campaign lifecycle for prospect campaigns: ideation, planning, launch, ongoing maintenance, measurement, and optimization. Build campaigns as programs that are maintained and improved over time, not one-off launches.
Maintain the prospect campaign calendar and tracking as the single source of truth for status, owners, deliverables, dependencies, and timing. Use Jira or Asana for project management, task tracking, and status reporting.
Coordinate across workstreams and drive deliverables to completion with content marketing (copy and content), digital and paid media, web, customer marketing, and the SDR team.
Lead conversion improvement from lead to MQL to SQL by analyzing funnel performance, gathering SDR and sales feedback, and recommending and implementing changes to targeting, messaging, offers, and handoff.
Plan, build, execute, track, and report on campaigns in Salesforce and Pardot, including campaign setup, lead and member tracking, and attribution to pipeline.
Plan and execute integrated campaigns, such as webinars, content syndication, third-party programs, reports, and industry surveys, built around topics that resonate with prospects matching eSentire’s ideal customer profile. Current priorities are organized into a small number of focused tracks (for example, new product, competitive takeout, and key moments in buyer’s journey) and will evolve with the business.
Own ongoing campaign maintenance and optimization, including owning and optimizing prospect nurture programs across the buyer journey.
Support and execute targeted account-based campaigns for priority accounts and segments, including the use of orchestration layers (Clay, Zoominfo) and ABM-based strategies.
Manage campaign-level budgets, vendor selection (including content syndication RFPs), and webinar setup and logistics.
Report on campaign performance in Salesforce and Pardot against pipeline and conversion goals, and present results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Share campaign planning and project management best practices with teammates and provide informal, execution-focused coaching to less experienced campaign team members. This role has no direct reports.
Partner with field, events, international (UKI and Rest of World), and channel marketing counterparts so campaigns align with event activity, regional needs, and partner programs.

Requirements:

8+ years of B2B marketing experience with a focus on demand generation or campaign marketing.
Proven track record building and executing integrated demand generation campaigns (virtual events, webinars, content syndication, industry reports) that generate qualified pipeline.
Strong project management skills, with experience owning a campaign calendar and driving deliverables across multiple cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority using project management tools such as Jira, Asana, etc.
Experience analyzing the marketing funnel and working with SDR and sales teams to improve lead-to-MQL-to-SQL conversion.
Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce and Pardot for campaign planning, execution, tracking, and performance reporting.
Experience building and optimizing nurture programs and account-based (ABM) campaigns; familiarity with tools such as Clay is a plus.
Comfortable managing multiple concurrent campaigns and stakeholders, including international teams and channel partners.
Experience marketing to security, IT, or other technical B2B buyers is strongly preferred; cybersecurity or SaaS industry experience is a plus.
Strong collaborator who works effectively across sales, marketing, and channel teams, with the judgment to operate independently against shared business goals.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting campaign strategy and results to senior stakeholders.

This posting is for an existing vacancy
Compensation Range
The expected base salary range for this role is $120k - $140k CAD. This range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge, skills, and internal equity.

Our Culture and Values
We celebrate diversity, operating with mutual respect and consideration, in an environment that fosters inclusivity for all. We believe that a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger – if you’re enthusiastic about this opportunity but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. It takes a diverse set of thoughts, cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives to be a true market leader.

Total Rewards
We believe in rewarding performance and providing comprehensive benefits tailored to support your well-being. Our package includes:

We reward strong performance through role-specific incentive programs, including either an annual bonus program or a competitive commission plan
Competitive benefit program
Paid parental leave
Matching RRSP or 401K program
Competitive employee referral bonus

Overview 

 At Esri, our senior business development managers collaborate with distributors to co-sell and promote the adoption of Esri technology.  We invite you to utilize your enterprise sales and multi-channel software business development experience to provide geographic technology and solutions to the European region’s national defence, intelligence, and security agencies. You’ll work closely with Esri’s distributor network to help customers optimize and expand adoption of Esri technology, identify new areas of growth, and deliver expertise that helps deliver on their mission and vision.

 This position may be based in the United Kingdom (UK) or Rotterdam, Netherlands. 

 Responsibilities 

- Drive opportunities.  Able to articulate business value with customers and distributors of diverse scope within the Europe region to create opportunities within new lines of business and market segments. Proactively drive value and growth across distributor, customer, and Esri.

- Think strategically.  Expertly speak, present, and negotiate with executives and key stakeholders. Possess strong global and financial skills and provide input into business and strategic growth plan for the region. Demonstrate expert knowledge of product components, application, and GIS value propositions of Esri technology in the Europe region.

- Partner with others.  Build and nurture long-term partnerships with customers and distributors. Facilitate client and distributor meetings that contribute impactful ideas. Influence those internally and externally through communication of ideas and strategies at all business levels. Actively share knowledge and support/mentor team members.

- Drive results.  Lead the ‘Executive Review’ with distributors to finalize terms and conditions of an enterprise agreement. Demonstrate the ability to be put into any competitive situation and displace competition through research and advanced industry/country knowledge.

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience successfully supporting the needs of gathering and designing technical specifications to solve a customer's needs

- Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a NATO security clearance, as required by applicable laws and contractual obligations

- Experience working in national security, including defence and intelligence or Public Safety

- Experience selling enterprise software solutions directly and through a channel

- Expert in negotiation and strategic engagements

- Advanced story telling skills and experience presenting at conferences and executive level engagements

- Ability to quickly learn new technology and translate it into solutions that address customer needs

- Mastery of English and other languages as needed (verbal and written)

Who We Are: 

 Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

 Customer Success Manager   

 Location: Vancouver, BC OR Toronto, ON 
 Work Environment: Hybrid   

 Role Summary   

 Exiger is seeking a Customer Success Manager based in Canada to manage and grow relationships with enterprise customers across the Americas and broader NoAM region.   

 This is a hands-on, technology-forward role for someone who is curious about how AI is changing the way businesses operate and who can become deeply knowledgeable about both our customers and the Exiger platform. You will work with customers to understand their objectives, organizational structure, stakeholders and use cases, then help translate the capabilities of Exiger’s technology into measurable business outcomes.   

 You will own relationships throughout the post-sale customer lifecycle, driving adoption, utilization and value realization while protecting renewals and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership. Success in this role requires the ability to move comfortably between detailed product and workflow conversations, strategic discussions with senior stakeholders and the commercial realities of managing an enterprise account.   

 What You’ll Do   

- Own the day-to-day and strategic customer relationship across a portfolio of enterprise customers in the Americas and NoAM.   

- Build multithreaded relationships across customer organizations, developing strong connections with users, champions, executive sponsors and other key stakeholders.   

- Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, organizational structure, objectives, challenges and evolving priorities.   

- Drive adoption and utilization of Exiger’s technology, helping customers understand how our intelligence, technology and AI capabilities can support their specific use cases.   

- Become highly proficient in the Exiger platform, taking hands-on responsibility for standard administration, configuration, and training for customers.   

- Help customers identify opportunities to automate traditionally manual workflows and use Exiger technology to respond more effectively as risks and requirements change.   

- Own the renewal outcome for each customer, d evelop customer success plans and proactively track progress against agreed business outcomes, adoption goals and measures of value.   

- Execute EVR Success Plans, create Success Stories, and align with the economic buyer.   

- Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and other strategic customer discussions that demonstrate value, surface opportunities and establish clear priorities for the partnership.   

- Manage the full customer renewal lifecycle, from ongoing engagement and value realization through contract renewal and partnership expansion.   

- Identify customer health risks early and take proactive action to address adoption, utilization, stakeholder or service concerns.   

- Partner closely with Sales to identify and develop opportunities to expand Exiger’s impact within existing customer organizations.   

- Coordinate across Product, Delivery, Application Support, Sales and other teams to ensure Exiger’s full suite of expertise is brought to bear on each customer account.   

- Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback, emerging requirements and use cases into actionable insights for Exiger teams.   

- Ensure customer issues and escalations are managed effectively, communicated clearly and resolved as quickly as possible.   

- Maintain strong internal visibility into customer activity, engagement, opportunities, feedback and risk.   

- Manage competing priorities across a portfolio of customers while maintaining a consistently high standard of customer experience.   

- Travel periodically within the Americas and NoAM to support customers and business needs.   

 What You Need   

- 2+ years of customer-facing experience in SaaS, technology, consulting, or similarly complex environments.   

- Demonstrated ability to navigate enterprise organizations and build multithreaded relationships across functions and seniority levels, communicating confidently with stakeholders from hands-on users to senior executives.   

- Strong technical curiosity about AI and emerging technology, with the ability to understand and explain it to customers (no engineering background required).   

- Ability to quickly build fluency in a complex platform and connect its capabilities to customer outcomes.   

- Strong commercial awareness, including identifying growth opportunities and navigating renewals and retention.   

- Strong presentation and facilitation skills, including delivering customer training.   

- Proactive, consultative approach — curious about the "why" behind customer requests, not just the "what."   

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, ambiguous customer needs and excellent organization and project management skills across a portfolio of accounts.   

- Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment with strong sense of ownership and accountability for customer outcomes.   

- Experience with third-party risk, supply chain risk, procurement, regulatory compliance, due diligence or adjacent disciplines is an advantage.   

- Experience with Gainsight or another dedicated Customer Success platform is a plus.   

- Ability to work in a hybrid capacity from our London office and support customers across the Americas and NoAM.  

 Why You’ll Love Working at Exiger   

- Do work that matters. Help customers tackle complex, real-world challenges across supply chains, risk and resilience, with work that can have a meaningful impact on businesses, governments and the communities they serve.   

- Work at the forefront of AI and data. Be part of a team applying advanced technology to difficult problems where better intelligence and faster action can make a real difference.   

- Join a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, collaboration and a shared commitment to excellence.   

- Receive a competitive compensation package that recognizes the value and impact you bring.   

- Work flexibly through a hybrid approach that balances time at home and in the office, where applicable.   

- Benefit from a focus on wellness and employee health , supporting sustainable performance and wellbeing.   

- Keep growing through purposeful career development programs designed to build your expertise and help you take on increasingly challenging work.

Learn more at  Exiger.com  and follow Exiger on  LinkedIn .
