ABOUT FACILITYOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.


What We’re Looking For:


The AI Program Lead reports directly to the CTO and serves as the central driver of AI strategy execution across FacilityOS. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of strategic program management, organizational enablement, and executive governance.

The ideal candidate brings both operational discipline and a genuine understanding of AI, someone who can manage a complex portfolio of initiatives, build the foundational infrastructure that makes AI adoption sustainable, and communicate program health clearly to C-suite leadership.

Department leaders own the AI transformation of their own functions, including the discovery, tooling, and outcomes of the agents and initiatives within their teams. The Program Lead's role is to consolidate that effort into a single coherent program: holding teams accountable, pushing initiatives forward, and guiding and coaching departments through adoption. The Program Lead is the organization's single voice of truth for enablement progress and success.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Portfolio Management

• Own end-to-end execution across a portfolio of cross-functional AI initiatives, from evaluation through launch to value realization

• Define and maintain program governance structures including owners, milestones, dependencies, and risk registers

• Proactively identify blockers, resolve execution gaps, and escalate delays with clarity and context

• Drive accountability across teams without direct authority, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery



AI Infrastructure & Enablement

• Design and implement org-wide frameworks and standards that enable consistent, scalable AI adoption across departments

• Lead the development of knowledge infrastructure, including content architecture, data foundation layers, and AI-readiness standards that supports enterprise AI deployment

• Evaluate and guide the adoption of data platforms and tooling in support of the company's AI strategy

• Establish and maintain consistent execution tools, tracking practices, and reporting standards across teams



Governance & Executive Reporting

• Facilitate weekly AI Council alignment meetings with VP and C-suite stakeholders, including the CTO, CRO, CFO, and CEO, a forum for visibility and cross-functional alignment; formal approvals remain with C-level leadership

• Prepare and deliver clear, high-quality executive status updates covering portfolio health, risks, and items requiring C-level decision or approval

• Lead technical coordination forums (e.g., AI Tech/Integration SWAT) bridging engineering, product, and operations

• Maintain centralized program visibility into project status, risks, resource needs, and strategic alignment

• Ensure program initiatives are evaluated against corporate compliance and security policy requirements, escalating for review and approval as needed



Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

• Partner with VPs and functional leads across all departments to align goals, scope, and delivery timelines

• Manage cross-functional handoffs and interdependencies to minimize execution friction

• Coordinate external vendor and contractor engagements, ensuring accountability and alignment to project outcomes

• Serve as the connective layer between CTO strategic priorities and department-level execution

• Guide and coach department leaders as they own the AI transformation and use of AI within their own functions



Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in program management, strategic operations, or technology leadership within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and competing priorities

• Strong working knowledge of AI tools, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS implementations

• Experience designing operational frameworks, governance structures, or enablement programs at an organizational level

• Excellent communication skills with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and VP-level audiences

• Comfortable driving progress in high-ambiguity, fast-moving environments without direct authority

• Familiarity with AI concepts including LLMs, agent frameworks, knowledge management, and data infrastructure is a strong advantage

• PMP, Agile, or equivalent certifications are a plus but not required



Why work at FacilityOS?

We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. Our company promotes a fast-paced, fun, friendly, and highly collaborative work environment that provides:

🩺Comprehensive health coverage 

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year



FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.



FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.



Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.



Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. ashby:finni-health:a8933d37-f2a7-4b0a-a7.description:
ABOUT FINNI HEALTH

Finni Health is building the operational and technology infrastructure that powers the next generation of behavioral healthcare. We partner with ABA clinic owners to help them build thriving practices while improving access to care for children and families.We provide the infrastructure for BCBAs to actually do it - credentialing, payer contracting, revenue cycle, HR, compliance, and the software that ties it together - so they can focus on delivering care to kids with autism instead of fighting insurance companies.

Since launching, Finni has grown 400%+ while approaching profitability and is backed by world-class investors including General Catalyst.

About the Role

Payroll is one of the most important promises we make. Every pay cycle, more than 1,000 W-2 employees across multiple states - plus the practice owners we serve - count on being paid accurately and on time. As our Payroll Manager, you will own that promise end to end.

You will run payroll in Rippling, manage Finni's payroll-tax accounts, oversee Rippling's filings and payments, lead payroll-related reconciliations and audits, and build the scalable, AI-enabled processes that let the payroll function grow as fast as the business does. This is a high-ownership role on our Finance & Operations team, with direct visibility into how a fast-scaling healthcare company runs.

Candidates may live in the United States or Canada, but substantial hands-on U.S. multi-state payroll experience is required.

What You'll Do

Payroll Operations & Compliance

•     Own scheduled and off-cycle payroll runs in Rippling for 1,000+ W-2 employees across multiple states - validating timekeeping, compensation changes, garnishments, deductions, and final pay each cycle

•     Perform pre- and post-payroll reviews, variance analysis, and funding validation; reconcile payroll to bank, tax, benefits, retirement-plan, and general-ledger records

•     Administer approved payments to practice owners and other nonemployees, supporting year-end information reporting (Forms 1099)

•     Manage our federal, state, and local payroll-tax accounts - registrations, closures, SUI rates, filing frequencies, and authorizations - as we enter new states

•     Oversee filings and payments completed by Rippling, and drive tax notices, amendments, penalties, and credits to documented closure

•     Lead quarter-end and year-end activities (Forms 941 and 940, W-2/W-3, applicable Forms 1099), and serve as the primary escalation point for employee and practice-owner payroll questions

Reconciliations & Audits

•     Lead recurring insurance reconciliations, matching carrier invoices against enrollments, employee deductions, and employer contributions so we are charged exactly what we owe

•     Own 401(k) reconciliations - deductions, contributions, loan repayments, recordkeeper funding - and support annual testing, Form 5500 preparation, and the independent plan audit

•     Coordinate annual workers' compensation premium audits, preparing payroll exposure by state, location, and classification code, and drive findings to resolution with Finance, People Operations, brokers, and carriers

Systems, AI & Automation

•     Serve as Finni's Rippling system owner - configurations, permissions, reporting, internal controls, role-based access, and audit-ready records

•     Build the payroll knowledge base into the company's single source of truth: policies, state requirements, and standard operating procedures

•     Design and deploy agentic AI workflows that answer routine payroll questions automatically and route sensitive, employee-specific cases for human review

•     Automate recurring work - agency notice triage, reconciliations, audit prep, reporting - so payroll scales without scaling headcount, and track accuracy, timeliness, and open-notice counts to prove it



What You Bring

•     4+ years of hands-on U.S. payroll experience, including 2+ years independently owning full-cycle, multi-state payroll for 500+ W-2 employees (1,000+ strongly preferred)

•     Deep command of federal, state, and local payroll tax - SUI, wage-and-hour, garnishments, final pay, year-end reporting - with direct experience maintaining state tax accounts, overseeing provider-filed returns, and resolving agency notices

•     Experience with quarter-end and year-end processing, payroll accounting, internal controls, and general-ledger reconciliation

•     Hands-on experience with benefits, 401(k), and workers' compensation reconciliations or audits

•     Rippling or another modern payroll and HRIS platform, plus advanced Excel or Google Sheets and confidence with large payroll datasets

•     Demonstrated use of AI or automation tools to build something that shipped - a knowledge base, workflow, bot, or script that other people actually use

•     Based in the United States or Canada, able to work core U.S. business hours and meet firm payroll deadlines



Who You Are

•     Relentless about accuracy. You reconcile, you double-check, and you find the error before anyone else does.

•     You'd rather build the system than run the errand. Handed a manual process, your instinct is to document it, then automate it.

•     You close loops. An open agency notice bothers you until it's resolved. You chase things down rather than logging them and moving on.

•     You operate without a playbook. We're growing fast and entering new states. You're comfortable being the person who figures it out - and then writes it down so the next person doesn't have to.



Nice to Have

•     Direct Rippling administration or implementation experience

•     Healthcare, ABA, multi-clinic, multi-entity, or large hourly-workforce experience

•     Experience with practice-owner or other nonemployee payment programs at scale

•     Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation

•     Experience building knowledge bases, workflow automation, or AI-enabled tools in a payroll or finance context

Why Finni

•     Own and shape a mission-critical function end to end at a high-growth company backed by General Catalyst and approaching profitability

•     Build a modern, AI-first payroll operation - the processes you design will define how we scale

•     Work with meaningful autonomy and direct exposure to company leadership

ashby:finni-health:1ed5ffc6-02d8-4548-9f.description:
ABOUT FINNI HEALTH

Finni Health is building the operational and technology infrastructure that powers the next generation of behavioral healthcare. We partner with ABA clinic owners to help them build thriving practices while improving access to care for children and families.

Since launching, Finni has grown 400%+ while approaching profitability and is backed by world-class investors including General Catalyst.

As we continue to grow, we're focused on building the financial systems, analytics, and automation that allow the company — and every practice we support — to grow efficiently. This role sits at the center of those efforts.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a FP&A Manager to own the financial performance of a portfolio of clinics — the go-to finance partner for forecasting, monthly performance, gross margin, and the payments practice owners rely on.

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role. You'll work closely with Practice Success Managers, practice owners, and company leadership; build the templates and AI-powered automations that scale our finance function; and turn analysis into realized P&L improvement. You won't just build the model and hand it off — you'll drive the outcome and be accountable for it.

If you enjoy owning a P&L end-to-end, building with AI, and seeing your recommendations turn into measurable margin improvement, this role is for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own your portfolio: forecasting, reporting & insights

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for all forecasting and financial-performance questions across your portfolio of clinics.

 - Build and maintain clinic-level projections; prepare monthly reporting with variance analysis and commentary that gives practice owners clear visibility into performance and opportunities.

 - Identify the key drivers of utilization, revenue, and cost across your portfolio; surface trends, anomalies, and risks — and turn them into insights people act on.

Practice-owner payments

 - Produce and own the recurring practice-owner payment calculations and payment runs, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery.

 - Reconcile owner payments to clinic P&L performance and underlying revenue/collections data; investigate and resolve discrepancies.

 - Document and standardize the payment methodology so it scales as new clinics onboard.

Gross margin & COGS optimization

 - Analyze gross margin and COGS at the clinic and service-line level — staffing utilization, cost structure, COGS cleanup — to identify efficiency opportunities for your portfolio.

 - Quantify the margin impact of proposed changes and track realized improvement.

Business partnering

 - Partner closely with Practice Success Managers to drill deeper into clinic analysis and jointly own clinic outcomes.

 - Act as a trusted financial advisor to independent practice owners; explain financial concepts in plain language.

 - Influence without authority — drive change across a decentralized network of owner-operators.

Action planning & performance improvement

 - Go beyond analysis: build actionable improvement plans and drive them from problem definition through execution and measurable results.

 - Work directly with owners and Practice Success Managers to execute — own the outcome, not just the recommendation.

AI & process automation

 - Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and similar) to build the financial models, reports, and automations we use internally and send to practice owners.

 - Ship like an engineer: work in GitHub — branch, open pull requests, merge to main - and deploy fixes and improvements to our finance tooling.

 - Automate the manual work out of our processes - identify and ship improvements that make reporting and forecasting faster and more scalable.

 - Use AI-assisted tools daily for analysis, modeling, and automation to raise both throughput and insight quality.

 - Continuously document, measure, and improve P&L processes as the business grows.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a similarly analytical role.

 - Advanced Excel / Google Sheets financial-modeling skills; solid grasp of the three financial statements and how they connect.

 - You know how to build with AI agents, with a basic working knowledge of GitHub, Python, and software development fundamentals.

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS

 - High agency — proactive, resourceful, and able to operate independently. You fix what's broken without waiting to be asked.

 - Competitive, with relentless follow-through — you play to win and stay on a problem until the result shows up in the numbers.

 - An owner: self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable carrying end-to-end deliverables on a lean team.

 - A strong written and verbal communicator who can explain financial concepts to non-finance stakeholders like clinic owners.

 - Comfortable with startup ambiguity and a fast-changing environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Multi-site / multi-unit P&L experience (healthcare, veterinary, dental, retail, hospitality, franchise).

 - Healthcare, ABA/behavioral health, or MSO/DSO experience.

 - Franchise or partner/owner-facing experience.

 - Experience building business cases and driving margin/COGS improvement.

 - You build with AI coding agents and ship like an engineer — writing code, opening pull requests, merging to main, and deploying fixes.

 - Working knowledge of SQL and databases, Python, GitHub, and software development fundamentals.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not a heads-down, build-the-model-and-hand-it-off seat — roughly half the job is partnering with practice owners and Practice Success Managers to drive change.

 - Not a pure accounting or month-end close role.

 - Not a big-company FP&A seat with narrow scope and established process — you'll help write the playbook.


WHY FINNI

 - Meaningful problems in behavioral healthcare — your work helps expand access to autism care for children and families.

 - Real trajectory: 400%+ growth, approaching profitability, backed by General Catalyst.

 - Ownership from day one on a lean, execution-focused team — your work visibly moves clinic P&Ls.

 - Build an AI-native finance skillset — agentic modeling, automation, and reporting — that most FP&A teams won't touch for years.

 - An AI-forward finance function: you'll build with the newest agentic tools, not just spreadsheets.

 - Supportive but high-expectation culture — we move with speed and intention.

 - Stock options: equity in what you build.


HOW TO APPLY

In your application, tell us about a time you didn't just analyze a problem — you drove the fix. What did you do, who did you have to bring along, and what was the quantified result?

About Us Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone. Through our innovative app-based marketplace, we connect shoppers with discounted perishable items while helping retailers turn would-be waste into revenue and meaningful environmental impact. We’re growing quickly across North America and partnering with retailers of all sizes to expand our reach.

 The goal of our Communications function is to raise awareness, drive adoption (for both shoppers and retailers), build trust and loyalty, and increase brand love and affinity.

 This dynamic leader will be highly strategic in their approach, inherently collaborative with other internal teams, and deeply curious about all the aspects of the business, our industry and the key stakeholders who are most important to its success. This person is a proactive, forward-thinking professional who can see around corners, and knows how to position the brand in the right way, at the right time, with the right people. 

 This role is ideal for someone who: 

- Thrives in a constantly evolving environment (in a good way, we're growing fast!)

- Thinks strategically across both sides of our marketplace, shopper and retailer, and builds cohesive stories that inform, attract, and create lasting affinity for each

- Communicates brilliantly, whether in writing, in a room, or through visuals

- Takes ownership and drives ideas all the way through execution

- Builds strong relationships inside and outside the company, and knows how to activate them for mutual benefit

- Balances speed with quality, and short-term wins with long-term thinking

- Is driven by solving real business problems with measurable impact

 What You'll Do

- Drive the external narrative and overall perception of Flashfood, using outside storytellers (press, creators/influencers, podcasts, etc.) and partners (NGOs, etc.) as your canvas

- Lead Media Relations, Creator Relations, Government Affairs/NGO Outreach, Industry Relations, Internal Comms, and Social Impact for Flashfood

- Partner with Marketing to produce campaigns that showcase the brand's impact, and turn our announcements and activity into storytelling opportunities

- Partner with teams across the company (e.g. Product) to mine for storytelling opportunities that drive the business forward

- Create and execute an executive visibility strategy, platforming our key execs in press, industry events, and beyond

- Develop an ongoing slate of consumer PR stories that keep Flashfood topical among our KOLs, and broaden the range of media that covers us

- Build a cohesive Creator Relations strategy, partnering with third-party creators and influencers to tell brand stories that bring in new audiences and retain current ones

- Build and nurture relationships with press — both traditional media (print, broadcast, .com) and "new media" (podcasts, Substacks, etc.) — to land stories that advance the brand

- Lead our relationships with relevant government entities and NGOs, partnering with them to elevate the Flashfood brand and the impact we're having on food waste reduction

- Partner with People on our internal comms strategy and approach

- Lead the assembly and dissemination of the annual Impact Report

- Partner with our PR agency, briefing and guiding them with efficiency and impact

 What You'll Bring

- A deep expertise shaping corporate narratives for high-growth companies, ideally within consumer, tech, or marketplace driven industries

- At least 8 years experience in a cross section of the following categories: Media Relations, Executive Visibility, Creator Relations, Government Affairs, Internal Comms and Social Impact

- Strong earned media experience, with an impressive track record of landing stories in a variety of media outlets

- Extensive experience working across earned media, influencer, editorial, and event-driven communications

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity

- Proven ability to execute and deliver results in a fast-paced environment

- Effective communication and collaboration skills

- A high level of ownership and accountability

- Comfort working cross-functionally and balancing competing priorities

- Data-driven mindset, with the ability to define success, measure performance, and adjust based on impact

 Nice to Have

- Experience in product communications

- Experience working across both the US and Canadian markets

- Experience working with or for a two-sided marketplace

- Experience leveraging AI tools and strategies to boost performance

 What We Offer 

- Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits

- 100% remote work with flexibility and trust

- Mission-driven work that reduces food waste and expands access to affordable food

- A fast-growing, collaborative team with big ambitions

- Real opportunities for career growth

This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.




ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

 


AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Float’s is hiring for multiple Senior Product Designer roles across our teams.

Join one of Canada’s leading product design teams and help build software that supports billions of dollars in financial activity each year and is trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian businesses.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - You’ll own the experience for one of our major product areas alongside your engineering and product counter parts. Currently we have open roles for:
   
   - Banking: moving and managing customer funds on Float. In the last 18 months, customers now hold 4.5x more money with us.
   
   - Growth: making it easy for Canadian businesses to switch to Float and use all of our products. *In the last 18 months, we’ve 2x’ed our customer base.




ABOUT YOU


HERE’S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT: 

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what’s best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You’re energized by building from 0 to 1. You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You’re hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You’re a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.


IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES IT’S A GREAT FIT IF THESE RESONATE WITH YOU:

 - Maintain a very high bar for craft. Especially around visual and interaction design.

 - Very comfortable prototyping in code. We do not use Figma and design all of our features on top of our real codebase.

 - Have an intuition for what makes great software. Comfortable refining the scope of your work with imperfect information.

 - Want to shape how we work. Define our process, quality bar, and team culture.





OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole. 

 


WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 


IN SHORT

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

 

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

BUILDING AN EARLY FOUNDATION FOR LONG-TERM SUCCESS

 - Identify long-term expansion opportunities by deeply understanding each customer’s broader financial operations and future needs.

 - Ensure customers stay on track with their year-one objectives, including spend targets and product adoption milestones.

 - Serve as a strategic partner post-onboarding to drive continued engagement, training, and advocacy within customer organizations.

 - Proactively monitor customer health signals and usage patterns, ensuring any barriers to adoption are addressed early.

 - Ensure customers remain engaged and see ongoing value from Float by addressing potential churn indicators before they escalate.

CHAMPIONING PRODUCT ADOPTION & DRIVING INNOVATION

 - Drive customer adoption of Float’s full suite of features, ensuring teams maximize the value of corporate and employee spend management.

 - Advocate for customer participation in Float’s Early Adopter Programs, gathering insights to shape future product iterations.

 - Educate and inspire customers to explore new ways to optimize their workflows with Float’s evolving capabilities.

 - Identify opportunities for growth across your aligned Book of Business. 


BEING THE VOICE OF THE CUSTOMER AT FLOAT

 - Provide insight and strategic recommendations on how Float can best serve our customers, from social proof to feature enhancements.

 - Partner with internal teams to leverage customer feedback for product development and operational improvements.

 - Help accelerate learning cycles by engaging customers who share our passion for simplifying corporate spending.

 - Collaborate on initiatives that impact Float’s customers, from onboarding programs to strategic campaigns that drive engagement and growth.

 - Support the development and execution of scalable processes that enhance the customer experience at every stage of their journey.

Float is investing in the next chapter of its Customer Success Operations function.  - Evaluate, implement, and optimize the Customer Success technology stack, driving adoption and enablement across the team.

 - Develop and continuously improve customer health scoring frameworks, risk indicators, and expansion signals.

 - Build and own recurring forecasting programs and target setting for customer retention and expansion, ensuring leadership has accurate visibility into business performance.

 - Create scalable account planning and risk management programs for Float's largest customers.

 - Partner with Customer Success leadership to define CSM workflows, operating rhythms, success metrics, and performance measurement.

 - Translate complex and fragmented customer data into clear recommendations and actionable insights for Customer Success and GTM leadership.

 - Partner cross-functionally with RevOps, Product, Finance, Sales, and Data teams to improve systems, reporting, customer handoffs, and operational efficiency.

 - Identify opportunities to automate manual work and streamline workflows so Customer Success Managers can spend more time driving customer value.

 - Establish reporting, dashboards, and operating cadences that help leadership make faster, data-informed decisions.

 - You Raise the Bar. You balance speed with quality and are always looking for ways to improve how teams operate.

 - You Win as a Team. You build strong relationships across functions and know that great operations require great collaboration.

 - 5+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar strategic operations role with end-to-end ownership.

 - Experience working in a consumption or usage-based SaaS business where forecasting, customer growth, and compensation models are more complex is highly preferred.

 - Proven experience building scalable Customer Success programs, processes, and operating rhythms from the ground up.

 - Hands-on experience selecting, implementing, and optimizing Customer Success technology and operational tooling.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex, fragmented data into clear business recommendations.

 - Experience building customer health models, forecasting frameworks, and executive reporting.

 - Exceptional cross-functional communication skills with experience partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, Product, and RevOps leaders.

 - A bias toward action—you identify problems, propose solutions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

 - Bonus: Familiarity with Salesforce, Metabase, or similar CS and BI platforms is a plus — but curiosity and the ability to pick up new tools fast matter more. Our stack is still taking shape, and we want someone excited to help decide its future, not someone anchored to what they already know.

 - Your experience is primarily as a Customer Success Manager or Account Manager rather than leading operational strategy and systems.

At Float, we believe great customer success is about building meaningful partnerships and unlocking long-term value for our customers. If you’re passionate about driving adoption, mitigating risks, and helping businesses scale their financial operations, we’d love to hear from you!



This is a remote role based in Quebec. You'll work primarily from home, with occasional travel to our Toronto office for team gatherings, key meetings, and moments of in-person connection and collaboration.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR


BUILDING AN EARLY FOUNDATION FOR LONG-TERM SUCCESS

 - Build deep relationships with customers as they begin their Float journey, ensuring a smooth and successful onboarding experience.

 - Partner with key stakeholders to define success criteria and measurable outcomes for their initial adoption of Float.

 - Identify long-term expansion opportunities by deeply understanding each customer’s broader financial operations and future needs.

 - Ensure customers stay on track with their year-one objectives, including spend targets and product adoption milestones.

 - Serve as a strategic partner post-onboarding to drive continued engagement, training, and advocacy within customer organizations.

 - Proactively monitor customer health signals and usage patterns, ensuring any barriers to adoption are addressed early.


PROACTIVELY MANAGING RISK AND RETENTION

 - Identify risks across your book of business and develop proactive mitigation plans in partnership with cross-functional teams.

 - Ensure customers remain engaged and see ongoing value from Float by addressing potential churn indicators before they escalate.

 - Support customers through any transitions, ensuring they continue to leverage Float’s full capabilities.


CHAMPIONING PRODUCT ADOPTION & DRIVING INNOVATION

 - Drive customer adoption of Float’s full suite of features, ensuring teams maximize the value of corporate and employee spend management.

 - Advocate for customer participation in Float’s Early Adopter Programs, gathering insights to shape future product iterations.

 - Educate and inspire customers to explore new ways to optimize their workflows with Float’s evolving capabilities.

 - Identify opportunities for growth across your aligned Book of Business. 


BEING THE VOICE OF THE CUSTOMER AT FLOAT

 - Provide insight and strategic recommendations on how Float can best serve our customers, from social proof to feature enhancements.

 - Partner with internal teams to leverage customer feedback for product development and operational improvements.

 - Help accelerate learning cycles by engaging customers who share our passion for simplifying corporate spending.

 - Collaborate on initiatives that impact Float’s customers, from onboarding programs to strategic campaigns that drive engagement and growth.

 - Support the development and execution of scalable processes that enhance the customer experience at every stage of their journey.



About You


HERE’S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what’s best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You’re energized by building from 0 to 1. You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You’re hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You’re a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.




IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES...

 - You're bilingual. You're fluent in both French and English — written and spoken — and can move effortlessly between the two with customers and colleagues across Canada.

 - You’ve got the experience. To be successful in this role, we’re looking for a Customer Success Manager with 3+ years of experience managing a book of 50+ customers simultaneously. You have a proven track record of driving product adoption, retention, and expansion within a B2B customer-base. 
   
   - Nice to have: CPA, CA, CFA designation

 - You know how to leverage data. You prioritize your efforts based on insights—analyzing customer usage, engagement trends, and success metrics to focus on the highest-impact activities. You’re comfortable with using technology to forecast risk, drive adoption, and measure success.

 - You’re eager to continue learning. You take a curious and problem-solving approach to customer challenges, always seeking to understand the ‘why’ behind every issue. You’re resourceful, adaptable, and energized by finding creative solutions that drive customer success.

 - You believe the customer comes first. You’re a strong advocate for your customers and bring their voice into internal conversations to enhance their experience. You actively contribute to internal initiatives, such as playbook development, process improvements, or customer advocacy programs, to scale impact beyond your own book of business.

 - You understand the market. Experience working with finance, accounting, or payments-related products is a plus. You understand the commercial side of customer success, aligning customer needs with business goals and identifying win-win opportunities for expansion.

oracle_hcm:edel/CX_2001:24623.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Regional Account Manager, Mid-Market Sales to be a part of enabling the success of our rapidly growing business

 As a Regional Account, Mid-Market Sales, you will: 

- Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory

- Meet or exceed the required number of face-to-face meetings each month with customers and partners in territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.

- Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts and recognition.

- Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations and quotes in Salesforce.com)

- Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner

- Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility and provide necessary presales support for prospects & customers.

- Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the SMB segment.   

- Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event leads

- Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.

- Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.

- Lead customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)

- Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported

- Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members

- Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth or our business 

- Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values 

 We Are Looking For: 
 An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities 

- 3 to 5 years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space

- Working knowledge of the businesses and partners in the local territory

- Ability to run productive customer-facing and partner-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow-up

- A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets 

- Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally

- Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota

- Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high-volume workload

- Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment

- Be computer savvy 

- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills

- Well organized with effective time and activity management skills

- Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner

- Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction

- Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.

- Bilingual French and English

- Must be able to travel between client locations during work hours. A personal vehicle is required for this role 

 Education: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, MBA preferred.

 Why Join Us: 

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. 
 Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000+ customers around the globe.

We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our accounting team to support the general accounting function in Canada. Reporting to the Controller, this position will assist the Accounting Manager and the GL Accounting Team in handling all day-to-day accounting activities.

- Responsibilities: 
Maintain financial records and general ledger accounts in Oracle ERP, ensuring accounting transactions are accurately recorded and supported by appropriate documentation.

- Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaid expenses, reclassifications, cash transactions, and other month-end adjustments in accordance with company accounting policies.

- Perform monthly reconciliations of assigned balance sheet and general ledger accounts using trial balances and supporting records, investigate discrepancies, and prepare necessary correcting and adjusting entries.

- Maintain prepaid expense schedules, calculate monthly amortization, and prepare current and long-term reclassification entries as part of the month-end close process.

- Review open purchase orders and project-related expenditures, analyze transaction details and billing status, and prepare accrual or prepaid adjustments to ensure expenses are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.

- Manage cash and corporate AMEX card accounting activities, including reviewing transactions and supporting documentation, coding expenses to appropriate accounts and cost centers, and preparing related journal entries.

- Prepare accounting schedules and supporting reports for month-end, quarterly, and year-end financial reporting.

- Review GST/PST-related accounting records and supporting documentation to assist with tax reporting, compliance requirements, and audit requests.

- Assist with internal and external audit activities by providing accounting records, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial documentation.

- Support various general accounting activities including fixed asset accounting and OPEX cost allocation.

- Support financial review on new vendor account setup

- Support Procurement in PO generation and liaison with internal requestors and vendors

- Participate in preparation of monthly OPEX funding request

- Ad-hoc accounting, purchasing, administrative, and project tasks as assigned by Accounting Manager or Controller
 Qualifications:

- 3+ years of accounting and administrative experience

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Highly motivated self-starter who can work independently and collaborate as part of a team

- University degree preferred

- Work experience in large enterprise ERP system (e.g. Oracle, SAP) is an asset

- Strong computer literacy including Microsoft Office applications

 • Account Management: 5–8 years managing Fortune 1000 or large enterprise accounts, preferably within the Canadian telco or service provider segment. Existing executive relationships within Canadian telcos (Bell, Rogers, TELUS, or equivalent) are preferred. 
 • Technical Acumen: Minimum 3 years selling network security products or managed security services, with exposure to AI-driven security operations considered an asset. 
 • Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities for both executive and technical audiences; strong written and verbal communication. 
 • Leadership: Goal-oriented, self-motivated professional with strong business acumen, interpersonal influence, and proven success working independently and within a matrix organization. 
 • Strategic Mindset: Skilled in building business plans and go-to-market strategies that expand market share and accelerate growth.

Fortinet's Canada Human Resources team is looking for an Associate HR Business Partner to help us build the next generation of HR business partnering. This role combines core HR partnership with data, AI, process improvement and automation to help leaders make better people decisions and help HR operate more effectively.
 This role is designed for an HR professional who has developed strong HR fundamentals and wants to become a modern, data-driven business partner. You will support leaders and employees across an assigned client group while also using AI, analytics, automation and process improvement to help HR operate more effectively and make better decisions.
 We are looking for someone who is curious about how work can be done differently. You should be comfortable coaching a manager on a people issue, analyzing workforce data to identify a trend, and looking at a manual HR process and asking: Can we simplify, automate or eliminate this? 
 In this role, success isn't measured by how many HR processes you administer. It is measured by whether you become a trusted partner to the business, generate useful insights from people data, improve how HR work gets done, and continuously find ways to make HR simpler, faster, smarter and more scalable. 
 This is an opportunity to develop broad HRBP capabilities while helping shape how Fortinet's HR function works in the future.
 Responsibilities

gem:freshbooks:am9icG9zdDqrYIp6uZudoV_eT.description:
About the Role
The Senior Payroll Specialist plays a critical role in the Finance department, ensuring accurate and compliant payroll processing for employees across Canada, the US, the Netherlands, and Germany. This individual is responsible for managing biweekly and monthly payroll cycles, reconciling accounts, and performing year-end procedures while maintaining strict adherence to company policies and statutory regulations. As a primary point of contact for payroll and benefit inquiries, the Senior Payroll Specialist provides exceptional service to employees and managers alike, fosters cross-departmental collaboration, and stays current on evolving tax laws to ensure the highest standards of payroll operations.
What You'll Do
Ensure accurate and timely biweekly/monthly payroll processing in Canada, US, Netherlands, and Germany 
Ensure all changes made within the payroll system are in accordance with company policies and statutory requirements. Collaborate with the HR department and other departments to ensure pay and personnel records are accurate and up to date.
Reconcile payroll accounts and propose corrections when necessary.
Prepare ROE's and other payroll records as required, in a timely manner. 
Perform year-end procedures including year-end reconciliations for issuance of T4s and W2s. 
Respond to CRA and other statutory agency inquiries in a timely manner. Research payroll tax payments and data discrepancies with federal, state, and local agencies, and work with tax agencies as well as internal staff for resolution.
Respond to employee inquiries related to payroll or benefits.  
Provide support for external audits.
Ensure proper internal controls, system standards & documentation, policies and audit requirements are developed, met, and maintained.
Stay up-to-date on payroll and tax laws and regulations including Federal and State laws (US and Canada), wage and hour and employee benefit laws.
Contribute to the adoption and responsible use of AI, automation, and emerging technologies to optimize Payroll workflows, improve operational efficiency, and support data-informed decision-making while maintaining compliance and data integrity.
Support a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the Payroll function.

lever:fullscript:7d4ba9e1-395c-4895-b787.description:
About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Manager, Procure-to-Pay & AP Transformation to lead our Accounts Payable team and build reliable, automated financial operations that can scale with Fullscript.
You’ll lead the team responsible for day-to-day AP execution, with your focus on developing people, strengthening controls, and improving the processes and systems behind their work. Working across Finance, Partner Managers, Distribution Centers, and ERP system teams, you’ll help connect purchasing, goods receiving, invoice matching, and vendor payments into an accurate, efficient procure-to-pay process.
You’ll thrive here if you’re a people leader with a proven track record of AP transformation in a business that purchases, receives, and sells physical goods. You understand the operational details, see where processes break down, and know how to build better ways of working.
What you'll do
Lead the team responsible for invoice processing, vendor payments, disbursements, and reconciliations, setting clear priorities and ensuring accurate, timely execution.
Coach and develop Accounts Payable Specialists through regular feedback, clear expectations, and accountability.
Drive procure-to-pay improvements across purchasing, goods receiving, invoice matching, and payment workflows in partnership with Finance, Partner Managers, and Distribution Centers.
Build reliable, automated processes that reduce manual work, prevent recurring errors, and support growing transaction volumes.
Strengthen controls across purchase orders, approvals, payments, employee expenses, and corporate card activities.
Guide the resolution of complex invoice and payment discrepancies, addressing root causes across purchasing, receiving, and AP.
Support cash flow planning through team oversight of vendor obligations and payment timing.
Partner with Finance and ERP system teams to improve ERP, EDI, and AP integrations and workflows.
Establish and monitor measures of accuracy, timeliness, and process performance to guide improvements.
Oversee AP support for audits, required tax filings, and financial reporting.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation to improve accuracy and make AP operations more scalable.
What you bring to the table
7+ years of experience in Accounts Payable, accounting, or related financial operations, including management responsibility for an AP team.
A proven track record of leading AP transformation, with measurable improvements in automation, accuracy, efficiency, or controls.
Experience managing procure-to-pay processes in an inventory-based business, such as wholesale, distribution, retail, or e-commerce.
A strong understanding of how purchase orders, goods receipts, invoice matching, and vendor payments connect, including how to resolve discrepancies across those workflows.
Experience developing teams and delivering results through clear priorities, coaching, and accountability.
Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite or similar platforms, and EDI tools or integrations that support purchasing and invoice workflows.
Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable processes, financial controls, and compliance requirements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn recurring operational issues into lasting process improvements.
Clear communication skills and the ability to lead improvements across teams.
Bonus if you have
Hands-on experience with NetSuite in an Accounts Payable or finance environment.
Experience with SPS Commerce EDI, including supporting integrations, transaction flows, or issue resolution.
Experience leading ERP, EDI, or AP system implementations or significant workflow improvements.
Experience scaling financial operations in a growing, mid-sized business.
Experience applying AI tools to financial operations with appropriate controls and oversight.
What we can offer you
Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa or Toronto preferred for this role.
Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters
RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future
Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.
Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products
Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career
Compensation Range
The salary range for this role is between $100,000 and $120,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.
Why Fullscript
Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.
What to Know Before You Apply
We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.
A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com.
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

Who we are: 

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 

 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 

 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our  blog  and follow us @InsideGeotab on  Instagram .  

 Who you are: 

 We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Business Development Associate who will grow new and expansion revenue by helping small and medium-sized fleets find the right fleet management solutions. In this early-career sales role, you will build customer relationships, develop your sales expertise, and make a measurable contribution to Geotab's growth. If you love connecting with customers and helping businesses solve real-world fleet challenges, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

 What you'll do: 

 As a Business Development Associate, your key area of responsibility will be developing new and expansion sales opportunities with small and medium-sized business customers, generally fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles. You will manage assigned leads and opportunities, work toward an individual annual recurring revenue growth target, identify customer needs, and present relevant Geotab solutions. You will use established sales processes to qualify prospects, build pipeline through direct outreach and partner and referral programs, conduct discovery conversations and demonstrations, and move standard opportunities forward. You will keep customer activity and opportunity information up to date in Salesloft and Salesforce, and seek guidance when requirements or deals are more complex. 

 You will work closely with Business Development leaders, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues to help customers and partners progress opportunities and to follow consistent sales practices. You will build your knowledge of telematics, fleet management, Geotab products, competitors, and SMB fleet challenges, while using customer and market research and developing AI capabilities to work more effectively. To thrive in this role, you will be curious, resilient, organized, collaborative, motivated by measurable goals, and open to coaching and continuous improvement. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

- 
 Manage an assigned list of SMB accounts and sales opportunities, typically serving fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles but may differ by segment. 

- 
 Use established partner and referral programs, including emerging SMB initiatives, to generate qualified pipeline and advance standard SMB opportunities through the sales process at high velocities. 

- 
 Deliver clear presentations, product overviews, and demonstrations appropriate to the customer's needs. 

- 
 Build working knowledge of telematics, fleet management, Geotab products, and common SMB fleet challenges. 

- 
 Prospect for and qualify new logo opportunities and identify expansion opportunities within existing SMB accounts. Execute account and opportunity plans for assigned SMB prospects using approved phone, email, digital, partner, referral, and other established selling motions. 

- 
 Use established discovery questions to understand customer needs, fleet challenges, and buying processes, and connect standard requirements to relevant Geotab solutions. Maintain accurate opportunity stages, next steps, activities, and close dates in Salesloft and SFDC; seek guidance on complex or non-standard requirements. 

- 
 Collaborate with Business Development leadership, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to progress opportunities and follow established sales practices. 

- 
 Engage all inbound leads assigned for your territory and manage conversion & reseller referral process 

- 
 Develop awareness of competitors, market trends, and segment-specific sales narratives. 

- 
 Seek coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and closing skills. 

- 
 Share relevant customer and market observations with the team to inform established planning, competitive analysis, and revenue-forecasting processes. 

- 
 Work collaboratively with partners and cross-functional teams, and use developing AI capabilities to improve research, prospecting, preparation, and selling efficiency. 

- 
 Use customer and market research to identify opportunities and understand SMB fleet pain points. 

- 
 Build the product, industry, and competitive expertise needed to progress into a Business Development Representative role. 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

- 
 A post-secondary diploma or degree; an equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in related fields may be substituted. 

- 
 A bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred. 

- 
 1–3 years of previous experience in sales, business development, customer development, account management, customer service, or a related field; experience with prospecting, relationship building, CRM systems, and partner or referral programs i 

- 
 Strong communication, listening, research, and relationship-building skills. 

- 
 Ability to learn technical and business concepts quickly and translate customer needs into relevant solutions. 

- 
 Comfort with prospecting, outreach, discovery conversations, presentations, and follow-up. 

- 
 Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail when managing multiple opportunities. 

- 
 A coachable, resilient, curious approach and motivation to achieve measurable goals. 

- 
 Ability to work collaboratively with partners and cross-functional teams. 

- 
 Familiarity with Salesloft, SFDC, CRM systems, or sales engagement tools is an asset. 

- 
 Comfort using developing AI capabilities to improve research, prospecting, preparation, and selling efficiency. 

- 
 Ability to use market and customer research to identify opportunities and understand SMB fleet pain points. 

 If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. 

 Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. 

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

 Why job seekers choose Geotab: 

 Flex working arrangements 
 Home office reimbursement program 
 Baby bonus & parental leave top up program 
 Online learning and networking opportunities 
 Electric vehicle purchase incentive program 
 Competitive medical and dental benefits 
 Retirement savings program 

 *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only 

 How we work: 

 At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! 

 We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. Geotab is seeking an Sales Development Representative who will develop sales activity within their assigned segments/channels by presenting solutions to existing and prospective clients through outbound prospecting .  What you'll do: 

 As an Sales Development Representative , your key area of responsibility will be generating new business opportunities through proactive outreach including cold calling, email campaigns, and networking at trade shows . You will need to work closely with Partner Account Managers (PAMs), Business Development Managers (BDMs), Sales Managers, and external partners/customers . - Maintain comprehensive technical knowledge of Geotab’s offerings and effectively communicate the value proposition to prospects, acting as the subject matter expert (SME).

- Initiate contact with prospective customers through various channels (outbound calls and lead submissions via live chat or website); engage prospects effectively, and showcase Geotab’s capabilities through compelling demonstrations.

- Qualify prospects based on predefined BANT criteria to ensure they meet the target customer profile.  Accurately assess prospect requirements, articulate relevant Geotab solutions, and schedule qualified appointments for Business Development Managers (BDMs).  

- Acquire and maintain an in-depth understanding of Geotab products, target fleet applications, and the business objectives of potential customers and partners.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all Geotab products, marketplace products, technology platforms and industry trends that impact the appropriate channel/network.

 As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data.

 This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks.

 GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job.

 What you’ll do 

- Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why.

- Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation.

- Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections.

- Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook.

- Own the weekly forecast readout for the CRO and sales leadership, keeping it short and focused on decisions. Bring the forecasting and policy perspective into annual planning.

- Coordinate the CRO organization's weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews, metrics, and follow-ups. Measure their impact on pipeline hygiene, data quality, forecast accuracy, and bookings, and change the cadence where it isn't working.

- Work with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Product, Data, and Enablement to deliver changes from the first draft through field adoption. Keep cadence documentation current so the organization knows what happens when, who owns it, and what's expected.

- Mentor others on the team and improve how we document and run our processes.

 What you’ll bring 

- Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, management consulting, or a similar role, including running a forecast process day to day in a business-to-business (B2B) subscription business.

- A practical understanding of how a sales organization runs, including pipeline stages, deal bookings and crediting, bookings and annual recurring revenue (ARR) definitions, and how compensation influences sales representative behavior.

- Strong data and analysis skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build a model from scratch, and check your own numbers before sharing them.

- The ability to work independently, identify what needs to be done, and work with stakeholders to get it done. You involve your manager when you need a decision or hit a blocker.

- Clear, concise writing. You can turn a complex issue into a short document or Slack message that a senior leader will read and act on.

- Comfort working with senior leaders, including taking feedback from a CRO and turning it into a better process or a more useful readout.

- Systems thinking and the ability to learn new tools and domains quickly. You understand how customer relationship management (CRM), quoting, billing, and compensation systems connect, and how a change in one affects the others. How you think matters more to us than which forecasting tool you've used.

- Helpful, but not required: experience rolling out bookings, crediting, or deal policies; forecasting consumption or usage-based revenue; using tools such as Clari and Salesforce reporting; or a consulting, strategy, or structured problem-solving background.

 About the team 

 The Sales Strategy & Operations team sits within Revenue Strategy & Operations at GitLab. We're a small team working closely with Finance, Deal Desk, Revenue Systems, Revenue Analytics, and sales leadership. We work asynchronously first, keep our documents short, and focus on practical solutions that make the field's job easier.
