You will also understand when a solution should be explored as a local experiment and when it needs to become a reusable pattern that improves the whole product.

You will work closely with Product managers, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other functional teams. As part of KOHO’s Product, Design, and Engineering partnership, you will shape strategy, create clarity across multiple teams, and raise the quality of the experience without making teams dependent on process or central approval.


What You’ll Do

 - Lead and develop product designers across multiple teams or a large, complex area, creating the conditions for people to grow, make decisions with confidence, and do exceptional work.

 - Set a clear design direction across zero-to-one and growth initiatives, helping teams move from ambiguous opportunities to compelling product experiences and measurable learning to accelerate KOHO in its mission to be the bank of choice for all Canadians, across app and web.

 - Coach teams through experimentation, using customer insight, research, data, prototypes, and product outcomes to decide what to build, what to test, and what to change next.

 - Balance growth velocity and unit economics with customer value, craft quality, trust, accessibility, and long-term experience health; know when to move quickly and when Coll or clarity cannot be compromised.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other teams to shape strategy, scope initiatives, make trade-offs, and deliver customer value. Respect, understand and incorporate varying perspectives in the work outputs.

 - Represent Design in roadmap, resourcing, timeline, and quality discussions, ensuring design has a meaningful voice from the beginning.

 - Support the KOHO Design System team through strategic direction, prioritization, critique, coaching, and cross-functional partnership, helping the system serve real product needs across app and web.

 - Build the operating practices, feedback loops, and decision frameworks that help teams move quickly, learn continuously, and scale quality.

 - Identify the capabilities KOHO needs as the organization grows and help attract, hire, onboard, and develop the designers and design leaders who will build them.

 - Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate exploration, synthesis, prototyping, design-system maintenance, communication, and decision-making while applying strong human judgment.
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 8+ years experience designing and shipping consumer-facing digital products, ideally across mobile and web, in fintech, financial services, or another complex domain.

 - You bring significant experience leading and developing product design teams (4+ years), including designers working on ambiguous, high-impact, or consequential problems.

 - You build strong, trust-based relationships with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners.

 - You are comfortable using modern AI tools to accelerate workflows, explore more possibilities, prototype, and increase the scale of your impact while applying sound judgment around privacy and quality.

 - You scale your impact of craft, quality, judgement, AI-leveage, and elevate those you lead and those around you

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS



À PROPOS DU RÔLE

À titre de gestionnaire principal(e) du design de produit, vous dirigerez le design au sein d’un portefeuille complexe qui réunit deux défis très différents, mais profondément liés : aider les équipes à créer et à développer de nouvelles expériences client, et bâtir les systèmes qui permettent de déployer un design de grande qualité à l’échelle de KOHO.

Vous dirigerez et développerez des designers de produit œuvrant dans la création d'expériences de toutes pièces (« zero-to-one »), la croissance, l’accueil (« onboarding ») et d’autres occasions de produit à fort impact. En parallèle, vous assurerez un leadership stratégique auprès de l’équipe du système de design de KOHO pour l'aider à évoluer en tant que fondation pratique, adoptée et de haute qualité sur l'application web et mobile.

Ce rôle s’adresse à un(e) leader en design capable de naviguer aisément entre l’ambiguïté et la mise à l’échelle. Vous aiderez les équipes à transformer des occasions incertaines en orientations de produit claires, à concevoir des expériences générant de vrais apprentissages et à faire des compromis judicieux entre rapidité d'exécution, qualité, confiance des clients et cohérence de l’expérience à long terme. Vous saurez également reconnaître quand une solution doit être testée localement et quand elle doit devenir un modèle réutilisable qui améliore l’ensemble du produit.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la gestion de produit, l'ingénierie, les données, la recherche, le marketing et d’autres équipes fonctionnelles. Dans le cadre du partenariat entre les équipes de produit, de design et d’ingénierie de KOHO, vous façonneza la stratégie, apporterez de la clarté entre plusieurs équipes et réhausserez la qualité de l’expérience sans rendre les équipes dépendantes de processus rigides ou d’approbation centrale.

Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

 Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

 By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com .

 About the Role 

 Later is seeking an Account Manager to act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to our customers. In this role, you’ll own the success of a portfolio of influencer marketing clients, ensuring campaigns deliver measurable ROI and long-term value.

 You’ll combine strategic consulting, campaign execution, and relationship management to help customers achieve their marketing goals. Internally, you’ll guide Coordinators and Co-Ops on execution, mentor junior team members, and act as the voice of the customer to influence Later’s product and service roadmap. This is a high-impact role at the center of our customer experience.

 What You’ll be doing: 

 Strategy 

- 
 Own a portfolio of customer relationships from onboarding through renewal, ensuring adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

- 
 Act as a trusted advisor by providing strategic recommendations that align influencer programs with customer business goals.

- 
 Lead strategic business reviews (SBRs) and campaign wrap reports, delivering insights that shape future strategy.

 Technical / Execution 

- 
 Oversee influencer campaign delivery from kickoff through reporting, ensuring content quality, on-time execution, and alignment to KPIs.

- 
 Partner with customers on post-sale strategy, sharing best practices and actionable insights to optimize performance.

- 
 Manage budgets, contracts, and deliverables with precision, providing transparent updates and proactive issue resolution.

 Team / Collaboration 

- 
 Project manage campaigns by delegating executional tasks to Coordinators/Co-Ops, while serving as a mentor and coach.

- 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Strategy, Research, and Product teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

- 
 Represent the customer and influencer voice internally, escalating insights and feedback to shape platform and service improvements.

 Research / Best Practices 

- 
 Analyze campaign performance data to generate actionable insights for customers and internal teams.

- 
 Identify risks and opportunities early, providing proactive solutions to drive stronger results.

- 
 Contribute to evolving best practices as the influencer marketing industry and Later’s platform capabilities grow.

 What Success Looks Like 

- 
 Customers view you as a trusted advisor who drives measurable ROI and long-term growth.

- 
 Campaigns are delivered on time, on budget, and above expectations .

- 
 Renewal and expansion rates across your book of business exceed targets.

- 
 Coordinators and Co-Ops under your guidance grow in performance and confidence.

- 
 Later is recognized internally and externally for best-in-class client services in influencer marketing.

 What You Bring 

- 
 3–5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, campaign management, or social media ; agency or paid media background preferred.

- 
 Proven success acting as a strategic advisor , delivering recommendations that map to client business goals.

- 
 Strong project management skills , with the ability to balance multiple accounts and priorities.

- 
 Excellent communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.

- 
 Analytical mindset, able to interpret data and translate insights into action.

- 
 Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.

- 
 High integrity, empathy, and a strong customer-first mindset.

- 
 Expertise with influencer or marketing platforms; ability to become an expert in the Later Influence™ platform.

 How You Work 

- Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.

- Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.

- Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.

- Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.

- Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.

- Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

 Our approach to compensation: 

 We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

 Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

 To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted. 

 Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

 Salary Range: 

 $90,000-105,000 OTE

 *Co-op team members, independent contractors, and freelancers are not eligible for company benefits.

 We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. 

 Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility: 

 At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit . We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

About League 

 League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. 

 Position Summary:

 This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.

 Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.

 League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.

 What You'll Own 

 Account research and point of view 

- Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.

- Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.

- Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.

 Outreach and pipeline creation 

- Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.

- Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.

- Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.

 The system itself 

- Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.

- Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.

- Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.

- Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

 Security-related responsibilities:  

- 

- Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.

- Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.

- Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.

- Comply with Information Security Policies.

 What You'll Bring 

- Two+  years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.

- A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.

- Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.

- Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.

- Strong written communication.

- Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.

- Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.

- Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.

 Helpful, not required 

- Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.

- Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.

- Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.

 How You Work 

 Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:

- You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.

- You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..

- You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.

- You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.

- You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.

- You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.

- You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.

- You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.

- You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.

 What Success Looks Like 

- Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.

- Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.

- The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.

- You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.

- You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

 CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. 

 Compensation range for Canada applicants only
 $55,000 — $65,000 CAD 

 AI Fluency & Ways of Working 

At League, we are an  AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work.

 What this means in practice: 

- Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow  to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation)

- Apply judgment and accountability  when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use

- Continuously learn and adapt  as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working

- Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done  from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively

- Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information

 How this scales by level: 

- Individual Contributors:  Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output

- Senior ICs / Managers:  Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes

- Leaders:  Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams

 What we look for: 

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way

- Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies

- Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment

 Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status . If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com .

 Our Application Process: 

 Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps 

- You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. 

- A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. 

- If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. 

- The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! 

- Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. 

 Here are some additional resources to learn more about League:

- Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners 

- Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care 

- Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors 

- League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform 

- Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here 

- Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition 

 Work Location: 

 We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location.

 Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. 

 Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here . 

 Use of AI Notice 
We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here .

 Privacy Policy 

 Review our Privacy Policy for information on how League is protecting personal data.

ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What You'll Do

 - Independently manage the full sales cycle from initiation to close – assisting some of the largest corporates and law firms in the world to succeed in the age of AI.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and legal teams to ensure our platform aligns with client needs and continues to develop at the highest pace.

 - Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, addressing their pain points with tailored solutions.

 - Deliver impactful product demonstrations and presentations to drive engagement and adoption.

 - Contribute to the refinement of our account acquisition and management strategies and processes, documenting best practices to scale effectively.

What You Bring

 - Have a proven track record of 8+ years’ experience in B2B sales, Go-to-Market strategies, or a comparable role in a top-tier consultancy, prestigious law firm, or industry-leading organization.

 - Show perseverance and the ability to adapt and overcome challenges while staying aligned with your goals.

 - Take clear responsibility of driving quota, hitting business targets and putting the outcome of the company first

 - Are naturally inquisitive, seeing every challenge as an opportunity to learn and grow.

 - Exhibit genuine openness to feedback, valuing the insights of others, and recognizing the importance of continuous improvement.

 - Have a deep enthusiasm for international business development and share our vision of revolutionizing the legal field through cutting-edge solutions.

 - Demonstrate a founder-like mindset, tackling obstacles with initiative and creating scalable systems for growth.

What’s In It For You

 - Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.

 - Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

 - Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

 - In-person environment: Toronto office is designed for ambitious builders.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for an Outbound Capital Account Executive to join our GTM Financial Services Team in NoAM. You will be in charge of managing a book of retail customers. Your goal is to support the growth and operations of Lightspeed customers through the offering of our Financial services.

As part of our growth, we are beginning the process of rolling out a more focused strategy on financial services. Capital Account Executives are key resources in the execution of our acquisition tactics. As trusted experts, you are responsible for business development activities in your assigned territory with the goal to drive awareness and adoption of Lightspeed Capital in the SMB segment.

What you will be responsible for: 

 - Proactively reach out to our existing customers to promote our financial services offering; 

 - Provide exceptionally high levels of service and use effective sales techniques to position and drive awareness on Lightspeed Capital for merchants;

 - Build a trusted advisor relationship with your customers and identify where Financial Service opportunities lie across your book of business;

 - Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize the growth of your book of business; 

 - Achieve sales targets by providing exceptional advice and service to each merchant and coordinating with the Regional leader for Account Management to maximize opportunities within the assigned territory

 - Employ effective business development & relationship management techniques to assist in meeting or exceeding established sales targets for the territory;

 - Provide regular feedback and be the voice of the merchant to business leaders.

What you will be bringing to the team:

 - Sales experience, preferably selling a financial service product, with a track record of high performance for several years running

 - Understanding of solution-based consultative sales in a SaaS environment;

 - Ability to use Salesforce.com and other technologies to manage and organize pipeline;

 - Committed to a culture of positivity and high performance;

 - You enjoy the challenge of exceeding targets

 - Excellent written and verbal communication;

 - Professional poise and confidence while communicating with executives;

 - Value feedback and thrive on constant improvement and learning;

 - Strong work ethic, and a self-driven desire to succeed.

 - Strong interpersonal skills to manage and build solid partnerships both internally and externally

 - As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

 - Experience in the Banking and Financial Services industry is a definite plus

 - Fluency in French.

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

 - Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

 - Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs everyday;

 - Uncapped commission;

 - Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

 - Complimentary lunches from Tuesday to Thursday 

 - Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

 - Immediate access to our benefits plan

 - RRSP match after 3 months

 - Fitness & Wellness benefit: $500 CAD per calendar year

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Parental leave Top-Up programs

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Lead Strategic Financial Analyst to join our Finance team across North America, reporting to the Director, Strategic Finance & Insights and working directly with the VP Finance and CFO. You will tackle complex, cross-functional business questions that require curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to navigate ambiguity. You will work across multiple areas of the business, gaining exposure to different business models, revenue streams and strategic priorities. You will take on questions that require you to connect the dots, build analysis from the ground up and bring a clear point of view to senior leadership.

Please note: This role is open across Canada and requires you to be available to work within EST/EDT hours.

What you’ll be doing:

 - Take on complex, open-ended questions that span multiple parts of the business and bring structure to ambiguity;

 - Understand how our different businesses make money, identify the key drivers of growth, and assess whether that growth is sustainable, connecting the individual business performance to the broader consolidated picture;

 - Build financial models and analysis from the ground up to answer strategic questions and support business decisions;

 - Find, access and validate the data you need, including working directly with SQL and BI tools when the answer isn’t readily available;

 - Improve forecasting across the business, both in-year and long-range, by strengthening methodologies and key drivers, increasing accuracy, and making the process more efficient and easier to explain;

 - Own the monthly and quarterly finance rhythm, partnering closely with business teams on reviews and reporting while maintaining a consistent standard across all areas of the business;

 - Challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for the Director, Strategic Finance & Insights, VP Finance, CFO and business leaders.

What you need to bring:

We’re a team within Finance responsible for helping Lightspeed understand what is driving our business today, where it is going next, and what we should do about it. This role sits at the intersection of strategic finance, data and business analysis, with exposure across Lightspeed’s software, payments, capital and hardware businesses.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or unowned problems;

 - Sound financial modelling skills, including building driver-based models and three-statement analysis from the ground up;

 - Experience working with data directly, including SQL or an equivalent querying tool and a BI platform;

 - Strong business curiosity and the ability to dig into a number until you understand what is really driving it;

 - The ability to challenge assumptions and numbers while building trusted relationships with business partners;

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to make complex analysis clear and actionable for both finance and non-finance audiences;

 - Experience working in a complex business with multiple revenue streams or business models.

You’ll enjoy:

 - A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

 - A culture that celebrates performance

 - The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

 - Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

 - Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋



Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!


Lightspeed is seeking a full-time Senior Financial Analyst to join our Finance Team in North America. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this role will play a key part in owning and transforming the company’s cash flow forecasting and reporting process.

Whether you’re coming from an Accounting or FP&A background, this role is a great opportunity to broaden your Finance experience and build expertise across both fields. If you’re looking for a role that gives you meaningful ownership while allowing you to develop a broader understanding of how Finance operates, you might have just found your next step.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and systems-minded, with the ability to apply strong professional judgment when assessing financial results and forecasts. Acting as a key liaison between Accounting, FP&A, Treasury and management, this role will drive the company’s cash flow planning and analysis while helping build scalable financial tools and processes.

This is a strategic position that will play an important role in improving the company’s visibility into cash flow performance and supporting financial decision-making across the organization. It’s also an opportunity to develop a well-rounded Finance skill set, with exposure to financial planning, accounting, treasury, financial systems and senior-level reporting.


What you’ll be responsible for:

 - Preparing the company’s cash flow forecast on a quarterly basis

 - Applying strong analytical thinking and professional judgment to assess whether cash flow forecasts and results are reasonable, investigating variances and identifying underlying drivers

 - Collaborating closely with FP&A to develop and maintain the cash flow budget and ensure alignment with financial planning assumptions

 - Reconciling cash flow forecasts to actual results and providing clear variance analysis and insightful commentary to management

 - Preparing cash flow reporting analysis to leadership and the Board as required

 - Acting as the primary liaison between Accounting, FP&A, Treasury and other Finance stakeholders on matters related to cash flow forecasting and analysis

 - Working closely with Treasury to monitor cash movements and improve visibility into the company’s cash position

 - Leading the redesign and continuous improvement of the company’s cash flow forecasting framework and supporting models

 - Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, systems improvements and scalable processes

 - Contributing to the implementation and development of financial models within Pigment, developing a strong understanding of how key business drivers are structured and analyzed as part of the company’s financial planning systems transformation

 - Building new analysis and tools to better understand key cash flow drivers and improve visibility into actual financial performance

 - Supporting the broader Finance team on other projects:
   
   - Month-end/Quarter-end related tasks
   
   - Process improvement initiatives, and ad-hoc projects as required



What you'll bring to the team:

 - 3 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial analysis, or FP&A

 - CPA or in process of obtaining a CPA designation

 - B.Comm in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience

 - Strong understanding of financial statements and the drivers of cash flow, including working capital and balance sheet movements

 - Experience with financial planning systems (e.g., Pigment, Adaptive) and accounting systems (e.g.,Netsuite)

 - Advanced knowledge of Excel

 - Ability to work under pressure, manage priorities and meet deadlines

 - Strong attention to detail, analytical and organizational skills.

 - Strong problem solving skills

 - Ability to work independently

 - Sense of collaboration and teamwork

 - As an international company with employees and customers outside Quebec, proficiency in English as a working language is required for this position.
   
    
    

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

 - Experience reporting under SOX

 - Experience with publicly traded companies

 - IFRS knowledge

 - Experience with a fast pace company



We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and let’s have a chat!

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

 - Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

 - Opportunity to make a difference; help merchants grow their businesses and become more successful by creating or improving products and addressing customer feedback

 - Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

You will work across multiple areas of the business, gaining exposure to different business models, revenue streams and strategic priorities. You will take on questions that require you to connect the dots, build analysis from the ground up and bring a clear point of view to senior leadership.

Please note: This role is open across Canada and requires you to be available to work within EST/EDT hours.

What you’ll be doing:

 - Take on complex, open-ended questions that span multiple parts of the business and bring structure to ambiguity;

 - Understand how our different businesses make money, identify the key drivers of growth, and assess whether that growth is sustainable, connecting the individual business performance to the broader consolidated picture;

 - Build financial models and analysis from the ground up to answer strategic questions and support business decisions;

 - Find, access and validate the data you need, including working directly with SQL and BI tools when the answer isn’t readily available;

 - Improve forecasting across the business, both in-year and long-range, by strengthening methodologies and key drivers, increasing accuracy, and making the process more efficient and easier to explain;

 - Own the monthly and quarterly finance rhythm, partnering closely with business teams on reviews and reporting while maintaining a consistent standard across all areas of the business;

 - Challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for the Director, Strategic Finance & Insights, VP Finance, CFO and business leaders.

What you need to bring:

We’re a team within Finance responsible for helping Lightspeed understand what is driving our business today, where it is going next, and what we should do about it. This role sits at the intersection of strategic finance, data and business analysis, with exposure across Lightspeed’s software, payments, capital and hardware businesses.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or unowned problems;

 - Sound financial modelling skills, including building driver-based models and three-statement analysis from the ground up;

 - Experience working with data directly, including SQL or an equivalent querying tool and a BI platform;

 - Strong business curiosity and the ability to dig into a number until you understand what is really driving it;

 - The ability to challenge assumptions and numbers while building trusted relationships with business partners;

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to make complex analysis clear and actionable for both finance and non-finance audiences;

 - Experience working in a complex business with multiple revenue streams or business models.

You’ll be part of a team that treats outbound as a skill, not a volume game- performance comes from understanding the customer, controlling the sales process, and consistently executing at a high level.

Lightspeed gives SMBs tools to compete with big box stores; and win. You’ll be at the forefront of those conversations.

This role is hybrid, based out of our Toronto office, with in-office days every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

 - Consistently exceed targets, taking ownership of your performance and contributing to broader team success.

 - You’ve built pipeline through an outbound motion and know how to turn cold outreach into real opportunities

 - You understand how to manage and forecast a pipeline, and you consistently hit or exceed your targets

 - You’ve been a top performer before and can clearly speak to the results behind it

 - You’re comfortable owning the full sales cycle from first touch to close

 - You create your own momentum instead of waiting on inbound; you are not an ‘order taker’

 - You know how to run strong discovery and guide deals forward with structure and intent

 - You’re comfortable being challenged on your deals and can clearly defend your forecast

 - You’re motivated to grow your career at Lightspeed Commerce and be part of a high-performance team

ashby:lightspeedhq:92270cb4-f10a-45cf-bd.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, SEO, you will lead the strategy and performance of our organic search channel, driving qualified traffic and lead generation through search engine optimization, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO). In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing our organic search roadmap, conducting technical and content audits, and continuously optimizing our presence across traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven search and answer surfaces. Reporting to the Directors of Performance Marketing, North America, you will play a key role in shaping brand visibility, influencing customer acquisition, and delivering measurable business results through Lightspeed's non-paid marketing channels. Your contributions will be instrumental to the continued growth and success of the business.


Please note that this is a 13-month fixed-term contract position.


What you'll be responsible for:

 - Develop and execute the organic search strategy across SEO, AEO, and GEO to drive scalable, sustainable traffic and lead growth

 - Experience with coaching, teaching, and enabling colleagues and stakeholders

 - Prior experience at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

This is a true ownership role. You’ll build and close your own pipeline, working a defined market segment with a strong outbound motion. From first touch to close, you’re responsible for driving deals forward through structured discovery, tailored demos, and disciplined deal strategy.

You’ll be part of a team that treats outbound as a skill, not a volume game- performance comes from understanding the customer, controlling the sales process, and consistently executing at a high level.

Lightspeed gives SMBs tools to compete with big box stores; and win. You’ll be at the forefront of those conversations.

This role is remote, based in British Columbia, Alberta, and Manitoba. 

 

What you’ll be doing:

 - Own your pipeline end-to-end - from generating opportunities through targeted outreach to closing and expanding deals within your territory.

 - Drive outbound strategy into defined market segments, leveraging structured cadences while continuously testing and optimizing your approach.

 - Lead high-impact discovery and product demos - running consultative, screen-share sessions that uncover real business challenges and tie directly to value.

 - Manage a complex sales pipeline using Salesforce, maintaining accurate forecasts and consistently delivering against monthly and quarterly targets.

 - Qualify and prioritize opportunities effectively using key criteria such as GTV, business model, and buying timeline to focus on high-value deals.

 - Partner closely with SDRs to convert outbound interest into qualified opportunities and ultimately closed revenue.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with leadership and peers to refine strategy, share insights, and elevate overall team performance.

 - Navigate pricing and negotiations with confidence, using structured deal strategy to protect value while driving deals forward.

 - Consistently exceed targets, taking ownership of your performance and contributing to broader team success.

What you need to bring:

 - You’ve built pipeline through an outbound motion and know how to turn cold outreach into real opportunities

 - You understand how to manage and forecast a pipeline, and you consistently hit or exceed your targets

 - You’ve been a top performer before and can clearly speak to the results behind it

 - You’re comfortable owning the full sales cycle from first touch to close

 - You create your own momentum instead of waiting on inbound; you are not an ‘order taker’

 - You know how to run strong discovery and guide deals forward with structure and intent

 - You’re comfortable being challenged on your deals and can clearly defend your forecast

 - You’re motivated to grow your career at Lightspeed Commerce and be part of a high-performance team

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

 - Experience with SaaS

Bonjour à vous ! Merci de votre visite 👋



Êtes-vous activement à la recherche d'une nouvelle opportunité ? Ou faites-vous simplement le point sur le marché ? Eh bien... vous pourriez être au bon endroit !



Vous cherchez activement une nouvelle opportunité ? Ou vous explorez simplement le marché ? Eh bien… vous êtes peut-être au bon endroit !



En tant que Responsable Senior des Opérations de Revenus (Senior Manager, Revenue Operations), vous dirigerez deux piliers mondiaux essentiels pour Lightspeed : notre moteur de Commissions Ventes & Partenaires et la fonction d'Optimisation & Performance GTM de RevOps Capital. Du côté des incitations, vous détiendrez la stratégie de bout en bout, la conception, la gouvernance et l'optimisation continue de tous les programmes de commissions des ventes et des partenaires, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient simples, évolutifs, conformes et étroitement alignés sur nos objectifs de croissance et de rentabilité — tout en dirigeant des équipes d'analystes performantes pour assurer une exécution précise, ponctuelle et fiable. Du côté de RevOps Capital, vous agirez en tant que « tour de contrôle » de la performance GTM, en pilotant les prévisions, les cadres de KPI, l'analyse des quotas et de la couverture, ainsi que les revues d'affaires hebdomadaires, mensuelles et trimestrielles qui traduisent les données en recommandations claires sur l'investissement, la productivité et l'optimisation commerciale. En partenariat étroit avec les dirigeants de RevOps, Finance, GTM, Juridique, Enablement et Systèmes d'Information, vous veillerez à ce que chaque dollar déployé dans les programmes de commissions et de Capital soit intentionnel, mesurable et axé sur l'accélération d'une croissance durable des revenus et de la performance des vendeurs/partenaires à l'échelle mondiale.



Ce que vous ferez :

Partie 1 – Commissions Mondiales Ventes & Partenaires

 - Stratégie, conception & analyse des programmes : Piloter la conception globale, la gouvernance et l'amélioration continue des cadres de commissions des ventes et des partenaires, en utilisant une analyse quantitative approfondie, une modélisation de scénarios et des données de performance pour s'assurer que les incitations sont simples, évolutives et étroitement alignées sur les objectifs de croissance et de rentabilité.

 - Opérations de commissions, systèmes & évolutivité : Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout des commissions pour les ventes et les partenaires, en veillant à ce que les versements soient exacts, ponctuels et conformes aux contrats et aux documents de plan ; piloter la transition des processus manuels vers des systèmes et outils évolutifs, en intégrant des contrôles solides, de l'automatisation et de la qualité de données.

 - Aperçus, impact GTM & rapports exécutifs : Transformer les données de commissions et de performance en enseignements exploitables pour les dirigeants GTM, en mettant en évidence les tendances comportementales, les risques et les opportunités ; piloter les présentations et comptes rendus exécutifs mensuels, en fournissant des récits clairs et des recommandations basées sur les données.

 - Gestion des parties prenantes & conduite du changement : Agir en tant que point de contact principal RevOps pour les ventes, les partenariats, la finance, le juridique et les SI sur les sujets d'incitation ; mener les changements transversaux liés à la conception des plans, aux outils et aux processus, tout en gérant la communication, l'accompagnement et l'adoption au sein des régions et des équipes.

 - Leadership d'équipe & développement : Gérer, coacher et développer les analystes des commissions de vente et des partenaires, en définissant des priorités claires, des KPI et des normes de qualité, tout en favorisant une culture de haute performance et axée sur les détails, centrée sur la précision, la responsabilisation, les enseignements et l'amélioration continue.

Partie 2 – Capital RevOps (Planification, Rapports & Performance)

 - Prévisions & réestimations : Piloter le rythme de prévision et de réestimation de bout en bout pour l'activité Capital (fin de mois, fin de trimestre, fin d'année), en affinant les hypothèses avec les équipes GTM et Finance en fonction des tendances macroéconomiques, de la qualité du pipeline et de la performance.

 - Modélisation des quotas, de la couverture & de la capacité : Piloter la définition des quotas, la couverture et les modèles de capacité pour les rôles GTM Capital, en fournissant des recommandations étayées par des données qui s'alignent sur les objectifs de l'entreprise, le marché adressable (TAM) et les repères de productivité.

 - Rythme de performance (WBR/MBR/QBR) : Piloter la cadence des revues de performance hebdomadaires, mensuelles et trimestrielles pour l'activité Capital, en apportant une vue « tour de contrôle » du pipeline, des réservations (bookings), des métriques de portefeuille et de la performance individuelle, et en traduisant les enseignements en actions claires avec la direction GTM.

 - Cadres de KPI & planification stratégique : Définir et faire évoluer les cadres de KPI pour mesurer la santé et l'efficacité de l'activité Capital tout au long de son cycle de vie, et traduire les informations en recommandations sur les endroits où investir, optimiser et améliorer l'économie unitaire.

 - Alignement transversal & communication : S'associer aux équipes Produit, Ventes, Marketing, Finance, Risques et Enablement pour aligner les plans GTM Capital et les rapports sur les priorités de l'entreprise ; communiquer des analyses et des options complexes dans des récits clairs et prêts pour la direction.

 - Développement de l'équipe & des capacités : Construire et développer les capacités d'analyse de RevOps Capital, en définissant les méthodes de travail, l'outillage et les meilleures pratiques, tout en coachant les membres de l'équipe pour renforcer leur réflexion stratégique, leur sens des affaires et leur influence auprès des parties prenantes seniors.



Ce que vous devez apporter :

 - 8 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le secteur SaaS ou technologique, idéalement dans des rôles d'opérations de revenus (Revenue Operations), de Finance ou d'opérations GTM connexes. Plus de 4 ans d'expérience en gestion d'équipe à la tête d'équipes analytiques très performantes.

 - Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finance, comptabilité ou domaine connexe ; une maîtrise est un atout.

 - Solide expérience dans la rémunération incitative et les commissions des ventes/partenaires, de la conception et la modélisation jusqu'à l'exécution opérationnelle.

 - Expérience pratique de la prévision, de la planification et de la gestion de la performance en partenariat avec la direction Finance et GTM.

 - Esprit très analytique, orienté processus et axé sur les détails, avec une expérience d'utilisation des systèmes/outils (plateformes de commissions, CRM, BI) pour faire évoluer les opérations.

 - Excellente communication et présence exécutive, avec une expérience éprouvée de la présentation d'analyses et de recommandations à la direction senior ; une expérience dans les services financiers ou les produits de Capital est un atout.

 - En tant qu’entreprise mondiale comptant des employés et des clients à l’extérieur du Québec, la maîtrise de l’anglais comme langue de travail est requise pour ce poste.
   
   

Ce qui fera votre succès :

 - Compétences analytiques & quantitatives d'exception : Vous êtes à l'aise au cœur des feuilles de calcul, des modèles et des tableaux de bord, transformant des données complexes de performance et de commission en informations claires et exploitables.

 - Penseur stratégique des systèmes : Vous savez prendre du recul pour concevoir des cadres évolutifs d'incitatifs, de prévisions et de gestion de la performance, tout en restant suffisamment proche des détails pour repérer les risques et les cas particuliers.

 - Communicateur clair & confiant : Vous savez expliquer la logique complexe des commissions, les compromis et les enseignements sur la performance de Capital aux dirigeants et aux équipes de terrain dans un langage simple et convaincant.

 - Conduite du changement & influence : Vous êtes doué pour faire adopter de nouveaux plans, outils et processus au sein des équipes GTM, Finance, Juridique et SI, en instaurant l'adhésion plutôt qu'en imposant simplement des règles.

 - Esprit d'opérateur & goût pour l'action : Vous vous souciez de la précision et du contrôle, mais vous avancez vite — cherchant constamment des moyens de simplifier, d'automatiser et d'améliorer la façon dont le travail est accompli.

 - Équipier collaboratif : Vous établissez de solides relations entre les fonctions et les régions, en équilibrant les objectifs de revenus/partenaires avec la gouvernance, la conformité et la faisabilité opérationnelle.

 - Leadership d'équipe & développement des talents : Vous aimez encadrer des talents analytiques, définir des attentes claires, donner du feedback et instaurer une culture de haute performance fondée sur la responsabilisation et l'autonomie.

Nous savons que les gens sont bien plus que ce qui se trouve sur leur CV. Si vous n'êtes pas certain d'avoir le profil exact pour le rôle... cliquez sur le bouton « Postuler » et tentez votre chance !



Tu pourras profiter:

 - d’un environnement de travail flexible qui te permettra de donner le meilleur de toi-même

 - d’une culture qui célèbre la performance

 - de la possibilité d’avoir un impact au sein d’une équipe assez grande pour évoluer professionnellement, mais assez agile pour que ta voix soit entendue

 - d’opportunités qui façonneront ta carrière

Sans oublier des avantages conçus pour favoriser ton bonheur, ta santé et ton épanouissement:

 - Des congés payés flexibles et des politiques de télétravail

 - Des options d’achat d’actions, parce que c’est aussi ton entreprise

 - Des cotisations à ton régime de retraite, parce que ton avenir nous tient à cœur

 - Des possibilités de formation pour développer tes compétences et ta carrière

 - Une allocation santé et bien-être pour te sentir au sommet de ta forme

 - Des congés pour faire du bénévolat et t’impliquer dans ta communauté

 - Des groupes d’intérêt, allant des groupes menés par des employés aux équipes sportives commanditées

 - Un programme d’achat d’ordinateur pour acquérir ton MacBook personnel

 - Un congé parental amélioré pour soutenir les familles qui s’agrandissent

Propulse ta croissance. Trouve ton équipe.

Chez Lightspeed, ta croissance est notre priorité. On investit en toi grâce à des possibilités d’apprentissage en continu, une mobilité internationale et des avantages conçus pour te soutenir, le tout au sein d’une équipe motivée, diversifiée et inclusive qui se passionne pour la réussite de nos communautés.



Lightspeed est fier d'être un employeur respectueux de l'égalité des chances et s'engage à créer un lieu de travail inclusif et sans barrières.
Lightspeed accueille et encourage les candidatures de personnes handicapées. Des aménagements sont disponibles sur demande pour les candidats qui participent à tous les aspects du processus de sélection.

À propos de nous

Propulsant les commerces qui sont le moteur de l’économie mondiale, la plateforme de commerce tout-en-un de Lightspeed aide les commerçants à innover afin de simplifier, adapter et offrir des expériences client exceptionnelles. Notre solution infonuagique transforme et unifie les opérations en ligne et hors ligne, les ventes omnicanaux, l’expansion avec de nouveaux emplacements, les paiements internationaux, les solutions financières et la connexion aux réseaux de fournisseurs.

Fondée à Montréal, au Canada, en 2005, Lightspeed est inscrite à la fois à la bourse de New York (NYSE: LSPD) et à celle de Toronto (TSX: LSPD). Avec des équipes en Amérique du Nord, en Europe et dans la région Asie-Pacifique, la société dessert des entreprises des secteurs de la vente au détail, de la restauration et du golf dans plus d'une centaine de pays.

Lightspeed traite vos informations conformément à notre Déclaration de confidentialité pour les candidats https://www.lightspeedhq.fr/legal/declaration-de-confidentialite-pour-les-candidats/.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋



Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!



As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, you will lead two critical global pillars for Lightspeed: our Sales & Partner Commissions engine and the RevOps Capital GTM optimization & performance function. On the incentives side, you will own the end-to-end strategy, design, governance, and continuous optimization of all sales and partner commission programs, ensuring they are simple, scalable, compliant, and tightly aligned with our growth and profitability goals—while leading high-performing analyst teams to deliver accurate, timely, and trusted execution. On the RevOps Capital side, you will operate as the GTM performance “control tower,” driving forecasting, KPI frameworks, quota and coverage analytics, and weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews that translate data into clear recommendations on investment, productivity, and commercial optimization. Partnering closely with RevOps, Finance, GTM, Legal, Enablement, and Information Systems leadership, you will ensure that every dollar we deploy in commissions and Capital programs is intentional, measurable, and focused on accelerating sustainable revenue growth and seller/partner performance globally.



What you’ll be doing:



Part 1 – Global Sales & Partner Commissions

 - Program strategy, design & analytics: Own the global design, governance, and continuous improvement of sales and partner commission frameworks, using deep quantitative analysis, scenario modeling, and performance data to ensure incentives are simple, scalable, and tightly aligned with growth and profitability goals.

 - Commission operations, systems & scalability: Lead end-to-end commission execution for sales and partners, ensuring payouts are accurate, timely, and aligned with contracts and plan documents; drive the transition from manual processes to scalable systems and tools, embedding robust controls, automation, and data quality.

 - Insights, GTM impact & executive reporting: Turn commission and performance data into actionable insights for GTM leaders, highlighting behavioral trends, risks, and opportunities; own monthly executive readouts and presentations, delivering clear narratives and recommendations grounded in data.

 - Stakeholder management & change leadership: Act as the primary RevOps point of contact for Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and IS on incentive topics; lead cross-functional changes to plan design, tooling, and processes, managing communication, enablement, and adoption across regions and teams.

 - Team leadership & development: Manage, coach, and develop Sales and Partner Commissions Analysts, setting clear priorities, KPIs, and quality standards while fostering a high-performance, detail-oriented culture focused on accuracy, accountability, insights, and continuous improvement.

Part 2 – RevOps Capital (Planning, Reporting & Performance)

 - Forecasting & reforecasting: Lead the end-to-end forecasting and reforecasting cadence for the Capital business (EOM, EOQ, EOY), refining assumptions with GTM and Finance based on macro trends, pipeline quality, and performance.

 - Quota, coverage & capacity modeling: Drive quota-setting, coverage, and capacity models for Capital GTM roles, providing data-backed recommendations that align with company targets, TAM, and productivity benchmarks.

 - Performance cadence (WBR/MBR/QBR): Own the weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance review cadence for Capital, bringing a “control tower” view of pipeline, bookings, portfolio metrics, and rep-level performance, and turning insights into clear actions with GTM leadership.

 - KPI frameworks & strategic planning: Define and evolve KPI frameworks to measure Capital health and efficiency across the lifecycle, and translate insights into recommendations on where to invest, optimize, and improve unit economics.

 - Cross-functional alignment & communication: Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Risk, and Enablement to align Capital GTM plans and reporting with company priorities; communicate complex analyses and options in clear, executive-ready narratives.

 - Team & capability building: Build and mature RevOps Capital analytical capabilities, defining ways of working, tooling, and best practices, while coaching team members to strengthen strategic thinking, business acumen, and influence with senior stakeholders.
   
   

What you need to bring:



 - 8-10 years in SaaS or technology, ideally in Revenue Operations, Finance, or related GTM operations roles. 4+ years of people management experience leading high-performing analytical teams.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or related field; Master’s is a plus.

 - Strong background in incentive compensation and sales/partner commissions, from design and modeling to operational execution.

 - Hands-on experience with forecasting, planning, and performance management in partnership with Finance and GTM leadership.

 - Highly analytical, process-oriented, and detail-focused, with experience using systems/tools (commission platforms, CRM, BI) to scale operations.

 - Excellent communication and executive presence, with a track record of presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership; experience in Financial Services or Capital products is a plus.

 - As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position



What will make you successful:



 - Exceptional analytical & quantitative skills: You’re comfortable deep in spreadsheets, models, and dashboards, turning complex performance and commission data into clear, actionable insights.

 - Strategic systems thinker: You can zoom out to design scalable frameworks for incentives, forecasting, and performance management, while staying close enough to the details to spot risks and edge cases.

 - Clear, confident communicator: You can explain complex commission logic, trade-offs, and Capital performance insights to executives and front-line teams in simple, compelling language.

 - Change leadership & influence: You’re skilled at driving adoption of new plans, tools, and processes across GTM, Finance, Legal, and IS, building buy-in rather than just enforcing rules.

 - Operator mindset & bias for action: You care about accuracy and control, but you also move fast—constantly looking for ways to streamline, automate, and improve how the work gets done.

 - Collaborative team player: You build strong relationships across functions and regions, balancing partner/revenue goals with governance, compliance, and operational feasibility.

 - People leadership & talent development: You enjoy coaching analytical talent, setting clear expectations, giving feedback, and building a high-performance culture grounded in ownership and accountability.



We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!



Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

 - A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

 - A culture that celebrates performance

 - The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

 - Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

 - Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

 - Equity options, because this is your company too

 - Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

 - Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

 - Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

 - Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

 - Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

 - Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

 - Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
   
   

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

ashby:lightspeedhq:7dd6da89-d74c-4283-a0.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Actively looking for a new opportunity to work on a team focusing on projects with real business impact? Do you thrive in environments where you can help raise the bar for quality, drive collaboration, and mentor others to reach their full potential? If so, you might be in the right place!

Lightspeed is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Capital Advances team. This squad builds and runs the machinery behind Lightspeed Capital, from the moment a merchant applies for an advance, through underwriting, to the advance being issued and repaid. Much of that surface is internal, the tooling and automation our underwriting and operations teams rely on to process advances at volume, sitting alongside the merchant facing moments at either end. The work blends complex operational workflows with high stakes merchant experiences, and there is real room to turn a slow, manual process into a fast and largely automated one. In this role, you'll help define a vision through iterative design and delivery.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of transforming complex workflows into simple, clear customer journeys with user-friendly interfaces that seamlessly integrate with other workflows. You excel at identifying opportunities to deliver value and thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with engineers and product managers to create exceptional customer experiences.

Location: Please note that Lightspeed is specifically seeking candidates who are based in the Eastern Time Zone (ET), with a requirement for candidates to be located on the East Coast of Canada.

 What you’ll be doing:

 - Problem Solving: Lead project work from a design perspective with autonomy and authority, facilitating design reviews and working sessions to help the teams deliver the best possible solutions. Being comfortable to work with ambiguity and able to turn nebulous concepts into specific ideas that are useful and delightful product features, as well as finding design moves that support the vision of automating business operation with AI. Ideally has  deep domain knowledge and business acumen on lending product business operation, customer onboarding, credit product underwriting process.

 - Designing with AI: You treat AI as part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. We see three places it changes design here: synthesizing complex, varied data into insight that sharpens our read of the problem space, using agentic workflows to spin up working prototypes fast, and staying in the build loop by shaping the prompts and instructions the team uses to develop experiences in production.

 - Embedding Systems Thinking: Have UX expertise and deep understanding of design systems, UI design, and how micro-interactions can help users complete a task. Design holistic systems, flows and interfaces across two very different surfaces, the internal tooling our underwriting and operations teams work in every day and the merchant experiences at either end of an advance, keeping them coherent with each other.

 - Driving User-Centricity: Draw insights from research and data, and know how to turn those insights into tangible solutions. Learn the day to day of the people who underwrite and service advances as closely as you learn the merchant's, and advocate for both when collaborating with cross-functional teams in product, engineering, risk, and operations.

 - Collaboration: Being comfortable working in a fast paced environment and familiar with the agile product development process and model. Work closely with your product and engineering partners in a tight cross-functional trio, design and craft artifact to support and facilitate multi-functional alignment sessions on product and design solutions.

What you need to bring:

 - At least 7 years of practical, in-house product, UX/UI design experience. Ideally with experience in designing and supporting development for 0 to 1 product.

 - Excellent communication skills. You can bring internal stakeholders on your design journey and explain work with focus and brevity.

 - Experience designing complex, workflow heavy products, internal tools, admin consoles, case management, or operational systems, where the user is doing a job rather than browsing.

 - Comfort working in a domain with rules you do not get to change. Financial services, lending, risk, payments, or anything else where policy and compliance shape the design space.

 - Demonstrable experience putting AI to work in your own design practice, not just experimenting on the side. We want concrete examples: agentic workflows you've built or used to synthesize research, prototype, or contribute to production, and the difference they made to your output.

 - A deep, holistic commitment to design quality: balancing 'Fit' (ensuring solutions solve the right problem for the user's context) and 'Craft' (delivering consistent, accessible, and performant experiences), always validating the 'why' behind your designs.
