Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋



Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!


The Revenue Operations team is central to the success of our go-to-market functions. As the Revenue Operations Manager for the B2B business unit establishing a best-in-class revenue operations function. Your expertise will guide GTM teams in strategic planning, insightful reporting, and performance optimization, helping drive alignment and efficiency across departments.

In this role, you will own the development, monitoring, and refinement of key performance indicators (KPIs) across the entire customer journey to ensure measurable success at every stage. Partnering closely with Finance and GTM leadership, you’ll play a critical role in developing investment cases to enhance team productivity and efficiency. This is a strategic, high-impact position where you will contribute directly to business growth by optimizing processes, establishing robust reporting frameworks, and ensuring data-driven decisions across the organization.



What you’ll be doing:

As the Manager of Revenue Operations, you will lead the RevOps function to drive operational excellence and support profitable revenue growth strategies. Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll develop and execute strategic initiatives aligned with our company OKRs to help achieve revenue and profitability targets.

 1. Weekly Performance Review and Pipeline Updates
    Lead weekly performance reviews, providing a comprehensive analysis of the pipeline and insights to leadership. This includes detailed forecasting updates for end-of-month (EOM), end-of-quarter (EOQ), and end-of-year (EOY) projections to support proactive decision-making across the organization. You’ll Identify and establish new KPIs to track the health and effectiveness of the GTM teams, adapting to emerging business priorities.

 2. Bi-Weekly Deep-Dive Reviews
    Conduct in-depth bi-weekly sessions focusing on New Business (AE) and Account Management (AM) performance. This includes delivering rep-level insights, analyzing trends, identifying pipeline risks and opportunities, and contributing to the Weekly Business Review (WBR) to ensure the sales teams are equipped to drive growth.

 3. Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR)
    Facilitate the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) sessions, partnering with GTM leaders to provide a strategic overview of performance. These reviews will analyze key metrics, assess progress against targets, and align on actionable insights to drive overall success.

 4. Monthly Quota Analysis and Coverage Recommendations
    Oversee the monthly analysis of quota attainment and coverage across the sales and customer teams. This responsibility includes providing unbiased data driven insights and recommendations on IC Quotas and Coverage to ensure optimal alignment with market opportunities, our company planning, and resource efficiency.

 5. Quarterly Reforecasting
    Lead the quarterly reforecasting process, working closely with Finance and GTM leadership. This involves adjusting revenue and performance targets to align with current business realities, identifying areas for investment or cost optimization, and ensuring targets are realistic and achievable.

In addition to these core responsibilities, you will:

 - Collaborate with cross-functional leaders in Enablement, Product, and Sales to ensure the strategy is aligned with global priorities and product roadmaps.



What you need to bring:

 - A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as business, finance, technology, or operations; a master’s degree in business or a related discipline is a plus but not required.

 - Significant experience (6+ years) within a go-to-market (GTM) environment, with a track record of delivering on strategic GTM initiatives that drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.

 - Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional outcomes, successfully collaborating with stakeholders in Information Systems, Data, Finance, GTM, and Marketing.

 - Strong experience leading budget and forecasting processes to align with company goals and expectations, ensuring financial accuracy and effective resource allocation.

 - Solid analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience establishing and managing KPIs to measure and optimize performance across the customer journey.

 - As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position



What will help you succeed in this role:

 - Exceptional Analytical Skills: A keen ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actionable insights that will guide GTM strategies and optimize performance metrics across all customer journey stages.

 - Strong Communication and Relationship-Building Abilities: Excellent communication skills to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels, especially in a cross-functional, hybrid, and rapidly evolving environment.

 - Strategic Thinking and Problem-Solving: The capacity to think big-picture while managing details, with an eye for process improvement and alignment to organizational goals.

 - Self-Starter with a Results-Driven Mindset: A proactive and resourceful attitude, with a drive for achieving tangible results and measurable impact on revenue performance.

Please note this role is based in British Columbia or Alberta.

Lightspeed is looking for a Manager, Outbound Sales to join our growing North American team. The Manager, Outbound Sales will manage a team supporting the West Coast Territory. In this role, you will own a defined segment of outbound sales, leading a team of Account Executives and driving new customer acquisition across a targeted account base. Lightspeed’s Outbound team is in hyper-growth mode — our process has been refined and optimized, and now is the time to scale our reach with proven leaders at the helm.

What you’ll be doing:

Own Your Segment

 - Lead and manage a team of Account Executives responsible for the full sales cycle within a defined segment of North American accounts

 - Own segment-level pipeline, forecast accuracy, and monthly/quarterly MRR targets — taking full accountability from top-of-funnel through close

 - Manage overall pipeline health and drive consistent execution against activity, conversion, and revenue KPIs

 - Collaborate with SDR leadership to ensure a smooth, high-quality lead-to-deal handover process

Develop Your Team

 - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Account Executives

 - Partner with enablement teams to design and deliver onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring reps are ramped and productive as quickly as possible

 - Drive ongoing skill development through rolling coaching, call reviews, pipeline inspection, and structured feedback loops

 - Identify individual performance gaps and implement targeted development plans to increase team output and rep tenure

Optimize the Motion

 - Refine and optimize current sales processes, including all tools used to connect, demo, and close new customers

 - Work cross-functionally with Sales Ops, Marketing, Enablement, and Product to remove roadblocks, improve tooling, and streamline workflows

 - Collaborate with regional and functional leaders on developing and executing the outbound strategy playbook

 - Identify the best tools for list creation, outbound messaging, and deal execution

And a little bit of…

 - Analyze sales forecasts, call volume, and pipeline health across the team and at the individual rep level

 - Create new strategies to grow revenue streams and expand the team’s addressable market

 - Ensure clear communication and handoff processes across the broader sales organization

How you’ll know you’re winning:

 - Your team consistently meets or exceeds Net New MRR targets

 - New hires ramp on schedule and hit productivity benchmarks within expected timelines

 - Forecast accuracy is tight — projected scenarios reflect reality

 - Average deal MRR trends upward over time as segment targeting sharpens

 - Cross-functional partners consider you a go-to for process improvement and execution clarity

What you bring:

 - Minimum 2 years of experience managing Account Executives in an outbound or full-cycle sales environment

 - Demonstrated ability to own a segment or territory from pipeline generation through close — with a strong sense of personal accountability for outcomes

 - Experience working cross-functionally to identify and resolve process gaps, improve tooling, and align stakeholders

 - Proven ability to onboard, coach, and develop sales reps at multiple stages — new hire, developing, and high performer

 - Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach, or comparable sales engagement platforms

 - Tech-savvy, with the ability to help team members who are less so

 - Entrepreneurial and agile mindset with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity

 - Experience with Retail or Hospitality point-of-sale systems is an asset

 - Proficiency in English

Company Description
Who is Litmus
Litmus is a growth-stage software company that is transforming the way companies harness the power of machine data to improve operations. Our software is enabling the next wave of digital transformation for the biggest and most innovative companies in the World – making Industrial IoT, Industry 4.0 and Edge Computing a reality. We just completed our Series B financing round, and we are looking to expand our global marketing team.
Why join the Litmus team
You want to be a part of something great
We pride ourselves on building the most talented and experienced team in the industry who knows how to win. We work hard and the results speak for themselves. We’re trusted by industry leaders like Google, Dell, Intel, Mitsubishi, Hewlett-Packard Enterprise and others as we partner to help Fortune 500 companies digitally transform.
You want to define and shape the future
At Litmus you’ll have the opportunity to influence and enable Industrial Internet of Things, the next wave of technology essential for global digitization. We’re leading the industry in machine data analytics and edge computing to feed machine learning, artificial intelligence and other applications that rapidly change the way companies operate.
You want to build and shape your career
Join a growth-stage Silicon Valley company to build and define your career path in an environment that allows you to progress rapidly. Bring your unique experience, talent and expertise and add to it by collaborating with and learning from the brightest people in the industry.
We are committed to hiring great people who are passionate about what they do and thrive on winning as a team. We welcome anyone and everyone who wishes to join the Litmus marketing team to apply and share their career experience, dreams and goals with us.
Job Description
About The Role – Sales Engineer
The Sales Engineer is senior client facing role that requires a minimum of 8+ years of technical experience in the manufacturing sector. You will play a starring role in the Litmus sales cycle, drawing on your expertise to show the value that an IIoT platform can bring a customer. You have a keen understanding of what happens on a factory floor in both discrete and batch production processes and you understand the broader ecosystem of industrial software such as MES/MOM, CMMS, SCADA, Historians, etc.
Your most important contribution will be your ability to understand the technical challenges that customers are experiencing with Industry 4.0 and IT/OT integration projects, and then to show how the Litmus platform bring value. You will design applications, demo the product, field technical questions, deploy small pilots, and facilitate valuable business interactions.
Job Responsibilities:
Perform high-level analysis of prospects business processes, procedures and requirements in preparation for solution presentations. Ability to uncover, understand and capture business and technical requirements.
Prepare custom, detailed solution presentations based on the findings and understanding of the customers’ business requirements. Deliver product solution demonstrations in support of the sales process.
Work with Account Executives to provide product, business and technical knowledge in support of sales activities and strategies.
Responsible for providing feedback from the market to Product Management and Development regarding additional products including gaps between product functionality and market/customer demands.
Liaison with Product Management and Development to understand details of product direction and communicate information back to sales organization.
Communicate with Product Management and Development to provide valuable field input into new product requirements.
Staying abreast of product roadmap as well as understanding the scenarios, features and functions within each of the products and how these are applied to address business and technical issues. This includes participating in internal software testing, delivering internal training and providing support for Value Added Resellers as necessary.
Work with colleagues to enhance and maintain the quality and effectiveness of demonstration scenarios. - Ensure smooth pre sales to implementation account transitions by facilitating "handoff" process with a focus on continuous customer satisfaction.
Provide sales with ongoing support in fulfillment of RFI's, RFP's and other customer/prospect driven requests.
Where necessary, engage marketing and field pre sales to deliver webinars including recorded or live demonstrations.
Provide assistance and expertise to Value Added Resellers during the sales cycle to include analysis of prospects business requirements, solution architecture and solution presentations.
Attend conferences, participate in Customer Meetings and Customer Focus Groups to stay on top of changes in business issues, requirements, regulations and technology to understand where the market is going. Participate in local, national and international Customer User Group conferences.
Qualifications
About You
You are motivated, intelligent, personable, creative, and ambitious - but most of all you want your work to matter. You are excited by technology, you are great with people, and you excel in a team environment.
You will also need to be a culture fit – ours is built on honesty, hard work, integrity, teamwork and respect for others.
You like to tinker with gadgets and you are totally comfortable around a Raspberry Pi.
Finally, you are passionate about being a part of the fourth industrial revolution.
Qualifications:
BS/MS degree in Electrical, Industrial or Computer Engineering.
8+ years of technical experience in the manufacturing or industrial sector in IT, OT, Automation, Process Control, Continuous Improvement, or related field.
Previous experience as a sales engineer or in a technical sales role highly desired.
Experience with IIot or IoT applications, projects, or platforms is a strong asset.
Ability to troubleshoot basic JavaScript. Python and write logic in multiple languages
Technical skills in Cloud and Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure with the major vendors such as Azure, AWS, GCP, and Cloudera.
VMWare and Inter-Networking, familiar with Cloud Object Storage and Kubernetes/Container solutions.
Experience with APIs and / or scripting (Python, etc.).
Basic understanding and experience with databases SQL or NoSQL.
Additional Information
Standard benefits included (medical, dental, vision, suppl.), travel stipend, great snacks, company outings.

Please note that this role is only open to those based in Ottawa or Toronto, Ontario.
 Candidates must have experience selling to the Canadian Federal Government.  

 Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk. Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X .

TAKE YOUR CAREER TO NEW HEIGHTS WITH LOOPIO! 🚀✨



At Loopio, our Sales team has a direct impact on our customers and prospects through connecting with Loopio’s award-winning RFP response software that will fuel their growth. We are growing our team with the addition of a Senior Account Executive for our Mid-Market segment (companies between 251 - 2,500 employee size).  This role is a pivotal revenue-generating role at Loopio and the team has a significant impact on our growth.

The ideal candidate has a strong blend of strategic thinking, previous SaaS experience, and a self-starter attitude. You are a B2B SaaS Sales professional who is excited to sell to Sales, Security, and Proposal Management teams. You are curious, know how to listen, and understand what prospects are really saying. You work with prospects to help solve their challenges and help them identify solutions to challenges they may not even know they have.

You will have a direct impact on the growth of the sales organization, and more importantly play a key role in the success of Loopio!



Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team



What You'll Be Doing

 - Play a key role in growing Loopio by driving forward sales opportunities within a defined market segment to generate new business revenue

 - Partner with our Sales Development team to prospect target accounts and with the expectation to self-source opportunities every quarter

 - Navigate complex sales cycles with multiple buyers.

 - Deliver a world-class sales experience, providing demos of the Loopio platform, and navigating through the complete buying process

 - Deliver and negotiate sales proposals to prospective customers and work closely with senior leadership to close large opportunities

 - Build strong partnerships with your prospects and prepare them for success as customers with our Customer Experience team

 - Meet (and exceed) quarterly sales targets and consistently deliver accurate forecasts to sales management and Loopio leadership

 - Work closely with Loopio’s Product team to help evolve the Loopio Platform based on market trends and customer requirements

What You'll Bring to the Team

 - 5+ years of sales experience as an Account Executive or similar role, preferably in B2B SaaS, with a track record of proving success

 - Demonstrated experience  managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders at Enterprise organizations from start to finish, with a strong ability to uncover customer problems and highlight appropriate solutions

 - Proven track record of self-sourcing opportunities at large organizations

 - Ability to develop relationships with senior leaders and c-level executives

 - Experience using Salesforce (or other CRMs), sales automation tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach and web conferencing tools

 - A proactive mindset with strong organizational and time-management skills

 - Self-aware individual who is eager to contribute feedback and ideas

 - Excellent presentation skills to connect with prospective clients on the phone and through delivering demos

 - Ability to thrive and adapt in a fast-paced culture along with highly motivated and passionate team members

 - The ability and interest to try new things and not afraid to take on a challenge independently interested in contributing to enhancing Loopio’s marketing initiatives

 - Post-Secondary Degree or equivalent


WHERE YOU’LL WORK 📍

 - We are currently only looking for candidates who reside in the Greater Toronto Area and can access our co-working space in Downtown Toronto for the occasional Sales Team get-together (once a month)

 - Loopio is a remote-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from.

 - Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇬🇧 London, and 🇮🇳 India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru).


WHY YOU’LL ♥️ WORKING AT LOOPIO

 - Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice https://lattice.com/e-lp/talent-products?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid-search&utm_campaign=NOAM_Google_Search_Brand_Core_Tier_1__OCT-Conv-Test-HR&utm_adgroup=Brand_Core_Tier_1&attribution=lattice-mktg&_bt=645279480236&_bk=lattice&_bm=p&_bn=g&_bg=149106216630&cq_src=google_ads&cq_cmp=19577143427&cq_con=149106216630&cq_term=lattice&cq_med=&cq_plac=&cq_net=g&cq_plt=gp&qgad=645279480236&qgterm=lattice&gad_source=1&gclid=Cj0KCQiA-5a9BhCBARIsACwMkJ4OzbQBp30JTrxoLWSv3ht4C0NBeu9uyrTE7GCIu8D_lqBGuC3CG7kaAiWnEALw_wcB for our 1:1s and performance conversations

 - You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support!

 - We’re an AI-forward company and weWe encourage experimentation and innovative thinking, especially when it comes to leveraging AI & Automation to drive business impact.

 - You’ll receive structured sales onboarding created by our Revenue Enablement team during your ramp period to ensure you are set up for success.

 - We offer a wide range of health and wellness benefits https://loopio.com/perks-benefits/ to support your physical and mental well-being, starting day 1️⃣ with Loopio.

 - We’ll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up.

 - You’ll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment.

 - Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and quarterly celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!

 - Our four Employee Resource Groups https://loopio.com/annual-deib-report/ offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round.

 - You’ll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business.

Questioning your qualifications? Read this ‼️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don’t apply for a position simply because they don’t hit every single criteria included in the job description—particularly members of underrepresented groups. 

Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you’re self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you’d like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table.



AI in Recruitment  👩🏻‍💻  At Loopio, we leverage  artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI  serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both  an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions  solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with  industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines



AI Usage in Interviews 🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process.

For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making.



Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team (work@loopio.com) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.

about this team
The Global Trade Optimization team is a support and strategic hub responsible for optimizing trade processes and capabilities through data-driven insights, technology enablement, process optimization, governance, and program execution. The team partners across Trade Compliance, Trade Operations, Global Fulfillment and Upstream Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, and regional business teams to drive efficiency, reduce costs, mitigate risk, and enable scalable trade programs worldwide. The team serves as the connective layer between business strategy, operations, and technology, ensuring that global trade capabilities are optimized through strong data governance, analytics, digital innovation, and program management.
core responsibilities
This role serves as the primary business leader for trade systems capabilities, ensuring technology investments, business processes, and global trade programs align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business value.
As the business owner for trade technology solutions, this position is accountable for defining the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of enhancements across the global trade ecosystem. Ensuring systems evolve to meet operational, compliance, and growth requirements.
Define and maintain the multi-year trade systems strategy and capability roadmap aligned to business and trade objectives through partnership of our PMO and Technology teams.
Establish and prioritize product and technology backlogs, enhancement requests, and technology investments based on business value and strategic priorities.
Develop business cases and value realization plans for new capabilities, system enhancements, automation initiatives, and technology investments.
Partner with Technology teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.
Drive roadmap management, stakeholder engagement, release planning, and key performance measurement.
Monitor health, user experience, utilization, and business outcomes to continuously improve technology capabilities and investments.
Manage the Trade budget, including support annual operating planning, long-range planning, and resource allocation activities, ensuring investments are aligned to strategic priorities and value creation opportunities.
Works closely with our internal Reporting, Forecasting, & Analytics function to manage financial savings and commitments with FP&A.
Partner with PMO lead to establish performance measures and governance mechanisms to track portfolio effectiveness and return on investment.
Monitor portfolio financial plans, business cases, forecasts, and delivery KPIs

environment.

effectively.

Capacity to drive insights from quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Ability to work and deliver in changing environments, under limited guidance while adhering to specified deadlines and budgets.
Deep desire to learn and improve by seeking, accepting, and acting on productive feedback.

The lululemon Legal team’s purpose is to empower the business while navigating risk and playing in possibility. We cultivate a culture of connection and curiosity, care for the whole person, foster an inclusive environment, and have fun along the way.
The Senior Manager, Senior Counsel (Regulatory Affairs) is a key member of lululemon's Legal team, responsible for monitoring and analyzing emerging legislative and regulatory developments that may impact the company. The role serves as a central regulatory resource within the Legal function and helps advance lululemon's priorities through strategic engagement with industry associations and other external stakeholders.
core responsibilities

Identify and prioritize the regulatory developments with the greatest potential impact on the organization’s operations, products, and processes.
Assess the legal and operational implications of new and changing regulations in partnership with cross-functional Legal teams.
Build and maintain relationships with industry associations and contribute to engagement and advocacy efforts intended to shape, improve, or delay legislative outcomes where aligned with company priorities.

Maintain insight into industry association activities to inform company participation, resourcing decisions, and engagement strategy.
Support the VP, Deputy General Counsel in setting regulatory strategy over a 12-18 month horizon, aligned with business priorities and key company initiatives.
Manage outside counsel supporting regulatory and legislative matters and oversee related spend within the broader Compliance budget.
Lead and develop team members, delegate work based on strengths and priorities, and ensure accountability for outcomes.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
Strong collaboration, negotiation, and influencing skills across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated people leadership, including the ability to set direction, delegate effectively, coach team members, and drive accountability.
Experience with regulatory affairs, industry associations, government affairs, global retail, consumer products, or enterprise compliance is an asset.

Description & Requirements
who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
FP&A is responsible for planning and managing lululemon's overall financial performance and serves as a key business partner in strategic and operational decision-making. The Senior Financial Analyst will play a critical role in supporting enterprise growth and margin productivity initiatives through strategic financial analysis, business case development, forecasting support, project leadership, and executive reporting.
This role combines recurring FP&A responsibilities, including monthly performance reporting and financial analysis, with strategic initiative work such as savings programs, growth investments, and enterprise-wide business cases. The successful candidate will partner across FP&A and cross-functional teams to develop financial methodologies, evaluate opportunities and risks, drive workstream accountability, and support executive decision-making through clear and compelling financial storytelling.
We are looking for a highly analytical, self-directed individual with strong business acumen, exceptional organizational skills, the ability to efficiently manage multiple priorities with meticulous attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a passion for problem-solving and tackling complex business challenges.
core responsibilities
Analysis:
Lead financial analysis, business case development, forecasting support, and strategic deep dives to evaluate business opportunities, performance trends, productivity initiatives, and investment decisions.
Develop methodologies to quantify financial impact, track results, identify risks and opportunities, and support enterprise decision-making through clear recommendations and insights.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to synthesize information, challenge assumptions, and translate business questions into structured financial analyses
Project management:
Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring progress against milestones, deliverables, and financial targets.
Coordinate stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business teams to align priorities, identify dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful execution.
Escalate key risks, decisions, and trade-offs as appropriate while maintaining clear visibility of progress and outcomes
Leadership:
Independently own assigned analyses, projects, and strategic workstreams from problem definition through recommendation and communication.
Facilitate cross-functional discussions, drive alignment among stakeholders, and influence decisions through data-driven recommendations and strong business partnership.
Contribute to the development of new processes, methodologies, and programs that improve planning effectiveness and business performance.
Executive storytelling:
Develop executive-ready materials that clearly communicate financial performance, business insights, strategic recommendations, risks, and opportunities.
Distill complex financial analyses into concise narratives tailored to senior leadership audiences, enabling faster and better decision-making.
Support monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc leadership reviews and business presentations.
qualifications
Bachelor's degree in commerce or business administration. Professional designation or MBA a plus.
5+ years of progressive financial analysis and program management experience with fast-paced business environments.
Retail industry experience is an asset.
Expert knowledge across MS suite: Excel, Work, Powerpoint, and outlook is required. Working knowledge of Oracle EPM and Power BI an asset.
Extremely organized, thorough and takes pride in quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets while maintaining attention to detail.
Capable of converting business needs into practical technical solutions
Excellent written, oral, presentation, and interpersonal skills
Proven ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a time sensitive manner.
Ability to cultivate strong business partnerships with all levels, including Senior Leadership.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and create structure where processes, information, or ownership may be unclear.
And:
Proven experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
must haves
Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.
additional notes
Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.
compensation and benefits package
lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $88,200 - $132,400 annually ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.
At lululemon, investing in our people is a top priority. We believe that when life works, work works. We strive to be the place where inclusive leaders come to develop and enable all to be well. Recognizing our teams for their performance and dedication, other components of our total rewards offerings include support of career development, wellbeing, and personal growth:
Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans

Description & Requirements
who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
About this team
We are trusted partners embedded across the business, helping teams bring bold ideas and distinctive guest experiences to life. Within Brand and Community, we partner closely with Collaborations, Brand, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing and other cross-functional teams to enable innovative partnerships while protecting lululemon’s brand, intellectual property and long-term relationships.
The opportunity
This is a pivotal role for an experienced lawyer who will lead legal support for lululemon’s global collaborations program, with a North America focus. You will advise on the full collaboration lifecycle—from structuring and negotiating complex partnerships through launch, compliance and ongoing relationship management—while developing scalable processes that allow the business to move quickly and responsibly. In addition to the collaborations program, you will provide legal advice and draft agreements on a range of marketing, sponsorship, social media, content production, loyalty programs and other matters supporting the Brand and Community Team.
Success will come from being curious, passionate and becoming a trusted advisor to the Collaborations team and Brand cross-functional partners, bringing strong commercial judgment, deep collaboration and licensing expertise, and a practical approach to navigating legal and reputational risk.
What you’ll do
Strategic Impact
Be the trusted legal advisor for lululemon’s collaborations program, providing strategic, practical guidance across complex and high-value global brand partnerships.
Partner closely with Collaborations, Brand, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Finance, InfoSec and other teams to structure partnerships that achieve business objectives while protecting lululemon’s brand and interests.
Advise across the collaboration lifecycle, including partnership structure, intellectual property, licensing, co-branding, marketing, supply chain, tax, consumer protection, privacy, confidentiality and trade-secret considerations.
Anticipate legal and commercial risks, develop pragmatic mitigation strategies, and enable teams to make informed decisions at speed.
Build deep knowledge of lululemon’s business, products and operating model, as well as the entertainment, apparel, retail and collaboration landscape.
Operational Excellence
Draft, negotiate and manage sophisticated collaboration agreements, including brand partnership, licensing, co-branding and influencer agreements, with a focus on complex and high-value arrangements.
Lead legal clearances and approvals for collaborations and help ensure contractual commitments are understood and operationalized across the business.
Develop and scale policies, playbooks, templates and processes that improve speed, consistency and compliance throughout the collaboration lifecycle.
Advise on applicable advertising and marketing requirements, consumer protection, data privacy and other regulatory considerations relevant to apparel, retail and entertainment collaborations.
Support the protection of confidential information, trade secrets and intellectual property shared with external partners.
Build strong partner relationships and serve as a connection point across cross-functional teams and the broader legal team, helping resolve issues before they impact launches or relationships.
Qualifications
J.D., LL.B. or equivalent law degree.
Active membership in good standing with a Bar in the United States or Canada.
Approximately 5+ years of relevant legal experience gained in-house, at a law firm and/or talent agency.
Meaningful experience with intellectual property, licensing, complex commercial contract negotiation and brand collaborations; experience in apparel, retail and/or entertainment is strongly preferred.
Experience advising on complex, high-value agreements and managing sophisticated partner relationships.
Working knowledge of advertising and marketing regulations, consumer protection and data privacy requirements relevant to collaborations.
Exceptional communication, influencing and collaboration skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and provide clear, business-oriented advice.
Keys to Success in this Role
Commercial judgment - balance legal, brand and relationship considerations to enable creative, high-impact collaborations while responsibly managing risk.
Responsiveness - deliver thoughtful advice and agreements at the pace required by high-profile launches and partner negotiations.
Relationship mindset - build trust with internal teams and external partners and navigate complex negotiations in a way that supports long-term relationships.
Enterprise mindset - understand how collaboration decisions affect the broader business and connect the right partners across functions to drive strong outcomes.
Operational excellence - create scalable contract, clearance and compliance processes that improve consistency and speed over time.
Flexibility - self-direct work, adapt to changing business priorities and take an entrepreneurial approach to solving new and ambiguous problems.

Description & Requirements
who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
FP&A is responsible for planning and managing lululemon's overall financial performance. We are an amazing team of passionate, active and dedicated leaders who are counted on as a key business partner in strategic and operational decisions. We provide a tremendous opportunity to learn about the various operations within lululemon working often in cross-functional teams on a variety of projects. You will be able to add value immediately, see the big picture, and develop a business and finance skill set that you can leverage in your future roles within the organization. We are a stand for high quality work, driving high quality results and living a high quality life.
core responsibilities
Reporting to the Director, FP&A, the Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for executing financial planning and analysis activities for the Store Development organization.
Act as a strategic partner to the Store Development team by developing analyses and pro forma P&L models for new store openings, pop-up stores, renovations, and relocations. Provide ROI, cash flow, and investment analysis to support real estate decision-making.
Deliver real estate performance analytics and actionable insights to support portfolio optimization and strategic business decisions.
Lead the development and enhancement of global tools, reporting, and planning processes to improve decision-making, drive consistency, and increase operational efficiency across regions.
Develop, maintain, and enhance complex financial models to support strategic planning, forecasting, and investment decisions.
Identify and implement opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting capabilities, and enhance the effectiveness of FP&A activities
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce or Business Administration.
CPA or MBA a plus.
5+ years of progressive financial analysis and reporting experience with fast paced business environments. Retail industry experience an asset.
Expert knowledge of Excel is required and working knowledge of Oracle Hyperion an asset.
Extremely organized, thorough and takes pride in quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proven ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a time sensitive manner.
Ability to work with a large amount of detail without losing sight of the big picture .
must haves
Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.
Additional Notes
Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.
Compensation and Benefits Package
lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $88,200 - $132,400 CAD ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.
At lululemon, investing in our people is a top priority. We believe that when life works, work works. We strive to be the place where inclusive leaders come to develop and enable all to be well. Recognizing our teams for their performance and dedication, other components of our total rewards offerings include support of career development, wellbeing, and personal growth:
Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans
Paid time off
Savings and retirement plan matching
Generous employee discount
Fitness & yoga classes
Parenthood top-up
Extensive catalog of development course offerings
People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)
Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.
workplace arrangement
This role is classified as In-Person under our SSC Workplace Policy:
In-Person
In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

Description & Requirements
Global Corporate Communications Manager | Contract until April 2028
about this team
lululemon is seeking a Global Corporate Communications Manager for an 18-month contract.
The Global Communications & Corporate Affairs team vision is to inspire people to trust and choose lululemon and create belief in the company’s purpose and potential.
The Global Corporate Communications team supports this vision by driving external communication and narrative strategies to enhance and protect lululemon’s corporate reputation, while building awareness and understanding of the company’s vision, strategy, and performance.
Reporting to the Director, Global Corporate Communications, this role is responsible for leading lululemon’s corporate website, external owned corporate content strategy and newsroom, as well as developing multi-stakeholder communications strategies and materials for key company initiatives and business moments, such as our quarterly earnings and annual shareholder meeting.
The ideal candidate has strong experience in corporate communications environments and is a highly-motivated and collaborative team player. This person will have excellent writing skills, strong stakeholder and project management abilities, and extensive experience working with business media and communicating around complex and high-visibility corporate moments.
core accountabilities:
Oversee our corporate website, including managing website vendor, content, budget, projects, and reporting.
Lead our corporate external owned content strategy and serve as a key member of our newsroom committee, supporting and maintaining editorial processes, content calendars, and standards that enable consistent, high-quality storytelling outputs.
Draft and edit external communications materials, including announcement plans, press releases, and executive briefing documents.
Support the team with day-to-day business media relations including management of the media inbox, media monitoring and measurement, and helping to build and maintain relationships with top-tier business and trade publications.
Provide assistance on fast-moving reputation work, including risk mitigation, and crisis and issues response.
Work with the team’s corporate communications agency of record as needed on owned content and proactive storytelling projects.
Serve as a key point of contact for our regional communications leaders for global storytelling and ‘corporate centre of excellence’ counsel.
Manage multiple communications projects simultaneously, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations are met.
qualifications:
You have a minimum of 8-10 years of dynamic experience in a strategic communications role at a global organization.
You are a clear communicator with excellent writing skills and a strong ability to solve problems effectively.
You are a strategic thinker with a global mindset.
You have sharp attention to detail and experience managing multiple projects within tight deadlines.
You have strong media relations experience and knowledge of financial markets, corporate finance concepts, and SEC disclosure norms.
You have strong verbal and presentation skills.
Education: min. Bachelor’s degree.
must haves
Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.
Additional Notes
Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we’re in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change
to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating and equitable, inclusive, and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
The lululemon Legal team’s purpose is to empower the business while navigating risk and playing in possibility. We cultivate a culture of connection and curiosity, care for the whole person, foster an inclusive environment, and have fun along the way. The Corporate Counsel, Compliance is a key member of lululemon’s Global Legal Compliance team. The team partners across the organization to identify and manage legal and regulatory risk while enabling responsible business growth. This role works closely with Product Integrity, Product Quality, Sustainability, Trade Compliance, Government Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to prepare the
business for evolving regulatory requirements and develop practical solutions that support lululemon’s goals.
core responsibilities
The Legal Counsel, Compliance provides practical, business-focused legal guidance on legal and compliance matters affecting lululemon’s products, services, operations, and strategic initiatives. This
role monitors regulatory developments, interprets legal requirements in the context of the business, and helps cross-functional teams prepare for and implement change.
Monitor legal, regulatory, and enforcement developments across relevant jurisdictions and assess their potential impact on the business.
Translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for business partners and senior leaders.
Advise on compliance considerations relating to products, services, new initiatives, complaints, and issue resolution.
Partner with cross-functional teams, such as Sustainability, Traceability, Trade, Product Integrity and Chemicals Management, to evaluate legal and compliance risk and develop practical mitigation strategies that support business objectives.
Support timely implementation of new or changing regulatory requirements, including identifying readiness gaps and helping teams establish appropriate processes.
Conduct legal research and provide counsel on emerging compliance issues and new product or business initiatives.
Develop and support compliance policies, guidance, best practices, tracking, and reporting.
Collaborate with Government Affairs on lobbying registration and gift and entertainment policy compliance.
Work with the broader Legal team to support compliance program execution, legal research, program maturity, and reporting.
qualifications
Undergraduate degree and Juris Doctor degree, or their equivalents, from accredited institutions.
Active bar membership or the ability to register as in-house counsel in the applicable jurisdiction.
Four or more years of relevant compliance or legal experience.
Demonstrated ability to interpret laws, rules, and regulations and provide practical, risk-based legal advice.
Strong business judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with commercial and operational objectives.
Strong project-management skills and a demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast- paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-lawyers.
Highly collaborative, organized, proactive, and attentive to detail.
Ability to work independently, adapt to changes in scope or direction, and resolve complex issues creatively and effectively.
Willingness and ability to learn new substantive areas and support a broad range of business teams.
Global, retail, consumer-product, or in-house experience is an asset.

Who we are
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
About this team
We are trusted partners embedded across Brand, Community, Innovation, Sports Marketing, Events & Production, and Guest Loyalty. We build scalable programmes that enable speed with integrity, simplify complex risks, and support bold storytelling grounded in compliance and clear guidance.
The opportunity
This is a pivotal role for an experienced lawyer, who thrives under pressure and sets the highest standards of excellence. Working closely with the Brand and Community team, you will support their initiatives by delivering world‑class legal services at speed, while innovating the future by creating business affairs and compliance automation processes. Success means becoming the go‑to advisor for our partners, a thought leader in the business, and a culture champion who enables partners to achieve extraordinary results.
What you’ll do
Strategic Impact
Be a trusted advisor for Marketing, Social Media, Sports Marketing, Community, Events & Production, and Loyalty.
Support on advice and legal documents related to campaigns, events, content production, ambassadors and other brand and community initiatives.
Build deep relationships across the business; anticipate needs and deliver solutions before issues arise.
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of lululemon’s business and products, as well as the industry areas you serve—including e‑commerce, social media, endorsements and sports marketing.
Operational Excellence
Negotiate and draft complex agreements: endorsement, sponsorship, influencer/creator, brand partnerships and collaborations, co‑branding/licensing, production, and experiential campaigns.
Design and scale contract review and clearance programmes that handle large volumes with precision and speed, leveraging AI and automated tools to innovate workflows and knowledge systems.
Support claims clearance, social media compliance, and new programme development (e.g., NIL, influencer initiatives), ensuring global guidelines work seamlessly in regional jurisdictions.
Deliver education training and drive programmatic changes that transform Business Affairs and marketing legal support.
Be a connection point for cross-functional partners and the broader legal team members.
Qualifications
J.D./LL.M
Active Bar membership in the US or Canada
5+ years of combined law firm and in‑house experience
Exceptional communication and influencing skills; ability to simplify complexity and inspire confidence
Keys to Success in this Role
Responsiveness is paramount: deliver answers and agreements quickly, even under urgent circumstances. We have high standards of productivity, expertise, and client service to support these key business units.
Enterprise mindset – using good legal judgment, knowledge of Canadian and US marketing laws, to enable a stable basis for the team to succeed. A passion for our business and Brand efforts, and care for the business objectives of our partners.
Develop deep knowledge of lululemon’s business, products, and operating model, combined with strong understanding of the industry areas served (e‑commerce, social media, endorsements, sports marketing).
Flexibility – responsibilities within support of the Brand and Community teams will shift in response to business requirements, and various capabilities. An entrepreneurial mindset to self-direct work that has impact, and adjust to change will be a great asset.

 We are looking for a detail-driven Legal Billing Specialist to join our growing Legal Operations Team. In this role, you will own the day-to-day of outside counsel and vendor billing across our matter management and eBilling platforms—reviewing invoices, enforcing our Outside Counsel Guidelines and negotiated fee arrangements, and keeping our legal spend accurate, compliant, and on time. The ideal candidate is tech-savvy, numbers-oriented, and thrives under recurring billing deadlines, bringing a collaborative and transparent approach to partnering with attorneys, law firms, and Finance. This is a billing-focused role that also supports the broader Legal Operations function.

 Responsibilities: 

- Prepare, review, and process outside counsel and vendor invoices; audit prebills and invoices, and flag rate errors, block-billing, math discrepancies, and billing-guideline violations before approval.

- Manage the day-to-day operation of the eBilling and matter management platform (Onit), including invoice intake, LEDES processing, rejections and appeals, accruals, and international / AP invoice processing.

- Enforce compliance with Lyft’s Outside Counsel Guidelines (OCG) and negotiated fee and alternative fee arrangements (AFAs); process write-offs, write-downs, and adjustments with clear documentation and audit trail.

- Manage timekeeper and billing-rate submissions and approvals; maintain accurate rate cards, matter budgets, and phase/task coding across the portfolio.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for billing inquiries and disputes; resolve discrepancies promptly by partnering with attorneys, law firms, and support staff.

- Partner closely with the Legal Operations eBilling Lead and with Finance / Accounts Payable on accruals, month- and quarter-end close, reconciliation, and payment status.

- Onboard outside counsel and vendors to our billing program, including engagement letters, budgets, and billing-guideline acknowledgment.

- Develop and iterate on spend metrics, dashboards, and benchmarking through data analytics to measure efficiency, surface trends, and identify cost-savings opportunities.

- Codify billing workflows into playbooks and intake templates; support platform efficiencies, configuration, testing, and report validation.

- Support broader Legal Operations initiatives and process improvements as needed.

 Experience: 

- A bachelor’s degree or higher preferred; coursework or a background in accounting, finance, or business administration is a plus.

- At least 2+ years of legal billing or eBilling experience in an in-house legal department, law firm, or both.

- Hands-on experience with an eBilling / matter management platform—Onit, Legal Tracker, Brightflag —and familiarity with LEDES invoice formats.

- Working knowledge of outside counsel billing guidelines, alternative fee arrangements, rate structures, and accruals.

- Strong Excel and analytical skills, with an eye for accuracy in high-volume, deadline-driven billing cycles.

- Understanding of financial management principles and process-improvement experience.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across the business and with external law firms at all levels.

- A proactive, entrepreneurial approach—recognizing needs, anticipating issues, and following through with a strong sense of ownership.

- Comfortable with new challenges and frequent change, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously.

- Experience with tools such as Ironclad, Evisort, Tonkean, and Google Suite is a plus.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-sharing and scooter-sharing systems that move millions of people in over 60 cities worldwide. We built North America's first automated bike-share system and continue to lead the micromobility revolution. Our systems operate globally - from Citi Bike in New York to BIXI in Montreal, Divvy in Chicago, Capital Bikeshare in DC, and iconic systems in Austin, Barcelona, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubai, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto, and beyond.

 We're not just technology providers - we operate these systems, building the software, hardware, and operations that make urban micromobility work at scale.

 Ready to shape how millions of people move through their cities every day?

 We are looking for a passionate Product Designer to join our Montreal office to work on Lyft’s micromobility Operations Technology team.

 As a member of the Operations Technology team, you’ll be responsible for evolving the platform that drives the global on-the-ground operations of our business. You’ll be designing features that are used in warehouses, vans, & on-the-ground to make our transportation systems some of the most reliable in the world. You’ll confront complex technical challenges & advocate for experiences that delight our operators and promote efficiency.

 Our Montreal office developed the first automated bikes-share system in North America and continues to work on the platform today that provides state-of-the-art electric bikes and scooters for tens of millions of rides per year. 

 As a product designer at Lyft, you will be involved at every step of product development, from brainstorming broad ideas to ensuring design quality through launch. Using your full range of interaction, visual, and product thinking skills. As a product designer on the Lyft Urban Solutions team you will own the design of features within the core rider experience for our bike and scooter riders, within the Lyft app and our market specific apps. 

 In a lot of ways, we function as a startup, meaning we all work closely and collaboratively across organizations to align on product vision and ship products. Our Design and Research teams live and breathe a user-centered process to create the best possible, end-to-end, experience for riders all over the world. We can be scrappy when we need to be, though we are always focused on quality and influence.

 As a qualified candidate, you have a track record of leading projects to successful outcomes for users and the business. You are a strong cross-functional partner, a great communicator, and are able to take a solution from idea to implementation. You uphold a high-quality bar and have a strong appreciation for the details. Above all, you approach problems holistically and create elegantly simple solutions to multi-faceted problems.

 Responsibilities: 

- Problem solve, think big, and explore divergent concepts/ideas while understanding how to converge and build iteratively towards your vision.

- Plan strategically and think tactically as a partner with product and engineering to define the future of the team.

- Influence the shape of the product with research and data while executing design work using high quality wireframes, mockups, user journeys, and cross-platform interactive prototypes.

- Advocate for design by sharing your work and presenting cross-functionally, while being able to precisely articulate design rationale.

- Inspire the entire team (including your cross-functional) partners by bringing new ideas to the table.

- Create a unified, end-to-end experience through close collaboration with team members from across the Product and Marketing Design Teams. 

 Experience: 

- 3+ years of experience working in UX, UI, HCI related field with experience working on web and mobile design

- Experience working with a lean team of Engineers, Product Managers and Program Managers

- Experience designing innovative products for desktop and mobile

- Excellent oral and written communication skills

- Experience with user research methods and analysis

- Expertise with Figma and other prototyping tools

- Excellence in design craft

- Ability to work with a low-ego, highly collaborative, cross-functional team

- Excited about working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment

Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going   Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.   Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.   With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.   If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!  Role Overview    At Magnet Forensics Inc, the Sales Development Reps are the frontlines of the Customer experience. Working closely with the Sales and Marketing teams, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a key player in our strategic growth plans. Through a combination of top of funnel activities, including both inbound lead response and outbound prospecting, the SDR will generate and qualify sales opportunities for our Account Executives. The most exciting part of this role is the opportunity for growth. At Magnet Forensics, successful SDRs will learn the fundamentals of Sales and Marketing providing a foundation for a career in Business Development, Sales, Marketing and more!      Who Should Apply:   As a successful candidate for this role, you are passionate about developing new skills and building a network of peers & mentors. You are motivated by healthy competition and you’re eager to be the leader of a winning group or team. You display resiliency when faced with adversity, and ultimately, you are naturally curious, consistently looking for novel ways to solve problems and improve processes.           What You’ll Do :
  • Qualify all sales leads generated by marketing, based on defined lead qualification criteria  
  • Leverage prospecting strategies, including phone, email and social networking to connect with prospective customers, identify their needs and challenges, and qualify their interest  
  • Work closely with our sales team (Account Executives) to schedule discovery meetings with sales ready leads/prospects 
  • Leverage a variety of marketing and sales tools that will be available for your use, to maximize your efficiency and effectiveness, including Prospecting tools (ex. SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator) and Marketing Automation tools (ex. Pardot) 
  • Manage new contacts via our CRM platform (Salesforce) to ensure accuracy for long term pipeline development 
  • Provide friendly and knowledgeable service to prospects on a consistent basis and build strong relationships 
  • Work as part of a cross functional team and build strong relationships across the organization
  • The primary focus of this role is Inbound Lead Response with additional attention on Outbound Prospecting
What We're Looking For:
  • You want to be part of a high growth software company that always puts it’s customers first 
  • You have a never give up attitude! You are an organized self-starter with excellent follow-through, that has demonstrated lots of initiative 
  • You are goal-oriented and full of drive, with an innate desire to succeed 
  • You have 2+ years experience in sales or customer service roles, and can work under pressure 
  • You have a University degree or College diploma in Business, Marketing or equivalent, and leverage it to be a critical thinker that enjoys solving complex challenges  
  • You are comfortable with change
  • You have strong analytical, relational and negotiation skills, as well as excellent verbal & written communication skills 
  • You have Proficiency in Microsoft Office, as well as a solid understanding of social media tools like LinkedIn and Twitter 
Nice to Have Skills:
  • You have experience working with a CRM system like Salesforce
  • You have familiarity and prior exposure to the lead funnel process - lead generation, lead follow up, and lead tracking  
  • You have prior experience with lead prospecting software tools an/or chatbot monitoring  
  • Proficiency in an additional European language is considered an asset.
