lever:magnetforensics:11c110df-ba77-482b.description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going   Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.   Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.   With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.   If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!  Role Summary   Magnet Forensics is seeking a detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support the company's global trade compliance program. This is an entry-level to early-career position responsible for conducting daily compliance reviews and screening activities to ensure compliance with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). The successful candidate will perform Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, restricted-party screening, sales opportunity reviews, end-user due diligence, and transaction monitoring activities. The position plays a critical role in helping the company identify potential export compliance risks before products, software, services, or technology are provided to customers, partners, vendors, or other third parties. This role will work closely with the Legal, Compliance, Sales Operations, Finance, Customer Success, and Procurement teams and will escalate higher-risk matters to senior compliance personnel for further review. The analyst will be responsible for screening transaction parties using Descartes and ensuring appropriate documentation and records are maintained. Magnet's procedures require screening customers, vendors, banks, brokers, consignees, and other transaction participants against restricted party lists throughout the transaction lifecycle. What You'll Do:

Customer and Transaction Due Diligence

  • Conduct Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews of customers, resellers, distributors, partners, vendors, and other third parties.
  • Review customer ownership structures, corporate affiliations, beneficial ownership information, and geographic presence.
  • Assess customer-provided information for completeness and identify potential red flags.
  • Support enhanced due diligence investigations when elevated risks are identified.
  • Maintain accurate records of KYC reviews and associated compliance determinations.

    •  Restricted Party Screening

  • Perform restricted-party screening using Descartes and other approved screening tools.
  • Screen customers, end users, vendors, financial institutions, intermediaries, resellers, distributors, and other transaction participants against applicable sanctions and restricted-party lists.
  • Review and resolve potential screening matches.
  • Coordinate escalation of possible sanctions or export-control concerns.
  • Ensure screening is conducted at required points throughout the transaction lifecycle, including new transactions, customer updates, renewals, and other triggering events.

    • Sales Opportunity Reviews

  • Review sales opportunities and transactions for export control and sanctions compliance concerns.
  • Verify customer locations, end users, end uses, and transaction details.
  • Identify transactions involving elevated-risk countries, entities, government organizations, or industries.
  • Support review of reseller, distributor, and channel partner transactions.
  • Work with Sales Operations and Legal teams to resolve compliance-related questions before transactions proceed.

    •  Export Compliance Operations

  • Support routine EAR and ITAR compliance activities.
  • Review requests involving international shipments, software access, demonstrations, evaluations, training, and customer engagements.
  • Assist with export authorization tracking and record maintenance.
  • Monitor compliance queues and ensure timely completion of required reviews.
  • Maintain trade compliance databases, logs, and other operational records.

    •  Compliance Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain organized records supporting compliance reviews and screening decisions.
  • Prepare routine metrics, reports, and dashboards relating to compliance activities.
  • Assist with internal audits and compliance assessments.
  • Support responses to internal and external information requests.
  • Help maintain compliance procedures, work instructions, and training materials.

    •  Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, IT, and Legal teams.
  • Provide guidance regarding routine compliance procedures and screening requirements.
  • Escalate unusual, complex, or higher-risk transactions to senior compliance personnel.
  • Assist with employee training and awareness initiatives.
    • What We're Looking For:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, International Relations, Political Science, Criminal Justice, Supply Chain, Finance, Law, Public Policy, or a related field.
  • Experience in trade compliance, compliance operations, risk management, due diligence, investigations, legal operations, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel.
    • Nice to have skills:
  • Experience conducting customer due diligence, KYC reviews, sanctions screening, or compliance reviews.
  • Familiarity with EAR, ITAR, OFAC sanctions regulations, or other trade compliance frameworks.
  • Experience using Descartes, World-Check, Dow Jones, or similar screening tools.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce, CRM systems, or case-management platforms.
  • Experience working in a legal, compliance, financial crime, risk, or regulatory environment.

About the role 
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team. The ideal candidate will have experience in account management, customer retention, and upselling, preferably within the financial advisor’s industry. This role is integral to supporting and managing an assigned group of customers, ensuring they achieve value from our solutions while maintaining attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.

 Our customers run highly varied CRM implementations with different account structures, operational processes, and billing arrangements. No two accounts are alike, so success in this role means tailoring your approach to each customer while staying organized across a portfolio of accounts.

 Who you’ll support 

 Maximizer serves customers across many industries, with a growing focus on financial services: wealth advisors and managers, insurance advisors, and dually licensed advisors practicing both.

 You’ll manage a portfolio of customer relationships ranging from small independent teams to enterprise organizations with many teams operating under a single head office. Some of these head-office relationships span many individual accounts, so the role calls for managing both breadth and structural complexity.

 What you’ll do 

- Act as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts, focusing on building and maintaining strong customer relationships.

- Support and manage an assigned Book of Business, ensuring satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

- Manage a diverse portfolio of customers with varied implementations, account structures, and billing arrangements, adapting your approach to each customer’s unique setup and needs.

- Keep clear, up-to-date records of key customer interactions, commitments, and follow-ups, so no promise falls through the cracks and any teammate can step in seamlessly when needed.

- Triage and prioritize competing customer needs across accounts of varying complexity, making sound judgment calls on what moves first.

- Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities to maximize account growth and customer lifetime value.

- Own multi-step issue resolution across Support, Product, Billing, and Sales, driving each item through to closure and keeping customers informed along the way.

- Conduct regular account business reviews or scheduled touch points depending on the account size and strategic importance.

- Ensure all account-related processes are executed with precision, maintaining data accuracy and process integrity within our systems.

- Contribute to the development and execution of customer engagement strategies, including the promotion of webinars, training sessions, and targeted campaigns.

 What success looks like 

 By the end of your first 90 days, you will have:

- Established a baseline standard of service and responsiveness across your book of business.

- Built a proactive engagement structure for every key account, scaled from complex to simple based on each account’s needs, so every key account has planned touchpoints alongside reliable coverage for incoming requests and upcoming renewals.

 Beyond your first 90 days, you’ll help shape what success looks like. You’ll work with your manager to set goals for retention, engagement cadence with key accounts, and expansion and upsell targets.

 What you’ll bring 

- 3+ years of experience in customer account management, preferably in the financial advisors or related industry.

- Demonstrated aptitude for strategic account management, with a track record of driving customer success and retention, within the enterprise customers.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously.

- Exceptional organization and task management: you track every follow-up, deadline, and commitment, and you deliver on them.

- Strong prioritization skills with a proven ability to juggle many customer priorities at once.

- Outstanding knowledge retention: you build and maintain a deep understanding of each customer’s setup, history, and goals.

- Adaptability and nimbleness in switching between customers with very different needs, configurations, and levels of complexity.

- Technical aptitude to learn and support complex business software, and to understand how each customer has shaped it around their own processes.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with customers and internal stakeholders.

- Experience using CRM tools and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

- Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

 Tools you’ll use 

 Zendesk, Amplitude, Metabase, Microsoft 365 (including Teams and Outlook), and Claude. Previous experience with any of these is a plus.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Fluency in both French and English (verbal and written).

- Previous experience working in a financial advisors related industry

- Familiarity with subscription-based business models and customer success metrics (e.g., renewal rates, NRR, expansion ARR).

- Experience in a SaaS company is a plus

- Experience using AI tools and processes to improve productivity in your work.

 Compensation 

 The base salary for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 CAD, with an on-target estimate of $80,000 - $95,000

 Why you should apply 

- 💰 Competitive Salaries with RRSP matching program

- 🏝 Generous paid vacay and sick days

- 💻 A powerful Laptop

- 📚 Budget for courses, books, and personal development

- ❤️ Peer to peer recognition and rewards

- 🍹 Team building events, happy hours and more

- 🧒🏻 Flexible remote work

 About Maximizer 

 Maximizer was launched in a garage on Vancouver Island in 1987, evolving through the development of early contact management systems (CMS), through sales force automation (SFA) technologies, right to today’s sophisticated customer relationship management (CRM) systems. Along the way, we have pioneered many of today’s technologies. Over our nearly 40-year history we have attracted over 100,000 customers from around the world, and 1 million users.

 Today, we are one of the few CRM providers in the world who can deploy our software in all three environments of on-premise, private or shared cloud, while providing access via a desktop/laptop, via a mobile device, or using the Maximizer app.

 Ultimately, however, we are successful because for over three decades we have proven we know how to help customers do three things: secure new customers; retain them for the long term; and maximize the repeat business from them.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, faith, colour, cultural background, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
 Salary Range
 $70,000 — $80,000 CAD

ABOUT MECKA AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.


HELP US BUILD THE TEAM BUILDING PHYSICAL AI

Mecka is building the data engine that helps robots understand and operate in the physical world. That requires an extraordinary team spanning software, infrastructure, machine learning, computer vision, robotics and research.

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter who can find those people—and convince them to build with us.

Reporting to our Director of Talent Acquisition, you’ll own technical searches from first outreach through to signed offer. You’ll work directly with hiring managers and company leaders, move with urgency, and help us build a lasting presence within the robotics and computer vision communities.

This is not a role for someone who waits for applicants. You’ll map specialized talent markets, develop relationships before there is an open role, and build pipelines that compound as Mecka grows.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead full-cycle recruiting across engineering, ML, computer vision, robotics and other specialized technical roles

 - Find exceptional candidates through original research, targeted sourcing and long-term relationship building—not only LinkedIn searches and inbound applications

 - Partner with hiring managers to define the real need, sharpen the role and build an interview process that identifies it

 - Build trusted relationships across robotics and computer vision companies, research labs, universities and technical communities

 - Develop talent pipelines before roles open, particularly for specialized and hard-to-find profiles

 - Keep searches moving quickly while maintaining a high hiring bar and a strong candidate experience

 - Present and close offers, helping candidates understand Mecka’s technical ambition, ownership and upside

 - Use pipeline data and market intelligence to tell us where talent sits, what candidates care about and when our approach needs to change

 - Help improve the recruiting systems, tools and practices we’ll need as Mecka scales


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience .  Must have experience hiring specialized engineers, researchers or technical leaders in robotics, computer vision, physical AI, autonomous systems, ML or another deep-tech environment

 - Strong sourcing instincts and evidence that you can uncover people other recruiters miss

 - Experience operating at speed in a demanding startup, scale up or similarly high-performance environment

 - The judgment to distinguish an impressive résumé from someone who will materially raise the bar

 - The credibility and curiosity to engage deeply technical candidates and hiring managers

 - Strong candidate-closing skills and comfort navigating compensation, equity and competing offers

 - High ownership: you identify obstacles, propose solutions and keep the process moving


EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE

 - Existing relationships across robotics, computer vision or embodied-AI companies, labs and academic communities

 - Experience recruiting at the intersection of software, hardware and research

 - Familiarity with the talent emerging from conferences and communities such as CVPR, NeurIPS, CoRL, RSS or ICRA

 - Experience with Ashby and modern sourcing or talent-intelligence tools


WHY MECKA

You’ll have direct access to the leaders making hiring decisions, ownership over some of our most important searches, and the opportunity to build a technical talent network—not simply fill requisitions.

The hiring bar is high. The pace is fast. The people you bring in will directly shape what Mecka becomes and we have super high ambitions.  If you do too - you may be the perfect fit!


A NOTE ON APPLYING

Studies show women and candidates from underrepresented groups often only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, while others apply after meeting 60%. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Key Responsibilities:
Adoption Strategy and Governance – MYLE Platform and AI Innovations
Global Adoption Strategy: Define and lead the adoption strategy for the entire MYLE platform (core clinical and administrative modules) as well as its AI innovations (Scribe AI, AI Document Indexing, AI Virtual Assistant, and future innovations), including adoption, retention, and satisfaction targets.
Success Metrics: Establish, track, and report key indicators (adoption rates for MYLE and its AI modules, CSAT/NPS, retention rates, churn rates) to executive leadership.
Tools and Playbooks: Develop onboarding pathways, playbooks, and tracking tools to enable structured adoption, from initial MYLE integration to the rollout of each new AI solution.
Proactive Monitoring and "Health Checks": Analyze platform usage data to identify drops in MYLE or AI feature adoption, as well as churn risk signals, before they become critical, and design targeted remediation plans.
Customer Experience Excellence and Retention
Change Management: Support clinics through their digital transition, whether during the initial MYLE implementation, the introduction of new AI features, or major updates.
Critical Escalations: Act as the escalation point for complex customer situations related to MYLE or AI tool adoption by mobilizing appropriate internal resources.
Targeted Remediation Plans: Design targeted interventions (training workshops, coaching, workflow optimization) for accounts showing signs of disengagement with MYLE or its AI modules in order to minimize churn.
Ambassadors and Retention: Develop engagement programs for power users/champions of MYLE and AI solutions within clinics to foster long-term platform adhesion.
Voice of the Customer and Platform Evolution
Strategic Influence: Synthesize field feedback, pain points, and unmet user needs regarding both MYLE core functions and AI modules to influence the global product roadmap.
Customer Prioritization: Represent the needs of clinical users in feature prioritization decisions, collaborating closely with Product and Engineering teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver a seamless, cohesive customer experience across the entire MYLE journey, without silos.
Team Leadership and Operational Excellence
Team Management: Recruit, mentor, and grow a team of specialists dedicated to MYLE and AI solution adoption, sharing best practices in account management and product expertise.
Methodology Optimization: Establish team processes, tools, and methodologies (follow-up automation, playbook enrichment, diagnostic tools).
Organizational Alignment: Collaborate with other leaders across the organization to align MYLE and AI innovation adoption goals with MEDFAR’s overall customer success strategy.
Working Conditions
Permanent, full-time position (40 hours per week)
Hybrid work model
Travel required to meet clients in person
The candidate must possess a car and a valid driver's license
Qualifications
7 to 10 years of relevant experience in customer success, software adoption management, or technology solution deployment, including team management experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or a healthcare-related field; equivalent experience considered.
Demonstrated experience in launching and scaling adoption initiatives for tech platforms, ideally Electronic Medical Records (EMR); experience with AI solutions is an asset.
Deep expertise in MYLE or a comparable EMR and its clinical and administrative workflows; strong understanding of integrated AI modules (Scribe AI, document indexing, virtual assistant) is a major asset.
Data-driven approach with experience using analytics tools (Tableau, PowerBI, or equivalent) to transform adoption metrics into actionable plans.
Strong change management skills (Prosci or equivalent certification is an asset) and the ability to influence multidisciplinary teams without direct hierarchical authority.
Excellent executive-level communication skills and full professional proficiency in French and English (oral and written).
Additional Information
Joining MEDFAR means working in a dynamic environment where trust, innovation, quality, and customer success guide our daily work. At MEDFAR, we promote efficiency and excellence in healthcare by offering the highest-performing Electronic Medical Record (EMR) on the market.

Company Description
MEDFAR Clinical Solutions was founded in 2010 by two aeronautical engineers who realized that the healthcare system was not exploiting the full potential of technology. Supported by a large community of medical experts and focused on clinical success and patient safety, MEDFAR was the first company to certify a cloud-based Electronic Medical Record in Canada: MYLE (Make Your Life Easy).
Committed to promoting excellence and effectiveness in healthcare worldwide, MEDFAR differentiates itself by offering a unique healthcare management solution for clinics, which replaces inefficient processes with a faster and safer technological alternative.
Job Description
You will join Maël, technical support manager, whose mandate is to help our customers when they encounter billing issues or have questions related to their invoice.
As a key point of contact for our clients — including clinics, hospitals, and healthcare professionals — your role will be to assist them via phone and email with the use of our MYLE software. You will have a direct and meaningful impact on their satisfaction.
Your responsibilities will include:
Quickly handling incoming client requests remotely;
Providing technical support related to the use of MYLE;
Understanding and identifying the root cause of issues, and offering appropriate solutions tailored to each situation;
Collaborating with other support team members to resolve tickets;
Escalating tickets based on their complexity and communicating relevant information to technical teams;
Contributing to the expansion of our knowledge base and the improvement of internal processes.
What will your first few months look like?
Your first four weeks will be dedicated to discovering the MYLE product. As a member of our support team, you’ll deepen your knowledge and gain insight into the many nuances of the MYLE software.
We’ve designed an internal training and development plan to help you reach your goals. Here’s what the typical progression and role evolution looks like — responsibilities and compensation grow along the way:
1) Client Support Associate (0–6 months)
Master our tools and processes
Handle simple email requests
Take calls during peak periods
2) Client Support Specialist (Level 1) (6–12 months)
Apply knowledge acquired as an Associate
Manage more complex email cases
Handle regular phone support
3) Client Support Specialist (Level 2) (12+ months)
Handle complex and more technical client issues via email
Manage phone support
Help create technical documentation to enrich our knowledge base
Support the training of new Level 1 Associates
Your manager’s role will be to equip and support you as you grow within the company — in the direction you choose. Whether you’re interested in customer success, sales, product management, or R&D, many MEDFARians have grown internally, and we want you to be next!
Qualifications

Previous experience in customer service
A genuine desire to help clients and deliver an exceptional experience

A thirst for knowledge and a willingness to step outside your comfort zone
Excellent command of both French and English (spoken and written)
A passion for technology and the ability to learn and use new tools effectively

Candidates must reside in the province of Quebec.

From 7:30 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. (regular shifts)
From 10:00 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. (on-call shifts only)
As such, candidates must:
Be available Monday through Sunday, between 7:30 a.m. and 10:00 p.m. (based on team needs);
Be open to working night shifts (10:00 p.m. to 7:30 a.m.), occasionally - a night shift bonus is offered.
Details regarding shift assignment (including night and weekend shifts) will be explained during the interview.

Overview 
 Overview 
 Are you passionate about driving cloud transformation across diverse industries? Join our dynamic team as a Cloud & AI Solution Specialist, where you will play a pivotal role in accelerating Microsoft Azure adoption in our key Strategic Accounts. You will collaborate with a high-performing team of Solution Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful cloud solutions that address complex customer needs. 
 As a Cloud & AI Specialist, you are a business leader with deep technical and business knowledge within our enterprise sales organization, working with our most important customers in Western Canada. A core competency of the role is to advance the engagement process to achieve/exceed quarterly Azure consumption targets across Infrastructure, Data, and AI platforms in your assigned accounts. You possess executive presence, you are able to engage with decision makers to drive AI transformation, and have an insatiable interest for learning how Azure cloud services can deliver digital transformation. You will lead a virtual team of sales, technical, and services resources to help customers realize transformation through cloud computing.  You will identify projects, build a compelling business case, and drive the consumption project to production. You will build and maintain relationships with customers, influence long-term strategic direction and act as a trusted advisor driving engagement at the CXO level with business and technology decision makers. You will help customers evaluate their cloud strategy, determine approaches to application and data migration and modernization, and recommend solutions that meet their requirements. You will remove roadblocks to deployment and drive customer satisfaction. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Responsibilities 
 Sales Execution 

- Brings impactful industry insights into customer engagements and closes deals with customers. Acts as a thought leader across solution areas to advise customers across business functions on digital transformation. Leads virtual transformational shifts to drive deployment and create business value for customers. May lead partner integration into account/territory planning and customer engagements. Provides thought leadership. 

- Orchestrates with team members on conducting personal campaigns to discover new opportunities and generate new leads. Leads conversations with strategic/high-potential customers (e.g., high budget, global account, highly competitive) along with account teams or partners. Facilitates the account team unit (ATU) and/or Specialist Team Unit (STU) to build pipeline in collaboration with partners and services. Guides others on social selling. Applies Microsoft's sales process to determine the quality of the opportunity and whether to proceed and educate the customers on how to best address their needs. 
 Scaling and Collaboration 

- Leads the planning and execution on opportunities with resources and partners to cross-sell and up-sell. Identifies, leverages, and coordinates partners and resources across solution areas. Validates partner solution relevance for customers. Provides input and feedback to Global Partner Solutions (GPS) on developing partner strategies and connects the partner ecosystems to scale business results. 

- Leads the sales orchestration with internal stakeholders and partners (e.g., Enterprise Operating Unit). Applies a holistic approach to build network across territories. Positions opportunities to promote collaboration and participation.

 As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will have the opportunity to drive Transformation in partnership with our most Strategic customers with a focus on AI, Copilot and Security to achieve both Microsoft and customer business outcomes. Leveraging your large, multi-functional team across the breadth of the Microsoft solutions portfolio, engage at the most senior levels of your customer and bring industry-relevant solutions to help the customer adopt and embrace digital technologies.   

 With a proven history of driving growth in market share, achieving sales targets, customer obsession, and partner collaboration, this role will give the opportunity to leverage your extensive customer network and sales experience to execute against your customer’s account plan.     

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   

 Responsibilities 

- Customer Advocate – Develops and oversees the execution of account plan(s) to ensure Microsoft revenue targets and customer outcomes are met.   

- Engages with internal and external stakeholders on business planning, to promote mutually beneficial customer digital transformation strategies.  

- Orchestrates full customer team across all areas of Microsoft to ensure we are focused on delivering customer outcomes across the customer lifecycle to build deep trust with Microsoft. 

- Industry Relevant Trusted Seller – Proactively develops a strong understanding of the customer’s business, industry priorities to drive new business opportunities/ drive growth/net new business.   

- Advocates on behalf of the customer internally, ensuring requests and needs of assigned accounts are being addressed.  

- Deliver Sales Excellence – Leads and orchestrates extended virtual teams across our solution areas to consistently achieve growth in revenue & market share.  

- Industry Knowledge – Builds and maintains a strong knowledge of customers’ industry, associated business strategy, and key industry partners and solutions.   Gains deeper insights and knowledge through direct engagement in their customers’ business and operations.

 Required/minimum qualifications

Overview 

 Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By bringing product, engineering, sales, customer success, and partners together around a shared customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. You will join a collaborative team focused on delivering AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable customer value.   

 As a Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM), you will serve as the primary customer success leader responsible for helping strategic customers turn their Microsoft cloud and AI investments into measurable business outcomes. You will build trusted relationships, align customer priorities with Microsoft capabilities, and orchestrate people, programs, and resources across Microsoft and our partner ecosystem to strengthen customer health, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustained value. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your business and technical acumen, strengthen your delivery and program-management capabilities, and grow your ability to lead through influence across customer, partner, and Microsoft teams. This role offers flexibility to work from home up to 50% of the time.   

 Are you passionate about helping customers accelerate business transformation through cloud and AI? Do you thrive in complex environments that require leadership, orchestration, and customer advocacy?   

 As a CSAM, you will lead Customer Success Planning and connect customer goals to Microsoft capabilities, Success Programs, and Success Management Services. You will establish governance and delivery rhythms, proactively manage risks and adoption blockers, and drive coordinated execution that helps customers achieve durable outcomes and expand the value of their Microsoft investments.   
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- 
- Build trusted-advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and Microsoft teams, aligning technology investments to strategic business priorities and measurable outcomes.   

- Lead stakeholder and priority alignment across customer organizations, establishing shared objectives, success measures, and governance approaches.   

- Own Customer Success Planning and execution, translating business priorities into coordinated programs of work that drive measurable customer value.   

- Orchestrate cross-functional execution across Microsoft, partners, and customer teams to strengthen customer health, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance AI transformation.   

- Leverage Success Management Services, Success Programs, and broader Microsoft resources to drive scaled execution and value realization.   

- Proactively identify and manage customer risks, adoption challenges, and delivery dependencies, guiding stakeholders toward timely resolution.   

- Serve as a customer advocate and customer success leader, using insights and feedback to improve execution and help customers realize durable business value from their Microsoft investments.   

-

 Required Qualifications (RQs) 

- Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND 4+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR equivalent experience.
 Preferred Qualifications (PQs) 

- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND 8+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience 
- OR Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience

- OR equivalent experience

- 3+ years relevant work experience within customer industry

- Microsoft or competitor equivalent (e.g., AWS) certification in relevant technologies (e.g., Azure, 365)

- Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification or equivalent service management certification 
- Project Management Institute (PMI) or equivalent Project Management certification

- Prosci or equivalent certification

Overview 
 This role provides coverage for an employee currently on a leave of absence and is expected to continue until the employee returns. The employee is currently expected to return in or around 12 months, although this timing may change. While we remain fully committed to your career development at Microsoft, we cannot commit to continued placement in this specific role beyond the assignment.  

 AI is changing how every company operates, and this role puts you right in the middle of that transformation.As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be a strategic partner to some of our largest customers, helping senior leaders turn AI ambition into real business outcomes. You’ll bring the best of Microsoft across AI, Azure, Copilot, Security and our broader cloud portfolio to help customers transform, while growing our business along the way. You'll do the visionary stuff and the "keep the business running stuff" with equal passion and execution excellence. You'll stay on the problem until it is solved. This is a team sport. You’ll lead a large, cross-functional account team, build relationships from the C-suite through to business and technology leaders, and bring the right people together to solve hard problems and create new opportunities.We’re looking for someone who is customer obsessed, commercially sharp, great with people and comfortable operating in a world that is changing incredibly fast. You need to be curious, willing to learn at an unprecedented pace, and great at mobilizing others.The opportunity is pretty simple:  help some of the world’s largest companies figure out how to win in the age of AI, and make Microsoft an indispensable partner in getting them there. 

 Responsibilities 
 What you’ll do  

- Drive growth. Own the account strategy and lead your team to deliver customer outcomes, adoption, consumption and revenue. 

- Solve the problem. You know when the problem is yours to solve or how to bring the right person in to solve it. Either way, you stay on it until the problem is solved. 

- Build executive relationships. Become a trusted partner to C-suite, business and technology leaders. 

- Lead the team. Bring together the best of Microsoft and our partner ecosystem around the customer’s biggest priorities. 

- Create opportunities. Connect customer challenges to strong business cases and Microsoft solutions. 

- Compete and win. Differentiate Microsoft, expand our strategic position and grow our share of the customer’s technology investment. 

- Turn strategy into action. Build alignment across complex customer organizations and keep everyone moving toward measurable outcomes. 

- Most importantly, stay curious. AI is moving fast. The people who will thrive in this role are the ones who love learning, aren't afraid to challenge the status quo, and can bring customers and teams along with them.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393557021672.description:
Overview 
 With a vision to build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a broad partner ecosystem, the  Windows and Device Sales (WDS)  organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes with Microsoft technology. 
 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners, to drive Windows platform adoption, strengthen technology security and help customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments. 
 This role contributes to a multi‑billion‑dollar business and plays a direct role in securing and expanding Windows as a trusted enterprise endpoint platform. You will work with customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation. 
 As a  Windows and Device Sales Specialist , you will strengthen and expand Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders, anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders to ensure Windows remains the trusted platform for secure, AI‑driven work. 
 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate the value of Windows across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and translate successful customer engagements into repeatable best practices that can be scaled across industries and partner ecosystems. 
 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, expand your technical and platform expertise across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

 #WDS 

 Responsibilities 
 Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives : Leverage your technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value. 
 Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments , deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based & differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket. 
 Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures , helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale. 
 Lead high‑impact customer engagements  across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.  
 Deliver impactful wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value , converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios. 
 Orchestrate across internal teams and partners , working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes. 
 Provide structured feedback and insights  from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers. 
 Embody our  Culture   &  Values  

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, Information Security, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR equivalent experience.
 Additional or preferred qualifications
 Master's Degree in Business Administration (i.e., MBA), Information Technology, Information Security, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR equivalent experience.
 4+ years solution or services sales experience.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393556972507.description:
Overview 
 At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.   
 The CSAM (IC1) is an early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
 Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and an M1 Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation – reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   

 Responsibilities 
 Executive partnership and execution 

- Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders. 

- Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts. 

- Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them. 

 Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation 

- Maintain deep, current account context across the pod’s defined portfolio.

Senior Accountant 
 Location: Remote (Canada)

 About the role 
 This is a first or second industry move for someone who came up through Big 4 and wants real accounting ownership - not another rotation. 
 You'll work directly with the Controller and Finance Manager across fund accounting, IFRS reporting, full-cycle close, and external audit for Orion Digital's asset management entity. The scope is broad by design: financial instruments, fund reconciliations, consolidations, treasury-related accounting, and operational finance - all within a dual-listed public company running a lean, high-accountability team. 
 If you want a steep learning curve, early ownership, and a clear path to Finance Manager - this is the role. 
 Why this role stands out 

- Direct exposure to fund accounting and IFRS reporting in a dual-listed (TSX/NASDAQ) environment 

- Hands-on audit experience across both corporate and fund audits - not just prep work 

- Work closely with the Controller and Finance Manager, not buried in a large team 

- Named growth path: this role is structured to develop into the Finance Manager position 

- Contribute to a live finance transformation - NetSuite, automation, AI-assisted workflows 

- Broad exposure across financial instruments, treasury, consolidations, and operational finance 
 What you'll own 
 Close & reporting 

- Journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting working papers for monthly and quarterly close 

- IFRS reporting support and preparation of internal and external reporting packages 

- Variance analysis, reconciling item investigation, and discrepancy resolution 

- Consolidation support across multiple entities and investment structures 

- Accounting across accruals, investments, loans, leases, and treasury-related activities 
 Fund accounting & audit 

- Fund accounting reconciliations and reporting processes for IntelligentInvesting Securities Inc. 

- Audit support schedules and coordination with external auditors across fund and corporate audits 

- Audit-ready working papers and supporting documentation maintained throughout the year 
 Process & operations 

- Cross-functional coordination to ensure accounting outputs reflect business activity accurately 

- Identification and execution of workflow and reconciliation improvements 

- Contribution to automation and process improvement initiatives across Finance systems 
 What you bring 

- CPA designated (or final stages) 

- 3–5 years of progressive accounting experience 

- Big 4 or national-firm background - required 

- IFRS foundation with financial instruments, fund accounting, or investment structures as a plus 

- External audit experience - preparation and coordination, not just awareness 

- Strong Excel and ERP skills; NetSuite experience is an asset 

- Able to investigate and resolve accounting issues independently 

- High ownership mentality - you don't wait to be told what needs fixing 

- Genuine interest in process improvement and working in a lean, fast-moving environment 
 What success looks like at 12–18 months 

- Reconciliations and reporting deliverables are accurate, timely, and audit-ready without escalation 

- Fund audit and close processes run reliably with your ownership 

- Accounting issues are caught and resolved before they become close problems 

- You're trusted to take on increasingly complex work with minimal direction 

- You're on a clear track toward the Finance Manager role 
 Compensation & benefits 

- Base salary: $85,000 – $95,000 CAD 

- Performance bonus 

- Equity participation in a publicly traded company 

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits + Health Spending Account 

- Flex vacation and personal days 

- Fully remote work with the tools and support to succeed 

- Wellbeing programs including counselling and mental health resources 
 A note on fit 
 This role is designed for someone early in their post-designation career who wants to move faster than a traditional path allows. You'll be given real ownership, direct access to finance leadership, and a clear line of sight to the next level. If that's what you're looking for, we'd like to hear from you.

jazzhr:mogo:job_20260721161420_6TWBICNB5.description:
Content Designer - Intelligent Investing 
 Location: Remote, Canada 
 Reports to: Senior Designer 
 Base Salary: $60,000–80,000 CAD, depending on experience and demonstrated taste. 
 About the work 
 Intelligent Investing is not building a social media account. We are building an institution that documents the reality of capital allocation. Our content is closer to a publication than a feed — calm, precise, and made to be respected years from now, not to win the afternoon. 
 We have more ideas than we have hands to make them. That is the job. You will take a strong observation and a clear direction, and turn it into finished work - a lot of it, at a high standard - under the guidance of our senior designer. 
 This is a craft role. You make things. You make them well, and you make them often. 
 What you’ll make 
 Most of our output is built from a few strong anchors, expressed many ways. One observation becomes the poster, the carousel, the Signal, the essay layout. One idea, multiple expressions — never the reverse. 
 Day to day, that means: 

- Poster and image posts, carousels, and typeset Signals - the pieces that make us recognizable. 

- Layout for essays and short films so they read like a publication, not a slide deck. 

- Fast, clean variations of approved concepts for testing and distribution. 

- Keeping the library of templates, source material, and reusable creative organized as it grows. 
 Volume is real here — but it rises by adding lighter pieces, never by thinning the important ones. 
 Publish and listen 
 You also own how the work goes out, and you keep an ear on how it lands. 

- Run the publishing calendar and schedule across our channels — a steady, consistent rhythm. 

- Watch how pieces perform: what earns saves and shares, which anchors return people, what quietly falls flat. 

- Listen to the audience — the recurring questions, the objections, the language people actually use — and bring it back so it sharpens what we make next. 

- Flag anything that needs a real reply — a customer, product, or sensitive issue — to the right person, fast. 

- Deliver a weekly performance report on a fixed schedule, covering engagement, saves and shares, follower growth, return visits, and the specific pieces that drove results. 
 This is publishing and listening, not performing. Replying in our voice, engaging publicly, and speaking for the brand stay with the team above you — reviewed, deliberate, never improvised in the comments. 
 The standard you’ll work to 
 The look follows the Michael Mann school: realism, competence, restraint. Real light, real materials, a cool and composed temperature. The work observes; it never performs. Status comes from what you leave out. 
 Two tests, every time: 

- The mute test. Paused and silent, does it read as an institution studying reality, or as an ad? We keep the first. 

- The witness test. Does the frame feel witnessed, or designed? Real desk, real page, real street — cropped and graded until the meaning already there becomes visible. 
 And a short list of things we refuse, always: hype, urgency, meme energy, reaction-face editing, the golden “luxury” grade, the swelling score, anything that reads as an advertisement the moment you mute it. A serious idea delivered cheaply becomes a cheap idea. The form has to match the substance. 
 You won’t hold this bar alone — your senior designer reviews the work, and the ideas come from us. But you have to be able to feel the difference between calm-and-alive and calm-and-dead, and fix the second with specificity, not volume. 
 What this role is not 

- Not idea origination. The observations are ours. You make them real. 

- Not the brand’s final gate. You work to the standard; your senior holds it. 

- Not community management. You publish and you listen — you are not the voice in the comments. 

- Not a churn machine. More is better only while the standard holds. 
 What you’ll bring 

- Real output. A body of finished, made work — not decks about work. You ship, and you ship a lot. 

- Command of the fundamentals. Typography, composition, crop, and grade held to a cinematic bar, not a social-template one. 

- AI-native execution. You use AI fluently to move faster across drafting, layout, and variations — while keeping your own judgment over craft and final quality. 

- Restraint. This is the one that matters most. You can make something quiet that still lands. You know what to leave out. 

- Enough literacy to serve the idea. You can lay out a written observation without flattening it, and take direction without needing every decision spelled out. 

- Hunger and speed. You want to make a lot of excellent work and get sharper fast. This role has real room to grow. 
 References that fit our world: Michael Mann, A24, Wieden+Kennedy, Apple, The Economist. If your instinct is “make it pop,” we’re probably not the fit. If your instinct is “make it undeniable and say less,” read on. 
 How to apply 
 Send your portfolio. With it, include one thing: 
 The single piece where you left the most out — and two or three sentences on what you removed, and why. 
 We read that first. It tells us more than a reel does. 
 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short, paid exercise: one observation, turned into finished work.

You will translate customer and developer needs into compelling lifecycle experiences, campaigns, and experiments across email, in-product, content, and emerging channels.

 This role combines product-led growth, lifecycle marketing, and technical audience marketing. You will partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Analytics, Builder Relations, and Data Science to identify growth opportunities, launch programs, and continuously optimize the Voyage AI customer journey—from discovery and onboarding through activation, adoption, and expansion.

 You will be responsible for building measurable growth strategies, segmenting audiences, testing messaging and experiences, and using data to improve performance against key business and product adoption goals. The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on marketer who understands technical audiences, is familiar with the AI and LLM ecosystem, thrives in ambiguity, and can turn customer insights into high-impact programs that accelerate the growth of Voyage AI. You bring strong technical aptitude and can drive initiatives from initial strategy through cross-functional execution.

 This is a highly visible role that requires natural leadership skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and levels. You are adept at thinking strategically and tactically to move work forward in a complex, cross-functional environment.

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Canada for our hybrid working model.

 In particular, you will be:

- Partnering closely with Product to identify opportunities across the customer journey and develop experiences and programs that drive activation, adoption, and continued usage of Voyage AI

- Designing and executing experiments across audiences, messaging, channels, and experiences to continuously optimize performance and identify scalable growth opportunities

- Developing and executing growth strategies and programs in partnership with Growth Marketing and cross-functional teams, from opportunity identification through launch and optimization

- Creating and curating relevant content for driving awareness and adoption, including crafting campaigns that support funnels and lifecycle stages

- Performing strategic product, market, and customer analyses to identify new growth drivers or opportunities for improvement

- Uncovering and leveraging new emerging channels and opportunities to accelerate growth and workload expansion

- Monitoring and analyzing funnel and product adoption KPIs to understand performance, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of growth initiatives

- Working collaboratively with our Product Marketing and Product team to align messaging and understand relevant product launches and moments to roll into each customer program or campaign

 We’re looking for someone with …

- 5+ years of B2D or B2B experience in growth marketing, with a focus on product-led growth and/or feature adoption and lifecycle marketing

- Experience designing and executing cross-sell/up-sell strategies to expand customer adoption across product offerings, leveraging insights and tailored messaging to drive incremental growth

- Deep understanding of marketing to developers or a technical audience

- Working knowledge of the AI and LLM ecosystem, including how developers build AI applications and use models, APIs, and retrieval technologies, with the ability to quickly develop fluency in new technical concepts and products

- Drive to provide the best possible experience to our customers and users

- Understanding of and appreciation for the big picture (market, customers, company) but also the details to successfully scale programs

- Passion to objectively measure your efforts and only make decisions based on data

- A collaborative mindset - you love working with others and incorporating relevant feedback

- An owner mentality - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get them to completion

- Flexibility and adaptability - you enjoy working in ambiguity. You are calm and effective under pressure and able to pivot quickly. You excel at task prioritization and proper evaluation of situational urgency

- Focus and drive - you know what matters and apply yourself with gusto, continuously exploring how much faster you can learn and execute

- Experience or have a working knowledge of product-led growth strategies and KPIs

About the Team

 MongoDB Professional Services serves as the delivery owner for complex customer initiatives, translating strategic goals into disciplined execution and measurable business outcomes across modernization, migration, cloud, data, and AI-related programs. The team drives delivery accountability across customers and internal stakeholders through strong governance, proactive risk management, and sustained alignment to customer priorities.  

 About the Role

 MongoDB is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead complex customer-facing Professional Services engagements and serve as the accountable delivery owner for customer requirements, execution, and business outcomes. The role translates  customer objectives into a clear delivery strategy, aligns  execution to expected outcomes, and drives alignment across scope, schedule, risk, dependencies, stakeholder actions, governance, and success measures.

 The person acts as a consultative partner to the customer’s business.   helping shape priorities, tradeoffs, and decisions while keeping delivery focused on value realization. They must bring strong services delivery leadership, executive communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in technically complex environments with sound judgement. 

 The role partners closely with Consulting Engineers, Customer Success, Sales, and customer stakeholders to maintain momentum, align resources, and deliver measurable value. It also operates at both the engagement and broader account level, including leading regular quarterly business reviews and helping teams reassess priorities when needed.  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Vancouver for our hybrid working model.

 What you will do:

- Lead complex Professional Services engagements from kickoff through closeout, maintaining continuity, accountability, and focus on value realization

- Own delivery accountability for customer requirements, execution, and business outcomes, keeping work aligned to customer priorities

- Drive alignment, planning, and execution using industry-standard delivery practices across scope, schedule, milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and success measures

- Serve as the primary interface to the customer executive sponsor and own financial accountability for overall engagement health

- Shape and structure delivery and scope by clarifying objectives, guiding priorities and tradeoffs, and translating business goals into an executable delivery approach

- Partner closely with customer stakeholders and MongoDB account, services, and technical teams to build alignment, remove blockers, and sustain momentum

- Balance customer outcomes with business objectives, using sound judgment to manage risk, commercial awareness, resource efficiency, and overall engagement health

- Lead governance cadences, including executive reviews and quarterly business reviews, to reassess priorities and keep resources focused on the highest-value work

 What you bring

- 8+ years in a project manager or delivery leader role, with a proven track record of leading projects for enterprise-scale clients in a SaaS product company

- Strong executive communication and leadership skills, with credibility across senior customer stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams

- Strong command of delivery fundamentals, including scope management, milestone planning, dependency management, risk management, executive reporting, and escalations

- Comfort operating in technical environments, paired with strong Professional Services business acumen across delivery economics, resource planning, commercial awareness, and engagement health

- Demonstrated problem-solving ability, strong judgment, and comfort navigating ambiguity, tradeoffs, and complex delivery decisions

- Proven leadership delivering outcomes across cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders, with the ability to influence, align, and drive accountability without direct authority

- Experience leading database, cloud, modernization, or software delivery initiatives

- Familiarity with MongoDB products, services, and common customer transformation journeys

- Familiarity with AI and Agentic application architectures, ecosystem services, and emerging customer use cases

- Practical experience leading the delivery of AI-integrated projects

Rather than focusing on process, you act as the architect of the delivery experience—shaping priorities, navigating complex trade-offs, and ensuring that every milestone is directly tied to the realization of the customer's desired business outcomes..

We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

 MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. 

 This role can be based in Montreal.

 As an ideal candidate, you will have:

- Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software

- Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity

- Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem

- Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology

- Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership

- Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan

- The ability to travel up to 25%

- A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

 You may also have:

- Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers 

- Experience with database programming and data models 

- Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects

- Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks

- Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message

- A MongoDB Certification

- A Cloud Provider Certification

 What you do at MongoDB:

 In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

- Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB

- Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders

- Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)

- Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events

- Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction

- Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members 

- Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

 What you will learn:

 MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

The Role

 AI Builder Experience (ABX) is MongoDB’s front door for the agentic era. We help human developers and coding agents discover, evaluate, and choose MongoDB, and we make MongoDB work naturally inside the AI-native tools, frameworks, and platforms where software is being built.

 We are looking for an outstanding Staff Product Manager to own the Partner Platform: the products, experiences, and operating model that allow ecosystem partners to build trusted, high-quality MongoDB experiences for their users. This includes the Partner API and the broader path toward self-serve integrations, partner onboarding, enterprise controls, marketplace/discovery, and partner-managed experiences.

 This is a role at the intersection of humans, machines, and partners. Human builders increasingly work through AI agents; AI agents need reliable interfaces, context, permissions, and tools; and partners determine where those experiences are discovered and adopted. You will make those three parts work together so MongoDB becomes the obvious database choice wherever AI-native software is created.

 The role is highly cross-functional and highly visible. You will work with engineering, design, IAM, billing, security, documentation, analytics, product marketing, partnerships, field teams, and strategic customers and partners. You will be expected to operate as both a strategic product leader and a hands-on builder who can turn an ambiguous ecosystem opportunity into a clear product vision, strategy, and an executable roadmap.

 What You’ll Do

- Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the MongoDB Partner Platform, starting with the Partner API and evolving toward a scalable, self-serve industry leading partner experience

- Turn partner and customer needs into clear product bets, sequencing near-term delivery against a compelling long-term platform strategy

- Build the next phases of the Partner API, including self-serve onboarding, enterprise and administrator controls, partner-managed account creation and billing, partner discovery, and a high-quality integration bar

- Establish a repeatable operating model for partner intake, design-partner engagement, integration support, launch readiness, documentation, incident response, and post-launch learning

- Partner deeply with the Partner team, IAM, Billing, Security, Engineering, Design, Docs, Analytics, Product Marketing, Sales, and Technical Services to align all towards the cross-functional outcomes required

- Work directly with strategic AI-native partners, cloud platforms, and similar to understand their users, business models, technical constraints, and adoption levers

- Ensure the platform works for both human and agentic developers: APIs and tools must be understandable to people, usable by agents, observable, secure, and resilient under automation

- Define the metrics that show whether the platform is creating value, e.g. partner activation, time to first successful integration, integration quality, end-user adoption, successful agentic workflows, cluster growth, and partner-influenced revenue

- Create clear product narratives and communicate strategy to executives, engineering teams, partners, customers, and field stakeholders

- Represent ABX and MongoDB externally as a credible voice on AI-native product development, developer ecosystems, and partner platforms

 What We’re Looking For

- 8+ years of product management or equivalent experience, including ownership of complex technical products, platforms, APIs, developer tools, ecosystems, or partner integrations

- Demonstrated success taking a product or platform from ambiguous opportunity through launch, adoption, and continued evolution

- Deep technical fluency: you can reason about APIs, authentication and authorization, distributed systems, platform boundaries, integrations, data flows, reliability, and security trade-offs

- Experience building products for developers, technical users, AI-native workflows, or platform ecosystems. Direct experience with AI agents, MCP, agent frameworks, agentic coding tools, or agentic developer platforms is strongly preferred

- A clear point of view on the difference between building for human developers and building for AI agents, including implications for APIs, documentation, tooling, evaluation, observability, and quality

- Strong partner and customer instincts, with experience translating external needs into a product strategy without becoming a collection of one-off feature requests

- Ability to navigate complex and growing organizations, align teams without direct authority, and create momentum when ownership and dependencies are not obvious

- Comfort balancing speed, security, quality, enterprise requirements, and long-term platform health in a fast-moving market

- Strong analytical judgment and the ability to define meaningful outcomes even when the direct revenue line is indirect or still emerging

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you write clear documents, make trade-offs visible, and communicate effectively from engineering working sessions to executive reviews

- Genuine enthusiasm for AI-native development and regular hands-on use of AI tools in your own work

 Nice to Have

- Experience with partner platforms, marketplaces, developer ecosystems, cloud platforms, databases, infrastructure, or enterprise SaaS

- Experience with OAuth, delegated access, API governance, partner billing, provisioning, or multi-tenant product models

- Experience with MongoDB, developer tools, application frameworks, or data infrastructure

 Success Measures

 Within 30 days:

- Develop a deep understanding of the current Partner API, partner pipeline, design-partner experience, dependencies, launch commitments, and known gaps

- Build strong working relationships with engineering, IAM, Billing, Security, Design, Partnerships, Docs, Analytics, Product Marketing, and the adjacent ABX PMs

- Meet key partners and customers and understand the jobs they need the Partner Platform to accomplish for humans, agents, and their businesses

- Produce a concise current-state assessment: what is working, what is fragile, what is one-off, and what must become platform capability

 Within 60 days:

- Evolve the Partner Platform vision and strategy, including clear ownership boundaries with AI Interfaces and AI Frameworks

- Establish a metrics framework connecting partner integration quality and adoption to builder activation, Atlas usage, enterprise confidence, and business impact

- Deliver an aligned roadmap for the next phases of Partner API, partner onboarding, enterprise controls, and partner platform capabilities

- Identify the highest-leverage operating-model changes needed to improve partner speed, quality, and repeatability

 Within 90 days:

- Drive one or more high-impact improvements that materially improve partner onboarding, integration quality, enterprise readiness, or end-user adoption

- Establish a credible plan for scaling from design partners to a broader ecosystem without relying on bespoke MongoDB-side work for every integration

- Be recognized by engineering, design, partnerships, marketing, and field teams as a trusted product leader and effective cross-functional partner

- Present a clear recommendation for the long-term Partner Platform shape, including the investments, sequencing, and trade-offs required to make MongoDB the default database for AI-native builders
