We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. The Staff Product Manager is an Individual Contributor (IC) product leader responsible for a broad platform surface for Atlas Infinite at MongoDB. Atlas Infinite is the largest architectural innovation in MongoDB Atlas ever, purpose-built to handle today's speed and scale of development and demand. 

 In this position, you will own and solve end-to-end problems around the user experience and database experience of Atlas Infinite, including but limited to feature discovery, activation, monetization, and retention. You will see patterns, opportunities, and risks across areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, establish reusable standards for PM craft, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You have deep knowledge of cloud database platforms, distributed data systems, and enterprise product development.

 You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering leaders, product peers, and executive stakeholders to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries, guiding a portfolio spanning Atlas Infinite's disaggregated compute and storage architecture, production workload readiness, migration and Atlas interoperability, and the new customer experiences this architecture may make possible. You will not inherit a closed list of future features: part of your mandate is to discover opportunities we have not yet articulated and challenge assumptions about which problems matter most. With AWS public preview now live, you will help turn real workload evidence into a credible path to GA and subsequent releases, in close partnership with the existing team.

 This role can be based out of a MongoDB office or remotely in Canada.

 Responsibilities

- Interlinked Vision & Multi-Year Bets: Set and champion a product vision across Atlas Infinite's capabilities, while actively discovering opportunities that are not on today's roadmap or fit any single team's remit. Explore what decoupled compute and storage could make possible for developers, enterprises, and emerging AI workloads; use hypotheses, customer evidence, prototypes, and market signals to uncover needs we have not yet named. Branching, on-demand compute, and instant recovery are examples of possible bets. Make the case for investment and prioritization, including build-vs-buy considerations, and distinguish exploratory vision from release commitments

- Cross-Team Execution: Along with program management, own execution health across workstreams, negotiating sequencing, scope, and resource trade-offs with engineering leaders and peer PMs where you have no direct authority. Ensure preview-to-GA readiness, roadmaps, and dependencies across database, storage, Atlas platform, migration, backup, security, and cloud infrastructure teams are aligned and connect to company objectives

- Execution & Research Standards: Establish lightweight operating practices and shared customer/market research frameworks that make workload qualification, customer-representative testing, win/loss analysis, launch readiness, and post-launch learning consistent across the portfolio. Use data to drive decisions without overburdening delivery teams

- Product Health: Resolve complex post-launch escalations when the root cause spans architecture, performance, migration, observability, supportability, or unclear ownership. Turn customer and operational signals into systemic product fixes rather than one-off workarounds

- Customer Discovery: Identify needs and competitive dynamics that cut across product areas. Look beyond requests from today's customers to discover emerging jobs-to-be-done, surprising uses of the architecture, and reasons customers do not choose MongoDB at all. Combine interviews, workload and pricing evidence, product analytics, field feedback, and experiments to test known hypotheses and uncover unknowns; reorient the roadmap when the evidence warrants it

- Outbound & GTM: Partner with product marketing, pricing, sales, solutions architecture, customer success, documentation, and support on high-stakes customer engagements, product positioning, and omni-channel marketing. Establish ideal customer profile; ensure claims and migration guidance match demonstrated capabilities; translate successful adoption and enablement approaches into shared playbooks

- Executive Alignment: Synthesize customer experience, technical readiness, adoption, and commercial impact into clear, confident product stories for senior leadership. Surface cross-area risks and progress early, including trade-offs between new-workload growth, customer savings, and changes to existing Atlas usage

- Mentorship: Mentor PMs across the area, sharing frameworks for cross-team alignment, customer evidence, technical trade-offs, multi-year bets, and leadership communication

 Qualifications

- 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record personally shaping strategy and outcomes for complex technical platforms across multiple teams, rather than only coordinating delivery

- Strong technical fluency in cloud databases, distributed data systems, storage infrastructure, developer experiences, or an adjacent developer platform. Able to reason with engineers about architecture, performance, availability, data movement, and trade-offs without needing to be the system designer

- A demonstrated ability to discover opportunities beyond the current roadmap: connect technical possibilities to unmet customer needs, formulate and test hypotheses, notice surprising patterns, and change direction when evidence challenges the original thesis

- Experience taking a complex product from early adoption toward dependable, broader use while protecting space for longer-term innovation; able to make explicit trade-offs among customer trust, technical readiness, speed, and investment

- Proven ability to influence without authority, negotiating sequencing and resource trade-offs across partner teams with competing priorities

- Commercial and analytical judgment: able to assess workload-level value, adoption and usage evidence, competitive alternatives, pricing and unit economics, and the impact of a new product on an existing portfolio. Comfortable with build-vs-buy questions where relevant

- Ability to raise the quality of customer discovery and product decision-making across teams through useful shared methods and mentorship, without mistaking more process for better outcomes

- Exceptional communication skills: able to explain a technical and commercial thesis, its uncertainties, and the evidence that would change your mind to engineers, customers, executives, and go-to-market partners

 Success Measures

- In 3 months you will have built a shared picture of which workloads Atlas Infinite serves well today, where customers struggle, what must be true for broader adoption, and what remains unknown. You will have clarified ownership with peer PMs and engineering, established baseline measures, and identified the highest-value questions to investigate

- In 6 months you will have influenced consequential roadmap and GA-readiness decisions with customer-representative evidence; articulated a compelling, revisable view of where Infinite can create distinctive customer value beyond GA; and built a learning agenda with clear tests and decision points for both known bets and newly emerging opportunities

- In 12 months the portfolio will show measurable progress against its established baselines for qualified adoption, customer experience, and readiness for broader workloads. Important bets will have advanced, changed, or been stopped for explicit reasons; cross-team investments will have produced customer value; and the team will be better equipped to recognize and act on opportunities that were not visible at the start of the year

You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a book of G2000 business, acting as a strategic partner to C-suite and technical leaders to align MongoDB’s capabilities with their multi-year IT transformations. You’ll build deep relationships with CIO/CTO personas, understand the nuances of complex market challenges, and orchestrate global resources to deliver transformative business value where your customers need it most.

- Proactively identify and mitigate complex consumption risks by combining technical goals with success metrics and advising on sophisticated architectural strategies. Deliver optimal solutions for significant strategic accounts, accelerating time-to-value and guiding customers to achieve high-stakes business goals through their MongoDB roadmap

- Conduct comprehensive customer business reviews for complex accounts, analyzing technical health and operational performance while translating insights into strategic value-based outcomes. Partner with C-suite and technical leaders to align on objectives and champion alignment of joint roadmaps that foster significant database growth

 Account & Portfolio Management

- Lead the cross-functional development of comprehensive account programs, outlining key deliverables and resource allocations that drive customer maturity and global revenue realization. Proactively manage a portfolio of the company’s most significant strategic accounts, developing and executing high-impact strategies to maximize value realization, executive advocacy, and long-term success

- Track and report progress against strategic outcomes, provide high-precision forecasting for high-value portfolios to senior leadership, and identify data patterns to drive growth and support presales expansion

- Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Use AI-driven innovation to scale best practices globally, transform consumption patterns, and create advanced technical solutions for strategic accounts

 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy

- Serve as the strategic voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging insights from complex environments and unique use cases to directly influence the product roadmap and coordinate cross-functional execution

- Connect customers with the right internal resources, including high-level Marketing programs and Executive Sponsor alignment, while leading collaborative learning sessions to ensure MongoDB maximizes value for our most significant accounts

- Orchestrate complex cross-functional initiatives, such as global migrations and modernization factories, by directing dedicated account teams to enable consumption growth

 What You Will Bring

- Relevant Experience: 9 to 12+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product

- Accountability: 6+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization for a defined book of strategic G2000 business

- Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the proven ability to influence technical and business outcomes at the C-suite level without direct authority

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equivalent technical work experience

 About MongoDB

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Regional Sales Director, Equipment Finance, Vendor Sales
A career as a Regional Sales Director, Equipment Finance, Vendor Sales at National Bank is an opportunity to lead a regional Vendor Sales team and execute a business plan focused on growing equipment vendor relationships, expanding vendor-originated financing opportunities, and delivering profitable growth, an exceptional client experience and strong employee engagement.
In this role, you will build strong relationships with employees, equipment vendors, clients and internal partners; establish clear performance expectations; and coach your team to deliver financing solutions through the vendor channel while balancing growth, risk and operational discipline.
Your role:
· Lead regional business development by strengthening and creating relationships with clients, equipment vendors, centres of influence and internal referral partners.
· Develop and implement an annual regional business plan aligned with Equipment Finance and Bank objectives.
· Establish clear sales, profitability, client experience and employee engagement goals, and translate them into individual and team accountabilities.
· Review financial, sales, pipeline and operational performance information; identify trends and take timely action to improve results.
· Coach team members in prospecting, relationship management, opportunity development, negotiation and effective sales execution.
· Promote disciplined pricing and deal structuring, balancing client needs, growth objectives and risk-return expectations within established authorities.
· Partner with Credit, Operations, Risk and other supporting teams to deliver a consistent client experience and efficient execution from origination through funding.
· Recruit, onboard, develop and retain employees, ensuring the regional team has the skills and capabilities required to achieve its objectives.
· Communicate job expectations, conduct regular coaching discussions, recognize strong performance and address performance issues in a timely and constructive manner.
· Create an inclusive, collaborative and accountable team environment that encourages open communication, innovation and sound decision-making.
· Support organizational change, process improvements and initiatives that strengthen regional effectiveness and sustainable growth.
· Manage regional resources and expenses within approved budgets and ensure adherence to Bank policies, conduct expectations, compliance requirements and risk controls.
Your team:
You are part of the Equipment Finance sales leadership team and collaborate closely with colleagues in Credit, Operations, Risk, Commercial Banking, Finance, Human Resources and other specialized groups. You lead a regional team of sales professionals and are accountable for their performance, development and contribution to the regional business plan.
The role requires regular presence in the assigned market and travel across the region to support employees, clients, vendors and business partners.
This role is based in Montreal.
Required skills:
· Bachelor's degree in business, finance, commerce or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
· Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in a Sales Manager or comparable leadership role, with demonstrated accountability for driving bottom-line results.
· Demonstrated experience leading a fast-paced sales team and delivering measurable revenue, profitability and client growth results.
· Strong knowledge of sales planning, pipeline management, performance metrics, financial statements and budget management.
· Knowledge of commercial credit, equipment finance structures, pricing and risk-management practices, with the ability to balance risk and reward.
· Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, employees and internal partners.
· Strong leadership, coaching and talent-development capabilities, including experience setting expectations and managing performance.
· Excellent communication, collaboration, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
· Sound judgment, integrity, discretion and a high degree of accountability.
· Strong planning, prioritization and execution skills, with the ability to make timely decisions in a changing environment.
· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and customer relationship management and sales reporting tools.
· Ability to travel regularly within the assigned region, as business needs require.

A career as a Senior Treasury Manager at National Bank means acting as a trusted treasury advisor and strategic partner to Commercial Banking clients across the West Fraser Valley.
In this role, you leverage your expertise in treasury management, cash flow optimization, deposits, and commercial banking to support complex client relationships, drive business growth, and deliver tailored treasury solutions. Working closely with senior decision-makers, you help businesses optimize working capital, manage liquidity, and improve operational efficiency. Treasury Managers are expected to play a critical role in deposit growth, treasury revenue generation, and client acquisition while partnering closely with Commercial Banking teams.
This position is primarily targeted at the Senior Treasury Manager level; however, we welcome applications from qualified candidates who may be better suited for a Treasury Manager opportunity based on their experience and expertise.
Your job
Develop and manage relationships with commercial clients, acting as a trusted advisor for treasury management and cash flow solutions.
Drive business growth through new client acquisition, relationship expansion, and deposit growth initiatives.
Identify opportunities related to liquidity management, receivables, payables, fraud prevention, and working capital optimization.
Partner with Commercial Banking teams to deliver tailored treasury solutions that meet client needs and strengthen relationships.
Negotiate pricing agreements and contribute to the profitability of client portfolios.
Lead treasury discussions with senior financial decision-makers, including CFOs, Controllers, and Treasurers.
Collaborate with internal partners to achieve regional growth objectives and deliver an exceptional client experience.
Your team
You will join the Treasury Management team within Commercial Banking and report to the Regional Head of Treasury Management, British Columbia. You will work closely with Commercial Banking teams supporting clients across Vancouver and the West Fraser Valley.
Our team stands out through its treasury expertise, collaborative culture, strong market knowledge, and commitment to delivering exceptional value to our clients.
Prerequisites
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
Significant experience in Treasury Management, Cash Management, Commercial Banking, or Corporate Banking.
Strong business development and relationship management experience with commercial clients.
Solid understanding of liquidity management, deposits, receivables, payables, fraud prevention, and treasury solutions.
Ability to understand the impact of interest rate fluctuations on client profitability and deposit strategies.
Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation is considered a strong asset.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

A career as a Senior Legal Counsel in the Legal Affairs sector within the Privacy team at National Bank, means being involved in a variety of initiatives that allow you to learn and excel in files that require knowledge in several fields of law, including privacy, data, artificial intelligence, technology, business agreements, mergers and acquisitions, litigation, employment law, governance and marketing. This role allows you to have a positive impact on our organization through your legal reasoning, business reflexes, curiosity, adaptability, interpersonal skills and analytical skills.
Your role
Act as a Senior Legal Counsel on the Privacy team, providing legal advice on a wide range of topics and initiatives
Provide legal advice and intervene in strategic files that have a significant impact on the activities, operations and results of National Bank of Canada and its subsidiaries
Carry out analyses and research, issue legal opinions and make recommendations to ensure the development and protection of National Bank of Canada and its subsidiaries
Understand the impact of regulatory requirements on the activities of National Bank of Canada and its subsidiaries
Improve internal processes and increase institutional knowledge
Analyze, interpret and review various reports and legal documents to protect the rights of National Bank of Canada
Participate in committees or special projects and represent National Bank of Canada with various external organizations
Your team
Within the Legal Affairs sector, you are part of a multidisciplinary team of several colleagues and report to the Senior Manager of the Privacy team. Our team offers training, support and development opportunities in emerging fields of practice. This is a unique chance to join our team!
Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility in your work to promote your quality of life. This includes hybrid work in the office and remotely, working hours to reconcile work and personal life, and flexible leave at times that matter.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.
Prerequisites
Bachelor's degree in law and 2 to 5 years of relevant experience
Member of the Quebec Bar or the Chambre des notaires du Québec
Experience in one of the following fields of law: Privacy, data, artificial intelligence, commercial agreements, litigation and employment law or governance
Desire and ability to learn and contribute in several fields of law
Sound judgement and business acumen
Ability to manage priorities and a large volume of files
Languages:
English, French

As an Account Executive in the Vendor Sales team at National Bank Equipment Finance, you’ll achieve sales targets by prospecting, developing and enhancing relationships with vendors and clients within Canada's Commercial Equipment and Agriculture markets. With your extensive relationships in the Canadian market and your extensive knowledge of the vehicles and machinery that drive these industries forward, you’ll have a positive impact on vendor and client experience.
Your role :
Prospect and develop relationships with new equipment vendors
Enhance relationships with existing vendor partners
Ensure timely response to financing opportunities
Build and present supportive credit packages for adjudication
Represent National Bank Equipment Finance at various industry events and trade shows
Your team:
As part of the Equipment Finance sector, you’ll be on a team of seven colleagues and you’ll report to the Regional Sales Director. Our local team stands out for our personalized service, attention to detail and expert advice. You'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the highest level of service while balancing portfolio growth, profitability and risk management. You'll bring the best of National Bank, collaborating with local teams to introduce vendor partners to the NBC products and services that meet their needs.
Training & Development:
We offer a wide range of ongoing learning opportunities for your development, including hands-on learning, training courses and collaborating with colleagues who have varied expertise and profiles.
Prerequisites :
Minimum five years' experience in heavy equipment, agriculture or transportation sales or finance, or equivalent
Valid Class 5 driver's licence
Available for travel minimum two days per week
Proficiency in English language (written and oral)
Proficiency in French language (written and oral) is an asset

Joining National Bank means working with a team of specialists who support innovative companies at every stage of their growth journey. As a Senior Treasury Manager within Commercial Banking, you will play a strategic role in helping organizations operating in the Creative Media & Technology sector optimize their cash flow, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate growth through tailored treasury management solutions.
You will act as a trusted advisor to a diverse client base that may include software and SaaS companies, gaming studios, digital media organizations, film and television production companies, telecommunications firms, advertising technology businesses, fintechs, and other innovation-driven enterprises.
Based in Vancouver, you will play a strategic role in expanding the Bank's presence within British Columbia's Creative Media & Technology ecosystem. You will partner with some of Western Canada's most innovative organizations, helping them optimize cash flow operations and support their growth ambitions through tailored treasury management solutions.
Your expertise in treasury management, payments, liquidity optimization, and transaction banking will enable you to develop long-term client relationships while contributing directly to the Bank's growth objectives.
Your job
Build lasting relationships with companies operating in the Creative Media & Technology sector by becoming their trusted advisor for treasury management solutions.
Serve as the treasury management expert supporting Relationship Managers and clients while identifying opportunities to deepen relationships and drive growth.
Design and deliver customized cash management, payments, liquidity, and transaction banking solutions aligned with clients’ strategic and operational objectives.
Influence financial leaders including CFOs, Treasurers, Founders, and Executive Teams by understanding their business models, challenges, and growth ambitions.
Drive portfolio growth through deposit acquisition, treasury revenue generation, and new business development while ensuring strong risk management and regulatory compliance.
Your team
You are part of a highly specialized Commercial Banking team serving some of Canada's most innovative companies. This collaborative environment brings together Relationship Managers, Treasury Specialists, Payments Experts, Industry Leaders, and Product Partners who work together to provide clients with comprehensive banking solutions.
Your role will position you as a key contributor to the Bank's growth within one of the fastest-growing sectors of the Canadian economy.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Several years of experience in Treasury Management, Cash Management, Commercial Banking, Payments, Transaction Banking, or Business Development.
Strong understanding of treasury management solutions, payment systems, liquidity management, receivables, payables, and commercial deposit products.
Proven ability to build relationships with senior financial decision-makers.
Strong business development and sales acumen.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

English

A career as a Senior Talent Acquisition Advisor at National Bank means pursuing your ambitions by improving the lives of candidates, managers, your colleagues and your colleagues. Define and implement strategies to identify and attract talent
Anticipate problems and recommend action plans accordingly

The Talent Acquisition team is based in downtown Montreal and focuses on strategic recruitment across Canada. The team is made up of around 40 passionate recruiters.
Our team values everyone's passions and bold ideas. We know that we can count on our colleagues to promote knowledge sharing and mutual support. Access to colleagues with diverse expertise, experience and profiles will enrich your development from every point of view.

Bachelor’s degree completed with 7 to 10 years of relevant experience
Proven experience in advisory roles with management in large companies
Strong interpersonal skills: Demonstrated leadership, ability to influence and negotiate, rigour, creativity and innovation skills
Ability to work in synergy with the team and partners
Ability to question the status quo

English, French

A career as a Paralegal within the Personal Banking and Intellectual Property Legal Affairs Team at National Bank means contributing to the implementation of regulatory projects and initiatives, as well as the legal administration of the Bank’s intellectual property assets. In this role, you will make a tangible impact by leveraging your experience in document management, legal research, and operational coordination.
Your job
Administer the Bank’s trademark portfolio, including abandonments, renewals, preliminary trademark searches, and the management of relationships with external counsel and regulatory authorities
Maintain and update the Bank’s patent and trade secret portfolio
Support regulatory projects by conducting preliminary research, documenting identified gaps, and coordinating follow-up activities
Provide support in the establishment and coordination of various internal and external committees within the sector
Conduct legal and case law research
Identify opportunities for automation and the implementation of new tools for the team, and formulate recommendations accordingly
Ensure structured knowledge management, documentation management, tool tracking, and ongoing coordination for the team
Support the standardization of documentation, filing, and follow-up practices
Your Team
As part of the Personal Banking and Intellectual Property Team, you will join a multidisciplinary team that makes a meaningful and positive impact on clients by protecting and enhancing National Bank’s assets. Reporting to the Senior Director, Projects, you will work closely with the entire team on a broad range of high-impact matters.
We strive to offer maximum flexibility to support your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible schedule designed to adapt to your needs. National Bank is committed to continuous development and internal mobility. Through our personalized learning programs, built around experiential learning, you will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise and expand your skill set. Resources such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, as well as coaching and mentoring programs, are available to you at all times.
Prerequisites
College diploma (DEC) in Paralegal Technology, Legal Studies, or an equivalent qualification
Relevant experience in legal support, document management, legal research, intellectual property, or a regulatory environment
Strong attention to detail, autonomy, and organizational skills
Ability to work collaboratively with legal professionals, internal partners, and external law firms
Proficiency with documentation, collaboration, and tracking tools
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to collaborate with a regulator/authority/government body outside Quebec.

A career on the Agriculture team with Commercial Banking specialized groups at National Bank means supporting agribusiness clients in your region with all their financial projects.
As an Account Manager, Agriculture you will manage a portfolio of clients. You will provide client support, establish lasting business relationships with the agribusiness community, and oversee business development for your region.
Your job:
• Implement business development strategies to ensure sustained growth for your sector.
• Perform in-depth analyses of your portfolio in order to identify opportunities for advisory offers adapted to clients’ changing needs.
• Establish trust-based relationships with colleagues and collaborate with your team to meet the company’s needs as well as the personal needs of agribusiness clients.
• Negotiate the terms and conditions of agreements with clients while maximizing the desired profitability components.
• Understand the general issues specific to the various production sectors.
• Participate in targeted visibility activities to generate contacts and develop your network.
• Maintain the quality of the loan and deposit portfolio.
Your team:
Working in the Commercial Banking and Private Banking 1859 sector, you will join a team of professionals specialized in the agriculture industry. You will also be surrounded by an ecosystem of experts to help you offer the solutions that best suit our clients’ needs.
You report to the agricultural vice-president and manage a customer portfolio located between Strathroy, London, Clinton and Listowel. Our training programs use on-the-job learning to help you master your role. You’ll also have access to colleagues with a wide range of expertise, experience, and backgrounds to enrich all aspects of your development.
Pre-requisites:
• University certificate OR bachelor’s degree in a related field OR master's degree in a related field combined with relevant experience
• Relevant experience in the field of agriculture
• Experience in business development and client portfolio management
• Credit and banking industry experience, an asset

A career as a Senior Financial Planning Advisor in the Support team at National Bank means acting as a specialist in coaching, guidance, and professional support for advisors and financial planners to promote excellence in financial planning practices.
This role allows you to have a positive impact on our organization through your expertise, your mastery of specialized planning tools such as Conquest Planning, and your experience in wealth management.
Your role
Support, coach, and guide advisors and financial planners in the effective use of current and future financial planning tools, including Conquest Planning.
Develop, optimize, and maintain financial planning processes, methodologies, and tools to enhance advisor effectiveness and client outcomes.
Collaborate with investment advisors and financial planners to promote industry best practices and high professional standards.
Participate in financial planning supervision and compliance activities, including reviewing client files and providing recommendations for improvement.
Support the team responsible for the preparation and delivery of retirement planning reports and retirement plans.
Review, update, and enhance client-facing and advisor-facing guidance materials, tools, and educational resources.
Your team
The Community Advisory Vice-Presidency consists of specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay at the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.
Within the Financial Planning Support sector, you are part of a team of professionals and report to the Senior Director, Community Advisory.
Our team stands out through its advisory and coaching role for Financial Security National Bank advisors and financial planners, its deep expertise in financial planning, its support for compliance activities, and its commitment to industry best practices.
We aim to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning through action, allow you to master your role and develop new areas of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at all times.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Financial Planning, Wealth Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in financial planning, wealth management, or a closely related advisory environment.
Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or Financial Planner (Pl. Fin.) designation.
Advanced knowledge of financial planning software, particularly Conquest Planning.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
Extensive knowledge of financial planning methodologies, wealth management strategies, and industry best practices.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.

Identify and develop business opportunities in your market, increase your commercial client base, and establish business development strategies
Help your clients attain their business objectives by proposing financial strategies based on the most suitable combination of Bank products and services

Our learning-by-doing training programs enable you to master your job. Access to colleagues with different expertise, experience and profiles will enrich your development in every way.

Based on your academic background, at least 4 to 8 years' experience in sales and business development within the financial industry:
University certificate and 8 years' experience
Bachelor's degree and 6 years' experience
Master's degree and 4 years' experience
Experience in sales and business development

Experience in commercial credit

A career as a Senior Account Manager in the Real Estate Finance team of the Commercial & Private Banking 1859 sector at the National Bank means supporting the best players in the real estate sector both in their interim construction projects and in their long-term financing needs. This job allows you to have a positive impact on our clients and our organization by combining your experience with large-value real estate banking transactions and your passion for business development.
Your job:
Identify and develop business opportunities in your market, increase your commercial client base, and establish business development strategies
Help your clients attain their business objectives by proposing financial strategies based on the most suitable combination of Bank products and services
Meet clients' changing needs by adapting and optimizing financial products and sales approaches
Negotiate the terms and conditions of agreements with clients, while making sure that they meet risk management standards and profitability criteria
Create and execute sales and business development plans in collaboration with the Real Estate Financing Group’s annual goals;
Manage, develop and maintain an existing portfolio including, but not limited to, credit underwriting and analysis of annual reviews, writing of new business, and exhibiting strong risk management skills;
Work in collaboration with the all the team across Canada, to reach our objectives of increased revenues and continuous improvement.
Identify the risks inherent to the sector activities.
Your team:
Within the Commercial & Private Banking 1859 sector you are part of a large team of 80 colleagues based across Canada and you report to the Director, Commercial Real Estate Financing. Our team stands out for our expertise, our speed to market and our entrepreneurial spirit. This position offers a hybrid work mode; you organize your weeks between the office, home and meetings with customers.
Basic requirements :
Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in a related field
Minimum of 5 years of real estate financing experience
Business development and negotiation experience
Knowledge of banking products and services for real estate businesses
Strong interpersonal and writing skills
Experience in commercial credit underwriting and evidence of strong business and financial analytical skills
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to serve clients who speak a language other than French regularly.

Building a career within the Corporate Financing Structuring team offers the opportunity to work on complex, large‑scale financing transactions across Canada, within the Enterprise segment (Business Banking and National Accounts Group). You will support a commercial and large corporate client base facing financial or business performance challenges.
As a Senior Account Manager, Corporate Financing Structuring, and in close collaboration with your colleagues, you will play a key role in the strategic support of companies nationwide. The diversity and complexity of your mandates will enable you to quickly become a trusted advisor, both for clients and for colleagues within the Enterprise sector.
Your Role
Act as a trusted advisor aligned with client needs by leveraging advanced expertise in corporate credit and extensive professional experience (primarily Type 1 Credit; solid experience in Type 2 Credit is considered an asset)
Support the achievement of client business objectives by proposing financial strategies based on an optimal mix of financing solutions tailored to each situation
Support Account Managers and Senior Account Managers in the management of financing files
Identify financial risks for the Bank related to financing transactions and make recommendations to mitigate or eliminate them
Participate in the structuring and renewal of credit files, including financial analysis and the design of corporate financing structures
In certain cases, in collaboration with the Account Manager, participate in client meetings that may require business travel across Canada
Take part in negotiations with internal stakeholders (Legal, Credit, Syndication, etc.) and external stakeholders (legal advisors, other financial institutions, financial investors, institutional lenders, etc.)
Use credit risk and profitability assessment tools while ensuring compliance with financing policies, standards, and risk management frameworks
Your Team
Within the Corporate Financing Structuring team, you will be part of a broad group of expert colleagues and will report directly to the Vice President and Managing Director. Established in 2024, the team stands out for its strong expertise in structuring complex and higher‑risk credit solutions for the Bank.
Our collaborative work environment promotes hands‑on learning, allowing you to quickly develop mastery of your role while benefiting from the support of your peers. Access to colleagues with diverse expertise, backgrounds, and experiences will enrich your professional development from every angle. An extensive external network further enhances your professional profile, including interactions with accountants, lawyers, external partners, and bilateral lenders.
Hybrid work arrangements apply in accordance with the Bank’s guidelines.
Prerequisites :
Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 7 years of relevant experience, OR Master’s degree in a related field with 5 years of relevant experience
Experience in complex commercial credit; strong knowledge of business banking products and services
Proficiency with internal decision‑making tools: WRR, BRR, FRR, RAROC, and experience with Unisson
Experience analyzing sophisticated financial models
Experience in client service, negotiation, and business development
Strong ability to manage priorities and deadlines
Excellent interpersonal skills and strong team player
Knowledge of capital markets debt instruments (asset)
Experience with Type 2 credit financing and syndicated financings (asset)
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to collaborate with a regulator/authority/government body outside Quebec.

A career as an SME Account Manager within the Commercial Banking & Private Banking 1859 team means serving as a trusted advisor to small and medium-sized businesses as well as agricultural producers in your market. Surrounded by a network of experts, you will support your clients in their growth, succession, investment, and financing projects by delivering solutions tailored to their unique business realities.
Your Job :
Develop and manage a portfolio of commercial and agricultural businesses.
Achieve business development objectives by proposing solutions tailored to your clients' financial, operational, and strategic needs.
Support entrepreneurs and agricultural producers in their growth, acquisition, investment, succession, and business transfer projects.
Identify referral opportunities and foster cross-functional collaboration across the Bank.
Conduct financial analyses and structure financing solutions adapted to the realities of various industries, including agriculture.
Negotiate financing terms and conditions while ensuring portfolio quality and profitability.
Ensure compliance with service standards, regulatory requirements, and risk management practices.
Identify business opportunities within your market for the full range of the Bank's products and services.
Develop an in-depth understanding of the regional agricultural ecosystem and the unique challenges faced by agricultural producers and agri-food businesses.
Actively participate in visibility initiatives, networking activities, and regional business and agricultural events.
Identify and manage risks inherent to the sectors you serve.
Your Team:
Within the Commercial Banking & Private Banking 1859 sector, you will be part of a team of professionals serving a diverse client base that includes commercial businesses, agricultural producers, and agri-food companies. You will collaborate with a broad network of experts in financing, agriculture, wealth management, and specialized services to deliver a distinctive advisory experience for your clients.
Reporting to the Regional Vice-President, this position is based in Fredericton, New Brunswick.
Our learning-by-doing training programs will enable you to develop strong expertise in both commercial banking and the agricultural sector, a key economic driver in the region. You will benefit from access to experienced colleagues and specialists who will support your ongoing professional development and career growth.
Prerequisites :
Experience in business development with commercial clients; experience in or an interest in the agricultural sector is considered a significant asset.
Strong understanding of the financial, operational, and economic challenges facing SMEs and agricultural businesses.
Established network within the local business community; relationships within the agricultural or agri-food ecosystem would be considered an advantage.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.

A career as a Senior Account Manager, Commercial Banking at National Bank means being responsible for growing the portfolio of business clients assigned to you. Your complex and varied duties will help you rapidly become the go-to resource person to your clients for their financial projects.
Your role:
Identify and develop business opportunities in your market, increase your commercial client base, and establish business development strategies
Help your clients attain their business objectives by proposing financial strategies based on the most suitable combination of Bank products and services
Meet clients' changing needs by adapting and optimizing financial products and advice/approaches
Negotiate the terms and conditions of agreements with clients, while making sure that they meet risk management standards and profitability criteria
Draw up business development plans
Assist the Regional Vice-President in reaching objectives
Work with the Manager – Financing Solutions
Actively participate to various networking activities (cocktails, conferences, etc.)
Work in synergie with all the other departments of the Bank

Working in the Commercial Banking and Private Banking 1859 sector, you will join a team of professionals that supports business clients. You will also be surrounded by an ecosystem of specialists, like financing solutions managers, who will help you offer the solutions that best suit our clients’ needs.
Reporting to Associate Vice-President & Market Lead, you will manage a portfolio of clients covering the Tri-Cities region.
Our training programs use on-the-job learning to help you master your role. You can access personalized training content on such topics as banking solutions and the advisory approach to support your ongoing learning. You’ll also have access to colleagues with a wide range of expertise, experience, and backgrounds to enrich all aspects of your development.

Based on your academic background, at least 5 to 9 years' experience in sales and business development within the financial industry:
University certificate and 9 years' experience
Bachelor's degree and 7 years' experience
Master's degree and 5 years' experience
Experience in sales and business development
Experience in analysis of financial statements
Experience in commercial credit
Network of professional contacts among local medium-sized enterprises and large companies, an asset

As a Senior Analyst in the Analysis and Financial Reporting team at National Bank, you’ll be acting as an accounting expert in the preparation of consolidated financial reports disclosed externally and internally as well as in the financial analysis of consolidated results. This position is an opportunity to gain an overview of the bank's activities and to create relationships with colleagues from several sectors.
Your role:
Participate in the production of reports to shareholders, the annual report, as well as the production of supplementary financial information and supplementary regulatory capital and Pillar 3 disclosure.
Participate in the financial analysis of the bank's consolidated results on a monthly basis.
Develop ad-hoc analyses at the request of management and/or internal and external auditors.
Produce regulatory reports for Canadian or foreign authorities while ensuring compliance with established deadlines.
Collaborate with accounting teams to prepare financial data.
Gain a comprehensive understanding of the Bank's business lines and subsidiaries.
Establish partnerships with stakeholders from multiple teams within the Bank (performance management, risk management, capital management, investor relations, etc.).
Improving processes and evolving our tools.
Your team:
As part of the Analysis and Financial Reporting team, you’ll be on a team of 10 of colleagues and you’ll report to the Senior Director. This is a dynamic team that likes to take on challenges and in which team spirit and collaboration are important values.
Our training programs based on learning in action allow you to master your craft. Customized training content on topics such as IFRS and the systems used is available to support your continuous learning. Access to colleagues with different expertise, experiences and diverse profiles enriches your development from all points of view.
Prerequisites:
Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field and 3 to 4 years of relevant experience
Advanced proficiency in Excel
Strong analytical skills
Be rigorous, autonomous and efficient
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to change
Ability to work under pressure and manage stress well

Meet business development objectives by proposing solutions tailored to all of your clients' needs;
Seize referral opportunities in a context of synergy across the Bank;

Negotiate the terms and conditions of products with clients, ensuring that they meet the desired profitability criteria;
Ensure the application of service quality standards, as well as compliance with compliance and risk management rules;

University certificate and 7 years of experience;
Bachelor's degree and 5 years of experience;
Master's degree and 3 years of experience;
Experience in business development;
Knowledge of financial statement analysis;
Established professional network of contacts with local small and medium-sized businesses;
Negotiation skills;

A career as a Senior Account Manager, Commercial Banking at National Bank means being responsible for growing the portfolio of business clients assigned to you. Your complex and varied duties will help you rapidly become the go-to resource person to your clients for their financial projects.
This position is based in Calgary
Your role:
Identify and develop business opportunities in your market, increase your commercial client base, and establish business development strategies
Help your clients attain their business objectives by proposing financial strategies based on the most suitable combination of Bank products and services
Meet clients' changing needs by adapting and optimizing financial products and advice/approaches
Negotiate the terms and conditions of agreements with clients, while making sure that they meet risk management standards and profitability criteria
Draw up business development plans
Assist the Regional Vice-President in reaching objectives
Work with the Manager – Financing Solutions
Actively participate to various networking activities (cocktails, conferences, etc.)
Work in synergy with all the other departments of the Bank

Working in the Commercial Banking and Private Banking 1859 sector, you will join a team of professionals that supports business clients. You will also be surrounded by an ecosystem of specialists, like financing solutions managers, who will help you offer the solutions that best suit our clients’ needs.
Reporting to the Associate Vice President, you will manage a portfolio of clients in Calgary.
Our training programs use on-the-job learning to help you master your role. You can access personalized training content on such topics as banking solutions and the advisory approach to support your ongoing learning. You’ll also have access to colleagues with a wide range of expertise, experience, and backgrounds to enrich all aspects of your development.
Prerequisites:
Based on your academic background, at least 5 to 9 years' experience in sales and business development within the financial industry:
University certificate and 9 years' experience
Bachelor's degree and 7 years' experience
Master's degree and 5 years' experience
Experience in sales and business development
Experience in analysis of financial statements
Experience in commercial credit

As a Senior Analyst in the Trust services team at National Bank Trust (NBT), you’ll be a tax expert working on estate and trust files. In this role, you’ll have a positive impact on the organization by leveraging your expertise as you handle complex files and demonstrate your commitment to providing an exemplary client experience. Your engagement, management of deadlines and desire to help optimize the team’s working methods will set you apart.
Your role
Search for, obtain and analyze tax slips to produce T3 and TP646 annual tax returns for estate files
Monitor book values of investments held by estates including the calculation of reinvested income, dividends, interest, foreign income, purchases, sales, capital gains and losses, foreign tax, return of capital and fees
Make accounting entries, produce and cash cheques, send returns and monitor their processing by communicating with government tax authorities
Perform reconciliation (financial statements or distributions) for estate files and incapacity files (tutorship, curatorship and protection mandate)
Support and take charge of certain estate settlement files (end-to-end process for files, i.e., obtaining assets, inventory of assets, taxes at death and distribution)
Support the production of T1 tax returns for individual clients (incapacity files managed by NBT)
Take charge of various initiatives and projects within the sector related to your area of expertise
Your team
In the National Bank Trust, trust services sector, you’ll be part of a team of six colleagues reporting to the director, trust services – estate settlement. Our team stands out for its expertise in tax and offering an exemplary client experience. We offer the possibility of working in hybrid mode so you can better manage your work-life balance.
Our training programs use on-the-job learning to help you master your role. You can access personalized training content on such topics as estate files and how to handle tax requests related to estate files to support your ongoing learning. You’ll also have access to colleagues with a wide range of expertise, experience and backgrounds to enrich all aspects of your development.
Prerequisites
Bachelor’s degree in accounting or any other relevant filed and three years of relevant experience
Experience in individual, estate, and trust taxation
Ability to provide advice to our stakeholders
Ability to quickly grasp complex problems and handle information from a variety of sources
Proficient Microsoft Office user, in particular Excel
Proficiency with TAXPREP software (trusts and personal)

At National Bank, a career on our Agriculture team means partnering with agribusiness clients who are helping shape the future of Atlantic Canada and the Canadian economy. As a Senior Account Manager, Agriculture, you will serve as a trusted advisor to farmers, producers, and agricultural businesses across the region, helping them achieve their ambitions through tailored financial solutions while growing a strong and profitable portfolio.
In this role, you will combine your passion for agriculture, business development expertise, and relationship-building skills to support clients through every stage of their growth journey. Backed by a collaborative team of industry specialists and banking experts, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in Nova Scotia and across Atlantic Canada while building your career with one of the country's leading financial institutions.
This position can be based anywhere in Nova Scotia**
Your role:
Develop and execute business development strategies to drive sustainable growth across your assigned territory.
Build and manage a portfolio of agricultural clients by delivering proactive advice and tailored financing solutions.
Analyze client portfolios to identify opportunities and anticipate evolving financing, cash management, and investment needs.
Establish strong relationships within the agricultural community and become a trusted advisor to clients and industry stakeholders.
Collaborate with internal partners and specialists to provide comprehensive solutions that support client success.
Structure and negotiate financing arrangements while balancing client needs, risk considerations, and profitability objectives.
Maintain a strong understanding of agricultural production sectors, market dynamics, and emerging industry trends.
Represent National Bank at industry events, trade shows, associations, and networking activities throughout Atlantic Canada.
Ensure the overall quality, growth, and profitability of the loan and deposit portfolio through sound risk management practices.
Your team:
You will join National Bank's Commercial Banking and Private Banking 1859 sector, within a team dedicated to supporting the growth and success of agricultural businesses across Atlantic Canada.
Based in Halifax, you will work closely with colleagues and specialized partners throughout the region to serve clients across Nova Scotia and other Atlantic provinces. You'll be supported by a network of experts in credit, cash management, investments, risk management, and wealth planning, enabling you to provide comprehensive advice and customized solutions.
Reporting to the Senior Director & Team Lead, Atlantic Canada, you will play a key role in strengthening National Bank's presence in the region's agricultural sector and helping clients achieve their long-term business goals.
At National Bank, we invest in your development through coaching, mentoring, ongoing learning opportunities, and exposure to experienced professionals from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise.
Required qualifications :
Bachelor's degree, university certificate, or master's degree in a related field, combined with relevant experience.
Significant experience within the agriculture industry.
Proven success in business development, relationship management, and portfolio growth.
Strong understanding of agricultural operations and production sectors.
Ability to establish credibility and maintain long-term client relationships.
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Willingness to travel throughout Atlantic Canada to meet clients and support business development activities.

English

A career as a Senior Analyst in the Capital Markets Accounting – Disclosure and Financial Performance team at National Bank means acting as an accounting specialist for the disclosure of results and balance sheet information for a growing sector. This role allows you to have a positive impact on our organization through your accounting, control, reconciliation, and disclosure skills.
Your role:
Develop and implement control mechanisms for accounting, tax, or financial operations to ensure the quality and integrity of the sector’s financial information and that of certain legal entities
Identify, reconcile, and explain variances and irregularities, and ensure that corrective actions are taken where required as part of the month-end accounting close process
Participate in the implementation of new activities, policies, standards, and procedures related to your business sector, and establish the appropriate analyses and controls
Identify issues, contribute to the development of tailored solutions, and ensure their proper implementation in collaboration with your colleagues to support the execution of activities while considering the diversity of files
Produce financial management reports on the balance sheet and results of the Capital Markets business lines
Participate in the quarterly and annual disclosure processes for the Financial Markets sector in the Bank’s consolidated results.
With a continuous improvement mindset, help enhance our performance tools across various platforms such as Excel, Power Query, SAP, etc
Act as a resource person for any questions related to your responsibilities.
Your team:
Within the Capital Markets Accounting – Disclosure and Financial Performance team, you will be part of a team of 13 colleagues and report to the Senior Director. We work closely with various teams under the Vice-President, Capital Markets and Subsidiaries Accounting, as well as with multiple other teams within Finance, including consolidation, tax, accounting systems, and others, and within the Capital Markets sector. Our team stands out for its expertise in disclosure, including statutory, regulatory, and management disclosure.
Our action-based learning programs help you master your profession. Customized training content on topics such as financial instruments, IFRS standards, and the systems used is available to support your ongoing learning. Access to colleagues with diverse expertise, experience, and backgrounds will enrich your development from every perspective.
Prerequisites:

Bachelor’s degree with a specialization in accounting and 3–5 years of relevant experience
CPA designation required
Advanced knowledge of Excel
Familiarity with artificial intelligence concepts and their use in a professional environment
Strong attention to detail with effective analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

As an Account Manager in the NBC Franchise Finance team at National Bank, you’ll be a trusted financing partner to hotel and restaurant owners across Quebec. With your business development expertise, financial acumen, and deep knowledge of the hospitality and real estate sectors, you’ll have a direct impact on client growth, portfolio quality, and the Bank’s profitability. Your ability to structure tailored financing solutions, build long-term relationships, and collaborate across teams will help strengthen National Bank’s leadership in franchise and hospitality finance.
Your role
Source, structure, and negotiate financing transactions with hotel and restaurant owners in Quebec.
Achieve annual origination, profitability, and fee income objectives aligned with business plans.
Analyze financial statements, operating performance, and industry trends to recommend credit decisions.
Prepare and present financing proposals and pricing strategies to clients and prospects.
Develop and execute targeted business development and networking initiatives.
Support the underwriting, renewal, and management of select high-profile Quebec-based house accounts.
Your team
As part of NBC Franchise Finance , you’ll join a specialized national team focused on financing solutions for hotel and restaurant operators. You’ll report to an AVP, Franchise Finance , and work closely with Credit Analysts, Structuring Managers, Portfolio Managers, Documentation Specialists, and Treasury partners. The team is recognized for its deep industry expertise, disciplined credit approach, and strong client relationships across Canada.
Our team values collaboration, accountability, and knowledge sharing. We work in a fast-paced, relationship-driven environment where professionalism and trust are essential. Standard business hours apply, with flexibility required to attend client meetings, industry events, and conferences as needed.
At National Bank, your professional growth is a priority. You’ll benefit from ongoing, hands-on learning through complex transactions, exposure to senior clients, and collaboration with colleagues who bring diverse expertise in credit, risk, treasury, and hospitality finance. You’ll also have access to structured training programs that deepen your technical, financial, and leadership capabilities.
In this role, you’ll have opportunities to expand your portfolio responsibility, strengthen your strategic advisory skills, and progress within NBC Franchise Finance or other specialized commercial banking teams. Career development is supported through regular goal setting, feedback, and tailored learning paths aligned with your ambitions.
Prerequisites
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, commerce, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in business development or sales within financial services, hospitality, or commercial real estate.
Minimum 3 years of experience in financial analysis, underwriting, or advisory roles in the hotel, restaurant, or commercial real estate sectors.
Strong knowledge of Quebec’s hotel and restaurant markets and business owners.
Strong communication skills in French required.
Proven ability to achieve sales objectives and perform in a target-driven environment.
Availability for travel and participation in industry events within Quebec, and nationally if required.

A career as a Treasury Manager at National Bank means acting as a treasury product specialist and trusted advisor for Commercial Banking clients.
With your business development experience, the quality of your client service, and your knowledge of the Commercial Banking sector, you will have a direct impact on client acquisition, relationship growth, profitability, and the overall client experience.
We currently have an opportunity available Regina.
Your job
Build strong relationships with commercial clients and prospects while delivering an exceptional client experience.
Identify and develop opportunities to grow deposits, treasury revenue, and client acquisition.
Recommend treasury management solutions including receivables, payables, liquidity management, reporting, and fraud prevention services.
Partner with Account Managers and Commercial Banking teams to deepen client relationships and support business growth.
Negotiate and review pricing agreements while ensuring client profitability and satisfaction.
Analyze client needs and provide tailored treasury recommendations that improve operational efficiency.
Collaborate with internal partners to deliver comprehensive banking solutions and achieve regional objectives.
Your team
You will work on the Treasury Management team within Commercial Banking and report to the Regional Head of Treasury Management.
You will partner closely with Commercial Banking teams within your assigned market to support client growth and business development opportunities.
Our team is recognized for its collaboration, treasury expertise, strong market knowledge, and commitment to delivering an exceptional client experience.
Prerequisites
Bachelor’s degree in a related business field.
Experience in Commercial Banking, Cash Management, Treasury Management, Business Banking, or a related field.
Strong relationship management and business development skills.
Knowledge of treasury products and commercial banking services.
Ability to understand the impact of interest rate changes on client profitability and deposit strategies.
Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation is considered an asset.
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

A career as a Senior Legal Counsel on the Data Governance Framework and Strategy team at National Bank means acting as a data governance specialist and contributing to the development, evolution and dissemination of applicable frameworks. You play a key role in aligning the data governance strategy and framework with regulatory requirements and best practises, particularly in terms of data management, quality, retention and destruction, as well as compliance and risk management.
Your job
Create, maintain and develop the data governance strategy, policies, standards and procedures.
Ensure data governance frameworks are consistent with risk management, privacy, information security and responsible artificial intelligence practises.
Monitor regulations and translate the new requirements into concrete and applicable orientations for the teams concerned.
Advise internal partners and support the interpretation of regulatory obligations related to data management, quality and retention/destruction.
Help prepare follow-ups, communications and responses for regulatory bodies.
Participate in governance committees and forums in collaboration with the legal, Compliance, risk, Privacy and second line of defence teams.
Your team
The Vice-President, Protection of Personal Information, Data Governance and responsible AI, has more than 55 specialists who work agile, proactive and collaborative to seize opportunities, stay abreast of technological developments and continuously improve processes.
You report to the Senior Manager in the Data Governance sector. Our team stands out for its strategic role, multidisciplinary collaboration and its influence on governance practises across the organisation.
Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible and adaptable schedule.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.
Prerequisites
University education in law, compliance or a related field (being a member of the Bar is an asset)
Significant experience in a regulated environment, particularly in governance, compliance, risk management or the protection of personal information.
Have a good understanding of data governance principles, frameworks and practises.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of regulatory requirements applicable to data management, quality and risk.
Be able to interpret and explain regulatory requirements into concrete orientations for business partners.
Comfortable evolving in a cross-sector and complex context.
Languages:
English, French
Reason to require this language: you will need to collaborate with a regulator/authority/government body outside Quebec.

A career as a Business Development Manager in the Equipment Financing team at National Bank means acting as a trusted financing partner for businesses operating in equipment intensive industries. This role allows you to have a direct impact on client growth and long term success thanks to your expertise in equipment financing, financial analysis, and relationship development.
You work closely with business owners and internal partners to structure financing solutions that support investment, productivity, and expansion. In this role, you focus on understanding client challenges and translating them into sustainable and profitable financing strategies.
Your role
• Create and implement strategies to grow equipment loans and leases in your territory
• Build and maintain relationships with clients and referral partners in equipment-driven industries
• Review financial statements and make credit recommendations for complex transactions
• Manage credit and leasing applications, including documentation and approvals
• Work with internal teams to ensure solutions meet client needs and align with risk standards
• Spot market opportunities and suggest improvements for sales and financing processes
Your team
The Equipment Financing team supports Canadian businesses by providing tailored leasing and financing solutions that enable growth and operational efficiency across multiple industries.
Within the Equipment Financing department, you are part of a collaborative team of business development professionals and report to a people leader within the sales organization. Your team stands out for its entrepreneurial mindset, strong market knowledge, and commitment to delivering practical financing solutions. A hybrid work environment and flexible schedule support a healthy balance between professional and personal priorities.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning through action, allow you to master your role and develop new areas of expertise. You always have access to resources like the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center, and coaching or mentoring.
Requirements
• Hold a university certificate with a minimum of five years of experience in financial services sales, or a bachelor’s degree with experience in financing or business development
• Demonstrated experience in equipment financing, leasing, or credit based sales within equipment intensive industries
• Strong ability to analyze financial statements and structure credit recommendations
• Experience managing complex sales cycles and higher value transactions
• Proficiency in using business systems and financial tools to manage client portfolios and credit processes
Soft skills to add in competencies
• Ability to build and maintain trusted client and partner relationships
• Strong collaboration skills when working with internal partners and stakeholders
• Capacity to prioritize effectively in a fast paced, results driven environment
• High level of integrity and respect for confidentiality
• Analytical mindset with a solution oriented approach
