In this role, you’ll be expected to:

 - Help shape the strategic direction and priorities of Revenue Operations, translating company and GTM goals into clear roadmaps, initiatives, and operating priorities for the team.

 - Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions on prioritization and execution while proactively resolving dependencies and conflicts across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations.

 - Define clear goals and scope for your team, creating accountability for high-quality execution while ensuring resources and priorities remain focused on the work with the greatest business impact.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team, coaching team members and leaders, providing clear feedback, and building development and succession plans that strengthen the long-term capabilities of Revenue Operations.

 - Act as a trusted strategic partner to GTM leaders, using data, operational expertise, and a strong understanding of the revenue engine to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and bring forward thoughtful recommendations.

 - Champion change across the GTM organization, ensuring new processes, systems, and ways of working are supported by thoughtful change management, stakeholder alignment, enablement, and adoption.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - GTM leaders view Revenue Operations as a strategic partner that provides clear insights, thoughtful recommendations, and the operational infrastructure required to make better business decisions.

 - Revenue processes, systems, and data provide a connected view of the customer journey from acquisition through expansion and enable the business to operate effectively as complexity and scale increase.

 - Leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline, forecasting, capacity, territories, and operational performance, with insights increasingly supporting scenario planning and forward-looking decisions rather than simply reporting historical activity.

 - Large cross-functional initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive management of dependencies, and successful adoption across impacted teams.

 - Your team operates with clear priorities and accountability, independently owns its areas of responsibility, and continues to develop the technical, analytical, and business capabilities required to support the organization.

 - Revenue Operations has the right structure, capabilities, and succession plans to support current business needs while preparing the function for future growth.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have:

 - 7+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with hands-on Salesforce administration: workflows, automation, data architecture, and complex reporting

 - Experience supporting an enterprise sales organization with complex deal structures and deep integration with quoting, billing, contracting and order management

 - Experience with lead management for ABM and large-scale expansions

 - Experience designing and executing new sales processes from 0-to-1, with a consideration for scalability

 - Strong technical fluency: proficient in Excel, BI platforms (eg. Tableau), and/or SQL for extraction and analysis

 - Demonstrated ability navigate cross-functional stakeholders in a large, complex organization during periods of transition

 - Excellent project management skills, having led a project end-to-end from requirements gathering through scoping, build, and rollout

 - Exceptional communicator, comfortable in a high-context, remote environment. Strong technical writing skills and an aptitude for asynchronous coordination

 - Strong aptitude for change management, enablement and communication. You develop rapport with your stakeholder teams and centre the seller experience in your process design

 - Experience deploying AI as a part of revenue systems, improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and analysis

 - Experience in a hardware-enabled business is a strong asset




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

About Us Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.   Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.   Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com. Role Summary The Commercial Account Manager is a quota-carrying, full-cycle sales professional responsible for driving new customer acquisition, expansion, and retention across a defined book of commercial accounts under 100 seats, spanning all industries, including Public Sector. This role owns execution across territory planning, pipeline creation, and deal execution while selling with and through channel partners and collaborating closely with an aligned Renewal Specialist. This Commercial Account Manager is accountable for revenue outcomes, forecast accuracy, and disciplined execution in a fast-paced, high-volume commercial environment. This role is designed for emerging Commercial Account Managers who are competitive, coachable, and motivated by winning. Success requires resilience, strong ownership, and the ability to build confidence and judgement through execution feedback and repetition. What You Will Do:

Revenue Ownership & Territory Strategy

  • Own a defined commercial territory with accountability for:
  • New logo acquisition, expansion and cross sell, retention and renewal growth, in partnership with a renewal specialist
  • Build an execute territory plans that aggressively pursue whitespace, competitive displacement, and partner led-opportunities
  • Prioritizing accounts and activity to maximize deal velocity, win rates, and customer impact
  • Take ownership of gaps and develop plans to close them — without waiting to be told 

    • Channel-First Commercial Selling

  • Sell with and through partners as the primary route to market, applying recommended co-sell motions
  • Align early with partners on deal ownership, coverage and next steps
  • Communicate clearly with partners and internal teams to maintain momentum and avoid stalls
  • Build confidence navigating partner dynamics through experience and coaching

    • Sales Execution & Persuasive Deal Leadership

  • Conduct discovery conversations that uncover customer needs, urgency, and value drivers, using provided frameworks
  • Apply structured qualification (e.g., MEDDPICC / BANT) to assess opportunity quality and next steps
  • Communicate value clearly to technical and business buyers and respond to objections with support and practice
  • Drive deals to close with defined next steps, mutual action plans, and escalating appropriately when needed

    • Pipeline, Forecasting & Operational Discipline

  • Build and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline aligned to quota expectations
  • Use Salesforce and Clari consistently to support forecasting and visibility
  • Maintain clean CRM with accurate stages, next steps and close plans to enable informed decisions and faster execution
  • Proactively flag stalled deals or risks and partner with leadership to address them
    • What You Will Bring:

    Sales Experience & Capability

  • At least 2 years of experience in a quota-carrying or adjacent B2B sales role
  • Experience owning opportunities end-to-end with guidance and feedback
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodology and willingness to apply it consistently
  • Exposure to high-velocity commercial sales environments preferred

    • Competitive, Driven Sales Mindset

  • Hungry to win and motivated by progression and results
  • Brings urgency and persistence to deals
  • Resilient through rejection and learns through iteration
  • Demonstrates growth mindset through coachability and follow-through

    • Channel & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Experience working with partners, resellers, or indirect sales motions
  • Clear understanding of how to co-sell and influence without authority
  • Strong collaboration skills with Sales Engineering, Renewals, and internal stakeholders

    • Organization, Discipline & Efficiency

  • Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization instincts
  • Able to manage multiple active opportunities without sacrificing quality or follow-through
  • Disciplined CRM user who understands that strong hygiene drives forecast accuracy, trust, and personal efficiency
  • Data-aware and outcome-focused in decision-making

    • Mindset & Values Alignment

  • Takes ownership of results and execution
  • Operates with autonomy in executing while engaging leadership for guidance and escalation as needed
  • Aligns strongly with Sophos values: Simplicity, Empowerment, Passion, Innovation, and Authenticity

Description 

 Sprout Social is seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and scaling of our partner and platform integration ecosystem. This role sits at the center of a critical shift for Sprout: moving from bespoke, one-off partner integrations toward a scalable, platform-based integration model that reduces engineering lift per partner while expanding the ecosystem of systems that connect to Sprout.

 This is an individual contributor role requiring deep technical fluency in integration architecture (APIs, managed packages, platform events, OAuth/permission models) paired with strong commercial judgment on what's worth building, for whom, and when.

 Why join Sprout’s Product team? 

 Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to come in and have full ownership of our integrations strategy.

 Our Product team operates at the intersection of strategy, innovation, customer value, and go-to-market collaboration. We are focused on delivering unified, data-driven solutions across our multi-product portfolio. As part of the broader R&D organization, our team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to create impactful experiences for customers while driving measurable business outcomes. This cross-functional partnership ensures that our products not only meet technical excellence but are also positioned effectively in the market, aligning with customer needs and business growth objectives. You won't just help set the vision for our integration platform, you'll also play a key role in shaping our overall approach to partner and platform strategy and own both strategy, execution, and outcomes. 

 What you’ll do 

- Own individual integrations strategy end-to-end from pricing and packaging to distribution strategy to GA readiness, including ongoing relationship management with cross-functional teams

- Partner closely with Engineering to sequence integration investments, balancing near-term customer/revenue commitments against longer-term platform scalability

- Define and execute platform-based integration strategies (e.g., generalized APIs or connectors) that let customers self-integrate, reducing the need for bespoke builds per vendor

- Serve as the key driver of integration lifecycle management, from alpha and beta through GA and post-launch scaling, aligning with strategic partners and key customers on roadmap, timeline, and requirements at each stage

- Own permissioning, security, and licensing model decisions for packaged integrations (managed packages, namespace strategy, license management)

- Build the business case and prioritization framework for new integration bets, including clear kill criteria and proof points before scaling investment

- Act as connective tissue between GTM, Partnerships, and Engineering to ensure integration work is commercially viable, not just technically sound

- Drive the execution of "best-in-class" product delivery, balancing the urgency of immediate customer needs with the long-term scalability and innovation of our core

 What you’ll bring 

 We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and visionary product manager to help our company build the right integrations strategy. If you can work cross-functionally to build, launch, and grow our integrations ecosystem, and align teams around solving hard problems together, we'd love to talk with you!

- 10+ years of PM experience in ecosystem or integration roles in a B2B product-driven SaaS environment.

- Proven success leading initiatives in a multi-product portfolio company.

- Experience collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and GTM leaders to deliver cohesive solutions.

- Experience partnering with distributed engineering teams across different time zones

- A default toward over communication: written specs, recorded walkthroughs, decision logs, and proactive status instead of waiting to be asked.

 **We are only looking for candidates located in Central or Eastern time zone due to heavy cross collaboration with international teams**

 How you’ll grow 

 Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

- Completing Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.

- Learning the current state of integrations at Sprout, along with future product and technical roadmaps.

- Diving into our products to learn about what makes our software unique and why customers love our products.

- Beginning to understand the capabilities and limitations of our integrations

- Establishing relationships with other product, engineering, design and revenue leaders and identifying areas of opportunity.

- Get hands-on with Sprout’s products, experiencing them from the customer’s perspective.

- Establishing a working cadence with your engineering partners in Poland, including how you'll handle handoffs, async decisions, and the daily overlap window.

 Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

- Partnering with senior product leaders to define key success metrics for your role and teams and how you will measure against them.

- Participate in architectural discussions and decisions, asking the right questions to guide your team to successful outcomes.

- Participating in planning and roadmap processes and helping to shape the product roadmap for long-term success.

 Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

- Becoming an expert in Sprout's integration ecosystem and confidently speaking to partner strategy, technical tradeoffs, and platform roadmap with internal and external stakeholderS

- Owning the integration roadmap and delivering measurable results on key strategic initiatives.

- Identify key opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration and alignment.

- Standing up working cadences to build and deliver on product roadmap and outcomes in partnership with design, engineering, and GTM teams

 Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

- Consistently meeting and exceeding established performance targets.

- Obtaining (solicited and unsolicited) and acting upon peer, customer, and leadership feedback.

- Continue to evolve Sprout’s product culture, shaping the next generation of product managers.

- Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our integration capabilities at Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet!

 Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

 Our Benefits Program 
 We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

- 100% Employer-Paid Health Benefits: We cover 100% of the premiums for you and your eligible dependents, including comprehensive medical, dental (basic & major), vision, life insurance, and disability.

- Generous Paid Time Off: 25 days of vacation annually, plus 5 paid sick days, all public holidays, and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.

- Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.

- Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $950 CAD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

- Remote Work Support: A one-time $550 USD (equivalent) stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD (equivalent) stipend for internet.

- Personalized Financial Wellness: No-cost, confidential access to financial experts through Your Money Line to support your personal financial goals.

- Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child and eldercare options through Care.com.

- Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

 * This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits. 

 Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

 Our current hiring range for this role: CA$145,200 – CA$181,500  annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

 We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

 The full base pay range for this role is CA$145,200 – CA$217,800.

 These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

 If you require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process or to submit your application, please email us at accommodations@sproutsocial.com. Include the nature of your request and your preferred contact information. We'll do everything we can to support your success during our recruitment process while upholding your privacy. Please note that only inquiries regarding accommodations will receive a response from this email address; other inquiries will not be addressed (e.g., you send your resume but are not requesting an accommodation).

Description 

 Sprout Social is seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and scaling of our Listening product. This role is responsible for central elements of Sprout’s overall strategy: positioning Listening as a competitive advantage targeting the growing social intelligence market and driving a step change in adoption by Sprouts wider base

 This is an individual contributor role requiring deep product leadership skills that can drive a transformation of our Listening product into a best in class provider of decision-grade social insights for our target personas

 Why join Sprout’s Product team? 

 Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to come in and drive a step change in the value and adoption of our Listening product.

 Our Product team operates at the intersection of strategy, innovation, customer value, and go-to-market collaboration. We are focused on delivering unified, data-driven solutions across our multi-product portfolio. As part of the broader R&D organization, our team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to create impactful experiences for customers while driving measurable business outcomes. This cross-functional partnership ensures that our products not only meet technical excellence but are also positioned effectively in the market, aligning with customer needs and business growth objectives. You won't just help set the vision for Listening, you'll also play a key role in shaping our overall approach to our wider intelligence strategy, execution, and outcomes. 

 What you’ll do 

- Continuously strengthen a deep understanding of the important jobs and decisions are customers face, how the market services those needs to today, strategic trends and the biggest opportunities for our product strategy and roadmap

- Own Listening overall product strategy & roadmap getting org wide buy-in to the most impactful product bets for investment with clear, trackable pay-off metrics. 

- Partner closely with Engineering to deliver on product bet investments, balancing near-term customer/revenue commitments against longer-term strategic goals. Drive innovative solutions that balance value with risk, effort and strategic alignment

- Collaborate deeply with the pricing and packaging team to optimize pricing strategies for Listening balancing costs, sales, retention, expansion and multi-product attachment goals. 

- Act as connective tissue with Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience to ensure product direction and deliveries are centred in customer and market insights. Ensure GTM is delivered to maximise customers and prospects awareness and ability to try and adopt new releases

- Establish and continuously improve the feedback signals that can drive future decisions - track customer pipeline, adoption and usage behaviours; competitive landscape, customer feedback, churn and closed lost drivers. Ensure regular direct customer engagement and provide support to internal customer escalations 

- Develop strong relationships and effective communications with stakeholders across R&D and wider Sprout. Advocate for Listening’s growth opportunities, influencing and ensuring alignment with wider business goals and priorities. Proactively communicate progress, risks, challenges and pivots. 

- You will be continuously challenging yourself and your peers to innovate - exploring new value creation opportunities - from unmet important customer needs to technology innovations and improvements in how we work as a product and wider team.

 What you’ll bring 

 We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and visionary product leader to help our company accelerate the growth of our Listening product. If you can align teams around solving hard problems together to achieve business impact, we'd love to talk with you!

- 10+ years of PM experience in a B2B product-driven SaaS or Analytics environment.

- Proven success leading product growth in a multi-product portfolio company.

- Experience collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and GTM leaders to deliver cohesive solutions.

- Experience partnering with distributed engineering teams across different time zones

- Demonstrated ability to understand and navigate complex technical concepts, constraints and trade-offs including communicating them to non-technical stakeholders

- A bias toward customer and market insight: strong continuous discovery mindset to develop deep customer and user empathy about their needs and workflows, coupled with analytical and commercial acumen to identify usage, impact and pricing opportunities

- Deep curiosity in rapidly changing landscapes affecting the social domain, software and the PM craft. The person must demonstrate a passion for continuous improvement (at a personal, team and product level) with an aptitude for hands-on learning and experimentation

- Excellent organizational, time management, prioritization, and project management skills ensuring core leadership & roadmap priorities progress at a fast pace while also meeting other PM demands

 **We are only looking for candidates in the EST or CST timezone due to heavy collaboration with international teams** 

 How you’ll grow 

 Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

- Completing Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.

- Partner with the VP of Product to set initial priorities and align on expectations for your role.

- Start building relationships with product managers, engineers, and designers in your product team as well as across the broader Product Management team.

- Immerse yourself in understanding our customers, their jobs to be done and testing how our product helps them.  Get hands-on with Sprout’s products, experiencing them from the customer’s perspective.

- Establishing a working cadence with your engineering partners in US and Ireland, including how you'll handle handoffs, async decisions, and the daily overlap window.

 Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

- Partnering with senior product leaders to define key success metrics for your role and teams and how you will measure against them.

- Participating in planning and roadmap processes and helping to shape the product roadmap for long-term success.

- Lead day-to-day product execution for your team delivering value to customers. You’ll identify project goals, contribute to research and delivery, and organize releases.

- Understand the engineering behind the Sprout product well enough that you can predict product trade-offs and ask your team productive questions.

- Analyzing our qualitative and quantitative research to start forming hypotheses about how our product can better fit our customers’ lives.

- Facilitating quarterly roadmap planning for your team and represent the plan to the rest of Sprout’s product teams, including executive leadership.

- Collaborating with other product managers for cross-team problem solving and feature delivery. Develop a strong understanding of Sprout’s wider product portfolio and consider how customers’ workflow spans across them. 

 Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

- Becoming the expert in Sprout's Listening product and confidently speaking to strategy, technical tradeoffs, and roadmap with internal and external stakeholders

- Owning the Listening roadmap and delivering measurable results on key strategic initiatives.

- Identify key opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration and alignment.

- Standing up working cadences to build and deliver on product roadmap and outcomes in partnership with design, engineering, and GTM teams

 Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

- Making strategic recommendations across product, pricing, gtm and ways of working to drive outsized business impact

- Consistently meeting and exceeding established performance targets.

- Obtaining (solicited and unsolicited) and acting upon peer, customer, and leadership feedback.

- Be ready to take on new challenges to help your team and the broader PM organization -- including things we maybe haven’t even anticipated

- Continue to evolve Sprout’s product culture, shaping the next generation of product managers.

- Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our ambition for Listening at Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet!

 Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

 Our Benefits Program 
 We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

- 100% Employer-Paid Health Benefits: We cover 100% of the premiums for you and your eligible dependents, including comprehensive medical, dental (basic & major), vision, life insurance, and disability.

- Generous Paid Time Off: 25 days of vacation annually, plus 5 paid sick days, all public holidays, and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.

- Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.

- Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $950 CAD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

- Remote Work Support: A one-time $550 USD (equivalent) stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD (equivalent) stipend for internet.

- Personalized Financial Wellness: No-cost, confidential access to financial experts through Your Money Line to support your personal financial goals.

- Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child and eldercare options through Care.com.

- Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

 * This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

 We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

 The full base pay range for this role is CA$145,200 – CA$217,800.

We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

 StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to applicants currently located in Canada or the United States.

 Commercial & Platform Agreements 

- Draft, negotiate, and interpret contracts with clients and ad tech ecosystem partners, including Supply Path Optimization (SPO) agreements with SSPs, publishers, and ad exchanges, as well as data sharing and measurement/verification vendor agreements.

- Guide post-launch compliance efforts, including auditing mechanisms and the ongoing protection of proprietary technology via trademarks, copyrights, and patents.

- Strong aptitude for complex technology and desire to learn the functioning of the ad tech ecosystem (including DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, CTV and other emerging channels, AI-powered ad tech, and programmatic advertising principles.)

- Excellent negotiation, analytical, and communication skills to manage disputes and advise senior leadership.

- Ability to handle complex cases and meet litigation deadlines in a high-pressure environment.

- Strategic thinking and problem-solving to balance legal risks with business goals.

- Strong drafting and negotiation skills for commercial agreements.

- Ability to simplify complex legal and technical concepts for cross-functional teams.

- Excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with non-legal stakeholders, including product managers and engineers.

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and provide clear, actionable legal advice.

- A demonstrated appetite for adopting automation and AI tools to drive efficiency and consistency in legal workflows.

- Preferred: Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) certification, experience with AI-related legal and governance issues in ad tech, martech, or similar technology platforms, and fluency with AI and automation tools in a modern legal function.

 StackAdapt is looking for an Employment Counsel to join our growing Legal team. Reporting to the Senior Director, Employment Counsel, you will help support the employment law function across Canada and, as needed, our other key international markets. This role is well-suited to an employment lawyer with 3+ years of hands-on experience looking to take on broad ownership across advisory work, compliance, dispute resolution, and cross-functional projects at a fast-growing, global technology company.

 You'll work closely with our People & Culture (P&C) team and business leaders on the full employment lifecycle, from hiring through to termination, while helping build scalable, compliant frameworks as StackAdapt continues to expand internationally.

 StackAdapt is a Remote First company. We are open to candidates located in Canada for this position. 

 What You'll Be Doing:

- Provide day-to-day employment law advisory support for Canada (all provinces, as applicable), with additional support to other jurisdictions such as the UK, Germany, Australia, and Singapore, working with local outside counsel as needed.

- Manage and help resolve employment standards complaints, human rights complaints, and demand letters, and support litigation strategy and outside counsel instruction where required.

- Partner with the People & Culture team on workplace investigations, performance management, accommodations, leaves of absence, and terminations.

- Draft and maintain employment agreements, policies, and handbooks across supported jurisdictions.

- Support key employment-related compliance projects and initiatives as the company scales, helping build sustainable and efficient processes for the Legal and P&C teams.

- Support international expansion by helping stand up compliant employment frameworks in new markets.

- Identify and lead opportunities to use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of employment law advice, document drafting, research, and case/matter management.

 What You'll Bring to the Table

- Minimum 3+ years of relevant employment law experience, with some of that at a law firm where you advised on Canadian employment matters and handled employment demands and litigation; experience with other jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, Australia, Singapore, Germany) is an asset.

- Called to the bar in at least one Canadian province (Ontario preferred) and in good standing.

- Strong working knowledge of Canadian employment and human rights legislation, with the ability to quickly get up to speed on multi-jurisdictional nuances.

- Excellent judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with practical, business-oriented advice.

- Strong project management skills and comfort managing a high volume of concurrent matters and stakeholders.

- Clear, confident communicator who can distill complex legal issues into practical guidance for non-lawyers.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.

- Genuine curiosity about how AI tools can be applied to legal work, along with a willingness to learn and adopt new tools as they're introduced.

 Using AI In This Role

 AI is an increasingly important part of how our Legal team works, and this role will have real opportunities to help shape that. Depending on the task, you may use AI tools to:

- Accelerate legal research and first drafts of memos, policies, playbooks, and correspondence (with your own review, judgment, and sign-off always required).

- Summarize and triage incoming matters, demand letters, and complaints to help prioritize response.

- Build and maintain internal playbooks, templates, and self-serve resources for the People & Culture team and business stakeholders.

- Support process improvement and automation for recurring employment law workflows, in partnership with the broader Legal and Compliance teams.

 We're looking for someone comfortable using AI-powered tools as part of their everyday workflow, who applies sound legal judgment to review and validate AI-assisted output, and who is interested in helping identify new ways AI can support the employment law function as our tools and processes evolve.

You’ll work closely with teams across Finance and the broader business while helping document and improve accounting processes through thoughtful use of technology and automation.

- 4+ years of professional accounting experience, including exposure to month-end close activities.

- Foundational knowledge of accounting principles and financial statements.

- Experience preparing journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, or variance analyses.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines during a time-sensitive close process.

- A structured, systems-oriented approach to breaking down and documenting processes.

- Curiosity and willingness to question the status quo and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Designated CPA or working towards obtaining your designation.

- Experience with NetSuite, FloQast, Zip, or another ERP or accounting system is an asset.

You’ll collaborate across disciplines to frame problem spaces, define strategic paths forward, and refine details before launch. greenhouse:stackadapt:4244148009.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

 As a Staff UX Research Strategist at StackAdapt, you'll help decide what we build next. You'll lead forward-looking, generative research that identifies new & emerging opportunities and shapes StackAdapt's future product & business strategy. 

 This is a hybrid role that blends UX research with market research; you'll move fluidly between understanding users deeply and understanding the market, applying whichever lens the question calls for. It's also a cross-org role: though you'll sit within Product, your partnerships & influence will span the entire StackAdapt organization (including analytics, go-to-market and revenue functions), informing decisions at the business-strategy level, not just the product roadmap.

 StackAdapt is a Remote First company, we are open to candidates located anywhere in Canada and the United States for this position. 

 What you'll be doing: 

- Lead end-to-end foundational research on new & emerging product areas, uncovering unmet user needs and shaping them into product opportunities

- Bring market-research rigor to product strategy by identifying ICPs, value propositions, product-market fit, market sizing for new product opportunities

- Develop a point of view on where the market is heading, scanning the competitive & industry landscape to identify where the biggest opportunities and tailwinds are (vs. evaluating one opportunity in isolation)

- Weigh competing opportunities against each other & make a clear, evidence-based case for where StackAdapt should invest; address opportunity costs by identifying which bets are worth it (ie. where the potential upside justifies the risk) while being explicit about the assumptions each recommendation rests on

- Co-own a strategic insights function (in partnership with Product Analytics) that turns signals from across StackAdapt’s business and the market into an early read on emerging opportunities & risks, giving leadership a proactive view of where to focus

- Act as a strategic thought partner to Product & Design leadership, influencing strategy by challenging assumptions & bringing evidence to high-stakes debates 

- Collaborate with the Vertical Solutions team to deepen understanding of key industries, supporting their research & surfacing vertical-specific opportunities

- Partner with Marketing, Sales and Client Services to translate research and market insight into go-to-market strategy, helping shape the positioning & launch of new products to customers

- Level up the UX Research team’s strategic-foresight & market research skills through hands-on coaching & shared playbooks, raising the team’s ability to run this kind of research

- Apply AI fluently across your own research workflow, using it where it genuinely sharpens or speeds the work while knowing where human judgment & rigor still need to lead

- Identify & implement improvements to UXR tools and processes, leveraging AI (where it makes sense) to create repeatable, scalable workflows that raise the quality and efficiency of research across the product org

 What you’ll bring to the table: 

- 7–10 years of applied research experience, with a portfolio that shows you've surfaced new opportunities and influenced product or business strategy, rather than validating decisions already made

- A blend of UX research & market research experience: alongside qualitative & quantitative UX methods, demonstrated experience with market opportunity assessment, sizing, ideal customer profile / segmentation, value-proposition, product-market-fit and competitive research

- Domain expertise in digital advertising, adtech/martech, data-driven platforms or privacy-sensitive B2B technology markets, with the ability to translate market shifts, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and regulatory trends into product direction

- Demonstrated flexibility and comfort with ambiguity, ill-defined problem spaces and complex domains, paired with systems thinking that connects user, market and business perspectives

- Experience influencing at the senior-leadership level (Director / VP / CTO), building the strategic narrative & business case that secures buy-in on research vision and direction

- Comfort partnering closely with analytics/data teams to pair quantitative signal with qualitative depth and to turn synthesized signals into discovery research

- Experience facilitating workshops (e.g. ideation, co-creation) and driving research into product and strategy decisions, not just awareness

- Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into the research workflow (synthesis, analysis, recruiting, or other stages), ideally with repeatable, scalable processes

- Experience conducting research on AI-powered features or products, and in B2B / platform environments, is a strong asset

 This individual contributor role will own the strategy, execution, and optimization of high-impact web experiences that strengthen our brand narrative, communicate StackAdapt’s value in a compelling way, and support measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines exceptional writing and storytelling skills with strong strategic thinking and a deep understanding of how content, user experience, and search work together to drive results.

greenhouse:stay22:4376139009.description:
À propos de Stay22 

 Basée à Montréal, Stay22 aide les créateurs ambitieux et les plateformes numériques à forte intention à transformer leur trafic existant en revenus additionnels, grâce à une technologie qui fonctionne discrètement en arrière-plan.

 Aujourd’hui, plus de 6 500 créateurs et plateformes font confiance à Stay22, avec plus d’un milliard de dollars en transactions annuelles transitant par la plateforme. Initialement conçue pour le secteur du voyage, l’entreprise accompagne désormais des partenaires dans les domaines du commerce de détail, du lifestyle, de l’édition, des événements et du transport, alors qu’elle poursuit l’expansion de son infrastructure de monétisation pour l’économie moderne des créateurs.

 Aperçu du poste 

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de gestionnaire principal·e, développement des affaires, afin de contribuer à l’expansion de la présence de Stay22 au sein de l’écosystème des annonceurs.

 Notre équipe Supply est au croisement de la technologie, de la stratégie produit et de l’impact commercial. Elle veille à établir les bons partenariats avec les fournisseurs afin de maximiser la valeur pour les éditeurs et les créateurs de contenu, tout en transformant les besoins des partenaires et du marché en informations concrètes qui contribuent à orienter nos produits et nos priorités.

 Il s’agit d’un rôle hautement stratégique, axé sur l’industrie, pour une personne qui comprend en profondeur l’ad tech, la monétisation numérique et le fonctionnement de l’écosystème commercial d’Internet. Tu dois avoir une solide expérience du côté des éditeurs et de la publicité, avoir travaillé avec des annonceurs et bien comprendre comment faire croître les revenus de façon véritablement incrémentale plutôt que de simplement remplacer des revenus existants. Tu sais repérer les occasions, saisir le bon levier et faire avancer les discussions avec intention.

 Responsabilités principales 

- Travailler de façon autonome pour repérer la valeur inexploitée au sein de relations d’affaires existantes, notamment en identifiant des occasions d’élargir les partenariats actuels, d’accéder à de nouveaux budgets publicitaires et de maximiser la structure déjà en place chez Stay22.

- Développer des argumentaires, présentations et analyses de rentabilité convaincants, adaptés aux besoins des partenaires, à leurs incitatifs commerciaux et aux discussions avec les clients.

- Collaborer étroitement avec la personne responsable de l’équipe Supply, l’équipe Produit et les gestionnaires principaux·ales, partenariats stratégiques, afin d’évaluer les occasions, de transformer les besoins des partenaires en solutions et de faire progresser les initiatives, à l’interne comme à l’externe.

- Conseiller les partenaires sur leur stratégie de monétisation, notamment en ce qui concerne les occasions de revenus incrémentaux, l’économie de l’affiliation, les modèles publicitaires et la distinction entre la création de valeur incrémentale et le simple remplacement de revenus.

- Gérer des cycles complexes de partenariats avec de grandes entreprises, en naviguant avec assurance dans des discussions avec des membres de la haute direction, en développant plusieurs relations en parallèle et en sachant quand pousser, faire une pause ou changer d’approche.

- Utiliser les données et les informations commerciales pour générer des résultats, contribuer aux revues d’affaires trimestrielles (QBR), déterminer les indicateurs clés et trouver des façons d’améliorer concrètement les résultats des partenaires.

- Gérer des initiatives commerciales et des budgets importants, avec la capacité d’influencer des résultats de plusieurs millions de dollars.

- Représenter Stay22 à l’externe, notamment lors de conférences de l’industrie et de rencontres en personne avec des partenaires, avec environ 20 à 30 % de déplacements.

 Expérience recherchée 

- Au moins 8 ans d’expérience en développement des affaires, en partenariats ou dans des rôles commerciaux stratégiques, idéalement dans l’ad tech, l’affiliation, l’édition, les médias numériques ou la monétisation numérique au sens large.

- Compréhension approfondie de l’écosystème des éditeurs et de la monétisation numérique, y compris du fonctionnement concret des modèles de distribution, de publicité, d’affiliation et de marketing à la performance.

- Esprit entrepreneurial et grande autonomie; tu es à l’aise de travailler sans plan établi, de prendre des risques calculés et de bâtir quelque chose à partir de zéro.

- Expérience directe avec des annonceurs ou de grandes entreprises partenaires, et compréhension de la façon dont les budgets sont attribués, gérés et optimisés.

- Excellent jugement commercial et capacité démontrée à naviguer dans des cycles complexes de vente et de partenariats avec de grandes entreprises, notamment en sachant quand pousser, quand faire une pause et comment développer plusieurs relations en parallèle.

- Présence exécutive et assurance, avec la capacité d’établir ta crédibilité et d’exercer ton influence auprès de parties prenantes chevronnées et de membres de la haute direction.

- Grande curiosité et capacité à reconnaître les tendances, avec une aptitude démontrée à repérer les occasions, à réfléchir rapidement et à transformer des idées ambiguës en actions concrètes.

- Capacité à gérer des résultats commerciaux importants, notamment des occasions et des projets complexes de plusieurs millions de dollars.

- Volonté de te déplacer environ 20 à 30 % du temps.

- Maîtrise de l’anglais requise pour les communications quotidiennes avec nos clients et collègues à l’international. La connaissance du français, de l’espagnol ou du chinois constitue un atout.

 À quoi t’attendre de notre processus d’embauche 

 Nous savons que ton temps est précieux. Voici donc un aperçu rapide des étapes à prévoir :

- Entrevue de présélection avec notre partenaire en acquisition de talents (30 minutes, téléphonique)

- Entrevue avec la personne gestionnaire (30 à 45 minutes, virtuel)

- Entrevue avec l’équipe de direction (30min, virtuel)

- Exercice pratique numérique

- Entrevue avec l’équipe Supply (90 minutes, en personne)

- Entrevue finale avec notre chef de la direction (30 minutes, virtuel)

- Offre et intégration 🎉

 Veuillez noter que ce processus peut être modifié à tout moment en fonction de besoins supplémentaires de l’équipe.

 Pourquoi rejoindre Stay22 ? 

- Emplacement de choix à Montréal : Travaillez depuis notre dynamique siège social situé dans la Petite-Italie, avec une allocation pour la cafétéria, un accès complet au gym, ainsi qu’une terrasse sur le toit comprenant un terrain saisonnier de basketball/pickleball et une patinoire de hockey.

- Une gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : Couverture santé et dentaire, contribution de l’employeur au REER, titre de transport STM entièrement payé, ainsi que des activités d’équipe, événements et retraites réguliers.

- Une flexibilité adaptée à votre réalité : Horaires flexibles, possibilités de travailler de n’importe où, fermeture des bureaux en fin d’année et journées flexibles.

 (Stay22 est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées. Si vous avez un handicap ou des besoins particuliers nécessitant des aménagements, contactez-nous à careers@stay22.com .) 

 Ton CV sera lu par Mariel , notre recruteuse interne, même si tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, on aimerait quand même te rencontrer.

 About Stay22 

 Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.

 Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.

 Position overview 

 We’re looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to help expand Stay22’s footprint across the advertiser ecosystem.

 Our Supply team is where tech and product strategy meets commercial impact. They make sure we have the right suppliers in place to maximize value for publishers and creators, while turning partner and market needs into actionable insights that help shape our products and priorities.

 This is a highly strategic, industry-facing role for someone who deeply understands ad tech, digital monetization, and how the internet’s commercial ecosystem works. You should bring strong publisher/advertising-side context, experience working with advertisers, and a sharp understanding of how to grow revenue in ways that are truly incremental rather than replacement-based. You know how to identify opportunities, pull on the right thread, and move conversations forward with purpose.

 Key Responsibilities  

- Work autonomously to uncover untapped value within existing enterprise relationships, identifying opportunities to expand current partnerships, access new advertiser budgets, and maximize Stay22’s existing setup.

- Develop compelling pitches, decks, and business cases tailored to partner needs, commercial incentives, and customer conversations.

- Work closely with the Head of Supply, Product, and Strategic Partnership Managers to evaluate opportunities, translate partner needs into solutions, and drive initiatives forward, both internally and externally.

- Advise partners on monetization strategy, including incremental revenue opportunities, affiliate economics, advertising models, and the distinction between incremental value creation and replacement.

- Manage complex enterprise partnership cycles, confidently navigating C-suite level conversations, multi-threading relationships, and knowing when to push, pause, or change course.

- Use data and commercial insights to drive outcomes, contributing to and/or driving QBRs, identifying key metrics, and finding ways to move the needle for partners.

- Manage significant commercial initiatives and budgets, with the ability to influence multi-million-dollar outcomes. 

- Represent Stay22 externally, including at industry conferences and in-person partner meetings, with approximately 20–30% travel.

 Requirements 

- 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or strategic commercial roles, ideally within ad tech, affiliate, publishing, digital media, or broader digital monetization.

- Deep understanding of the publisher and digital monetization ecosystem, including how distribution, advertising, affiliate, and performance marketing models work in practice.

- Highly entrepreneurial and self-directed, comfortable operating without an established playbook, taking calculated risks, and building something from the ground up.

- Experience working directly with advertisers and/or large enterprise partners, with an understanding of how budgets are allocated, managed, and optimized.

- Strong commercial judgment and proven ability to navigate complex enterprise sales and partnership cycles, including knowing when to push, when to pause, and how to multi-thread relationships.

- Executive presence and confidence, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior stakeholders and C-suite executives.

- Strong curiosity and pattern recognition, with a demonstrated ability to uncover opportunities, think on your feet, and turn ambiguous ideas into action.

- Ability to manage significant commercial outcomes, including complex, multi-million-dollar opportunities and projects.

- Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of the time.

- English proficiency is required for daily communication with international clients and colleagues. Multilingual French, Spanish, or Chinese is an asset.

 What to Expect from our Hiring Process 

 We know your time’s valuable, so here’s the quick rundown of what to expect.

- Screening call with our Talent Acquisition Partner (30-45 min)

- Interview with the Hiring Manager (30-45 min, virtual)

- Leadership Interview (30 min, virtual)

- Digital exercise

- Panel interview with the Supply team (90 min, in-person)

- Final interview with our CEO (30 min, virtual)

- Offer & onboarding 🎉

 Please note that this process is subject to change at any point, based on additional requirements from the team. 

 Why join Stay22? 

- Prime Montreal Location: Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.

- Comprehensive Benefits: Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.

- Flexibility That Works: Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days.

 Stay22 is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at careers@stay22.com .

 Your application will be reviewed by Mariel , our internal recruiter- even if you don’t meet every requirement but you’re excited, let’s talk.

Who we are 

 About Stripe 

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team 

 The Account Executive, SMB Grower team is a highly consultative sales team that is responsible for the growth and retention of Stripe’s largest and fastest growing SMB customers. As an Account Executive, SMB Grower team member, you’ll identify new opportunities for our clients to get the most out of Stripe by quickly understanding our clients’ needs, execute scaled sales strategies to close upsell and renewals with existing Stripe customers, and drive end-to-end campaigns to increase adoption of Stripe’s offerings.

 What you’ll do

Who we are

 About the team 

 Marketing Operations is a team of marketing execution experts and systems thinkers focused on efficiency. We partner closely with Regional and Demand marketing, Growth, Martech, and creative teams to deliver scalable, high-impact campaigns across channels. While we operate globally, this role is focused on supporting the AMER region.

 What you’ll do 

 We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the end-to-end marketing operations process owner for in-person and online events. In this role, you will collaborate with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Marketing Operations teammates to identify audiences, track and drive attendance, produce high-performing and measurable campaigns, accurately process attendee and non-attendee data, route leads accurately and quickly, and provide sales follow-up reporting.

 Responsibilities 

- Own end-to-end marketing operations for in-person and online events, from campaign intake through post-event reporting.

- Partner with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Sales to define operational plans, timelines, responsibilities, and success metrics.

- Manage audience strategy and campaign execution, including segmentation, registration, email, testing, launch readiness, and attendance tracking.

- Monitor registration and attendance, address risks and dependencies, and identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement.

- Manage the accurate capture, validation, enrichment, and reconciliation of attendee and non-attendee data.

- Oversee lead scoring, classification, routing, nurture, sales notifications, and handoff within agreed service levels.

- Report on campaign performance, attendance, engagement, lead routing, sales follow-up, and pipeline impact.

- Maintain high standards for data quality, privacy, consent, and contact governance throughout the campaign lifecycle.

- Identify and address process, data, and technology gaps by implementing scalable documentation and operating procedures that improve consistency and performance.   

 Who you are 

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation operations, event operations, or a related field.

- 3+ years of proven expertise in Marketo, with a strong track record of developing scalable programs and driving successful campaign outcomes.

- Proven track record of optimizing campaign and execution workflows within event and webinar platforms (such as Splash and ON24).

- Experience with audience segmentation, campaign workflows, lead management, and sales follow-up processes.

- Strong program-management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and multiple concurrent events.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience using campaign data to identify issues and improve performance.

- Understanding of data quality, consent, privacy, and contact-governance practices.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills and experience working across Marketing, Sales, and Technology teams.

- Attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

- Experience integrating AI into scalable marketing operations workflow designs and streamline processes.

 Preferred qualifications   

- Experience in the technology or financial services sectors, ideally within a high-growth company.

- Knowledge of marketing automation tools and processes to enhance efficiency and scalability in campaign execution.

- Strong adaptive skills with a proven ability to thrive in a rapidly changing environment.

- Experience managing or collaborating with an offshore production team to streamline operations.

greenhouse:stripe:7663023.description:
Who we are 

 About Stripe 

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team 

 The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.

 As a part of the Connect design team, you'll lead product development for the largest complex users on Stripe—marketplaces such as Doordash and Lyft, and platforms such as Shopify and Woo. You'll drive the vision for how these marketplaces and platforms manage risk and compliance for their business and their users in the US and internationally. You'll work with other designers on the team to define the future of the experience for all Connect users on the dashboard.

 This role is a strong fit for a designer who is energized by complexity, motivated by impact, and excited to turn difficult systems into simple, intuitive experiences.

 What you’ll do 

 In this role, you will be responsible for deeply understanding our users and product strategy to design and advocate for the highest quality product experience. You’ll utilize a broad set of product design skills including user interface design, user experience and interaction design, and prototyping.

 Responsibilities 

- Own the end-to-end product design process from discovery through delivery

- Ship meaningful, high-quality experiences that balance business needs with usability

- Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to shape the team's roadmap and goals from an impactful and measurable customer outcomes perspective

- Leverage insights from our UXR team to identify opportunity areas, and to validate potential solutions to pain points

- Partner with content design to craft compelling experiences that deliver the right information at the right time to the right user

- Work closely with other product designers to drive holistic solutions for our marketplaces and platforms and their users

 Who you are 

 You’re a product designer who thrives in complex, interconnected problem spaces. You bring strong design fundamentals and polished UI craft, quickly develop informed perspectives, and translate user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into thoughtful solutions. You’re proactive and self-directed, comfortable navigating ambiguity and shared ownership, and skilled at influencing cross-functional teams through clear storytelling. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements 

- Has 6+ years relevant design experience at a tech, product-driven company

- Has experience working in a complex problem space such as B2B or SaaS interfaces

- A portfolio that demonstrates strong design fundamentals and polished UI craft

- Experience partnering closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction and proven ability to influence teams

- Ability to balance user needs, business goals, and multiple stakeholder inputs

- Experience working horizontally across product areas on ambiguous and complex problems 

- Confident presenting work to company leadership and skilled at communicating design decisions through a clear and compelling story

 Preferred qualifications 

- Are skilled in explaining your work, process, and decisions to cross-functional stakeholders and crave feedback to help you produce your best work

- Care about details and are excited to keep pushing your work until it is pixel-perfect

- Value working with a diverse group of people with different perspectives and expertise

- Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow—and have them help you learn and grow

- Are committed to building a sustainable and scalable business by balancing user and business needs

This is a high-impact role for a designer who finds as much satisfaction in untangling complex workflows and dense information architectures as in crafting polished interfaces.

greenhouse:stripe:8165259.title: UX Research Manager, Payments
greenhouse:stripe:8165259.description:
Who we are 

 About Stripe 

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

 Research at Stripe 

 Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and expand economic access globally. We design tools and infrastructure to help our users start, run, and scale an online business from anywhere in the world. We believe there are too many barriers to doing business on the internet and that opportunities are not equally distributed around the world. We also believe that building and growing a business online is a problem rooted in code, language, and design, not finance.

 That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an experienced UX Research Manager to join our growing UX Research team and help build, coach, and mentor a growing and highly skilled group of researchers.

 About UX research and the role 

 The UX Research team is part of Stripe’s Design team. It works across brand and product initiatives to deliver products and experiences that meet user needs. Since Stripe’s main audience is people who build products, we take pride in creating user-friendly, user-focused experiences.

 In addition to conducting primary research, we enable other Stripes, including engineers, product managers, designers, and operations teams, to learn and apply research skills to global problems. You will help shape research as a core competency across Stripe and define how we put users first in our research.

 What you’ll do 

 As a UX Research Manager, you will use your people-management and research expertise to lead a team of researchers that collaborates with product teams on core Payments and Risk products to build insight-driven product experiences. Core Payments includes Stripe’s in-person and online payment capabilities, checkout suite, Radar, and smart solutions that help businesses achieve optimal payment performance while balancing regulatory requirements, conversion, costs, and fraud considerations.

 You will report to the Head of Research.

 Responsibilities 

- Lead, manage, coach, and mentor a team of researchers conducting mixed-methods research throughout the product-development process for Stripe’s Payments and Risk product pillar.

- Lead initiatives and guide the research team through artificial intelligence (AI) transformation in its internal processes, how it conducts research for Stripe users, and how it supports the changing needs of product partners.

- Share research insights that deepen Stripe’s understanding of user needs and identify opportunities to meet those needs.

- Grow the team to meet Stripe’s needs while developing individual contributors to deliver impactful, actionable research studies.

- Partner with Design and Stripe leadership to determine how to best use user research at Stripe and deepen our understanding of users.

- Work as a strategic partner to business leads, product managers, design leaders, and Stripe leadership. Define long-term strategy and short-term tactics for products by grounding decisions in user needs and insights.

- Prioritize research needs and approaches across multiple workstreams. Select the right project, scale, and scope at the right time, and deliver actionable insights.

- Enable other Stripes to learn and apply research skills by building research programs, platforms, and toolkits that support tactical research.

- Partner closely with other researchers to build Stripe’s research practice and infrastructure, including sourcing research vendors to support your team’s work.

 Who you are 

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

 Minimum requirements 

- 7+ years of relevant user research experience working on digital experiences and generating actionable insights that drive impact.

- 3+ years of people-management and leadership experience.

- Experience directly managing, coaching, and developing a team of user researchers, as well as recruiting and building research teams.

- Ability to set and achieve priorities that balance the needs of users, projects, the Research team, and Stripe.

- Experience conducting project work while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.

 Preferred qualifications 

- Relevant experience in financial technology, particularly payment processing.

- Ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work.

- Experience conducting complex research at scale using a range of methods, including qualitative interviews, surveys, ideation sessions, ethnographic field research, usability evaluations, and diary studies.

- Experience conducting primary research while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience rolling out large-scale research programs.

- A consistent focus on users and their needs, with experience driving impact from insights.

- Understanding of the balance between speed and rigor, and how research translates into design, product, and business decisions. Ability to work with urgency and focus while adapting methodological rigor to the situation.

- Experience building or scaling research platforms, systems, or programs.

ashby:surveymonkey:a0b90cc1-db9f-4cc2-a5.title: Expansion Account Executive
ashby:surveymonkey:a0b90cc1-db9f-4cc2-a5.description:
SurveyMonkey is the world’s most popular platform for surveys and forms, built for business—loved by users. We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.

Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com http://surveymonkey.com.


 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

SurveyMonkey is seeking an Expansion Account Executive to join our high-growth sales team, reporting directly to the Sales Manager. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to our existing customers, helping them uncover the full potential of our AI-powered insights platform to drive critical business decisions. We are hiring for this position to accelerate our footprint within established accounts, ensuring our customers maximize their ROI through expanded services and enterprise-grade integrations. You will join a culture that values ownership, transparency, and high-performance, where your contributions directly impact products used by 260K+ organizations worldwide.




WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

 - Execute full-cycle sales strategies by identifying, prospecting, and closing expansion opportunities within an existing book of business to exceed revenue targets.

 - Partner with Customer Success teams to map organizational hierarchies and navigate new departments, effectively positioning SurveyMonkey’s enterprise suite to new buyers.

 - Deliver consultative, solution-based presentations that align our AI and automation capabilities with complex customer needs and measurable business outcomes.

 - Manage complex deal cycles using the MEDDPICC framework to ensure accurate forecasting, stakeholder alignment, and consistent pipeline health.

 - Leverage advanced sales technology, including Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach, to analyze deal insights and optimize your outreach strategy for maximum impact.

 - Drive continuous process improvement by incorporating feedback and industry trends into your sales approach, ensuring a modern and effective buying experience.




WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM PEOPLE WITH

 - 2+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas in a SaaS or professional services environment.

 - Experience in account expansion or territory management, specifically in navigating large organizations to build relationships with new internal stakeholders.

 - Proficiency in sales qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC, Sandler, or Challenger to manage multi-stakeholder deals.

 - Technical expertise in CRM and sales engagement tools, specifically Salesforce and Gong, to manage data-driven pipelines.

 - AI-First Mindset: Proactive in adopting AI productivity tools to automate administrative tasks, allowing for more "high-value" human interaction and deeper strategic account planning.

 - A background in building business cases and Mutual Action Plans (MAPs) to guide prospects through the procurement and implementation process.



The base pay provided for this position ranges from CAD $56,312.50/year - $66,250.00/year depending on the geographic market and assuming a full-time schedule. Actual base pay is based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, education or training, skills, and experience.

Bonuses may also be offered as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; RRSP matching; flexible spending & health savings account; paid holidays; paid time off; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. 

This opening is for an existing vacancy.

SurveyMonkey believes in-person collaboration is valuable for building relationships, fostering community, and enhancing our speed and execution in problem-solving and decision-making. As such, you will be required to work from our Ottawa office up to 1 day per week.

#LI-Hybrid


Why SurveyMonkey? We’re glad you asked

At SurveyMonkey, curiosity powers everything we do. We’re a global company where people from all backgrounds can make an impact, build meaningful connections, and grow their careers. ashby:surveymonkey:9325fe7d-9493-49e8-a3.description:
