We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.

Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com http://surveymonkey.com.


 

What we’re looking for

There is a unique thrill in hunting for new business when you are backed by a globally recognized, beloved brand like SurveyMonkey. Our products are already trusted by leaders across virtually every industry, meaning when you reach out, the trust is already there, and prospects know our name. Your mission is to show them what they don't know. We’re seeking an Account Executive to manage the full-cycle sales process for SurveyMonkey’s enterprise suite, focusing on new logo acquisition via outbound pipeline generation and upselling existing self-service SurveyMonkey users into Enterprise opportunities. You will identify unique mission-driven needs and build ROI-based business cases for diverse stakeholders, while leveraging AI and various Sales platforms to maintain a disciplined pipeline from initial prospecting through to close.



What you’ll be working on

 - Signal-Driven Pipeline Generation: Generate the vast majority of your pipeline through aggressive outbound prospecting into your assigned territory. You won't be flying blind; you will leverage a wealth of high-intent signal data and tools like ZoomInfo, GTM Workspaces, internal GPT tools, Gemini, and Claude to scale your outreach intelligently.

 - Strategic Territory Penetration & Multi-Threading: Take true ownership of a data-rich territory loaded with untapped potential. You will systematically map out target accounts and multi-thread across different departments (such as Marketing, HR, and IT) to build consensus, execute competitive displacement plays, and drive multi-product adoption.

 - Rigorous Iteration & Conversion: You will piece together data insights and technology to land highly effective messages, applying the rigor and discipline to constantly A/B test, adapt, and refine your approach to maximize conversion rates.

 - High-Velocity Deal Execution: Command a fast-paced, full-cycle sales motion. You will confidently transition from cold prospecting to consultative pitching and closing, while efficiently capitalizing on inbound and product-led growth (PLG) signals as the cherry on top of your outbound efforts.

 - Agile Methodology & Pipeline Management: Apply the Sandler selling methodology and MEDDPICC framework efficiently to qualify hard, highlight competitive differentiators, and drive urgency. You will utilize Salesforce and Gong to track a high volume of active deals and maintain razor-sharp forecasting without slowing down your deal cycles.



We’d love to hear from people with

 - The Hunter's Mentality: A proven track record of thriving in an outbound-heavy role. You are entirely comfortable knowing that your success relies on your ability to generate pipeline via proactive hustle, cold calling, email, and LinkedIn.

 - Territory & Stakeholder Management: Experience systematically penetrating a defined territory and multi-threading through mid-sized organizational structures. You know how to identify economic buyers, build champions across multiple departments, and create consensus to get deals done quickly.

 - Signal-to-Message Translation: You excel at connecting the dots. You know how to synthesize intent data and leverage technology to craft scalable messaging that lands, and you possess the discipline to continuously iterate on your outreach to improve metrics.

 - High-Velocity B2B Experience: 2+ years of fast-paced, full-cycle sales experience. You know how to create urgency, run "rip and replace" sales cycles against entrenched competitors, and balance quick transactional wins with focused outbound prospecting to consistently crush quota.

 - Multi-Product Proficiency: A history of successfully cross-selling or positioning a multi-product portfolio, demonstrating the active listening skills required to map specific products to specific buyer pains.

 - Industry & Persona Expertise (Bonus): While not strictly required, a background in Market Research or direct experience selling into HR or Healthcare organizations is a massive plus that will bring immediate, unique value to our current team.



The base pay provided for this position ranges from CAD $56,312.50/ year - $66,250.00/ year, depending on the geographic market and assuming a full-time schedule. Actual base pay is based on a number of factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, education or training, skills, and experience.

Bonuses may also be offered as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; RRSP matching; flexible spending & health savings account; paid holidays; paid time off; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

 This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.

- Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).

- Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.

- Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.

- Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.

 What We Are Looking For 

- Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.

- Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.

- Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.

- High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.

- Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.

- Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.

- Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

- Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.

- Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.

 Nice to Have 

- Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.

- A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.

- Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.

- Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.

- Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.

 Our Tech Stack 

- Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.

 About the Role 

 We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Program Manager to join our team. This is a tactical, implementation-focused role , hands-on in shaping how EPD (Engineering, Product & Design) operates, works together, and stays productive: building and refining the processes and rhythms that keep the org running, driving improvement initiatives over time, and owning the processes behind EPD's operational health. You'll help the team understand trends and spot where improvements are needed.

 Because we're an early-stage and fully remote company, we're looking for an individual who can work independently to align the teams involved in building the product. A deep understanding of the technical engineering space (how engineering teams operate, where the friction points typically live, and what good looks like) is essential to being effective and credible in this role. Ability to think on one's feet, enjoy collaborating with highly technical teams, operate comfortably in ambiguity without a clearly defined deliverable, and be comfortable working asynchronously is essential.

 Key Responsibilities 

 You will work as part of the TPM team to:

- Own the processes for bug tracking, incidents, reliability, and escalations, and continuously improve them to drive efficiency and progress toward EPD's operational health goals.

- Spot trends across operational health data and translate them into clear insights on how EPD is doing and where improvement is needed.

- Build dashboards and reports in tools like Jira and Snowflake that give EPD and the broader company visibility into operational health and progress.

- Turn data into a clear story: what it's telling us, why it matters, and what needs to change, then design and implement the process changes to act on it.

- Identify process gaps with EPD and proactively develop just the right amount of process to fill the gap: not too much, not too little.

- Support planning activities and project tracking processes, helping keep them running smoothly and consistently across EPD.

- Help run project status reviews, leadership roadmap reviews, and priority reviews, making sure the right information is ready and the right people are in the room.

- Connect the dots across systems, processes, and teams, spotting where disconnected efforts overlap, conflict, or could be simplified, and acting on it.

- Jump in on whatever initiative pops up in EPD that needs support, structure, or someone to help carry it forward, whether or not it fits inside a defined program.

- Handle project retrospectives involving participants and stakeholders to understand what went well and what should be adjusted in future project work.

- Seek opportunities to bring about ongoing improvement and simplification in business operating procedures and practices, leading to improved efficiency and effectiveness.

 What We Are Looking For

greenhouse:taketwo:8165127.description:
Who We Are 

 Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. The Company develops and publishes products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, Private Division, and Zynga. Our products are currently designed for console gaming systems, PC, and Mobile, including smartphones and tablets, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO.

 While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

 The Challenge 

 Take-Two Interactive, Inc., a leader in the interactive entertainment industry, is looking for a talented Business Intelligence Developer to join a team responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making across the organization. 

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in SQL-based data analysis, has experience with Tableau Server/Online Administration. If you are self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, can communicate data-driven insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, have a strong eye for design of dashboards and data sources and are excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of data, design, and emerging AI/NLP technologies, this is the opportunity for you. 

 What You’ll Take On 

 •    Maintain and administer Tableau Server as a platform. 
•    Build and optimize Tableau data sources, including live connections and scheduled extracts, ensuring high availability and rapid load performance.
•    Write, tune, and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from relational databases and cloud data warehouses.
•    Partner with business teams, product managers, and analysts to translate complex requirements into scalable BI solutions that support a mix of strategic, tactical and operational reporting to ensure intuitive and visually compelling user experiences.
•    Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions.
•    Define and enforce data visualization standards, naming conventions, and best practices to ensure consistency and scalability across all BI deliverables.
•    Evaluate and implement emerging AI and NLP tools, including Amazon Q, to enhance self-service analytics and natural language querying capabilities for business users.
•    Maintain clear documentation for dashboards, data sources, and analytical processes to support knowledge sharing, onboarding, and audit readiness.

 What You Bring  

 •    4+ years of hands-on experience with building BI solutions preferably in Tableau. 
•    2+ years of Tableau Server/Online administration experience, including user and permissions management, site configuration, workbook publishing, extract scheduling, and performance optimization of workbooks and data sources.
•    Solid SQL proficiency for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Snowflake).
•    Experience conducting data analysis tasks including data cleaning, blending, aggregation, and root-cause investigation of data quality issues.
•    Strong communication skills with the ability to present data-driven insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
•    Comfortable working cross-functionally with business partners, data developers, and product teams in an agile environment to gather requirements and deliver BI solutions iteratively.
•    Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.

 •    Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Online Administration — 2+ years (required)
•    SQL — intermediate to advanced (required)
•    Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tool (required)

 Great to Have 

 •    Amazon Q or other NLP/AI analytics tools
•    AWS data services — Redshift, S3, QuickSight
•    Snowflake or other cloud data warehouse platforms
•    Python for data analysis and automation
•    Power BI or Looker
•    Experience in the gaming or interactive entertainment industry

 What We Offer You 

- Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.

- Growth. As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.

- Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.

- Benefits. Medical, dental, vision, pension plan, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!

- Perks. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events, stocked pantries and the ability to earn up to $500+ per year for taking care of yourself and more.

 The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $71,400 and $105,660 per year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. 

 Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. 

 Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

(“Take-Two”) is committed to fostering and celebrating the diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds of its talent, partners, and communities throughout its organization. Consistent with this commitment, Take-Two does not discriminate or retaliate against any employee or job applicant because of their race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, and genetic information (including family medical history), or on the basis of any other trait protected by applicable law. If you need to report a concern or have questions regarding Take-Two’s equal opportunity commitment, please contact  Careers@take2games.com

lever:telesat:b1330dc7-d42d-4d75-abaf-99.description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years.  Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.   The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite.  For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is responsible for driving integrated engineering execution across the Core User Terminal (Core UT) platform. This role serves as the central coordination point across multiple engineering disciplines, ensuring software, hardware, integration, test, and release activities are aligned to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes.   Working within the User Terminal Engineering organization, the Senior Engineering Delivery Manager partners closely with Engineering Managers, Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Verification & Validation, Architecture teams, and the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to manage cross-functional dependencies, integration readiness, execution risks, and release delivery.   As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making. Main Responsibilities:

Engineering Delivery Leadership

  • Own and maintain the integrated Core User Terminal delivery plan across multiple engineering teams and disciplines.
  • Drive execution coordination spanning software, modem hardware, systems engineering, integration, verification, validation, and release functions.
  • Establish and maintain delivery milestones, priorities, ownership, critical paths, and execution plans.
  • Identify, manage, and drive resolution of cross-functional dependencies, engineering risks, and delivery blockers.
  • Escalate unresolved issues and schedule risks to engineering leadership while recommending mitigation plans.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure engineering commitments support overall program objectives.
  • Provide Core UT execution status, risks, dependencies, and readiness assessments to support solution-level planning and governance activities led by the Solution RTE.

    •  

    Integration and Release Delivery

  • Lead planning and execution of platform integration and release activities across the Core UT product.
  • Drive integration readiness planning, execution tracking, and milestone achievement.
  • Develop and maintain release readiness criteria, quality gates, and go/no-go readiness reviews.
  • Coordinate system integration events across engineering disciplines.
  • Monitor and mitigate integration risks before they impact delivery commitments.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet agreed readiness requirements prior to formal release activities.
  • Support solution-level integration and release planning by providing accurate readiness assessments, dependency visibility, and risk mitigation plans.

    •  

    Delivery Governance and Execution Reporting

  • Provide consolidated delivery status and execution visibility to engineering leadership.
  • Develop and maintain engineering dashboards, milestone reporting, dependency trackers, risk registers, and blocker management processes.
  • Deliver regular execution reviews highlighting delivery progress, risks, mitigation actions, integration readiness, and release status.
  • Facilitate engineering delivery reviews and cross-functional coordination forums to maintain organizational alignment.
    Track delivery performance indicators and identify trends requiring management attention.
  • Represent Core UT delivery status and readiness in solution-level planning, synchronization, and governance forums.

    •  

    Cross-Functional Delivery Coordination

  • Partner with Product Management to translate approved scope and priorities into executable engineering plans.
    Collaborate with Program Management to ensure engineering execution accurately supports overall program planning and reporting.
  • Work with Engineering Managers to align team commitments, schedules, assumptions, and delivery objectives.
  • Coordinate with System Architects and technical specialists to convert architectural direction into executable work plans, milestones, and integration activities.
  • Partner with the Solution-level RTE to communicate Core UT delivery status, dependencies, execution risks, and milestone readiness.
  • Coordinate and manage cross-segment dependencies impacting solution-level commitments and releases.
  • Support resolution of integration, schedule, and execution issues affecting delivery across the broader Solution Train.
  • Represent Core UT engineering execution within solution-level planning and synchronization activities.

    •  

    Continuous Delivery Improvement

  • Lead lessons-learned and post-release reviews following major integration and release activities.
  • Develop metrics that improve delivery predictability, dependency management, blocker resolution, and release quality.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements that increase engineering effectiveness, execution transparency, and delivery reliability.
  • Contribute to the evolution of engineering operating models, integration practices, and delivery governance frameworks.
    • Success Measures:
  • Improved engineering delivery predictability across the Core UT platform.
  • Reduction in dependency-related schedule impacts.
  • Earlier identification and mitigation of integration and execution risks.
  • Improved release readiness and platform quality metrics.
  • Reduced aging of engineering blockers and unresolved dependencies.
  • Increased visibility and alignment across engineering, product, program, architecture, and Solution Train stakeholders.
  • Effective management and resolution of cross-segment dependencies supporting solution-level commitments.
  • Successful execution of major integration, validation, and release milestones.
    • Education and Experience Required:

    Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience leading complex engineering development programs in software, hardware, telecommunications, aerospace, networking, or related technology industries.
  • Experience coordinating multiple engineering teams in a highly technical product development environment.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional dependencies, integration activities, and release execution.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering, software development lifecycles, product development processes, and technical risk management.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence outcomes across organizations without direct authority.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Release Train Engineering, or similar execution frameworks.

    •  

    Preferred

  • Experience in satellite communications, wireless communications, networking, modem development, or user terminal systems.
  • Experience leading platform-level integration and release activities involving both hardware and software deliverables.
  • Familiarity with large-scale telecommunications or aerospace development programs.
  • SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), PMP, Agile, or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience developing engineering metrics, dashboards, and execution governance processes.
    • Organizational Relationships:

    The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is accountable for engineering execution, dependency management, integration readiness, and release coordination across the Core User Terminal platform.

    As the delivery lead for the UT segment, the role works closely with the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to ensure alignment of commitments, dependencies, milestones, and release readiness across the broader Lightspeed Solution Train. The role provides delivery visibility and execution coordination for Core UT while supporting solution-level planning, integration, and release objectives.

    Staffing, product prioritization, architecture decisions, and resource management remain the responsibility of Engineering Management, Product Management, and Systems Architecture.

    Working Conditions:
  • This role offers hybrid work environment.
  • Working conditions are generally comfortable typical of an office environment.
  • International travel is required.
  • This is a single contributor role.

    •  

    The successful candidate must be able to work in Canada and obtain clearance under the Canadian Controlled Goods program (CGP).

lever:telesat:200d134d-7e5f-4bff-b6b1-3e.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
lever:telesat:200d134d-7e5f-4bff-b6b1-3e.description:
The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise.  The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.   Key Responsibilities:

Program Integration and Enterprise Planning

  • Lead the development and maintenance of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) across all program segments.
  • Manage program-wide integrated budgets and long-term financial plans
  • Establish and manage cross-functional program dependencies, interfaces, and integration milestones.
  • Identify and escalate critical path risks, schedule variances, and program execution concerns.
  • Ensure consistent planning methodologies are applied across all participating organizations.
  • Coordinate enterprise-level planning activities to support strategic objectives and delivery commitments.
  • Facilitate integrated program reviews and milestone readiness assessments.

    •  

    PMO Governance and Program Controls

    • Develop and maintain PMO governance frameworks, procedures, standards, and operating models.
    • Establish stage-gate and phase review processes throughout the program lifecycle.
    • Drive compliance with program management policies, reporting requirements, and governance expectations.
    • Lead portfolio-level schedule, budget/cost, risk, and performance monitoring activities.
    • Establish and maintain accurate program health and performance metrics.
    • Ensure consistency of reporting, forecasting, and program status assessments across all segments.

      •  

      Executive Reporting and Decision Support

      • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and integrated program performance metrics.
      • Provide objective analysis of program execution, emerging risks, opportunities, and trends.
      • Support executive leadership reviews, and governance forums.
      • Prepare briefing materials, recovery plans, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
      • Present portfolio status, major issues, and critical decisions to senior leadership.

        •  

        Portfolio Performance Management

        • Establish and monitor key performance indicators for program execution.
        • Consolidate schedule, budget/cost, risk, and resource information
        • Analyze performance trends and identify corrective actions when required.
        • Ensure consistent measurement and reporting of program objectives and outcomes.
        • Lead program health assessments and maturity reviews.

          •  

          Risk, Dependency, and Change Integration

          • Oversee segment-level risk and dependency management processes.
          • Ensure critical cross-segment risks are identified, monitored, and escalated appropriately.
          • Support the program change management activities and impact assessments.
          • Facilitate issue resolution among stakeholders with competing priorities and objectives.
          • Support integrated decision-making across multiple organizations.

            •  

            Program Management Excellence

            • Establish and evolve the PMO as an enterprise center of excellence for program and project management, continuously developing frameworks, standards, methodologies, and capabilities aligned with organizational growth and program complexity.
            • Design, implement, and continuously improve PMO processes, templates, methodologies, governance artifacts, and toolsets, recognizing that many components of the future-state PMO operating model are still under development.
            • Lead the development and adoption of standardized planning, reporting, governance, and portfolio management practices across diverse stakeholder organizations with varying levels of project management maturity.
            • Provide guidance, mentorship, and functional leadership to Program Managers across the enterprise.
            • Promote best practices in planning, scheduling, governance, risk management, and reporting.
            • Lead PMO process improvement and capability development initiatives.

              •  

              Team Leadership

              • Build a high-performing PMO capability by establishing team structure, role definitions, responsibilities, competencies, and development plans aligned to future organizational needs.
              • Lead and develop PMO personnel, including program analysts, schedulers, program controllers, governance specialists, and reporting analysts.
              • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.
              • Support workforce planning and capability development within the PMO organization.
              • Ensure PMO resources effectively support enterprise priorities and delivery objectives.
Education and Experience required:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification
  • PMI Risk Management Professional (PMI-RMP) certification
  • PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) certification
  • PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
  • SAFe or equivalent Agile certification
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in project, program, portfolio, or PMO leadership roles.
  • 5+ years leading PMO, program controls, governance, program integration, or portfolio management functions.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing, transforming, or significantly maturing PMO organizations, governance frameworks, operating models, methodologies, and enterprise planning capabilities.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, complex engineering, aerospace, telecommunications, defense, or technology programs.
  • Experience working with executive leadership and governance boards.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience with integrated master planning, earned value management, portfolio reporting, and enterprise governance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing PMO transformations and organizational maturity initiatives
    • Knowledge and Skills:
    • PMO Transformation and Organizational Design
    • Process Development and Institutionalization
    • Organizational Influence without Authority
    • Building Structure in Ambiguous Environments
    • Enterprise Program Management
    • Integrated Master Scheduling
    • Oracle Primavera Cloud
    • Executive Reporting and Analytics
    • Risk and Opportunity Management
    • Governance Framework Development
    • Organizational Change Management
    • Resource and Capacity Planning
    • Strategic Planning
    • Stakeholder Management
    • Systems Thinking
    • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Financial Acumen
    • Negotiation and Influence
    • Conflict Resolution
    • Continuous Improvement
    Security & Compliance Requirements:
  • Canadian Reliability Status (Minimum) is required
  • Eligibility for Controlled Goods Program (CGP) Registration is required
  • Ability to handle controlled, sensitive, and export-regulated technical data in compliance with Canadian and international regulations

  • This role has direct reports and will work and interact with multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Working conditions are typical of a downtown Ottawa office environment.
  • Must be in-office 5x times a week (Monday-Friday)

Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.   The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite.  For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The successful candidate will lead and manage development of user terminal type approval and certification process, third-party vendor management, and definition of test procedures for the Telesat Lightspeed LEO constellation.    In addition, they will provide technical expertise in the development, integration, and productization of antennas and user terminal technology as it pertains to the needs and uses cases of satellite terminals. This position is also responsible for the creation and support of user terminal sales tools.   Resource is required to work onsite a minimum of 4 days per week Purpose of Job:
  • Lead and manage development of type approval for the User Terminals for the Telesat Lightspeed LEO constellation 
  • Manage third-party vendor inquires, evaluations and support
  • Provide technical expertise in the development, integration, and productization of antenna and modem technology as it pertains to the needs and uses cases of satellite terminals 
  • Deliver product requirements and technical specifications for use by internal and external development teams, including requirements for documentation 
  • Support sales and commercial go-to-market initiatives to drive service adoption that meet or exceed revenue targets 
    • Main Responsibilities :
  • As a member of the User Terminal team, you will be responsible for the definition, specifications, and process for third-party type approval and certification of user terminals on the Telesat Lightspeed network. 
  • Evaluation of antennas and user terminals with integrated and stand-alone modems. Upgrades from NGSO or multi-band/multi-orbit solutions 
  • Define test procedures, measurements, reports of terminal criteria including RF characteristics from accredited test labs certified 
  • Ensure that Telesat Lightspeed user terminal third-party process is designed to meet market needs to deliver the most compelling products and operate at the highest quality-of-service standards 
  • Work in close collaboration with Telesat’s systems engineering and technical product management teams to ensure seamless integration of terminal functionality and performance within the complete system and according to product roadmaps 
    • Education & Experience Required :
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or relevant discipline with an emphasis in communication systems or satellite terminals
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in product management in a STEM field with a minimum of 5 years in the satcom sector 
  • Master's degree or MBA is a plus 
  • Experience managing terminals, antennas or modems through a type of approval process is preferred. 
    • Specialized Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :
  • Knowledge of satellite antenna and modem technologies required for terminals
  • Knowledge of satellite markets and verticals such as Enterprise, Maritime, Land Mobility, Government, or Aviation
  • Knowledge of antenna, RF or modem certifications and homologation a plus 
  • Ability to write clear, concise and testable product requirements and experience in prioritization of features, enhancements and minimum  viable products 
  • Success in building winning communication products and managing long term roadmaps for complex communication systems 
  • Proven success collaborating with cross-functional teams including technology, business development, marketing, sales, 0peration and support 
  • Experience working with external vendors including outside design and manufacturing facilities 
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to summarize complex problems, solutions and recommendations for diverse audiences, including both technical and non-technical customers, colleagues and executives 
  • Fluent in English, written and oral  
    • Decision Making & Supervision :
  • Makes decisions about task priorities as required in the course of leading external vendor’s designs 
  • Self motivation and the drive to take on varied tasks through to conclusion 
  • The ability to work well with a diverse team spread around the world 
  • Ability to describe technical solutions in an easily readable, concise and accurate way 
  • Will need to execute in areas of ambiguity and make reasonable decisions 
    • Supervision Exercised :

  • Supervision of suppliers/contractor during supplier facing activities. 
    • Working Conditions :

  • Full-time office or hybrid 80/20 office/remote, subject to work needs 
  • Working conditions are generally comfortable typical of an office  environment. 
  • Occasional travel, including international travel is anticipated 
  • Candidate must be able to obtain relevant security clearance if based in  Canada

lever:telesat:bf7e1f06-4b8d-4410-a6f4-0d.group: telesat|user terminal program manager mil ka|ottawa
lever:telesat:bf7e1f06-4b8d-4410-a6f4-0d.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
lever:telesat:bf7e1f06-4b8d-4410-a6f4-0d.description:
As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment. Main Responsibilities:
  • Lead and drive execution of Mil-Ka user terminal development and integration programs, working with external terminal vendors and Telesat technical teams from requirements definition through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment.
  • Serve as a primary programmatic interface with Mil-Ka terminal vendors, establishing clear expectations for scope, deliverables, schedule, technical milestones, risks, actions, and contractual commitments.
  • Own end-to-end program planning and execution for assigned terminal programs, including contracts, statements of work, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, opportunities, dependencies, deliverables, and executive reporting.
  • Work closely with Product Management, Systems Engineering, User Terminal Engineering, software, RF/antenna, network, security, and other technical teams to translate program and mission requirements into executable vendor development plans.
  • Drive vendor performance against technical, schedule, cost, quality, and delivery commitments, identifying issues and dependencies early and coordinating recovery plans or escalation when required.
  • Plan and coordinate key program and engineering lifecycle reviews, including requirements reviews, design reviews, integration and test readiness activities, verification events, manufacturing readiness reviews, and other contractual milestones.
  • Coordinate user terminal integration, verification, qualification, and interoperability activities across vendor and Telesat teams to support readiness for operational deployment.
  • Support the definition, negotiation, and execution of development, supply, integration, and support agreements in partnership with Telesat engineering, procurement, legal, commercial, and contracts organizations.
  • Manage program interfaces and dependencies between the user terminal development effort and the broader Mil-Ka solution, including network integration, software, ground infrastructure, logistics, training, support, and deployment activities where applicable.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables, documentation, review packages, test results, action items, risks, decisions, and technical dependencies are tracked through closure.
  • Develop and maintain concise program management artifacts, dashboards, schedules, risk registers, and status reporting that provide clear visibility into program health, key decisions, emerging risks, and required leadership actions.
    • Education and Experience Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, program management, or a related discipline. A technical background in communications systems, satellite communications, RF systems, electronics, or related fields is preferred.
  • Minimum of 6 years of program or project management experience in a complex STEM environment, including experience within satellite communications, aerospace, defence, telecommunications, or a comparable technology sector.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external suppliers through complex hardware/software product development, system integration, qualification, manufacturing, and delivery programs.
  • Experience with government or defence satellite communications systems, military user terminals, tactical communications equipment, or other mission-critical communications systems is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing programs involving government customers, defence contractors, or government-specific technical and programmatic requirements is an asset.
  • Strong understanding of satellite user terminal architectures, with sufficient technical depth to work effectively with engineering organizations across RF, antennas, modems, networking, software, electronics, and system integration.
  • Experience managing requirements, statements of work, contractual deliverables, design reviews, verification activities, acceptance milestones, and supplier performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent and interdependent workstreams while maintaining accountability across geographically distributed internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Proven experience identifying and managing program risks, schedule dependencies, technical issues, cost pressures, and design trade-offs, with the ability to clearly communicate impacts and recommended actions to leadership.
  • Strong working knowledge of program and project management tools, including Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling tools such as Primavera, as well as Jira or similar work-management platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical, programmatic, supplier, government, and executive stakeholders.
  • PMP certification and/or a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
    • Decision Making and Supervision:
  • Establishes priorities and drives execution across multiple internal and supplier workstreams required to meet Mil-Ka user terminal program commitments.
  • Makes programmatic decisions within delegated authority and facilitates timely technical, contractual, or leadership decisions when issues exceed that authority.
  • Independently identifies emerging risks, schedule impacts, resource constraints, and cross-program dependencies and drives appropriate mitigation and escalation.
  • Highly self-directed, with the initiative and ownership mindset required to move complex programs forward in an environment where requirements and priorities may evolve.

    •  

    Supervision Exercised:
  • There is no direct reporting staff but this role is expected to lead multi-disciplinary project teams and/or provide technical assistance or guidance to other engineers or specialists;
  • Supervision of suppliers/contractor during supplier facing activities. 
    • Working Conditions:
  • This position will be based out of either the Ottawa, ON or Bethesda, MD office.
  • Hybrid (4 days in office, 1 day remote), subject to work needs.
  • Working conditions are generally typical of an office environment.
  • Periodic travel to supplier and Telesat locations is anticipated.

successfactors:careers.telus.com:6063883.description:
Description

 The Opportunity 

 Fully Managed, a TELUS company, helps organizations simplify, secure and modernize their technology environments through managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud and professional services.

 We're looking for an Account Manager focused on new-logo acquisition and growth. This is a consultative sales role for someone who can create opportunities, qualify them thoughtfully, build credibility with business and technology leaders, and lead opportunities from initial engagement through commercial close.

 You'll benefit from access to TELUS's extensive sales channels, established client relationships and internal referral networks. However, we're equally interested in what you can bring to the table. You'll be expected to actively develop new business through your own professional network, industry connections, social media and direct engagement with prospective clients.

 We believe business development is everyone's responsibility. Whether an opportunity comes through a TELUS referral, an existing client relationship or a conversation within your own network, we encourage our people to recognize genuine opportunities and make meaningful connections.

 Our approach is relationship-first. We aren't looking for someone who simply pushes products or waits for leads to arrive. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about other businesses, comfortable initiating conversations and proactive about creating opportunities where there's a genuine fit.

 You'll work closely with TELUS sales teams and Fully Managed technical, strategy and service-delivery resources to develop the right solutions and bring the right expertise into each pursuit.

 What You’ll Do 

 Create opportunities and build relationships 

- 
 Proactively generate new business through your professional network, referrals, industry relationships, social media, targeted outreach and direct engagement with prospective clients

- 
 Leverage TELUS sales channels, account teams and internal referral networks to develop and advance qualified managed-services opportunities

- 
 Build lasting relationships with business owners, executives and technology leaders, identifying where Fully Managed can address meaningful business and technology challenges

- 
 Create opportunities through authentic conversations, thoughtful follow-up and consistent relationship development, rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads or assigned opportunities

- 
 Cultivate referrals through existing relationships, satisfied clients, TELUS colleagues and the broader Fully Managed team

 Own the sales process 

- 
 Take ownership of new-logo managed IT opportunities from initial engagement through commercial close

- 
 Lead structured discovery to understand a prospective client's business, technology environment, operational challenges, risks and desired outcomes

- 
 Qualify opportunities around the fundamentals that make a pursuit real: why change, why now and why Fully Managed?

- 
 Identify the economic buyer, key stakeholders, decision criteria, budget expectations and commercial process

- 
 Establish clear, mutual next steps that create momentum and move qualified opportunities toward a decision

- 
 Maintain accurate opportunity stages, close dates, next steps and forecast categories in Salesforce

 Develop solutions and drive growth 

- 
 Partner with technical, strategy and service-delivery resources to validate client environments, develop solutions and shape proposals

- 
 Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes that resonate with executive and operational stakeholders

- 
 Present managed-services solutions and commercial recommendations to prospective clients

- 
 Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes while maintaining accountability for the opportunity

- 
 Identify opportunities for additional TELUS and Fully Managed solutions where they create meaningful client value

- 
 Participate in win/loss reviews and apply lessons learned to improve qualification, positioning, commercial strategy and conversion

 What Success Looks Like 

 You build a pipeline that is not only large enough, but credible and executable.

 You consistently create opportunities through both TELUS-supported channels and your own business-development efforts. Your professional relationships are an active source of introductions, referrals and new conversations.

 Your opportunities have clear business drivers, engaged decision-makers and defined next steps. You know which pursuits deserve investment, which require further qualification, and which should be removed from the active forecast.

 You create productive relationships with TELUS sellers and internal delivery teams, bring the right expertise into opportunities at the right time, and consistently move qualified opportunities toward a decision.

 Ultimately, success is measured by new clients acquired, recurring revenue generated, self-sourced pipeline, pipeline quality and predictable conversion.

 Qualifications

 What You’ll Bring 

- 
 5+ years of experience in B2B technology, managed services, telecommunications, SaaS or other technical consultative sales environment

- 
 Demonstrated experience developing and closing new business

- 
 A track record of generating your own opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals or relationship-driven business development

- 
 Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the confidence to ask thoughtful, sometimes challenging questions to uncover a prospective client's true needs

- 
 Experience engaging multiple stakeholders, including business leaders, finance, IT and executive decision-makers

- 
 Ability to translate technical concepts into business value and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

- 
 Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish genuine buying intent from exploratory or price-shopping activity

- 
 Experience managing a sales pipeline and maintaining accurate opportunity and forecast data

- 
 Familiarity with managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud or infrastructure solutions is strongly preferred

- 
 A degree or diploma is an asset, but equivalent practical experience is equally valued

 How You Work 

 You are curious, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership.

 You build trust quickly without being transactional. You prepare well, ask thoughtful questions and listen closely enough to understand what is actually driving a client's decision.

 You have the initiative to build your own network and create opportunities. Whether you're reconnecting with a former colleague, attending an industry event, engaging with someone on LinkedIn or following up on a referral, you're comfortable starting conversations and exploring where TELUS Fully Managed might be a good fit.

 You're persistent without being pushy. You recognize that strong business development comes from credibility, consistent follow-through and a genuine interest in helping clients succeed.

 You also understand that selling managed services is a team sport. You know when to involve technical specialists, service-delivery leaders and executives while remaining accountable for moving the opportunity forward.

 What You’ll Find at TELUS Fully Managed 

- 
 Competitive base compensation with uncapped commission potential

- 
 TELUS RSP matching and employee share programs

- 
 Additional TELUS employee perks

- 
 Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

- 
 Access to established TELUS sales channels, referral networks and client relationships

- 
 Dedicated technical, strategy and service-delivery experts who support complex client pursuits

- 
 Professional development and career opportunities across Fully Managed and TELUS

- 
 A collaborative environment where sales, technical and operational teams work together to acquire new clients and deliver exceptional client experiences

successfactors:careers.telus.com:6068905.description:
Description

 Ready to drive innovation and efficiency to support awesome customer experiences? 

 Join our team 

 The P&C Operations team is passionate about providing team members with positive experiences, from their pay to the tools we use to support our Total Rewards processes and programs. We want to be easier to do business with and we’ve been innovating and elevating ourselves to provide delightful experiences. This team has deep knowledge and experience and take great pride in their delivery of services to our customers – the TELUS team.

 Here’s the impact you’ll make and what we’ll accomplish together! 

 You’re a dynamic team player who will drive our Total Rewards & supporting operational strategy forward. Your curiosity, collaboration expertise, strong accounting education and experience along with a desire for life-long learning are strengths that will be critical in the delivery of our services. Your experience using SAP as your platform for service delivery, investigations and problem solving, will support your individual and team goals. Your insightful portfolio analytics and recommendations, knowledge of our processes and identification of areas of opportunity will influence strategic decisions made by leaders. You’ll also team up with friendly, supportive internal partners, including your colleagues, leadership, controllers, key business stakeholders and external stakeholders, such as government agencies, to shape the future of work.

 Here's how: 

 Operate as a Trusted Advisor, Subject Matter Expert and Leader in Financial/Payroll Accounting :

- 
 Provide guidance to the P&C Operations leadership team and act as a subject matter expert that can be relied upon in day-to-day and unique situations

- 
 Showcase your proven ability to build relationships in a national and remote environment, at all levels of the organization 

- 
 Represent P&C Operations in work, interactions. meetings and projects, on a regular basis

- 
 Collaborate with key stakeholders to support various programs for our team members, including recommendations to gain direction, alignment, and support from your leader 

- 
 Informally lead and provide support to our off-shore team of financial analysts 

 Execution and/or support of our biweekly, monthly, quarterly and annual payroll accounting functions: 

- 
 Accountable for payroll postings, GL accounts, journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, employee receivables, liability and expenses, banking accounts and major payroll government remittances including CRA and MRQ 

- 
 Manage inputs and outputs of payroll financials ensuring compliance with TELUS policies, legislated or collective agreement negotiated requirements, federal or provincial legislation 

- 
 Lead for portfolio, both internal and external auditor’s Sarbanes-Oxley control requirements to ensure integrity of data and brand of TELUS

- 
 Accountable for the accuracy, limit in use and protection of team member data within your role 

- 
 Leverage and enhance our use of the SAP payroll and financial systems to support your deliverables 

 Provide critical business insights and thought leadership: 

- 
 Prepare and deliver compelling executive level presentations with thoughtful recommendations using your advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities in conjunction with your excellent verbal and written communication skills

- 
 Identify, develop and implement radical simplification and everyday innovation as part of our everyday culture 

- 
 Leverage financial information to create and support companywide financial projections, modelling and budgeting

- 
 Provide expertise in payroll/accounting processes and related system requirements for HR and payroll financial operations 

- 
 Create financial reporting and related processes to support evolving customer demands

 Qualifications

 What You’ll Bring 

- 
 More than 10 years of experience in payroll and financial accounting, systems and compliance across federal, provincial and collective agreement environments within large, complex organizations

- 
 Payroll accounting/accounting designation (CPA, CGA, CMA, CA) or equivalent

- 
 Strong quantitative, problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for senior leadership

- 
 Advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP Human Resources (HR) and Financial Information (FI) modules

- 
 Demonstrated ability to build relationships and lead change through team-oriented collaboration at all levels of the organization

- 
 Excellent organizational, prioritization and facilitation skills with a commitment to accuracy and attention to detail

- 
 Experience working with Canada Revenue Agency (CRA), Revenu Québec and internal and external auditors

- 
 recognized for your excellence in accuracy, attention to detail and protection of team member data in your stewardship 

- 
 Commitment to protecting team member data and upholding privacy and compliance standards

- 
 Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment, with a drive for continuous learning and professional development

 Nice-to-haves  

- 
 Experience working in SAP cloud environments

- 
 Bilingual in English and French (written and oral)

 Advanced knowledge of English is required because you will most of the time interact in English with external parties (clients, suppliers, candidates, external partners, etc.); interact in English with internal parties (colleagues, internal partners, stakeholders, etc.) as part of this position's main responsibilities given its national scope. 

 A bit about us 

 Our business is connecting Canadians. Our social impact is using our world-leading technology to create meaningful change, give back to help communities thrive, and help those who need it most. When you join our team, you’re helping us make the future friendly. We’re committed to diversity and equitable access to employment opportunities based on ability —your unique contributions and talents will be valued and respected here.

successfactors:careers.telus.com:5961725.description:
Join TELUS and Elevate Your Sales Career! 

Are you a natural at building relationships and negotiating? Do you excel in critical thinking, communication, and delivering exceptional client experiences with innovative solutions for business owners? If so, TELUS has the perfect opportunity for you!

As an Account Manager, you are creative, resilient, and passionate about learning and exceeding sales goals. You find real solutions for small and medium business owners from our core Business products (Mobility, Fibre Internet, Business Security Services, Fleet Services (IoT), VOIP) so that they can stay focused on growing their business.

 Why Choose TELUS SMB 

- Uncapped Commission: Earn competitive pay with uncapped commission potential and generous TELUS Shares contributions

- Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy comprehensive benefits from day one and a health spending account

- Accelerate in Sales: Thrive in a high-velocity, winning-focused environment with top-notch training and development tools

- Career Growth: Unlock opportunities for advancement into advanced sales or leadership roles within SMB or across TELUS

- Personal Growth: Benefit from leading-edge training tools and supportive managers who care about your development

- Fastest-Growing Segment: Join the industry’s largest and fastest-growing Small Medium Business segment

 Here's how 

- Account Management: Effectively manage medium business accounts (1-100 employees), ensuring continuous business development and growth

successfactors:careers.telus.com:6000623.description:
Description

 Empower Canadian Businesses with Game-Changing Technology! 

 Are you a driven, energetic sales professional who loves prospecting new business and helping them succeed with the right solutions? Join TELUS as an Account Manager and help businesses succeed with our 100% fiber optic network – TELUS PureFibre – and a powerful suite of innovative solutions.

 Who We Are 

 TELUS Small Medium Business (SMB) is the fastest-growing and largest business segment in the industry. We're revolutionizing how Canadian businesses access and utilize technology, making it secure, simple, and worry-free. As we continue our journey to become the digital-first technology provider of choice, we're looking for talented sales professionals to join our winning team.

 Your Role 

 As an Account Manager, you'll be a hunter who prospects new business daily through strategic outreach. You will actively engage with 30-40 potential business clients per day within your territory to introduce TELUS solutions, qualify prospects, and close deals. You're not just a salesperson – you're a trusted advisor who will build relationships and help businesses thrive in the digital age. You'll leverage your passion for technology, creativity, resilience, and love of learning to exceed sales goals while providing real solutions from our comprehensive portfolio

 Here’s how: 

- Hunt and develop new business through strategic territory management, in-field visits, and proactive outreach

- Build a robust pipeline by connecting with prospective customers through a mix of in-person visits, networking, and business development activities
Deliver consultative solutions tailored to each business's unique needs, including internet, mobility, security, and cloud solutions

- Cultivate long-term partnerships with clients who see you as their trusted technology advisor

- Achieve and exceed monthly sales targets while maintaining a focus on customer success

- Maintain accurate records in our CRM to track opportunities and customer interactions

- Represent TELUS at networking events and own your territory like an entrepreneur

 What's In It For You 

- Realistic Earnings Expectations:

- Full OTE: $104,000 - $119,000 (based on 100% quota)

- Base Salary: $50,000 - $65,000 (based on experience)

- Top Performers: $130,000+. Accelerator program & commission plan designed to reward your success!

- Generous TELUS share purchase program with company contributions

- Comprehensive benefits from day one

- Industry-leading training and development programs

- Clear career progression path to advanced sales and leadership roles

- Mentorship from top-performing sales leaders

- Supportive, high-performance team environment

 Qualifications

 What You'll Bring 

- Hunter mentality and drive: you’re energized by high-volume prospecting, cold calling and door-to-door sales

- Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

- Strong organizational and time management abilities

- Resilience and coachability, open to feedback

- Entrepreneurial mindset with genuine interest in technology solutions

- Valid driver's license (field-based role with territory responsibility)

- Comfort with autonomous field work and self-directed prospecting

 Preferred (but we’ll train the right attitude): 

- 1-2 years of B2B sales experience (door-to-door, field sales, outside sales or retail)

- CRM experience (Salesforce or similar platforms)

- Post-secondary education in business or related field

- Experience in field sales, outside sales, or territory management

- Background in technology, telecommunications, or SaaS sales

 Work Environment 

- Dynamic blend of in-office collaboration and autonomous field work

- Territory-based responsibility with entrepreneurial freedom

- Access to cutting-edge sales technology and tools

- Supportive team atmosphere with collaborative culture

 Ready to make an impact? Join our winning team and help shape the future of business technology with TELUS PureFibre. Your success story starts here!

successfactors:careers.telus.com:6031074.description:
Description

 TELUS Health's Employer Solutions supports the health and wellbeing of over 35 million lives worldwide with our clinical expertise, global presence and digital well-being platforms. We’re committed to building the healthiest workplaces on the planet.

 That’s why we offer employers a range of services and tools to empower healthier, happier, and more productive employees with proactive wellness solutions in a digital ecosystem that helps them prevent and manage issues and concerns about family, health, life, money, and work.

 The TELUS Health's Employer Solutions team is focused on delivering high quality care through highly personalized care, enhanced employers and employees experiences and easy access to a broad range of services such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) as well as primary care, virtual care, preventive health, wellness, mental health, occupational and executive health.

 Our team and what we'll accomplish together 

 The Specialty Sales team is the backbone of our Employer Solutions growth strategy. We partner directly with Business Development and Customer Success teams across Canada to deepen product knowledge, unlock complex EAP solutions, and drive adoption of new launches from day one—across SMB to Enterprise customers.

 As an Account Manager on this team, you'll be the trusted advisor and solution architect who helps our sales force win deals at every customer size, retain customers through strategic bundling, and position TELUS Health as the partner that truly understands their evolving workforce needs.

 With no commission splits, our sales force actively brings us into their most strategic opportunities—making this a role where your expertise directly influences revenue growth and customer outcomes. 

 Key Responsibilities 

- Win new business: Partner with Business Development teams on net-new sales opportunities, bringing deep EAP product expertise and Life Moments solution design to win deals across SMB to Enterprise segments

- Enable the sales force: Receive specialized product training—including demo capabilities and direct access to Product and Marketing teams—then equip the broader organization with launch strategies, client-ready messaging, and objection-handling tools that go beyond standard Employer Solutions training

- Lead client conversations differently: Position TELUS Health as a Wellbeing Prevention Partner in every sales conversation, not just an EAP vendor

- Drive upsell and cross-sell through life moments: Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to identify growth opportunities—helping clients adopt additional TELUS Health solutions that address evolving workforce needs before they escalate into absence, claims, or disengagement

- Design complex, bundled solutions: Translate customer pain points into tailored product recommendations. Build the case for bundles that span mental health, caregiving, financial wellbeing, and return-to-work solutions—connecting the story to specific employee life moments

- Bridge Sales, Product, and Marketing: Act as the strategic liaison gathering client feedback, identifying market patterns, and feeding insights back to Product and Marketing to sharpen the Life Moments narrative and inform go-to-market decisions

- Champion post-sale adoption: Partner with CSMs to ensure clients realize full value—and recognize TELUS Health as their trusted advisor for whatever their employees face next

 Qualifications

 Must Have 

- 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or solution selling—preferably in benefits, HR technology, EAP, or employee wellness solutions

- Deep familiarity with Employee Assistance Programs, benefits bundling, and how wellbeing solutions address employees across key life moments—health, family, financial, and workplace transitions

- Ability to internalize and articulate a new go-to-market framework (Life Moments) and train others on it quickly, clearly, and credibly

- Proven ability to influence and partner with sales teams without direct authority—overlay or matrix environment experience is a strong asset

- Strong consultative selling skills: the ability to translate complex, multi-product solutions into a compelling client story

- Excellent communication and presentation skills—able to engage Business Development reps, CSMs, clients, and executives with equal confidence

- Cross-functional experience working with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to drive go-to-market initiatives

- A track record of learning new products quickly and enabling others through structured training on features, benefits, and messaging

 Great to Have 

- Experience in the Canadian employer or benefits market with familiarity with regional workforce challenges

- A track record of successfully launching new products or services and driving adoption across sales organizations

- Direct B2B sales experience in consultative or solution-based selling environments

- Familiarity with TELUS Health products, services, or the competitive landscape in the Employer Solutions space

- Experience presenting EAP or wellness solutions to HR leaders, benefits managers, or C-suite stakeholders

- Bilingualism English and French (strong asset)

 Knowledge of English is required because you will on a regular basis interact in English with external parties (clients, suppliers, candidates, external partners, etc.); interact in English with internal parties (colleagues, internal partners, stakeholders, etc.); and work with IT tools whose interface is only accessible in English as part of this position's main responsibilities given its national scope.

Description

 Accelerate Revenue Growth in Canada's Mid-Market Technology Sector 

 TELUS is seeking a High-Velocity Sales account manager to proactively acquire new named accounts and drive rapid revenue expansion across Canada's mid-market segment. This is fast-paced, results-driven selling for competitive sales professionals who excel at prospecting, closing new business, and maximizing account value through strategic upsells and cross-sells.

 The Role 

 Drive your territory with a hunter's mentality - prospect proactively, close deals fast, then expand strategically. Leverage TELUS's comprehensive technology portfolio (5G, IoT, AI, cybersecurity, cloud) to rapidly convert prospects into customers, then unlock additional revenue through targeted upsells and cross-sells. This is high-velocity selling focused on both net-new customer acquisition and accelerated account growth.

 Responsibilities :

- 
 Prospect new named accounts through cold calling, social selling, networking, and targeted outreach campaigns

- 
 Rapidly qualify and close new business opportunities with short sales cycles (30-90 days)

- 
 Maximize account value through strategic upsells and cross-sells across TELUS's technology portfolio

- 
 Drive velocity - maintain high activity levels for both new customer acquisition and account expansion

- 
 Build pipeline relentlessly - maintain 3-4x coverage through continuous prospecting while nurturing existing accounts

- 
 Execute high-volume outreach - 50+ prospecting touches daily across calls, emails, and social channels

- 
 Manage account growth - develop expansion strategies for closed accounts to unlock additional revenue

- 
 Compete and win - outmaneuver competitors through speed, persistence, and compelling differentiation

- 
 Leverage PSO methodologies to accelerate deal velocity and maximize total account revenue

 What we are looking for: 

 ✓ GRIT: Energy & Drive - Relentless prospecting, competitive fire, rejection resilience, self-motivation

 ✓ Customer Focus - Consultative approach, authentic customer advocacy, solution-oriented mindset, exceptional experience delivery

 ✓ Organizational Discipline - Skilled in managing high-volume pipelines, including rigorous activity tracking, forecast accuracy, and handling both net-new and upsell opportunities

 ✓ Business Acumen - Quick pain point identification, rapid ROI articulation, portfolio knowledge

 Qualifications

- 
 3+ years new business acquisition and account growth in B2B sales

- 
 Proven hunter mentality with consistent track record of exceeding new revenue and expansion quotas

- 
 Demonstrated success with rapid deal closure and strategic account expansion

- 
 Cold calling/prospecting expertise - comfortable with high daily activity levels

- 
 Account management skills - ability to identify expansion opportunities and execute cross-sell strategies

-

 Structured sales methodology experience (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN)

You'll have access to a comprehensive technology portfolio with multiple entry points, competitive compensation with accelerators for new logos and account growth, diverse revenue streams from net-new and expansion opportunities, and a meritocratic culture rewarding top performers.
