 Join us in providing TELUS Business Solutions to medium and large-sized organizations. 

 TELUS is seeking skilled sales professionals driven by a commitment to surpassing customer expectations and revenue goals. Joining the TELUS Business Solutions Sales team means embodying the TELUS brand and our core values:

- We passionately put our customers and communities first

- We embrace change and innovate courageously

- We grow together through spirited teamwork

Our goal is to help owners and executives stay focused on their key priorities and partner with them on their important journeys. As a sales professional at TELUS, you will take on a challenging and consultative role that offers a balance of autonomy and collaboration.

As an Account Manager, your primary objective is to enhance TELUS' presence in the Commercial market by delivering innovative technology solutions that align with the client's core business objectives. In this role, you will focus on addressing and exploring a wide range of services, including MPLS, business internet, security, SaaS & IaaS, unified cloud communication, mobility, and IoT (Internet of Things). By leveraging these solutions, you will help clients optimize their business strategies and achieve their desired outcomes. This will be supported by TELUS' internal subject matter experts, coaches, training resources and collaborative partnerships with external associates.

 How you will be successful

- Grow/maintain revenue and develop new business opportunities in existing or new commercial customers

- Champion TELUS within customer organizations while advocating internally for them

- Partner with an interdependent account team of specialty sales and technical pre-sales, and draw in executive leaders as needed

- Demonstrate key sales competencies such as Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Customer Focus, Grit (Energy and Drive), and Teamwork/Collaboration

 We foster a fantastic culture where individual and team success is celebrated. We believe in having fun while achieving our goals

 What you’ll do 

- Prepare professional proposals targeted to the key decision makers (usually senior managers or C-Suite) that clearly communicate TELUS’ first in-class solutions and value proposition to the customers' business problem

- Negotiate contracts, initiating orders and pursuing new business with grit, energy, and determination 

- Provide feedback to marketing and sales regarding potential challenges in our business, opportunities, and competitive insights

- Effectively create, manage and close a funnel of opportunities and sales operations utilizing the power of SalesForce

 Qualifications

 Some key attributes and skills that you possess include 

- You demonstrate business and technical acumen, effectively by identifying and communicating financially sound TELUS solutions while leveraging your understanding of technologies, products, services, and resources

- You have a proven track record of fostering strong, trust-based relationships that align with TELUS' value proposition

- You possess strong customer understanding and responsiveness, with analytical skills to prioritize and make fact-based decisions. You are skilled at negotiating mutually satisfactory resolutions

- As part of the role, it is essential to possess a valid driver's license and be willing to travel as required

- Vendor certifications such as AWS, Microsoft and others in the fields of AI and Cloud.

- Visibility with TELUS’ senior leadership teams in support of our largest customers in Canada

- A key role in transforming TELUS’ Enterprise strategy with key clients

- The opportunity to work and collaborate with a passionate team driven by the desire to deliver a best-in-class client experience

- Optional stock purchase plan, dedication to a diverse and inclusive team culture with loads of career development opportunities, flexible Total Rewards benefit plan with many innovative options and programs including a Direct Contribution Pension, flexible work styles, and more

- Flexible workplace culture, allowing team members to have the freedom to work remotely or in the office according to their preferences and job requirements. This flexibility promotes work-life balance and fosters a productive and inclusive work environment

 TELUS actively promotes gender diversity and equality in the workplace. We value the unique perspectives and contributions of all individuals, regardless of gender, and strive to create an inclusive environment that fosters growth and opportunities for everyone.

You will work alongside world-class solution architects, account strategists, and delivery leaders who are as invested in your success as they are in our customers' outcomes.

 What you will do 

- Lead enterprise business solutions sales initiatives for strategic accounts using TELUS's Premier Sales Organization (PSO) methodology

- Build and cultivate long-term executive relationships with C-suite decision-makers (CIOs, CFOs, CEOs, business unit leaders), uncovering strategic business challenges and translating complex technology into business outcomes

- Develop custom, business-outcome-focused executive proposals written in customer terminology and lead contract negotiations with procurement and executive teams to close multi-million-dollar deals

 Qualifications

 What you bring 

- Proven success managing complex, long-cycle enterprise technology or telecommunications sales with a track record of closing deals in the $500K+ range

- Consultative approach and executive presence – you ask strategic questions before presenting solutions, listen to clients' business challenges, and command respect in boardrooms with clarity and confidence

- Demonstrated ability to navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes, coordinate complex deal cycles involving solution architects, vendor partners, legal teams, procurement teams, and executive sponsors

- Working knowledge of digital transformation trends, cloud migration, and modern enterprise IT architectures (you don't need to be a technologist, but you understand how these technologies impact business operations and competitive advantage)

- Prior experience selling across multiple technology domains or demonstrated ability to quickly learn integrated solutions architecture

Description

 Join our team 

Saskatchewan agriculture is at an inflection point. The province generates over $21.5B in annual farm revenue across roughly 34,000 operations – many of them large-scale, mechanized grain and oilseed producers managing thousands of acres. These farmers face real, mounting pressures: volatile weather and input costs, complexity across multiple fields and systems, and the need to optimize every decision for ROI.

 Decisive Farming is positioned exactly where Saskatchewan farmers need us. Our award-winning Farm at Hand software and integrated agronomy platform help commercial-scale producers make better decisions faster – consolidating fragmented data, delivering prescription planning tied to profitability, and simplifying operations across large acreages. Backed by TELUS, Decisive Farming by TELUS Agriculture & Consumer Goods is the trusted advisor platform for Saskatchewan's progressive farming community.

We're growing our presence in Saskatchewan, and we're looking for a driven Account Manager to build a territory in Regina and across the province – someone who understands Saskatchewan farming and can earn trust with the farmers and advisors who shape the region's agricultural success. This is a territory with significant whitespace – room to build a customer base, establish yourself as a trusted advisor in the region, and grow revenue alongside Decisive Farming's expansion.

 What you'll do 

As our new Account Manager you'll manage a growing territory across Saskatchewan, building high-trust relationships with commercial grain producers, mixed operations, retailers, and agronomists. Working alongside our customer success team and reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you'll own the full sales cycle – from territory planning through closing deals and expanding customer value.

 Sales excellence 

- Sell and differentiate Optimize RX, crop marketing solutions, IoT, and Sure Check to new and existing customers, targeting large grain producers, mixed operations, and agricultural advisors

- Build an annual territory business plan, reviewed monthly with leadership, that identifies priority accounts and market opportunities

- Manage a portfolio of accounts through the full sales pipeline, maintaining a strong closure rate and average revenue per account

- Use Salesforce CRM strategically to forecast, track pipeline, and inform territory strategy

- Work with leadership to execute corporate sales strategy while respecting Saskatchewan's seasonal cycles and market realities

 Customer success and advisory 

- Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, helping farmers connect agronomic planning with measurable ROI and operational efficiency

- Provide frontline technical support to customers (software navigation, file loading, troubleshooting)

- Collaborate with our customer success team to ensure customers realize value and expand adoption across multiple products

- Nurture and grow retail partner and agronomy advisor relationships, deepening their ability to serve their grower customers

 Market presence and growth 

- Participate in trade shows, farm events, and community activities that build Decisive Farming's visibility and credibility in Saskatchewan

- Develop and manage a promotional territory budget that strengthens brand presence locally

- Build a network of anchor customers and influencers who become proof points for other prospects in the region

 Together, these activities build a territory where Decisive Farming is known for trusted partnerships, consistent growth, and measurable farmer outcomes.

 Qualifications

 What you bring 

 Must-haves 

- Consultative mindset – genuine curiosity about farmer challenges and commitment to solutions that drive long-term profitability and operational success, not just short-term sales

- Farm credibility – background in farming, crop input sales, agronomy, farm retail advisory, or another ag-adjacent role. This might be direct farming experience, working with crop inputs or seeds, advising on agronomy, or helping farmers through a retail or advisory partnership – the key is understanding Saskatchewan farming and farmer decision-making

- Direct sales experience – proven track record of closing deals in a farm or agricultural business environment

- Strong relationship-building skills – ability to speak confidently at the farm level, listen effectively, and earn trust with both farmers and ag professionals

- Data-driven mindset – comfort with farm financials (accounting, ROI, margin analysis) and ability to help farmers see the business case for digital tools

- Salesforce proficiency – able to maintain disciplined pipeline, forecast accurately, and use CRM insights to inform strategy

- Organizational excellence – ability to manage multiple priorities, execute territory plans, and follow through on commitments

 Great-to-haves 

- Sales training or certification

- CCA or P.Ag credentials

- Experience with farm management software, precision ag platforms, or ag retail advisory tools

 Why join us 

 You're not just selling software – you're helping Saskatchewan farmers make better decisions on thousands of acres. Your work directly impacts real operations, real margins, and real sustainability outcomes. You'll build a territory known for trusted advisory partnerships and measurable customer success, positioning yourself as a respected voice in Saskatchewan agriculture.

You'll have support from a dedicated customer success team, marketing resources, and regional leadership focused on your success. And you'll be part of a company backed by TELUS' investment and resources, with the agility of a specialized ag tech business that knows this market intimately.

As you build this territory, you'll have opportunities to mentor other account managers, move into team leadership, or expand into adjacent markets. Top performers in this role have a clear path forward.

lever:tracktik:f5025efd-f145-445c-a142-b.description:
At Trackforce, we are transforming physical security operations that are managed around the world. As the leading SaaS platform for physical security workforce management, we provide security companies and organizations with a streamlined solution to manage their guard forces, respond faster, operate more efficiently, and reduce costs — all while staying focused on safety and protection.
We support 4,600+ clients across more than 50 countries and are proud to be a growing team of 300+ professionals. With our headquarters in Dallas, Texas, and Centers of Excellence in Montreal, Quebec and Wroclaw, Poland, we collaborate across regions and time zones in a hybrid work environment that combines flexibility, connection, and meaningful impact.
At Trackforce, we operate in both hybrid and remote models, offering flexibility to balance in‑office collaboration with WFH. This approach allows our teams to stay connected while maintaining autonomy and work‑life balance. We are highly focused on delivering value to our customers, and our recent merger has strengthened our position as the market leader in security workforce management software.


What We're Looking For
The Digital Client Success Advisor is responsible for driving scalable customer success outcomes across a high-volume portfolio through digital-first engagement strategies. This role ensures customers adopt the platform effectively, achieve their desired outcomes, and contribute positively to Gross Renewal Retention,Gross Retention, Net Retention, and CSQL generation. The Advisor uses data, automation tools, and structured digital programs to proactively manage customer health and support renewals, while minimizing the need for high-touch interactions. 
What You'll be Doing
1. Digital Customer Engagement & Adoption 
Execute digital and automated engagement strategies that guide customers throughout their lifecycle.

lever:tracktik:b368bd22-96d3-4bd5-95da-e.title: Finance Business Partner
lever:tracktik:b368bd22-96d3-4bd5-95da-e.description:
At Trackforce, we are transforming physical security operations that are managed around the world. As the leading SaaS platform for physical security workforce management, we provide security companies and organizations with a streamlined solution to manage their guard forces, respond faster, operate more efficiently, and reduce costs — all while staying focused on safety and protection.
We support 4,600+ clients across more than 50 countries and are proud to be a growing team of 300+ professionals. With our headquarters in Dallas, Texas, and Centers of Excellence in Montreal, Quebec and Wroclaw, Poland, we collaborate across regions and time zones in a hybrid work environment that combines flexibility, connection, and meaningful impact.
At Trackforce, we operate in both hybrid and remote models, offering flexibility to balance in‑office collaboration with WFH. This approach allows our teams to stay connected while maintaining autonomy and work‑life balance. We are highly focused on delivering value to our customers, and our recent merger has strengthened our position as the market leader in security workforce management software.


Your Mission
Reporting to the Director, Financial Planning & Analysis, the Finance Business Partner plays a critical role at the intersection of FP&A and business strategy. You will support cross-functional financial planning, build strategic partnerships with business leaders, and deliver insights that drive high-impact decision-making. This role goes beyond reporting and modeling - it's about connecting the dots across departments to influence outcomes and support the company’s growth trajectory. We deeply embrace AI and emerging technology — not as a buzzword, but as a core lever for how we plan, report, and make decisions.
Role & Responsibilities
· Act as a strategic finance partner to department leaders, building trusted relationships and providing guidance rooted in data-driven insights.
· Support the financial planning process for your assigned function, contributing to comprehensive financial models, budgeting/forecasting, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis using Adaptive Planning.
o Develop a firm grasp of adaptive planning and own accountability for all inputs and outputs from Adaptive.
· Leverage AI & BI tools — automating variance analysis and forecast workflows to make reporting faster, cleaner, and more automated — and collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to surface actionable insights from financial and operational data.
o Help identify and apply tools that make reporting faster, cleaner, and more automated.
· Own and improve cadence reporting — support weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting cycles, with an eye toward automation and process improvement wherever manual work can be reduced.
· Deliver high-level financial analysis, performance reporting, and recommendations to drive key business decisions and strategic initiatives.
· Contribute to the development, maintenance, and evolution of key financial and operational dashboards that support executive decision-making.
· Proactively analyze business performance and trends, identifying risks, opportunities, and improvement areas to inform leadership.
· Contribute to business case development for strategic initiatives, including product launches, pricing decisions, go-to-market investments, and operational efficiencies.
· Prepare materials for executive leadership, with exposure to Board of Directors and investor materials.
· Track SaaS metrics — help monitor and analyze core unit economics including CAC, NRR, and GRR.
Your Skills & Experience
· Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (CPA/CFA designation in progress or completed is a strong asset).
· 2–3 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting.
· A process-driven approach — you naturally look for ways to make things repeatable and scalable.
· Proficiency in Adaptive Planning or similar financial planning tools.
· Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through strong business acumen and communication skills.
· Advanced Excel and financial modeling expertise, with proficiency in PowerPoint and executive storytelling.
· Experience with BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and comfort navigating large datasets.
· Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to automate reporting, streamline analysis, and improve process efficiency — this is a core expectation of the role, not a nice-to-have.
· Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-driven mindset.
· Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments without heavy oversight and enjoys working collaboratively across departments. Proven track record of taking initiative and going above and beyond, with high personal standards of accountability.
Success Metrics
· Measurable improvement in forecast accuracy and planning cycle efficiency
· Accuracy and timeliness of financial planning and reporting.
o Ensure data integrity in the FP&A system (Adaptive), as well as outputs any reports, workbooks or dashboards reflect timely and accurate data. Own the numbers from input to output.
o Continuous work to sanity check and verify the data integrity of results in adaptive and outputs delivered to Executive Team
· Successful implementation of process improvements and enhancements in financial operations leveraging AI to increase efficiency.

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY:

We're hiring a Senior Business Development Manager to identify, sign, and launch new reselling partners for Trulioo. This is a hunter role: you own the full cycle of, sourcing, qualifying and building prospective partners, negotiating and closing partnership agreements, and driving each new partner through onboarding to their first revenue.



Where our Partner Success team grows and retains existing partners, you focus on net-new: finding the platforms and companies whose customers need identity verification, convincing them that Trulioo is the best solution to embed and resell, and getting them live and producing. Your remit will be global — while you're based in North America, you identify and pursue partner opportunities across multiple markets worldwide, following where industry trends and demand for identity verification are creating new opportunities. You carry a partner-acquisition target and are measured on the number and quality of partners you sign and successfully launch. Signing a partner is the beginning of the relationship. You partner closely with the Partner Success team staying engaged well beyond launch to jointly drive the partnership's early momentum and long-term success. You'll work across Business Development leadership, Partner Success, Legal, Product, Technical Account Management, and Marketing to move partners from first conversation to a thriving, growing relationship.



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working remotely out of North America, with a preference for USA-based applicants.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Identify opportunities across markets and industry trends. Track industry trends, regulatory shifts, and emerging demand for identity verification across global markets to identify where new partner opportunities are opening — and prioritize the markets and verticals with the strongest potential.

 - Build and own a global pipeline of prospective partners. Research markets worldwide and identify identity orchestration, risk decisioning, onboarding, and other platforms whose customers need identity verification and who are a strong fit to resell Trulioo.

 - Prospect and open new relationships. Run outbound outreach and leverage your network and industry presence to initiate conversations with target partners.

 - Qualify and prioritize partner fit. Evaluate prospective partners on commercial potential, technical fit, market reach, and strategic value; focus effort on the partnerships most likely to drive meaningful revenue.

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting to the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis, the Strategic Financial Analyst will be the financial architect for Trulioo’s biggest strategic bets, working side-by-side with the VP of FP&A. This isn't a reporting FP&A role, it’s a high-ownership position where you’ll build the models that actually drive our strategic growth, forecasting, and capital allocation. You’ll live in the data, breaking down unit economics and stress-testing assumptions until you find the hidden levers that move the needle.



We want an AI-native analyst that uses AI as a daily tool for automating repetitive tasks, and surfacing patterns in complex transaction data. You should comfortably integrate  Claude or similar tools to accelerate your workflow, prompt financial models, and analyze data outputs. You view AI as an essential asset that adds real leverage to financial analysis, driving better forecasts and reporting, faster iteration, and amplified analytical rigour.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office).




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Financial Planning, Performance & Reporting

 - Budgeting & AOP: Lead the annual operating planning process for your business segment, working across departments to build realistic, data-driven financial targets that align with company strategy.

 - Rolling Forecasting: Manage and refine rolling forecasts to provide leadership with dynamic, forward-looking insights that adapt to changing business conditions.

 - Performance Tracking & Variance Insights: Analyze monthly and quarterly results against prior periods and budgets, breaking down and escalating major variances with clear strategic context.

 - Executive & Board Communications: Collaborate with the VP of FP&A to craft clear, compelling financial narratives, KPI dashboards, quarterly board materials and investor updates.

Strategic Analysis & Growth Initiatives

 - Unit Economics & Margin Optimization: Deeply analyze margin drivers, such as transaction volumes, pricing structures, and product mix, to evaluate levers that impact EBITDA.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the strategic financial voice across the organization, partnering with leaders in Sales, Product, Operations, and Customer Success to model growth initiatives.

 - Strategic & M&A Modeling: Construct sophisticated multi-scenario financial models to guide corporate development, M&A diligence, integration, and strategic expansion initiatives.

Data, AI & Infrastructure

 - KPI Frameworks & Dashboards: Maintain accountability across the organization by defining key metrics for unit economics and efficiency, establishing automated dashboards to measure what matters.

 - Data Governance & Analytics: Ensure the absolute integrity of financial datasets by aggregating information from diverse sources and partnering across the organization to enhance transactional data flows.

 - AI Integration & Automation: Leverage advanced LLMs and AI tools to accelerate workflows, automate reporting pipelines, optimize forecasting models, and flag transaction anomalies.






WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

FP&A & Strategic Finance

 - 2–3 years of hands-on analyst or FP&A experience in fintech, payments, or transaction-focused industries.

 - Deep modeling expertise: Adept at modeling unit economics, transaction volumes, and pricing structures.

 - Metrics & Profitability mastery: Deep understanding of cohort profitability, CAC/LTV dynamics, and the precise bottom-line impact of minor pricing adjustments.


Corporate Development & M&A

 - 1–2 years of experience within corporate development, private equity, or junior investment banking.

 - Diligence & Leadership exposure: Firsthand experience building and defending robust financial models during due diligence and high-level leadership meetings.


Attention to Detail and Rigour

 - Commitment to meticulousness defines your work style.

 - You naturally detect discrepancies in complex, 100-line models that others overlook, and you annotate your assumptions with the clarity of code comments. Identifying data logic errors or broken reasoning across multi-tab sheets is second nature to you.

 - Knowing how easily a single flawed variable can distort entire projections, you routinely stress-test models by working backward from the final outputs.


AI-Native Mindset

 - Leveraging Claude or similar tools to accelerate deliverables is second nature to you.

 - You have practical experience prompting financial models, interpreting data outputs, and automating routine analytical tasks.

 - Constantly seeking out novel applications, you evaluate how AI can introduce substantial leverage into financial analysis and reporting.


Intellectual Curiosity

 - You're curious. You ask why. You read financial results like a puzzle to solve.

 - You want to understand what drives outcomes, not just report them.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

Corporate Development & M&A

 - 1–2 years of experience within corporate development, private equity, or junior investment banking.

 - Diligence & Leadership exposure: Firsthand experience building and defending robust financial models during due diligence and high-level leadership meetings.

Qualifications

Excellent foundation in performance management and labor relations;

Excellent judgment, exemplary discretion, and the ability to quickly build trust with managers and employees at all levels;

LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

Technical Program Managers work cross-functionally to lead a growing book of service engagements, ensuring automation engagements and initiatives are optimally resourced, solutioned and delivered within budget time, scope, quality, and cost constraints.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Develop detailed and effective plans and monitor all aspects of program / project / workstream lifecycle, including scope, change and release management.

 - Attend and minute all program/project meetings and work closely with client automation COE and Services PMO to ensure all services are delivered and automations are aligned with client strategic objectives so that timecards and milestone completion forms are signed off promptly with invoicing initiated.

 - Own the full lifecycle of automation and custom solutions and programs from presales to order, initiation to handover.

 - Ensure client and internal stakeholders are managed effectively and updated on progress with risks, dependencies and issues managed with risk registry and mitigated.

 - Ensure all documentation and deliverables, including hands-on where necessary, are fit for purpose, follow UiPath recommended standards and of consistently high quality across engagements.

 - Conduct internal and client-facing program/project status meetings and present such reports as required including progress against plan, billings, resource utilization, service credits drawdown and incurred costs.

 - Provide weekly status summary of all programs and projects assigned and escalate to management as needed.

 - Drive client references and document case studies including identifying and sharing new uses for UiPath.

 - Also, as an employee of UiPath you are required to comply at all times with UiPath’s policies that were communicated to you from time to time and that are available on Inside UiPath.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 8+ years of experience in client-facing technology project–previous program or delivery management role focused on software development and systems integration.

 - Experience in various agile, waterfall, SDLC, hybrid methodologies and continuous integration.

 - High attention to detail and proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple, competing, and conflicting priorities simultaneously.

 - PMP, PRINCE2, Project+, or similar project management certifications

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. greenhouse:unbounce:5415525008.description:
Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A (AI First)

 Department: Operations

 Location: Remote, Canada or US

 Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

 Hours: Monday-Friday, 9AM-5PM (in your time zone)

 About the Role 

 Unbounce is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A (AI First) to join our FP&A team. You'll run our budgeting and forecasting cycles, prepare monthly reporting, support the accounting team through month-end close, and partner with teams across the business to answer financial questions.

 This is an AI-native role: the outputs are familiar (an annual budget, a rolling forecast, a monthly reporting package, board metrics), but you will spend a meaningful share of your time building the systems that produce them rather than producing them by hand. Every employee at Unbounce has Claude, and our billing and accounting stack was rebuilt this year on Recurly and Rillet, so the data layer underneath you is new rather than inherited.

 Concretely, when a recurring analysis takes four hours by hand, we expect your instinct to be to build the thing that does it in four minutes next month, and then to be the person who can tell whether its answer is right. The second half matters more than the first. Automation without judgment is worse than no automation, and this role owns both.

 We're after someone dependable and detail-oriented who communicates clearly and whose first instinct on a repetitive task is to automate it. You don't need to have done every item on this list. If you're strong in most areas and willing to learn the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

 What You’ll Be Doing 

 Build and operate AI-driven finance workflows 

- Design, build and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that carry the recurring FP&A load: variance analysis, first-pass commentary, cohort and retention analysis, board metric refreshes, and the routine data pulls underneath all of them.

- Use AI as a default part of your workflow, across analysis, modeling, reporting, and commentary, within our team practices and data-handling guidelines.

- Use Claude, which every employee here already has, to speed up analysis, automate recurring reporting, draft first-pass variance commentary, and pressure-test your own assumptions before numbers go out.

- Build the context these agents need in order to be reliable: metric definitions, documented data lineage from source system to report, and explicit rules for how each number is constructed. An agent is only as good as the context it can reach.

- Decide what should and should not be automated. Draw and defend the line between work an agent runs unsupervised, work an agent drafts for human review, and work that stays fully manual.

- Own the finance team's shared library of agents, prompts, skills and calculation templates. Treat it as a deliverable in its own right, versioned and documented, so that it keeps producing when you are on vacation.

- Own what the tools produce, review AI-assisted work to the same standard as your own, and know when a question needs judgment instead. Build the checks in: validation against source, reconciliation, and a review step that catches a wrong answer before it reaches leadership or the board.

- Raise the ceiling for the people around you. Some of your highest-leverage work will be enabling your business partners to answer their own questions rather than producing the analysis yourself.

 Planning and forecasting 

- Prepare Own the annual budget and quarterly/monthly forecast updates, gathering inputs from department leaders.

- Maintain the company's financial model (revenue, expenses, headcount, and cash) and keep the key assumptions up to date. Structure it so that running a new scenario is a configuration change, not a rebuild.

- Run scenario analysis to help leadership weigh decisions, using AI to build and iterate on cases faster than a manual model rebuild allows, fast enough to be useful in the meeting where the decision is actually being made.

 Reporting 

- Own the monthly reporting package: actuals versus budget and forecast, variance analysis, and commentary. AI-drafted first pass, then edited and owned by you.

- Help prepare materials for leadership and board meetings, including our key metrics and dashboards.

- Work with the accounting team during month-end close to make sure results are accurate and on time.

 Metrics and analysis 

- Own our core SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR, net and gross revenue retention, churn, CAC, and LTV) and keep the definitions consistent.

- Look at customer, product, and segment profitability and take the findings to the people who can act on them.

- Build and maintain reports in our BI tools so teams can see the numbers they need, and so that analysts, dashboards and agents all draw on one trusted source rather than several competing ones.

 Working with the business 

- Be the finance point of contact for Sales, Marketing, Product, and G&A, helping them manage budgets and understand spend.

- Partner with Data and Analytics to scope reporting needs, so what we build answers the right questions.

- Help evaluate the costs and benefits of proposed projects and investments.

- Handle ad-hoc analysis requests as they come up.

 A Little Bit About You 

- A reliable instinct for when a machine-generated answer is wrong. This is a very important qualification for this role.

- Structured thinking: you can break a vague business question into defined, verifiable steps, which is the same skill that makes an agent work.

- Demonstrated use of AI tools in real finance work. You can walk us through something you automated or accelerated, and how you checked the output.

- Experience building AI-assisted workflows: prompt-based reporting, scripting, or connecting AI tools to finance data sources.

- 3–5+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a similar analytical finance role. We weight demonstrated ability to build with AI as heavily as two additional years of conventional experience.

- Experience at a SaaS or subscription business, or willingness to get up to speed on the model.

- A good understanding of common SaaS metrics (ARR, retention, churn, CAC, LTV) and what drives them.

- Solid financial modeling and Excel/Google Sheets skills. Excel and Google Sheets are output formats here rather than the core skill; the core skill is breaking a FP&A question down precisely enough that an agent can run it reliably and repeatably.

- A working knowledge of the three financial statements and subscription revenue recognition.

- The ability to explain financial results clearly to people outside of finance.

- Comfort with ERP, planning, and BI tools (e.g. NetSuite, Cube, QuickSight, or similar).

- An understanding of how finance and business systems fit together and how data moves between them, and the ability to scope reporting needs with Data teams.

- A willingness to work in the open, documenting what you build so that someone else can run it.

- A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

 Nice to Have  

- Experience partnering with Sales or RevOps on pipeline, quota, or go-to-market planning.

- Exposure to headcount and workforce planning alongside the People team.

- SQL or comfort working with larger datasets.

- MBA, CFA, or CPA.

 Our Stack  

- Every employee has a Claude account. Recurly for billing and Rillet for accounting, both implemented this year. QuickSight for business intelligence.

 Share Our Values 

- Customer First

- Bias for Action

- High Velocity Decision Making

- Inclusion

- Results Focused

 Compensation 

 Our compensation bands are designed to reflect how people grow in their roles. Each level includes three stages: Developing, Proficient and Expert, which represent increasing capability, independence and impact over time.

 The compensation range for this role is $95,000 to $110,000 CAD which reflects the Proficient stage of our compensation band for this job level (P3). For United States based applicants, the compensation range for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 USD. 

 Progression into higher stages and job levels may occur over time based on demonstrated performance, mastery of role expectations and overall impact. For specialized or hard-to-fill roles, we may extend offers above the posted range if a candidate brings exceptional experience.
 Perks & Benefits

 Flexibility and Time Off

- Flexible Time Off Policy - We encourage a minimum of 4 weeks per year!

- Remote First Team

- Flexible Hours

- Work From Anywhere Program

 Health and Wellness

- Health Insurance

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

- Quarterly Company Wide Recharge Days

- End of Year Company Wide Holiday Closure

- Maternity & Parental Leave Program

- $2000 Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

 Growth & Future

- Professional Development Budget

- Volunteer Day

- Team Building Budget

- Employee Referral Bonus Program ($1000)

- Anniversary Milestone LSA Top Up

- Birthday Day Off

 We Value Individuality!

 At Unbounce, we want every employee to be excited to bring their full, authentic self to work. When you bring your unique experiences, background, knowledge, perspective, and self-expression while embracing the same from others we learn from each other. We innovate and co-create an environment where team members can do the best work of their careers. We're bolder and more brilliant together.

 We're dedicated to ensuring each team member feels a sense of belonging, feels safe, cared for, respected and valued for who they are, and trusts that their unique voice is heard, embraced, and meaningfully contributes to decision-making. We're committed to equitable employee experience, opportunity, pay and support for every employee regardless of gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, family or marital status, religion, socio-economic status, veteran status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, education, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you unique.

 We have no tolerance for sexism, racism, xenophobia, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, ageism, or any other forms of hateful/harmful discrimination and we're taking action against unequal pay in our community through leading the #PayUpforProgress movement.

 If you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please email us at careers@unbounce.com .

 Our use of AI in hiring

 We're committed to keeping hiring personal. Every application is reviewed by a real person on our team, and we don't use AI to screen or filter candidates out.

 We do use AI to help with assessing candidates and summarizing interview feedback. These tools support our team in working more efficiently and reducing bias. All final hiring decisions are made by people who bring their judgment and experience to determine who joins our team.

At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the  2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM ,  2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index ,  Gartner Peer Insights ,  2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and  G2.  Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

- Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide. 

- Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team. 

- Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization. 

- Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment. 

 Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

 Summary of the Role and Team 

 As an Associate Seller (Business Development Representative), you will join Varicent’s North America Sales Development team and play a key role in generating qualified pipeline opportunities within enterprise organizations. Working closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue teams, you will identify prospective customers, understand their business challenges, and create opportunities that contribute directly to revenue growth. This role offers exposure to enterprise sales environments, modern prospecting strategies, AI-enabled sales technologies, and structured sales methodologies. For individuals interested in building a long-term career in SaaS sales, this role provides a strong foundation for future advancement into quota-carrying and customer-facing sales positions.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- 
 Develop and execute prospecting strategies across assigned enterprise accounts and territories

- 
 Research target organizations, stakeholders, business initiatives, and market trends to identify potential opportunities

- 
 Engage prospective customers through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other digital channels

- 
 Conduct discovery and qualification conversations to understand business priorities, challenges, and potential fit

- 
 Apply qualification methodologies such as MEDDICC to evaluate opportunities and determine next steps

- 
 Collaborate with Account Executives and Marketing to align account strategies and pipeline development efforts

- 
 Maintain accurate account, activity, and opportunity information within Salesforce and related sales tools

- 
 Analyze outreach performance and refine prospecting strategies using data, feedback, and AI-enabled technologies

 What You Bring 

- 
 Experience in business development, sales development, inside sales, or another customer-facing role within a SaaS, technology, or B2B environment

- 
 Experience achieving activity, prospecting, meeting-generation, pipeline, or business performance goals

- 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage business stakeholders professionally

- 
 Experience using CRM and sales engagement platforms such as Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools

- 
 Strong organizational, research, and time-management skills

- 
 Ability to understand customer challenges and connect conversations to business outcomes

- 
 Ability to learn quickly, apply feedback, and continuously improve performance

- 
 Ability to manage priorities effectively in a collaborative and fast-paced environment

 Nice to Have 

- 
 Experience in B2B SaaS sales environments serving enterprise or mid-market customers

- 
 Exposure to qualification methodologies such as MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, or similar frameworks

- 
 Experience collaborating with Marketing on outbound campaigns and account-based prospecting initiatives

- 
 Familiarity with Sales Performance Management, Incentive Compensation Management, Revenue Operations, or Sales Planning solutions

- 
 Experience prospecting into financial services, insurance, or other highly regulated industries

- 
 Interest in leveraging AI-enabled tools and modern sales technologies to improve prospecting effectiveness

 Success Outcomes 
 First 90 Days 

- 
 Complete onboarding and develop proficiency in Varicent’s products, sales process, prospecting tools, and target markets

- 
 Build an understanding of ideal customer profiles, enterprise buying environments, and account strategies

- 
 Consistently execute outbound and inbound prospecting activities across multiple channels

- 
 Maintain accurate CRM records and prospect engagement activity

 Within 6 Months 

- 
 Consistently generate qualified meetings and pipeline opportunities aligned with team objectives

- 
 Conduct effective discovery and qualification conversations with enterprise stakeholders

- 
 Demonstrate proficiency in account research, stakeholder mapping, and opportunity qualification

- 
 Build productive working relationships with Account Executives and Marketing partners

 Within 12 Months 

- 
 Independently execute a territory-based prospecting strategy that generates a consistent flow of qualified opportunities

- 
 Consistently identify customer business priorities, key stakeholders, and potential value drivers

- 
 Improve prospecting effectiveness through data-driven optimization and effective use of sales technologies

- 
 Establish a reputation as a reliable contributor to pipeline growth and business development efforts

 For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is between CAD $66,100 – $86,800 . In addition to base salary, our compensation package may include bonuses, commissions for eligible sales roles, and a comprehensive benefits package. The actual base salary will vary based on factors including individual qualifications and market data, as objectively assessed during the interview process.   

 This posting is for an existing  vacancy.   

 This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

- Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most

 The Opportunity

 Varicent is seeking a strategic, creative, and data-driven Director, Digital Marketing & Web Experience to lead our digital growth engine across digital marketing, website strategy and experience, paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, conversion optimization, and digital performance measurement.

 This leader will own the strategy and performance of Varicent’s digital channels, with accountability for their contribution to pipeline and revenue. You’ll shape how prospective customers discover, engage with, and convert through Varicent’s digital experiences while ensuring our investments are measurable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

 This is a broad functional leadership role that combines strategic ownership with operational fluency. You’ll lead a team and agency ecosystem spanning digital marketing and web experience while partnering closely with Marketing leadership, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Creative, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Marketing, IT, Finance, and other stakeholders.

 What You’ll Do

 Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership

- 
 Own Varicent’s digital marketing strategy across paid media, SEO/SEM, website experience, landing pages, conversion optimization, retargeting, and account-based digital programs.

- 
 Develop and lead a multi-quarter digital marketing and web roadmap aligned with pipeline, revenue, brand, and customer acquisition goals.

- 
 Define the role of digital channels throughout the buyer journey, from awareness and demand creation through conversion, pipeline acceleration, and customer expansion.

- 
 Establish priorities, investment areas, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks for the function.

 Identify emerging digital opportunities, buyer behavior shifts, platform changes, competitive trends, and technologies that can improve performance.

 Own paid media budget strategy, channel mix, investment allocation, forecasting, and spend pacing.

- 
 Partner with agencies on campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and performance recommendations.

- 
 Partner with Demand Generation, Content, and Product Marketing to develop digital programs supporting product, audience, industry, ABM, event, webinar, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.

- 
 Lead audience segmentation, targeting, and experimentation across channels, creative, landing pages, forms, CTAs, and conversion paths.

- 
 Continuously optimize programs to improve conversion, lead quality, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and return on marketing investment.

- 
 Ensure digital programs are effectively integrated with marketing automation, CRM, lead routing, scoring, nurture, attribution, and reporting.

 Lead the vision for website experience, UX, design, navigation, information architecture, conversion paths, accessibility, and brand consistency in partnership with the Senior Web Developer.

 Own the website roadmap and establish effective processes for prioritization, governance, design standards, development coordination, QA, and release management.

 Establish SEO/AEO/GEO measurement that connects visibility and engagement with conversion and organic pipeline outcomes.

 Evolve Varicent’s approach to discoverability across traditional search engines, AI-powered search experiences, review sites, citations, and third-party platforms.

- 
 Own the digital performance measurement framework across paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, website experience, and conversion paths.

- 
 Define KPIs, dashboards, reporting cadences, and executive-level performance narratives.

- 
 Partner with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Analytics to ensure reliable campaign tracking, attribution, data flow, lead capture, routing, scoring, and reporting.

- 
 Analyze performance across the funnel, including traffic quality, engagement, conversion, MQL and opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.

- 
 Translate complex performance data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership.

- 
 Lead digital forecasting and performance planning in partnership with Demand Generation and revenue teams.

- 
 Build a test-and-learn culture that continuously improves audiences, creative, messaging, website experiences, and investment decisions.

- 
 Lead and develop the digital marketing and web experience function, including a Senior Web Developer and Senior Manager of Digital Marketing , alongside Varicent’s SEO/AEO/GEO and paid media agency partners.

- 
 Set clear goals, responsibilities, performance expectations, development plans, and operating rhythms for two direct reports.

- 
 Build a culture of accountability, creativity, speed, experimentation, and measurable impact.

- 
 Manage team capacity, prioritization, workload, hiring needs, and career development.

- 
 Coach team members to strengthen strategic thinking, execution quality, and analytical decision-making.

- 
 Establish scalable processes for campaign execution, web intake, design review, QA, testing, and agency collaboration.

- 
 Shape the future-state organization, including team structure, capability gaps, and development needs.

 Own digital marketing and web budget planning across paid media, agencies, contractors, tools, and platforms.

- 
 Manage external partners across paid media, SEO, web design and development, analytics, creative production, and CRO.

- 
 Define agency scopes, deliverables, timelines, performance expectations, and accountability.

- 
 Evaluate agency and vendor performance and make recommendations regarding renewals, consolidation, replacement, or additional investment.

- 
 Develop business cases for digital investments based on growth opportunities, performance, and expected ROI.

- 
 Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and IT on vendor selection, contracts, renewals, and compliance.

 Act as a senior digital and web strategy partner to the SVP of Marketing and broader Marketing leadership team.

- 
 Lead alignment across teams on website priorities, digital campaign strategy, conversion goals, investment tradeoffs, and reporting.

- 
 Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to understand digital lead quality, pipeline progression, and conversion outcomes.

 Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure campaigns have effective tracking, attribution, scoring, and routing.

- 
 Communicate priorities, results, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

- 
 12+ years of experience across digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, web strategy, or performance marketing, gained in-house, at an agency, or through a combination of both.

- 
 7+ years of people leadership experience, including leading teams, managers, or multidisciplinary digital and web functions.

- 
 Significant B2B marketing experience, ideally within SaaS, technology, enterprise software, or another complex sales environment.

-

- 
 Deep knowledge of paid media, SEM, SEO, paid social, display, retargeting, programmatic, content syndication, and account-based advertising.

- 
 Strong understanding of website strategy, UX, web design and development workflows, CMS management, CRO, accessibility, and web analytics.

- 
 Experience leading website redesigns, optimization programs, landing page strategies, or other significant digital experience initiatives.

- 
 Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar technologies.

- 
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.

- 
 Experience managing agencies, vendors, contractors, scopes of work, budgets, and performance expectations.

- 
 Executive-level communication skills and experience presenting strategy, results, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

- 
 Strong cross-functional and program leadership skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities across teams, systems, agencies, and timelines.

- 
 Experience incorporating AI-powered marketing capabilities, such as generative AI, AI-driven personalization, or conversational experiences, into the digital marketing ecosystem.

- 
 Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and the ability to partner effectively with web developers on technical implementation.

- 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, revenue management, sales performance management, fintech, or go-to-market technology.

- 
 Experience leading digital marketing and web experience within a global or multi-region organization.

- 
 Experience managing managers or building and scaling a digital marketing/web function.

- 
 Experience with ABM strategy and account-based advertising platforms.

- 
 Experience with website personalization, intent-based experiences, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.

- 
 Experience with Dreamdata or another multi-touch attribution platform.

 Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms such as Optimizely, VWO, Unbounce, Mutiny, or Convert.

- 
 Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as Hotjar, Crazy Egg, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity.

- 
 Experience leading major website redesigns, rebrands, CMS migrations, taxonomy initiatives, or web governance programs.

- 
 Familiarity with privacy, cookie consent, GDPR, CCPA, accessibility, and web compliance requirements.

- 
 Experience partnering with Finance on forecasting, ROI analysis, and investment planning.

- 
 Advanced knowledge of multi-touch attribution, marketing mix analysis, and revenue performance reporting.

- 
 Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), and/or HubSpot certifications.

 You’ll build a clear understanding of Varicent’s digital ecosystem by assessing paid media, web experience, SEO/AEO/GEO, analytics, agencies, budgets, team capabilities, conversion paths, campaign tracking, and current performance benchmarks. You’ll establish relationships with key partners across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, IT, Finance, and our agency ecosystem while identifying immediate risks and optimization opportunities.

You’ll strengthen visibility into digital contribution to pipeline and revenue while establishing clear team goals, responsibilities, and development priorities.

 You’ll deliver measurable improvements across digital pipeline contribution, paid media efficiency, organic visibility, and website conversion. You’ll establish Varicent’s website as a stronger growth engine, improve the quality and actionability of digital performance reporting, strengthen agency and team performance, and lead at least one major web, CRO, acquisition, SEO, or performance measurement initiative with measurable business impact.

At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the  2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM ,  2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index ,  Gartner Peer Insights ,  2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and  G2.  Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

- Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide. 

- Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team. 

- Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization. 

- Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment. 

 Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

 About the Role

 We’re looking for a Manager, Content Marketing .  to lead our content function and help shape how Varicent shows up in the market.

 You’ll manage and develop a team of content marketers and writers, setting a high bar for quality while giving them the coaching, context, and feedback they need to do their best work.

 This is also a hands-on role. You’ll write and edit high-impact content, help shape and execute our content strategy, and partner closely with the Senior Director of Marketing and teams across the business to develop new ideas and initiatives.

 You’ll join a collaborative, open-minded marketing team at a company that is leading its market and actively redefining what’s possible for our customers.

 What You’ll Do

 Own and Execute Content Strategy

- 
 Help develop and execute Varicent’s content strategy across audiences, channels, and stages of the buyer journey.

- 
 Connect content priorities, production, and measurement to key marketing and business goals.

- 
 Identify the topics where Varicent has something meaningful and differentiated to say, and determine the formats and channels that will best reach our audiences.

- 
 Own our organic content strategy, including SEO and AEO , helping Varicent show up wherever buyers are searching for answers.

- 
 Partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Brand, Design, Customer Marketing, Sales, Product, and other teams to understand priorities and determine where content can have the greatest impact.

- 
 Measure content performance, identify what’s working and what isn’t, and continuously refine the strategy based on results.

 Lead and Develop the Team

- 
 Manage, mentor, and develop a team of content marketers and writers, including internal and contract resources.

- 
 Set priorities, manage the editorial calendar, allocate resources, and provide the context and direction the team needs to deliver high-quality work.

- 
 Give clear, thoughtful feedback that improves both the content and the people creating it.

- 
 Help scale the content function, processes, and capabilities as Varicent grows.

- 
 Guide the team in using AI effectively while protecting Varicent’s voice, differentiation, quality, and point of view.

 Write and Edit

- 
 Maintain a consistent voice and a high standard of quality across Varicent’s marketing content.

- 
 Write and edit content across a range of formats, including thought leadership, email, website copy, product launches, SEO and AEO content, campaigns, customer stories, ebooks, reports, and more.

- 
 Partner with subject matter experts to uncover compelling ideas and turn their expertise into content people want to read.

- 
 Translate complex subjects into clear, engaging content without losing the ideas and nuance that make them interesting.

- 
 Help develop and strengthen Varicent’s distinct point of view on the market and the issues shaping our customers.

 What We’re Looking For

- 
 An exceptional writer who has developed into an equally strong editor, content strategist, and people leader.

- 
 Significant experience in B2B content marketing , ideally within enterprise SaaS or another complex B2B category .

- 
 Demonstrated experience developing and executing content strategies that support measurable marketing and business goals.

- 
 Experience managing, coaching, and developing writers or content marketers.

- 
 Strong editorial judgment and a clear point of view on what makes content worth publishing.

- 
 A strong understanding of SEO and how organic discovery is evolving through AI-powered search and answer engines (AEO) .

- 
 The ability to use performance data and audience insights to evaluate content, learn, and adjust priorities.

- 
 The ability to quickly understand complex subjects and explain them clearly and compellingly.

- 
 Confidence working with executives, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners.

- 
 A portfolio that demonstrates range, strong writing and editing skills, and experience across multiple content formats.

Candidates should expect a high-activity, high-volume, and high-velocity sales environment requiring strong prioritization, organization, and consistent execution. You will own your territory end-to-end—developing account strategies, generating new business, expanding existing customers, and leading deals to close. Success requires consultative selling, accurate forecasting, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a channel-driven model.

- Deal Execution: Lead full sales cycles from prospecting through close, including discovery, solution alignment, technical validation, and negotiation

- Forecasting & Performance: Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce, uphold strong CRM discipline, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets

- Deal Execution: Lead full sales cycles from prospecting through close, including discovery, solution alignment, technical validation, and negotiation

- Forecasting & Performance: Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce, uphold strong CRM discipline, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets

- Language Requirement: Fluent in French

 Bonus Skills 

- 4+ years of B2B tech sales experience with a proven track record in a quota-carrying role

- Experience selling through channel partners and managing full sales cycles

- Solid business acumen, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline discipline

ashby:visier:0cc19ea3-f36f-467d-ab45-eca.description:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.



POSITION OVERVIEW

As an Account Executive for our Embedded team, you will own the end-to-end sales process for new logo-based clients in North America, acting as a crucial driver in an outcomes-based selling motion. 

Visier provides foundational technology for our embedded partners to commercialize workforce data, accelerate AI innovation and unlock valuable insight using a purpose-built context layer. 

You will leverage advanced relationship building and strategic communication skills, paired with knowledge of modern GTM practices, to generate a consistent pipeline, influence executive stakeholders, secure new embedded partners and drive revenue growth. 

Through this work you’ll enable our partners to drive value for their customers and realize quantifiable outcomes while helping Visier achieve sales objectives in the North America region for our embedded products.





WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER:

 - Pipeline Development & Control: Own and control the sales process for Visier’s embedded solutions across key verticals, consistently achieving annual sales quotas based on annual contract value.

 - Outcomes-Based Alignment: Utilize effective research and sales discovery techniques to identify a prospect’s strategic priorities, tying Visier's value directly to their desired outcomes.

 - Strategic GTM Guidance: Recommend and guide packaging decisions and go-to-market strategies for each partner’s embedded implementation to ensure optimal value realization.

 - Commercial Creativity: Strategically address financial objections and blockers by reframing current ways of thinking about budget, cost of inaction, and build vs. buy considerations. 

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proactively partner with internal Visier teams and stakeholders to establish credibility, develop compelling business cases, and ultimately deliver on our partnership commitments. 




WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - Education & Experience: 7+ years of established success selling complex cloud-based solutions (Embedded/OEM or PaaS preferred).

 - Outcomes-Based Sales Mastery: Mastery of foundational sales skills (MEDDPICC or MEDDIC) combined with a strategic understanding of complex business challenges to close strategic accounts.

 - Creative Conflict & Communication: The ability to share your unique perspective, openly debate ideas to find the best solutions, and authentically engage with C-level executives.

 - Drive to Win: A goal-focused mentality where you take smart risks, move fast, and stay hungry to win as a team.

 - Independent Execution: Proven ability to work independently, receiving little instruction on day-to-day work, while selecting the best methods and techniques for closing customer deals.

 - Learning Agility: A continuous learning mindset where if you don't get it right the first time, you learn and try again.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - You roll up your sleeves

 - You make it easy

 - You are proud

 - You never stop learning

 - You play to win




HOW WE WORK AND WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Annual company All Hands in Vancouver, our entire organization travels to our Vancouver HQ for a week of team building, learning and breakout sessions

 - Competitive salary, and top-tier health and wellness benefits

 - Stock options and/or bonus based on your role, location, and employment type

The base pay range for this position in the US is $140,000 - $150,000 USD/year + bonus



Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.



AI in Hiring
As a people analytics company, we think carefully about how AI is used in decisions that affect people, including our own. Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills. We ask that live interviews be AI-free, so we can get to know how you communicate, think through problems, and describe the work you've actually done. We reserve the right to end the interview early if candidate fraud is suspected.


If you have questions about how AI is used in our process or how your data is handled, review our Visier Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.visier.com/candidate-privacy-notice-and-recruiter-policy/ or reach out to us.
