lever:waabi:99598723-50aa-4733-ae66-bf10.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


About the role

Waabi continues to scale its breakthrough technology into commercial deployment, and how we attract, reward, and retain exceptional people will be central to the ongoing growth and innovation. This role directly shapes that story: understanding where the business is going and ensuring our compensation structure continues to support that trajectory. You'll be responsible for designing for the current and the future while also being the trusted expert for employees, managers, executives, and company leadership when it comes to our compensation approach and program.
 
You will...
Anchor compensation in the business trajectory. Build a deep understanding of Waabi's growth path, including headcount plans, commercialization milestones, geographic expansion, and funding outlook, and use it to guide compensation decisions.
Design the compensation structure of the future and the plan to get there. Define how base, equity, and variable pay work together to support where the business is headed. Understand today’s structure, set the long-term philosophy, ranges, and grant guidelines, then lay out the roadmap and sequencing to evolve if needed.
Own the end-to-end annual compensation cycle, including administering the compensation tool and partnering with managers and senior leaders to plan outcomes for their teams. Streamline and scale the process, including through AI tools where they add value.
Lead market benchmarking for all roles across Waabi's locations, deeply understanding the job architecture and talent marketplace, to effectively complete job matching, survey submissions, and recommending updates to cash and equity ranges.
Build bottoms-up compensation forecasts with Finance, modeling spend and equity usage against the business plan. Own a variety of modeling and analysis projects to inform decision making.
Lead compensation enablement and education across the organization. Be the single owner of how Waabi teaches compensation: 
Training managers on the structure, philosophy and how pay decisions are made
Helping employees understand the value and mechanics of their total compensation, including stock options
Equipping Recruiting to structure competitive offers
Building employee communications that tie it together
Communicate and advise across company leadership. Translate complex compensation topics into clear recommendations and trade-offs for the executive team. Manage preparation of compensation materials for board review and discussions
Ensure pay equity and compliance through regular reviews and adherence to pay transparency and reporting requirements across the U.S. and Canada.
Qualifications:
A bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
7+ years of compensation experience, ideally in high-growth technology companies, including owning annual cycles and multi-location benchmarking.
Experience designing compensation philosophy, structures and programs (salary, variable and equity).
Extensive analytical and modeling skills (including building forecasts) as well as expertise in benchmarking and survey methodology (Radford, Carta, Pave, etc).
Executive presence, with clear, confident communication to employees, managers, and senior executives.
Strong collaboration and communication skills
Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive, confidential information.
Enthusiasm for applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve workflows.
Open-minded and collaborative team player with the willingness to help others.
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.
Bonus/nice to have:
Experience with private company compensation planning, including planning through company evolution (revenue, funding, and maturity).
Experience managing preparation for board review of compensation programs.
Direct experience in HIgh-Tech, AI or AV company, with an understanding of how the talent marketplace shapes pay.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to automate compensation analysis, modeling, or cycle workflows.
The US yearly salary range for this role is: $175,000 - $260,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. Waabi US Inc.’s yearly salary ranges are determined based on several factors in accordance with the Company’s compensation practices. Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

lever:waabi:5e2c25f8-150e-46bf-95a7-71ed.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We're seeking a Senior Product Designer to own the human-in-the-loop workflows at the core of how Waabi turns raw driving data into a safer autonomy stack: the software environments where expert human judgment and automation work as one to make every engineer, analyst, operator, and researcher faster.
 
These are the workflows where a human expert and an automated system have to move together: data labeling, map annotation, track testing, and release testing. Your job is to design the environments that make that collaboration fast and high-signal, and then bring shared patterns into the design system for compounding returns across every internal and partner-facing surface.
 
You'll join as the third product designer at Waabi, sitting on the Product, Design & TPM team. You'll be the systems-minded builder who turns one-off UI work into compounding returns across the whole platform.
 
You will…
Design data labeling and annotation workflows. You'll design the tools for data curation, internal lightweight labeling, QA, and the feedback loops that connect label quality to model performance. Today this work lives in many surfaces, and your goal will be to unify the workflows to accelerate training data throughput and quality, to continually improve autonomy safety at scale.
Design data discovery surfaces and annotation tools. Grow the primary tools for finding, filtering, and curating AV data across logs, events, simulations, and labels. You'll help design the experience that lets triage analysts, systems engineers, autonomy engineers, and ML researchers navigate petabytes of driving and simulated data. You'll also own the design for our map annotation tooling: task management, branch/merge workflows, annotator feedback loops, defect logging, and urban surface street annotation as Waabi expands from highway trucking to urban robotaxi deployments.
Ground the work in research. Get out of the tools and into the workflows. Shadow labelers, annotators, triage analysts, and right-seaters in their real environment. Produce qualitative and quantitative insight on where time and signal are lost, and disseminate it so the whole team designs from the same picture of the user.
Build and scale Waabi's design system. Work with designers and full-stack engineers to take our nascent system and turn it into a robust, branded component system. This means complex, reusable components: timeline scrubbers, rich multi-select filters, pass/fail summary cards, map visualization primitives, data tables with inline actions. These components serve triage, metrics dashboards, data exploration, mapping, fleet ops, and partner-facing UI.
Establish front-end and design infrastructure for tooling self-service. Build the context architecture that lets teams build their own UI with UX best practices baked in. Enable robust prototyping with read-only or snapshot data so teams can iterate without touching production.
Ship directly in code. You'll contribute to production React codebases using AI-assisted tools. The shipped product is the deliverable, not a Figma handoff.
 
Qualifications
Data-centric workflow designer who builds in code. 5-8+ years designing complex, data-rich tools where the primary interface is structured data: tables, filters, search, dashboards, maps, or annotation tools. You see the cross-tool workflow as your unit of work, not the single screen. You can make dense information scannable and actionable without dumbing it down, and you validate by building working prototypes on real data, not static mocks.
Design-system builder. You think in components, tokens, patterns, and infrastructure, and see the reusable primitive inside every one-off request. You've built or significantly grown a design system, and you understand the difference between a component library and a design system: tokens, documentation, governance, adoption, and the political work of supporting engineers to use it.
AI-native builder. You use AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Claude Code, or a similar agentic setup) as a default part of how you prototype and ship, not a novelty. It's how you get from idea to working software fast.
First-principles thinker. You strip problems down to their fundamentals. The tools you'll design have no off-the-shelf pattern to copy. Curation workflows, map annotation, track test playlist management, data lineage visualization: these require you to understand the domain deeply and invent the right interaction model.
Strong front-end intuition. You don't need to be a senior React engineer, but you understand component architecture, state management, and the constraints of web-based data visualization well enough to design things that are buildable and performant.
Infrastructure mindset. You're energized by the meta-problem: how do we make everyone faster? You see AGENTS.md files, context documentation, and component APIs as design deliverables, not overhead.
Bonus / Nice to Have
Advanced AI-assisted workflows. Custom agentic setups, and real opinions about how AI changes the relationship between design systems and self-service UI.
GIS or mapping tools background. Experience with map annotation, geospatial data, or tools like Mapbox, QGIS, or proprietary mapping tools.
Data platform or ML tooling experience. Prior work designing labeling tools, data curation interfaces, dataset management, or ML experiment tracking.
Design system at scale. You've maintained a system used by 10+ engineers across multiple product surfaces and dealt with the versioning, adoption, and governance challenges that come with it.
AV, robotics, or safety-critical domains. Prior experience where the quality of tooling directly impacts physical safety.

BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Design is a strategic lever at Wealthsimple — we don’t just make things beautiful, we help shape what gets built. We're growing our Product Design team and hiring both Senior and Staff Product Designers across multiple product areas, including Investing, Banking, and more. Rather than filling a single role, we’re looking for outstanding designers who want to help us define the future of personal finance in Canada. When you apply, we’ll explore where your strengths, experience, and interests align best across our teams.




CURRENT OPEN ROLES

 1. Staff Designer, AI Products 

 2. Senior Designer, Self-Directed Investing




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design thoughtful, high-impact product experiences that empower clients to make smarter financial decisions.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, content, and research throughout the entire product development process.

 - Own the full design stack — from early discovery and prototyping to high-fidelity visuals and micro-interactions.

 - Conduct research and use data to understand client needs, identify opportunities, and inform design decisions.

 - Help evolve our design system and scale the product with consistency, craft, and intention.

 - Raise the bar for quality and clarity — not just in your own work, but across the team.




SKILLS YOU BRING

 - Experience designing for consumer-facing mobile apps (React Native, native iOS/Android).

 - Strong UX and visual design skills, with the ability to turn complex problems into simple, elegant experiences.

 - A user-first mindset and a strong product sense — you know when to sweat the details and when to move quickly.

 - A collaborative approach and clear communication style.

 - Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to ship real products.

 - A passion for personal finance, and an interest in banking, investing, or financial planning tools.

 - For Senior Designers: a track record of shipping high-quality, impactful work end-to-end.

 - For Staff Designers: experience leading large initiatives, mentoring others, and driving design quality and strategy at a higher level.




IF YOU’RE EXCITED TO BE PART OF WEALTHSIMPLE'S MISSION, PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR RESUME AND A PORTFOLIO THAT DEMONSTRATE:

 - How you’ve tackled ambiguous product challenges and found clarity

 - Your process and rationale behind design decisions

 - Your impact on the product and business

 - How you’ve used insights to advocate for client needs




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Growth Manager to own performance and lifecycle marketing for our active trader and crypto business. This role runs the programs that grow our self-directed trading and crypto segment - acquiring high-intent traders and crypto investors through the channels they live in, converting them into funded active traders, and deepening engagement through lifecycle across the trades, products, and benefits that drive volume and revenue.


You'll own paid media and lifecycle end-to-end, from media buys on trader and crypto-native channels through in-app journeys that turn a new account into an active, funded trader. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Sales/BDR, and Analytics; operate with a high degree of day-to-day autonomy; and be accountable for funded active-trader and crypto engagement outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own active trader and crypto demand generation across the channels traders and crypto investors live in — paid social (X/Twitter, Cashtags), trading platforms (TradingView), finance and crypto media (Yahoo Finance), trading and crypto newsletters, SEM, and influencers/community — measured through to funded accounts and sustained trading activity, not clicks.

 - Own the media buys end to end — plan and manage budgets, negotiate placements and rates with vendors, run creative and landing-page testing, and diagnose what's working (reactivation vs. acquisition, channel vs. landing page) rather than just reporting spend.

 - Own the trader and crypto lifecycle alongside Lifecycle and Product — activation, first-trade, funding, and "nearly active" re-engagement journeys across Braze content cards, AT status screens, and rewards. Bring performance and LCM best practices to how these journeys are built, even where you're not hands-on-keyboard for every send.

 - Drive go-to-market for active trader and crypto products and benefits — options, futures, margin, USD, and crypto (spread pricing, coin selection, staking) — coordinating paid, lifecycle, web, and product surfaces into a single launch, and owning the brief end to end.

 - Build and maintain clear reporting across the trader and crypto funnel — first touch through sign-up, funding, first trade, and retained trading value. Partner with Analytics on incrementality and true lift, and make clear recommendations on where to double down, test, or pull back.

 - Run a consistent testing cadence across creative, audiences, offers, and landing pages, and turn what you learn into repeatable programs.

 - Actively embed AI tools into performance and lifecycle workflows — creative and copy iteration, audience research, landing page iteration, and campaign experimentation.

 - Contribute to the quarterly plan alongside other Growth leads, then own delivery against it.
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4–6 years in performance marketing, growth, or lifecycle marketing with a track record of generating high-quality consumer demand and optimizing it through to downstream value.

 - Deep hands-on experience in paid media — you've owned budgets and managed campaigns across platforms like Google, Meta, X, YouTube, or programmatic, negotiated with vendors, and optimized for downstream value rather than cost per click.

 - Lifecycle marketing depth — you've built or owned activation, onboarding, nurture, or re-engagement journeys and understand how lifecycle compounds the demand you generate. Hands-on with a lifecycle platform (Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar) is strongly preferred; at minimum you bring the best practices and can direct the work.

 - Experience marketing to engaged, high-intent audiences who know the product and compare it closely to alternatives — you understand how messaging, channel mix, and creative shift for that kind of buyer.

 - Strong cross-functional partnering — you've worked closely with Product and Analytics (segment definitions, funnel diagnosis, incrementality) and Product Marketing (messaging, GTM briefs), and made those relationships an advantage.

 - A demonstrated habit of using AI to accelerate your work — creative at scale, research and enrichment workflows, faster insight from data. You treat AI as a core part of how you work.

 - Analytical mindset — you use data to diagnose funnel problems, prioritize opportunities, and recommend change, not just report on results.
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Personal or professional familiarity with self-directed investing, active trading, or crypto — options, margin, futures, high-frequency trading, or digital assets — and the platforms and communities traders live in (X/FinTwit, TradingView, trading and crypto newsletters, YouTube).

 - Experience running go-to-market for a product or benefit launch across paid, lifecycle, and product surfaces.

 - Experience in consumer fintech, investing, brokerage, trading, or crypto platforms.




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

About Xanadu: 

Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere.

And that is something to be excited about!

 Your role and responsibilities:
 Xanadu is looking for a Director, Total Rewards to lead the evolution and day-to-day delivery of our global compensation, equity and benefits programs.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role will be both a strategic partner and hands-on leader. You will help shape Xanadu’s Total Rewards philosophy and build the programs, practices and governance required for our next stage as a public company, while ensuring our core reward programs operate effectively every day.

You will partner closely with the Chief People Officer on executive compensation, equity strategy, and Compensation Committee matters. At the same time, you will remain close to the work — leading compensation cycles, developing analyses and recommendations, overseeing equity and benefits programs, solving complex compensation issues and building the infrastructure required to scale.

Xanadu operates in a highly specialized and competitive talent market. Our ability to attract, retain and motivate exceptional scientific, technical and business talent is critical to our success. The Director, Total Rewards will help ensure our approach to compensation and equity reflects the talent we compete for, our stage of development and financial model, and our responsibilities as a public company.

The successful candidate will bring strong Total Rewards expertise, sound business and financial judgment, and the ability to translate strategy into practical solutions. They will be equally comfortable discussing compensation philosophy with senior leaders, building a compensation model, or working through an individual compensation decision.

 Total Rewards Strategy & Architecture

- Build reward programs that help Xanadu attract, retain and motivate exceptional talent while supporting performance, internal equity, affordability and long-term shareholder value.

- Develop and maintain compensation architecture, including job levels, market benchmarks, salary ranges and approaches to geographic and talent-market differentiation.

- Balance the use of cash and equity to create a compelling employee value proposition while supporting responsible capital and equity utilization.

- Translate Total Rewards strategy into clear policies, programs, governance and operating practices that can scale with the organization.

- Monitor external talent, compensation, economic and regulatory developments and recommend changes as Xanadu and the competitive landscape evolve.

 Executive Compensation & Public Company Governance

- Develop analyses, recommendations and materials for the Compensation Committee, including executive compensation, incentive design, benchmarking, peer groups and equity programs.

- Lead executive compensation benchmarking and modeling and provide advice on compensation arrangements for executives and other senior leaders.

- Partner with Legal, Finance and external advisors on executive compensation disclosure and applicable securities, stock exchange and governance requirements in Canada and the United States.

- Maintain strong compensation governance, controls and documentation appropriate for a public company environment.

- Support the design and ongoing evolution of short- and long-term incentive programs that align leadership outcomes with company performance and long-term shareholder value.

 Equity & Long-Term Incentives

- Lead the evolution and operation of Xanadu’s equity and long-term incentive programs, balancing attraction and retention, performance alignment, employee value, shareholder interests and responsible equity utilization.

- Develop modeling and recommendations related to equity participation, grant practices, share-pool utilization, dilution and burn rate.

- Oversee the administration of RSUs, stock options and other equity programs, including grant processes, vesting, reporting and employee support.

- Partner with Legal and Finance on equity governance, controls and public-company requirements.

- Ensure employees and leaders understand the value, mechanics and intent of Xanadu’s equity programs.

 Global Compensation & Benefits

- Lead Xanadu’s annual compensation processes, including salary reviews, promotions, incentive planning and bonus payouts.

- Provide hands-on compensation advice and decision support to the People team, leaders and Talent Acquisition on offers, promotions, retention situations and other complex compensation matters.

- Establish clear governance for compensation decisions, including offer ranges, exceptions and approval authorities.

- Lead the ongoing assessment and evolution of health, welfare, retirement and wellness programs, balancing employee value, market competitiveness and cost.

- Manage key Total Rewards vendors, consultants and brokers and ensure strong service, economics and governance.

- Ensure compensation and benefits practices comply with applicable pay transparency, pay equity, statutory benefits and other regulatory requirements.

- Partner on global mobility and international employment matters where Total Rewards expertise is required and help develop scalable approaches as Xanadu’s international footprint evolves.

 Analytics, Operations & Infrastructure

- Develop clear reporting on compensation costs, equity utilization, market competitiveness, pay equity and other key Total Rewards measures.

- Partner with Finance on compensation forecasting, budgeting and scenario modeling.

- Ensure Total Rewards data, processes and controls are accurate, efficient, scalable and audit-ready.

- Optimize HiBob as the core People platform supporting compensation architecture, employee data and Total Rewards processes, and ensure effective integration with Shareworks, payroll and other supporting systems.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- Significant progressive experience in Total Rewards, with deep expertise across compensation, equity, executive rewards and benefits.

- Experience operating in a public company environment, including executive compensation, equity programs and Compensation Committee or Board support.

- Direct Total Rewards experience across both Canada and the United States, with a strong understanding of the different compensation, benefits, regulatory and market environments.

- Experience developing compensation architecture, market benchmarking, incentive programs and equity strategies.

- Hands-on experience with Shareworks, including public-company equity administration, grants, reporting and employee equity programs.

- Strong working experience with HiBob or similar HRIS systems to support compensation, employee data and Total Rewards processes.

- Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to advise senior leaders and contribute effectively to Board and Compensation Committee discussions.

- A collaborative working style and demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition and business leaders.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where it does not yet exist.

- A willingness to be hands-on: comfortable getting into the details, solving problems, and doing the work required to move the organization forward.
 Preferred qualifications and experience:

- Experience in a technology, deep-tech, R&D-intensive or similarly specialized talent environment.

- Experience helping an organization mature its Total Rewards practices following an IPO or during a period of significant organizational evolution.

- Experience balancing cash and equity compensation in an organization where equity is an important component of the employee value proposition and capital stewardship is critical.

- Experience with global mobility, international benefits and cross-border compensation matters.

- CCP, CEP or other relevant professional designation.

Working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Security and business stakeholders, you’ll design, build, and own the core infrastructure and data models that power data-driven decision-making across the organization.

 What You’ll Do 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics data models that support reporting, business intelligence, product analytics, and operational decision-making.

- Build and manage trusted data pipelines and transformation workflows using modern analytics engineering practices.

- Partner with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Design, Strategy & Operations, and AI Platform to understand business needs and translate them into effective data solutions.

- Establish clear definitions, metrics, dimensions, and data contracts to create consistency across teams and use cases.

- Develop reusable datasets and semantic models that enable self-service analytics and reduce duplicated work.

- Improve the reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability of analytics infrastructure.

- Implement data quality checks, testing, documentation, lineage, and monitoring for critical data assets.

- Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to optimize data architecture, warehouse performance, and transformation workflows.

- Work with analysts, data scientists, and business partners to ensure data products are intuitive, discoverable, and fit for purpose.

- Help establish best practices for analytics engineering, including version control, code review, CI/CD, documentation, and deployment standards.

- Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 What You’ll Bring 

- 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or a related field.

- Strong SQL skills, including experience developing complex queries and dimensional data models.

- Experience building and maintaining analytics transformations using tools such as dbt or comparable frameworks.

- Proficiency in Python or another programming language used for data processing and automation.

- Experience working with modern cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.

- Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layers.

- Experience implementing data quality testing, monitoring, documentation, and observability practices.

- Demonstrated ability to partner with cross-functional stakeholders and translate ambiguous business questions into scalable data solutions.

- Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

- A thoughtful approach to data governance, security, privacy, and responsible use of data.

- Familiarity with data cataloging and lineage tools.

 Our Tech Stack 

- Warehousing : Snowflake as the primary warehouse; BigQuery for GCP-native workloads

- Ingestion : Fivetran for SaaS-to-Snowflake pulls; Airflow (on AWS) for custom DAGs, Lambda-based extraction, and S3 staging

- Modeling : dbt for transformation and semantic layer definition

- Custom compute : Databricks for bespoke modeling work that doesn't fit cleanly into dbt/Snowflake

- Infrastructure : Terraform for managing Fivetran connections, GCP infrastructure, and AWS resources

- Version control & CI/CD : GitHub

- Consumption : Tableau dashboards; internal tools built on top of semantic data layers

 As Senior Manager of FP&A , you'll own financial partnership across R&D, G&A, and Cost of Sales — working directly with the CTO, CPO, CFO, and other functional leaders as their primary finance counterpart. You'll translate complex operational activity into clear financial narratives, build the models that drive decisions, and show up as the finance partner your business partners actually want to call. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable building a bottoms-up headcount model one day and challenging a business leader's assumptions the next.

- Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with sharp variance analysis and a clear point of view; not just a slide of numbers.

- Contribute to core FP&A processes including monthly flux and variance analysis, Board narrative support, and ELT forecast reporting.

- Support the Director of FP&A in maintaining and improving corporate financial systems, rollforwards, and planning infrastructure.
